nodes.title: ViNT: A Foundation Model for Visual Navigation
nodes.tldr: ViNT is a transformer foundation model for visual navigation trained on diverse robot datasets, adaptable to new tasks via prompt-tuning and diffusion goal proposals.
nodes.problem: General-purpose pretrained models for vision-based robotic navigation across platforms and tasks.
nodes.approach: Transformer trained on multi-robot navigation data with goal-token adaptation and diffusion subgoal proposals.
nodes.niche_reason: Robot navigation foundation models are specialised but growing.

nodes.title: RVT: Robotic View Transformer for 3D Object Manipulation
nodes.tldr: Multi-view transformer that re-renders camera inputs from virtual views, beating the 3D-voxel method PerAct on RLBench while training 36x faster.
nodes.problem: Explicit 3D representations like voxels are accurate for manipulation but too costly to scale.
nodes.approach: Attention across views plus re-rendering from virtual viewpoints around the workspace, trained from few demonstrations.
nodes.niche_reason: Multi-view transformers for manipulation are a common approach

nodes.title: Robot Learning with Sensorimotor Pre-training
nodes.tldr: RPT pre-trains a masked Transformer over camera, proprioception and action tokens on 20,000 real robot trajectories, improving transfer across tasks and robots.
nodes.problem: Robot policies trained from scratch lack reusable models of physical-world dynamics.
nodes.approach: Self-supervised masked prediction over latent sensorimotor token sequences.
nodes.confidence_reason: Robot pretraining fits foundation models or self-supervised learning.
nodes.niche_reason: Established but specialised: sensorimotor pretraining for robots.

nodes.title: Robots That Ask For Help: Uncertainty Alignment for Large Language Model Planners
nodes.tldr: KnowNo uses conformal prediction to calibrate LLM planners' uncertainty, so robots ask for human help only when needed, with statistical task-completion guarantees.
nodes.problem: LLM robot planners hallucinate confidently, yet should know when to ask for help.
nodes.approach: Conformal prediction on LLM planner outputs sets help-request thresholds, with no finetuning.
nodes.niche_reason: Uncertainty-aware LLM robot planning is specialised but growing.

nodes.title: RoboCook: Long-Horizon Elasto-Plastic Object Manipulation with Diverse Tools
nodes.tldr: Robot learns long-horizon elasto-plastic manipulation with varied tools, using point-cloud GNN tool-object models and self-supervised planning from brief real data.
nodes.problem: Robots struggle with long-horizon soft-body manipulation requiring tool use and tool-object interaction understanding.
nodes.approach: Point-cloud GNN dynamics for tool-object interactions, tool classification, and self-supervised policy learning.
nodes.niche_reason: Tool-use soft-object manipulation is specialised but established

nodes.title: Measuring Interpretability of Neural Policies of Robots with Disentangled Representation
nodes.tldr: Introduces interpretability metrics for compact robot neural policies based on disentangled representations, using decision trees for factors and measuring decision concentration, mutual information and modularity.
nodes.problem: Quantitatively measuring interpretability of learned robot neural policies.
nodes.approach: Decision-tree-derived factors of variation and disentanglement-based metrics: concentration, mutual information, modularity.
nodes.niche_reason: Quantitative interpretability of robot policies is rare.

nodes.title: How to Learn and Generalize From Three Minutes of Data: Physics-Constrained and Uncertainty-Aware Neural Stochastic Differential Equations
nodes.tldr: Learns physics-informed neural SDE dynamics with distance-aware uncertainty, enabling accurate long-horizon predictions from only minutes of data.
nodes.problem: Learning controllable dynamics from small datasets that generalize poorly beyond training states.
nodes.approach: Neural SDE with physics-based drift and a diffusion term that grows for states far from training data.
secondary_topics: Reinforcement Learning › Model-Based RL & World Models
nodes.niche_reason: Specialised: physics-informed neural SDEs for robot control.

nodes.title: Stabilize to Act: Learning to Coordinate for Bimanual Manipulation
nodes.tldr: BUDS splits bimanual tasks into a stabilizing arm and an acting arm, learning restabilization and acting policies from 20 demonstrations for tasks like zipping jackets.
nodes.problem: High-dimensional bimanual action space makes coordinated dual-arm policies hard to learn.
nodes.approach: Role assignment framework with a learned restabilizing classifier and demonstration-learned acting policy.
nodes.niche_reason: Bimanual structured learning is established but specialised.

nodes.title: VoxPoser: Composable 3D Value Maps for Robotic Manipulation with Language Models
nodes.tldr: VoxPoser has LLMs write code composing 3D value maps with a VLM, and uses model-based planning to zero-shot synthesize robot trajectories for open-set manipulation tasks.
nodes.problem: Robot manipulation relies on predefined motion primitives, limiting open-set instructions and objects.
nodes.approach: LLMs infer affordances and constraints, code-write 3D value maps grounded by a VLM, then plan closed-loop trajectories.
nodes.confidence_reason: LLM-driven value maps blend foundation-model and motion-planning topics.
nodes.niche_reason: LLM-driven robot manipulation is a crowded, fast-moving area.

nodes.title: Surrogate Assisted Generation of Human-Robot Interaction Scenarios
nodes.tldr: Uses surrogate models that predict human and robot behavior to generate diverse failure scenarios for human-robot interaction systems more efficiently than full simulation.
nodes.problem: Evaluating HRI systems by simulating generated scenarios is computationally expensive and limits complex domains.
nodes.approach: Augment quality-diversity scenario generation with surrogate predictors of human and robot behavior, validated on shared-control teleoperation.
nodes.niche_reason: Failure-scenario generation for HRI with surrogates is a rare niche.

nodes.title: Diff-LfD: Contact-aware Model-based Learning from Visual Demonstration for Robotic Manipulation via Differentiable Physics-based Simulation and Rendering
nodes.tldr: Learns manipulation from demonstration videos by estimating object poses with differentiable rendering and optimizing contacts in differentiable simulation.
nodes.problem: Learning manipulation from visual demonstration without hand-designed reward functions
nodes.approach: Differentiable rendering for pose and shape plus differentiable-simulation contact sequence optimization
nodes.confidence_reason: Model-based simulation versus demonstration learning framing overlaps
nodes.niche_reason: Differentiable-physics learning from demonstration is specialised

nodes.title: PreCo: Enhancing Generalization in Co-Design of Modular Soft Robots via Brain-Body Pre-Training
nodes.tldr: Pre-trains a universal brain-body co-design policy across tasks, enabling zero-shot initial designs and fast fine-tuning for modular soft robots.
nodes.problem: Co-designing soft robot morphology and control from scratch is slow and costly.
nodes.approach: Pre-train a universal co-designer on diverse tasks, then fine-tune it for new co-design tasks.
secondary_topics: Reinforcement Learning › Transfer, Meta & Continual RL
nodes.niche_reason: Rare: pretrained co-design for modular soft robots.

nodes.title: Intent-Aware Planning in Heterogeneous Traffic via Distributed Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
nodes.tldr: Distributed MARL where agents infer nearby drivers' intents from local observations and plan with explicit behavioral and instant incentives.
nodes.problem: Autonomous vehicles cannot infer nearby drivers' intentions in dense, heterogeneous traffic.
nodes.approach: Two-level incentive model with distributed MARL for joint trajectory and intent prediction.
nodes.confidence_reason: Driving application vs multi-agent RL contribution is a judgment call.
nodes.niche_reason: Distributed MARL for driver intent inference is specialised but established.

nodes.title: Finetuning Offline World Models in the Real World
nodes.tldr: Pretrains a world model on offline real-robot data, then finetunes online with planning regularized by epistemic model uncertainty for few-shot adaptation.
nodes.problem: Real-robot RL is data-hungry, and offline RL suffers distribution shift and limited task transfer.
nodes.approach: Offline world model pretraining, then online finetuning with test-time planner regularized by return and uncertainty.
nodes.primary_topic: Reinforcement Learning › Model-Based RL & World Models
nodes.niche_reason: Model-based and offline-to-online RL are common research themes.

nodes.title: Distilled Feature Fields Enable Few-Shot Language-Guided Manipulation
nodes.tldr: Distills 2D foundation-model features into 3D feature fields for few-shot 6-DOF grasping and placing targeted by free-text language.
nodes.problem: 2D image features lack the 3D geometry needed for robotic manipulation.
nodes.approach: Feature fields combining accurate 3D geometry with CLIP semantics for few-shot grasp and place.
secondary_topics: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: language-guided feature-field manipulation is specialised

nodes.title: Language to Rewards for Robotic Skill Synthesis
nodes.tldr: An LLM writes reward parameters that a real-time MPC optimizer turns into robot motions, letting users steer skills interactively.
nodes.problem: LLMs struggle to command low-level, hardware-dependent robot actions, which are underrepresented in their training data.
nodes.approach: LLM-generated reward functions optimised by MuJoCo MPC, bridging language instructions to low-level control.
secondary_topics: Reinforcement Learning › Reward Learning, Inverse RL & Preferences
nodes.niche_reason: Language-to-reward for robotics is a well-known, fairly crowded approach

nodes.title: Predicting Object Interactions with Behavior Primitives: An Application in Stowing Tasks
nodes.tldr: Learns a robot stowing policy from a simulation-trained GNN that predicts object interactions over behavior primitives, using one demonstration and primitive-augmented trajectory optimization.
nodes.problem: Automating stowing of objects into cluttered shelves is hard due to multi-object interactions and long horizons.
nodes.approach: GNN predicts object interactions in primitive parameter space; trajectory optimization searches a heterogeneous primitive library.
nodes.confidence_reason: Manipulation versus long-horizon planning placement is a judgment call.
nodes.niche_reason: Robot manipulation with learned dynamics is a common direction.

nodes.title: HANDLOOM: Learned Tracing of One-Dimensional Objects for Inspection and Manipulation
nodes.tldr: Presents HANDLOOM, a learned autoregressive tracer that estimates the trace of long cables from greyscale images, enabling state-based knot tying and untangling.
nodes.problem: Estimating the spatial state of long, crossing deformable linear objects like cables for manipulation.
nodes.approach: Neural networks trained on simulated and real examples predict cable traces and classify crossings autoregressively.
nodes.niche_reason: Cable tracing for knot manipulation is a rare niche

nodes.title: DATT: Deep Adaptive Trajectory Tracking for Quadrotor Control
nodes.tldr: RL-trained feedforward-feedback-adaptive quadrotor controller with L1 disturbance estimation tracks infeasible trajectories under strong wind without hardware fine-tuning.
nodes.problem: Precisely tracking arbitrary quadrotor trajectories under unknown nonlinear dynamics, infeasibility, and actuation limits.
nodes.approach: Feedforward-feedback-adaptive control structure trained in simulation with RL, plus an L1 adaptive disturbance estimator.
nodes.niche_reason: Learned quadrotor control is specialised but established.

nodes.title: Bootstrap Your Own Skills: Learning to Solve New Tasks with Large Language Model Guidance
nodes.tldr: BOSS bootstraps a skill library by letting an agent practice LLM-suggested skill chains without task rewards, enabling zero-shot execution of unseen long-horizon household tasks.
nodes.problem: Learning new long-horizon tasks without expert demonstrations or rich reward functions.
nodes.approach: Skill bootstrapping: LLM guides chaining of primitive skills to practice and add new skills.
nodes.niche_reason: LLM-guided skill acquisition is specialised but growing.

nodes.title: GNFactor: Multi-Task Real Robot Learning with Generalizable Neural Feature Fields
nodes.tldr: GNFactor is a visual behavior cloning agent that jointly trains NeRF reconstruction and a Perceiver policy over a shared semantic 3D voxel representation.
nodes.problem: Robots need 3D scene understanding to perform diverse manipulation tasks from few real-world demonstrations.
nodes.approach: NeRF-based 3D voxel features with distilled vision-language semantics feeding a Perceiver policy.
secondary_topics: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: NeRF-feature behavior cloning is an established specialised niche.

nodes.title: Hijacking Robot Teams Through Adversarial Communication
nodes.tldr: Black-box attack on learned multi-agent RL policies that manipulates only inter-agent communication, inferring rewards by imitation, and demonstrated on real swarm robots.
nodes.problem: Communication in robot teams is vulnerable to adversarial manipulation of learned MARL policies.
nodes.approach: Imitate target policies from observed behavior, infer rewards, and craft adversarial communication signals.
nodes.niche_reason: Adversarial attacks on multi-robot communication are rare.

nodes.title: HACMan: Learning Hybrid Actor-Critic Maps for 6D Non-Prehensile Manipulation
nodes.tldr: RL with a hybrid action space that picks a contact point on an object point cloud plus motion parameters, enabling zero-shot sim-to-real non-prehensile manipulation.
nodes.problem: Non-prehensile 6D object manipulation needs reasoning about gripper-object contact without grasping.
nodes.approach: Object-centric contact-location and motion-parameter action representation learned by a modified off-policy RL algorithm.
secondary_topics: Reinforcement Learning › Online & Deep RL Algorithms
nodes.niche_reason: Non-prehensile 6D manipulation is established but specialised

nodes.title: Continual Vision-based Reinforcement Learning with Group Symmetries
nodes.tldr: Continual vision-based RL that groups tasks related by rotations or translations and trains one equivariant policy per group.
nodes.problem: Continual RL learns redundant policies for visually symmetric tasks, wasting sample efficiency.
nodes.approach: PPO with equivariant feature extractor and Wasserstein-based unsupervised task grouping.
nodes.primary_topic: Reinforcement Learning › Transfer, Meta & Continual RL
nodes.niche_reason: Symmetry-aware continual vision RL is a specialised niche.

nodes.title: MimicPlay: Long-Horizon Imitation Learning by Watching Human Play
nodes.tldr: MimicPlay learns latent plans from human play videos to guide low-level visuomotor control trained on few teleoperated demos, improving long-horizon manipulation success and robustness.
nodes.problem: Long-horizon imitation learning requires too many robot demonstrations.
nodes.approach: Hierarchical framework: latent plans from human play data guide a low-level policy trained on small teleoperation data.
nodes.niche_reason: Imitation learning from human video is a crowded robotics topic.

nodes.title: Language Embedded Radiance Fields for Zero-Shot Task-Oriented Grasping
nodes.tldr: LERF-TOGO grasps objects by task-relevant part zero-shot, querying a CLIP-distilled language radiance field conditioned on DINO-extracted 3D object masks to rank grasps.
nodes.problem: Task-oriented grasping needs part-level semantic targeting, but language fields lack object boundaries.
nodes.approach: Build LERF, extract 3D object mask via DINO features, query LERF within the mask to rank grasp candidates.
secondary_topics: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: Language fields for grasping are a specialised intersection.

nodes.title: Language-Guided Traffic Simulation via Scene-Level Diffusion
nodes.tldr: Scene-level conditional diffusion model for traffic simulation that uses an LLM to turn language instructions into guidance loss functions for controllable, realistic traffic.
nodes.problem: Controlling learning-based traffic simulators requires domain expertise and is hard for practitioners.
nodes.approach: Spatio-temporal transformer scene diffusion guided by LLM-generated loss functions from user language queries.
nodes.niche_reason: Language-controlled traffic simulation is specialised.

nodes.title: Rearrangement Planning for General Part Assembly
nodes.tldr: Transformer predicting precise part poses for novel shapes in a target assembly by inferring part-target correspondence, generalizing to real scans.
nodes.problem: Robotic assembly works only for single targets or categories, not general assemblies with unseen part shapes.
nodes.approach: Transformer model inferring part-to-target shape correspondence to predict each part's pose, tested on CAD and real scans.
nodes.confidence_reason: Assembly pose prediction sits between manipulation and task planning.
nodes.niche_reason: General part assembly with unseen shapes is a rare robotics niche.

nodes.title: On the Utility of Koopman Operator Theory in Learning Dexterous Manipulation Skills
nodes.tldr: A Koopman operator-based imitation learning framework learns dexterous manipulation policies analytically, matching state-of-the-art success rates while being an order of magnitude faster.
nodes.problem: Learning dexterous manipulation is computationally heavy, hard to interpret and sensitive to initialization.
nodes.approach: Represent hand-object dynamics as linear systems via Koopman operators and solve policies analytically from demonstrations.
nodes.confidence_reason: Both dexterous manipulation and imitation learning fit as primary.
nodes.niche_reason: Koopman theory for manipulation policies is rare.

nodes.title: Task-Oriented Koopman-Based Control with Contrastive Encoder
nodes.tldr: Jointly learns Koopman embedding, operator and linear controller via end-to-end RL with a contrastive encoder, extending Koopman control to pixel tasks and a lidar robot.
nodes.problem: Koopman-based control has been limited to low-dimensional systems and requires well-identified models.
nodes.approach: Task-cost-driven end-to-end RL with contrastive encoder learning the Koopman embedding and linear controller.
secondary_topics: Reinforcement Learning › Model-Based RL & World Models
nodes.niche_reason: Koopman-based learned control is an unusual niche within robot learning.

nodes.title: Robot Parkour Learning
nodes.tldr: Learns a single end-to-end vision-based parkour policy for a quadruped by training skills with RL inspired by direct collocation and distilling them, using simple rewards and no reference motions.
nodes.problem: Autonomous parkour needs diverse, vision-based legged locomotion skills without reference animal data or complex rewards.
nodes.approach: Collocation-inspired RL for individual skills, then distillation into one depth-vision policy transferred sim-to-real.
nodes.niche_reason: Agile legged locomotion is established but specialised.

nodes.title: SayPlan: Grounding Large Language Models using 3D Scene Graphs for Scalable Robot Task Planning
nodes.tldr: Grounds LLM task planning in large 3D scene graphs via hierarchical semantic search, classical path planning, and simulator-feedback replanning.
nodes.problem: LLM plans are hard to ground in large multi-floor, multi-room environments.
nodes.approach: Hierarchical 3D scene graph search with path-planner integration and iterative simulator replanning.
secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › Agents & Tool Use
nodes.niche_reason: LLM-for-robot-planning is common; scene-graph grounding is less so.

nodes.title: Expansive Latent Planning for Sparse Reward Offline Reinforcement Learning
nodes.tldr: VELAP plans waypoints by sampling in a learned latent space, growing a tree of visited latents to solve sparse-reward vision-based manipulation offline.
nodes.problem: Sampling-based planners such as RRT scale poorly to high-dimensional inputs and need privileged knowledge.
nodes.approach: Iteratively expanded tree-based memory of visited latent areas, used for sampling-based exploration in a learned embedding.
secondary_topics: Reinforcement Learning › Model-Based RL & World Models
nodes.niche_reason: Sampling-based latent planning for offline RL; specialised

nodes.title: One Model to Drift Them All: Physics-Informed Conditional Diffusion Model for Driving at the Limits
nodes.tldr: Learns a conditional diffusion model over physics-informed dynamics parameters, used in real-time MPC to enable autonomous drifting on two vehicles across road conditions.
nodes.problem: Reliable autonomous driving at the limits of handling under uncertain vehicle and road properties.
nodes.approach: Conditional diffusion over physics-informed dynamics parameters, conditioned on online measurements, inside model predictive control.
nodes.niche_reason: Autonomous drifting at handling limits is a rare application niche.

nodes.title: Robot See Robot Do: Imitating Articulated Object Manipulation with Monocular 4D Reconstruction
nodes.tldr: Robot See Robot Do imitates articulated object manipulation from one monocular human video by recovering 3D part motion and replanning bimanual robot arm trajectories.
nodes.problem: Robots need demonstrations of articulated object manipulation without task-specific training.
nodes.approach: 4D Differentiable Part Models recover part motion via analysis-by-synthesis; robot plans arm motions to replicate it.
nodes.niche_reason: Video-based imitation of articulated objects is specialised but growing.

nodes.title: FREA: Feasibility-Guided Generation of Safety-Critical Scenarios with Reasonable Adversariality
nodes.tldr: Generates adversarial yet AV-feasible driving scenarios by guiding adversarial background-vehicle policies with the autonomous vehicle's largest feasible region.
nodes.problem: Safety-critical scenario generation can be excessively adversarial, producing unavoidable collisions that are useless for testing AVs.
nodes.approach: Precompute the AV's largest feasible region and train an adversarial policy maximizing a feasibility-dependent objective.
nodes.niche_reason: Scenario generation for AV testing is established but specialised.

nodes.title: RAM: Retrieval-Based Affordance Transfer for Generalizable Zero-Shot Robotic Manipulation
nodes.tldr: RAM builds an affordance memory from robot, human-object-interaction and custom data, then hierarchically retrieves and transfers affordances for zero-shot manipulation.
nodes.problem: Zero-shot robotic manipulation without expensive in-domain demonstrations.
nodes.approach: Retrieval-based affordance transfer from a unified affordance memory built from diverse out-of-domain data.
nodes.niche_reason: Retrieval-based affordance transfer is moderately specialised.

nodes.title: Guided Reinforcement Learning for Robust Multi-Contact Loco-Manipulation
nodes.tldr: Learns robust RL policies for multi-contact loco-manipulation from a single trajectory-optimized demonstration per task, transferred to a real legged robot.
nodes.problem: RL for contact-rich loco-manipulation needs meticulous, task-specific MDP design.
nodes.approach: Task-independent MDP with one model-based trajectory-optimized demonstration as guidance.
nodes.confidence_reason: Loco-manipulation with RL and trajectory optimization; topic is a judgment call
nodes.niche_reason: Guided RL for legged loco-manipulation is specialised.

nodes.title: Physically Embodied Gaussian Splatting: A Visually Learnt and Physically Grounded 3D Representation for Robotics
nodes.tldr: Pairs particles that carry physics with attached 3D Gaussians, so a robot can predict future states and correct them online from visual observations.
nodes.problem: Robots need a representation of geometry, physics, and visuals that predicts futures and stays synced with reality.
nodes.approach: Dual Gaussian-particle representation; image mismatch produces visual forces that correct particle positions.
secondary_topics: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.confidence_reason: Robot world representation mixing physics and Gaussian rendering; topic is close
nodes.niche_reason: Coupling particle physics with Gaussian splatting for robots is rare

nodes.title: Scaling Cross-Embodied Learning: One Policy for Manipulation, Navigation, Locomotion and Aviation
nodes.tldr: CrossFormer is a transformer policy trained on 900K trajectories from 20 robot embodiments, controlling arms, wheeled robots, quadcopters and quadrupeds with shared weights.
nodes.problem: Robot learning lacks datasets per platform, and multi-robot data has mismatched sensors, actions and control rates.
nodes.approach: A flexible transformer that consumes any embodiment's observations and actions without manual space alignment.
nodes.niche_reason: Generalist cross-embodiment policies are a fast-growing mainstream direction.

nodes.title: Bridging the Sim-to-Real Gap from the Information Bottleneck Perspective
nodes.tldr: Frames sim-to-real transfer from the information bottleneck perspective, learning from privileged simulation information while limiting reliance on it for real-world proprioceptive locomotion.
nodes.problem: Existing methods underuse privileged simulator information when only local states exist in the real world.
nodes.approach: Information-bottleneck objective encouraging latent representations that retain privileged knowledge useful for proprioceptive policies.
secondary_topics: Reinforcement Learning › Transfer, Meta & Continual RL
nodes.niche_reason: Sim-to-real for locomotion is common; the information-theoretic angle is less so.

nodes.title: WoCoCo: Learning Whole-Body Humanoid Control with Sequential Contacts
nodes.tldr: WoCoCo decomposes whole-body humanoid tasks into contact stages for RL with task-agnostic rewards, achieving real-world parkour, box loco-manipulation, dancing, and climbing without motion priors.
nodes.problem: Humanoid tasks with sequential contacts need tedious task-specific tuning and suffer long-horizon exploration issues.
nodes.approach: Decompose tasks into contact stages with task-agnostic reward and sim-to-real design for end-to-end RL.
nodes.niche_reason: Humanoid RL is active but contact-sequence framing is specialised.

nodes.title: Environment Curriculum Generation via Large Language Models
nodes.tldr: Eurekaverse uses LLM code generation to design progressively harder terrain environments, training quadruped parkour policies that transfer to the real world.
nodes.problem: Designing effective environment curricula for robot skill learning requires expert effort per domain.
nodes.approach: LLMs write environment code in an unsupervised environment design loop that adapts difficulty and diversity.
secondary_topics: Reinforcement Learning › Transfer, Meta & Continual RL
nodes.niche_reason: LLM-generated environment curricula for parkour is an unusual combination.

nodes.title: PoliFormer: Scaling On-Policy RL with Transformers Results in Masterful Navigators
nodes.tldr: RGB-only indoor navigation policy trained with large-scale on-policy RL using a vision transformer encoder and causal transformer decoder, transferring zero-shot to real robots.
nodes.problem: Building a navigation agent with long-term memory that generalizes from simulation to real robots.
nodes.approach: Massively parallel on-policy RL with a vision transformer encoder and causal transformer decoder for memory.
secondary_topics: Reinforcement Learning › Online & Deep RL Algorithms
nodes.niche_reason: Transformer RL navigation is an active but common direction.

nodes.title: Gameplay Filters: Robust Zero-Shot Safety through Adversarial Imagination
nodes.tldr: Gameplay filter: predictive safety filter that simulates matches against a co-trained adversary to veto unsafe actions, giving zero-shot full-order safety for quadrupeds.
nodes.problem: Ensuring robust safety of learned robot controllers under out-of-distribution perturbations without overly restricting agility.
nodes.approach: Adversarial reinforcement learning trains safety strategy and worst-case adversary; online rollouts filter unsafe actions.
nodes.niche_reason: Game-theoretic learned safety filters for full-order legged dynamics are uncommon.

nodes.title: Uncertainty-Aware Decision Transformer for Stochastic Driving Environments
nodes.tldr: UNREST is an uncertainty-aware decision transformer for stochastic driving that estimates uncertainty via conditional mutual information and replaces global returns with truncated returns.
nodes.problem: Return-conditioned sequence-model offline RL fails in stochastic driving environments.
nodes.approach: Conditional mutual information uncertainty estimation, truncated returns, and dynamic uncertainty-aware inference.
nodes.niche_reason: Decision transformers for stochastic driving are established but specialised.

nodes.title: Play to the Score: Stage-Guided Dynamic Multi-Sensory Fusion for Robotic Manipulation
nodes.tldr: MS-Bot uses predicted task stages to dynamically weight vision, audio and tactile modalities in imitation learning for manipulation like pouring and keyway peg insertion.
nodes.problem: Deciding which sensory modality matters at each stage of contact-rich manipulation.
nodes.approach: Coarse-to-fine stage understanding guiding dynamic multi-sensory fusion within imitation learning.
nodes.niche_reason: Audio and tactile dynamic fusion for manipulation is relatively rare.

nodes.title: TieBot: Learning to Knot a Tie from Visual Demonstration through a Real-to-Sim-to-Real Approach
nodes.tldr: TieBot learns tie-knotting from visual demonstration by reconstructing mesh subgoals, training a privileged teacher, and distilling a point-cloud student to a real dual-arm robot.
nodes.problem: Tie knotting is hard due to high deformation and long-horizon manipulation actions.
nodes.approach: Hierarchical feature matching for mesh subgoals, teacher-student policy distillation, real-to-sim-to-real.
nodes.niche_reason: Tie-knotting with deformable objects is a rare task.

nodes.title: OKAMI: Teaching Humanoid Robots Manipulation Skills through Single Video Imitation
nodes.tldr: OKAMI lets humanoid robots imitate manipulation from a single RGB-D human video via object-aware retargeting, then trains closed-loop visuomotor policies from its rollouts.
nodes.problem: Teaching humanoids manipulation skills from one video without costly teleoperation.
nodes.approach: Object-aware motion retargeting with open-world vision models, then policy distillation from generated rollouts.
nodes.niche_reason: Humanoid video imitation is specialised but active.

nodes.title: D$^3$Fields: Dynamic 3D Descriptor Fields for Zero-Shot Generalizable Rearrangement
nodes.tldr: Implicit 3D descriptor fields that map any 3D point to fused foundation-model features and instance masks, enabling zero-shot goal-specified rearrangement.
nodes.problem: Robot scene representations rarely combine 3D geometry, dynamics and semantics for manipulation.
nodes.approach: Project 3D points onto multi-view 2D foundation-model features and interpolate them into a dynamic descriptor field.
secondary_topics: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: Foundation-feature 3D fields for manipulation are a common recent theme.

nodes.title: Learning Quadruped Locomotion Using Differentiable Simulation
nodes.tldr: A differentiable simulation framework decouples contact-heavy whole-body dynamics into continuous domains, letting quadrupeds learn locomotion in minutes with better sample efficiency than PPO and zero-shot real-world transfer.
nodes.problem: Differentiable simulation struggles with discontinuous contact dynamics, limiting its use for legged robot control.
nodes.approach: Decouple simulation into two continuous domains and align with a precise non-differentiable simulator for first-order gradient policy learning.
nodes.niche_reason: Differentiable simulation for legged control is established but specialised.

nodes.title: Visual Whole-Body Control for Legged Loco-Manipulation
nodes.tldr: Visual whole-body control for legged arms that uses legs and arm together to extend reach, trained in simulation and deployed via Sim2Real.
nodes.problem: Legged robots with arms cannot reach objects far outside the arm's own workspace.
nodes.approach: Two-level policy: low-level all-DoF tracking, high-level visual velocity and end-effector commands.
nodes.confidence_reason: Legged locomotion versus manipulation is a judgment call.
nodes.niche_reason: Visual whole-body control for legged manipulators is specialised.

nodes.title: RoVi-Aug: Robot and Viewpoint Augmentation for Cross-Embodiment Robot Learning
nodes.tldr: RoVi-Aug uses generative image-to-image models to synthesize demonstrations with different robots and camera views, enabling zero-shot cross-embodiment policy transfer and multi-robot co-training.
nodes.problem: Robot datasets are imbalanced in robot types and camera angles, causing overfitting and poor embodiment transfer.
nodes.approach: Diffusion-based robot and viewpoint augmentation of demonstration images, used for training or co-training policies.
nodes.niche_reason: Cross-embodiment data augmentation via generative models is specialised.

nodes.title: Reinforcement Learning with Foundation Priors: Let Embodied Agent Efficiently Learn on Its Own
nodes.tldr: RLFP uses policy, value, and success-reward foundation models to guide RL, with Foundation-guided Actor-Critic achieving sample-efficient real-robot manipulation without manual reward engineering.
nodes.problem: Real-world robot RL is data-hungry and needs heavy manual reward design.
nodes.approach: Foundation-guided actor-critic leveraging foundation model priors for guidance and automatic rewards.
nodes.primary_topic: Reinforcement Learning › Reward Learning, Inverse RL & Preferences
secondary_topics: Reinforcement Learning › Online & Deep RL Algorithms
nodes.niche_reason: Foundation-model-guided robot RL is a common current theme.

nodes.title: Learning Robot Soccer from Egocentric Vision with Deep Reinforcement Learning

nodes.title: Adaptive Tracking Control of Dielectric Elastomer Soft Actuators with Viscoelastic Hysteresis Compensation

nodes.title: An Efficient Multi-solution Solver for the Inverse Kinematics of 3-Section Constant-Curvature Robots

nodes.title: AnyTeleop: A General Vision-Based Dexterous Robot Arm-Hand Teleoperation System

nodes.title: Autonomous Justification for Enabling Explainable Decision Support in Human-Robot Teaming

nodes.title: Bandit Submodular Maximization for Multi-Robot Coordination in Unpredictable and Partially Observable Environments

nodes.title: Beyond Flat GelSight Sensors: Simulation of Optical Tactile Sensors of Complex Morphologies for Sim2Real Learning

nodes.title: Bridging Active Exploration and Uncertainty-Aware Deployment Using Probabilistic Ensemble Neural Network Dynamics

nodes.title: CCIL: Context-conditioned imitation learning for urban driving

nodes.title: CLIP-Fields: Weakly Supervised Semantic Fields for Robotic Memory

nodes.title: Causal Policy Gradient for Whole-Body Mobile Manipulation

nodes.title: Cherry-Picking with Reinforcement Learning

nodes.title: Co-optimization of Morphology and Behavior of Modular Robots via Hierarchical Deep Reinforcement Learning

nodes.title: CoDEPS: Online Continual Learning for Depth Estimation and Panoptic Segmentation

nodes.title: ConceptFusion: Open-set multimodal 3D mapping

nodes.title: Concurrent Constrained Optimization of Unknown Rewards for Multi-Robot Task Allocation

nodes.title: Decentralization and Acceleration Enables Large-Scale Bundle Adjustment

nodes.title: Deep RL at Scale: Sorting Waste in Office Buildings with a Fleet of Mobile Manipulators

nodes.title: Language-Driven Representation Learning for Robotics

nodes.title: Learning and Adapting Agile Locomotion Skills by Transferring Experience

nodes.title: Metric-Free Exploration for Topological Mapping by Task and Motion Imitation in Feature Space

nodes.title: Motion Planning (In)feasibility Detection using a Prior Roadmap via Path and Cut Search
nodes.tldr: Detects infeasible motion planning queries on a prior roadmap via iterative path and cut search, reducing costly edge collision checks.

nodes.title: MultiSCOPE: Disambiguating In-Hand Object Poses with Proprioception and Tactile Feedback

nodes.title: NeuSE: Neural SE(3)-Equivariant Embedding for Consistent Spatial Understanding with Objects

nodes.title: On discrete symmetries of robotics systems: A group-theoretic and data-driven analysis

nodes.title: One Policy to Dress Them All: Learning to Dress People with Diverse Poses and Garments

nodes.title: POV-SLAM: Probabilistic Object-Aware Variational SLAM in Semi-Static Environments

nodes.title: Pre-Training for Robots: Offline RL Enables Learning New Tasks in a Handful of Trials

nodes.title: Progressive Learning for Physics-informed Neural Motion Planning

nodes.title: RADIUS: Risk-Aware, Real-Time, Reachability-Based Motion Planning

nodes.title: RT-1: Robotics Transformer for Real-World Control at Scale

nodes.tldr: InterPreT lets robots learn symbolic predicates and operators from non-expert language feedback via an LLM, compiled into PDDL for planning that generalizes.
nodes.problem: Learning abstract state representations for long-horizon robot planning without expert-engineered predicates.
nodes.approach: LLM learns predicates and operators from human language feedback, compiled on-the-fly into a PDDL domain.
nodes.niche_reason: Learning symbolic predicates from language feedback is a rare niche.

nodes.title: Imitation Bootstrapped Reinforcement Learning
nodes.tldr: IBRL trains an imitation policy first, then uses it to propose actions for online exploration and value bootstrapping, greatly improving RL with demonstrations.
nodes.problem: Sample-efficient RL from limited demonstrations without costly additional expert data.
nodes.approach: Imitation-learned policy proposes alternative actions for exploration and bootstrapped Q targets.
secondary_topics: Reinforcement Learning › Online & Deep RL Algorithms
nodes.niche_reason: Combining IL and RL for robots is a common direction.

nodes.title: Implicit Graph Search for Planning on Graphs of Convex Sets
nodes.tldr: IxG and IxG* plan on graphs of convex sets using implicit graph search interleaved with trajectory optimization, giving faster smooth planning than solving full GCS.
nodes.problem: Planning with Graphs of Convex Sets requires slow large mixed-integer convex programs.
nodes.approach: Implicit graph search (INSAT) over the convex-set graph with interleaved partial trajectory optimization.
nodes.niche_reason: Search-plus-optimization planning on GCS is a rare classical-planning topic.

nodes.title: JIGGLE: An Active Sensing Framework for Boundary Parameters Estimation in Deformable Surgical Environments
nodes.tldr: JIGGLE actively probes deformable tissue to estimate attachment points by combining a differentiable soft-body simulator with an EKF and info-gain control.
nodes.problem: Surgical automation must infer hidden tissue attachments safely without tearing under poor visibility.
nodes.approach: Differentiable soft-body simulator with extended Kalman filter, plus optimization-based active control.
nodes.confidence_reason: Surgical robotics: manipulation and healthcare overlap
nodes.niche_reason: Active sensing of tissue attachments in surgical robotics is rare

nodes.title: Keypoint Action Tokens Enable In-Context Imitation Learning in Robotics
nodes.tldr: Tokenizes visual keypoint observations and action trajectories so a text-only pretrained transformer does few-shot in-context imitation, matching diffusion policies in low-data regimes.
nodes.problem: Robot imitation learning needs many demonstrations, and visual policies struggle with few-shot data.
nodes.approach: Keypoint Action Tokens convert observations and actions into token sequences for an off-the-shelf LLM.
secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › In-context Learning & Prompting
nodes.niche_reason: Text-only transformers acting as visual imitation policies is unusual

nodes.title: Khronos: A Unified Approach for Spatio-Temporal Metric-Semantic SLAM in Dynamic Environments
nodes.tldr: Khronos unifies short-term tracking and long-term factor-graph reasoning to build dense, real-time spatio-temporal metric-semantic maps of dynamic scenes.
nodes.problem: Robots need dense spatio-temporal maps of dynamic environments, not just pose estimates.
nodes.approach: Factorizes into fast active-window tracking and a slower factor-graph process over long-term changes.
nodes.niche_reason: spatio-temporal SLAM is an emerging but established subfield

nodes.title: Language-Augmented Symbolic Planner for Open-World Task Planning
nodes.tldr: LASP lets symbolic planners work in open worlds with incomplete knowledge by using an LLM to diagnose execution errors and incrementally build the knowledge base.
nodes.problem: Symbolic planners assume complete domain knowledge, which is unavailable in open-world robot tasks.
nodes.approach: LLM diagnoses execution failures and updates missing preconditions, objects, and properties in the planner's knowledge base.
secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › Agents & Tool Use
nodes.niche_reason: LLM plus symbolic planner in open worlds is specialised.

nodes.title: Learning Any-View 6DoF Robotic Grasping in Cluttered Scenes via Neural Surface Rendering
nodes.tldr: NeuGraspNet frames 6DoF grasp detection as rendering, jointly learning local neural surface rendering and grasp quality from a single viewpoint in clutter.
nodes.problem: 6DoF grasping in cluttered scenes from a single view without extra scene exploration.
nodes.approach: Neural volumetric and surface rendering features shared between grasp generation and grasp evaluation.
secondary_topics: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: Rendering-based grasp detection is established but specialised.

nodes.title: Learning Manipulation by Predicting Interaction
nodes.tldr: Pre-trains visual representations for manipulation by predicting the transition frame and detecting the interaction object from keyframes and language, improving real-robot performance.
nodes.problem: Existing manipulation representation learning ignores interaction dynamics between objects and environment.
nodes.approach: Pre-train by predicting the transition frame and detecting the interaction object from initial/final keyframes plus instruction.
nodes.niche_reason: Robot visual pre-training is established but specialised.

nodes.title: Learning to Learn Faster from Human Feedback with Language Model Predictive Control
nodes.tldr: Fine-tunes a robot code-writing LLM on its past interactions as a transition model, using model predictive control to reduce human corrections needed.
nodes.problem: In-context feedback from humans is forgotten over long interactions, so robot code LLMs need many corrections.
nodes.approach: Frame interactions as a POMDP, train the LLM to complete prior interactions, then plan shorter success paths via MPC.
nodes.confidence_reason: Teachability spans planning, HRI, and LLM fine-tuning; primary is a judgment.
nodes.niche_reason: LLM-for-robot-code with teachability is established but specialised.

nodes.title: Leveraging Large Language Model for Heterogeneous Ad Hoc Teamwork Collaboration
nodes.tldr: An LLM-based hierarchical planner with Interactive Reflection of Thoughts lets an ad hoc robot collaborate with unknown heterogeneous teammates without training.
nodes.problem: Ad hoc robot teamwork with unknown heterogeneous teammates without prior coordination.
nodes.approach: Training-free LLM hierarchical dynamic planner with interactive reflection of thoughts and a new benchmark.
secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › Agents & Tool Use
nodes.niche_reason: LLM-driven heterogeneous ad hoc robot teamwork is rare.

nodes.title: Linear-time Differential Inverse Kinematics: an Augmented Lagrangian Perspective
nodes.tldr: Revisits differential inverse kinematics with augmented Lagrangian and ADMM, giving a Featherstone-style algorithm with linear complexity versus QP-based solvers.
nodes.problem: Equality-constrained differential inverse kinematics is typically solved with QP, whose cost grows with problem dimension.
nodes.approach: Augmented Lagrangian rigid-body dynamics algorithm combined with OSQP-style ADMM, giving linear complexity.
nodes.niche_reason: Algorithmic IK via augmented Lagrangian is specialised but established.

nodes.title: Logic-Skill Programming: An Optimization-based Approach to Sequential Skill Planning
nodes.tldr: Sequences independently learned robot skills by optimizing cumulative value functions, using tensor-train value approximations and alternating symbolic search with skill optimization.
nodes.problem: Optimal sequencing of independently learned skills is open, especially when goals are geometric, not symbolic.
nodes.approach: Optimizes cumulative skill value functions via tensor-train approximation, alternating symbolic search and subgoal optimization.
nodes.niche_reason: Skill sequencing with learned value functions is specialised

nodes.title: MIRAGE: Cross-Embodiment Zero-Shot Policy Transfer with Cross-Painting
nodes.tldr: MIRAGE enables zero-shot transfer of vision-based robot policies to unseen robot arms by masking the target robot and inpainting the source robot in real time.
nodes.problem: Transferring trained manipulation policies to robots unseen during training without extra data or finetuning.
nodes.approach: Cross-painting: mask target robot and inpaint source robot in images, with Cartesian control accounting for dynamics.
nodes.niche_reason: Cross-embodiment zero-shot transfer is active but specialised.

nodes.title: MOKA: Open-World Robotic Manipulation through Mark-Based Visual Prompting
nodes.tldr: MOKA uses VLMs with mark-based visual prompting to predict keypoint affordances and motion from free-form instructions, enabling open-world robotic manipulation without robot training data.
nodes.problem: Leveraging VLMs to control robots for open-world manipulation from language instructions.
nodes.approach: Mark-based visual prompting with point-based affordance representation and VLM keypoint reasoning converted to robot motions.
nodes.niche_reason: VLM-driven manipulation is a very active area.

nodes.title: MPCC++: Model Predictive Contouring Control for Time-Optimal Flight with Safety Constraints
nodes.tldr: Improves model predictive contouring control for drone racing with gate-safe track constraints, learned residual aerodynamics, and Bayesian optimization tuning, reaching over 80 km/h without crashes.
nodes.problem: Time-optimal quadrotor racing with safety guarantees at the limit of handling.
nodes.approach: MPCC with spatial track constraint and terminal set, residual dynamics learned from data, TuRBO hyperparameter tuning.
nodes.niche_reason: Time-optimal quadrotor MPC for racing is a rare niche.

nodes.title: Model Predictive Control for Aggressive Driving Over Uneven Terrain
nodes.tldr: Physics-based traversability constraints for rollover and ditch crossing are parallelized inside sample-based MPC, enabling safe aggressive off-road driving at 7-10 m/s on uneven terrain.
nodes.problem: Off-road vehicles at speed risk rollover and ditch failures on hills and banks that geometry-based methods mishandle.
nodes.approach: Derive physics-based traversability constraints and embed them in parallelized sample-based MPC with a low-level controller.
nodes.niche_reason: Aggressive off-road MPC on full-scale vehicles is a rare niche.

nodes.title: Motion Planning in Foliated Manifolds using Repetition Roadmap
nodes.tldr: Plans manipulation motions across foliated manifolds by reusing roadmap experience, guided by configuration distributions and tangent-chart atlases.
nodes.problem: Multi-modal constrained motion planning in foliated manifolds is expensive for manipulation.
nodes.approach: Dynamic repetition roadmap learns from prior planning attempts, with an atlas for new manifolds.
nodes.niche_reason: Foliated manifold planning is a rare constrained-planning setting

nodes.title: Multimodal Diffusion Transformer: Learning Versatile Behavior from Multimodal Goals
nodes.tldr: MDT is a diffusion transformer policy learning versatile long-horizon manipulation from image and language goals, using self-supervised auxiliary objectives for sparse language annotations.
nodes.problem: Imitation learning from datasets only partially labeled with language goals.
nodes.approach: Diffusion multimodal transformer with latent goal-conditioned state representation and two self-supervised auxiliary objectives.
nodes.niche_reason: Diffusion policies for imitation are common.

nodes.title: NaVid: Video-based VLM Plans the Next Step for Vision-and-Language Navigation
nodes.tldr: NaVid is a video-based vision-language model that plans the next navigation action from a monocular RGB stream and instruction, with no maps or depth.
nodes.problem: Generalizing vision-language navigation to unseen scenes and from simulation to real robots.
nodes.approach: Video VLM trained on navigation and web data to output next-step actions from RGB video.
nodes.niche_reason: Embodied VLM navigation is an active, fairly common direction.

nodes.title: Natural Language Can Help Bridge the Sim2Real Gap
nodes.tldr: Uses natural language descriptions of images to pretrain a domain-invariant image encoder, closing the sim-to-real visual gap for imitation-learned robot policies.
nodes.problem: Visual sim-to-real gap for image-conditioned robot policies with scarce real data.
nodes.approach: Pretrain image encoder to predict language descriptions, then train IL policy on sim plus few real demos.
nodes.niche_reason: Language as a sim-to-real bridge is a somewhat unusual angle.

nodes.title: Octo: An Open-Source Generalist Robot Policy
nodes.tldr: Octo is an open-source transformer generalist robot policy trained on 800k Open X-Embodiment trajectories that finetunes quickly to new sensors, action spaces and robots.
nodes.problem: Building open generalist robot policies that adapt efficiently to diverse sensors, action spaces and platforms.
nodes.approach: Large transformer policy pretrained on Open X-Embodiment, conditioned on language or goal images, with efficient finetuning.
nodes.niche_reason: Robot foundation models are a hot, common direction.

nodes.title: Octopi: Object Property Reasoning with Large Tactile-Language Models
nodes.tldr: Combines GelSight tactile representation learning with vision-language models to reason about object physical properties, introducing the PhysiCLeAR tactile-language dataset and the Octopi system.
nodes.problem: Physical reasoning for manipulation is limited to properties inferable from vision or language, missing tactile information.
nodes.approach: Tactile video encoder paired with a large vision-language model, minimal language fine-tuning, plus a new annotated tactile dataset.
nodes.niche_reason: Tactile-language models are very rare.

nodes.title: Offline Imitation Learning Through Graph Search and Retrieval
nodes.tldr: GSR organizes suboptimal demonstrations into a graph with pretrained features, searches for behavior values, then retrieves best actions for behavior cloning in manipulation.
nodes.problem: Learning precise manipulation from suboptimal demonstrations without unstable offline RL
nodes.approach: Graph search on pretrained representations to value behaviors, retrieval plus behavior cloning
nodes.niche_reason: Retrieval/graph-based alternative to offline RL is specialised

nodes.title: One-Shot Imitation Learning with Invariance Matching for Robotic Manipulation
nodes.tldr: Learns manipulation from one unannotated demonstration by matching invariant state regions between demo and test scene, instead of regressing end-effector pose directly.
nodes.problem: One-shot policy learning for novel manipulation tasks from a single unannotated demonstration
nodes.approach: Invariance matching of state-space regions to infer end-effector pose
nodes.niche_reason: One-shot imitation is established; invariance matching is distinctive

nodes.title: Optimal Non-Redundant Manipulator Surface Coverage with Rank-Deficient Manipulability Constraints
nodes.tldr: Plans non-revisiting surface coverage for redundant manipulators, exploiting valid kinematic singularities to cut posture reconfigurations and keep motion continuous.
nodes.problem: Existing non-revisiting coverage planners disregard singularities, forcing extra posture reconfigurations.
nodes.approach: Traverses valid singularities on discrete mesh surfaces without explicitly computing them, using finite-step optimal planning.
nodes.niche_reason: Singularity-aware manipulator coverage is a rare niche.

nodes.title: POAM: Probabilistic Online Attentive Mapping for Efficient Robotic Information Gathering
nodes.tldr: POAM gives constant-time online sparse Gaussian process updates with a non-stationary attentive kernel via variational EM, for efficient robotic information gathering.
nodes.problem: GP models for robotic information gathering are too computationally costly in large environments.
nodes.approach: Online sparse GP with attentive kernel and variational EM constant-time updates of inducing inputs and hyperparameters.
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Kernels, GPs & Nonparametrics
nodes.confidence_reason: Gaussian-process method; fits robotics mapping or probabilistic methods.
nodes.niche_reason: Online non-stationary GPs for informative sampling are rare.

nodes.title: POLICEd RL: Learning Closed-Loop Robot Control Policies with Provable Satisfaction of Hard Constraints
nodes.tldr: Makes the learned policy affine near the unsafe set to form a repulsive buffer, provably guaranteeing hard affine state constraints with black-box environments.
nodes.problem: RL with soft constraint penalties cannot guarantee hard constraint satisfaction in robot control.
nodes.approach: Affine policy region around the unsafe set acting as repulsive buffer, agnostic to the RL training algorithm.
nodes.niche_reason: Safe RL is established; provable hard-constraint angle is specialised.

nodes.title: Parallel and Proximal Linear-Quadratic Methods for Real-Time Constrained Model-Predictive Control
nodes.tldr: A parallel, proximal linear-quadratic solver for dual-regularized equality-constrained problems enables faster real-time constrained MPC, demonstrated on a quadruped robot.
nodes.problem: Whole-body model predictive control needs fast LQR subproblem solves, which are serial and costly for large problems.
nodes.approach: Rewrite the LQR recursion by block elimination, then split decision variables into parametric subproblems solved concurrently.
nodes.niche_reason: Parallel LQR solvers for real-time MPC are specialised but established.

nodes.title: Partially Observable Task and Motion Planning with Uncertainty and Risk Awareness
nodes.tldr: TAMPURA plans long-horizon manipulation and navigation under partial observability and action uncertainty, learning abstractions and reasoning risk-aware at task and controller levels.
nodes.problem: Task and motion planning assumes full observability and deterministic effects, ignoring information gathering and risk.
nodes.approach: Learn high-level abstraction from goal-conditioned controllers and solve under uncertainty before refining to continuous actions.
nodes.niche_reason: TAMP under uncertainty is established but specialised.

nodes.title: PoCo: Policy Composition from and for Heterogeneous Robot Learning
nodes.tldr: Composes diffusion policies learned from heterogeneous robot data across simulation, human videos and real robots, enabling multi-task manipulation.
nodes.problem: Pooling heterogeneous modalities and domains into one policy is prohibitively expensive and difficult.
nodes.approach: Composes diffusion-model data distributions with task-level composition and analytic cost functions applied at inference.
nodes.niche_reason: Composing policies across heterogeneous data sources is a less common approach

nodes.title: Practice Makes Perfect: Planning to Learning Skill Parameter Policies
nodes.tldr: Robot actively chooses which parameterized skills to practice by estimating and extrapolating competence, then plans with competence-aware sequencing for autonomous improvement.
nodes.problem: Robots must learn skill parameter selection for long-horizon tasks without environment resets.
nodes.approach: Competence estimation, extrapolation, and competence-aware planning for active skill practice.
nodes.niche_reason: Planning-driven active skill practice on real robots is specialised

nodes.title: Pushing the Limits of Cross-Embodiment Learning for Manipulation and Navigation
nodes.tldr: Trains a single goal-conditioned policy across arm, quadcopter, quadruped and mobile base, showing navigation data co-training improves goal-conditioned manipulation via cross-embodiment transfer.
nodes.problem: How diverse can robot embodiments be in training data while still yielding positive transfer.
nodes.approach: Single goal-reaching policy co-trained on heterogeneous manipulation and navigation data across embodiments.
nodes.niche_reason: Cross-embodiment is growing; navigation-manipulation transfer is more unusual.

nodes.title: RACER: Epistemic Risk-Sensitive RL Enables Fast Driving with Fewer Crashes
nodes.tldr: RACER combines epistemic risk-sensitive RL with an adaptive action-space curriculum, enabling fast off-road driving on a rally car with far fewer crashes during training.
nodes.problem: Avoiding catastrophic failures while learning high-speed driving with RL
nodes.approach: Risk-sensitive objective with epistemic uncertainty and expanding action bounds curriculum
nodes.niche_reason: Real-world risk-sensitive RL on vehicles is specialised.

nodes.title: RAG-Driver: Generalisable Driving Explanations with Retrieval-Augmented In-Context Multi-Modal Large Language Model Learning
nodes.tldr: Uses retrieved expert driving demonstrations as in-context examples so a multimodal LLM can produce driving actions with natural-language explanations.
nodes.problem: Explainable driving needs generalisable MLLMs, but annotated data is scarce and fine-tuning causes forgetting.
nodes.approach: Retrieval-augmented in-context learning grounded on expert demonstrations, requiring no further training.
nodes.niche_reason: Explainable driving with MLLMs is a fast-growing, crowded topic.

nodes.title: RL2AC: Reinforcement Learning-based Rapid Online Adaptive Control for Legged Robot Robust Locomotion
nodes.tldr: Adds a 1000Hz adaptive controller that provides torque compensation on top of an RL locomotion policy, improving legged robustness to loads, disturbances and sim-to-real gaps.
nodes.problem: RL locomotion policies struggle to adapt rapidly to model uncertainty, heavy loads and sim-to-real gaps.
nodes.approach: Adaptive controller combined with an RL policy, running online without simultaneous RL training.
nodes.niche_reason: RL locomotion is mainstream; adaptive-control hybrids are common.

nodes.title: RT-H: Action Hierarchies using Language
nodes.tldr: Two-level robot policy that predicts fine-grained language motions before actions, so humans can correct it in language during execution.
nodes.problem: Mapping diverse high-level tasks to low-level actions needs much more demonstration data
nodes.approach: Hierarchical policy predicting language motions as an intermediate step before actions
nodes.confidence_reason: VLA framing versus hierarchical imitation learning is a judgment call
nodes.niche_reason: Language-motion hierarchy for robot policies is unusual

nodes.title: RVT-2: Learning Precise Manipulation from Few Demonstrations
nodes.tldr: RVT-2 is a faster multitask 3D manipulation transformer that solves precise tasks from few demonstrations, reaching 82% on RLBench and learning plug insertion.
nodes.problem: Language-conditioned 3D manipulation needing high precision from few demonstrations.
nodes.approach: Architectural and system-level improvements to the robotic view transformer, including multi-stage coarse-to-fine action prediction.
nodes.niche_reason: Demonstration-based manipulation policies are a common topic.

nodes.title: Real-Time Anomaly Detection and Reactive Planning with Large Language Models
nodes.tldr: A two-stage framework: a fast LLM-embedding anomaly classifier triggers slower LLM fallback reasoning, integrated with model predictive control to keep robots safe despite reasoner latency.
nodes.problem: Using slow, costly LLMs for online out-of-distribution failure detection and safe mitigation in robots.
nodes.approach: Fast embedding-space anomaly classifier plus slow generative fallback selection, with MPC maintaining feasible branching fallback plans.
secondary_topics: Trustworthy ML › AI Safety & Alignment Research
nodes.niche_reason: LLM-based runtime safety monitoring for control is relatively rare.

nodes.title: Reconciling Reality through Simulation: A Real-To-Sim-to-Real Approach for Robust Manipulation
nodes.tldr: RialTo robustifies real-world imitation policies by building digital twins from scans, transferring demonstrations into simulation, and fine-tuning with RL, improving robustness over 67%.
nodes.problem: Imitation learning needs heavy supervision for robustness, while real-world RL is unsafe and impractical.
nodes.approach: Real-to-sim-to-real pipeline: scan-based digital twin interface, inverse distillation of demos, simulated RL fine-tuning.
nodes.niche_reason: Real-to-sim digital twins for policy robustification are specialised.

nodes.title: Render and Diffuse: Aligning Image and Action Spaces for Diffusion-based Behaviour Cloning
nodes.tldr: Render and Diffuse unifies image and action spaces by iteratively updating virtual renders of the robot with a diffusion process, improving sample efficiency and spatial generalisation in behaviour cloning.
nodes.problem: Mapping RGB observations to low-level robot actions is hard and data-hungry because the spaces differ.
nodes.approach: Represent actions as robot 3D-model renders in image space and refine them with a learned diffusion process.
nodes.niche_reason: Diffusion policies are common, but render-based action space is a specialised twist.

nodes.title: Rethinking Robustness Assessment: Adversarial Attacks on Learning-based Quadrupedal Locomotion Controllers
nodes.tldr: Sequential adversarial attacks reveal weaknesses in learned quadrupedal locomotion controllers, even robust ones, in simulation and on a real robot, and help robustify the policy.
nodes.problem: Formally finding vulnerabilities of learned legged locomotion controllers across long-tailed, temporal, high-dimensional perturbation spaces.
nodes.approach: Sequential adversarial attack optimization on observations/perturbations to find failure sequences, then use them for robustification.
nodes.niche_reason: Adversarial robustness evaluation of legged controllers is uncommon.

nodes.title: Risk-Calibrated Human-Robot Interaction via Set-Valued Intent Prediction
nodes.tldr: Calibrates risk in human-robot cooperation so the robot asks for human clarification only when intent uncertainty cannot be controlled, with finite-sample guarantees.
nodes.problem: Robots over-trust confidently wrong human intent predictions during zero-shot human-robot cooperation.
nodes.approach: Set-valued risk calibration framed as sequence-level multi-hypothesis testing over a pretrained risk-aware policy.
nodes.confidence_reason: Judgment call between HRI and uncertainty calibration topics.
nodes.niche_reason: Set-valued intent calibration for HRI is specialized.

nodes.title: RoboCasa: Large-Scale Simulation of Household Tasks for Generalist Robots
nodes.tldr: Presents RoboCasa, a large kitchen simulation framework with generative assets and 100 tasks, showing synthetic demonstration data scales imitation learning.
nodes.problem: Robot learning is limited by scarce real-world household data for generalist policies.
nodes.approach: Realistic kitchen simulation with generative 3D assets, human demos, and automated trajectory generation.
nodes.niche_reason: Simulated robot benchmarks are a common, active direction

nodes.title: RoboPack: Learning Tactile-Informed Dynamics Models for Dense Packing
nodes.tldr: RoboPack learns a tactile-informed dynamics model with a recurrent graph network over visuo-tactile history, enabling MPC for non-prehensile manipulation and dense packing.
nodes.problem: Modeling rigid and deformable object dynamics for manipulation using touch and vision.
nodes.approach: Recurrent graph neural network estimating particle states and latent physics, used with model-predictive control.
secondary_topics: Reinforcement Learning › Model-Based RL & World Models
nodes.niche_reason: Tactile-informed learned dynamics for packing is rare.

nodes.title: SAGE: Bridging Semantic and Actionable Parts for GEneralizable Articulated-Object Manipulation under Language Instructions
nodes.tldr: SAGE bridges semantic parts and actionable parts of articulated objects, combining a VLM with a small part-perception model to execute language-instructed manipulation with feedback.
nodes.problem: Semantic part meanings and physical functionality of articulated object parts can be discordant for language-driven manipulation.
nodes.approach: Instruction interpreter proposes programs; part grounding maps semantic parts to generalizable actionable parts; trajectories predicted with feedback.
nodes.niche_reason: Articulated-object manipulation with language is specialised.

nodes.title: SEEK: Semantic Reasoning for Object Goal Navigation in Real World Inspection Tasks
nodes.tldr: Searches for target objects during robotic inspection using a relational semantic network over a dynamic scene graph, guided by common-sense priors.
nodes.problem: Robot inspection search is slow because robots lack human-like prior and common-sense knowledge.
nodes.approach: Probabilistic planning over a relational semantic network that estimates target-finding probability per spatial element.
nodes.niche_reason: Specialised: semantic object search for robotic inspection.

nodes.title: Safe & Accurate at Speed with Tendons: A Robot Arm for Exploring Dynamic Motion
nodes.tldr: A four-DoF tendon-driven robot arm with base-mounted actuation and pneumatic muscles that reduces collision forces and enables fast, safe dynamic motion.
nodes.problem: Rigid motor-driven arms transfer high forces at impact when moving fast.
nodes.approach: Tendons move actuation to the base to cut inertia, combined with pneumatic muscles.
nodes.niche_reason: Tendon-driven dynamic arms are an unusual hardware direction.

nodes.title: Safe Planning for Articulated Robots Using Reachability-based Obstacle Avoidance With Spheres
nodes.tldr: SPARROWS is a real-time receding-horizon trajectory planner for articulated robots that guarantees collision safety using reachability analysis and sphere-based obstacle avoidance.
nodes.problem: Real-time motion planning for articulated robots that is provably safe around obstacles and humans.
nodes.approach: Receding-horizon trajectory optimization with reachable sets and sphere-based obstacle representation for safety guarantees.
nodes.niche_reason: Formal safe planning for manipulators is specialised.

nodes.title: Scalable Distance-based Multi-Agent Relative State Estimation via Block Multiconvex Optimization
nodes.tldr: Scalable distributed distance-based relative state estimation for many agents, using a generalized graph realization with convex and non-convex multiconvex models solved by block coordinate descent.
nodes.problem: Large-scale distance-based multi-agent relative state estimation is high-dimensional and non-convex.
nodes.approach: Generalized graph realization with convex and non-convex multiconvex models solved by block coordinate descent.
nodes.niche_reason: Distance-based multi-robot localization via multiconvex optimization is rare.

nodes.title: ScrewMimic: Bimanual Imitation from Human Videos with Screw Space Projection
nodes.tldr: Learns bimanual robot manipulation from single human video demos by modeling the two hands as a screw-motion action space, then fine-tunes via self-supervision.
nodes.problem: Bimanual manipulation is hard to learn from human demonstrations due to coordination and synchronization demands.
nodes.approach: Screw-motion action space for two-hand coordination, learned from human video and fine-tuned self-supervised.
nodes.niche_reason: Screw-action bimanual representation is specialised but not unusual

nodes.title: Set It Up!: Functional Object Arrangement with Compositional Generative Models
nodes.tldr: SetItUp lets robots interpret under-specified instructions like setting a dining table by using LLM-proposed abstract spatial relations grounded into poses via composed diffusion models.
nodes.problem: Robots must create functional object arrangements from under-specified instructions with little training data.
nodes.approach: LLM proposes spatial-relation graph constraints; compositional library of relation-specific diffusion models solves object poses.
nodes.niche_reason: Functional arrangement from vague goals with compositional diffusion is uncommon.

nodes.title: SpringGrasp: Synthesizing Compliant, Dexterous Grasps under Shape Uncertainty
nodes.tldr: Dexterous grasp planner that synthesizes compliant grasps robust to noisy, partial shape observations, validated on a real robot across 14 objects.
nodes.problem: Grasp planners assume exact object geometry, but noisy partial observations make the shape uncertain.
nodes.approach: Analytic, differentiable SpringGrasp metric scores the dynamic behavior of the whole compliant grasping process.
nodes.niche_reason: Compliant grasp synthesis under shape uncertainty is a specialised robotics topic

nodes.title: Stein Variational Ergodic Search
nodes.tldr: Formulates ergodic coverage search as probabilistic inference, using Stein variational methods to optimize a distribution of exploration trajectories for online adaptation.
nodes.problem: Choosing among infinitely many continuous coverage trajectories is computationally challenging for robots.
nodes.approach: Stein variational inference over ergodic trajectories, run in parallel within a model-predictive control loop.
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Probabilistic & Bayesian Methods
nodes.niche_reason: Stein-based ergodic coverage planning is a rare robotics niche

nodes.title: THE COLOSSEUM: A Benchmark for Evaluating Generalization for Robotic Manipulation
nodes.tldr: Presents a 20-task simulation benchmark spanning 14 perturbation axes, showing manipulation policies degrade by 30-50% in success rate under environmental changes.
nodes.problem: Robot policies are rarely evaluated under environmental perturbations beyond their training setup.
nodes.approach: Simulation benchmark varying colour, texture, lighting, distractors and camera pose, validated against real-world perturbations.
nodes.niche_reason: Robot generalization benchmarks are a common, active genre

nodes.title: Tactile-Driven Non-Prehensile Object Manipulation via Extrinsic Contact Mode Control
nodes.tldr: Plans robot actions for non-prehensile manipulation with grasped objects, using compliant high-resolution tactile sensing and gradient-based contact-mode optimization.
nodes.problem: Driving object poses and forces to targets with non-prehensile manipulation under complex tactile sensor dynamics and friction.
nodes.approach: Optimization over robot actions under static equilibrium, kinematics and frictional contact, using differentiable contact modes.
nodes.niche_reason: Tactile non-prehensile manipulation is a specialized robotics area.

nodes.title: Task Adaptation in Industrial Human-Robot Interaction: Leveraging Riemannian Motion Policies
nodes.tldr: Reactive task-parametrized Riemannian Motion Policies let industrial robots adapt motion to human intent and compose complex tasks without manual control.
nodes.problem: Industrial robots need manual control and cannot adapt task plans to human intent.

nodes.title: Demonstrating LEAP Hand V3: Low-Cost, Easy-to-Assemble, High-Performance Hand for Robot Learning
nodes.tldr: Presents LEAP Hand V3, a $200 3D-printed 8-DOF dexterous hand with open-source teleoperation, retargeting, and sim2real tools for robot learning.
nodes.problem: Dexterous robot hands are expensive, hard to reproduce, and lack accessible learning tooling.
nodes.approach: Hybrid rigid-soft 3D-printed hand design with a universal MCP joint and open-source software suite.
nodes.niche_reason: Low-cost open dexterous hands are a growing, common hardware line

nodes.title: Demonstrating MOSART: Opening Articulated Structures in the Real World
nodes.tldr: Real-world study of a mobile manipulator opening unseen articulated objects; modular pipelines beat end-to-end learning and perception is the bottleneck.
nodes.problem: Whether mobile manipulation of unseen articulated objects works end-to-end in the real world is unclear.
nodes.approach: Builds a modular system and runs 100+ end-to-end trials across 13 real-world sites.
nodes.confidence_reason: System study spans manipulation, perception and evaluation; primary topic is judgment call.
nodes.niche_reason: Large-scale real-world mobile manipulation study is less common.

nodes.title: Demonstrating MuJoCo Playground
nodes.tldr: Open-source MuJoCo Playground framework unifies physics, batch rendering, and training environments for fast robot learning and sim-to-real transfer.
nodes.problem: Streamlining simulation, training, and sim-to-real transfer for diverse robots.
nodes.approach: Integrated stack of MJX physics, batch renderer, and training environments.
secondary_topics: Reinforcement Learning › Online & Deep RL Algorithms
nodes.niche_reason: Simulation frameworks for robot learning are common

nodes.title: Demonstrating Multi-Suction Item Picking at Scale via Multi-Modal Learning of Pick Success
nodes.tldr: Learns to predict multi-suction pick success from RGB, depth and segmentation, pretrained self-supervised and fine-tuned on real industrial picking data.
nodes.problem: Multi-suction picking from clutter must generalize to open item sets and meet latency limits, with few live attempts.
nodes.approach: Self-supervised multimodal pretraining to reconstruct inputs, then a pick-quality classifier with fine-tuned encoders.
nodes.niche_reason: Learned suction-pick success in industrial settings is specialised

nodes.title: Demonstrating REASSEMBLE: A Multimodal Dataset for Contact-rich Robotic Assembly and Disassembly
nodes.tldr: REASSEMBLE is a multimodal dataset of 4,551 contact-rich assembly and disassembly demonstrations with event cameras, force-torque, audio and RGB.
nodes.problem: Existing manipulation datasets lack contact-rich assembly and disassembly tasks.
nodes.approach: Collect multimodal demonstrations on the NIST Assembly Task Board 1 with diverse sensors.
nodes.niche_reason: Industrial assembly datasets with event cameras and audio are uncommon.

nodes.title: Demonstrating Shared Force-Language Embeddings for Natural Human-Robot Communication
nodes.tldr: Learns a shared embedding space between robot force time-series and natural-language motion descriptions for bidirectional translation, evaluated with 10 participants.
nodes.problem: Bridging linguistic descriptions and physical forces for natural human-robot communication.
nodes.approach: Joint latent space for force curves and phrases using augmentation, feature engineering, and multitask learning.
secondary_topics: Audio, Speech & Multimodal › Audio-Visual & Cross-modal Learning
nodes.niche_reason: Aligning force signals with language is very rare.

nodes.title: Demonstrating ViSafe: Vision-enabled Safety for High-speed Detect and Avoid
nodes.tldr: Presents ViSafe, a vision-only airborne collision avoidance system using barrier-function safety on multi-camera hardware, tested to 144 km/h closure.
nodes.problem: Airborne vehicles need automated visual separation for high-density shared airspace, currently handled by pilots.
nodes.approach: Vision-only edge-AI on a multi-camera prototype, with perception-driven control barrier functions enforcing self-separation.
nodes.niche_reason: Vision-only high-speed airborne collision avoidance is a rare niche.

nodes.title: Demonstrating a Control Framework for Physical Human-Robot Interaction Toward Industrial Applications
nodes.tldr: A QP-based torque control framework for physical human-robot interaction with compliance modes and safety constraints, demonstrated on a Kinova cobot for industrial use.
nodes.problem: Industrial-grade physical human-robot interaction control with safety guarantees.
nodes.approach: Second-order QP with weighted task hierarchy and compliance modes, built on mc_rtc.
nodes.niche_reason: Classical control engineering demo, unusual relative to learning mainstream.

nodes.title: Demonstrating the Octopi-1.5 Visual-Tactile-Language Model
nodes.tldr: Live demo of a visual-tactile-language model that answers questions about grasped objects, using tactile input and RAG to learn new items.
nodes.problem: Robots need touch-aware language reasoning for dexterous manipulation and occlusion.
nodes.approach: Multi-part tactile signals with a retrieval-augmented generation module, shown on a handheld tactile interface.
nodes.confidence_reason: Demo paper; topic split between tactile robotics and multimodal LLMs
nodes.niche_reason: Visual-tactile-language models are rare

nodes.title: Dex1B: Learning with 1B Demonstrations for Dexterous Manipulation
nodes.tldr: A dataset of one billion generated dexterous grasping and articulation demonstrations, plus a unified conditional generative model used for both data synthesis and policy deployment.
nodes.problem: Scarcity of large-scale, diverse demonstrations for dexterous manipulation.
nodes.approach: Condition-driven generative model synthesizes grasp and articulation actions at massive scale for data and policy use.
nodes.niche_reason: Specialised dexterous manipulation, but large-scale data trend is common.

nodes.title: DexWild: Dexterous Human Interactions for In-the-Wild Robot Policies
nodes.tldr: DexWild collects in-the-wild dexterous human hand interaction data with a low-cost mocap system and co-trains with robot demos for generalizable policies.
nodes.problem: Teleoperation data for dexterous policies is costly and hard to scale across environments.
nodes.approach: Low-cost mobile hand mocap system DW-Mocap and co-training on human and robot demonstrations.
nodes.niche_reason: Human-hand data for dexterous robots is active but specialised.

nodes.title: Dexonomy: Synthesizing All Dexterous Grasp Types in a Grasp Taxonomy
nodes.tldr: Synthesizes physically plausible, penetration-free dexterous grasps for every GRASP-taxonomy type from one template each, validated by contact-aware control and used to train a type-conditional model.
