nodes.problem: Dexterous grasp synthesis is limited to specific grasp types, objects, and hands, with penetration issues.
nodes.approach: Global alignment, simulation-based local refinement, and contact-aware force-control validation from single annotated templates.
nodes.niche_reason: Specialised dexterous grasping with taxonomy-driven angle.

nodes.title: DexterityGen: Foundation Controller for Unprecedented Dexterity
nodes.tldr: Pretrains RL dexterous motion primitives into a foundation controller, then steers it with human teleoperation for complex tool use.
nodes.problem: Teaching robots dexterous skills like tool use is hard for teleoperation alone and for sim-to-real RL.
nodes.approach: RL pretrains primitives such as in-hand rotation; a learned dataset trains a controller prompted by teleoperation.
nodes.niche_reason: Dexterous manipulation with sim-to-real RL is a common robotics direction.

nodes.title: Diffeomorphic Obstacle Avoidance for Contractive Dynamical Systems via Implicit Representations
nodes.tldr: Combines neural contractive dynamical systems with SDF-based diffeomorphic transforms to give learned-from-demonstration robot skills full-body obstacle avoidance while preserving contraction stability.
nodes.problem: Skills learned from demonstrations need safe obstacle avoidance without losing stability guarantees.
nodes.approach: Signed distance fields with flow-based diffeomorphisms that preserve contraction of the learned vector field.
nodes.niche_reason: Stable dynamical-system skill learning with diffeomorphic avoidance is rare.

nodes.title: Differentiable GPU-Parallelized Task and Motion Planning
nodes.tldr: A bilevel TAMP algorithm uses GPU parallelism to sample thousands of solution seeds and refine them with differentiable optimization, solving constrained problems in seconds.
nodes.problem: Task and motion planning is slow and struggles with highly constrained solution spaces.
nodes.approach: Batched GPU sampling of plan-skeleton seeds followed by parallel differentiable constraint optimization.
nodes.niche_reason: TAMP is specialised; GPU-parallel differentiable version is less common.

nodes.title: Discrete-Time Hybrid Automata Learning: Legged Locomotion Meets Skateboarding
nodes.tldr: Learns discrete mode switching and continuous dynamics jointly with on-policy RL, without trajectory segmentation, demonstrated on a quadruped riding a skateboard.
nodes.problem: Identifying hybrid mode switching in legged robot dynamics without trajectory segmentation or event labels.
nodes.approach: On-policy RL with beta policy distribution and multi-critic architecture for contact-guided motion.
secondary_topics: Reinforcement Learning › Online & Deep RL Algorithms
nodes.niche_reason: Hybrid automata learning with RL on skateboarding is an unusual combination

nodes.title: Distilling Contact Planning for Fast Trajectory Optimization in Robot Air Hockey
nodes.tldr: Distills a stochastic optimal control policy for contact planning and pairs it with online MPC, improving robot air hockey over control-only or learning-only methods.
nodes.problem: Contact-rich, highly dynamic tasks are intractable for real-time optimal control and hard for pure learning near constraints.
nodes.approach: Offline distilled contact planner plus online model-predictive control under kinematic constraints.
nodes.niche_reason: Dynamic air hockey with distilled contact planning is unusual.

nodes.title: Doppler Correspondence: Non-Iterative Scan Matching With Doppler Velocity-Based Correspondence
nodes.tldr: Non-iterative LiDAR scan matching for 4D LiDAR/radar that uses translation-invariant Doppler velocity to establish point correspondences instead of repeated nearest-neighbor search.
nodes.problem: LiDAR odometry scan matching fails in adverse weather and repetitive geometry; Doppler information is ignored.
nodes.approach: Doppler velocity-based correspondence invariant to translation and small rotation, enabling non-iterative scan matching.
nodes.niche_reason: Doppler-based correspondence for 4D radar/FMCW LiDAR is a specialised sensing niche.

nodes.title: Dynamic Rank Adjustment in Diffusion Policies for Efficient and Flexible Training
nodes.tldr: DRIFT uses SVD to dynamically adjust the trainable rank of diffusion policies, enabling DRIFT-DAgger to move from offline bootstrapping to fast online interactive imitation learning.
nodes.problem: Overparameterized diffusion policies are too costly to train for online interactive imitation learning.
nodes.approach: SVD-based dynamic rank adjustment during diffusion policy training within a DAgger-style algorithm.
nodes.niche_reason: Efficient training of diffusion policies for interactive imitation is specialised.

nodes.title: Dynamic Safety in Complex Environments: Synthesizing Safety Filters with Poisson’s Equation
nodes.tldr: Synthesizes safe sets from occupancy maps by solving Poisson equation with a guidance-field forcing function, yielding CBF safety filters demonstrated on a legged robot.
nodes.problem: Generating safe sets for robots in complex, dynamically changing environments from perception data.
nodes.approach: Solve Poisson's equation with Dirichlet conditions and a smooth guidance vector field to define a safety function for CBFs.
nodes.niche_reason: PDE-based safety function synthesis is an unusual approach.

nodes.title: Effective Sampling for Robot Motion Planning Through the Lens of Lattices
nodes.tldr: Constructs deterministic lattice-based sample sets (A_d* lattice) for sampling-based motion planning, giving strong finite-time (δ,ε)-completeness guarantees and fast running time.
nodes.problem: Sampling-based planners lack practical finite-sample guarantees.
nodes.approach: Deterministic sampling from the A_d* lattice, the best-known covering, combined with (δ,ε)-completeness analysis.
nodes.niche_reason: Lattice-theoretic planning guarantees are a rare, mathematical niche.

nodes.title: Efficient Hierarchical Any-Angle Path Planning on Multi-Resolution 3D Grids
nodes.tldr: Finds optimal any-angle Euclidean shortest paths on hierarchical multi-resolution 3D occupancy grids, faster than search and sampling baselines.
nodes.problem: Search-based any-angle planners do not scale to large high-resolution 3D maps.
nodes.approach: Exploit multi-resolution volumetric connectivity to keep any-angle optimality tractable.
nodes.niche_reason: Specialised planning niche; any-angle search is not ML mainstream

nodes.title: Enhancing Autonomous Driving Systems with On-Board Deployed Large Language Models
nodes.tldr: Combines an MPC controller with on-board LLMs that check driving behavior against language instructions and tune MPC parameters, with RAG, LoRA, and quantization.
nodes.problem: Supervised driving models fail on edge cases, and cloud-dependent LLMs are impractical on board.
nodes.approach: Hybrid MPC with LLM-driven parameter adaptation, RAG, LoRA fine-tuning, and quantization for on-board inference.
secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › Efficient LLM Inference & Architectures
nodes.niche_reason: LLM-augmented MPC for on-board driving is a less common combination

nodes.title: FACTR: Force-Attending Curriculum Training for Contact-Rich Policy Learning
nodes.tldr: Bilateral teleoperation relays contact forces to the operator, and a visual-corruption curriculum teaches a transformer policy to use force.
nodes.problem: Robot policies rarely use force feedback, so they stay limited to quasi-static kinematic tasks.
nodes.approach: Low-cost bilateral teleop for force collection, plus a curriculum that decreases visual corruption during training.
nodes.confidence_reason: Topic split between teleoperation hardware and policy learning.
nodes.niche_reason: Force-feedback teleoperation for contact-rich policy learning is specialised.

nodes.title: FAST: Efficient Action Tokenization for Vision-Language-Action Models
nodes.tldr: FAST tokenizes robot actions with the discrete cosine transform, letting autoregressive VLAs learn dexterous high-frequency tasks and match diffusion VLAs with up to 5x less training time.
nodes.problem: Per-timestep binning tokenization fails for dexterous, high-frequency robot actions in autoregressive VLAs.
nodes.approach: Compression-based frequency-space action tokenization using DCT, released as universal FAST+ tokenizer.
nodes.niche_reason: VLA policy research is currently mainstream in robotics.

nodes.title: FEAST: A Flexible Mealtime-Assistance System Towards In-the-Wild Personalization
nodes.tldr: A mealtime-assistance robot personalized in the wild via modular hardware, multiple interaction modes, and LLM-adapted behavior trees, validated in an in-home study.
nodes.problem: Feeding assistance robots must adapt to varied activities, contexts, foods, and user preferences in the home.
nodes.approach: Parameterized behavior trees safely adapted by an LLM, with web, head-gesture, and button interfaces.
nodes.niche_reason: Robotic feeding assistance with in-home personalization is a rare, caregiving-focused niche.

nodes.title: FERMI: Flexible Radio Mapping with a Hybrid Propagation Model and Scalable Autonomous Data Collection
nodes.tldr: Radio mapping framework combining physics-based direct-path modelling with a neural network, plus multi-robot planning that collects sparse data efficiently and generalizes to unseen positions.
nodes.problem: Radio signal prediction for unseen transmitter-receiver pairs needs dense manual data collection in obstructed environments.
nodes.approach: Hybrid physics plus neural propagation model, with a scalable multi-robot planner for autonomous data collection.
nodes.confidence_reason: Robotics data collection plus radio modelling; several robotics topics fit
nodes.niche_reason: Radio mapping for robot teams is an unusual niche

nodes.title: Fine-Tuning Vision-Language-Action Models: Optimizing Speed and Success
nodes.tldr: Optimized fine-tuning recipe for OpenVLA with parallel decoding, action chunking, and L1 regression, raising LIBERO success from 76% to 97%.
nodes.problem: VLAs need costly fine-tuning, and existing adaptation methods are slow and suboptimal.
nodes.approach: Systematic study of decoding, action representation, and objectives yielding OpenVLA-OFT.
nodes.niche_reason: VLA fine-tuning variants are a crowded area.

nodes.title: Flow Matching Ergodic Coverage
nodes.tldr: Casts ergodic coverage as flow matching, equivalent to a closed-form linear quadratic control problem, supporting Stein variational and optimal-transport flows for hard targets.
nodes.problem: Ergodic coverage requires costly constrained trajectory optimization to match target distributions under dynamics.
nodes.approach: Unconstrained flow-matching formulation equivalent to LQ optimal control, with SVGD and OT flow variants.
nodes.confidence_reason: Straddles ergodic coverage, robot control, and flow-matching generative methods.
nodes.niche_reason: Ergodic coverage is very rare; flow-matching take is novel.

nodes.title: Flying Hand: End-Effector-Centric Framework for Versatile Aerial Manipulation Teleoperation and Policy Learning
nodes.tldr: Unified aerial manipulation framework with an end-effector-centric interface, hexarotor with arm and whole-body MPC, enabling teleoperation and imitation learning across tasks.
nodes.problem: Aerial manipulation hardware and control are tightly coupled to specific tasks, hindering cross-task algorithms.
nodes.approach: Fully-actuated hexarotor with 4-DoF arm, whole-body MPC, and end-effector-centric command interface.
nodes.niche_reason: Aerial manipulators with imitation learning are very rare.

nodes.title: From Foresight to Forethought: VLM-In-the-Loop Policy Steering via Latent Alignment
nodes.tldr: Uses a VLM as a runtime verifier for robot policy steering, with a latent world model predicting action outcomes for it to judge.
nodes.problem: Off-the-shelf VLMs struggle to predict consequences of low-level robot actions.
nodes.approach: Decouple foresight from a latent world model and forethought by aligning the VLM with predicted latent states.
nodes.confidence_reason: Policy steering with VLM verifier spans VLA and imitation topics
nodes.niche_reason: VLM-as-verifier for runtime policy steering is a fairly rare direction

nodes.title: Gain Tuning Is Not What You Need: Reward Gain Adaptation for Constrained Locomotion Learning
nodes.tldr: Adapts reward-weighting gains online from received penalties so a quadruped learns locomotion with near-zero constraint violation without falling.
nodes.problem: Hand-chosen reward gains cannot guarantee constraint satisfaction during robot locomotion learning.
nodes.approach: Online adjustment of positive-to-penalty reward gain ratio based on proximity to constraint thresholds.
nodes.niche_reason: Constrained locomotion with online reward-gain adaptation is a specialised robotics niche.

nodes.title: Gait-Net-augmented Implicit Kino-dynamic MPC for Dynamic Variable-frequency Humanoid Locomotion over Discrete Terrains
nodes.tldr: Uses a lightweight Gait-Net to set step durations inside an implicit kino-dynamic MPC, letting humanoids adapt step timing and placement over discrete terrain.
nodes.problem: Fixed-time MPC discretization cannot adapt step duration and placement together for humanoid gaits.
nodes.approach: Gait-Net-augmented sequential convex MPC optimizing step location, duration and contact forces.
nodes.niche_reason: Variable-frequency humanoid MPC is specialised.

nodes.title: GauSS-MI: Gaussian Splatting Shannon Mutual Information for Active 3D Reconstruction
nodes.tldr: GauSS-MI quantifies per-Gaussian visual uncertainty and uses Shannon mutual information to pick next-best views for real-time active 3D Gaussian Splatting reconstruction.
nodes.problem: Selecting the most informative viewpoints for active reconstruction with visual quality uncertainty.
nodes.approach: Probabilistic per-Gaussian uncertainty with a mutual-information criterion, integrated with view and motion planning.
secondary_topics: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: Active view selection for splatting is a rare intersection.

nodes.title: Generalizing Safety Beyond Collision-Avoidance via Latent-Space Reachability Analysis
nodes.tldr: Latent Safety Filters generalize HJ reachability to a world model's latent space, enforcing learned safety constraints from raw images.
nodes.problem: Hand-written safety constraints cannot capture hazards visible only in high-dimensional observations.
nodes.approach: Safety classification in latent space of a generative world model wrapping arbitrary policies.
secondary_topics: Trustworthy ML › AI Safety & Alignment Research
nodes.niche_reason: Latent-space reachability for learned hazards is a rare control angle.

nodes.title: GeoDEx: A Unified Geometric Framework for Tactile Dexterous and Extrinsic Manipulation under Force Uncertainty
nodes.tldr: Estimates uncertain tactile forces and plans dexterous and extrinsic manipulation using geometric primitives, achieving 14x speed-up over SOCP.
nodes.problem: Tactile force readings are noisy and miscalibrated, making force-controlled manipulation unstable.
nodes.approach: Unified estimation, planning and control built on plane, cone and ellipsoid geometric primitives.
nodes.confidence_reason: Tactile sensing and manipulation planning straddle two topics
nodes.niche_reason: Geometric force-uncertainty framework is specialised within manipulation

nodes.title: Geometric Gait Optimization for Kinodynamic Systems Using a Lie Group Integrator
nodes.tldr: Variational gait optimization and motion planning for kinodynamic locomoting systems using Lagrangian reduction and Lie group integrators, demonstrated on roller racer, snakeboard and swimmer.
nodes.problem: Gait optimization and planning for systems mixing kinematic constraints and second-order dynamics.
nodes.approach: Geometric mechanics dynamic model with Lie group integrator based variational gait optimization and gait transition composition.
nodes.niche_reason: Geometric gait optimization for snakeboard and swimmer robots is very rare.

nodes.title: Global Contact-Rich Planning with Sparsity-Rich Semidefinite Relaxations
nodes.tldr: Exploits correlative, term and kinematic sparsity in contact-rich planning as polynomial optimization to solve sparse SDP relaxations in seconds with near-global optimality, plus the SPOT toolbox.
nodes.problem: Contact-rich motion planning is nonconvex and hard to solve globally.
nodes.approach: Sparse Lasserre moment/sum-of-squares semidefinite relaxations exploiting robot structure and contact-mode separability.
nodes.niche_reason: Certifiably global SDP planning for contact is very rare.

nodes.title: Gripper Pose and Object Pointflow as Interfaces for Robotic Bimanual Manipulation
nodes.tldr: Bimanual manipulation policy that predicts keyframe gripper poses and object pointflow as interfaces alongside continuous action estimation.
nodes.problem: Bimanual manipulation needs precise localization and smooth, collision-free curved trajectories.
nodes.approach: End-to-end framework combining keypose and pointflow interface predictions with continuous action estimation.
nodes.niche_reason: Active robot manipulation line with many competing methods

nodes.title: HOMIE: Humanoid Loco-Manipulation with Isomorphic Exoskeleton Cockpit
nodes.tldr: HOMIE combines an RL humanoid loco-manipulation policy (walk, squat, arbitrary upper-body) with a low-cost isomorphic exoskeleton cockpit for whole-body teleoperation.
nodes.problem: Humanoid teleoperation lacks reliable low-level control and accurate whole-body commands for loco-manipulation.
nodes.approach: RL with upper-body pose curriculum, height reward and symmetry, plus exoskeleton arms, hands and pedal.
nodes.niche_reason: Humanoid teleoperation systems are active but specialised.

nodes.title: Hierarchical Temporal Logic Task and Motion Planning for Multi-Robot Systems
nodes.tldr: Solves hierarchical temporal-logic task and motion planning for multi-robot teams with a hybrid Graph of Convex Sets and mixed-integer convex programming.
nodes.problem: TAMP for multi-robot systems with complex temporal-logic specs scales poorly and yields infeasible or slow solutions.
nodes.approach: Hybrid Graph of Convex Sets formulation with graph pruning heuristics and MICP, proven sound and complete.
nodes.niche_reason: GCS-based temporal logic TAMP is a rare formal-methods niche.

nodes.title: Hierarchical and Modular Network on Non-prehensile Manipulation in General Environments
nodes.tldr: A modular, reconfigurable RL policy architecture with environment-aware object representations achieves zero-shot sim-to-real non-prehensile manipulation across diverse environment geometries, plus a digital-twin benchmark.
nodes.problem: Non-prehensile manipulation policies fail to generalize across environments with varying geometric constraints.
nodes.approach: Reconfigurable network modules, contact-based environment representation, procedural environment generation and RL training in simulation.
nodes.niche_reason: Non-prehensile manipulation is specialised within robotics.

nodes.title: How to Coordinate UAVs and UGVs for Efficient Mission Planning? Optimizing Energy-Constrained Cooperative Routing with a DRL Framework
nodes.tldr: A scalable deep RL framework with an encoder-decoder transformer that routes heterogeneous UAV-UGV teams, using UGVs to recharge UAVs during missions.
nodes.problem: Energy-limited UAVs and slow UGVs must coordinate routing and recharging to cover task points quickly.
nodes.approach: Transformer policy with sortie-wise agent switching trained by deep RL for cooperative routing.
nodes.niche_reason: Heterogeneous UAV-UGV routing is specialised but established.

nodes.title: Human2LocoMan: Learning Versatile Quadrupedal Manipulation with Human Pretraining
nodes.tldr: Co-trains a quadruped manipulator on human and robot demonstrations with a unified action space, improving data efficiency for versatile quadrupedal manipulation.
nodes.problem: Scaling imitation learning for quadruped manipulation is hard because data collection is labor-intensive.
nodes.approach: Teleoperation pipeline unifying human and robot observation-action spaces, with multimodal cross-embodiment co-training and pretraining.
nodes.niche_reason: Human-to-robot co-training for quadrupeds is a specialised niche

nodes.title: IMLE Policy: Fast and Sample Efficient Visuomotor Policy Learning via Implicit Maximum Likelihood Estimation
nodes.tldr: IMLE Policy is a behaviour-cloning visuomotor policy using rejection-sampling implicit maximum likelihood, needing less data and single-step action generation.
nodes.problem: Diffusion policies need large datasets and many inference steps, costly in robotics.
nodes.approach: Generator trained with rejection-sampling IMLE for one-step multimodal action generation.
secondary_topics: Generative Models › GANs, VAEs & Normalizing Flows
nodes.niche_reason: Single-step implicit generators for policies are rarer than diffusion policies

nodes.title: Implicit Neural-Representation Learning for Elastic Deformable-Object Manipulations
nodes.tldr: Learns implicit neural representations of elastic objects from partial observations, then fine-tunes them with RL for manipulation policies.
nodes.problem: Deformable objects have huge state spaces and only partial, noisy observations.
nodes.approach: Signed-distance implicit representation learning plus RL-based representation fine-tuning.
secondary_topics: Reinforcement Learning › Online & Deep RL Algorithms
nodes.confidence_reason: Representation learning versus manipulation policy; split is ambiguous
nodes.niche_reason: Deformable-object INR policies are an unusual direction

nodes.title: Influence of Static and Dynamic Downwash Interactions on Multi-Quadrotor Systems
nodes.tldr: Measures forces, torques, and PIV wake velocities for single and paired quadrotors to characterize downwash effects for dense multi-quadrotor flight.
nodes.problem: Downwash between close quadrotors destabilizes vehicles, forcing conservative collision-avoidance zones.
nodes.approach: Data-driven experimental analysis combining force/torque sensing with particle image velocimetry.
nodes.confidence_reason: empirical aerodynamics measurements; multi-robot control is only a motivating application
nodes.niche_reason: Experimental quadrotor downwash characterization is a rare, hardware-grounded niche.

nodes.title: Interface-level Intent Inference for Environment-agnostic Robot Teleoperation Assistance
nodes.tldr: Infers intended sip/puff commands with GRUs to assist robot arm teleoperation without knowing the user's policy, reducing collisions for spinal cord injured users.
nodes.problem: Robot interpretation of interface-level teleoperation commands diverges from user intent for users with limited physical ability.
nodes.approach: Data-driven GRU model inferring intended sip/puff commands from signals, used in assisted teleoperation frameworks, evaluated in a human subjects study.
nodes.niche_reason: Assistive sip/puff teleoperation for spinal cord injury users is very rare.

nodes.title: Interruption Handling for Conversational Robots
nodes.tldr: A real-time system detects user interruptions to a conversational LLM-powered robot and responds based on interrupter intent, handling 93.69% of interruptions in a 21-participant study.
nodes.problem: Social robots handle user-initiated interruptions poorly in real time.
nodes.approach: Intent-based interruption classification and handling designed from human-human interaction patterns, integrated into an LLM social robot.
nodes.niche_reason: Real-time interruption handling in conversational robots is a rare topic.

nodes.title: Is Your Imitation Learning Policy Better than Mine? Policy Comparison with Near-Optimal Stopping
nodes.tldr: A sequential statistical test compares two robot policies with few evaluation trials, stopping early when the evidence is clear while keeping valid error guarantees.
nodes.problem: Comparing imitation policies with only 10 to 50 trials, batch tests lack adaptive stopping and risk p-hacking.
nodes.approach: Near-optimal sequential test that decides after each trial whether more evaluation is needed.
nodes.niche_reason: Sequential testing for robot policy comparison is a rare niche.

nodes.title: Joint State and Noise Covariance Estimation
nodes.tldr: Joint state and noise covariance estimation is convex with closed-form optimal covariance; block coordinate descent algorithms plug into SLAM least-squares solvers.
nodes.problem: Measurement noise covariance, which sets least-squares weights, is usually fixed rather than estimated jointly with states.
nodes.approach: Closed-form optimal covariance within MAP and likelihood frameworks, plus BCD algorithms plugged into nonlinear least squares solvers.
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Probabilistic & Bayesian Methods
nodes.niche_reason: Specialised estimation theory for robotics perception.

nodes.title: Kinodynamic Trajectory Following with STELA: Simultaneous Trajectory Estimation & Local Adaptation
nodes.tldr: Extends factor-graph trajectory estimation and control to arbitrary dynamics, jointly estimating past states and adapting controls to follow kinodynamic plans online.
nodes.problem: Separate state estimation and control cause unsafe trajectory following under noise and model mismatch.
nodes.approach: Factor-graph optimization with iSAM incremental updates, time-windowing and an optimized duration variable.
nodes.niche_reason: Factor-graph trajectory following for arbitrary dynamics is specialised

nodes.title: LangWBC: Language-directed Humanoid Whole-Body Control via End-to-end Learning
nodes.tldr: Trains one neural policy mapping language commands to humanoid whole-body motions via RL, policy distillation, and a CVAE for diversity.
nodes.problem: Translating language into humanoid whole-body motion is hard due to the gap to physical actions.
nodes.approach: End-to-end RL with policy distillation and a conditional VAE structure for compositional motion.
nodes.niche_reason: Language-directed humanoid control is a specialised, growing subfield

nodes.title: Learned Perceptive Forward Dynamics Model for Safe and Platform-aware Robotic Navigation
nodes.tldr: Learns a perceptive forward dynamics model of a legged robot from terrain geometry and proprioception, used in zero-shot MPPI for safe navigation on ANYmal.
nodes.problem: Safe platform-aware navigation without hand-tuned cost functions or simplified dynamics.
nodes.approach: Train a perceptive forward dynamics model on simulated and real data; plan with MPPI using failure probability.
nodes.niche_reason: Learned dynamics for legged traversability is specialised but established.

nodes.title: Learning Getting-Up Policies for Real-World Humanoid Robots
nodes.tldr: Learns getting-up policies for a real G1 humanoid via a two-phase curriculum: discover trajectories first, then refine them into smooth, deployable motions.
nodes.problem: Hand-designed getting-up controllers fail across varied fall configurations and rough terrain.
nodes.approach: Two-phase learned curriculum with complex contact modeling and sparse rewards, refined to slow motions.
nodes.niche_reason: Learned getting-up for full-size humanoids is a specialised task

nodes.title: Learning Humanoid Standing-up Control across Diverse Postures
nodes.tldr: Learns humanoid standing-up control from scratch with RL and a multi-critic architecture, then deploys directly to the Unitree G1 across diverse postures and terrains.
nodes.problem: Humanoid standing-up from arbitrary postures fails on hardware or needs fixed trajectories.
nodes.approach: Curriculum RL with multi-critic and smoothness/speed regularization for sim-to-real.
nodes.niche_reason: Posture-adaptive humanoid recovery is specialised.

nodes.title: Learning Interpretable Features from Interventions
nodes.tldr: Users intervene when a robot errs, the robot learns an interpretable failure feature and adjusts its policy to match user preferences.
nodes.problem: In-home robots must adapt to individual users, but users struggle to specify their preferences in advance.
nodes.approach: Intervention-triggered learning of explanatory features that correct the policy, validated in a 48-person user study.
nodes.niche_reason: Intervention-based personalization of in-home robots is specialised

nodes.title: Learning to Act Anywhere with Task-centric Latent Actions
nodes.tldr: Learns task-centric latent actions from unlabeled cross-embodiment videos, then pretrains a VLA over discrete latent tokens that decode into robot behaviors.
nodes.problem: Generalist robot policies need large labeled datasets and heterogeneous action spaces.
nodes.approach: Unsupervised DINOv2 and language-filtered latent actions, autoregressive VLM pretraining, latent decoding.
nodes.niche_reason: VLA foundation models are a crowded direction.

nodes.title: Leveling the Playing Field: Carefully Comparing Classical and Learned Controllers for Quadrotor Trajectory Tracking
nodes.tldr: Shows that prior RL-versus-geometric quadrotor comparisons were biased, and proposes a fair protocol under which the two controller classes perform far more similarly.
nodes.problem: Comparisons between learned and classical quadrotor controllers favour RL due to asymmetric task, data and input access.
nodes.approach: Best-practice synthesis of RL and geometric controllers under symmetric objectives, datasets and feed-forward inputs.
nodes.confidence_reason: Contribution is protocol-level evaluation; control topic is the setting
nodes.niche_reason: Fair benchmarking of quadrotor control is a specialised methodological niche

nodes.title: LiDAR Registration with Visual Foundation Models
nodes.tldr: Uses DINOv2 features from surround-view camera images as point descriptors so RANSAC or ICP can register LiDAR scans to older 3D maps without retraining.
nodes.problem: LiDAR-to-map registration fails under domain shift, seasonal change, and differing point cloud structure.
nodes.approach: DINOv2 image features as descriptors fed to RANSAC or ICP, with no domain-specific retraining.
secondary_topics: Computer Vision › Vision Foundation Models & Self-Supervision
nodes.niche_reason: Camera features for LiDAR registration is a growing but common idea

nodes.title: MISO: Multiresolution Submap Optimization for Efficient Globally Consistent Neural Implicit Reconstruction
nodes.tldr: MISO accelerates neural implicit SDF SLAM using multiresolution submaps with learned hierarchical optimization and feature-level submap alignment, avoiding full geometry decoding.
nodes.problem: Neural implicit SLAM back-end optimization is slow and drifts at large scale.
nodes.approach: Multiresolution submaps, learned hierarchical local optimization, and direct hierarchical feature alignment and fusion.
secondary_topics: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: Neural SLAM back-end optimization is a specialised robotics-vision topic.

nodes.title: Manual2Skill: Learning to Read Manuals and Acquire Robotic Skills for Furniture Assembly Using Vision-Language Models
nodes.tldr: Manual2Skill uses VLMs to parse instruction manuals into hierarchical assembly graphs, then pose estimation and motion planning to assemble real IKEA furniture.
nodes.problem: Robots cannot interpret abstract manuals to perform long-horizon assembly.
nodes.approach: VLM-extracted assembly graphs, 6D relative pose prediction per step, and motion planning for execution.
nodes.niche_reason: Learning from instruction manuals for assembly is uncommon.

nodes.title: Map Space Belief Prediction for Manipulation-Enhanced Mapping
nodes.tldr: A POMDP planner for manipulation-enhanced semantic mapping uses neural, calibrated map-space belief updates to choose viewpoints and manipulation actions that reveal objects in cluttered shelves.
nodes.problem: Efficiently identifying all objects in a cluttered shelf requiring occlusion removal under uncertainty.
nodes.approach: Learn calibrated neural belief updates over a metric-semantic grid map within a POMDP planner.
nodes.niche_reason: Interactive perception with learned belief updates is relatively rare.

nodes.title: Meta-Learning Online Dynamics Model Adaptation in Off-Road Autonomous Driving
nodes.tldr: Combines Kalman-filter online adaptation with meta-learned basis functions to adapt vehicle dynamics models in real time for high-speed off-road driving, validated on a full-scale vehicle.
nodes.problem: Dynamics models fail to generalize to unseen off-road terrain, requiring real-time adaptation.
nodes.approach: Offline meta-learning of basis functions and adaptation parameters with online Kalman-filter model adaptation.
nodes.niche_reason: High-speed off-road dynamics adaptation is a rare niche.

nodes.title: Morpheus: A Neural-driven Animatronic Face with Hybrid Actuation and Diverse Emotion Control
nodes.tldr: Morpheus is an animatronic face combining rigid and string actuation, with a self-modelling network mapping speech to emotional expressions.
nodes.problem: Animatronic faces struggle to express emotion given hardware space limits and control difficulty.
nodes.approach: Rigid eyes and mouth plus string-driven cheeks and nose; gradient-trained motor-to-landmark model drives speech-controlled blendshapes.
nodes.niche_reason: Neural-driven animatronic faces are a very rare robotics niche.

nodes.title: NaVILA: Legged Robot Vision-Language-Action Model for Navigation
nodes.tldr: Two-level framework: a VLA outputs language mid-level actions such as moving forward 75cm, which a visual locomotion RL policy executes on legged robots.
nodes.problem: Translating human language commands into low-level joint actions for legged navigation in clutter.
nodes.approach: Unifies a VLA producing spatial language commands with a locomotion RL policy for execution.
nodes.niche_reason: Legged vision-language navigation is an emerging, specialised direction.

nodes.title: Neural Inertial Odometry from Lie Events
nodes.tldr: Samples IMU data as Lie-algebra level-crossing events, making neural inertial odometry priors robust to sampling rate and trajectory changes.
nodes.problem: Neural inertial odometry priors fail to generalize across IMU sampling rates and trajectory profiles.
nodes.approach: Level-crossing event sampling on the SE(3) Lie algebra with normalized Lie polarities for training.
secondary_topics: Architectures & Training › Time Series & Sequential Data
nodes.niche_reason: Event-based sampling of IMU data on the Lie algebra is rare

nodes.title: Novel Demonstration Generation with Gaussian Splatting Enables Robust One-Shot Manipulation
nodes.tldr: Generates diverse demonstrations from one expert demo by editing 3D Gaussian Splatting scenes, raising visuomotor policy success from under 10 to 85.9 percent.
nodes.problem: Visuomotor imitation policies generalize poorly across visual domains due to limited demonstration diversity.
nodes.approach: 3DGS scene reconstruction and automatic editing of poses, objects, views, lighting and embodiments to synthesize demonstrations.
secondary_topics: Data, Benchmarks & Evaluation › Synthetic Data & Data Curation
Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: Splatting-based demo synthesis is emerging but specialised.

nodes.title: On the Surprising Robustness of Sequential Convex Optimization for Contact-Implicit Motion Planning
nodes.tldr: Introduces CRISP, a primal-only sequential convex programming solver for contact-implicit motion planning that solves problems from naive all-zero initialization.
nodes.problem: Contact-implicit planning's complementarity constraints break constraint qualifications that numerical solvers need.
nodes.approach: Solves a trust-region convex QP each iteration, using a weighted l1 merit function to monitor convergence.
nodes.niche_reason: Contact-implicit planning via sequential convex programming is specialised

nodes.title: Online Competitive Information Gathering for Partially Observable Trajectory Games
nodes.tldr: Presents an online method for rational trajectory planning in partially observable games, where agents gather information about opponents via particle-based stochastic gradient play.
nodes.problem: Planning optimally in continuous partially observable multi-agent games is intractable without heavy offline computation.
nodes.approach: Finite history/horizon POSG refinement with particle belief estimates and stochastic gradient play, deployed online.
nodes.confidence_reason: Game-theoretic planning sits between motion planning and multi-agent games.
nodes.niche_reason: Active information gathering in trajectory games is an unusual angle

nodes.title: Optimal Interactive Learning on the Job via Facility Location Planning
nodes.tldr: Polynomial-time interaction planner that schedules when a robot learns from or asks its human user, minimizing human effort while completing tasks under hidden preferences.
nodes.problem: Robots learning on the job must balance learning, human burden, and task progress.
nodes.approach: Formulates planning as uncapacitated facility location, with approximation algorithms for unknown preferences.
nodes.confidence_reason: Human-robot learning on the job also touches imitation learning.
nodes.niche_reason: Facility-location planning for robot learning from humans is an unusual angle.

nodes.title: PIN-WM: Learning Physics-INformed World Models for Non-Prehensile Manipulation
nodes.tldr: Identifies rigid-body physics parameters from vision with differentiable physics and rendering, then learns manipulation policies that transfer zero-shot to the real world.
nodes.problem: Non-prehensile manipulation depends on friction and restitution, and sim-to-real gaps hurt policies.
nodes.approach: Differentiable-physics system identification plus digital cousins that perturb physics and rendering.
secondary_topics: Reinforcement Learning › Model-Based RL & World Models
nodes.niche_reason: Physics-informed world models for pushing are specialised

nodes.title: PINGS: Gaussian Splatting Meets Distance Fields within a Point-Based Implicit Neural Map
nodes.tldr: PINGS is a LiDAR-visual SLAM system whose point-based implicit neural map unifies a signed distance field and Gaussian splatting radiance field with mutual geometric consistency.
nodes.problem: Scalable incremental mapping of consistent, high-quality distance and radiance fields for robots.
nodes.approach: Compact neural points encoding both SDF and Gaussian splatting, with geometric consistency constraints between fields.
secondary_topics: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: Neural-map SLAM is an established specialised area.

nodes.title: PP-Tac: Paper Picking Using Omnidirectional Tactile Feedback in Dexterous Robotic Hands
nodes.tldr: PP-Tac is a multi-fingered robot hand with omnidirectional tactile sensing and a diffusion policy trained on synthesized grasp trajectories to pick up paper-like flat objects.
nodes.problem: Robots struggle to grasp thin, flat deformable objects like paper and fabric.
nodes.approach: Tactile multi-fingered hand with slippage detection, synthesized grasp data, and a diffusion policy.
nodes.confidence_reason: Straddles dexterous manipulation and tactile hardware; both contributions central.
nodes.niche_reason: Thin flat-object grasping with tactile hands is a specialized niche.

nodes.title: PartInstruct: Part-level Instruction Following for Fine-grained Robot Manipulation
nodes.tldr: PartInstruct is the first large benchmark for fine-grained robot manipulation with part-level language instructions over 513 annotated object instances.
nodes.problem: No large datasets exist for manipulation with part-level instructions and part-annotated 3D objects.
nodes.approach: Build simulated benchmark with part-level annotations and tasks; evaluate and train instruction-following policies.
nodes.niche_reason: Part-level language grounding for manipulation is specialised.

nodes.title: Particle-Grid Neural Dynamics for Learning Deformable Object Models from RGB-D Videos
nodes.tldr: Learned particle-grid neural dynamics model for deformable objects from sparse RGB-D robot interaction videos, coupled with Gaussian splatting for action-conditioned video and planning.
nodes.problem: Modeling deformable object dynamics from limited visual observations with diverse materials and shapes.
nodes.approach: Hybrid particle and spatial-grid representation that predicts dense particle motion for learned digital twins.
secondary_topics: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.confidence_reason: Learned simulator vs 3D perception framing is a judgment call
nodes.niche_reason: Learned digital twins of deformables with particle-grid dynamics are rare.

nodes.title: Physics-Driven Data Generation for Contact-Rich Manipulation via Trajectory Optimization
nodes.tldr: A data pipeline turns few VR human demos into large cross-embodiment datasets using kinematic retargeting and trajectory optimization, training diffusion policies for contact-rich tasks.
nodes.problem: Costly collection of large datasets for contact-rich robot manipulation.
nodes.approach: Simulation-based demo refinement via retargeting and trajectory optimization across embodiments and physical parameters.
nodes.niche_reason: Physics-driven synthetic demo generation is specialised.

nodes.title: Prompting with the Future: Open-World Model Predictive Control with Interactive Digital Twins
nodes.tldr: Combines VLM reasoning with interactive digital twins in model predictive control, simulating candidate trajectories and prompting the VLM with predicted futures to select actions.
nodes.problem: VLMs generalize in high-level planning but lack physical understanding for low-level open-world manipulation control.
nodes.approach: Simulate trajectories in digital twins, render outcomes from novel views, and let the VLM select the best.
nodes.niche_reason: VLM plus digital-twin MPC is specialised but active.

nodes.title: Provably-Safe, Online System Identification
nodes.tldr: Integrates receding-horizon planning that generates provably safe exciting trajectories with robust identification giving overapproximative bounds on payload inertial parameters.
nodes.problem: Identifying unknown payload inertial parameters safely, while respecting constraints and avoiding collisions, is hard.
nodes.approach: Online receding-horizon excitation planning with bounded-noise overapproximative parameter estimation.
nodes.niche_reason: Provably safe payload identification is rare.

nodes.title: RAMEN: Real-time Asynchronous Multi-agent Neural Implicit Mapping
nodes.tldr: RAMEN lets multiple robots build a shared neural implicit map under unreliable communication, using uncertainty-weighted asynchronous consensus ADMM across agents.
nodes.problem: Multi-agent neural implicit mapping needs synchronous communication, impractical with limited bandwidth and interruptions.
nodes.approach: Weighted decentralized consensus ADMM biasing toward lower-uncertainty network parameters, with uncertainty from update frequency.
nodes.niche_reason: Decentralized asynchronous neural implicit mapping is a rare robotics niche.

nodes.title: RAPID: Robust and Agile Planner Using Inverse Reinforcement Learning for Vision-Based Drone Navigation
nodes.tldr: Learns a visual planner for agile drone flight via inverse RL from motion-primitive expert data, trained only in simulation and flying up to 8.8 m/s.
nodes.problem: High-speed vision-based drone navigation suffers from BC compounding errors and RL reward design and sample inefficiency.
nodes.approach: Inverse RL on expert planner demonstrations producing collision-free waypoints directly from vision, with zero-shot sim-to-real transfer.
secondary_topics: Reinforcement Learning › Reward Learning, Inverse RL & Preferences
nodes.niche_reason: Learning-based agile drone flight with IRL is specialised.

nodes.title: RLDG: Robotic Generalist Policy Distillation via Reinforcement Learning
nodes.tldr: RLDG uses reinforcement learning to generate high-quality data for fine-tuning generalist robot policies, outperforming human demonstrations by up to 40% on precise assembly tasks.
nodes.problem: Generalist robot policy performance depends on training data quality, and human demonstrations are suboptimal.
nodes.approach: Train task-specific RL policies and distill their data into fine-tuning generalist policies.
secondary_topics: Reinforcement Learning › Online & Deep RL Algorithms
nodes.niche_reason: RL-to-generalist distillation is a less common recipe within VLA work.

nodes.title: ROMAN: Open-Set Object Map Alignment for Robust View-Invariant Global Localization
nodes.tldr: Localizes robots by aligning open-set object submaps via graph-theoretic data association using object shape, semantics, and gravity priors.
nodes.problem: Global localization fails under significantly different viewpoints and in feature-sparse or perceptually aliased environments.
nodes.approach: Register object submaps with unified graph-theoretic data association over shape, semantic similarity, and gravity direction.
nodes.niche_reason: Object-map localization is established but specialised.

nodes.title: RUKA: Rethinking the Design of Humanoid Hands with Learning
nodes.tldr: RUKA is a low-cost, 3D-printed tendon-driven humanoid hand with five fingers whose control is made practical through learning-based approaches.
nodes.problem: Designing an affordable, compact, strong and precise dexterous humanoid hand.
nodes.approach: 3D-printed tendon-driven hand using learned control to compensate for low-cost actuation.
nodes.niche_reason: Learning-aided robot hand hardware is established but specialised.

nodes.title: Reactive Diffusion Policy: Slow-Fast Visual-Tactile Policy Learning for Contact-Rich Manipulation
nodes.tldr: Slow latent diffusion policy predicts action chunks while a fast tokenizer reacts to tactile feedback, enabling contact-rich visual-tactile imitation with AR tactile teleoperation.
nodes.problem: Action-chunked visual imitation cannot react instantly to tactile feedback during chunk execution.
nodes.approach: Two-level slow-fast hierarchy: latent diffusion for chunks at low rate, asymmetric tokenizer at high rate.
nodes.niche_reason: Diffusion imitation policies are common; tactile reactivity adds some niche.

nodes.title: Resolving Conflicting Constraints in Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning with Layered Safety
nodes.tldr: Addresses conflicting safety constraints among agents in multi-robot navigation by combining multi-agent reinforcement learning with layered safety mechanisms such as reachability and control barrier functions.
nodes.problem: MARL lacks safety guarantees for multi-robot collision avoidance, and agents' constraints can conflict.
nodes.approach: Layered safety combining learned MARL policies with control-theoretic guarantees; details not given in abstract.
nodes.confidence_reason: Abstract is truncated and omits the method itself.
nodes.niche_reason: Safe MARL for multi-robot coordination is specialised.

nodes.title: Riemannian Direct Trajectory Optimization of Rigid Bodies on Matrix Lie Groups
nodes.tldr: Trajectory optimization for rigid-body dynamics on matrix Lie groups using Riemannian interior-point methods, with exact derivatives, running an order of magnitude faster.
nodes.problem: Direct trajectory optimization ignores rigid-body manifold structure, converging slowly.
nodes.approach: Lie group variational integrator with Riemannian interior-point method and exact Riemannian derivatives.
nodes.niche_reason: Established geometric optimal control niche, not mainstream ML

nodes.title: RoboMIND: Benchmark on Multi-embodiment Intelligence Normative Data for Robot Manipulation
nodes.tldr: Releases RoboMIND, 107k teleoperated manipulation demonstrations across 479 tasks and four robot embodiments, including failure data.
nodes.problem: Robot manipulation lacks large, unified, multi-embodiment demonstration datasets.
nodes.approach: Unified teleoperation collection protocol plus an Isaac Sim digital twin for evaluation.
nodes.niche_reason: Robot manipulation datasets are increasingly common.

nodes.title: RoboPanoptes: The All-Seeing Robot with Whole-body Dexterity
nodes.tldr: A robot with cameras distributed over its whole body uses a visuomotor policy learned from demonstrations to exploit contact across its entire surface.
nodes.problem: Robots typically manipulate with end-effectors, missing whole-body contact and narrow-space tasks.
nodes.approach: Whole-body visuomotor policy aggregating distributed camera views, trained from human demonstrations.
nodes.confidence_reason: system paper straddling manipulation and imitation policy
nodes.niche_reason: whole-body dexterity with distributed vision is an unusual system design

nodes.title: RoboVerse: A Unified Platform, Benchmark and Dataset for Scalable and Generalizable Robot Learning
nodes.tldr: RoboVerse is a unified simulation platform, benchmark and large synthetic dataset for scalable robot learning, aiming to standardize evaluation across fragmented simulators.
nodes.problem: Scaling robot data and standardized benchmarks is hard; existing simulation efforts are fragmented.
nodes.approach: Unified simulation platform integrating multiple simulators with a large synthetic dataset and standardized benchmarks.
nodes.niche_reason: Robot simulation benchmarks are established but specialised.

nodes.title: Robot Data Curation with Mutual Information Estimators
nodes.tldr: Scores robot demonstrations by their contribution to state-action mutual information, estimated with kNN on VAE embeddings, to rank dataset quality for imitation learning.
nodes.problem: Imitation policies depend on demonstration quality, but robot datasets are rarely assessed for it.
nodes.approach: kNN mutual information estimates on VAE state-action embeddings, scoring each trajectory's contribution.
nodes.niche_reason: Demonstration-quality scoring is an emerging, less-explored robotics topic

nodes.title: Robot Learning with Super-Linear Scaling
nodes.tldr: CASHER crowdsources 3D-reconstructed digital twins and collects simulation data driven by RL and demos, progressively replacing human effort so performance scales super-linearly.
nodes.problem: Robot learning data collection scales poorly with human effort.
nodes.approach: Real-to-sim-to-real pipeline with crowdsourced scene scans, RL bootstrapped by demos and model-generated demonstrations.
nodes.niche_reason: Sim data scaling is established; crowdsourced digital twins is specialised.

nodes.title: Robust Peg-in-Hole Assembly under Uncertainties via Compliant and Interactive Contact-Rich Manipulation
nodes.tldr: A learning-free peg-in-hole system uses compliant contact-rich interactions and manipulation funnels to absorb perception and physical uncertainties during tight-tolerance assembly.
nodes.problem: Peg-in-hole assembly under tight tolerance is hard due to perception and contact uncertainties.
nodes.approach: Plan collision-inclusive compliant interactions composing funnels in state spaces to localize holes and refine insertion.
nodes.niche_reason: Learning-free contact-rich assembly with funnel formalism is uncommon.

nodes.title: SATA: Safe and Adaptive Torque-Based Locomotion Policies Inspired by Animal Learning
nodes.tldr: Bio-inspired framework for learning torque-based legged locomotion policies with better early exploration, achieving zero-shot sim-to-real transfer and compliant, safe behavior.
nodes.problem: Torque-space legged locomotion policies are hard to train and unsafe in unseen environments.
nodes.approach: Biomechanics-inspired torque policy learning with improved early-stage exploration.
nodes.niche_reason: Torque-based legged locomotion is specialised.

nodes.title: SKIL: Semantic Keypoint Imitation Learning for Generalizable Data-efficient Manipulation
nodes.tldr: SKIL uses vision foundation models to extract semantic keypoint descriptors for sample-efficient imitation learning, reaching 70% on long-horizon towel hanging with 30 demonstrations and supporting human-video learning.
nodes.problem: Imitation learning of generalizable, precise, long-horizon tasks needs too many demonstrations.
nodes.approach: Automatically obtained semantic keypoints from vision foundation models form descriptors as the policy's observation abstraction.
nodes.niche_reason: Keypoint-based imitation is established but specialised.

nodes.title: STDArm: Transfer Visuomotor Policy From Static Data Training to Dynamic Robot Manipulation
nodes.tldr: Transfers stationary-trained visuomotor policies to moving mobile arms by buffering asynchronous actions and predicting base motion to stabilize the end effector.
nodes.problem: Visuomotor policies trained on static robots become unstable when the platform moves.
nodes.approach: Action manager for higher-frequency outputs, plus an end-effector stabilizer that predicts base motion.
nodes.confidence_reason: Policy transfer and motion stabilization straddle two Robotics topics.
nodes.niche_reason: Static-to-dynamic policy transfer is an uncommon setting.

nodes.title: Safe Beyond the Horizon: Efficient Sampling-based MPC with Neural Control Barrier Functions
nodes.tldr: Learns an approximate discrete-time control barrier function and embeds it in sampling-based MPC, with a variance-reducing sampler, for safe real-time control.
nodes.problem: Sampling-based MPC does not guarantee safety beyond its prediction horizon for black-box nonlinear dynamics.
nodes.approach: Learned neural CBF as a constraint inside variational inference MPC, plus a low-variance sampling strategy.
nodes.niche_reason: learned barrier functions in sampling MPC are specialised

nodes.title: SafeMimic: Towards Safe and Autonomous Human-to-Robot Imitation for Mobile Manipulation
nodes.tldr: Learns mobile manipulation skills from one third-person human video, verifying each action for safety with simulation-trained value functions and backtracking.
nodes.problem: Robots need to learn tasks from a single human video safely, without costly human supervision.
nodes.approach: Parses video into segments, adapts motions to its morphology with verified candidate actions, and backtracks on failure.
nodes.confidence_reason: Imitation, safe RL and planning topics overlap; primary is judgment.
nodes.niche_reason: Safe one-shot human-video imitation for mobile manipulation is specialised.

nodes.title: Safety with Agency: Human-Centered Safety Filter with Application to AI-Assisted Motorsports
nodes.tldr: Introduces a safety filter for shared human-AI control that intervenes gradually and minimally, preserving driver agency while improving safety in racing trials.
nodes.problem: Safety filters ignore human decisions, causing automation surprise and eroding driver agency.
nodes.approach: Model-free safety formulation that gradually steps in and minimally modifies human actions.
nodes.confidence_reason: Judgment call between shared-autonomy HRI and safe control.
nodes.niche_reason: Human-centered shared-autonomy safety filters are unusual.

nodes.title: Self-supervised Multi-future Occupancy Forecasting for Autonomous Driving
nodes.tldr: LOPR forecasts stochastic multi-future LiDAR occupancy grids in a generative latent space conditioned on cameras, maps and planned trajectories, with single-step or diffusion decoders.
nodes.problem: Deterministic occupancy grid prediction yields unrealistic forecasts and ignores stochasticity and extra sensors.
nodes.approach: Latent-space generative occupancy prediction with multimodal conditioning and optional diffusion-based decoding.
nodes.niche_reason: Occupancy forecasting is established but specialised.

nodes.title: Sense and Sensibility: What makes an social robot convincing to high-school students?
nodes.tldr: A 40-student study shows a social educational robot strongly sways answers, more so when portraying certainty and for students experienced with LLMs.
nodes.problem: How persuasive a social robot is to students, and how displayed certainty modulates influence.
nodes.approach: User study with an educational robot varying certainty via semantics, prosody and facial signals on circuit questions.
nodes.niche_reason: Social robot persuasion studies with students are rare at ML venues.

nodes.title: Sim-and-Real Co-Training: A Simple Recipe for Vision-Based Robotic Manipulation
nodes.tldr: Shows that mixing simulated and real demonstration data during co-training significantly improves vision-based manipulation, and gives guidelines for simulation data factors.
nodes.problem: Real-world robot data collection is costly, while simulation-only training suffers from the sim-to-real gap.
nodes.approach: Co-training policies on mixtures of simulation and real datasets, with controlled experiments across two robot domains.
secondary_topics: Data, Benchmarks & Evaluation › Synthetic Data & Data Curation
nodes.niche_reason: Sim-real co-training is an active direction; recipe-style analysis is common.

nodes.title: Sketch-to-Skill: Bootstrapping Robot Learning with Human Drawn Trajectory Sketches
nodes.tldr: Turns human-drawn 2D sketches into 3D trajectories that seed behavior cloning and guided RL, reaching about 96% of teleoperation-based performance from sketches alone.
nodes.problem: Robot manipulation policies need many expert demonstrations, which are costly to collect at scale.
nodes.approach: Sketch-to-3D trajectory generator produces autonomous demonstrations for behavior cloning, then guided RL refinement.
secondary_topics: Reinforcement Learning › Online & Deep RL Algorithms
nodes.confidence_reason: Sketch demonstrations and RL refinement overlap two topics.
nodes.niche_reason: Sketch-based robot learning is a specialised, emerging niche.

nodes.title: Solving Multi-Agent Safe Optimal Control with Distributed Epigraph Form MARL
nodes.tldr: Uses the epigraph form for constrained multi-agent RL so each agent can solve its part, giving stable training with zero constraint violation on robot tasks.
nodes.problem: Safe multi-agent RL with constraints trains unstably when violations must be zero.
nodes.approach: Distributed epigraph-form optimization within centralized-training distributed-execution MARL.
nodes.niche_reason: Established safe MARL line with an epigraph-based twist

nodes.title: SpatialVLA: Exploring Spatial Representations for Visual-Language-Action Models
nodes.tldr: SpatialVLA injects 3D information via Ego3D position encoding and uses adaptive action grids, pretrained on 1.1M robot episodes as a generalist spatially aware manipulation policy.
nodes.problem: Vision-language-action models lack effective spatial representations for cross-robot manipulation.
nodes.approach: Ego3D position encoding and adaptive discretized action grids on a VLM pretrained with 1.1M episodes.
nodes.niche_reason: VLA models are currently a very active mainstream topic.

nodes.title: Superfast Configuration-Space Convex Set Computation on GPUs for Online Motion Planning
nodes.tldr: Uses GPU parallelism to inflate collision-free paths into probabilistically collision-free convex sets in configuration space online, enabling fast trajectory optimization in changing environments.
nodes.problem: Convex-set based motion planning was too slow to handle dynamic environments online.
nodes.approach: Massively parallel GPU inflation of paths into convex set sequences, integrated with dynamic roadmaps and trajectory optimization.
nodes.niche_reason: Convex-set planning with GPU parallelism is a rare specialised direction.

nodes.title: Tactile sensing enables vertical obstacle negotiation for elongate many-legged robots
nodes.tldr: A tactile antenna system lets elongated many-legged robots sense and negotiate tall vertical obstacles, with control enabling 3D climbing behaviors.
nodes.problem: Many-legged elongated robots lack sensing and control for rapid vertical motion over tall obstacles.
nodes.approach: Tactile antenna sensing coupled with a reactive control strategy for obstacle traversal.
nodes.niche_reason: Centipede-like robots with tactile antennae are very rare.

nodes.title: Towards Uncertainty Unification: A Case Study for Preference Learning
nodes.tldr: UUPL unifies human preference and robot uncertainty in Gaussian process preference learning, improving posterior mean and covariance, with per-user calibration.
nodes.problem: Integrating human preference uncertainty with robot uncertainty in preference learning.
nodes.approach: GP preference learning with a human uncertainty model and an uncertainty-unified Gaussian mixture covariance.
secondary_topics: Reinforcement Learning › Reward Learning, Inverse RL & Preferences
Learning Theory & Optimization › Kernels, GPs & Nonparametrics
nodes.niche_reason: Uncertainty-aware GP preference learning for HRI is rare.

nodes.title: Uncertainty-Aware Trajectory Prediction via Rule-Regularized Heteroscedastic Deep Classification
nodes.tldr: SHIFT frames trajectory prediction as classification with heteroscedastic spectral-normalized GPs and rule-derived priors to separate epistemic and aleatoric uncertainty and improve generalization.
nodes.problem: Trajectory prediction models generalize poorly beyond limited training data and lack calibrated uncertainty.
nodes.approach: Heteroscedastic spectral-normalized GP classification with informative priors from automated rule extraction.
nodes.niche_reason: Uncertainty-aware prediction with rule priors is specialised.

nodes.title: Uni-NaVid: A Video-based Vision-Language-Action Model for Unifying Embodied Navigation Tasks
nodes.tldr: A video-based vision-language-action model unifying instruction following, object search, question answering and person tracking for navigation, with online token merging for 5Hz inference.
nodes.problem: Navigation agents are tailored to single tasks and cannot share synergy across navigation task types.
nodes.approach: Video VLA with online visual token merging, trained on 3.6M samples across four navigation tasks.
nodes.niche_reason: VLA models are a hot, crowded direction; navigation unification adds little rarity.

nodes.title: Unified Video Action Model
nodes.tldr: Unifies video prediction and action prediction in one latent model with decoupled lightweight diffusion heads, enabling fast policy inference without generating video.
nodes.problem: Video-generation-based policies are too slow and less accurate than direct policy learning.
nodes.approach: Joint video-action latent representation with decoupled diffusion decoding, trained with selective input masking for many tasks.
nodes.confidence_reason: Could be VLA foundation model or video generation; judgment call.
nodes.niche_reason: Unified video-action robot policies are a growing, specialised area.

nodes.title: Unified World Models: Coupling Video and Action Diffusion for Pretraining on Large Robotic Datasets
nodes.tldr: UWM jointly denoises video and action diffusion streams in one transformer, enabling policy learning and pretraining from action-free video.
nodes.problem: Robot imitation learning needs action labels, so abundant action-free video goes unused.
nodes.approach: Unified transformer with independent diffusion timesteps for video and action modalities.
nodes.niche_reason: Video-action diffusion pretraining for robot policies is specialised

nodes.title: Users and Wizards in Conversations: How WoZ Interface Choices Define Human-Robot Interactions
nodes.tldr: Compares three Wizard-of-Oz interfaces for robot conversation, finding VR telepresence preferred by users and producing more connected interaction than restricted GUIs.
nodes.problem: Unclear how Wizard-of-Oz interface restrictions on dialogue input and output shape human-robot interaction quality.
nodes.approach: Controlled user and wizard study comparing restricted GUI, unrestricted GUI with audio, and VR telepresence interfaces.
nodes.niche_reason: Wizard-of-Oz interface comparison for robot dialogue is an unusual HRI angle.

nodes.title: V-HOP: Visuo-Haptic 6D Object Pose Tracking
nodes.tldr: A Transformer-based tracker fusing vision and a unified haptic representation to track 6D object pose during manipulation, generalizing across grippers and tactile sensor types.
nodes.problem: Visuo-haptic pose estimation generalizes poorly across grippers, sensors and sim-to-real, and lacks temporal coherence.
nodes.approach: Unified haptic representation across embodiments plus Transformer visuo-haptic pose tracker.
nodes.niche_reason: Visuo-tactile pose tracking across embodiments is a rare direction.

nodes.title: Verti-Bench: A General and Scalable Off-Road Mobility Benchmark for Vertically Challenging Terrain
nodes.tldr: Off-road mobility benchmark with 100 rugged environments and 1000 navigation tasks in multi-physics simulation, scalable to many vehicle platforms.
nodes.problem: Off-road mobility evaluation cannot use static datasets, since vehicle-terrain interaction needs closed-loop simulation.
nodes.approach: High-fidelity multi-physics simulation with standardized tasks, expert and failure datasets, and a gym-like RL interface.
nodes.niche_reason: Vertically challenging off-road mobility benchmarking is a rare niche

nodes.title: ViTaSCOPE: Visuo-tactile Implicit Representation for In-hand Pose and Extrinsic Contact Estimation
nodes.tldr: Neural implicit SDF fusing vision and high-resolution shear tactile fields to estimate in-hand object pose, 3D geometry, and external contact locations.
nodes.problem: In-hand pose and contact estimation is hard due to partial, noisy visual and tactile observations.
nodes.approach: Signed distance field conditioned on tactile shear and visual feedback, with simulation used for training.
nodes.niche_reason: Established but specialised: visuo-tactile implicit pose estimation.

nodes.title: Vib2Move: In-hand Object Reconfiguration via Fingertip Micro-vibrations
nodes.tldr: Vib2Move repositions planar objects in a parallel gripper by modulating friction with fingertip micro-vibrations, reaching errors under 5 mm.
nodes.problem: Precise in-hand reconfiguration of planar objects without complex dexterous hands.
nodes.approach: Vibration-based variable-friction actuator, sliding motion model, and planner coordinating trajectories and vibrations.
nodes.niche_reason: Vibration-modulated friction for in-hand manipulation is very rare.

nodes.title: Vysics: Object Reconstruction Under Occlusion by Fusing Vision and Contact-Rich Physics
nodes.tldr: Reconstructs a rigid object's shape under heavy occlusion by fusing RGBD tracking with contact-based physics inferred from robot proprioception, without pre-training.
nodes.problem: Heavy occlusion hides object geometry, and vision-only reconstruction misses physically implied contacts.
nodes.approach: Jointly optimize an SDF from visible geometry and physics-inferred physible geometry via implicit contact dynamics optimization.
secondary_topics: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: Fusing contact physics into occluded object shape reconstruction is unusual.

nodes.title: You Only Teach Once: Learn One-Shot Bimanual Robotic Manipulation from Video Demonstrations
nodes.tldr: Learns bimanual manipulation from a single human video by extracting hand-motion patterns, generating varied demonstrations, and training a bimanual diffusion policy.
nodes.problem: Bimanual manipulation needs many demonstrations or teleoperation, which is costly to collect.
nodes.approach: Keyframe-based trajectory synthesis from one video, then a customized bimanual diffusion policy.
nodes.niche_reason: video-based imitation with diffusion policies is common

nodes.title: emg2tendon: From sEMG Signals to Tendon Control in Musculoskeletal Hands
nodes.tldr: Maps wrist-worn sEMG signals to tendon controls for a musculoskeletal robotic hand, giving an inexpensive, occlusion-robust alternative to mocap for training tendon-driven policies.
nodes.problem: Tendon-driven hands lack direct mocap-to-tendon mapping, and visual tracking suffers from occlusion.
nodes.approach: Learn a mapping from wrist sEMG signals to tendon control for musculoskeletal hand simulation.
nodes.niche_reason: sEMG to tendon control for musculoskeletal hands is very rare.

nodes.title: π₀: A Vision-Language-Action Flow Model for General Robot Control
nodes.tldr: Generalist robot policy built by adding a flow-matching action head to a pretrained vision-language model, trained on multi-platform dexterous robot data.
nodes.problem: Robot learning lacks the generality, data, and robustness needed for real-world dexterous tasks.
nodes.approach: Flow-matching action expert on a VLM backbone, trained on diverse robot platforms and fine-tuned for new skills.
nodes.niche_reason: Vision-language-action foundation models are very crowded now

nodes.title: 3D Highlighter: Localizing Regions on 3D Shapes via Text Descriptions
nodes.tldr: Localizes semantic regions on 3D meshes from text prompts using a CLIP-guided neural field, including concepts absent from the shape's domain.
nodes.problem: Text-driven localization on 3D shapes usually needs 3D datasets or annotations, and out-of-domain concepts are hard
nodes.approach: Neural field contextualizes text, colors regions via probability-weighted blend, optimized with a pretrained CLIP encoder.
nodes.confidence_reason: Text-driven 3D localization straddles 3D understanding and CLIP-based zero-shot vision
nodes.niche_reason: Text-localized mesh regions with out-of-domain concepts is an unusual angle

nodes.title: 3D Line Mapping Revisited
nodes.tldr: Introduces LIMAP, a library that builds robust 3D line maps from multi-view images using improved triangulation and structural priors like parallelism and orthogonality.
nodes.problem: Line-based 3D reconstruction lags far behind point-based methods due to degenerate line triangulation.
nodes.approach: Degeneracy-aware triangulation, careful scoring and track building, and coincidence and orthogonality priors.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: Line-based mapping is rarer than point-based reconstruction

nodes.title: A Dynamic Multi-Scale Voxel Flow Network for Video Prediction
nodes.tldr: DMVFN predicts future video frames from RGB only using a differentiable routing module that selects adaptive sub-networks per input by motion scale, far faster than prior methods.
nodes.problem: Video prediction methods are large, slow and need extra inputs like depth or semantic maps.
nodes.approach: Dynamic multi-scale voxel flow network with differentiable routing selecting sub-networks by perceived motion scale.
nodes.niche_reason: Flow-based video prediction is established but less mainstream now.

nodes.title: A General Regret Bound of Preconditioned Gradient Method for DNN Training
nodes.tldr: Derives a full-matrix preconditioned optimizer with block-diagonal Kronecker-factored constraints, giving a regret bound and AdaBK variants that improve SGDM and AdamW on vision tasks.
nodes.problem: Full-matrix preconditioning has better regret bounds but is too expensive for deep network training.
nodes.approach: Cone-constrained preconditioner derivation with Kronecker factorization, plus practical stabilization techniques.
nodes.niche_reason: Kronecker-factored preconditioning for DNN optimizers is specialised.

nodes.title: ACSeg: Adaptive Conceptualization for Unsupervised Semantic Segmentation
nodes.tldr: Unsupervised semantic segmentation that learns adaptive per-image concept prototypes from self-supervised ViT features and classifies them.
nodes.problem: Pixel grouping in unsupervised segmentation over- or under-clusters because scene complexity varies per image.
nodes.approach: Adaptive Concept Generator maps learnable prototypes to per-image concepts, trained with a modularity loss.
secondary_topics: Computer Vision › Vision Foundation Models & Self-Supervision
nodes.niche_reason: unsupervised segmentation is an established area

nodes.title: Accelerated Coordinate Encoding: Learning to Relocalize in Minutes Using RGB and Poses
nodes.tldr: ACE trains a scene-specific coordinate head in minutes via batched MLP optimization, matching slow relocalizers without depth or 3D models.
nodes.problem: Learning-based visual relocalization needs hours or days of training per scene.
nodes.approach: Scene-agnostic backbone with MLP prediction head optimized over many views plus a reprojection loss curriculum.
nodes.niche_reason: Fast scene-coordinate relocalization training is a specialised area

nodes.title: Accelerating Dataset Distillation via Model Augmentation
nodes.tldr: Speeds up gradient-matching dataset distillation up to 20x by training synthetic data with early-stage models and parameter-perturbed models instead of many random initializations.
nodes.problem: Gradient-matching dataset distillation is computationally very expensive.
nodes.approach: Model augmentation using early-stage models and parameter perturbation to learn synthetic sets efficiently.
nodes.primary_topic: Data, Benchmarks & Evaluation › Synthetic Data & Data Curation
secondary_topics: Architectures & Training › Efficient Training, Compression & Pruning
nodes.niche_reason: Dataset distillation is an established specialised subfield.

nodes.title: Actionlet-Dependent Contrastive Learning for Unsupervised Skeleton-Based Action Recognition
nodes.tldr: ActCLR finds motion-region actionlets of skeletons by contrasting with static anchors, then applies motion-adaptive augmentations and pooling for unsupervised skeleton-based action recognition.
nodes.problem: Self-supervised skeleton action methods treat motion and static parts equally.
nodes.approach: Unsupervised actionlet extraction, region-specific data transformations, and semantic-aware feature pooling in contrastive learning.
nodes.niche_reason: Skeleton action recognition is established but specialised.

nodes.title: AltFreezing for More General Video Face Forgery Detection
nodes.tldr: AltFreezing alternately freezes spatial and temporal weights of a 3D ConvNet to force detection of both artifact types, improving generalization of video face forgery detection.
nodes.problem: Face forgery detectors rely on one artifact type and fail on out-of-domain forgeries.
nodes.approach: Alternating freezing of spatial and temporal convolution weights during training of a spatiotemporal model.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › Human Pose, Avatars & Faces
nodes.niche_reason: Deepfake detection is established but specialised.

nodes.title: AnyFlow: Arbitrary Scale Optical Flow With Implicit Neural Representation
nodes.tldr: Estimates optical flow at arbitrary output scales from low-resolution inputs by treating flow as a continuous coordinate-based implicit representation.
nodes.problem: Downsampled inputs for optical flow lose small objects and precise boundaries, hurting accuracy.
nodes.approach: Coordinate-based implicit neural representation that decodes flow at any scale, generalizing across KITTI and other benchmarks.
nodes.niche_reason: Arbitrary-scale optical flow is established but specialised

nodes.title: Attention-Based Point Cloud Edge Sampling
nodes.tldr: Selects salient point cloud edge points with attention, inspired by Canny edge detection, as a non-generative sampling method.
nodes.problem: Choosing informative points from point clouds; existing learned samplers are generative and complex.
nodes.approach: Attention-weighted edge detection on point clouds, selecting outline points directly via statistics.
nodes.confidence_reason: abstract vague on method details and benchmarks
nodes.niche_reason: Point cloud sampling is a specialised, established niche

nodes.title: Attribute-Preserving Face Dataset Anonymization via Latent Code Optimization
nodes.tldr: Anonymizes face datasets by optimizing GAN latent codes to hide identity while keeping facial attributes, with no extra network training.
nodes.problem: Anonymizing face identities in datasets while keeping attributes useful for downstream training.
nodes.approach: Latent code optimization in a pretrained GAN with identity obfuscation and feature-matching losses.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › Human Pose, Avatars & Faces
secondary_topics: Trustworthy ML › Machine Unlearning & Privacy Attacks
nodes.confidence_reason: Could file under face modeling or privacy; both fit
nodes.niche_reason: Face anonymization via GAN inversion is specialised but well studied

nodes.title: AutoAD: Movie Description in Context
nodes.tldr: Generates movie audio descriptions by training a small mapping network between frozen GPT and CLIP, using clip context, subtitles and extra pretraining data.
nodes.problem: Generating context-aware audio description for movies with scarce training data.
nodes.approach: Mapping network bridging frozen GPT and CLIP, pretrained on text-only and captioning data.
nodes.confidence_reason: Vision-language generation over video context; could also fit video understanding
nodes.niche_reason: Specialised task, built on common frozen-VLM bridging

nodes.title: AutoRecon: Automated 3D Object Discovery and Reconstruction
nodes.tldr: AutoRecon automatically segments foreground objects from SfM point clouds using self-supervised ViT features, then reconstructs them with decomposed neural scene representations.
nodes.problem: Object reconstruction needs manual background removal via boxes, masks, or mesh editing.
nodes.approach: Locate foreground in SfM point clouds with ViT features, then supervise decomposed neural fields with the point clouds.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: Neural reconstruction is established; automated object discovery is specialised.

nodes.title: Autoregressive Visual Tracking
nodes.tldr: ARTrack treats object tracking as autoregressive coordinate sequence prediction, progressively estimating trajectories without localization heads.
nodes.problem: Template-matching trackers consider only per-frame localization, not the sequential evolution of object trajectories.
nodes.approach: Time-autoregressive model conditioning each coordinate estimate on previous states, with no post-processing.
nodes.niche_reason: Visual tracking is a well-established area

nodes.title: B-Spline Texture Coefficients Estimator for Screen Content Image Super-Resolution
nodes.tldr: Super-resolves screen content images at arbitrary scales by estimating B-spline parameters for an implicit neural representation, keeping text and edges sharp.
nodes.problem: Screen content has sharp edges and text that natural-image SR methods handle poorly.
nodes.approach: Network predicts B-spline scaling, translating, and smoothing parameters; an MLP decodes HR pixels.
nodes.niche_reason: Arbitrary-scale SR is crowded; screen-content B-spline variant is specialised.

nodes.title: BEDLAM: A Synthetic Dataset of Bodies Exhibiting Detailed Lifelike Animated Motion
nodes.tldr: BEDLAM is a synthetic video dataset of realistically clothed, moving SMPL-X bodies that lets networks reach state-of-the-art real-image 3D human pose and shape estimation.
nodes.problem: Synthetic human datasets lack realistic clothing and motion, limiting 3D pose and shape estimation.
nodes.approach: Physics-simulated clothing on animated SMPL-X bodies, rendered in varied scenes and lighting.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › Human Pose, Avatars & Faces
