secondary_topics: Data, Benchmarks & Evaluation › Synthetic Data & Data Curation
nodes.niche_reason: Synthetic human data is specialised but established.

nodes.title: BEVFormer v2: Adapting Modern Image Backbones to Bird's-Eye-View Recognition via Perspective Supervision
nodes.tldr: A two-stage bird's-eye-view detector adds perspective-space supervision so modern image backbones converge faster and reach state-of-the-art nuScenes results.
nodes.problem: BEV detectors are tied to specific depth-pretrained backbones and converge slowly with modern image backbones.
nodes.approach: Perspective-view proposals from a perspective head feed the bird's-eye-view head for final 3D predictions.
nodes.confidence_reason: Detector serves driving; could be detection or autonomous driving topic.
nodes.niche_reason: Camera-based BEV driving detection is a crowded, mainstream area.

nodes.title: Being Comes From Not-Being: Open-Vocabulary Text-to-Motion Generation With Wordless Training
nodes.tldr: Zero-shot text-to-motion generation that turns text into a masked motion prompt for a pretrained reconstruction model, trained without any paired text.
nodes.problem: Open-vocabulary text-to-motion needs diverse paired data or costly online optimization at inference.
nodes.approach: Masked-motion prompting with a text-to-pose generator and wordless training.
secondary_topics: Computer Vision › Human Pose, Avatars & Faces
nodes.confidence_reason: Text-to-motion straddles generation and human pose topics.
nodes.niche_reason: Text-driven motion synthesis is specialised but established.

nodes.title: Beyond mAP: Towards Better Evaluation of Instance Segmentation
nodes.tldr: Shows average precision misses duplicate instance predictions, proposes new duplicate measures and a Semantic Sorting and NMS module to remove them.
nodes.problem: Average precision fails to penalize duplicate and miscategorized predictions in instance segmentation.
nodes.approach: Two duplicate-counting metrics and a plug-and-play Semantic Sorting and NMS module with pixel occupancy matching.
nodes.niche_reason: Metric critiques of detection evaluation are an established, common topic

nodes.title: Box-Level Active Detection
nodes.tldr: Box-level active detection fixes unrealistic image-level evaluation by budgeting per box; ComPAS combines human labels for informative objects with pseudo-labels for learned ones.
nodes.problem: Image-level active detection wastes annotation budget and biases evaluation
nodes.approach: Box-based budget with committee querying plus model pseudo-labeling (ComPAS)
nodes.niche_reason: Active learning for detection is established but specialised.

nodes.title: CLIP-S4: Language-Guided Self-Supervised Semantic Segmentation
nodes.tldr: Class-free semantic segmentation that learns pixel embeddings contrastively, then aligns them with CLIP's feature space and predictions, requiring no annotations or class names.
nodes.problem: Semantic segmentation needs costly pixel labels and predefined class sets.
nodes.approach: Pixel-segment contrastive learning with CLIP embedding and semantic consistency losses.
nodes.niche_reason: Class-free language-driven segmentation is specialised.

nodes.title: CREPE: Can Vision-Language Foundation Models Reason Compositionally?
nodes.tldr: CREPE is a benchmark of hundreds of thousands of image-text pairs showing vision-language foundation models fail at systematic and productive compositional reasoning.
nodes.problem: Whether large vision-language models reason compositionally is not systematically measured.
nodes.approach: Benchmark built from Visual Genome scene graphs with seen-unseen splits and hard negatives for systematicity and productivity.
nodes.niche_reason: Compositionality evaluation is established but specialised.

nodes.title: CVT-SLR: Contrastive Visual-Textual Transformation for Sign Language Recognition With Variational Alignment
nodes.tldr: Recognizes sign language from video by aligning visual features with textual glosses using a VAE and contrastive cross-modal alignment.
nodes.problem: Sign language recognition is bottlenecked by scarce labeled sign video data
nodes.approach: Single-cue visual-textual alignment with VAE-based pretrained contextual knowledge and contrastive alignment
nodes.confidence_reason: Video understanding vs vision-language alignment is a judgment call
nodes.niche_reason: Sign language recognition is specialised but well studied

nodes.title: Camouflaged Instance Segmentation via Explicit De-Camouflaging
nodes.tldr: DCNet segments camouflaged instances using Fourier-based pixel-level camouflage decoupling and instance-level suppression with difference attention.
nodes.problem: Instance segmentation fails on camouflaged objects due to deceptive appearance.
nodes.approach: Fourier-transform camouflage decoupling module plus difference attention suppressing camouflage at the instance level.
nodes.niche_reason: Camouflaged instance segmentation is a rare vision subtask.

nodes.title: Canonical Fields: Self-Supervised Learning of Pose-Canonicalized Neural Fields
nodes.tldr: CaFi-Net self-supervisedly canonicalizes the 3D pose of category instances represented as NeRFs, using a Siamese equivariant field network, matching point-cloud methods.
nodes.problem: Pose-canonicalizing neural fields of object categories without aligned datasets like ShapeNet.
nodes.approach: Siamese network extracting equivariant features from radiance fields for self-supervised category-level canonicalization.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: Operating directly on NeRFs as inputs is unusual.

nodes.title: Cap4Video: What Can Auxiliary Captions Do for Text-Video Retrieval?
nodes.tldr: Generates captions for videos with zero-shot captioning, then uses them to augment training, fuse features, and add a caption-query matching score for text-video retrieval.
nodes.problem: Text-video retrieval ignores auxiliary text like titles and subtitles that online videos carry.
nodes.approach: Auto-generated captions used for data augmentation, cross-modal feature interaction, and extra matching scores.
nodes.niche_reason: Text-video retrieval is a crowded benchmark-driven area

nodes.title: Coaching a Teachable Student
nodes.tldr: Distills a privileged BEV teacher into an image-based driving student by aligning features to BEV space with student-paced coaching, improving CARLA driving score.
nodes.problem: Distilling privileged driving agents into sensorimotor students gives suboptimal student behavior.
nodes.approach: BEV-feature alignment with teacher supervision, student-paced coaching, and a high-capacity imitation-learned teacher.
nodes.niche_reason: End-to-end driving distillation in CARLA is a common setup.

nodes.title: Common Pets in 3D: Dynamic New-View Synthesis of Real-Life Deformable Categories
nodes.tldr: Introduces CoP3D, a crowd-sourced video dataset of about 4,200 pets, and Tracker-NeRF for dynamic new-view synthesis of deformable cats and dogs.
nodes.problem: Non-rigid 3D reconstruction from sparse views lacks large benchmarks outside controlled settings.
nodes.approach: Learns trajectories and dynamics of 3D points from few frames and generates views interpolated in viewpoint and time.
secondary_topics: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: In-the-wild non-rigid reconstruction datasets are still uncommon

nodes.title: ConQueR: Query Contrast Voxel-DETR for 3D Object Detection
nodes.tldr: Query Contrast pushes DETR-style 3D detector queries toward matched ground truths, cutting about 60% of false positives and closing the gap with dense detectors.
nodes.problem: DETR-based 3D detectors produce many redundant overlapping false-positive queries.
nodes.approach: Contrastive loss over positive and negative GT-query pairs using feature similarity.
nodes.niche_reason: 3D detection with DETR is a common direction.

nodes.title: Connecting Vision and Language With Video Localized Narratives
nodes.tldr: Video Localized Narratives: spoken-and-traced annotations linking words to video regions for 20k videos, with new benchmarks for narrative grounding and video question answering.
nodes.problem: Lack of annotations connecting vision and language for complex multi-actor video events.
nodes.approach: New annotation protocol where annotators narrate and trace objects on video, yielding grounding and QA benchmarks.
nodes.niche_reason: Video-language annotation datasets are established but specialised.

nodes.title: Consistent-Teacher: Towards Reducing Inconsistent Pseudo-Targets in Semi-Supervised Object Detection
nodes.tldr: Reduces inconsistent pseudo-targets in semi-supervised object detection via adaptive anchor assignment, 3D feature alignment and a GMM-based score threshold.
nodes.problem: Oscillating pseudo-boxes inject noise into student training and cause overfitting in semi-supervised detection.
nodes.approach: Adaptive anchor assignment, a 3D feature alignment module and Gaussian Mixture Model dynamic score thresholds.
nodes.niche_reason: Semi-supervised detection with pseudo-labels is a common mainstream direction

nodes.title: Context-Aware Alignment and Mutual Masking for 3D-Language Pre-Training
nodes.tldr: Generic 3D-language pretraining aligning point clouds with text via context-aware spatial-semantic alignment and masked proposal reasoning.
nodes.problem: 3D visual reasoning is task-specific; scarce paired 3D-language data and sparse point clouds hinder pretraining.
nodes.approach: Context-aware spatial-semantic alignment plus mutual 3D-language masked modeling on object proposals.
nodes.niche_reason: 3D-language pretraining is specialised relative to image-text pretraining

nodes.title: Critical Learning Periods for Multisensory Integration in Deep Networks
nodes.tldr: Shows early training exposure to correlated multisensory signals determines final skill integration, with cross-sensor reconstruction improving resilience.
nodes.problem: Whether neural networks have critical learning periods for integrating information across sensory sources is unknown.
nodes.approach: Track source sensitivity during training in deep linear and shallow nets; test cross-sensor reconstruction auxiliary loss.
secondary_topics: Audio, Speech & Multimodal › Audio-Visual & Cross-modal Learning
nodes.confidence_reason: Could be training dynamics or multimodal learning; both central.
nodes.niche_reason: Critical periods for multisensory integration is an unusual biology-inspired angle.

nodes.title: D2Former: Jointly Learning Hierarchical Detectors and Contextual Descriptors via Agent-Based Transformers
nodes.tldr: Jointly learns hierarchical keypoint detectors and contextual descriptors with agent-based transformers to improve pixel-level image matching in texture-less regions.
nodes.problem: CNN descriptors lack discriminability in texture-less regions and detectors miss keypoints of varied structure.
nodes.approach: Descriptor agents model long-range context, and a hierarchical detector produces keypoints at several structure levels.
nodes.niche_reason: Image matching with transformers is common.

nodes.title: DINER: Disorder-Invariant Implicit Neural Representation
nodes.tldr: DINER adds a hash table mapping coordinates to a disorder-invariant distribution before an implicit neural representation, reducing spectral bias and improving signal fitting.
nodes.problem: Spectral bias limits the capacity of implicit neural representations to fit signals.
nodes.approach: Hash-table coordinate re-mapping that makes signals with the same attribute histogram share distributions before the INR backbone.
nodes.confidence_reason: Implicit representation fits representation learning and low-level vision about equally.
nodes.niche_reason: INR spectral-bias remedies are established but specialised.

nodes.title: DKM: Dense Kernelized Feature Matching for Geometry Estimation
nodes.tldr: Dense feature matching with kernel regression global matching, warp refinement, and learned dense confidence, outperforming sparse methods on two-view geometry.
nodes.problem: Dense feature matching has lagged sparse methods for two-view geometry estimation.
nodes.approach: Kernelized global matcher, depthwise-conv warp refinement, and consistent-depth confidence learning.
nodes.niche_reason: Feature matching is a crowded geometry area

nodes.title: DNF: Decouple and Feedback Network for Seeing in the Dark
nodes.tldr: Enhances low-light RAW images by decoupling noise-to-clean and RAW-to-sRGB subtasks and feeding features back across stages.
nodes.problem: Single- and multi-stage RAW enhancers suffer domain ambiguity and lose features passed as images.
nodes.approach: Decouple domain-specific subtasks and propagate features with a feedback mechanism rather than image-level outputs.
nodes.niche_reason: Low-light RAW enhancement is an established, active restoration area.

nodes.title: Decoupled Multimodal Distilling for Emotion Recognition
nodes.tldr: Decoupled multimodal distillation splits each modality into shared and exclusive spaces and distills across modalities using graph units with learned weights, for emotion recognition.
nodes.problem: Modality heterogeneity and uneven contribution hurt multimodal emotion recognition.
nodes.approach: Decoupled modality representations with dynamic graph distillation units learning crossmodal distillation weights.
nodes.primary_topic: Audio, Speech & Multimodal › Audio-Visual & Cross-modal Learning
nodes.confidence_reason: Emotion recognition fits cross-modal learning or representation learning about equally.
nodes.niche_reason: Multimodal emotion recognition is an established specialised subfield.

nodes.title: Deep Deterministic Uncertainty: A New Simple Baseline
nodes.tldr: A single softmax network with a regularized feature space plus Gaussian discriminant analysis matches Deep Ensembles for uncertainty at lower cost.
nodes.problem: Reliable uncertainty from single-forward-pass models is needed without expensive methods like ensembles.
nodes.approach: Residual connections and spectral normalization regularize features, then GDA density estimation gives epistemic uncertainty.
nodes.niche_reason: OOD uncertainty baselines are a common, crowded topic

nodes.title: Deep Graph Reprogramming
nodes.tldr: Reuses a frozen pretrained GNN on new cross-domain tasks by reprogramming the input data and the aggregator without changing weights or node features.
nodes.problem: Reusing a pretrained GNN across tasks with different feature dimensions and task types without retraining.
nodes.approach: Data reprogramming (feature padding, edge slimming) plus a task-adaptive reprogrammable aggregator.
nodes.niche_reason: GNN model reprogramming is a rare direction.

nodes.title: DegAE: A New Pretraining Paradigm for Low-Level Vision
nodes.tldr: DegAE pretrains low-level vision networks by treating degradation as the pretext, targeting high-cost tasks where data is scarce.
nodes.problem: Self-supervised pretraining for low-level vision is poorly understood, especially for tasks with costly data.
nodes.approach: Degradation autoencoder pretraining paradigm inspired by examining pretraining in high- and low-level vision.
secondary_topics: Computer Vision › Vision Foundation Models & Self-Supervision
nodes.niche_reason: Pretraining specifically for low-level vision is somewhat specialised.

nodes.title: Devil Is in the Queries: Advancing Mask Transformers for Real-World Medical Image Segmentation and Out-of-Distribution Localization
nodes.tldr: Uses mask-transformer object queries as cluster centers to localize out-of-distribution regions in medical segmentation, with a query-distribution loss improving both inlier segmentation and OOD detection.
nodes.problem: Real-world medical segmentation must handle rare, out-of-distribution tail conditions such as unseen lesions.
nodes.approach: Mask transformer queries fit inlier cluster centers; MaxQuery pixel-query similarity localizes OOD, plus query-distribution loss.
secondary_topics: Architectures & Training › Domain Adaptation & OOD Generalization
nodes.niche_reason: Medical segmentation with OOD localization is specialised.

nodes.title: DiffRF: Rendering-Guided 3D Radiance Field Diffusion
nodes.tldr: DiffRF is a diffusion model that directly generates voxel-grid radiance fields, using a rendering loss to learn multi-view consistent priors that avoid fitting artifacts.
nodes.problem: Generating 3D radiance fields directly with diffusion despite noisy, ambiguous ground-truth radiance fields.
nodes.approach: 3D denoising on explicit voxel grids paired with a rendering loss.
nodes.niche_reason: Direct 3D radiance field diffusion is less common than 2D diffusion.

nodes.title: DisCo-CLIP: A Distributed Contrastive Loss for Memory Efficient CLIP Training
nodes.tldr: DisCo-CLIP decomposes the contrastive loss into intra-GPU and inter-GPU gradient parts, cutting loss memory from O(B^2) to O(B^2/N) while staying mathematically exact.
nodes.problem: Contrastive loss memory grows quadratically with batch size, limiting large-batch CLIP training.
nodes.approach: Distributed decomposition of contrastive loss gradients; inter-GPU gradients collected via all_reduce.
nodes.niche_reason: Memory-efficient contrastive training is a crowded systems direction

nodes.title: DisCoScene: Spatially Disentangled Generative Radiance Fields for Controllable 3D-Aware Scene Synthesis
nodes.project: Project page can be found here.
nodes.tldr: Generates controllable 3D-aware scenes by composing object-centric radiance fields conditioned on bounding-box layouts, learned from 2D images.
nodes.problem: 3D-aware generators focus on single objects and struggle to compose complex scenes.
nodes.approach: Abstract 3D bounding-box layout prior with global-local discrimination over object-centric radiance fields.
secondary_topics: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: Object-layout 3D scene generation is specialised

nodes.title: Divide and Adapt: Active Domain Adaptation via Customized Learning
nodes.tldr: Active domain adaptation framework that partitions target samples into four transferability categories, annotating the most informative ones and tailoring learning for others.
nodes.problem: Conventional active learning ignores domain shift and misses valuable target samples.
nodes.approach: Uncertainty and domainness scores unified into an informativeness score, with GMM-based sample partitioning.
nodes.primary_topic: Architectures & Training › Domain Adaptation & OOD Generalization
secondary_topics: Data, Benchmarks & Evaluation › Synthetic Data & Data Curation
nodes.niche_reason: Established but specialised: active domain adaptation.

nodes.title: ECON: Explicit Clothed Humans Optimized via Normal Integration
nodes.tldr: Reconstructs detailed clothed 3D humans from a single image by inferring 2D normal maps, registering partial surfaces to SMPL-X and inpainting the gaps.
nodes.problem: Implicit-function methods give disembodied limbs, while body-model methods cannot capture loose clothing.
nodes.approach: Detailed 2.5D front and back surfaces from normal maps, registered via SMPL-X, then geometry inpainting.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › Human Pose, Avatars & Faces
secondary_topics: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: Clothed-human reconstruction is specialised but well-studied

nodes.title: ERNIE-ViLG 2.0: Improving Text-to-Image Diffusion Model With Knowledge-Enhanced Mixture-of-Denoising-Experts
nodes.tldr: Large Chinese text-to-image diffusion model using knowledge-enhanced textual and visual cues and stage-specific denoising experts, reaching zero-shot FID 6.75 on MS-COCO.
nodes.problem: Text-to-image diffusion still lags in image fidelity and text-image alignment.
nodes.approach: Incorporate fine-grained textual and visual knowledge of scene elements, and use different denoising experts per stage.
nodes.niche_reason: Text-to-image diffusion is a crowded mainstream area.

nodes.title: ESLAM: Efficient Dense SLAM System Based on Hybrid Representation of Signed Distance Fields
nodes.tldr: Efficient neural implicit dense RGB-D SLAM using multi-scale axis-aligned feature planes decoded into TSDF and color, improving accuracy while running much faster without pretraining.
nodes.problem: Slow and inaccurate dense visual SLAM with implicit neural scene representations.
nodes.approach: Axis-aligned multi-scale feature planes with shallow decoders predicting TSDF and RGB for tracking and mapping.
secondary_topics: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: Neural SLAM was a busy area at the time.

nodes.title: EVA: Exploring the Limits of Masked Visual Representation Learning at Scale
nodes.tldr: EVA scales a vanilla ViT to one billion parameters by masked reconstruction of CLIP-aligned features, setting records across recognition, detection and segmentation, and aiding CLIP training.
nodes.problem: Exploring the limits of scaling visual representation learning with publicly available data.
nodes.approach: Masked image modeling predicting image-text aligned vision features, scaled to a giant ViT.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › Vision Foundation Models & Self-Supervision
nodes.niche_reason: Large-scale vision pretraining is a common mainstream topic.

nodes.title: EXIF As Language: Learning Cross-Modal Associations Between Images and Camera Metadata
nodes.tldr: Learns image features capturing camera information by embedding image patches jointly with EXIF metadata converted to text, enabling zero-shot splice localization.
nodes.problem: Learning visual representations of camera properties for image forensics and calibration.
nodes.approach: Contrastive multimodal embedding between image patches and EXIF metadata text processed by a transformer.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › Vision Foundation Models & Self-Supervision
nodes.niche_reason: EXIF-supervised forensics representation is unusual.

nodes.title: Efficient Frequency Domain-Based Transformers for High-Quality Image Deblurring
nodes.tldr: Deblurring transformer that computes self-attention with element-wise products in the frequency domain, plus a JPEG-inspired gated feed-forward network.
nodes.problem: Transformer deblurring is costly and the naive feed-forward network gives weak results.
nodes.approach: Frequency-domain attention via element-wise products (FSAS) and a discriminative frequency FFN (DFFN).
nodes.niche_reason: Image deblurring transformers are a common restoration direction

nodes.title: Efficient RGB-T Tracking via Cross-Modality Distillation
nodes.tldr: Distills a powerful two-stream RGB-thermal tracker into a compact single-stream tracker, keeping accuracy at lower compute.
nodes.problem: Two-stream RGB-T trackers are too heavy, while compact ones lose accuracy.
nodes.approach: Specific-common feature distillation and multi-path selection distillation.
secondary_topics: Architectures & Training › Efficient Training, Compression & Pruning
nodes.niche_reason: RGB-thermal tracking is specialised

nodes.title: Efficient Second-Order Plane Adjustment
nodes.tldr: Applies Newton's method to plane adjustment by analytically eliminating planes and computing the Hessian efficiently, improving on Levenberg-Marquardt for point-to-plane fitting.
nodes.problem: Plane adjustment for depth-sensor mapping is slow with approximate Hessian solvers
nodes.approach: Closed-form optimal planes eliminated from the cost, enabling exact Newton steps
nodes.niche_reason: Established geometric optimization; plane-based SLAM is specialised

nodes.title: Egocentric Video Task Translation
nodes.tldr: EgoT2 combines separately trained task-specific egocentric video models with a shared task translator, improving performance across heterogeneous Ego4D tasks.
nodes.problem: Egocentric video tasks are treated in isolation despite being interconnected, causing missed synergies and task competition.
nodes.approach: Flipped design with separate task backbones and a shared translator transforming their outputs.
nodes.niche_reason: Egocentric video with cross-task translation is a specialised design.

nodes.title: Event-Based Video Frame Interpolation With Cross-Modal Asymmetric Bidirectional Motion Fields
nodes.tldr: Event-camera video frame interpolation with cross-modal asymmetric bidirectional motion field estimation and attention-based synthesis, plus a new high-frame-rate event dataset ERF-X170FPS.
nodes.problem: Existing event-based interpolation estimates inter-frame motion with events only or approximations, missing complex motion.
nodes.approach: Direct bidirectional motion estimation from events and images, interactive attention synthesis fusing warping and synthesis features.
nodes.niche_reason: Event-camera sensing for interpolation is a rare niche.

nodes.title: Exploring Discontinuity for Video Frame Interpolation
nodes.tldr: Makes video frame interpolation robust to logos, UI, and subtitles via a figure-text augmentation, a discontinuity map, and dedicated losses.
nodes.problem: Interpolation methods assume continuous motion and fail on logos, UI, and subtitles.
nodes.approach: Figure-text mixing augmentation, a discontinuity map predictor, and losses supervising discontinuous regions.
nodes.niche_reason: Frame interpolation is established; handling graphics and text overlays is less studied.

nodes.title: F2-NeRF: Fast Neural Radiance Field Training With Free Camera Trajectories
nodes.tldr: Fast grid-based NeRF that handles arbitrary camera trajectories and unbounded scenes using a new perspective warping, training in minutes.
nodes.problem: Existing space-warping methods only work for forward-facing or object-centric camera paths.
nodes.approach: Perspective warping for unbounded scenes inside a grid-based NeRF framework.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: Fast grid-based NeRF for arbitrary camera paths; established subfield.

nodes.title: FAME-ViL: Multi-Tasking Vision-Language Model for Heterogeneous Fashion Tasks
nodes.tldr: FAME-ViL uses one vision-language model with cross-attention and task-specific adapters to handle heterogeneous fashion tasks, saving 61.5% of parameters.
nodes.problem: Task-specific fine-tuning of V+L models for fashion tasks is parameter-inefficient.
nodes.approach: Unified V+L model with adapters and a multi-task training strategy preventing negative transfer.
nodes.niche_reason: Fashion-domain multi-task V+L adaptation is a specialised application.

nodes.title: Feature Separation and Recalibration for Adversarial Robustness
nodes.tldr: Feature Separation and Recalibration disentangles robust and non-robust activations and recalibrates the non-robust ones to recover useful cues, improving adversarial training robustness.
nodes.problem: Adversarial perturbations corrupt feature activations; deactivating them discards discriminative cues.
nodes.approach: Plug-in module separating robust from non-robust features, then recalibrating non-robust activations.
nodes.niche_reason: Adversarial training variants are common.

nodes.title: Flow Supervision for Deformable NeRF
nodes.tldr: Shows that optical flow can directly supervise deformable NeRFs by using the inverse function theorem, avoiding the need to invert the backward deformation field.
nodes.problem: Enforcing flow constraints on deformable NeRFs is costly because the backward deformation field must be inverted.
nodes.approach: Scene flow is computed without inverting the deformation, via inverse function theorem, supporting a broad class of deformation fields.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: Flow supervision for deformable NeRF is a specialised technical niche.

nodes.title: Freestyle Layout-to-Image Synthesis
nodes.tldr: Lets pre-trained text-to-image diffusion place unseen semantics onto a given layout by rectifying cross-attention with masks.
nodes.problem: Layout-to-image models cover a closed set of semantic classes, so they cannot generate unseen semantics.
nodes.approach: Rectified cross-attention plugged into each cross-attention layer of a pre-trained diffusion model to enforce region-token binding.
nodes.niche_reason: Freestyle layout control beyond base classes is an uncommon diffusion direction.

nodes.title: Frequency-Modulated Point Cloud Rendering With Easy Editing
nodes.tldr: AFNet modulates implicit radiance with adaptive frequency encodings for point-cloud-based novel view synthesis, giving real-time rendering and easy editing.
nodes.problem: High-fidelity, real-time, editable novel view synthesis from point clouds.
nodes.approach: Hypernetwork-learned local frequency encodings drive adaptive frequency activations, with a preprocessing module.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: Point-based neural rendering is established but specialised.

nodes.title: GAPartNet: Cross-Category Domain-Generalizable Object Perception and Manipulation via Generalizable and Actionable Parts
nodes.tldr: Defines generalizable actionable parts across object categories, builds the GAPartNet dataset, and proposes domain-generalizable 3D part segmentation and pose methods enabling cross-category manipulation.
nodes.problem: Cross-category generalizable object perception and manipulation via shared actionable parts.
nodes.approach: Part-centric dataset plus adversarial domain-generalization 3D segmentation and part-based manipulation heuristics.
nodes.niche_reason: Established but specialised articulated object perception.

nodes.title: GRES: Generalized Referring Expression Segmentation
nodes.tldr: Introduces Generalized Referring Expression Segmentation allowing multi-target and no-target expressions, with the gRefCOCO dataset and the region-based ReLA baseline.
nodes.problem: Classic referring expression segmentation only supports single-target expressions.
nodes.approach: New benchmark and large dataset gRefCOCO, plus ReLA modeling region-region and region-language dependencies.
nodes.niche_reason: Referring segmentation is established but specialised.

nodes.title: Gated Stereo: Joint Depth Estimation From Gated and Wide-Baseline Active Stereo Cues
nodes.tldr: Gated Stereo fuses active gated time-of-flight intensity cues with wide-baseline stereo for long-range depth up to 160 m, with a new automotive gated stereo dataset.
nodes.problem: Accurate high-resolution long-range depth estimation for automotive scenes is difficult with RGB stereo or monocular gated imaging.
nodes.approach: Monocular and stereo depth branches fused, supervised with supervised and gated self-supervised losses.
nodes.niche_reason: Active gated imaging for depth is a rare sensing modality.

nodes.title: GeneCIS: A Benchmark for General Conditional Image Similarity
nodes.tldr: GeneCIS is a zero-shot benchmark for conditional image similarity, where models adapt to conditions such as colour or texture; a mined-caption method helps.
nodes.problem: Models use one fixed notion of similarity, but users need dynamic, condition-specific similarity.
nodes.approach: Benchmark of open-set similarity conditions; training from automatically mined image-caption data.
nodes.confidence_reason: benchmark vs retrieval placement; zero-shot evaluation focus
nodes.niche_reason: conditional similarity benchmarks are specialised

nodes.title: Generalist: Decoupling Natural and Robust Generalization
nodes.tldr: Splits adversarial training into two expert learners, one for natural and one for robust generalization, then periodically merges them into a global learner.
nodes.problem: Adversarial training improves robustness but costs natural accuracy through joint training.
nodes.approach: Bi-expert task-aware training with interval parameter aggregation into a shared global learner.
nodes.niche_reason: Decoupling natural and robust generalization is specialised

nodes.title: Generalizable Implicit Neural Representations via Instance Pattern Composers
nodes.tldr: Generalizable INRs modulate only a small early-layer weight set per instance, letting a shared MLP learn composition rules that generalize to unseen instances.
nodes.problem: Coordinate-based MLP implicit representations struggle to share structure across instances and generalize to unseen ones.
nodes.approach: Instance pattern composer: modulate a few weights in an early layer, with remaining weights learning shared composition rules.
nodes.confidence_reason: INR representation topic; meta-learning framing is a judgment call.
nodes.niche_reason: Generalizable INRs are specialised; weight modulation is a known tactic.

nodes.title: Generalizable Local Feature Pre-Training for Deformable Shape Analysis
nodes.tldr: Learns local 3D shape features that transfer to unseen deformable classes like humans and animals, by differentiably optimising the receptive field size during pre-training.
nodes.problem: Existing 3D transfer learning fails to generalise to new deformable shape classes at object or scene level.
nodes.approach: Local feature pre-training with a learnable, differentiable receptive field optimised within 3D transfer learning.
nodes.niche_reason: Local 3D feature transfer for deformable shapes is specialised but established.

nodes.title: GeoLayoutLM: Geometric Pre-Training for Visual Information Extraction
nodes.tldr: Geometric pre-training for document visual information extraction, modeling spatial relations explicitly and pre-training relation heads, boosting relation extraction on FUNSD.
nodes.problem: Document models learn geometry implicitly and have a pre-train/fine-tune gap for relation extraction.
nodes.approach: Three geometry-related pre-training tasks plus relation heads pre-trained and fine-tuned for relation extraction.
nodes.niche_reason: Document intelligence is established but specialised.

nodes.title: GradMA: A Gradient-Memory-Based Accelerated Federated Learning With Alleviated Catastrophic Forgetting
nodes.tldr: Federated learning method that borrows continual-learning gradient memory to correct server and worker updates, reducing forgetting under heterogeneous, partial client participation.
nodes.problem: Catastrophic forgetting from data heterogeneity and partial participation in federated learning.
nodes.approach: Gradient-memory correction of server and worker update directions with memory reduction.
nodes.niche_reason: Common federated continual-learning style variant.

nodes.title: Gradient Norm Aware Minimization Seeks First-Order Flatness and Improves Generalization
nodes.tldr: Defines first-order flatness via maximal gradient norm and proposes GAM, a training method seeking minima flat in all directions for better generalization than SAM.
nodes.problem: Zeroth-order flatness used by SAM cannot separate minima with low and high generalization error.
nodes.approach: Penalize the maximal gradient norm within a perturbation radius during training.
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Deep Learning Theory
nodes.niche_reason: Sharpness-aware minimization variants are a crowded mainstream topic

nodes.title: Habitat-Matterport 3D Semantics Dataset
nodes.tldr: HM3DSEM is the largest dataset of densely annotated semantics in real 3D spaces, with 142,646 instances, and improves object-goal navigation policies.
nodes.problem: Lack of large, accurately annotated semantic 3D scene data for embodied navigation.
nodes.approach: Texture-aware annotation of object instances across 216 real 3D spaces, validated on ObjectNav.
nodes.niche_reason: Embodied 3D scene datasets are common infrastructure.

nodes.title: HairStep: Transfer Synthetic to Real Using Strand and Depth Maps for Single-View 3D Hair Modeling
nodes.tldr: Proposes HairStep, a strand-map plus depth-map intermediate representation that bridges synthetic and real domains for single-view 3D hair reconstruction, with a new annotated dataset.
nodes.problem: Domain gap between synthetic training data and real images in single-view 3D hair modeling.
nodes.approach: Strand and depth map intermediate representation inferred from real images, with annotated portrait dataset.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › Human Pose, Avatars & Faces
nodes.niche_reason: 3D hair reconstruction is a rare niche.

nodes.title: HandsOff: Labeled Dataset Generation With No Additional Human Annotations
nodes.tldr: HandsOff generates unlimited synthetic images with pixel-wise labels from under 50 labeled images by combining GAN inversion with dataset generation.
nodes.problem: Labeled GAN dataset generation requires new human annotations of synthetic images.
nodes.approach: Unify GAN inversion with a label-generating branch trained on few existing labeled images.
nodes.primary_topic: Data, Benchmarks & Evaluation › Synthetic Data & Data Curation
secondary_topics: Generative Models › GANs, VAEs & Normalizing Flows
nodes.niche_reason: GAN-based labeled data synthesis was a recognised but specialised line.

nodes.title: Heterogeneous Continual Learning
nodes.tldr: Continual learning where network architectures change over time, using distillation from weaker to stronger models with fast data inversion to recover prior-task features.
nodes.problem: Continual learning assumes a fixed architecture, but architectures keep evolving.
nodes.approach: Knowledge distillation from weaker teacher to stronger student, plus Quick Deep Inversion.
secondary_topics: Architectures & Training › Efficient Training, Compression & Pruning
nodes.niche_reason: Architecture-changing continual learning is specialised but established.

nodes.title: Hidden Gems: 4D Radar Scene Flow Learning Using Cross-Modal Supervision
nodes.tldr: Estimates 4D radar scene flow using cross-modal supervision from co-located sensors in autonomous vehicles.
nodes.problem: Estimating 4D radar scene flow where direct motion supervision is limited.
nodes.approach: Multi-task network with loss functions exploiting several cross-modal constraints from co-located sensing.
secondary_topics: Audio, Speech & Multimodal › Audio-Visual & Cross-modal Learning
nodes.confidence_reason: Motion estimation with sensor-fusion supervision straddles two close topics.
nodes.niche_reason: Radar-based scene flow for driving is specialised but established.

nodes.title: HierVL: Learning Hierarchical Video-Language Embeddings
nodes.tldr: HierVL learns hierarchical video-language embeddings with contrastive objectives at clip level and video level, using Ego4D narrations and summaries.
nodes.problem: Video-language embeddings capture only short-term clip-text associations, missing long-term context.
nodes.approach: Hierarchical contrastive training aligning clips with step descriptions and whole videos with summaries.
nodes.niche_reason: Video-language pretraining is a common topic.

nodes.title: Hierarchical B-Frame Video Coding Using Two-Layer CANF Without Motion Coding
nodes.tldr: Learned B-frame video codec that drops motion coding, using a low-resolution base layer and conditioned enhancement layer to cut computation.
nodes.problem: Motion coding costs bits and compute in learned video compression.
nodes.approach: Two-layer conditional augmented normalizing flows with skip-mode latent coding.
secondary_topics: Generative Models › GANs, VAEs & Normalizing Flows
nodes.niche_reason: Learned video coding is established; motion-free design is specialised.

nodes.title: Hierarchical Dense Correlation Distillation for Few-Shot Segmentation
nodes.tldr: HDMNet mines pixel-level query-support correlations with transformer attention and correlation distillation for few-shot semantic segmentation, reaching 50.0% mIoU one-shot on COCO-5i.
nodes.problem: Few-shot segmentation suffers coarse granularity and train-set overfitting with prototype features.
nodes.approach: Hierarchical dense correlation matching with self-attention and coarse-to-fine correlation distillation.
nodes.niche_reason: Few-shot segmentation is a well-trodden benchmark task.

nodes.title: Hierarchical Discriminative Learning Improves Visual Representations of Biomedical Microscopy
nodes.tldr: HiDisc is a self-supervised method that uses the patient-slide-patch hierarchy of microscopy to define positive pairs and a unified discriminative objective.
nodes.problem: Patch-level self-supervised learning ignores patient-slide-patch hierarchy and needs strong augmentations that hurt performance.
nodes.approach: Hierarchical contrastive learning where patches sharing a common ancestry are positives, with patch, slide, and patient objectives.
nodes.niche_reason: Hierarchical clinical-hierarchy contrastive learning is a specialised niche.

nodes.title: High-Fidelity 3D Human Digitization From Single 2K Resolution Images
nodes.tldr: Reconstructs 3D human models from single 2K images by separately predicting coarse global shape and detailed part-wise normals, plus a 2K human dataset.
nodes.problem: High-fidelity 3D human reconstruction lacks large high-resolution training data and suitable network design.
nodes.approach: Two-scale pipeline: low-res depth for global shape, part-wise normal network for detail, high-res depth fusion.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › Human Pose, Avatars & Faces
secondary_topics: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: Single-image 3D human digitization is an established niche.

nodes.title: High-Frequency Stereo Matching Network
nodes.tldr: Improves iterative stereo matching by decoupling feature transfer across iterations, normalizing disparities, and using a multi-scale attention feature extractor, reaching top Middlebury rank.
nodes.problem: Iterative stereo methods lose high-frequency detail across iterations and fail cross-domain.
nodes.approach: Decouple module, normalized disparity refinement, and multi-stage channel self-attention feature extractor.
nodes.niche_reason: iterative stereo matching is a mainstream direction

nodes.title: HyperReel: High-Fidelity 6-DoF Video With Ray-Conditioned Sampling
nodes.tldr: HyperReel is a 6-DoF video representation using ray-conditioned sample prediction and compact dynamic volumes for high-quality real-time rendering with small memory.
nodes.problem: Dynamic view synthesis lacks simultaneous real-time speed, small memory and high quality.
nodes.approach: Ray-conditioned sample prediction network plus memory-efficient dynamic volume representation.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: Dynamic NeRF-style view synthesis is a crowded area.

nodes.title: I2MVFormer: Large Language Model Generated Multi-View Document Supervision for Zero-Shot Image Classification
nodes.tldr: Uses an LLM prompted with few annotator descriptions to generate multiple text views per class, learning multi-view embeddings for zero-shot image classification.
nodes.problem: Zero-shot classifiers depend on high-quality curated text like Wikipedia and a single text source per class.
nodes.approach: LLM conditioned on example descriptions generates class views, fed to a multi-view semantic embedding model.
secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › In-context Learning & Prompting
nodes.niche_reason: LLM-generated multi-view text for zero-shot is specialised

nodes.title: ImageBind: One Embedding Space To Bind Them All
nodes.tldr: Learns a joint embedding space for six modalities by binding each to images, so only image-paired data is needed, yielding zero-shot cross-modal retrieval and arithmetic.
nodes.problem: Joint multimodal embeddings usually need all modality combinations paired, which is impractical.
nodes.approach: Uses an image encoder as a shared anchor, aligning each other modality to image embeddings from natural image pairing.
nodes.primary_topic: Audio, Speech & Multimodal › Audio-Visual & Cross-modal Learning
nodes.niche_reason: Multimodal embeddings are mainstream; binding via images is a known pattern

nodes.title: Imagen Editor and EditBench: Advancing and Evaluating Text-Guided Image Inpainting
nodes.tldr: Imagen Editor fine-tunes a cascaded diffusion model for text-guided inpainting using object-detector masks during training, and EditBench provides a systematic human-evaluated benchmark.
nodes.problem: Text-guided inpainting needs prompt-faithful edits consistent with the input image, and better evaluation.
nodes.approach: Cascaded diffusion fine-tuning with detector-proposed masks and high-res image conditioning, plus EditBench benchmark.
secondary_topics: Generative Models › Generative Model Evaluation & Theory
nodes.niche_reason: Text-to-image editing is a crowded area.

nodes.title: Implicit Occupancy Flow Fields for Perception and Prediction in Self-Driving
nodes.tldr: Unified self-driving model that implicitly represents occupancy and flow over space and time, queried at continuous locations by the planner, avoiding dense grid computation.
nodes.problem: Self-driving perception and prediction either miss objects or waste compute on dense occupancy grids.
nodes.approach: Single network implicitly represents occupancy and flow, with global attention and continuous spatio-temporal queries.
nodes.niche_reason: Occupancy and flow forecasting for driving is a busy, mainstream area

nodes.title: Improving Commonsense in Vision-Language Models via Knowledge Graph Riddles
nodes.tldr: Injects commonsense from ConceptNet into vision-language training data on the fly by linearizing knowledge subgraphs into text variants, and adds a retrieval-based commonsense benchmark.
nodes.problem: Vision-language models lack commonsense knowledge that large VL datasets do not contain.
nodes.approach: Bidirectional knowledge-graph sub-graph sequentialization used as text augmentation during training.
secondary_topics: Architectures & Training › Knowledge Graphs & Relational Learning
nodes.niche_reason: Knowledge-graph augmentation for VL commonsense is a specialized direction.

nodes.title: Improving Cross-Modal Retrieval With Set of Diverse Embeddings
nodes.tldr: Encodes each image or caption as a set of diverse embeddings via slot attention, scored with a smooth-Chamfer similarity for cross-modal retrieval.
nodes.problem: Image-text retrieval is ambiguous because one image fits many captions and one caption fits many images.
nodes.approach: Slot-attention set prediction plus smooth-Chamfer similarity, which reduces side effects of prior set-matching functions.
nodes.primary_topic: Audio, Speech & Multimodal › Audio-Visual & Cross-modal Learning
nodes.niche_reason: Image-text retrieval is a mature, crowded area.

nodes.title: Improving Fairness in Facial Albedo Estimation via Visual-Textual Cues
nodes.tldr: ID2Albedo estimates facial albedo using visual-textual cues about race, skin color and age, reducing light-skin bias in 3D face reconstruction.
nodes.problem: Facial albedo estimation is ill-posed and existing models show light-skin bias.
nodes.approach: Semantic loss using CLIP-style text attributes to supervise albedo without illumination constraints, plus fairness-focused data and evaluation.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › Human Pose, Avatars & Faces
nodes.niche_reason: Specialised face reconstruction with a fairness angle.

nodes.title: Improving Robust Generalization by Direct PAC-Bayesian Bound Minimization
nodes.tldr: Directly minimizes a robust PAC-Bayesian bound, yielding a trace-of-Hessian regularizer on the top layer that improves ViT adversarial robustness cheaply.
nodes.problem: Gap between robust PAC-Bayesian theory of adversarial overfitting and practical algorithms.
nodes.approach: Minimize bound over model posterior, deriving a top-layer trace-of-Hessian flatness regularizer with analytic solution.
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Generalization & Statistical Learning
nodes.niche_reason: PAC-Bayes for adversarial robustness is specialised.

nodes.title: Incrementer: Transformer for Class-Incremental Semantic Segmentation With Knowledge Distillation Focusing on Old Class
nodes.tldr: Incrementer is a transformer for class-incremental semantic segmentation that adds only new class tokens and distills selectively in old-class regions, with a class deconfusion strategy.
nodes.problem: Class-incremental segmentation suffers forgetting, and uniform distillation limits new-class learning.
nodes.approach: Add new class tokens to a transformer decoder; distill focusing on old-class regions with class deconfusion.
nodes.niche_reason: Common continual-learning setting applied to segmentation.

nodes.title: InstructPix2Pix: Learning To Follow Image Editing Instructions
nodes.tldr: InstructPix2Pix trains a conditional diffusion model on GPT-3 and Stable Diffusion generated edit examples to follow written image editing instructions in a single forward pass.
nodes.problem: Editing images from natural-language instructions without per-image fine-tuning or inversion.
nodes.approach: Synthesize paired edit data with a language model and text-to-image model, train instruction-conditioned diffusion.
secondary_topics: Data, Benchmarks & Evaluation › Synthetic Data & Data Curation
nodes.niche_reason: Diffusion image editing is a crowded mainstream topic.

nodes.title: Interactive Segmentation As Gaussion Process Classification
nodes.tldr: GPCIS casts click-based interactive segmentation as Gaussian process pixel classification with amortized variational inference and deep kernels to propagate click information.
nodes.problem: Click information is not explicitly propagated in deep interactive segmentation.
nodes.approach: GP classification with amortized variational posterior and deep kernel learning.
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Kernels, GPs & Nonparametrics
nodes.niche_reason: GP-based interactive segmentation is an uncommon probabilistic angle.

nodes.title: InternImage: Exploring Large-Scale Vision Foundation Models With Deformable Convolutions
nodes.tldr: Scales CNN-based vision foundation models with deformable convolution as the core operator, reaching ViT-like scaling on ImageNet, COCO, and ADE20K.
nodes.problem: Large-scale CNNs lag behind vision transformers in scaling to foundation-model size.
nodes.approach: Deformable convolution backbone with input-conditioned adaptive spatial aggregation.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › Vision Foundation Models & Self-Supervision
nodes.niche_reason: Scaled CNN backbones are an established, fairly common vision direction

nodes.title: Interventional Bag Multi-Instance Learning on Whole-Slide Pathological Images
nodes.tldr: IBMIL applies backdoor adjustment to multi-instance learning on whole-slide pathology images, removing bag-context confounding and boosting existing MIL methods.
nodes.problem: Bag contextual priors create spurious bag-label correlations in whole-slide image classification.
nodes.approach: Interventional training via backdoor adjustment for deconfounded bag-level prediction.
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Causality & Causal Inference
nodes.niche_reason: Causal intervention applied to pathology MIL is specialised.

nodes.title: Language-Guided Music Recommendation for Video via Prompt Analogies
nodes.tldr: Recommends music for a video from free-form text guidance, training a trimodal model on LLM-synthesized music descriptions and using text dropout for robustness.
nodes.problem: Music-for-video retrieval lacks paired text descriptions for training text-guided models
nodes.approach: Analogy prompting of BLOOM-176B to synthesize music descriptions for trimodal retrieval training
nodes.primary_topic: Audio, Speech & Multimodal › Audio-Visual & Cross-modal Learning
secondary_topics: Audio, Speech & Multimodal › Audio & Music Understanding
nodes.niche_reason: Text-guided music-for-video retrieval is specialised but established

nodes.title: LaserMix for Semi-Supervised LiDAR Semantic Segmentation
nodes.tldr: Semi-supervised LiDAR segmentation that mixes laser beams from different scans and enforces consistent, confident predictions before and after mixing.
nodes.problem: Dense LiDAR annotation is costly, and unlabeled scans are underused.
nodes.approach: Laser-beam mixing across scans with consistency and confidence regularization, agnostic to range-view or voxel representations.
nodes.niche_reason: Semi-supervised LiDAR segmentation is a common, established direction.

nodes.title: Latency Matters: Real-Time Action Forecasting Transformer
nodes.tldr: RAFTformer is a two-stage video transformer for real-time action forecasting that couples inference latency to evaluation, matching accuracy with 9x lower latency.
nodes.problem: Action forecasting models ignore inference latency in real-world, latency-aware settings.
nodes.approach: Short-clip video transformer backbone with head transformer aggregating clips, shuffled causal masking, and real-time evaluation protocol.
nodes.niche_reason: Action anticipation with latency focus is specialised.

nodes.title: Learned Image Compression With Mixed Transformer-CNN Architectures
nodes.tldr: Combines parallel CNN and transformer blocks with a channel-wise entropy model to achieve state-of-the-art rate-distortion in learned image compression.
nodes.problem: Learned image compression lacks an efficient way to fuse CNN local modelling with transformer non-local modelling.
nodes.approach: Parallel Transformer-CNN mixture block plus a channel-wise entropy model using swin-style attention with channel squeezing.
nodes.niche_reason: Learned compression is a mainstream, well-populated area

nodes.title: Learning Customized Visual Models With Retrieval-Augmented Knowledge
nodes.tldr: Customizes CLIP for target domains by retrieving relevant web image-text pairs and training only new modular blocks while freezing original weights.
nodes.problem: Adapting CLIP-style models to target domains cheaply, without costly web-scale pretraining.
nodes.approach: Retrieve about 3% of CLIP's pretraining data as external knowledge; train frozen-backbone modular blocks.
nodes.niche_reason: CLIP adaptation via retrieval is a fairly common direction.

nodes.title: Learning Human-to-Robot Handovers From Point Clouds
nodes.tldr: Learns vision-based policies for human-to-robot handovers via a two-stage teacher-student framework combining planning, RL, and self-supervision, transferring to real robots.
nodes.problem: Learning robust human-to-robot handovers is hard because simulating realistic human interaction is difficult.
nodes.approach: Two-stage teacher-student training with motion and grasp planning, reinforcement learning, and self-supervision, using human-in-the-loop.
nodes.niche_reason: Handover policies are a specialised robotics niche

nodes.title: Learning Video Representations From Large Language Models
nodes.tldr: LAVILA conditions LLMs on video to create dense automatic narrations, then trains contrastive video-language embeddings on them, beating prior results on egocentric and third-person benchmarks.
nodes.problem: Video-language pretraining suffers from sparse, poorly synchronized, low-diversity human narrations.
nodes.approach: Finetune visually conditioned LLMs as video narrators, then contrastively train on generated narrations.
secondary_topics: Data, Benchmarks & Evaluation › Synthetic Data & Data Curation
nodes.niche_reason: Video-language pretraining is common; LLM narrators are a moderate twist.

nodes.title: Learning a Sparse Transformer Network for Effective Image Deraining
nodes.tldr: Sparse Transformer for image deraining that keeps only the most useful self-attention scores via learnable top-k selection, plus mixed-scale feed-forward and expert compensation.
nodes.problem: Transformers aggregate irrelevant attention values from mismatched query-key tokens, hurting restoration.
nodes.approach: Learnable top-k sparse attention with mixed-scale feed-forward and mixture-of-experts refinement.
nodes.niche_reason: Transformer image restoration is a common direction.

nodes.title: MAESTER: Masked Autoencoder Guided Segmentation at Pixel Resolution for Accurate, Self-Supervised Subcellular Structure Recognition
nodes.tldr: Self-supervised segmentation of subcellular structures in volume electron microscopy by clustering masked-autoencoder token representations at pixel resolution.
nodes.problem: Pixel-level biological segmentation needs manual ground truth, which is costly and domain-specific.
nodes.approach: Masked autoencoder patch representations clustered end to end, with cover-and-stride inference for pixel output.
nodes.niche_reason: Self-supervised EM subcellular segmentation is specialised

nodes.title: MAGVIT: Masked Generative Video Transformer
nodes.tldr: Uses a 3D tokenizer and masked video token modeling to handle ten video synthesis tasks with one model, faster than diffusion and autoregressive methods.
nodes.problem: Separate models are needed for each video synthesis task, and diffusion and autoregressive video generation is slow.
nodes.approach: Quantize videos into spatial-temporal tokens and train a masked token model with a shared multi-task embedding.
nodes.niche_reason: Masked video token generation is established but specialised

nodes.title: Magic3D: High-Resolution Text-to-3D Content Creation
nodes.tldr: Speeds up text-to-3D by optimizing a sparse neural field with a low-resolution diffusion prior, then refining a textured mesh at high resolution.
nodes.problem: Text-to-3D optimization with NeRF is very slow and limited to low-resolution supervision.
nodes.approach: Two-stage coarse-to-fine framework: sparse 3D neural representation, then differentiable textured mesh rendering.
nodes.niche_reason: Text-to-3D via diffusion priors is a crowded area

nodes.title: Marching-Primitives: Shape Abstraction From Signed Distance Function
nodes.tldr: Converts a signed distance function into compact superquadric primitives by iteratively growing them along marching voxel connectivity levels, without polygonal meshes.
nodes.problem: Shape abstraction from SDFs usually goes through polygonal meshes instead of compact primitives.
nodes.approach: Iteratively fit probabilistic superquadric primitives over connected voxel volumes at multiple SDF levels.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: primitive-based shape abstraction is specialised

nodes.title: MarginMatch: Improving Semi-Supervised Learning with Pseudo-Margins
nodes.tldr: Improves semi-supervised classification by using training dynamics across iterations to judge pseudo-label quality and mask unreliable examples.
nodes.problem: Pseudo-labels from a single iteration's confidence are unreliable in low-data regimes.
nodes.approach: Pseudo-margins from prediction fluctuations combined with consistency regularization.
nodes.confidence_reason: Semi-supervised learning has no exact vocabulary topic
nodes.niche_reason: Pseudo-labeling SSL is a crowded mainstream direction

nodes.title: MaskSketch: Unpaired Structure-Guided Masked Image Generation
nodes.tldr: MaskSketch uses self-attention maps of a pretrained masked generative transformer to guide sampling with a sketch, enabling structure-guided image generation without training or paired data.
nodes.problem: Image generation conditioning is mostly limited to labels or text, offering little spatial control.
nodes.approach: Exploit masked generative transformer attention maps encoding structure to guide a new sampling procedure.
nodes.niche_reason: Masked generative transformer sketch guidance is less common than diffusion.

nodes.title: Masked Image Modeling With Local Multi-Scale Reconstruction
nodes.tldr: Applies masked-image reconstruction at multiple local layers, with fine-scale targets for lower layers and coarse-scale for upper, cutting pretraining cost.
nodes.problem: MIM supervises only the top encoder layer, so lower layers are poorly guided and training is slow
nodes.approach: Local multi-scale reconstruction supervising lower layers with fine targets and upper layers with coarse targets
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › Vision Foundation Models & Self-Supervision
nodes.niche_reason: Masked image modeling is a crowded direction

nodes.title: Matching Is Not Enough: A Two-Stage Framework for Category-Agnostic Pose Estimation
nodes.tldr: Two-stage transformer for category-agnostic keypoints: first-stage matching gives similarity-aware position proposals that a second cross-attention stage refines.
nodes.problem: One-stage support-query matching for arbitrary-category keypoints gives noisy, duplicated predictions.
nodes.approach: Two-stage transformer where matched keypoints become proposals refined by decoder cross-attention.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › Human Pose, Avatars & Faces
nodes.confidence_reason: general keypoint task for arbitrary categories has no exact topic
nodes.niche_reason: category-agnostic keypoint estimation is specialised

nodes.title: MethaneMapper: Spectral Absorption Aware Hyperspectral Transformer for Methane Detection
nodes.tldr: MethaneMapper is a spectral-absorption-aware hyperspectral transformer that detects and localizes methane plumes, plus a large dataset of plume masks from AVIRIS-NG flightlines.
nodes.problem: Existing methane analysis from hyperspectral data is terrain-sensitive, manual, error-prone, and not scalable.
nodes.approach: End-to-end transformer with modules locating methane-relevant spectral wavelengths and plume regions; new segmentation dataset.
nodes.niche_reason: Hyperspectral greenhouse-gas detection is a rare application niche.

nodes.title: Modeling Video As Stochastic Processes for Fine-Grained Video Representation Learning
nodes.tldr: Learns video representations by pulling frame embeddings toward a Brownian bridge stochastic process in latent space via process-based contrastive loss.
nodes.problem: Frame-wise video features ignore the temporal dynamic process of each video.
nodes.approach: Process-based contrastive loss aligning frame sequences to Brownian bridges, with annotation-specific sampling.
nodes.niche_reason: Process-based video contrastive learning is specialised

nodes.title: Mofusion: A Framework for Denoising-Diffusion-Based Motion Synthesis
nodes.tldr: Denoising-diffusion framework for conditional human motion synthesis from music or text, with scheduled kinematic losses for plausible long motions.
nodes.problem: Human motion synthesis trades off diversity against quality and struggles with long plausible sequences.
nodes.approach: Motion diffusion with scheduled weighting of kinematic losses and an editable latent space.
nodes.niche_reason: Diffusion motion synthesis is a common direction

nodes.title: MotionDiffuser: Controllable Multi-Agent Motion Prediction Using Diffusion
nodes.tldr: MotionDiffuser models joint multi-agent future trajectories with diffusion, a PCA-compressed representation and constrained sampling via differentiable costs, achieving top Waymo motion prediction results.
nodes.problem: Multi-agent motion forecasting needs multimodal joint trajectory distributions that are controllable.
nodes.approach: Permutation-invariant diffusion over PCA-compressed trajectories with cost-guided constrained sampling.
nodes.niche_reason: Diffusion-based trajectory forecasting for driving is established but specialised.

nodes.title: Multi-View Adversarial Discriminator: Mine the Non-Causal Factors for Object Detection in Unseen Domains
nodes.tldr: MAD removes non-causal factors from domain-invariant features by adversarially training a multi-view domain classifier on augmented source domains for unseen-domain object detection.
nodes.problem: Domain shift degrades detectors; single-view adversarial alignment keeps hidden non-causal factors.
nodes.approach: Multi-view adversarial discriminator over random-augmented source domains to purify common features.
nodes.primary_topic: Architectures & Training › Domain Adaptation & OOD Generalization
nodes.niche_reason: Multi-view adversarial domain generalization is specialised.

nodes.title: Multiplicative Fourier Level of Detail
nodes.tldr: Implicit representation using multi-resolution grids, sinusoidal modulation and multiplicative recursion, yielding a linear combination of sine bases.
nodes.problem: Hybrid implicit representations rely on interleaved fusion and nonlinear decoders.
nodes.approach: Recursive multiplicative fusion of sinusoidally modulated multi-level features, then linear decoding.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: Multiplicative Fourier implicit fields are specialised.

nodes.title: NeMo: Learning 3D Neural Motion Fields From Multiple Video Instances of the Same Action
nodes.tldr: NeMo optimizes one neural 3D motion field shared across multiple monocular videos of the same action, outperforming per-video human mesh recovery on dynamic sports.
nodes.problem: Monocular human mesh recovery degrades on dynamic motions absent from MoCap training data.
nodes.approach: Optimize a Neural Motion field representing one 3D motion jointly across multiple videos of the same action.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › Human Pose, Avatars & Faces
nodes.niche_reason: Unusual idea of pooling multiple videos of the same action.

nodes.title: Neural Kernel Surface Reconstruction
nodes.tldr: Neural Kernel Surface Reconstruction scales kernel-based implicit surface reconstruction to large noisy sparse point clouds using compactly supported kernels and gradient-fitting solves.
nodes.problem: Reconstructing 3D surfaces from large, sparse, noisy point clouds at scale.
nodes.approach: Compactly supported neural kernel fields with sparse linear solvers and gradient fitting.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: Learned surface reconstruction from point clouds is established but specialised.

nodes.title: Neural Part Priors: Learning To Optimize Part-Based Object Completion in RGB-D Scans
nodes.tldr: Neural Part Priors are coordinate-MLP spaces of objects and parts, optimized at test time to complete part-based objects in RGB-D scans consistently.
nodes.problem: Per-object 3D scene predictions ignore global consistency across similar objects in scans.
nodes.approach: Coordinate-field MLP priors over objects and parts, optimized at test time to fit scan geometry.
secondary_topics: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: Part-based scan completion is specialised within 3D vision.

nodes.title: Neural Volumetric Memory for Visual Locomotion Control
nodes.tldr: Neural Volumetric Memory aggregates depth-camera feature volumes in the robot's egocentric frame with SE(3) equivariance to enable legged locomotion on challenging terrain.
nodes.problem: Legged locomotion from a single depth camera under partial observability of terrain beneath the robot.
nodes.approach: Geometric memory architecture that fuses past camera feature volumes into the ego-centric frame.
nodes.niche_reason: Vision-based legged locomotion is established but specialised.

nodes.title: NeuralLift-360: Lifting an In-the-Wild 2D Photo to a 3D Object With 360deg Views
nodes.tldr: NeuralLift-360 lifts a single in-the-wild photo to a 360-degree 3D object using a depth-aware NeRF guided by diffusion priors, a ranking loss and CLIP-guided sampling.
nodes.problem: Generating a plausible 360-degree 3D object from a single reference image.
nodes.approach: Depth-aware NeRF optimized with diffusion guidance, depth ranking loss, and CLIP-guided sampling.
secondary_topics: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: Image-to-3D with diffusion distillation was a common direction.

nodes.title: Next3D: Generative Neural Texture Rasterization for 3D-Aware Head Avatars
nodes.tldr: Next3D combines mesh-guided neural textures rasterized into tri-planes in a 3D GAN to produce controllable, topologically flexible 3D-aware head avatars.
nodes.problem: Controllable 3D-aware facial avatar synthesis handling hair and topology changes.
nodes.approach: Generative texture-rasterized tri-planes over parametric mesh templates with a mouth interior module.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › Human Pose, Avatars & Faces
secondary_topics: Generative Models › GANs, VAEs & Normalizing Flows
nodes.niche_reason: 3D-aware head avatar GANs are established but specialised.

nodes.title: Nighttime Smartphone Reflective Flare Removal Using Optical Center Symmetry Prior
nodes.tldr: Removes nighttime reflective flare from smartphone photos using an optical center symmetry prior, plus a bracketed dataset of realistic flare pairs.
nodes.problem: Locating reflective flare regions without removing real light sources at night
nodes.approach: Optical center symmetry prior to locate flare proposals, with networks trained on bracketed flare pairs
nodes.niche_reason: Lens flare removal is specialised but has some prior work

nodes.title: NoPe-NeRF: Optimising Neural Radiance Field With No Pose Prior
nodes.tldr: NoPe-NeRF trains NeRFs without known camera poses by using undistorted monocular depth priors to constrain relative poses, handling large camera motion.
nodes.problem: Optimizing NeRFs without pose priors fails under dramatic camera movement.
nodes.approach: Scale-and-shift-corrected monocular depth priors with novel losses constraining relative poses between frames.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: Pose-free NeRF is a common NeRF subtopic.

nodes.title: Non-Contrastive Unsupervised Learning of Physiological Signals From Video
nodes.tldr: Learns remote pulse estimation from unlabelled video using sparse power spectra within physiological bounds, with no contact-sensor ground truth.
nodes.problem: Remote photoplethysmography relies on labelled video with contact-sensor ground truth, which is costly.
nodes.approach: Non-contrastive objective encouraging sparse in-band power spectra and variance across batches.
nodes.confidence_reason: Healthcare application versus video self-supervision is a judgment call
nodes.niche_reason: Unsupervised remote pulse estimation from unlabelled video is rare

nodes.title: Normal-Guided Garment UV Prediction for Human Re-Texturing
nodes.tldr: Predicts garment UV maps from images using predicted surface normals to preserve isometry, enabling physically plausible re-texturing of clothed humans without 3D reconstruction.
nodes.problem: Editing dressed human images and videos requires texture maps consistent with garment deformation and geometry.
nodes.approach: Self-supervised UV map estimation preserving isometry using predicted 3D surface normals, extendable to temporal coherence.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › Human Pose, Avatars & Faces
nodes.niche_reason: Garment UV prediction for re-texturing is a rare problem.

nodes.title: Normalizing Flow Based Feature Synthesis for Outlier-Aware Object Detection
nodes.tldr: Uses an invertible normalizing flow over inlier features to synthesize outliers that are unlikely under all inlier classes, improving outlier-aware object detection.
nodes.problem: Object detectors are overconfident on outlier objects, and synthesized outliers may still look like inliers.
nodes.approach: Joint class-conditional density via normalizing flow, sampled to produce low-likelihood outlier features.
secondary_topics: Generative Models › GANs, VAEs & Normalizing Flows
nodes.niche_reason: Established OOD detection niche applied to object detection

nodes.title: Object Pose Estimation With Statistical Guarantees: Conformal Keypoint Detection and Geometric Uncertainty Propagation
nodes.tldr: Pose estimator that uses conformal keypoint prediction sets and geometric uncertainty propagation to output 6D pose sets with guaranteed coverage and worst-case error bounds.
nodes.problem: Keypoint-based pose estimators give no provable guarantees on estimate quality or uncertainty.
nodes.approach: Inductive conformal keypoint sets propagated to a pose set; RANSAG average pose with semidefinite error bounds.
nodes.niche_reason: Provable pose uncertainty via conformal keypoints is a rare combination.

nodes.title: On the Convergence of IRLS and Its Variants in Outlier-Robust Estimation
nodes.tldr: Proves convergence of an IRLS variant that combines majorization and graduated non-convexity for outlier-robust estimation, with fast linear and quadratic rates.
nodes.problem: Why IRLS-style methods work well for non-convex, non-smooth outlier-robust estimation remains unexplained.
nodes.approach: Incorporate majorization and graduated non-convexity into IRLS and analyze convergence on random Gaussian regression.
nodes.niche_reason: Robust estimation optimization is specialised but well established

nodes.title: On the Effectiveness of Partial Variance Reduction in Federated Learning With Heterogeneous Data
nodes.tldr: Shows that variance reduction applied only to final classification layers corrects client drift in federated learning with heterogeneous data, with a convergence proof.
nodes.problem: Data heterogeneity in federated learning makes deep networks' final layers diverge across clients and hurts accuracy.
nodes.approach: Partial variance reduction: control-variate drift correction applied only on final layers, while FedAvg trains feature extractors.
nodes.niche_reason: Drift correction in federated learning is a common research direction.

nodes.title: On the Effects of Self-Supervision and Contrastive Alignment in Deep Multi-View Clustering
nodes.tldr: Presents DeepMVC, a unified framework showing contrastive alignment can hurt deep multi-view clustering, especially with many views, and proposes new self-supervision variants.
nodes.problem: Fragmented self-supervision design in deep multi-view clustering with unclear effects of contrastive alignment.
nodes.approach: Unified framework, theoretical proof of contrastive alignment drawbacks, and new instances with alternative self-supervision.
nodes.niche_reason: Deep multi-view clustering is a rare subfield.

nodes.title: Open Vocabulary Semantic Segmentation With Patch Aligned Contrastive Learning
nodes.tldr: PACL modifies CLIP's contrastive compatibility to align vision patch tokens with text, enabling zero-shot open-vocabulary semantic segmentation without segmentation annotations.
nodes.problem: Open-vocabulary segmentation without segmentation labels requires patch-level image-text alignment, which CLIP lacks.
nodes.approach: Patch Aligned Contrastive Learning aligning vision patch tokens to text CLS token with pre-trained CLIP encoders.
nodes.niche_reason: CLIP-based open-vocabulary segmentation is a common direction.

nodes.title: Open-Vocabulary Panoptic Segmentation With Text-to-Image Diffusion Models
nodes.tldr: Performs open-vocabulary panoptic segmentation by combining frozen text-to-image diffusion features with CLIP-style discriminative classification.
nodes.problem: Segmenting arbitrary categories in the wild needs open-vocabulary recognition beyond fixed label sets.
nodes.approach: Unifies frozen internal representations of diffusion and discriminative models in a single panoptic segmentation pipeline.
nodes.niche_reason: Common open-vocabulary segmentation direction; diffusion features used.

nodes.title: OpenGait: Revisiting Gait Recognition Towards Better Practicality
nodes.tldr: Benchmarks gait recognition for real-world practicality, releasing an open codebase and a simple strong baseline, GaitBase, validated across datasets.
nodes.problem: Gait recognition performs poorly in the wild, and indoor-dataset conclusions do not generalize.
nodes.approach: Re-run ablations across a flexible OpenGait codebase and build the GaitBase baseline.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › Human Pose, Avatars & Faces
nodes.confidence_reason: Gait biometrics has no dedicated topic; benchmark plus baseline model
nodes.niche_reason: Gait recognition is specialised; practicality benchmarking is less common

nodes.title: OpenMix: Exploring Outlier Samples for Misclassification Detection
nodes.tldr: OpenMix uses outlier samples and mixed pseudo-samples to learn to reject uncertain inputs, improving misclassification detection and OOD detection together.
nodes.problem: Deep classifiers are overconfident on errors; Outlier Exposure does not help misclassification detection.
nodes.approach: Generate pseudo-samples by outlier transformation and train the classifier to reject them.
secondary_topics: Architectures & Training › Domain Adaptation & OOD Generalization
nodes.niche_reason: Failure detection is a specialised but active area.

nodes.title: Optimal Transport Minimization: Crowd Localization on Density Maps for Semi-Supervised Counting
nodes.tldr: Optimal transport minimization recovers person locations from density maps and yields hard point pseudo-labels for semi-supervised crowd counting.
nodes.problem: Density maps give counts but poor people localization, and soft pseudo-labels weaken semi-supervised training.
nodes.approach: Sinkhorn-distance optimal transport to fit point maps, plus confidence-weighted hard pseudo-labels.
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Optimal Transport & Divergences
nodes.confidence_reason: Localization versus counting is a judgment call between detection-style topics
nodes.niche_reason: Crowd counting is established; OT-based hard pseudo-labels are less common

nodes.title: PACO: Parts and Attributes of Common Objects
nodes.tldr: PACO is a dataset of 641K part masks plus attributes over 75 object categories in images and egocentric video, with benchmarks for part and attribute tasks.
nodes.problem: Datasets lack rich part-level masks and attributes beyond object masks.
nodes.approach: Annotate LVIS and Ego4D with part masks and attributes; define metrics and benchmark three tasks.
nodes.niche_reason: Part-level annotated datasets are established but specialised.

nodes.title: PC2: Projection-Conditioned Point Cloud Diffusion for Single-Image 3D Reconstruction
nodes.tldr: Reconstructs 3D shape from a single image by denoising a point cloud with diffusion, conditioning each step by projecting image features onto the partial points.
nodes.problem: Single-image 3D reconstruction needs aligned, high-resolution geometry that works on real-world images.
nodes.approach: Point cloud diffusion with projection conditioning that projects local image features onto partially denoised points.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: Diffusion point cloud reconstruction is established but specialised.

nodes.title: PDPP:Projected Diffusion for Procedure Planning in Instructional Videos
nodes.tldr: Treats procedure planning in instructional videos as distribution fitting, sampling action sequences from a projected diffusion model using only task labels.
nodes.problem: Procedure planning relies on expensive intermediate visual or language supervision.
nodes.approach: U-Net diffusion over action sequences with a projection method to enforce start and end conditions.
nodes.confidence_reason: Procedure planning from videos fits both planning and diffusion topics.
nodes.niche_reason: Diffusion-based procedure planning from videos is a specialized niche.

nodes.title: PEFAT: Boosting Semi-Supervised Medical Image Classification via Pseudo-Loss Estimation and Feature Adversarial Training
