nodes.tldr: Semi-supervised medical image classification that selects clean pseudo-labels via estimated pseudo-loss and uses feature-level adversarial noise to learn from low-quality pseudo-labeled samples.
nodes.problem: Confidence-threshold pseudo-labeling admits wrong labels and wastes low-confidence samples in semi-supervised medical classification.
nodes.approach: Pseudo-loss based clean/noisy split plus feature adversarial training regularization on low-quality pseudo-labeled data.
nodes.niche_reason: Semi-supervised pseudo-labeling for medical imaging is common.

nodes.title: PHA: Patch-Wise High-Frequency Augmentation for Transformer-Based Person Re-Identification
nodes.tldr: Shows ViTs dilute high-frequency details in person re-ID and adds wavelet-split patches plus a patch-wise contrastive loss at training time to preserve them.
nodes.problem: ViTs lose high-frequency cues like clothes texture in person re-identification.
nodes.approach: Haar wavelet high-frequency patches as auxiliary input with a patch-wise contrastive loss, removed at inference.
nodes.niche_reason: Person re-ID is an established but specialised subfield.

nodes.title: PLIKS: A Pseudo-Linear Inverse Kinematic Solver for 3D Human Body Estimation
nodes.tldr: Reconstructs a 3D SMPL human mesh from one image by solving a linearized inverse kinematics problem over pixel-aligned vertices, using camera calibration when available.
nodes.problem: Direct regression of body shape and pose from images is nonlinear and inflexible to external constraints.
nodes.approach: Model-in-the-loop optimization on a linearized SMPL formulation with analytic solutions and easy added constraints.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › Human Pose, Avatars & Faces
secondary_topics: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: Human mesh recovery is a common computer vision task

nodes.title: PRISE: Demystifying Deep Lucas-Kanade With Strongly Star-Convex Constraints for Multimodel Image Alignment
nodes.tldr: Learns network features with strongly star-convex loss landscapes so Lucas-Kanade homography alignment converges to the correct solution on multimodal image pairs.
nodes.problem: Lucas-Kanade image alignment gets stuck in poor local optima under large distortions.
nodes.approach: Minimax training with contrastive hinge losses enforcing star-convexity around ground-truth alignments.
secondary_topics: Architectures & Training › Differentiable Optimization & Structured Layers
nodes.niche_reason: Star-convex deep Lucas-Kanade is a specialised alignment niche.

nodes.title: Panoptic Lifting for 3D Scene Understanding With Neural Fields
nodes.tldr: Panoptic Lifting trains a neural field from images and machine-generated 2D panoptic masks, using linear assignment of instance IDs for multi-view consistent 3D panoptic segmentation.
nodes.problem: Obtaining consistent 3D panoptic scene representations from images when 2D predicted instance identifiers are inconsistent across views.
nodes.approach: Neural field with linear assignment of instance IDs plus robustness: confidence test-time augmentation, consistency loss, bounded fields, gradient stopping.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: Semantic neural fields are established but specialised.

nodes.title: Passive Micron-Scale Time-of-Flight With Sunlight Interferometry
nodes.tldr: A Michelson interferometer using only sunlight achieves passive micron-scale time-of-flight depth sensing, robust to indirect illumination, with outdoor prototype demonstrations.
nodes.problem: Achieving micrometer-resolution depth sensing passively without active illumination.
nodes.approach: Full-field Michelson interferometer with sunlight and axial scanning to acquire time-resolved responses.
nodes.confidence_reason: Optical sensing hardware technique; closest vocabulary topic is depth/geometry.
nodes.niche_reason: Optical interferometric imaging is far from ML mainstream.

nodes.title: Patch-Mix Transformer for Unsupervised Domain Adaptation: A Game Perspective
nodes.tldr: PMTrans uses PatchMix to build an intermediate domain by sampling patches from source and target, framing unsupervised domain adaptation as a three-player min-max game.
nodes.problem: Cross-attention in ViT-based domain adaptation depends on pseudo label quality and fails under large domain gaps.
nodes.approach: Game-theoretic PatchMix intermediate domain with semi-supervised mixup losses and attention-based patch label re-weighting.
nodes.primary_topic: Architectures & Training › Domain Adaptation & OOD Generalization
nodes.niche_reason: Unsupervised domain adaptation is a common topic.

nodes.title: Perspective Fields for Single Image Camera Calibration
nodes.tldr: Predicts a per-pixel perspective field, an up-vector and latitude map, from one image and converts it to camera calibration parameters.
nodes.problem: Single-image camera calibration needs representations robust to cropping, warping and rotation.
nodes.approach: Neural network predicts per-pixel up vector and latitude, which convert easily to calibration parameters.
nodes.niche_reason: Perspective-field calibration is a specialised geometric vision representation.

nodes.title: PixHt-Lab: Pixel Height Based Light Effect Generation for Image Compositing
nodes.tldr: Generates shadows and reflections for image compositing by lifting pixel-height maps to 3D geometry and guiding a neural renderer with 3D-aware buffers.
nodes.problem: Pixel-height light effects lack geometry, giving poor soft shadows and only specular reflections.
nodes.approach: Explicit pixel-height-to-3D mapping reconstructs geometry; physically based reflections with glossiness.
nodes.niche_reason: pixel-height compositing is a specialised graphics niche

nodes.title: PointClustering: Unsupervised Point Cloud Pre-Training Using Transformation Invariance in Clustering
nodes.tldr: Unsupervised point cloud pre-training that formulates the pretext task as deep clustering and uses transformation invariance at point and instance levels.
nodes.problem: Point cloud pre-training lacks strong self-supervision that captures geometry and semantics.
nodes.approach: Iterative feature clustering with point-level and instance-level transformation invariance learning.
nodes.niche_reason: clustering-based point cloud pretraining is established but specialised

nodes.title: Polarimetric iToF: Measuring High-Fidelity Depth Through Scattering Media
nodes.tldr: A polarimetric indirect time-of-flight imaging method that corrects multipath interference to measure accurate depth through scattering media such as fog.
nodes.problem: iToF depth suffers multipath interference errors in scattering media like fog.
nodes.approach: Scattering-aware polarimetric phase model estimating unpolarized backscatter to correct phase and amplitude errors.
nodes.niche_reason: Computational imaging with polarization and ToF is uncommon.

nodes.title: Polynomial Implicit Neural Representations for Large Diverse Datasets
nodes.tldr: Poly-INR represents images as polynomial functions of coordinates via multiplicative interactions, achieving generative quality near state of the art without convolution, normalization, or attention.
nodes.problem: Implicit neural representations lack capacity to model large diverse image datasets generatively.
nodes.approach: Polynomial coordinate-based networks with element-wise multiplications of features and affine-transformed coordinates, no positional encodings.
nodes.primary_topic: Generative Models › GANs, VAEs & Normalizing Flows
nodes.confidence_reason: Straddles implicit representations and generative modeling; topic list lacks INR.
nodes.niche_reason: Polynomial INR-based image generation is unusual.

nodes.title: Positive-Augmented Contrastive Learning for Image and Video Captioning Evaluation
nodes.tldr: CLIP-based captioning metric that adds generated images and text to contrastive training, correlating better with human judgments than CIDEr, SPICE and CLIP-Score.
nodes.problem: Caption evaluation metrics correlate poorly with human judgment on images and videos.
nodes.approach: Contrastive visual-semantic space learned with augmented positive generated image-text pairs.
nodes.niche_reason: CLIP-based caption metrics are a common direction.

nodes.title: Private Image Generation With Dual-Purpose Auxiliary Classifier
nodes.tldr: Trains differentially private GANs with a dual-purpose auxiliary classifier that learns from real and fake data, improving both gen2real and the proposed real2gen utility.
nodes.problem: Differentially private image generation sacrifices quality and utility under privacy budgets.
nodes.approach: Dual-purpose auxiliary classifier alternating real and fake data with sequential training in DP-GAN.
secondary_topics: Generative Models › GANs, VAEs & Normalizing Flows
nodes.niche_reason: DP generative modeling is established but specialised.

nodes.title: Progressive Semantic-Visual Mutual Adaption for Generalized Zero-Shot Learning
nodes.tldr: PSVMA progressively adapts semantic and visual information via dual semantic-visual transformers to disambiguate shared attributes and transfer knowledge in generalized zero-shot learning.
nodes.problem: Shared attributes create semantic ambiguity in generalized zero-shot learning.
nodes.approach: Dual semantic-visual transformer modules modeling attribute-prototype to visual-feature correspondences progressively.
nodes.niche_reason: Attribute-based GZSL is an established specialised subfield.

nodes.title: Progressive Transformation Learning for Leveraging Virtual Images in Training
nodes.tldr: Progressive Transformation Learning gradually adds GAN-translated virtual images to training data, selecting by Mahalanobis domain gap, boosting UAV-based human detection.
nodes.problem: Large UAV human datasets are costly; virtual images suffer from domain gap during virtual-to-real translation.
nodes.approach: Iteratively select virtual images by detector-feature Mahalanobis gap, transform with conditional GAN, add to training set.
secondary_topics: Architectures & Training › Domain Adaptation & OOD Generalization
Data, Benchmarks & Evaluation › Synthetic Data & Data Curation
nodes.niche_reason: UAV human detection with progressive synthetic data is uncommon.

nodes.title: ProphNet: Efficient Agent-Centric Motion Forecasting With Anchor-Informed Proposals
nodes.tldr: ProphNet is an efficient agent-centric multimodal motion forecasting model using anchor-informed proposals and a uniform input encoding for autonomous driving.
nodes.problem: Motion forecasting must handle heterogeneous inputs, multimodal behavior, and low onboard latency.
nodes.approach: Agent-centric network with modality-agnostic encoding and diverse proposals fused with goal-oriented anchors.
nodes.niche_reason: Trajectory forecasting for driving is a common benchmark area.

nodes.title: ProtoCon: Pseudo-Label Refinement via Online Clustering and Prototypical Consistency for Efficient Semi-Supervised Learning
nodes.tldr: Refines pseudo-labels using nearest-neighbour information from online clustering in a prototypical embedding space, with an auxiliary self-supervised loss for label-scarce semi-supervised learning.
nodes.problem: Confidence-based pseudo-labeling underperforms when labelled data is scarce.
nodes.approach: Online clustering of prototypical embeddings to refine pseudo-labels, plus auxiliary SSL loss.
nodes.confidence_reason: Semi-supervised learning has no exact topic; several close fits.
nodes.niche_reason: Pseudo-labelling SSL is a crowded, common direction.

nodes.title: Q-DETR: An Efficient Low-Bit Quantized Detection Transformer
nodes.tldr: Q-DETR is a low-bit quantized detection transformer that uses distribution-rectification distillation to recover accuracy, with 4-bit DETR close to full precision on COCO.
nodes.problem: Low-bit quantization of DETR loses significant accuracy because query information gets distorted.
nodes.approach: Bi-level distribution rectification distillation aligns query distributions and uses foreground-aware query matching to transfer teacher information.
nodes.primary_topic: Architectures & Training › Efficient Training, Compression & Pruning
nodes.niche_reason: Quantizing detection transformers is a common model-compression direction.

nodes.title: QPGesture: Quantization-Based and Phase-Guided Motion Matching for Natural Speech-Driven Gesture Generation
nodes.tldr: QPGesture generates co-speech gestures by quantizing motion into a VQ-VAE codebook and matching speech-aligned gesture units via Levenshtein distance.
nodes.problem: Speech-driven gesture generation suffers from random motion jitter and asynchronous alignment between speech and gestures.
nodes.approach: Gesture VQ-VAE codebook plus phase-guided motion matching, aligned by Levenshtein distance over audio quantization.
nodes.primary_topic: Audio, Speech & Multimodal › Audio-Visual & Cross-modal Learning
secondary_topics: Computer Vision › Human Pose, Avatars & Faces
nodes.confidence_reason: Motion-from-speech could be pose or cross-modal topic
nodes.niche_reason: Speech-to-gesture generation via motion matching is a rare niche.

nodes.title: Quantum Multi-Model Fitting
nodes.tldr: First quantum approach to multi-model geometric fitting, formulated for adiabatic quantum computers, with an iterative decomposed version for real-world-sized problems.
nodes.problem: Robust multi-model geometric fitting is hard; quantum optimization had only addressed single-model fitting.
nodes.approach: Formulate multi-model fitting as a quantum-samplable problem without objective relaxation, plus iterative decomposition.
nodes.niche_reason: Quantum computing applied to vision model fitting is very rare.

nodes.title: R2Former: Unified Retrieval and Reranking Transformer for Place Recognition
nodes.tldr: R2Former unifies retrieval and reranking for visual place recognition with a transformer that uses feature correlation, attention, and coordinates instead of RANSAC.
nodes.problem: Place recognition reranking with RANSAC ignores useful cues like feature correlations and attention.
nodes.approach: End-to-end transformer reranker over local feature correlations, attention values, and xy coordinates.
nodes.niche_reason: Transformer reranking for place recognition is specialised.

nodes.title: REVEAL: Retrieval-Augmented Visual-Language Pre-Training With Multi-Source Multimodal Knowledge Memory
nodes.tldr: Trains an end-to-end retrieval-augmented visual-language model whose memory encodes multimodal world knowledge, reaching state-of-the-art on VQA and captioning.
nodes.problem: Knowledge-intensive visual questions need external world knowledge that parametric models lack.
nodes.approach: Pretrain memory, encoder, retriever and generator jointly end-to-end over diverse multimodal knowledge sources.
nodes.niche_reason: Retrieval-augmented VLMs are growing but still specialised.

nodes.title: RODIN: A Generative Model for Sculpting 3D Digital Avatars Using Diffusion
nodes.tldr: Generates NeRF avatars with 3D diffusion by rolling out 2D feature maps onto one plane, enabling efficient 3D-aware denoising.
nodes.problem: 3D diffusion at high detail is too memory- and compute-heavy for rich avatars.
nodes.approach: Roll-out diffusion network with 3D-aware convolution, latent conditioning, and hierarchical synthesis.
nodes.niche_reason: 3D diffusion for avatar generation is an established but specialised direction.

nodes.title: RUST: Latent Neural Scene Representations From Unposed Imagery
nodes.tldr: Trains a scene-representation transformer on unposed RGB images using a learned latent pose encoder, matching posed-camera quality for novel view synthesis.
nodes.problem: Scene representation transformers need accurately posed ground-truth cameras, limiting large-scale training.
nodes.approach: Pose encoder peeks at the target image to produce a latent pose embedding consumed by the view-synthesis decoder.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: Pose-free novel view synthesis is an active, crowded area

nodes.title: ReLight My NeRF: A Dataset for Novel View Synthesis and Relighting of Real World Objects
nodes.tldr: ReNe is a real-world OLAT dataset of 20 scenes captured with robot arms for NeRF novel view synthesis and relighting, with a lightweight baseline.
nodes.problem: No real-object datasets with accurate camera and light poses for relighting neural radiance fields.
nodes.approach: Robot-arm acquisition of 2000 images per scene under 50 views and 40 one-light-at-a-time conditions.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: Relightable NeRF datasets are specialised within 3D vision.

nodes.title: Real-Time Evaluation in Online Continual Learning: A New Hope
nodes.tldr: Proposes real-time evaluation of online continual learning that accounts for computation cost as the stream does not wait; a simple baseline beats state-of-the-art CL methods.
nodes.problem: Continual learning evaluations ignore compute and training time constraints, which is unrealistic.
nodes.approach: Real-time stream evaluation on the CLOC dataset comparing methods under computational budgets.
nodes.niche_reason: Continual learning is common; compute-aware evaluation is a modest twist.

nodes.title: RealImpact: A Dataset of Impact Sound Fields for Real Objects
nodes.tldr: Dataset of 150,000 real impact sound recordings of 50 objects with locations, forces, materials and RGBD images, benchmarking acoustic and audio-visual tasks.
nodes.problem: No standard dataset of real-object impact sound fields exists for audio-visual learning and sim-to-real calibration.
nodes.approach: Collect controlled recordings with annotated impact and microphone positions; evaluate listener localization and visual acoustic matching.
nodes.primary_topic: Audio, Speech & Multimodal › Audio-Visual & Cross-modal Learning
nodes.niche_reason: Real object impact sound fields are very rare.

nodes.title: Region-Aware Pretraining for Open-Vocabulary Object Detection With Vision Transformers
nodes.tldr: RO-ViT pretrains vision transformers contrastively with region-cropped positional embeddings and focal loss, bridging image-level pretraining and open-vocabulary detection with state-of-the-art LVIS results.
nodes.problem: Image-level pretraining mismatches region-level use in open-vocabulary object detection.
nodes.approach: Cropped positional embeddings, focal contrastive loss and novel object proposals in detection fine-tuning.
nodes.niche_reason: Open-vocabulary detection is a common topic.

nodes.title: Regularize Implicit Neural Representation by Itself
nodes.tldr: Regularizes implicit neural representations with a learned Dirichlet-energy term built from a tiny INR, improving generalization on non-uniformly sampled signals.
nodes.problem: Implicit neural representations generalize poorly, especially from non-uniformly sampled data.
nodes.approach: Learned Dirichlet energy regularizer with Laplacian smoothness, parameterized by a tiny INR.
nodes.confidence_reason: Area placement for INR regularizer is ambiguous.
nodes.niche_reason: INR regularization is specialised; area placement is loose.

nodes.title: Relational Space-Time Query in Long-Form Videos
nodes.tldr: Introduces ReST, a templated spatiotemporal query framework and two egocentric benchmarks jointly testing activities, objects, and interactions in long videos.
nodes.problem: Video benchmarks study activities, objects, and interactions separately on short clips, not jointly on long egocentric video.
nodes.approach: Templated spatiotemporal query framework generating annotations for ReST-ADL and ReST-Ego4D, with baselines.
nodes.niche_reason: Egocentric long-video query benchmarks are established but specialised.

nodes.title: Renderable Neural Radiance Map for Visual Navigation
nodes.tldr: Introduces a grid map of latent codes that can be decoded into neural radiance field renderings, supporting visual localization and image-goal navigation.
nodes.problem: Visual navigation needs a map that is visually descriptive and usable for localization and goal-reaching.
nodes.approach: Renderable neural radiance map storing image-derived latent codes on a grid, with localization and navigation frameworks on top.
secondary_topics: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: NeRF-based maps for navigation are established but specialised.

nodes.title: RepMode: Learning to Re-Parameterize Diverse Experts for Subcellular Structure Prediction
nodes.tldr: RepMode predicts multiple subcellular fluorescence structures from transmitted-light 3D images using re-parameterized mixture-of-experts with task-aware gating.
nodes.problem: Predicting fluorescence structures without staining is hard due to partial labels and multi-scale sizes.
nodes.approach: Mixture-of-diverse-experts block with gating re-parameterization, yielding a compact plain network per task.
secondary_topics: Architectures & Training › Mixture of Experts & Sparsity
nodes.confidence_reason: Biomedical imaging with MoE architecture overlap
nodes.niche_reason: Partially labeled subcellular structure prediction is rare

nodes.title: RobustNeRF: Ignoring Distractors With Robust Losses
nodes.tldr: Trains NeRF with robust losses that treat transient distractors such as moving objects and shadows as outliers, removing floaters without distractor priors.
nodes.problem: Distractors that move or change during capture cause NeRF artifacts and floaters.
nodes.approach: Robust estimation losses in NeRF optimization, with few hyperparameters and no distractor priors.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: Robust NeRF training is a fairly common extension.

nodes.title: SCPNet: Semantic Scene Completion on Point Cloud
nodes.tldr: SCPNet completes semantic scenes from LiDAR point clouds using a multi-path completion network, dense-to-sparse distillation from multi-frame teachers, and label rectification of dynamic objects.
nodes.problem: Semantic scene completion suffers from sparse input, multi-scale objects and noisy labels for moving objects.
nodes.approach: Multi-path blocks, dense-to-sparse knowledge distillation, and panoptic-label-based completion label rectification.
nodes.niche_reason: Established but specialised LiDAR scene completion.

nodes.title: SIEDOB: Semantic Image Editing by Disentangling Object and Background
nodes.tldr: SIEDOB edits images from segmentation maps by generating background and objects with separate subnetworks and fusing them into a harmonized result.
nodes.problem: Monolithic semantic editors produce unrealistic objects and texture-inconsistent backgrounds.
nodes.approach: Disentangled background and instance-object generators with dedicated modules and a fusion network.
nodes.niche_reason: Segmentation-map image editing is a common line of work.

nodes.title: SMOC-Net: Leveraging Camera Pose for Self-Supervised Monocular Object Pose Estimation
nodes.tldr: SMOC-Net uses predicted camera poses from unlabeled real images to impose relative-pose constraints in teacher-student distillation for self-supervised monocular 6D object pose estimation.
nodes.problem: Self-supervised 6D object pose estimation suffers sim-real gap and costly differentiable rendering
nodes.approach: Teacher-student distillation with refiner using relative camera-pose geometric constraint
secondary_topics: Architectures & Training › Domain Adaptation & OOD Generalization
nodes.niche_reason: Self-supervised object pose estimation is established but specialised

nodes.title: SPARF: Neural Radiance Fields From Sparse and Noisy Poses
nodes.tldr: SPARF jointly optimizes a NeRF and noisy camera poses from as few as three wide-baseline images using multi-view correspondence and depth consistency losses.
nodes.problem: NeRF needs dense views with accurate poses, failing with sparse inputs and noisy camera poses.
nodes.approach: Multi-view correspondence objective and depth consistency loss to jointly refine NeRF and poses.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: Sparse-view NeRF with pose optimization is a common NeRF subtopic.

nodes.title: Scalable, Detailed and Mask-Free Universal Photometric Stereo
nodes.tldr: Recovers highly detailed surface normals from images under unknown, spatially varying lighting, without object masks, using a scalable spatial-light feature network.
nodes.problem: Photometric stereo under uncontrolled lighting needs masks and typically calibrated, lighting-specific setups.
nodes.approach: Extends universal photometric stereo with spatial-light features over high-resolution inputs, trained on a new synthetic dataset.
secondary_topics: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: Photometric stereo under unknown lighting is specialised but established.

nodes.title: Scaling Up GANs for Text-to-Image Synthesis
nodes.tldr: GigaGAN, a scaled GAN architecture for text-to-image synthesis that is much faster at inference than diffusion and autoregressive models and supports latent editing.
nodes.problem: Naively scaling StyleGAN becomes unstable, leaving GANs behind diffusion for text-to-image.
nodes.approach: Stable high-capacity GAN generator design trained on large web-scale image-text data.
secondary_topics: Generative Models › GANs, VAEs & Normalizing Flows
nodes.niche_reason: GAN text-to-image is less mainstream than diffusion but still common

nodes.title: SceneComposer: Any-Level Semantic Image Synthesis
nodes.tldr: SceneComposer synthesizes images from semantic layouts of any precision, from pure text to detailed segmentation maps, using precision-encoded mask pyramids and multi-scale guided diffusion.
nodes.problem: Layout-to-image synthesis lacks flexibility across user layout precision levels.
nodes.approach: Precision-encoded mask pyramid and text feature map conditioning a multi-scale guided diffusion model.
nodes.niche_reason: Conditional image synthesis is common; any-precision layouts add a mild twist.

nodes.title: Self-Supervised Learning for Multimodal Non-Rigid 3D Shape Matching
nodes.tldr: Self-supervised method combining mesh functional-map regularization with a contrastive mesh-point cloud loss for non-rigid shape matching across meshes and partial point clouds.
nodes.problem: Point-cloud shape matching lags mesh-based matching, and cross-modality correspondences are hard.
nodes.approach: Self-supervised multimodal learning coupling mesh functional maps with contrastive loss linking mesh and point cloud data.
nodes.niche_reason: Non-rigid 3D shape matching is a rare niche within vision.

nodes.title: Self-Supervised Video Forensics by Audio-Visual Anomaly Detection
nodes.tldr: Detects manipulated speech videos by training an autoregressive model on real audio-visual synchronization features and flagging low-probability videos, without any fake training data.
nodes.problem: Detecting audio-visual inconsistencies in manipulated videos without labeled fake data.
nodes.approach: Autoregressive anomaly detection over audio-visual sync features trained only on real videos.
nodes.primary_topic: Audio, Speech & Multimodal › Audio-Visual & Cross-modal Learning
nodes.niche_reason: Forensics via audio-visual anomaly detection is specialised.

nodes.title: Side Adapter Network for Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmentation
nodes.tldr: Attaches a lightweight side network to a frozen CLIP model, predicting mask proposals and attention biases so CLIP recognizes masks for open-vocabulary segmentation.
nodes.problem: Open-vocabulary segmentation needs strong recognition of arbitrary classes without costly large-model training or slow inference.
nodes.approach: Frozen CLIP with a trainable side network giving mask proposals and CLIP attention bias, trained end-to-end.
nodes.niche_reason: Open-vocabulary segmentation with CLIP is a crowded mainstream direction

nodes.title: Slimmable Dataset Condensation
nodes.tldr: Introduces slimmable dataset condensation: derive smaller synthetic datasets from prior condensation results alone, via a new objective and significance-aware parameterization with error bounds.
nodes.problem: Dataset condensation must be repeated with the original data whenever the storage budget changes.
nodes.approach: Training objective addressing network inconsistency and underdetermined solutions, plus significance-ordered synthetic data parameterization.
nodes.primary_topic: Data, Benchmarks & Evaluation › Synthetic Data & Data Curation
secondary_topics: Architectures & Training › Efficient Training, Compression & Pruning
nodes.niche_reason: Dataset distillation is established but specialised.

nodes.title: SmartBrush: Text and Shape Guided Object Inpainting With Diffusion Model
nodes.tldr: SmartBrush inpaints missing regions with objects guided by both text and mask shape, using object-mask prediction in the diffusion U-Net to preserve the background.
nodes.problem: Text-guided inpainting lacks shape control and often alters surrounding background.
nodes.approach: Diffusion U-Net with object-mask prediction and multi-task training with text-to-image generation.
nodes.niche_reason: Diffusion inpainting is a common topic.

nodes.title: SplineCam: Exact Visualization and Characterization of Deep Network Geometry and Decision Boundaries
nodes.tldr: Provably exact method for computing the geometry and decision boundaries of continuous piecewise linear deep networks over a data region, without sampling or approximation.
nodes.problem: Existing deep network visualizations rely on sampling or approximations rather than exact geometry.
nodes.approach: Exact CPWL spline-based computation of network mapping geometry over a specified input region.
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Deep Learning Theory
nodes.niche_reason: Exact CPWL geometry computation is a rare interpretability angle.

nodes.title: Stitchable Neural Networks
nodes.tldr: Stitchable Neural Networks connect pretrained models of different sizes with simple stitching layers, yielding many accuracy-efficiency trade-offs from one network that can switch at runtime.
nodes.problem: Efficiently assembling a pretrained model family for dynamic accuracy-efficiency trade-offs at deployment.
nodes.approach: Split anchor networks across blocks and join them with lightweight stitching layers trained briefly.
nodes.primary_topic: Architectures & Training › Efficient Training, Compression & Pruning
nodes.niche_reason: Model stitching across pretrained families is an unusual direction.

nodes.title: StyleGene: Crossover and Mutation of Region-Level Facial Genes for Kinship Face Synthesis
nodes.tldr: StyleGene extracts region-level facial genes in StyleGAN2 latent space and applies crossover and mutation to synthesize diverse kinship faces without paired data.
nodes.problem: Kinship face synthesis lacks large-scale annotated kinship data for generating descendants.
nodes.approach: Region-level gene encoders and decoder trained with cycle losses, plus crossover and mutation module.
secondary_topics: Computer Vision › Human Pose, Avatars & Faces
nodes.niche_reason: Kinship face synthesis is a rare application niche.

nodes.title: Super-CLEVR: A Virtual Benchmark To Diagnose Domain Robustness in Visual Reasoning
nodes.tldr: A controllable synthetic VQA benchmark isolating four domain-shift factors, plus probabilistic NSVQA showing disentangled reasoning and perception improves robustness.
nodes.problem: VQA models fail on out-of-distribution data, and entangled shift factors make generalization hard to analyze.
nodes.approach: Generate virtual data with independently controllable shift factors; add uncertainty reasoning to neural-symbolic VQA.
nodes.niche_reason: VQA robustness benchmarks are a specialised but known area.

nodes.title: TarViS: A Unified Approach for Target-Based Video Segmentation
nodes.tldr: TarViS is one network that segments arbitrary video targets via abstract queries, trained jointly across video segmentation tasks and hot-swapped at inference.
nodes.problem: Video segmentation tasks are fragmented into task-specific methods that cannot generalize across tasks.
nodes.approach: Abstract target queries decoded to pixel-precise masks in a single jointly trained architecture.
nodes.niche_reason: Unified video segmentation is an established research line.

nodes.title: Temporal Interpolation Is All You Need for Dynamic Neural Radiance Fields
nodes.tldr: Trains dynamic NeRFs by temporally interpolating feature vectors, via neural modules or 4D hash grids, giving over 100x faster training with strong rendering quality.
nodes.problem: Dynamic scene neural radiance fields are slow to train and struggle to capture short and long-term temporal features.
nodes.approach: Interpolate space-time features over time frames in neural or 4D hash-grid representations, plus a smoothness term.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: Dynamic NeRF was a crowded area at the time.

nodes.title: Tensor4D: Efficient Neural 4D Decomposition for High-Fidelity Dynamic Reconstruction and Rendering
nodes.tldr: Tensor4D represents dynamic scenes as hierarchically decomposed 4D spatio-temporal tensors into time-aware volumes and feature planes for efficient high-fidelity reconstruction and rendering.
nodes.problem: Memory-efficient high-fidelity dynamic scene reconstruction and rendering from sparse or monocular views.
nodes.approach: Hierarchical 4D tensor decomposition into volumes then planes, factorized coarse to fine.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: Dynamic NeRF representations are established but specialised.

nodes.title: Text2Scene: Text-Driven Indoor Scene Stylization With Part-Aware Details
nodes.tldr: Text2Scene textures indoor 3D scenes from a reference image and text, assigning colors to semantic parts then adding detailed per-object texture.
nodes.problem: Automatically creating realistic part-aware textures for multi-object virtual scenes.
nodes.approach: Part-aware decomposition from geometric segmentation, then per-object texturing aligned to input embeddings.
nodes.niche_reason: Scene-level texture stylization is established but specialised.

nodes.title: Top-Down Visual Attention From Analysis by Synthesis
nodes.tldr: Models top-down visual attention as sparse reconstruction under analysis-by-synthesis, yielding AbSViT, a goal-modulated vision transformer.
nodes.problem: Standard self-attention is stimulus-driven and cannot focus on task-relevant objects.
nodes.approach: Sparse reconstruction modulated by a top-down task signal, variationally approximated inside a ViT.
nodes.confidence_reason: architecture vs vision-language framing is a judgment call
nodes.niche_reason: neuroscience-inspired top-down attention is specialised

nodes.title: Towards Accurate Image Coding: Improved Autoregressive Image Generation With Dynamic Vector Quantization
nodes.tldr: Encodes image regions into variable-length codes by information density, then generates coarse-to-fine autoregressively, improving quality and speed.
nodes.problem: Fixed-size, fixed-length VQ codes waste capacity and force raster-scan generation.
nodes.approach: Dynamic-quantization VAE with variable-length codes and a stacked-transformer generator.
nodes.niche_reason: Variable-length discrete tokens for AR image gen is unusual.

nodes.title: Towards Better Stability and Adaptability: Improve Online Self-Training for Model Adaptation in Semantic Segmentation
nodes.tldr: Improves online self-training for source-free segmentation adaptation by dynamically updating the teacher and resampling training-consistent pseudo-labels, comparable to or better than UDA.
nodes.problem: Online self-training for source-free domain adaptation of segmentation models is unstable without source data.
nodes.approach: Dynamic teacher update mechanism plus training-consistency-based resampling strategy.
nodes.primary_topic: Architectures & Training › Domain Adaptation & OOD Generalization
nodes.niche_reason: Source-free adaptation for segmentation is a common research direction.

nodes.title: Towards Effective Adversarial Textured 3D Meshes on Physical Face Recognition
nodes.tldr: Designs 3D-printable adversarial textured meshes on a face that deceive black-box face recognition systems and evade anti-spoofing defenses.
nodes.problem: Physical attacks on commercial face recognition are detectable or ineffective, hindering robustness evaluation.
nodes.approach: Perturb a low-dimensional 3D Morphable Model coefficient space rather than high-dimensional mesh space.
nodes.niche_reason: Physical 3D adversarial face attacks are specialised

nodes.title: Towards Flexible Multi-Modal Document Models
nodes.tldr: FlexDM treats vector graphic documents as sets of multimodal elements and uses one masked-field prediction model to solve many design tasks like layout, font and color choice.
nodes.problem: Graphic design tasks are inter-related but typically solved by separate task-specific models.
nodes.approach: Unified masked multimodal element model with multi-task learning and in-domain pre-training.
nodes.niche_reason: Graphic design document modeling is a rare application area.

nodes.title: Towards High-Quality and Efficient Video Super-Resolution via Spatial-Temporal Data Overfitting
nodes.tldr: Improves overfitted-per-chunk video super-resolution by splitting videos into chunks via spatial-temporal information and joint data-aware training, reaching real-time 28 fps on a phone.
nodes.problem: Overfitting-based video super-resolution needs many chunks or large models, costing storage, bandwidth, or speed.
nodes.approach: Spatial-temporal chunk division plus data-aware joint training of a single overfitted model.
nodes.niche_reason: Streaming-oriented overfitted SR is specialised within restoration.

nodes.title: TransFlow: Transformer As Flow Learner
nodes.tldr: TransFlow is a pure transformer for optical flow using spatial self-attention and cross-frame attention, achieving state-of-the-art results on Sintel and KITTI-15.
nodes.problem: CNN-based optical flow struggles with global dependencies, occlusion, and complex multi-stage pretraining.
nodes.approach: Pure transformer architecture with self- and cross-attention across adjacent frames and long-range temporal association.
nodes.niche_reason: Optical flow architectures are a common vision topic.

nodes.title: Transforming Radiance Field With Lipschitz Network for Photorealistic 3D Scene Stylization
nodes.tldr: LipRF stylizes a pre-trained NeRF by learning a Lipschitz mapping of its appearance from 2D style transfer, giving consistent photorealistic novel views.
nodes.problem: Coupling NeRF with photorealistic style transfer causes cross-view inconsistency and degraded stylized views.
nodes.approach: Pre-train a radiance field, then learn a Lipschitz network that restyles its appearance using 2D style priors.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: Photorealistic NeRF stylization via Lipschitz mapping is an unusual angle.

nodes.title: Two-Way Multi-Label Loss
nodes.tldr: Proposes a two-way multi-label loss bridging softmax cross-entropy and multi-label classification via relative class comparison and margins, competitive with other multi-label losses.
nodes.problem: Binary cross-entropy for multi-label classification suffers imbalance issues compared with the softmax loss.
nodes.approach: Loss based on relative comparison among classes and samples, with margin enhancement to improve feature discriminability.
nodes.niche_reason: Multi-label classification losses are a common, well-studied topic.

nodes.title: Uncurated Image-Text Datasets: Shedding Light on Demographic Bias
nodes.tldr: Annotates Google Conceptual Captions with demographic attributes and shows societal bias persists across captioning, CLIP embeddings and text-to-image generation.
nodes.problem: Societal and demographic bias in large uncurated image-text datasets for vision-language models.
nodes.approach: Manually annotate demographic and contextual attributes, analyze group representation, and evaluate three downstream vision-language tasks.
nodes.niche_reason: Dataset bias audits are common in vision-language fairness work.

nodes.title: Understanding Deep Generative Models With Generalized Empirical Likelihoods
nodes.tldr: Uses generalized empirical likelihood tests to diagnose mode dropping and mode imbalance in GANs and diffusion models, predicting these failures better than precision-recall metrics.
nodes.problem: Likelihood-free generative models lack reliable diagnostics for dropped modes and imbalance.
nodes.approach: Moment-condition GEL tests combining MMD with per-sample interpretability and label information.
nodes.primary_topic: Generative Models › Generative Model Evaluation & Theory
nodes.niche_reason: Likelihood-free generative diagnostics are specialised.

nodes.title: Understanding Masked Autoencoders via Hierarchical Latent Variable Models
nodes.tldr: Proves that masked autoencoders identify latent variables in a hierarchical latent variable model, and shows masking ratio and patch size determine the semantic level recovered.
nodes.problem: No principled theory explains why masked autoencoders learn high-level representations.
nodes.approach: Hierarchical latent variable model with identifiability guarantees linking masking ratio and patch size to recovered latents.
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Deep Learning Theory
nodes.niche_reason: Theory of masked reconstruction is specialised but established.

nodes.title: Understanding Masked Image Modeling via Learning Occlusion Invariant Feature
nodes.tldr: Reinterprets masked image modeling as a siamese method learning occlusion-invariant features, a favorable initialization for vision transformers.
nodes.problem: Reconstruction-based masked image modeling lacks an explanation comparable to siamese contrastive methods.
nodes.approach: Relaxes MIM into an equivalent siamese form and empirically tests similarity functions and learned features.
secondary_topics: Computer Vision › Vision Foundation Models & Self-Supervision
nodes.niche_reason: Masked image modeling analysis is a common direction.

nodes.title: Understanding and Improving Features Learned in Deep Functional Maps
nodes.tldr: Analyzes features learned in deep functional maps, showing they act as comparable pointwise descriptors, and proposes modifications that improve non-rigid shape matching.
nodes.problem: Unclear what information deep functional map features encode for non-rigid 3D shape correspondence.
nodes.approach: Theoretical analysis of feature properties and pipeline changes promoting them, enabling extrinsic architectures.
nodes.niche_reason: Spectral shape correspondence is a rare niche.

nodes.title: Uni-Perceiver v2: A Generalist Model for Large-Scale Vision and Vision-Language Tasks
nodes.tldr: Uni-Perceiver v2 is a generalist model handling major vision and vision-language tasks, encoding images as region proposals and text via a Transformer language model.
nodes.problem: Generalist models lack versatility and performance across large-scale vision and vision-language tasks.
nodes.approach: Unified encoding of region proposals and text with shared decoder and a unified loss for joint training.
secondary_topics: Computer Vision › Vision Foundation Models & Self-Supervision
nodes.niche_reason: Generalist vision-language modeling is a common direction.

nodes.title: UniDistill: A Universal Cross-Modality Knowledge Distillation Framework for 3D Object Detection in Bird's-Eye View
nodes.tldr: Cross-modality knowledge distillation in BEV space lets single-modality 3D detectors learn from LiDAR, camera or fusion teachers with no inference cost.
nodes.problem: Multi-modal 3D detectors are complex, while single-modal detectors are less accurate.
nodes.approach: Projects teacher and student features into BEV and applies three sparse foreground distillation losses.
nodes.niche_reason: Cross-modal distillation for driving detection is common.

nodes.title: UniSim: A Neural Closed-Loop Sensor Simulator
nodes.tldr: UniSim converts a single driving log into a closed-loop multi-sensor simulation using neural feature grids for background and actors, enabling safety-critical autonomy evaluation.
nodes.problem: Closed-loop evaluation of self-driving requires realistic sensor data for new scenarios
nodes.approach: Neural feature grids composite static scene and dynamic actors to render LiDAR and camera
secondary_topics: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: Neural sensor simulation for driving is specialised

nodes.title: Unifying Vision, Text, and Layout for Universal Document Processing
nodes.tldr: Unifies text, image and layout into one Vision-Text-Layout transformer that handles document understanding and generation through prompt-based sequence generation.
nodes.problem: Document AI models lack a unified way to handle text, image and layout jointly
nodes.approach: Vision-Text-Layout transformer with self-supervised pretraining and prompt-based sequence generation
nodes.niche_reason: Document AI is established; unified generation is less common

nodes.title: Unsupervised Space-Time Network for Temporally-Consistent Segmentation of Multiple Motions
nodes.tldr: Unsupervised 3D spatio-temporal network segments multiple motions from sub-volumes of optical flow, with temporal-consistency regularization and no appearance or ground truth.
nodes.problem: Temporally consistent motion segmentation from optical flow without supervision
nodes.approach: 3D U-Net on flow sub-volumes trained with parametric motion model reconstruction loss
nodes.niche_reason: Classical flow-based motion segmentation, less common today

nodes.title: V2V4Real: A Real-World Large-Scale Dataset for Vehicle-to-Vehicle Cooperative Perception
nodes.tldr: V2V4Real is the first large-scale real-world multi-modal dataset for vehicle-to-vehicle cooperative perception, with benchmarks for cooperative 3D detection, tracking and Sim2Real adaptation.
nodes.problem: Lack of real-world data hinders research in vehicle-to-vehicle cooperative perception.
nodes.approach: Collect LiDAR and RGB data from two driving vehicles with 3D boxes and HD maps, plus benchmarks.
nodes.niche_reason: Cooperative perception is established but specialised within driving.

nodes.title: VL-SAT: Visual-Linguistic Semantics Assisted Training for 3D Semantic Scene Graph Prediction in Point Cloud
nodes.tldr: Trains a point-cloud 3D scene graph predictor with a vision-language oracle that transfers semantics during training, boosting tail relations with 3D-only inference.
nodes.problem: 3D scene graph prediction from point clouds suffers weak semantics and long-tailed relation distributions.
nodes.approach: Train-time distillation from a vision-language-geometry oracle into a 3D-only scene graph model.
secondary_topics: Architectures & Training › Knowledge Graphs & Relational Learning
nodes.niche_reason: Scene graph prediction on point clouds is established but specialised

nodes.title: VectorFloorSeg: Two-Stream Graph Attention Network for Vectorized Roughcast Floorplan Segmentation
nodes.tldr: Segments rooms in vector-graphics floorplans by classifying line segments and partitioned regions with a two-stream graph attention network, outperforming raster image-based methods.
nodes.problem: Raster-based floorplan segmentation yields aliased boundaries and fragments, ignoring vector structure.
nodes.approach: Two-stream graph neural network over line segments and regions with modulated graph attention fusion.
nodes.niche_reason: Vector floorplan analysis is a rare application niche.

nodes.title: Video-Text As Game Players: Hierarchical Banzhaf Interaction for Cross-Modal Representation Learning
nodes.tldr: Models video frames and text words as players in a cooperative game, using Hierarchical Banzhaf Interaction for fine-grained, explainable cross-modal contrastive learning and retrieval.
nodes.problem: Contrastive video-text learning only models coarse global interaction, missing fine-grained frame-word correspondence.
nodes.approach: Cluster tokens and compute Banzhaf interaction at multiple semantic levels via stacked token merging.
nodes.primary_topic: Audio, Speech & Multimodal › Audio-Visual & Cross-modal Learning
nodes.niche_reason: Game-theoretic interaction for video-text alignment is unusual.

nodes.title: VoxFormer: Sparse Voxel Transformer for Camera-Based 3D Semantic Scene Completion
nodes.tldr: Transformer for camera-based 3D semantic scene completion that densifies sparse visible voxel queries from depth into full volumetric semantics via masked autoencoding.
nodes.problem: Inferring complete 3D occupied and semantic geometry from only 2D images, including occluded regions.
nodes.approach: Sparse visible voxel queries from depth, densified by masked-autoencoder self-attention.
nodes.niche_reason: Camera-based 3D occupancy is a crowded, active area.

nodes.title: Zero-Shot Everything Sketch-Based Image Retrieval, and in Explainable Style
nodes.tldr: A single transformer for all zero-shot sketch-based image retrieval variants, matching local patch tokens across sketch and photo, with explainable correspondences.
nodes.problem: Zero-shot sketch-based image retrieval across categories and datasets, with interpretable matching.
nodes.approach: Learnable tokenizer, cross-modal attention for local correspondences, and kernel relation network scoring.
nodes.niche_reason: Sketch retrieval is established; explainable patch matching is specialised

nodes.title: 3D Face Reconstruction with the Geometric Guidance of Facial Part Segmentation
nodes.tldr: Proposes Part Re-projection Distance Loss that turns facial part segmentation into 2D point sets for robust 3D morphable-model face reconstruction under extreme expressions.
nodes.problem: 3D face reconstruction fails on extreme expressions due to sparse or inaccurate landmark supervision.
nodes.approach: Segmentation points re-projected onto the image with grid-anchor statistical distance descriptors.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › Human Pose, Avatars & Faces
nodes.niche_reason: 3DMM face reconstruction is established and fairly common.

nodes.title: 3D Human Pose Perception from Egocentric Stereo Videos
nodes.tldr: Transformer that estimates 3D human pose from egocentric stereo video using scene depth features and temporal joint queries, plus two new egocentric benchmark datasets.
nodes.problem: Head-mounted egocentric views with self-occlusion make accurate full-body 3D pose estimation hard.
nodes.approach: Scene-depth features and temporally enhanced joint queries in a stereo transformer.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › Human Pose, Avatars & Faces
nodes.niche_reason: Egocentric stereo pose is a specialised niche

nodes.title: 3DGStream: On-the-Fly Training of 3D Gaussians for Efficient Streaming of Photo-Realistic Free-Viewpoint Videos
nodes.tldr: Streams free-viewpoint video of dynamic scenes by fitting per-frame 3D Gaussians in about 12 seconds with a compact transformation cache, rendering at 200 FPS.
nodes.problem: Neural FVV methods need full offline sequences and cannot render in real time for streaming.
nodes.approach: Neural Transformation Cache models per-frame Gaussian motion, plus adaptive Gaussian addition for new objects.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: Streaming dynamic Gaussian splatting is a specialised niche.

nodes.title: 3DInAction: Understanding Human Actions in 3D Point Clouds
nodes.tldr: Recognizes human actions in 3D point cloud sequences by estimating patches that move through time (t-patches) and a hierarchical spatio-temporal architecture.
nodes.problem: Point cloud action recognition is hard due to lack of structure, permutation invariance, and varying point counts.
nodes.approach: Estimate temporally tracked t-patches as building blocks and learn spatio-temporal features hierarchically.
nodes.niche_reason: Point cloud sequence action recognition is under-explored.

nodes.title: 4D-DRESS: A 4D Dataset of Real-World Human Clothing With Semantic Annotations
nodes.tldr: Introduces 4D-DRESS, a real-world 4D dataset of human clothing scans with semantic annotations and benchmarks for clothing simulation and reconstruction.
nodes.problem: Synthetic clothing datasets lack realism; real 4D human clothing data is scarce and hard to annotate.
nodes.approach: Semi-automatic 4D human parsing pipeline combining human-in-the-loop labeling with automation.
secondary_topics: Computer Vision › Human Pose, Avatars & Faces
nodes.niche_reason: Real-world 4D clothing datasets are specialised but established.

nodes.title: A Pedestrian is Worth One Prompt: Towards Language Guidance Person Re-Identification
nodes.tldr: PromptSG uses CLIP with learned pseudo-token prompts to give language-guided semantic attention for person re-identification, improving results by up to 10%.
nodes.problem: Predefined CLIP prompts poorly express visual context and generalize badly for person re-identification.
nodes.approach: End-to-end prompt-driven semantic guidance with learned pseudo tokens for individual-specific descriptions.
nodes.niche_reason: CLIP prompt tuning for re-id is a common pattern.

nodes.title: A Vision Check-up for Language Models
nodes.tldr: Probes what language models know about the visual world via code-generated images, then trains vision representations using LLM-generated images alone.
nodes.problem: What text-only language models learn about the visual world, and whether that supports vision training.
nodes.approach: Code-rendered image generation, recognition and self-correction tests, then self-supervised vision training on LLM-generated images.
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › LLM Evaluation & Benchmarks
secondary_topics: Computer Vision › Vision Foundation Models & Self-Supervision
nodes.confidence_reason: Straddles LLM evaluation and visual representation learning from text-only models.
nodes.niche_reason: Unusual probing of visual knowledge in text-only models.

nodes.title: AV2AV: Direct Audio-Visual Speech to Audio-Visual Speech Translation with Unified Audio-Visual Speech Representation
nodes.tldr: Translates audio-visual speech directly into audio-visual speech in another language, keeping synchronized lip movements and speaker identity, and robust to acoustic noise.
nodes.problem: Speech translation ignores visual cues and fails under acoustic noise.
nodes.approach: Unified audio-visual self-supervised representations plus a zero-shot speaker AV-renderer.
nodes.primary_topic: Audio, Speech & Multimodal › Audio-Visual & Cross-modal Learning
secondary_topics: Audio, Speech & Multimodal › Speech Recognition & Synthesis
nodes.niche_reason: Direct audio-visual speech translation is a rare direction.

nodes.title: Abductive Ego-View Accident Video Understanding for Safe Driving Perception
nodes.tldr: Releases MM-AU, a dataset of 11,727 ego-view accident videos with text and object annotations, plus an abductive framework for accident understanding.
nodes.problem: Driving systems lack understanding of accident cause-effect chains from ego-view video.
nodes.approach: Object-centric video diffusion guided by an abductive CLIP model with a contrastive interaction loss.
nodes.confidence_reason: Mixes dataset and method contributions; primary topic is a judgment call
nodes.niche_reason: Accident-reason understanding from ego video is a rare niche

nodes.title: Absolute Pose from One or Two Scaled and Oriented Features
nodes.tldr: Derives minimal solvers for absolute camera pose from two oriented features, or one scaled and oriented feature given a known vertical direction.
nodes.problem: Absolute pose estimation rarely exploits feature scale and orientation from keypoints.
nodes.approach: Minimal geometric solvers using oriented/scaled correspondences with gravity direction from IMU.
nodes.niche_reason: Minimal algebraic solvers are a rare geometry niche.

nodes.title: Accept the Modality Gap: An Exploration in the Hyperbolic Space
nodes.tldr: Shows geodesic contrastive losses break hyperbolic hierarchies and proposes accepting the text-image modality gap for cross-modal alignment.
nodes.problem: Euclidean-style multimodal contrastive learning transposed to hyperbolic space disrupts hierarchies.
nodes.approach: Similarity measure for cross-modal alignment that does not enforce spatial proximity.
nodes.confidence_reason: Hyperbolic geometry and cross-modal alignment could fit two topics
nodes.niche_reason: Hyperbolic multimodal embedding with modality gap is a rare angle.

nodes.title: Active Domain Adaptation with False Negative Prediction for Object Detection
nodes.tldr: Actively selects target-domain images for labeling by scoring undetected objects alongside uncertainty, plus uncertainty-guided pseudo-labeling, for object detection adaptation.
nodes.problem: Active sampling for detector adaptation ignores undetected objects, causing false negative errors.
nodes.approach: False Negative Prediction Module scores image undetectability, combined with uncertainty-based active sampling.
nodes.primary_topic: Architectures & Training › Domain Adaptation & OOD Generalization
nodes.niche_reason: Active domain adaptation for detection is a moderately common direction

nodes.title: Adapting Visual-Language Models for Generalizable Anomaly Detection in Medical Images
nodes.tldr: Adapts CLIP for zero/few-shot medical anomaly detection using multi-level residual adapters and pixel-wise visual-language alignment losses.
nodes.problem: Natural-image vision-language models transfer poorly to anomaly detection in medical images due to domain gap.
nodes.approach: Lightweight residual adapters at multiple encoder levels with multi-level pixel-wise visual-language feature alignment losses.
nodes.niche_reason: Medical anomaly detection with VLMs is specialised yet established.

nodes.title: Align Your Gaussians: Text-to-4D with Dynamic 3D Gaussians and Composed Diffusion Models
nodes.tldr: Align Your Gaussians synthesizes text-to-4D dynamic scenes by optimizing deformable 3D Gaussians with composed text-to-image, text-to-video and multiview diffusion feedback.
nodes.problem: Text-to-4D generation lacks temporal consistency, visual quality and realistic geometry.
nodes.approach: Score distillation with dynamic Gaussians, Gaussian regularization and autoregressive composition.
secondary_topics: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: Text-to-4D generation is specialised, though increasingly studied.

nodes.title: AlignMiF: Geometry-Aligned Multimodal Implicit Field for LiDAR-Camera Joint Synthesis
nodes.tldr: AlignMiF aligns geometry across LiDAR and camera in a joint neural implicit field via geometry-aware alignment and shared geometry initialization for better joint view synthesis.
nodes.problem: Fusing LiDAR and camera in one implicit field suffers modality misalignment, where optimizing one hurts the other.
nodes.approach: Geometry-Aware Alignment and Shared Geometry Initialization modules to align coarse geometry across sensors.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: Joint LiDAR-camera neural fields are specialised within NeRF work.

nodes.title: Amodal Completion via Progressive Mixed Context Diffusion
nodes.tldr: Amodal completion by guiding a pretrained diffusion inpainting model with context outside the bounding box, progressively growing the object and trimming background.
nodes.problem: Generating the hidden parts of occluded objects without two-step mask-then-pixel pipelines and occluder co-occurrence bias.
nodes.approach: Progressive mixed-context diffusion inpainting beyond the bounding box, with a success-judging criterion.
nodes.niche_reason: Amodal completion is a relatively uncommon task.

nodes.title: Are Conventional SNNs Really Efficient? A Perspective from Network Quantization
nodes.tldr: Argues SNN time steps are analogous to quantized activation bit-widths, proposes a Bit Budget energy metric, and finds weight and spike-pattern focus beats temporal focus.
nodes.problem: Comparisons between SNNs and quantized ANNs are unfair and SNN energy estimates via SynOps are misleading.
nodes.approach: Unify time steps and bit-widths, define Bit Budget to allocate weights, activations and time steps under hardware constraints.
nodes.primary_topic: Architectures & Training › Efficient Training, Compression & Pruning
nodes.confidence_reason: Spiking networks fit no topic exactly; quantization framing chosen.
nodes.niche_reason: Spiking networks are a rare niche relative to mainstream deep learning.

nodes.title: Atlantis: Enabling Underwater Depth Estimation with Stable Diffusion
nodes.tldr: Generates photorealistic underwater images from terrestrial depth using a depth-conditioned Stable Diffusion ControlNet, enabling supervised underwater depth estimation.
nodes.problem: Underwater depth estimation lacks labeled data, so models suffer a large domain gap from terrestrial training.
nodes.approach: Depth2Underwater ControlNet creates new underwater scenes conditioned on terrestrial depth maps.
secondary_topics: Data, Benchmarks & Evaluation › Synthetic Data & Data Curation
nodes.confidence_reason: dataset generation pipeline with a depth estimation focus
nodes.niche_reason: underwater depth via diffusion-generated scenes is a rare niche

nodes.title: Attention-Propagation Network for Egocentric Heatmap to 3D Pose Lifting
nodes.tldr: EgoTAP lifts stereo egocentric joint heatmaps to 3D pose with a Grid ViT encoder and a skeleton-aware Propagation Network, cutting MPJPE error by 23.9%.
nodes.problem: Egocentric 3D pose estimation suffers from self-occlusion and out-of-view limbs, and heatmap-to-3D lifting is inaccurate.
nodes.approach: Grid ViT encoder summarizes heatmaps, then propagation network uses skeletal structure to infer obscured joints.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › Human Pose, Avatars & Faces
nodes.niche_reason: Egocentric stereo 3D body pose is a niche subfield.

nodes.title: BEHAVIOR Vision Suite: Customizable Dataset Generation via Simulation
nodes.tldr: BEHAVIOR Vision Suite provides tools and assets built on BEHAVIOR-1K to generate customizable, high-quality synthetic data for systematically evaluating vision models.
nodes.problem: Real-world vision datasets lack comprehensive, customizable labels for systematic evaluation under varied conditions.
nodes.approach: Simulation-based generator with high-quality assets and physics for fully customized labeled synthetic vision data.
nodes.primary_topic: Data, Benchmarks & Evaluation › Synthetic Data & Data Curation
nodes.niche_reason: Simulation-driven vision evaluation data is specialised.

nodes.title: BadCLIP: Dual-Embedding Guided Backdoor Attack on Multimodal Contrastive Learning
nodes.tldr: BadCLIP is a backdoor attack on CLIP using visual triggers aligned with target text semantics and optimized to evade detection and survive clean fine-tuning defenses.
nodes.problem: Existing backdoor attacks on multimodal contrastive models are countered by specialized detection and fine-tuning defenses.
nodes.approach: Dual-embedding guided trigger optimization aligning triggers with textual target semantics and target vision features.
nodes.niche_reason: Backdoor attacks are established; targeting multimodal contrastive models is specialised.

nodes.title: Bayes' Rays: Uncertainty Quantification for Neural Radiance Fields
nodes.tldr: Post-hoc uncertainty estimation for any pretrained NeRF using spatial perturbations and a Bayesian Laplace approximation, without retraining.
nodes.problem: NeRF uncertainty methods are heuristic or computationally expensive.
nodes.approach: Volumetric uncertainty field built from spatial perturbations and a Laplace approximation.
secondary_topics: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: Established NeRF uncertainty line, specialised Bayesian angle

nodes.title: Boosting Neural Representations for Videos with a Conditional Decoder
nodes.tldr: Adds a conditional decoder with temporal-aware affine transform and a sinusoidal block to implicit neural video representations, improving reconstruction, codecs, and inpainting.
nodes.problem: Implicit neural video representations underuse capacity because intermediate features misalign with target frames.
nodes.approach: Frame-index-conditioned affine alignment, sinusoidal NeRV-like blocks, and a high-frequency-preserving loss.
nodes.niche_reason: Specialized implicit video representation line

nodes.title: Brain Decodes Deep Nets
nodes.tldr: Maps pretrained vision models onto the brain via fMRI encoding (FactorTopy) to visualize hierarchy and scaling, finding brain-like models forget less when fine-tuned.
nodes.problem: Understanding the internal organization of large pretrained vision models through brain alignment.
nodes.approach: Brain encoding predicts fMRI from network features, with explicit mapping across space, layers, scales and channels.
nodes.niche_reason: Using brain encoding as an analysis tool for networks is unusual.

nodes.title: Breathing Life Into Sketches Using Text-to-Video Priors
nodes.tldr: Animates a single-subject vector sketch from a text prompt, using score distillation from a pretrained text-to-video diffusion model to guide strokes.
nodes.problem: Animating sketches is a laborious process that requires professional design skill.
nodes.approach: Score distillation from a text-to-video prior moves strokes via local deformations and global affine transforms.
nodes.niche_reason: Text-driven vector sketch animation is a rare niche

nodes.title: C2KD: Bridging the Modality Gap for Cross-Modal Knowledge Distillation
nodes.tldr: Cross-modal knowledge distillation where teacher and student differ in modality, using bidirectional distillation and sample filtering to bridge the modality gap.
nodes.problem: Traditional knowledge distillation fails across modalities due to modality imbalance and soft-label misalignment.
nodes.approach: Customized bidirectional teacher-student distillation, on-the-fly selection of misaligned samples, and progressive cross-modal proxies.
nodes.primary_topic: Architectures & Training › Efficient Training, Compression & Pruning
secondary_topics: Audio, Speech & Multimodal › Audio-Visual & Cross-modal Learning
nodes.confidence_reason: No distillation topic in vocab; placed under compression
nodes.niche_reason: Cross-modal distillation is specialised but has active peers

nodes.title: CAD-SIGNet: CAD Language Inference from Point Clouds using Layer-wise Sketch Instance Guided Attention
nodes.tldr: Recovers the sketch-and-extrude design history of a CAD model from a point cloud using auto-regressive cross-attention with sketch-guided attention.
nodes.problem: Reverse engineering a physical object into its CAD design history from a 3D scan is only partly realized.
nodes.approach: Auto-regressive cross-attention between point cloud and CAD language embeddings with sketch-instance guided attention.
secondary_topics: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: CAD design-history recovery from point clouds is a rare niche

nodes.title: CADTalk: An Algorithm and Benchmark for Semantic Commenting of CAD Programs
nodes.tldr: Introduces semantic commenting of CAD programs: segments code into blocks labeled by shape part, using rendered shapes, conditional image generation, and vision-language annotators, plus the CADTalk benchmark.
nodes.problem: CAD programs lack semantic comments and structure, making them hard to understand and modify.
nodes.approach: Execute programs to render shapes, generate photoreal images, apply semantic annotators, and distill labels back to code blocks.
nodes.confidence_reason: Fits no topic cleanly; CAD program understanding mixes code, shapes, and vision-language.
nodes.niche_reason: CAD program semantic annotation is a very rare task.

nodes.title: CAT-Seg: Cost Aggregation for Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmentation
nodes.tldr: Adapts CLIP for open-vocabulary semantic segmentation by aggregating image-text cosine-similarity cost volumes and fine-tuning the encoders.
nodes.problem: Labeling pixels with unseen classes using CLIP-style vision-language models, which existing methods handle poorly.
nodes.approach: Cost-volume aggregation of image-text similarity, with fine-tuned CLIP encoders for segmentation.
nodes.niche_reason: Open-vocabulary segmentation with CLIP is a crowded area

nodes.title: CFAT: Unleashing Triangular Windows for Image Super-resolution
nodes.tldr: Adds non-overlapping triangular windows alongside rectangular shifted windows in a transformer, reducing boundary distortion for better image super-resolution.
nodes.problem: Rectangular shifted-window transformers distort at boundaries and offer limited shifting modes for super-resolution.
nodes.approach: Composite attention fusing triangular-rectangular window local attention with channel-based global attention.
nodes.niche_reason: Transformer super-resolution is a common direction

nodes.title: CFPL-FAS: Class Free Prompt Learning for Generalizable Face Anti-spoofing
nodes.tldr: Uses CLIP-based content and style prompt transformers that modulate visual features, improving face anti-spoofing on unseen domains without domain labels.
nodes.problem: Face anti-spoofing models fail to generalize to unseen domains, and existing methods need domain labels.
nodes.approach: Content and style Q-Formers learn class-free text prompts that dynamically adjust classifier weights via prompt modulation.
nodes.primary_topic: Architectures & Training › Domain Adaptation & OOD Generalization
nodes.confidence_reason: Spans domain generalization and vision-language prompting
nodes.niche_reason: CLIP prompt learning for face anti-spoofing is specialised

nodes.title: CLIP-Driven Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Graph Generation via Cross-Modality Contrastive Learning
nodes.tldr: CCL-3DSGG trains a 3D scene graph feature extractor with CLIP-derived text and image cross-modal contrastive learning, enabling open-vocabulary recognition of novel objects and predicates.
nodes.problem: 3D scene graph generation needs costly annotations and closed-set training fails on novel classes.
nodes.approach: Align 3D scene graph features with word-level text and multi-view images via contrastive learning; match via cosine similarity.
nodes.niche_reason: Open-vocabulary 3D scene graph generation is a rare topic.

nodes.title: CLiC: Concept Learning in Context
nodes.tldr: CLiC learns a local visual concept from one image in the context of its object and applies it to another object via soft masks.
nodes.problem: Learning a localized visual pattern from a single image and transferring it across objects of different shapes.
nodes.approach: In-context concept learning with soft masks covering the concept and surrounding region, built on visual concept learning.
nodes.niche_reason: Local concept transfer is specialised within personalization.

nodes.title: COLMAP-Free 3D Gaussian Splatting
nodes.tldr: Performs novel view synthesis with 3D Gaussian Splatting without COLMAP poses by sequentially adding frames and growing Gaussians while jointly estimating camera poses.
nodes.problem: Neural rendering relies on precomputed camera poses; joint pose and 3D optimization is hard.
nodes.approach: Progressively grow 3D Gaussians frame by frame using video continuity, optimizing poses without SfM.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: Gaussian splatting is a very active, crowded area.

nodes.title: Can I Trust Your Answer? Visually Grounded Video Question Answering
nodes.tldr: NExT-GQA adds 10.5K temporal grounding labels to video QA, showing VLMs rarely ground answers in relevant video, and proposes Gaussian mask optimization to improve grounding.
nodes.problem: Whether video QA answers are truly grounded in relevant visual evidence
nodes.approach: New grounded-QA dataset plus Gaussian mask optimization with cross-modal learning
nodes.niche_reason: Grounded VideoQA is established but specialised

nodes.title: Causal-CoG: A Causal-Effect Look at Context Generation for Boosting Multi-modal Language Models
nodes.tldr: Causal-CoG prompts multimodal LMs to generate image context first, then filters samples by causal effect so context is used only where it helps VQA.
nodes.problem: Multimodal LMs give imprecise answers on VQA; contextual image descriptions may help but not always.
nodes.approach: Self-generated image contexts plus causality filtering as a plug-and-play decoding strategy.
secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › In-context Learning & Prompting
nodes.niche_reason: prompting for VQA is a common direction

nodes.title: Chat-UniVi: Unified Visual Representation Empowers Large Language Models with Image and Video Understanding
nodes.tldr: Chat-UniVi unifies image and video understanding in one multimodal LLM using dynamic visual tokens merged by clustering, enabling efficient use of limited visual tokens.
nodes.problem: Multimodal LLMs struggle to handle both images and videos efficiently with few visual tokens.
nodes.approach: Dynamic visual tokens via nearest-neighbor clustering give a unified image-video representation for an LLM.
nodes.niche_reason: Multimodal LLM variants are common.

nodes.title: Clockwork Diffusion: Efficient Generation With Model-Step Distillation
nodes.tldr: Clockwork Diffusion speeds up text-to-image diffusion by periodically reusing low-resolution UNet computation from earlier steps instead of recomputing it.
nodes.problem: Text-to-image diffusion UNets are computationally expensive at every denoising step.
nodes.approach: Reuse and approximate low-res UNet feature computation from preceding steps with a lightweight adaptor, distilling model steps.
nodes.niche_reason: Diffusion efficiency is a common direction.

nodes.title: CoDeF: Content Deformation Fields for Temporally Consistent Video Processing
nodes.tldr: Represents a video as a canonical image field plus a temporal deformation field, letting image algorithms run consistently on video.
nodes.problem: Temporally consistent video processing that lifts image methods to video without training.
nodes.approach: Jointly optimized canonical content field and per-frame deformation field, rendered through a regularized pipeline.
nodes.confidence_reason: straddles video understanding, tracking and video-to-video generation
nodes.niche_reason: Canonical-field video representation is specialised but established

nodes.title: CoDi-2: In-Context Interleaved and Interactive Any-to-Any Generation
nodes.tldr: A multimodal LLM that interleaves text, image, and audio in-context inputs and outputs, enabling zero-shot any-to-any generation.
nodes.problem: Models lack in-context, interleaved multimodal understanding and generation.
nodes.approach: Align modalities to language for encoding and generation, trained on in-context multimodal instructions.
nodes.niche_reason: Interleaved any-to-any generation is a specialised direction

nodes.title: Coarse-to-Fine Latent Diffusion for Pose-Guided Person Image Synthesis
nodes.tldr: CFLD controls a pretrained text-to-image diffusion model with learned coarse semantic prompts and fine appearance features for pose-guided person synthesis.
nodes.problem: Pose-guided person synthesis overfits when appearance is aligned to pose without semantic understanding.
nodes.approach: Perception-refined decoder yields coarse prompts, plus multi-scale appearance bias via hybrid-granularity attention.
secondary_topics: Computer Vision › Human Pose, Avatars & Faces
nodes.niche_reason: Pose-guided diffusion image synthesis is a common direction

nodes.title: CogAgent: A Visual Language Model for GUI Agents
nodes.tldr: Presents CogAgent, an 18B visual language model that uses high-resolution screenshots to understand and navigate GUIs, outperforming HTML-based LLM agents.
nodes.problem: Text-only LLM agents struggle to understand and act on graphical user interfaces.
nodes.approach: 18B visual language model with low- and high-resolution encoders, using screenshots as input.
secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › Agents & Tool Use
nodes.niche_reason: GUI agents are a fast-growing, crowded area.

nodes.title: Coherence As Texture - Passive Textureless 3D Reconstruction by Self-interference
nodes.tldr: Uses spatial coherence of natural light and an optical self-interference setup to passively estimate depth of textureless surfaces, demonstrated with a lab prototype.
nodes.problem: Passive stereo and defocus depth estimation fail on textureless objects.
nodes.approach: Optical self-interference of locally coherent scattered light acts as a texture feature for depth recovery.
secondary_topics: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: Physical-optics hardware approach, very unlike mainstream learning-based vision.

nodes.title: Compact 3D Gaussian Representation for Radiance Field
nodes.tldr: Compresses 3D Gaussian splatting over 25x via learnable Gaussian masking, grid-based neural color fields, and vector-quantized geometry codebooks with entropy coding.
nodes.problem: 3DGS needs huge numbers of Gaussians and attributes, causing large memory and storage.
nodes.approach: Learnable mask pruning, grid neural field for view-dependent color, codebook quantization and entropy coding.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: Gaussian splatting variants are common and active.

nodes.title: Continual Self-supervised Learning: Towards Universal Multi-modal Medical Data Representation Learning
nodes.tldr: MedCoSS continually pre-trains self-supervised models across medical modalities in stages, using rehearsal buffers and distillation to avoid forgetting and modality conflicts.
nodes.problem: Joint self-supervised pretraining across many medical modalities causes conflicts and cannot cover modalities not yet collected.
nodes.approach: Multi-stage continual SSL with k-means rehearsal buffer, feature distillation and intra-modal mixup.
nodes.niche_reason: Continual SSL for multi-modal medical data is specialised.

nodes.title: Cooperation Does Matter: Exploring Multi-Order Bilateral Relations for Audio-Visual Segmentation
nodes.tldr: Segments sounding objects in video with an audio-visual transformer that models pixel, modality and temporal bilateral entanglements, reaching state-of-the-art on AVSBench.
nodes.problem: Locating sounding objects at pixel level requires aligning audio and visual signals across frames
nodes.approach: Siamese encoder, bilateral audio-visual fusion module, and adaptive inter-frame consistency loss
nodes.primary_topic: Audio, Speech & Multimodal › Audio-Visual & Cross-modal Learning
nodes.niche_reason: Audio-visual segmentation is a specialised niche

nodes.title: CoralSCOP: Segment any COral Image on this Planet
