nodes.tldr: Foundation model that densely segments coral reef images at multiple granularities with semantic labels, with strong zero-shot ability from a 41k-image dataset.
nodes.problem: Coral analysis needs heavy manual labeling by biologists, and generic segmenters lack coral semantics.
nodes.approach: Parallel semantic branch added to dense segmentation, trained on the CoralMask dataset.
nodes.niche_reason: Coral reef segmentation is a rare application area.

nodes.title: Correcting Diffusion Generation through Resampling
nodes.tldr: Particle filtering that corrects distributional gaps in diffusion generation by resampling with weights from real images and a pretrained object detector.
nodes.problem: Diffusion outputs miss objects and have low quality due to distributional discrepancies.
nodes.approach: Resampling particles with weights derived from a small real image set and an object detector.
nodes.niche_reason: Particle-filter resampling for diffusion is a specialized inference-time niche.

nodes.title: Correspondence-Free Non-Rigid Point Set Registration Using Unsupervised Clustering Analysis
nodes.tldr: Registers non-rigid point sets without correspondences by treating them as clustering centroids and members, with closed-form Laplacian-kernel solutions and linear-memory Nystrom approximation.
nodes.problem: Non-rigid point set registration needs correspondences and struggles with large deformations.
nodes.approach: Tikhonov regularisation with an L1-induced Laplacian kernel plus clustering-improved Nystrom approximation.
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Kernels, GPs & Nonparametrics
nodes.niche_reason: Correspondence-free non-rigid registration is specialised but established.

nodes.title: CosmicMan: A Text-to-Image Foundation Model for Humans
nodes.tldr: A text-to-image foundation model specialized for photorealistic human images, using a 6M-image dataset with dense captions and decomposed attention refocusing.
nodes.problem: General text-to-image models produce poor humans and misalign dense text with image structure.
nodes.approach: Scalable data flywheel for dense captions, plus decomposed cross-attention refocusing on body groups.
secondary_topics: Computer Vision › Human Pose, Avatars & Faces
nodes.niche_reason: Human-centric text-to-image is an active, fairly crowded niche.

nodes.title: Cross-spectral Gated-RGB Stereo Depth Estimation
nodes.tldr: Stereo depth estimation combining gated and RGB-NIR cameras with active flood illumination, using only low-cost CMOS sensors, improving long-range depth accuracy.
nodes.problem: Gated depth estimates have much lower resolution than RGB stereo methods.
nodes.approach: Multi-modal stereo network exploiting gated, RGB and NIR cues including active illumination.
nodes.niche_reason: Gated stereo with RCCB and active illumination is an unusual sensing setup.

nodes.title: DEADiff: An Efficient Stylization Diffusion Model with Disentangled Representations
nodes.tldr: Transfers reference image style to text-to-image diffusion by decoupling style and semantics via Q-Formers injected into exclusive cross-attention layers.
nodes.problem: Encoder-based style transfer harms text controllability in text-to-image diffusion models.
nodes.approach: Q-Formers on style and semantic prompts trained on paired non-reconstructive images, injected into disjoint cross-attention subsets.
nodes.niche_reason: Reference style transfer for diffusion is fairly common

nodes.title: Data-Efficient Multimodal Fusion on a Single GPU
nodes.tldr: Aligns image, text and audio by augmenting pretrained unimodal encoders' latent spaces, rivalling CLIP with far less compute.
nodes.problem: Strong multimodal alignment models need massive paired data and compute, which is impractical in many settings.
nodes.approach: FuseMix, a multimodal latent-space augmentation applied to arbitrary pretrained unimodal encoders.
nodes.primary_topic: Audio, Speech & Multimodal › Audio-Visual & Cross-modal Learning
nodes.niche_reason: Data-efficient multimodal alignment is specialised but established

nodes.title: Deciphering 'What' and 'Where' Visual Pathways from Spectral Clustering of Layer-Distributed Neural Representations
nodes.tldr: Spectral clustering over affinity matrices from all layers of pretrained vision transformers yields spatial layout and object identity, suggesting key/query 'where' and value 'what' pathways.
nodes.problem: Understanding grouping information in large pretrained vision models' activations across all layers.
nodes.approach: Optimize spectral clustering objective over per-layer affinity matrices; key-query affinities give layout, value affinities give semantics.
nodes.confidence_reason: Interpretability analysis that also yields segmentation; topic is a judgment call.
nodes.niche_reason: Neuroscience-inspired spectral analysis of network activations is unusual.

nodes.title: Dense Optical Tracking: Connecting the Dots
nodes.tldr: Speeds up dense point tracking by propagating sparse motion-boundary tracks into a dense flow and visibility field, refined by a learned flow estimator.
nodes.problem: Tracking every point in a frame with occlusion-aware point trackers is too slow in practice.
nodes.approach: Sparse key-region tracks seed nearest-neighbor dense flow, refined by an occlusion-aware learnable flow network.
nodes.niche_reason: Dense point tracking is an established area

nodes.title: Detours for Navigating Instructional Videos
nodes.tldr: Retrieves detour video segments from how-to repositories given a source video and a natural-language alteration query, trained with weakly supervised narration-derived data.
nodes.problem: Finding a how-to video segment that alters the current recipe path requires targeted temporal retrieval.
nodes.approach: Video-and-text conditioned retrieval of temporal segments, with narration text pipeline generating weakly supervised training pairs.
nodes.niche_reason: Novel video detour navigation task for how-to videos.

nodes.title: DiVa-360: The Dynamic Visual Dataset for Immersive Neural Fields
nodes.tldr: A 53-camera real-world 360-degree dynamic dataset of synchronized multi-view video, with masks, audio and text, plus benchmarks of dynamic neural field methods.
nodes.problem: Dynamic neural fields lag 2D video because real-world multi-view datasets are scarce.
nodes.approach: Customized low-cost 53-camera capture system producing 21 object, 25 hand-object and 8 long sequences.
secondary_topics: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: Dynamic neural field datasets are scarce but a recognised need

nodes.title: DiffPortrait3D: Controllable Diffusion for Zero-Shot Portrait View Synthesis
nodes.tldr: Zero-shot diffusion model that synthesizes consistent novel views of a face from one portrait, guided by appearance attention and camera-pose control without test-time optimization.
nodes.problem: Synthesizing 3D-consistent novel views of a face from a single unposed in-the-wild portrait, preserving identity.
nodes.approach: Frozen 2D diffusion UNets with reference appearance injected into self-attention, plus a camera-pose control module and cross-view attention.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › Human Pose, Avatars & Faces
nodes.confidence_reason: judgment call between avatars and controllable generation
nodes.niche_reason: Single-image portrait view synthesis is specialised but well explored

nodes.title: Diffeomorphic Template Registration for Atmospheric Turbulence Mitigation
nodes.tldr: Recovers clean irradiance from turbulence-distorted images by registering each frame to a latent template using aggregated optical flow and a flow inversion module.
nodes.problem: Mitigating atmospheric turbulence distortion without supervised data or heuristic template initialization.
nodes.approach: Aggregate optical flow from a reference frame with a CLT prior and invert flows to register images to the template.
nodes.niche_reason: Turbulence mitigation is a rare restoration niche.

nodes.title: Diffusion Handles Enabling 3D Edits for Diffusion Models by Lifting Activations to 3D
nodes.tldr: Diffusion Handles lifts diffusion activations of a selected object to 3D using proxy depth, transforms them, and re-projects to enable training-free 3D object edits in images.
nodes.problem: Image diffusion models lack ways to do 3D-aware object edits preserving identity, occlusion, and lighting.
nodes.approach: Lift activations to 3D via estimated depth, apply 3D transform, project back, and guide diffusion with manipulated activations.
nodes.niche_reason: 3D-aware image editing is specialised within image editing.

nodes.title: Diffusion Reflectance Map: Single-Image Stochastic Inverse Rendering of Illumination and Reflectance
nodes.tldr: Recovers illumination and reflectance jointly from one image via a diffusion model that operates in the reflectance map, generalizing from synthetic to real images.
nodes.problem: Jointly estimating illumination and object reflectance from a single image is ill-posed.
nodes.approach: Diffusion model in reflectance-map space with two subnetworks for illumination and reflectance.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.confidence_reason: Inverse rendering fits no single topic cleanly.
nodes.niche_reason: Diffusion-based stochastic inverse rendering is an unusual combination.

nodes.title: Diffusion-EDFs: Bi-equivariant Denoising Generative Modeling on SE(3) for Visual Robotic Manipulation
nodes.tldr: Diffusion-EDFs is an SE(3)-equivariant diffusion policy for visual manipulation that trains end-to-end from only 5-10 demonstrations in under an hour.
nodes.problem: Learning visual manipulation from stochastic human demonstrations demands data efficiency and generalization.
nodes.approach: SE(3)-equivariant denoising diffusion over end-to-end visual policies with bi-equivariant structure.
nodes.niche_reason: Equivariant diffusion policies are a specialised growing niche

nodes.title: Discovering and Mitigating Visual Biases through Keyword Explanation
nodes.tldr: Discovers visual biases by extracting keywords from captions of mispredicted images, validates them with a vision-language scorer, and supports debiasing.
nodes.problem: Visual biases in vision models are hard to name and need human interpretation.
nodes.approach: Keyword extraction from mispredicted-image captions, scored by a vision-language model.
nodes.niche_reason: Keyword-based bias explanation is specialised within fairness work.

nodes.title: Distraction is All You Need: Memory-Efficient Image Immunization against Diffusion-Based Image Editing
nodes.tldr: Protects images from diffusion-based editing by attacking cross-attention maps with timestep-universal perturbations, nearly halving memory versus prior immunization methods.
nodes.problem: Text-to-image diffusion editing enables malicious manipulation of personal images, and existing immunization is memory-heavy.
nodes.approach: Semantic attack on cross-attention maps with timestep-universal gradient updates producing timestep-agnostic perturbations.
nodes.niche_reason: Immunizing images against diffusion editing is a specialised defense niche.

nodes.title: DistriFusion: Distributed Parallel Inference for High-Resolution Diffusion Models
nodes.tldr: Parallelizes high-resolution diffusion inference across GPUs by reusing previous-step features, enabling asynchronous communication and up to 6.1x speedup.
nodes.problem: High-resolution diffusion generation is too slow for interactive use due to computational cost.
nodes.approach: Displaced patch parallelism that splits inputs across GPUs and reuses prior-timestep feature maps as context.
nodes.niche_reason: Common diffusion-speedup theme, systems-focused variant

nodes.title: Diversified and Personalized Multi-rater Medical Image Segmentation
nodes.tldr: D-Persona is a two-stage framework producing both diversified and personalized medical image segmentations from multiple raters using a Probabilistic U-Net and attention-based expert projection heads.
nodes.problem: Annotation ambiguity across raters in medical image segmentation, needing both diverse and rater-personalized outputs.
nodes.approach: Stage I diversified Probabilistic U-Net with bound-constrained loss; Stage II attention-based prompts for personalized rater predictions.
nodes.niche_reason: Multi-rater segmentation is specialised within medical imaging.

nodes.title: Domain Prompt Learning with Quaternion Networks
nodes.tldr: Adapts vision-language models to specialized domains by using domain foundation-model features to guide language prompts and vision prompts through quaternion networks.
nodes.problem: Prompt learning for VLMs underperforms in specialized domains such as remote sensing and medical imaging.
nodes.approach: Quaternion networks map language embeddings into a domain space guided by domain vision features; hierarchical vision prompts.
secondary_topics: Architectures & Training › Domain Adaptation & OOD Generalization
nodes.niche_reason: Quaternion networks for domain prompt learning are an unusual VLM adaptation angle.

nodes.title: Don't Drop Your Samples! Coherence-Aware Training Benefits Conditional Diffusion
nodes.tldr: Coherence-Aware Diffusion conditions diffusion models on both the condition and a per-sample confidence score, so they learn from noisy annotations without discarding data.
nodes.problem: Conditional information for diffusion models can be noisy or unreliable, and discarding low-quality samples wastes data.
nodes.approach: Condition the diffusion model on a per-sample confidence score so it discounts unreliable conditioning during training.
nodes.niche_reason: Handling noisy conditioning in diffusion is less crowded than samplers.

nodes.title: Dr.Hair: Reconstructing Scalp-Connected Hair Strands without Pre-Training via Differentiable Rendering of Line Segments
nodes.tldr: Reconstructs scalp-connected hair strands from images without pretraining, by optimizing line-segment strands with a differentiable renderer and global orientation initialization.
nodes.problem: Learned hair reconstruction needs costly synthetic pretraining that does not transfer to real images
nodes.approach: Differentiable line-segment rendering with Laplace-based strand initialization
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
secondary_topics: Computer Vision › Human Pose, Avatars & Faces
nodes.niche_reason: Very rare: hair strand reconstruction has few related papers

nodes.title: DragDiffusion: Harnessing Diffusion Models for Interactive Point-based Image Editing
nodes.tldr: Extends DragGAN-style interactive point-based editing to pretrained diffusion models by optimizing one timestep's latent, with identity-preserving fine-tuning, and releases DragBench.
nodes.problem: Point-based drag editing with GANs is limited by pretrained GAN capacity and does not work well on diverse real images.
nodes.approach: Optimize a single diffusion timestep latent with identity-preserving fine-tuning and reference-latent control; introduce DragBench benchmark.
nodes.niche_reason: Diffusion image editing is a crowded area.

nodes.title: DreamPropeller: Supercharge Text-to-3D Generation with Parallel Sampling
nodes.tldr: Speeds up text-to-3D score distillation by parallelizing sampling with Picard iterations, reaching up to 4.7x wallclock speedup.
nodes.problem: Score distillation text-to-3D generation takes too long, hurting user experience.
nodes.approach: Drop-in Picard-iteration parallel sampling wrapper that handles momentum updates and dimension changes.
nodes.niche_reason: Text-to-3D distillation is a popular, crowded direction

nodes.title: Dynamic Cues-Assisted Transformer for Robust Point Cloud Registration
nodes.tldr: DCATr restricts transformer attention to correlated structural cues and updates features dynamically, reducing matching ambiguity for state-of-the-art point cloud registration.
nodes.problem: Coarse-to-fine point cloud registration suffers ambiguous superpoint matching from interference of irrelevant regions.
nodes.approach: Cues-constrained attention, consistency-weighted aggregation, and dynamic feature updating in a transformer.
nodes.niche_reason: Established 3D vision task with specialised attention design.

nodes.title: Dynamic LiDAR Re-simulation using Compositional Neural Fields
nodes.tldr: Presents DyNFL, a neural field method that re-simulates LiDAR scans of dynamic driving scenes and lets users edit viewpoints and add or remove objects.
nodes.problem: Dynamic-scene LiDAR re-simulation lacks editable, physically faithful reconstructions for driving data.
nodes.approach: Composes separately reconstructed static background and object neural fields through an occlusion-aware ray drop test.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: Editable LiDAR neural fields for driving are specialised

nodes.title: Dynamic Policy-Driven Adaptive Multi-Instance Learning for Whole Slide Image Classification
nodes.tldr: Combines reinforcement-learning-driven dynamic instance sampling with contrastive feature aggregation to improve multi-instance classification of whole-slide histopathology images.
nodes.problem: Pseudo-bag MIL for whole-slide images has high storage costs, overfitting, and biased decisions.
nodes.approach: Dynamic policy instance selection with reward-based sampling and contrastive bias correction.
secondary_topics: Reinforcement Learning › Online & Deep RL Algorithms
nodes.confidence_reason: Mixes MIL, RL sampling and medical imaging; abstract wording is loose.
nodes.niche_reason: RL-driven MIL for pathology is specialised.

nodes.title: EAGLE: Eigen Aggregation Learning for Object-Centric Unsupervised Semantic Segmentation
nodes.tldr: EAGLE improves unsupervised semantic segmentation by learning object-level features with a spectral eigenbasis cue and an object-centric contrastive loss.
nodes.problem: Patch-level ViT features lack explicit object-level semantics, so complex objects are segmented poorly.
nodes.approach: Eigenbasis cues from semantic similarity and color affinity drive an object-centric contrastive loss.
nodes.niche_reason: Unsupervised segmentation with ViT features is a crowded area.

nodes.title: Editable Scene Simulation for Autonomous Driving via Collaborative LLM-Agents
nodes.tldr: ChatSim enables editable photo-realistic 3D driving scene simulation through natural language, using collaborating LLM agents, multi-camera neural radiance fields and lighting estimation for asset insertion.
nodes.problem: Editable driving scene simulation lacks efficient interaction, multi-camera realism and external asset integration.
nodes.approach: LLM agent collaboration with multi-camera NeRF rendering and scene-consistent lighting estimation.
secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › Agents & Tool Use
nodes.niche_reason: Language-driven driving simulation is specialised.

nodes.title: Efficient Deformable ConvNets: Rethinking Dynamic and Sparse Operator for Vision Applications
nodes.tldr: DCNv4 is a faster, more expressive deformable convolution operator, removing softmax normalization and optimizing memory access for vision backbones.
nodes.problem: DCNv3 converges slowly and is memory-inefficient, limiting dynamic sparse operators in vision.
nodes.approach: Remove softmax in spatial aggregation and reduce redundant memory access for speedup.
nodes.confidence_reason: Operator spans classification, detection and generation; primary is a judgment
nodes.niche_reason: Deformable convolution backbones are a mainstream vision topic

nodes.title: Efficient LoFTR: Semi-Dense Local Feature Matching with Sparse-Like Speed
nodes.tldr: Makes the detector-free LoFTR matcher about 2.5x faster via adaptive token selection in attention, with a two-stage correlation layer for better subpixel accuracy.
nodes.problem: Transformer-based semi-dense feature matching is redundant and slow over the entire feature map.
nodes.approach: Aggregated attention with adaptive token selection and a two-stage correlation layer for subpixel matches.
nodes.niche_reason: Feature matching is a mainstream vision geometry topic

nodes.title: Efficient Solution of Point-Line Absolute Pose
nodes.tldr: Gives elementary minimal solvers for absolute camera pose from point and line correspondences, lowering polynomial degrees from 4 to 2 and 8 to 4, with up to 10x speedup.
nodes.problem: Minimal point-line absolute pose problems required high-degree polynomial root finding, making solvers slow.
nodes.approach: Derive simpler algebraic formulations reducing needed polynomial degrees.
nodes.niche_reason: Algebraic minimal solvers are a niche corner of geometric vision.

nodes.title: EfficientSAM: Leveraged Masked Image Pretraining for Efficient Segment Anything
nodes.tldr: EfficientSAM builds lightweight Segment Anything models by pretraining small encoders with masked image pretraining that reconstructs SAM encoder features.
nodes.problem: SAM's huge compute cost limits its use in real-world applications.
nodes.approach: SAMI masked pretraining reconstructs SAM features; light encoders and mask decoder are then finetuned on SA-1B.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › Vision Foundation Models & Self-Supervision
nodes.niche_reason: Efficient SAM variants are a crowded area.

nodes.title: EgoThink: Evaluating First-Person Perspective Thinking Capability of Vision-Language Models
nodes.tldr: A VQA benchmark from egocentric video clips that tests first-person reasoning in 21 vision-language models, showing large room for improvement.
nodes.problem: VLM evaluations mostly use third-person views, leaving first-person reasoning for embodied agents unmeasured.
nodes.approach: Egocentric clips with manually annotated QA across six capabilities and twelve dimensions; GPT-4 judges open answers.
nodes.niche_reason: First-person VLM benchmarks are a specialised, growing niche.

nodes.title: Emu Edit: Precise Image Editing via Recognition and Generation Tasks
nodes.tldr: Emu Edit is a multi-task instruction-based image editor trained across editing and vision tasks with learned task embeddings, plus a new seven-task editing benchmark.
nodes.problem: Instruction-based image editing models often fail to follow user instructions accurately.
nodes.approach: Multi-task generative training over diverse editing and recognition tasks with learned task embeddings.
nodes.niche_reason: Instruction-based image editing is a common area.

nodes.title: Enhancing Video Super-Resolution via Implicit Resampling-based Alignment
nodes.tldr: Replaces bilinear resampling in video super-resolution alignment with an implicit coordinate-network resampler that preserves high frequencies, improving state-of-the-art frameworks cheaply.
nodes.problem: Bilinear interpolation in frame alignment smooths high frequencies and hurts video super-resolution.
nodes.approach: Implicit resampling using sinusoidal positional encoding, coordinate MLP and window-based cross-attention.
nodes.niche_reason: Alignment resampling analysis is a specialised low-level vision angle.

nodes.title: Enhancing Vision-Language Pre-training with Rich Supervisions
nodes.tldr: Pre-trains vision-language models on web screenshots using ten tasks built from HTML tree structure and spatial localization, with cheap annotations.
nodes.problem: Image-text pairs miss the rich visual and textual structure present in web screenshots.
nodes.approach: Ten strongly supervised pre-training tasks exploiting HTML element hierarchy and spatial layout.
nodes.niche_reason: screenshot-based VLM pretraining is an uncommon data source

nodes.title: Event-based Structure-from-Orbit
nodes.tldr: Reconstructs a fast-spinning object's 3D shape and recovers the equivalent orbital camera motion from a static event camera's data.
nodes.problem: Recovering 3D structure and spin motion of fast rotating objects with self-occlusion in event data.
nodes.approach: Spatio-temporal clustering event feature tracker feeding a factor-graph structure-from-orbit back-end.
nodes.niche_reason: Event-camera structure-from-motion for spinning objects is a rare setting.

nodes.title: ExACT: Language-guided Conceptual Reasoning and Uncertainty Estimation for Event-based Action Recognition and More
nodes.tldr: Recognizes actions from event camera streams using language-guided conceptual reasoning and a learned semantic uncertainty estimate.
nodes.problem: Event-based action recognition suffers from long event durations, ambiguous action semantics and redundant frame representations.
nodes.approach: Adaptive fine-grained event representation plus conceptual reasoning module with distributional uncertainty estimation.
nodes.confidence_reason: event-based recognition vs uncertainty estimation overlap
nodes.niche_reason: Event-camera action recognition with language reasoning is specialised

nodes.title: Exploring the Transferability of Visual Prompting for Multimodal Large Language Models
nodes.tldr: Learns a visual prompt on one multimodal LLM that transfers to other MLLMs and improves downstream task performance without retraining each model.
nodes.problem: Fine-tuning every multimodal LLM separately for downstream tasks is costly and redundant.
nodes.approach: Visual prompts regularised by feature consistency alignment and language-guided task semantics enrichment.
nodes.niche_reason: Transferable prompts across different MLLMs is specialised

nodes.title: F3Loc: Fusion and Filtering for Floorplan Localization
nodes.tldr: Localises a camera within a floorplan in real time using ray-based depth from single and multi-view modules plus temporal filtering, without per-map retraining.
nodes.problem: Self-localisation in a floorplan without retraining per map or a large image database.
nodes.approach: Probabilistic model fusing single- and multi-view horizontal depth predictions with temporal filtering.
nodes.confidence_reason: Localisation sits between CV pose estimation and robot perception; judgment call.
nodes.niche_reason: Floorplan-based localisation is specialised but has a steady literature.

nodes.title: FAR: Flexible Accurate and Robust 6DoF Relative Camera Pose Estimation
nodes.tldr: Combines learned relative camera pose regression with a geometric solver via a Transformer that balances both and guides the solver with a prior.
nodes.problem: Solver-based pose is precise but fragile; learned pose is robust but imprecise.
nodes.approach: Transformer weighs solved versus learned pose estimates and supplies a prior to guide the solver.
nodes.niche_reason: Relative pose estimation is a mature, crowded area

nodes.title: Fantastic Animals and Where to Find Them: Segment Any Marine Animal with Dual SAM
nodes.tldr: Adapts the Segment Anything Model with a dual structure, multi-level prompts and connectivity prediction for state-of-the-art marine animal segmentation.
nodes.problem: SAM trained on natural images lacks marine priors and single-point prompts give weak guidance.
nodes.approach: Dual decoders with adapter-enhanced SAM encoder, multi-level coupled prompts and criss-cross pixel connectivity prediction.
secondary_topics: Computer Vision › Vision Foundation Models & Self-Supervision
nodes.niche_reason: Marine animal segmentation is a specialised application niche

nodes.title: Fast ODE-based Sampling for Diffusion Models in Around 5 Steps
nodes.tldr: Learns the mean direction of each sampling trajectory to remove ODE truncation error, giving good image quality with about five function evaluations.
nodes.problem: High-order ODE samplers still lose quality at very few function evaluations.
nodes.approach: Learned mean-direction solver exploiting the near 2D subspace of sampling trajectories.
nodes.niche_reason: Fast ODE samplers for diffusion are crowded

nodes.title: Feature 3DGS: Supercharging 3D Gaussian Splatting to Enable Distilled Feature Fields
nodes.tldr: Extends 3D Gaussian Splatting to distil arbitrary-dimension features from 2D foundation models like SAM and CLIP, enabling fast semantic segmentation and editing.
nodes.problem: NeRF-based semantic feature fields are slow to render and suffer continuity artifacts, limiting feature quality.
nodes.approach: Architectural and training changes that resolve resolution and channel mismatch between RGB images and feature maps in 3DGS.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: Gaussian splatting with foundation-feature distillation is a popular direction.

nodes.title: Feedback-Guided Autonomous Driving
nodes.tldr: Improves behavior-cloned driving agents by using LLM-generated language feedback that explains prediction failures, with an efficient end-to-end architecture.
nodes.problem: Behavior cloning alone fails to teach complex driving; agents need fine-grained corrective feedback.
nodes.approach: LLM generates corrective feedback on driving prediction failures; efficient sensorimotor end-to-end LLM-based architecture.
nodes.niche_reason: Behavior cloning for driving with LLM feedback is a fairly common combo

nodes.title: FinePOSE: Fine-Grained Prompt-Driven 3D Human Pose Estimation via Diffusion Models
nodes.tldr: A diffusion-based 3D human pose denoiser guided by fine-grained, body-part-aware text prompts, with prompt-pose communication and timestep-driven prompt stylization.
nodes.problem: 3D pose estimation ignores text knowledge and fine-grained body-part guidance.
nodes.approach: Diffusion denoiser with learnable part-aware prompts coupled to text and pose features.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › Human Pose, Avatars & Faces
nodes.niche_reason: Diffusion-based pose estimation is a common direction.

nodes.title: FlowDiffuser: Advancing Optical Flow Estimation with Diffusion Models
nodes.tldr: Reformulates optical flow estimation as conditional generation, denoising random flows toward the true flow with a recurrent decoder, generalizing better.
nodes.problem: Regression-based optical flow generalizes poorly when trained on synthetic or constrained data.
nodes.approach: Noise-to-flow diffusion with a conditional recurrent denoising decoder and hidden state denoising.
nodes.confidence_reason: Optical flow vs diffusion framing: topic judgment between two close areas
nodes.niche_reason: Established flow task, unusual diffusion-based formulation

nodes.title: FlowVid: Taming Imperfect Optical Flows for Consistent Video-to-Video Synthesis
nodes.tldr: Consistent video-to-video synthesis that edits the first frame with any image model and propagates edits using optical flow as a warped diffusion reference.
nodes.problem: Video-to-video diffusion editing struggles to keep temporal consistency across frames.
nodes.approach: Warps optical flow from the first frame as a supplementary reference to a diffusion model.
nodes.niche_reason: diffusion video editing is a crowded, active area

nodes.title: FoundationPose: Unified 6D Pose Estimation and Tracking of Novel Objects
nodes.tldr: Unified foundation model for 6D object pose estimation and tracking of novel objects, working with CAD models or few reference images without finetuning.
nodes.problem: Pose estimation and tracking of novel objects without per-object training, across model-based and model-free setups.
nodes.approach: Neural implicit view synthesis, LLM-aided synthetic training, transformer architecture and contrastive learning formulation.
nodes.niche_reason: Object pose estimation is established but specialised.

nodes.title: Frequency-Adaptive Dilated Convolution for Semantic Segmentation
nodes.tldr: Makes dilated convolution frequency-adaptive, using per-location dilation rates and frequency-split kernels to enlarge receptive fields.
nodes.problem: Fixed global dilation rates limit both effective bandwidth and receptive field size in dilated convolution.
nodes.approach: Spatially adaptive dilation plus AdaKern weight decomposition and FreqSelect high/low frequency reweighting.
nodes.confidence_reason: architecture-level operator evaluated mainly on segmentation
nodes.niche_reason: frequency-adaptive convolution operator, specialised

nodes.title: From Activation to Initialization: Scaling Insights for Optimizing Neural Fields
nodes.tldr: Theoretical analysis of how weight initialization and activation function choices interact in neural fields, arguing for joint design for stable optimization.
nodes.problem: Neural fields lack a theoretical framework linking initialization and activation to optimization
nodes.approach: Theoretical analysis of the initialization-activation interplay and its effect on optimization
secondary_topics: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.confidence_reason: Thin abstract; neural-field theory with unclear empirical scope
nodes.niche_reason: Neural-field optimization theory is specialised

nodes.title: From Correspondences to Pose: Non-minimal Certifiably Optimal Relative Pose without Disambiguation
nodes.tldr: Estimates globally optimal relative camera pose directly from correspondences as a QCQP, skipping the usual four-candidate cheirality disambiguation step.
nodes.problem: Relative pose estimation normally needs a separate disambiguation stage among four candidate poses.
nodes.approach: Certifiably optimal non-minimal QCQP formulation with constraints that enforce valid 3D geometry.
nodes.niche_reason: Certifiable geometric optimization is specialised but established

nodes.title: From Feature to Gaze: A Generalizable Replacement of Linear Layer for Gaze Estimation
nodes.tldr: Replaces the fully connected layer in gaze estimation with an analytic geodesic projection onto the sphere, improving cross-domain generalization without target data.
nodes.problem: Gaze estimators degrade on unseen domains; fully connected layers overfit when mapping features to 3D gaze.
nodes.approach: Geodesic Projection Module as analytic FC replacement, plus Sphere-Oriented Training.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › Human Pose, Avatars & Faces
secondary_topics: Architectures & Training › Domain Adaptation & OOD Generalization
nodes.niche_reason: Gaze estimation generalization is established but specialised.

nodes.title: From Isolated Islands to Pangea: Unifying Semantic Space for Human Action Understanding
nodes.tldr: Builds a unified verb-based action semantic space aligning image, video, skeleton and MoCap datasets into one database, with a model mapping physical to semantic space.
nodes.problem: Action datasets use incompatible class definitions, preventing joint use for generalizable action understanding.
nodes.approach: Design a hierarchical verb-based semantic space, align datasets to it, and train a physical-to-semantic mapping model.
nodes.niche_reason: Action recognition is established; unified semantic taxonomy across modalities is specialised.

nodes.title: Frozen CLIP: A Strong Backbone for Weakly Supervised Semantic Segmentation
nodes.tldr: Single-stage weakly supervised semantic segmentation using a frozen CLIP backbone, a new decoder, and a refinement module that dynamically rectifies pseudo labels.
nodes.problem: Weakly supervised semantic segmentation with image-level labels without separate pseudo-label and segmentation stages.
nodes.approach: Frozen CLIP as backbone, lightweight decoder, pseudo labels from frozen features refined by a refinement module.
secondary_topics: Computer Vision › Vision Foundation Models & Self-Supervision
nodes.niche_reason: WSSS with CLIP is a common recent direction.

nodes.title: GART: Gaussian Articulated Template Models
nodes.tldr: GART models articulated subjects as moving 3D Gaussians on a template prior, reconstructed from monocular video and rendered in novel poses.
nodes.problem: Capturing and rendering non-rigid articulated subjects from monocular video is hard.
nodes.approach: Mixture of moving 3D Gaussians with learnable forward skinning and latent bones, fit by differentiable rendering.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
secondary_topics: Computer Vision › Human Pose, Avatars & Faces
nodes.niche_reason: Articulated Gaussian reconstruction from monocular video is specialised

nodes.title: GAvatar: Animatable 3D Gaussian Avatars with Implicit Mesh Learning
nodes.tldr: GAvatar generates animatable 3D Gaussian avatars from text prompts, using pose-driven primitives, implicit attribute fields and SDF-based mesh regularization.
nodes.problem: Naive Gaussian splatting produces unstable, low-quality animatable avatars from text.
nodes.approach: Pose-driven Gaussian primitives, implicit fields predicting attributes, and SDF-based implicit mesh learning.
secondary_topics: Computer Vision › Human Pose, Avatars & Faces
nodes.niche_reason: Text-to-avatar Gaussian generation is specialised but active.

nodes.title: GP-NeRF: Generalized Perception NeRF for Context-Aware 3D Scene Understanding
nodes.tldr: Jointly renders radiance and semantic embedding fields with transformers and self-distillation losses, improving segmentation consistency for NeRF-based 3D scene understanding.
nodes.problem: Per-pixel semantic labels in NeRFs ignore context, causing blurry boundaries and inconsistent object segments.
nodes.approach: Transformer-aggregated radiance and semantic fields with semantic and depth-guided self-distillation losses.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: Semantic NeRF with transformer-fused radiance and semantic fields; specialised.

nodes.title: GPS-Gaussian: Generalizable Pixel-wise 3D Gaussian Splatting for Real-time Human Novel View Synthesis
nodes.tldr: GPS-Gaussian renders 2K novel views of humans in real time by regressing Gaussian splatting parameters directly from sparse source views, with no per-subject optimisation.
nodes.problem: Per-subject optimisation makes novel-view synthesis of human characters slow under sparse camera views.
nodes.approach: Pixel-wise Gaussian parameter maps on source views, lifted to 3D with a jointly trained depth estimator.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
secondary_topics: Computer Vision › Human Pose, Avatars & Faces
nodes.niche_reason: generalizable Gaussian splatting is a common direction

nodes.title: GPT4Point: A Unified Framework for Point-Language Understanding and Generation
nodes.tldr: A point-language multimodal LLM for 3D object understanding (captioning, Q&A) and controllable point-cloud generation, trained on a 1M-object annotated dataset.
nodes.problem: MLLMs understand 2D images well but lack unified 3D object understanding and generation.
nodes.approach: Point-text MLLM framework with a Pyramid-XL annotation engine producing multi-granularity captions for Objaverse-XL objects.
nodes.niche_reason: 3D point-language MLLMs are emerging but still specialised.

nodes.title: GS-SLAM: Dense Visual SLAM with 3D Gaussian Splatting
nodes.tldr: GS-SLAM uses 3D Gaussian representation with real-time differentiable splatting for dense RGB-D SLAM, with adaptive Gaussian expansion and coarse-to-fine tracking.
nodes.problem: Neural-implicit SLAM is slow in mapping and rendering.
nodes.approach: 3D Gaussian splatting map with adaptive densification/pruning and coarse-to-fine pose tracking.
secondary_topics: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: Gaussian-splatting SLAM is a very active area.

nodes.title: Gaussian Splatting SLAM
nodes.tldr: First monocular SLAM built on 3D Gaussian Splatting as sole representation, with direct Gaussian-based tracking and geometric regularization, supporting RGB-D and running live at 3fps.
nodes.problem: Monocular visual SLAM needs accurate tracking, mapping and high-quality rendering without offline SfM poses.
nodes.approach: Direct camera tracking optimized against 3D Gaussians, with geometric verification and regularization for incremental dense reconstruction.
secondary_topics: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.confidence_reason: Equally a 3DGS reconstruction paper and a SLAM paper.
nodes.niche_reason: Gaussian splatting SLAM was a crowded, fast-growing direction.

nodes.title: Gaussian-Flow: 4D Reconstruction with Dynamic 3D Gaussian Particle
nodes.tldr: Gaussian-Flow models dynamic scenes with per-Gaussian polynomial and Fourier time deformations, achieving fast 4D reconstruction and real-time rendering from multi-view or monocular video.
nodes.problem: Slow training and rendering of dynamic scene reconstruction
nodes.approach: Dual-domain deformation of 3D Gaussian attributes via polynomial and Fourier fitting
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: Dynamic Gaussian splatting is a crowded area

nodes.title: GaussianAvatars: Photorealistic Head Avatars with Rigged 3D Gaussians
nodes.tldr: GaussianAvatars rigs 3D Gaussian splats to a parametric morphable face model, giving photorealistic head avatars controllable in expression, pose and viewpoint.
nodes.problem: Creating photorealistic, fully controllable head avatars.
nodes.approach: Splats attached to mesh triangle local frames with learned offsets, jointly optimized with morphable model parameters.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › Human Pose, Avatars & Faces
secondary_topics: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: Gaussian head avatars are an active specialised area.

nodes.title: Gear-NeRF: Free-Viewpoint Rendering and Tracking with Motion-aware Spatio-Temporal Sampling
nodes.tldr: Gear-NeRF uses segmentation-derived 4D semantic embeddings to stratify dynamic regions by motion scale, adapting sampling for better dynamic view synthesis and free-viewpoint tracking.
nodes.problem: Dynamic NeRFs lose quality under limited compute and lack semantic understanding.
nodes.approach: Learn spatio-temporal semantic embeddings defining motion-based gears that set per-region sampling resolution.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: Dynamic NeRF is established; motion-stratified sampling is specialised.

nodes.title: General Object Foundation Model for Images and Videos at Scale
nodes.tldr: A single object-level foundation model that detects, segments, tracks, grounds and identifies arbitrary objects in images and videos, zero-shot on new tasks.
nodes.problem: Object perception tasks each need task-specific models; a unified open-world object model is missing.
nodes.approach: Unified image, text and visual-prompt encoders trained on diverse supervision and millions of images.
nodes.niche_reason: Unified detection and segmentation foundation models are crowded

nodes.title: Generalized Large-Scale Data Condensation via Various Backbone and Statistical Matching
nodes.tldr: Dataset condensation that matches statistics across several backbone layers and feature statistics, giving strong accuracy on CIFAR-100, Tiny-ImageNet, and full ImageNet-1k.
nodes.problem: Single-layer local-match-global distillation limits how much information a distilled dataset keeps.
nodes.approach: Generalized matching over various backbone layers and statistics to synthesize a small representative dataset.
nodes.primary_topic: Data, Benchmarks & Evaluation › Synthetic Data & Data Curation
nodes.niche_reason: Established distillation area with a specific matching design

nodes.title: Generalized Predictive Model for Autonomous Driving
nodes.tldr: GenAD is a large-scale latent-diffusion video prediction model for driving, trained on 2000+ hours of web videos, generalizing zero-shot and adaptable to planning.
nodes.problem: Generalizable driving video prediction without costly data collection
nodes.approach: Latent diffusion with temporal reasoning blocks trained on large web driving video dataset
nodes.niche_reason: Driving world models are a popular direction

nodes.title: Generative Powers of Ten
nodes.tldr: Uses joint multi-scale diffusion sampling with a different prompt per scale to generate consistent images across extreme zoom levels, from landscape to insect macro.
nodes.problem: Generating consistent new content across vastly different image scales beyond super-resolution.
nodes.approach: Joint multi-scale diffusion sampling that keeps consistency across scales while preserving each sampling process.
nodes.niche_reason: Extreme semantic zoom generation is a rare, unusual application of diffusion.

nodes.title: Geometrically-driven Aggregation for Zero-shot 3D Point Cloud Understanding
nodes.tldr: Training-free method that aggregates vision-language features across local and global point cloud geometry to improve zero-shot 3D classification and segmentation.
nodes.problem: 2D VLM features mapped to 3D points ignore the point cloud's geometric structure.
nodes.approach: Iterative local-to-global aggregation using geometric and semantic point-level reasoning.
nodes.niche_reason: Training-free VLM transfer to point clouds is specialised but active

nodes.title: GraCo: Granularity-Controllable Interactive Segmentation
nodes.tldr: Lets users control mask granularity in interactive segmentation via an extra input parameter, trained on automatically generated mask-granularity pairs.
nodes.problem: Interactive segmentation has spatial ambiguity and lacks granularity control without costly multi-granularity annotations.
nodes.approach: Any-granularity mask generator creates pseudo-annotations, used to train granularity-controllable interactive segmentation.
nodes.niche_reason: Specialised interactive segmentation setting, moderately explored.

nodes.title: H-ViT: A Hierarchical Vision Transformer for Deformable Image Registration
nodes.tldr: H-ViT is a hierarchical vision transformer for deformable image registration that estimates deformation fields top-down using dual self- and cross-attention across scales.
nodes.problem: Deformable image registration needs short- and long-range flow features at multiple scales.
nodes.approach: Top-down hierarchical transformer where high-level deformation features guide low-level ones via self- and cross-attention.
nodes.niche_reason: Medical registration is an established specialised area.

nodes.title: HHMR: Holistic Hand Mesh Recovery by Enhancing the Multimodal Controllability of Graph Diffusion Models
nodes.tldr: HHMR is an all-in-one graph diffusion model for hand mesh generation, inpainting, reconstruction and fitting via multimodal conditions and condition-aligned gradient guidance.
nodes.problem: Unifying hand mesh generation and recovery tasks in one controllable generative model.
nodes.approach: Graph-convolution-attention diffusion with shared modality feature space, random masking and gradient guidance.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › Human Pose, Avatars & Faces
nodes.niche_reason: Diffusion for hand meshes is specialised.

nodes.title: HOI-M^3: Capture Multiple Humans and Objects Interaction within Contextual Environment
nodes.tldr: A large dataset of 3D tracked multiple humans and objects from RGB and object-mounted IMUs, plus baselines for monocular capture and interaction generation.
nodes.problem: Human-object interaction data covers isolated individuals and objects, lacking multi-human multi-object scenes.
nodes.approach: Dense RGB and object-mounted IMU capture of 199 sequences with 3D human and object tracking, plus two baseline tasks.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › Human Pose, Avatars & Faces
nodes.niche_reason: Multi-human multi-object interaction is a less crowded but established niche.

nodes.title: HOLD: Category-agnostic 3D Reconstruction of Interacting Hands and Objects from Video
nodes.tldr: HOLD reconstructs articulated hands and objects jointly from monocular interaction video without object templates, using a compositional articulated implicit model.
nodes.problem: Category-agnostic 3D reconstruction of hand-object interaction without pre-scanned templates or 3D data.
nodes.approach: Compositional articulated implicit model disentangling hand and object, optimized from monocular video.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
secondary_topics: Computer Vision › Human Pose, Avatars & Faces
nodes.niche_reason: Hand-object reconstruction is an established specialised area.

nodes.title: HandDiff: 3D Hand Pose Estimation with Diffusion on Image-Point Cloud
nodes.tldr: Diffusion-based 3D hand pose estimator that iteratively denoises keypoints conditioned on hand-shaped image-point clouds, with joint-wise and local detail conditions.
nodes.problem: Diffusion models struggle with keypoint permutation mapping and precise hand localization.
nodes.approach: Diffusion denoising of keypoints with joint-wise and local detail conditioning.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › Human Pose, Avatars & Faces
nodes.niche_reason: Diffusion-based hand pose estimation is fairly common.

nodes.title: HashPoint: Accelerated Point Searching and Sampling for Neural Rendering
nodes.tldr: Combines rasterization-based hash-table point search with ray marching and adaptive sampling to speed up ray-tracing-based neural volume rendering at equal accuracy.
nodes.problem: Volume neural rendering trades rendering speed against fidelity between rasterization and ray tracing.
nodes.approach: Rasterized hash-table point search feeding adaptive surface sampling for ray marching.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: Neural rendering acceleration is a crowded area

nodes.title: Honeybee: Locality-enhanced Projector for Multimodal LLM
nodes.tldr: Honeybee is a locality-enhanced visual projector for multimodal LLMs that controls visual token count while preserving local spatial context.
nodes.problem: Visual projectors connecting vision encoders to LLMs are under-explored, yet token count and local detail matter.
nodes.approach: Flexible projector design with locality enhancement, plus strategies for combining multiple instruction datasets.
nodes.niche_reason: Visual projector design for MLLMs is a common, crowded direction.

nodes.title: Hourglass Tokenizer for Efficient Transformer-Based 3D Human Pose Estimation
nodes.tldr: Prunes redundant frame tokens in video pose transformers and recovers full-length tokens, cutting FLOPs by nearly 50% at little accuracy cost.
nodes.problem: Video pose transformers are too computationally expensive for resource-constrained devices.
nodes.approach: Token pruning cluster keeps diverse tokens; token recovering attention restores full temporal resolution.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › Human Pose, Avatars & Faces
secondary_topics: Architectures & Training › Efficient Training, Compression & Pruning
nodes.niche_reason: Efficient video pose transformers are established, though a specialised subfield.

nodes.title: HouseCat6D - A Large-Scale Multi-Modal Category Level 6D Object Perception Dataset with Household Objects in Realistic Scenarios
nodes.tldr: Category-level 6D object pose dataset with polarimetric RGB-D, 194 household objects, precise annotations, scenes, and dense parallel-jaw grasp labels.
nodes.problem: Existing category-level pose datasets have weak annotation quality and limited pose variety.
nodes.approach: Multi-modal capture of household objects with mm-level pose annotation and grasp labels.
nodes.niche_reason: Category-level pose datasets are a moderately common topic.

nodes.title: Human Motion Prediction Under Unexpected Perturbation
nodes.tldr: Introduces predicting human reactive motion under unexpected physical perturbations, including multiple people, with a Latent Differentiable Physics model that is data-efficient and generalizes well.
nodes.problem: Predicting reactive human motions under unexpected perturbations, with data scarcity and complex interactions.
nodes.approach: Latent Differentiable Physics model combining differentiable physics with deep neural networks.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › Human Pose, Avatars & Faces
nodes.niche_reason: Perturbation-driven reactive motion prediction is a new, rare task.

nodes.title: HumanGaussian: Text-Driven 3D Human Generation with Gaussian Splatting
nodes.tldr: HumanGaussian generates 3D humans from text using Gaussian splatting with structure-aware score distillation and annealed negative prompt guidance, giving fast, detailed results.
nodes.problem: Text-to-3D human generation with fine detail and without slow, over-saturated score distillation optimization.
nodes.approach: Gaussian splatting guided by RGB-and-depth structure-aware SDS, annealed negative prompt guidance, and prune-only cleanup phase.
secondary_topics: Computer Vision › Human Pose, Avatars & Faces
nodes.niche_reason: Text-to-3D with SDS and splatting is a crowded area.

nodes.title: HybridNeRF: Efficient Neural Rendering via Adaptive Volumetric Surfaces
nodes.tldr: HybridNeRF renders most of a scene as surfaces and only difficult regions volumetrically, achieving real-time VR-resolution view synthesis with 15-30% lower error.
nodes.problem: Volumetric NeRF rendering is slow while pure surface representations fail on thin or semi-opaque structures.
nodes.approach: Adaptive hybrid of surface and volume rendering with per-region selection.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: NeRF acceleration is a common topic.

nodes.title: IPoD: Implicit Field Learning with Point Diffusion for Generalizable 3D Object Reconstruction from Single RGB-D Images
nodes.tldr: IPoD treats implicit-field query points as a noisy point cloud denoised by diffusion, adaptively concentrating queries on the object for single RGB-D view 3D reconstruction.
nodes.problem: Generalizable 3D object reconstruction from single-view RGB-D requires dense uniform query supervision.
nodes.approach: Joint implicit field learning and point diffusion with self-conditioning from implicit predictions.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: Specialised diffusion plus implicit field reconstruction.

nodes.title: IS-Fusion: Instance-Scene Collaborative Fusion for Multimodal 3D Object Detection
nodes.tldr: IS-Fusion fuses LiDAR and camera features at scene and instance level in BEV with hierarchical and instance-guided fusion, topping nuScenes multimodal 3D detection.
nodes.problem: Small, sparse objects in BEV make reliable multimodal 3D detection hard when fusing only at scene level.
nodes.approach: Hierarchical Scene Fusion transformers plus Instance-Guided Fusion to produce instance-aware BEV features.
nodes.niche_reason: BEV 3D detection fusion is a common driving topic.

nodes.title: Image Neural Field Diffusion Models
nodes.tldr: Trains diffusion models on image neural fields renderable at any resolution, enabling mixed-resolution training and multi-scale inverse problems by converting latent autoencoders.
nodes.problem: Most diffusion models learn fixed-resolution images rather than continuous images.
nodes.approach: Photorealistic image neural field latent autoencoders with diffusion trained on mixed-resolution datasets.
nodes.niche_reason: Continuous image representations for diffusion are established but specialised.

nodes.title: ImageNet-D: Benchmarking Neural Network Robustness on Diffusion Synthetic Object
nodes.tldr: ImageNet-D uses diffusion models to synthesize hard objects with diverse backgrounds, textures and materials, dropping accuracy of classifiers, CLIP and MiniGPT-4 by up to 60%.
nodes.problem: Existing robustness benchmarks have limited variation and low synthetic quality.
nodes.approach: Generate challenging test images with diffusion models to benchmark vision model robustness.
nodes.confidence_reason: Benchmark spans robustness and synthetic data; topic is a judgment call.
nodes.niche_reason: Robustness benchmarks exist widely; diffusion-sourced hard sets are less common.

nodes.title: Implicit Event-RGBD Neural SLAM
nodes.tldr: EN-SLAM is the first event-RGBD implicit neural SLAM, using a shared radiance field with differentiable camera response function rendering for robust tracking and mapping.
nodes.problem: Implicit neural SLAM fails under motion blur and lighting variation.
nodes.approach: Shared radiance field with differentiable CRF rendering for event and RGB data plus temporal aggregating optimization.
secondary_topics: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: Event-camera neural SLAM is a rare sensing modality.

nodes.title: Improved Baselines with Visual Instruction Tuning
nodes.tldr: LLaVA-1.5 shows that an MLP vision-language connector, CLIP-ViT-L-336px and academic VQA data give state-of-the-art open multimodal models trained cheaply on 1.2M public samples.
nodes.problem: Understanding design choices that make large multimodal models strong and data-efficient.
nodes.approach: Systematic controlled study of LLaVA with MLP projector, higher resolution encoder, and VQA data.
nodes.niche_reason: Very crowded mainstream multimodal LLM space.

nodes.title: In-Context Matting
nodes.tldr: Introduces in-context matting, which predicts alpha mattes for a batch of images from one reference image and a guided prior, without extra per-image input.
nodes.problem: Auxiliary-input matting needs per-image guidance, while automatic matting is less accurate.
nodes.approach: IconMatting: diffusion-based model matching inter- and intra-image similarity to the reference.
nodes.confidence_reason: Matting sits between segmentation and low-level vision.
nodes.niche_reason: Matting is established; in-context reference matting is a specialised twist.

nodes.title: Insect-Foundation: A Foundation Model and Large-scale 1M Dataset for Visual Insect Understanding
nodes.tldr: Introduces Insect-1M, a million-image taxonomy-labeled insect dataset, and a self-supervised insect foundation model using patch-wise relevant attention and description consistency loss.
nodes.problem: No existing insect dataset covers enough species to train foundation models for agriculture-oriented insect recognition.
nodes.approach: Large insect dataset with taxonomy and descriptions plus micro-feature self-supervised learning with patch-wise relevant attention.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › Vision Foundation Models & Self-Supervision
nodes.niche_reason: Insect foundation models for entomology are a very rare niche.

nodes.title: Investigating Compositional Challenges in Vision-Language Models for Visual Grounding
nodes.tldr: A benchmark showing vision-language models perform well on standard grounding yet fail at attribute, relation and priority compositional reasoning, plus a fine-tuning fix.
nodes.problem: VLMs look strong on grounding benchmarks but may lack compositional understanding of attributes and relations.
nodes.approach: ARPGrounding benchmark of 11,425 samples plus composition-aware fine-tuning using cheap image-text annotations.
nodes.niche_reason: VLM compositionality benchmarks are a common topic

nodes.title: Jack of All Tasks Master of Many: Designing General-Purpose Coarse-to-Fine Vision-Language Model
nodes.tldr: Unified instruction-tuned LLM that handles coarse and fine vision-language tasks, including segmentation and multi-image inputs, through an instruction-guided tokenizer.
nodes.problem: General-purpose vision LLMs struggle to combine segmentation and multi-image inputs with coarse tasks.
nodes.approach: Instruction-guided image tokenizer with gradient-aware adaptive mask sampling, trained on a curated 6.8M-sample dataset.
nodes.niche_reason: General-purpose vision LLMs are fairly common.

nodes.title: Koala: Key Frame-Conditioned Long Video-LLM
nodes.tldr: Koala adds learnable spatiotemporal queries and key-frame-conditioned tokenizers to pretrained video LLMs so they understand minutes-long videos, improving zero-shot long video QA.
nodes.problem: Video LLMs trained on short clips fail to understand minutes-long videos.
nodes.approach: Two tokenizers conditioned on sparse key-frame visual tokens with learnable spatiotemporal queries.
nodes.niche_reason: Video LLM adaptations for long video are common.

nodes.title: LORS: Low-rank Residual Structure for Parameter-Efficient Network Stacking
nodes.tldr: Shares most parameters across stacked modules with a low-rank residual per module, matching detector decoder performance with 70% fewer decoder parameters.
nodes.problem: Deep stacks of identical modules inflate parameter counts and hinder practical deployment.
nodes.approach: Low-rank residual structure lets stacked modules share parameters while keeping a few unique ones.
nodes.primary_topic: Architectures & Training › Efficient Training, Compression & Pruning
nodes.niche_reason: parameter sharing in stacked transformers is a common efficiency idea

nodes.title: LUWA Dataset: Learning Lithic Use-Wear Analysis on Microscopic Images
nodes.tldr: Releases a 23,130-image microscopy dataset for classifying worked materials in lithic use-wear, showing pretrained models beat experts but leave gaps.
nodes.problem: Identifying worked material from lithic microscopic images is hard and lacks open, large datasets.
nodes.approach: Benchmarks pretrained vision models like DINOv2 with few-shot learning across magnifications and sensing modalities.
nodes.niche_reason: Archaeological use-wear microscopy vision is a very rare application area.

nodes.title: LangSplat: 3D Language Gaussian Splatting
nodes.tldr: LangSplat encodes CLIP language features, compressed by an autoencoder with SAM hierarchies, into 3D Gaussians for open-vocabulary 3D queries, 199x faster than LERF.
nodes.problem: Open-vocabulary language querying in 3D scenes is slow and imprecise with NeRF-based language fields.
nodes.approach: 3D Gaussians encode compressed CLIP features, with SAM-derived hierarchical semantics and tile-based splatting rendering.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: Popular splatting area with a specialised language-field angle.

nodes.title: Latent Modulated Function for Computational Optimal Continuous Image Representation
nodes.tldr: LMF decouples arbitrary-scale super-resolution decoding into shared latent modulation and cheap low-dimensional rendering, cutting computation sharply.
nodes.problem: Implicit neural image representations decode in high-resolution high-dimensional space, causing quadratic computational cost.
nodes.approach: HD latent MLP produces per-feature modulations for an LD render MLP, plus controllable multi-scale rendering by complexity.
nodes.niche_reason: Efficient implicit decoders for arbitrary-scale SR are a specialised niche.

nodes.title: LeGO: Leveraging a Surface Deformation Network for Animatable Stylized Face Generation with One Example
nodes.tldr: LeGO stylizes 3DMM-based face meshes toward an exemplar style using a surface deformation network trained with CLIP losses.
nodes.problem: Existing 3D face stylization is limited by statistical 3DMM variation and weak stylization degree.
nodes.approach: Surface deformation network trained with differentiable rendering, directional CLIP losses, and a mesh agnostic encoder.
secondary_topics: Computer Vision › Human Pose, Avatars & Faces
nodes.confidence_reason: 3D generation vs avatar/face topic overlap
nodes.niche_reason: Specialised stylized face generation with fixed topology

nodes.title: Learning Adaptive Spatial Coherent Correlations for Speech-Preserving Facial Expression Manipulation
nodes.tldr: Introduces adaptive spatial coherent correlation learning for speech-preserving facial expression manipulation, using correlated local facial animation across emotions as supervision without paired samples.
nodes.problem: Changing facial emotion while preserving mouth motion needs unavailable paired training samples.
nodes.approach: Learn a spatial coherent correlation metric with disparity-aware adaptive weighting as an additional loss.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › Human Pose, Avatars & Faces
nodes.confidence_reason: Primary topic judgment between face manipulation and image generation categories.
nodes.niche_reason: Speech-preserving expression manipulation is a rare face-editing niche.

nodes.title: Learning Diffusion Texture Priors for Image Restoration
nodes.tldr: Pretrains a diffusion texture prior on high-quality images, then adapts it to restoration tasks with conditional guidance adapters and an initial predictor.
nodes.problem: Diffusion restoration loses fidelity and background structure due to sampling randomness.
nodes.approach: Frozen texture-focused diffusion backbone with trainable guidance adapters and an initial regression predictor.
nodes.niche_reason: Diffusion priors for restoration are established but specialised

nodes.title: Learning without Exact Guidance: Updating Large-scale High-resolution Land Cover Maps from Low-resolution Historical Labels
nodes.tldr: Paraformer updates high-resolution land-cover maps using low-resolution historical labels, with a parallel CNN-Transformer extractor and pseudo-label-assisted training for weak supervision.
nodes.problem: High-resolution land-cover mapping lacks accurate training labels over large geographic areas.
nodes.approach: Parallel CNN-Transformer features plus pseudo-label-assisted refinement of low-resolution labels for weakly supervised segmentation.
nodes.niche_reason: Established remote sensing subfield with specialised weak-label setup.

nodes.title: LiSA: LiDAR Localization with Semantic Awareness
nodes.tldr: Distills a segmentation model into scene coordinate regression so LiDAR localization ignores dynamic and repetitive structures without extra inference cost.
nodes.problem: LiDAR scene coordinate regression treats dynamic and repetitive points equally, hurting localization accuracy.
nodes.approach: Knowledge distillation of semantic segmentation features into an SCR network.
nodes.niche_reason: Established LiDAR localization line with a semantic distillation twist

nodes.title: LidaRF: Delving into Lidar for Neural Radiance Field on Street Scenes
nodes.tldr: LidaRF improves NeRF on street scenes by fusing Lidar geometry features, occlusion-aware depth supervision from densified Lidar, and Lidar-based augmented views.
nodes.problem: NeRF quality degrades on street scenes with collinear camera motion and sparse sampling.
nodes.approach: Lidar geometric representation fused with grid features, robust depth supervision, and augmented views.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: NeRF for driving scenes is a common variant.

nodes.title: LiveHPS: LiDAR-based Scene-level Human Pose and Shape Estimation in Free Environment
nodes.tldr: LiveHPS estimates scene-level 3D human pose and shape from a single LiDAR using distillation and temporal-spatial cues, and releases the FreeMotion multimodal motion dataset.
nodes.problem: Estimating global human pose and shape in large scenes from LiDAR despite varying point distributions and occlusion.
nodes.approach: Distillation to handle point cloud variation plus temporal-spatial geometric modeling; new multi-sensor FreeMotion dataset.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › Human Pose, Avatars & Faces
nodes.niche_reason: LiDAR-only human mesh recovery is an uncommon modality.

nodes.title: Living Scenes: Multi-object Relocalization and Reconstruction in Changing 3D Environments
nodes.tldr: Relocalizes and reconstructs object instances across scans taken at different times, using an SE(3)-equivariant encoder-decoder for matching, registration and reconstruction.
nodes.problem: Long-term changes in 3D scenes from sparse scans are understudied compared with dense short-term tracking.
nodes.approach: Single SE(3)-equivariant network for instance matching and registration, plus joint point-cloud accumulation optimization.
secondary_topics: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: Long-term object relocalization in changing scenes is specialised

nodes.title: LocLLM: Exploiting Generalizable Human Keypoint Localization via Large Language Model
nodes.tldr: LocLLM localizes keypoints from an image and text instructions with an LLM, generalizing to keypoint types unseen in training.
nodes.problem: Keypoint localization models are limited to keypoint types provided by training data.
nodes.approach: LLM reasons over image and text clues on keypoint type and relation, with parameter-efficient instruction tuning.
secondary_topics: Computer Vision › Human Pose, Avatars & Faces
nodes.niche_reason: LLM-driven keypoint localization is specialised but emerging.

nodes.title: Logit Standardization in Knowledge Distillation
nodes.tldr: Applies Z-score standardization to teacher and student logits before softmax in distillation, removing the shared-temperature assumption and improving many logit-based distillation methods.
nodes.problem: Shared-temperature knowledge distillation forces teacher and student logit magnitudes to match.
nodes.approach: Plug-and-play logit standardization with temperature set to weighted logit standard deviation.
nodes.primary_topic: Architectures & Training › Efficient Training, Compression & Pruning
nodes.niche_reason: Knowledge distillation variants are common.

nodes.title: Look-Up Table Compression for Efficient Image Restoration
nodes.tldr: Compresses look-up tables for fast image restoration with a diagonal-first scheme that keeps diagonal entries and subsamples the rest, saving up to 90% storage.
nodes.problem: Storage growth of multiple LUTs limits LUT-based image restoration on devices.
nodes.approach: Diagonal-First Compression preserving and re-indexing diagonal LQ-HQ pairs while aggressively subsampling non-diagonal pairs.
secondary_topics: Architectures & Training › Efficient Training, Compression & Pruning
nodes.niche_reason: LUT-based restoration is an uncommon efficiency niche.

nodes.title: Lookahead Exploration with Neural Radiance Representation for Continuous Vision-Language Navigation
nodes.tldr: Predicts semantic neural radiance features of future views to evaluate candidate moves, letting a VLN agent plan over a navigable future path tree.
nodes.problem: Lookahead VLN planning with RGB future prediction is distorted and costly.
nodes.approach: Pre-trained hierarchical neural radiance representation producing multi-level semantic features for parallel path evaluation.
secondary_topics: Audio, Speech & Multimodal › Embodied Multimodal Agents
nodes.niche_reason: VLN lookahead with radiance representations is specialised.

nodes.title: LucidDreamer: Towards High-Fidelity Text-to-3D Generation via Interval Score Matching
nodes.tldr: Replaces score distillation with interval score matching on deterministic diffusion trajectories to reduce over-smoothing in text-to-3D generation with Gaussian splatting.
nodes.problem: Score distillation sampling yields inconsistent updates and over-smoothed, low-quality text-to-3D models.
nodes.approach: Deterministic diffusion trajectories with interval-based score matching, combined with 3D Gaussian Splatting.
secondary_topics: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: Text-to-3D with score distillation is a crowded area

nodes.title: M&M VTO: Multi-Garment Virtual Try-On and Editing
nodes.tldr: M&M VTO is a single-stage diffusion transformer for multi-garment virtual try-on with text-controlled layout and tiny per-person finetuning for identity preservation.
nodes.problem: Virtual try-on struggles with mixing multiple garments, layout control, and preserving person identity.
nodes.approach: Single-stage VTO UNet diffusion transformer disentangling person features, plus PaLI-3 finetuned text layout control.
nodes.niche_reason: Virtual try-on is an established but specialised application of diffusion.

nodes.title: MCD: Diverse Large-Scale Multi-Campus Dataset for Robot Perception
nodes.tldr: Introduces a multi-sensor robot perception dataset from three campuses with lidar, IMU, camera, and UWB, plus semantic labels and survey-grade ground truth.
nodes.problem: Robot perception datasets skew to driving and SLAM datasets lack environment and domain variation.
nodes.approach: Multi-sensor recordings across three campuses with survey-grade lidar-inertial ground truth and 29-class lidar labels.
nodes.niche_reason: Multi-campus dataset with non-repetitive lidar is a less common resource

nodes.title: MIGC: Multi-Instance Generation Controller for Text-to-Image Synthesis
nodes.tldr: MIGC enables multi-instance text-to-image generation by splitting it into per-instance subtasks with an instance enhancement attention, then aggregating into Stable Diffusion, with a COCO-MIG benchmark.
nodes.problem: Generating multiple instances at specified locations with correct attributes in one image.
nodes.approach: Divide-and-conquer instance shading with enhancement attention aggregated into Stable Diffusion.
nodes.niche_reason: Layout-controlled diffusion generation is a common topic.

nodes.title: MM-Narrator: Narrating Long-form Videos with Multimodal In-Context Learning
nodes.tldr: Generates audio descriptions for hours-long videos using GPT-4 multimodal in-context learning with memory-based register-and-recall context.
nodes.problem: Producing coherent audio descriptions for very long videos beyond short clips.
nodes.approach: Training-free multimodal in-context learning with memory augmentation and complexity-based demonstration selection.
nodes.confidence_reason: Narration vs video understanding overlap; topic judgment call
nodes.niche_reason: Niche application, but LLM-based multimodal ICL is crowded

nodes.title: MMM: Generative Masked Motion Model
nodes.tldr: MMM tokenizes 3D human motion and trains a conditional masked transformer for text-to-motion, giving parallel fast decoding, high fidelity, and built-in editing such as in-betweening.
nodes.problem: Text-to-motion models trade off real-time speed, fidelity, and editability.
nodes.approach: Motion tokenizer plus masked motion transformer conditioned on text tokens, with parallel iterative decoding.
secondary_topics: Computer Vision › Human Pose, Avatars & Faces
nodes.niche_reason: Established text-to-motion niche within generative modeling.

nodes.title: MMSum: A Dataset for Multimodal Summarization and Thumbnail Generation of Videos
nodes.tldr: MMSum is a human-validated dataset of videos with summaries across 17 categories and 170 subcategories for multimodal summarization and thumbnail generation, with benchmarks.
nodes.problem: Existing multimodal summarization datasets are small, inaccessible, and poorly categorized.
nodes.approach: Curate a large categorized dataset with human-validated video and text summaries and baseline benchmarks.
nodes.niche_reason: Multimodal summarization with thumbnail output is an uncommon task.

nodes.title: MTLoRA: Low-Rank Adaptation Approach for Efficient Multi-Task Learning
nodes.tldr: MTLoRA uses task-agnostic and task-specific low-rank adapters to fine-tune multi-task vision transformers, cutting trainable parameters 3.6x with higher accuracy.
nodes.problem: Parameter-efficient tuning was studied for single tasks, not multi-task dense prediction models.
nodes.approach: Shared task-agnostic and per-task low-rank adaptation modules that disentangle parameters in multi-task fine-tuning.
secondary_topics: Computer Vision › Vision Foundation Models & Self-Supervision
nodes.confidence_reason: PEFT for dense vision multi-task learning straddles two topics.
nodes.niche_reason: LoRA variants are common; multi-task dense prediction is less so.

nodes.title: MVBench: A Comprehensive Multi-modal Video Understanding Benchmark
nodes.tldr: Presents MVBench, 20 video tasks that need temporal understanding, converts annotations to multiple-choice QA, and a VideoChat2 baseline beating leading MLLMs by over 15%.
nodes.problem: Multimodal LLM benchmarks mostly test static images, not temporal understanding in video.
nodes.approach: Static-to-dynamic task conversion and automatic video annotation to multiple-choice QA.
nodes.niche_reason: Video-MLLM benchmarks are a common, crowded evaluation type

nodes.title: Map-Relative Pose Regression for Visual Re-Localization
nodes.tldr: Conditions a pose regressor on a scene map so predicted poses are map-relative, trained across hundreds of scenes for fast adaptation.
nodes.problem: Absolute pose regression needs vast per-scene training data that is slow to generate for each new scene.
nodes.approach: Scene-map conditioned regressor trained scene-agnostically, with optional minutes of fine-tuning.
nodes.niche_reason: Map-relative pose regression is a specialised relocalization niche

nodes.title: Masked Autoencoders for Microscopy are Scalable Learners of Cellular Biology
nodes.tldr: Shows masked autoencoders scale better than weakly supervised classifiers on microscopy, and adds a channel-agnostic architecture that generalizes to unseen channel layouts.
nodes.problem: Featurizing large-scale microscopy images for biology is hard, and scaling behavior is poorly understood.
nodes.approach: Scale ViT masked autoencoders versus weakly supervised classifiers, and add channel-agnostic input handling.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › Vision Foundation Models & Self-Supervision
nodes.niche_reason: Microscopy foundation models are specialized but growing

nodes.title: Matching Anything by Segmenting Anything
nodes.tldr: Learns instance association from unlabeled static images by matching SAM regions, plus an adapter letting any segmenter or detector track objects zero-shot.
nodes.problem: Cross-domain object tracking depends on labeled domain-specific video datasets.
nodes.approach: Image-only instance matching over SAM proposals with data transformations, and a universal MASA adapter.
secondary_topics: Computer Vision › Vision Foundation Models & Self-Supervision
nodes.niche_reason: Foundation-model tracking is a crowded, active direction

nodes.title: MeLFusion: Synthesizing Music from Image and Language Cues using Diffusion Models
nodes.tldr: MeLFusion is a text-to-music diffusion model with a visual synapse that injects image semantics into music generation, introducing the MeLBench dataset and IMSM metric.
nodes.problem: Music synthesis is mostly text-conditioned and ignores visual cues like images.
nodes.approach: Text-to-music diffusion with a visual synapse infusing image semantics, plus new dataset and metric.
nodes.primary_topic: Generative Models › Audio, Speech & Music Generation
secondary_topics: Audio, Speech & Multimodal › Audio-Visual & Cross-modal Learning
nodes.niche_reason: Image-conditioned music generation is a rare cross-modal niche.

nodes.title: MemoNav: Working Memory Model for Visual Navigation
nodes.tldr: MemoNav is a working-memory-inspired image-goal navigation model with short-term, long-term and working memory over a topological map using forgetting and graph attention.
nodes.problem: Inefficient image-goal navigation from using all historical observations regardless of relevance.
nodes.approach: Short-term memory with forgetting, long-term global memory, and graph attention producing goal-relevant working memory.
secondary_topics: Audio, Speech & Multimodal › Embodied Multimodal Agents
nodes.niche_reason: Established embodied navigation with a cognitively inspired memory design.

nodes.title: MeshGPT: Generating Triangle Meshes with Decoder-Only Transformers
