nodes.tldr: Generates compact artist-style triangle meshes by autoregressively predicting sequences of learned quantized geometric tokens with a decoder-only transformer.
nodes.problem: Neural-field iso-surfacing yields dense triangle meshes unlike compact, sharp-edged artist-created meshes.
nodes.approach: Graph-convolutional VQ vocabulary of triangle embeddings, decoded into triangles and modelled by a transformer over tokens.
nodes.niche_reason: Mesh generation is a specialised 3D generative niche

nodes.title: MicroCinema: A Divide-and-Conquer Approach for Text-to-Video Generation
nodes.tldr: MicroCinema splits text-to-video into text-to-image then image-and-text-to-video, using an Appearance Injection Network and Appearance Noise Prior to focus on motion and preserve 2D diffusion priors.
nodes.problem: Generating high-quality, coherent text-to-video where appearance and motion learning compete.
nodes.approach: Two-stage divide-and-conquer with appearance injection network and appearance noise prior on pre-trained diffusion.
nodes.niche_reason: Text-to-video diffusion is very crowded.

nodes.title: MindBridge: A Cross-Subject Brain Decoding Framework
nodes.tldr: Decodes images from fMRI across subjects with a single model, using cyclic fMRI reconstruction for subject-invariant representations and reset-tuning for new subjects.
nodes.problem: Brain decoding models are trained per subject, so they do not transfer across people.
nodes.approach: Biologically inspired aggregation for variable input sizes, cyclic fMRI reconstruction, reset-tuning.
nodes.niche_reason: Cross-subject fMRI decoding is a rare niche.

nodes.title: MirageRoom: 3D Scene Segmentation with 2D Pre-trained Models by Mirage Projection
nodes.tldr: MirageRoom projects indoor point clouds to 2D images using mirage-like parametric projection through a heterogeneous medium to reduce occlusion, leveraging pretrained 2D models for 3D scene segmentation.
nodes.problem: 3D-to-2D projection for point cloud segmentation suffers from occlusion and incoherence.
nodes.approach: Parametric mirage projection with distorted rays plus masked reprojection bridging 2D and 3D features.
nodes.niche_reason: Mirage-inspired non-straight-ray projection is an unusual idea.

nodes.title: Mitigating Object Hallucinations in Large Vision-Language Models through Visual Contrastive Decoding
nodes.tldr: Training-free visual contrastive decoding reduces object hallucinations in large vision-language models by contrasting outputs from original and distorted images.
nodes.problem: Object hallucinations in LVLMs produce plausible but nonexistent objects.
nodes.approach: Contrast output distributions from original and distorted visual inputs at decoding time.
secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › Knowledge Editing & Factuality
nodes.niche_reason: Hallucination mitigation for LVLMs is a crowded area

nodes.title: Modality-Agnostic Structural Image Representation Learning for Deformable Multi-Modality Medical Image Registration
nodes.tldr: Learns modality-agnostic structural image representations with self-similarity and anatomy-aware contrastive learning, improving CT-MR and T1w-T2w registration.
nodes.problem: Multi-modality medical registration relies on noise-sensitive or non-discriminative similarity measures.
nodes.approach: Deep neighbourhood self-similarity plus contrastive training, with no anatomy labels or pre-aligned images.
nodes.niche_reason: Structural representation learning for multimodal registration is specialised.

nodes.title: Monkey: Image Resolution and Text Label Are Important Things for Large Multi-modal Models
nodes.tldr: Monkey lets large multimodal models handle 1344x896 inputs by splitting images into patches with per-patch adapters, plus multi-level captions for richer training data.
nodes.problem: LMMs struggle with high-resolution input and detailed scene understanding.
nodes.approach: Uniform patch tiling matched to the encoder's training resolution, with multi-level description generation.
nodes.niche_reason: Resolution scaling for LMMs is a crowded mainstream direction

nodes.title: MonoNPHM: Dynamic Head Reconstruction from Monocular Videos
nodes.tldr: Reconstructs dynamic 3D heads from monocular RGB video by fitting a neural parametric head model with a texture field and landmark-based deformation.
nodes.problem: Dynamic 3D head reconstruction from monocular video with expression-dependent geometry and color is hard.
nodes.approach: Latent appearance space on a neural parametric head model, with volumetric SDF rendering and landmark losses.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › Human Pose, Avatars & Faces
secondary_topics: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: Parametric face models are established; monocular dynamic head fitting is specialised.

nodes.title: Move as You Say Interact as You Can: Language-guided Human Motion Generation with Scene Affordance
nodes.tldr: Generates language-guided human motion in 3D scenes via a two-stage method: a diffusion model predicts scene affordance maps, then an affordance-to-motion diffusion model produces motion.
nodes.problem: Generating language-guided motion in 3D scenes is hard with limited language-scene-motion data.
nodes.approach: Scene affordance maps as an intermediate representation linking 3D scene grounding to conditional motion diffusion.
secondary_topics: Computer Vision › Human Pose, Avatars & Faces
nodes.confidence_reason: Could be human motion generation or pose; scene-grounded motion is a judgment call.
nodes.niche_reason: Language-guided 3D scene motion generation is specialised.

nodes.title: Mudslide: A Universal Nuclear Instance Segmentation Method
nodes.tldr: Mudslide segments overlapping nuclei in pathology images by assigning pixels collapse forces from a collapse field, working under both full and point supervision.
nodes.problem: Segmenting densely overlapping nuclei with costly mask annotations in pathology images.
nodes.approach: Collapse field producing force maps and initial boundaries; pixels collapse along force directions into instances.
nodes.niche_reason: Histopathology nuclei segmentation with physics-inspired formulation is niche.

nodes.title: Multi-Scale Video Anomaly Detection by Multi-Grained Spatio-Temporal Representation Learning
nodes.tldr: Multi-grained spatio-temporal self-supervised proxy tasks detect small-scale video anomalies better, using contrastive missing-frame estimation.
nodes.problem: Video anomaly detectors miss small-scale anomalies hidden in localized regions and background noise.
nodes.approach: Continuity judgment, discontinuity localization and contrastive missing-frame estimation at coarse and fine levels.
nodes.niche_reason: Video anomaly detection is established but specialised

nodes.title: Multi-agent Long-term 3D Human Pose Forecasting via Interaction-aware Trajectory Conditioning
nodes.tldr: Forecasts long-term multi-agent 3D human poses by first predicting multimodal global trajectories, then local poses conditioned on each, with graph-based agent interactions.
nodes.problem: Long-term multi-agent pose forecasting struggles with multimodal motion and complex interactions.
nodes.approach: Coarse-to-fine trajectory-conditioned pose forecasting with a graph-based interaction module.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › Human Pose, Avatars & Faces
nodes.niche_reason: Long-horizon multi-agent pose forecasting is specialised but established.

nodes.title: Multi-modal Instruction Tuned LLMs with Fine-grained Visual Perception
nodes.tldr: A multimodal LLM that grounds pixel-wise masks and descriptions from text, box, image or audio references, using attention-based refocusing.
nodes.problem: MLLMs lack fine-grained pixel-level perception and interaction beyond text and region prompts.
nodes.approach: Attention-score refocusing guides grounding toward the referenced object, adding implicit pixel supervision with no extra compute.
nodes.niche_reason: Grounded multimodal LLMs are a crowded, active area

nodes.title: Multi-view Aggregation Network for Dichotomous Image Segmentation
nodes.tldr: Segments high-resolution dichotomous objects with one encoder-decoder that fuses distant and close-up views, mimicking human multi-view perception.
nodes.problem: Dichotomous segmentation balances global localization against fine detail in high-resolution images
nodes.approach: Single-stream multi-view aggregation with complementary localization and refinement modules
nodes.niche_reason: Established but specialised: dichotomous segmentation is a niche task

nodes.title: MuseChat: A Conversational Music Recommendation System for Videos
nodes.tldr: MuseChat is a dialogue-based music recommender for videos that retrieves matching tracks and uses a multimodal LLM to explain choices, with a new conversational dataset.
nodes.problem: Video music recommendation ignores user preferences and lacks interactivity and explanation.
nodes.approach: Retrieval module plus Vicuna-based multimodal reasoning module, trained on a new simulated two-turn dialogue dataset.
nodes.primary_topic: Audio, Speech & Multimodal › Audio-Visual & Cross-modal Learning
secondary_topics: Audio, Speech & Multimodal › Audio & Music Understanding
nodes.niche_reason: Conversational music recommendation for video is a rare application.

nodes.title: NC-TTT: A Noise Constrastive Approach for Test-Time Training
nodes.tldr: NC-TTT adapts models at test time using an unsupervised noise-contrastive auxiliary task that discriminates noisy feature maps, recovering accuracy under domain shift.
nodes.problem: Deep vision models degrade under test-time domain shift without labels.
nodes.approach: Auxiliary objective classifying noisy views of projected feature maps, optimized at test time to adapt the model.
nodes.primary_topic: Architectures & Training › Domain Adaptation & OOD Generalization
nodes.niche_reason: Test-time adaptation is a common research area.

nodes.title: NRDF: Neural Riemannian Distance Fields for Learning Articulated Pose Priors
nodes.tldr: Learns a neural Riemannian distance field over joint rotations from positive poses only, usable as a plausible-pose prior.
nodes.problem: Modeling the space of plausible articulated poses without negative training examples.
nodes.approach: Zero-level-set neural field on product quaternion space with geodesic-distance sampling.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › Human Pose, Avatars & Faces
nodes.confidence_reason: Pose prior sits between pose estimation and manifold-based generative modeling.
nodes.niche_reason: Riemannian product-quaternion pose priors are unusual.

nodes.title: Navigate Beyond Shortcuts: Debiased Learning Through the Lens of Neural Collapse
nodes.tldr: Uses neural-collapse-based shortcut primes to stop biased models from learning spurious shortcuts early, improving generalization on biased datasets without extra training cost.
nodes.problem: Models trained on imbalanced attributes take shortcuts early and form biased, non-collapsed feature spaces that generalize poorly.
nodes.approach: Prime training with neural-collapse-structured shortcut primes encourages models to skip simple shortcuts and learn intrinsic correlations.
nodes.primary_topic: Architectures & Training › Domain Adaptation & OOD Generalization
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Deep Learning Theory
nodes.confidence_reason: Shortcut-bias problem spans OOD generalization, fairness and theory.
nodes.niche_reason: Neural collapse for debiasing is a specialised intersection of two topics.

nodes.title: NeISF: Neural Incident Stokes Field for Geometry and Material Estimation
nodes.tldr: Uses polarization cues in a differentiable polarimetric renderer to recover geometry and materials under multi-bounce inter-reflections.
nodes.problem: Multi-view inverse rendering assumes single light bounce and fails on inter-reflections.
nodes.approach: Neural incident Stokes field modeling accumulated polarization of multi-bounced light.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.confidence_reason: Polarization-based inverse rendering straddles 3D reconstruction and physics.
nodes.niche_reason: Polarization cues for inverse rendering are unusual.

nodes.title: NeuRAD: Neural Rendering for Autonomous Driving
nodes.tldr: NeuRAD is a NeRF-based novel view synthesis method for dynamic driving data with camera and lidar sensor modeling, working across five datasets for closed-loop simulation.
nodes.problem: Existing NeRF methods for autonomous driving need long training, dense supervision, or lack generalizability.
nodes.approach: Simple network with sensor modeling of rolling shutter, beam divergence and ray dropping for camera and lidar.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: NeRF for driving simulation is established but specialised.

nodes.title: Neural Directional Encoding for Efficient and Accurate View-Dependent Appearance Modeling
nodes.tldr: Neural Directional Encoding transfers feature-grid encoding to the angular domain with cone-traced spatial features, improving NeRF view synthesis of specular objects with real-time small networks.
nodes.problem: NeRFs poorly model high-frequency view-dependent appearance and interreflections of glossy objects.
nodes.approach: Spatially varying directional feature-grid encoding using cone-traced spatial features.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: NeRF appearance modeling is established but specialised.

nodes.title: No Time to Train: Empowering Non-Parametric Networks for Few-shot 3D Scene Segmentation
nodes.tldr: Seg-NN is a training-free non-parametric network using hand-crafted filters for few-shot 3D segmentation; Seg-PN adds a light query-support module and cuts training time by 90%.
nodes.problem: Pretraining for few-shot 3D segmentation is costly and creates a domain gap to unseen classes.
nodes.approach: Non-parametric dense feature extraction with hand-crafted filters plus a lightweight query-support transfer module.
nodes.niche_reason: Training-free non-parametric point cloud methods are a specialised niche.

nodes.title: Novel Class Discovery for Ultra-Fine-Grained Visual Categorization
nodes.tldr: Introduces ultra-fine-grained novel class discovery and RAPL, using channel-wise region alignment and proxy-guided semi-supervised learning to discover new subcategories such as soybean cultivars.
nodes.problem: Discovering new ultra-fine-grained categories with small inter-class and large intra-class variation.
nodes.approach: Channel-wise region alignment plus semi-supervised proxy learning with proxy-guided supervised and contrastive losses.
nodes.niche_reason: Ultra-fine-grained class discovery is a rare niche task.

nodes.title: ODIN: A Single Model for 2D and 3D Segmentation
nodes.tldr: Single transformer segments both 2D images and 3D point clouds by alternating within-view and cross-view fusion, distinguished by positional encodings.
nodes.problem: 2D and 3D segmentation are usually handled by separate architectures.
nodes.approach: Transformer alternating 2D within-view and 3D cross-view fusion via token positional encodings.
nodes.niche_reason: Unified 2D/3D segmentation is uncommon but growing.

nodes.title: OPERA: Alleviating Hallucination in Multi-Modal Large Language Models via Over-Trust Penalty and Retrospection-Allocation
nodes.tldr: Reduces hallucination in multimodal LLMs at decoding time via an over-trust logit penalty and a retrospection rollback, needing no training.
nodes.problem: Multimodal LLMs hallucinate because they over-trust a few summary tokens and neglect image tokens.
nodes.approach: Beam-search logit penalty on over-trust plus rollback that re-checks summary-token presence and reselects tokens.
secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › Knowledge Editing & Factuality
nodes.niche_reason: MLLM hallucination mitigation is a crowded research area.

nodes.title: Object Pose Estimation via the Aggregation of Diffusion Features
nodes.tldr: Uses Stable Diffusion features, aggregated across granularities by three architectures, to make object pose estimation generalize much better to unseen objects.
nodes.problem: Pose estimators degrade sharply on unseen objects because image features generalize poorly.
nodes.approach: Analyze diffusion model features, then aggregate multi-granularity diffusion features in three architectures.
nodes.niche_reason: Diffusion-feature pose estimation is specialised but emerging.

nodes.title: Object Recognition as Next Token Prediction
nodes.tldr: Casts object recognition as autoregressive text-token prediction from image embeddings, using a custom attention mask and one-shot parallel label sampling with a compact decoder.
nodes.problem: Generating class labels with a language decoder is costly if labels are decoded one at a time.
nodes.approach: Non-causal mask isolating label tokens with image prefix, one-shot parallel sampling, and layer-pruned decoder.
nodes.niche_reason: Language decoders for recognition are an unusual but growing direction

nodes.title: Omni-SMoLA: Boosting Generalist Multimodal Models with Soft Mixture of Low-rank Experts
nodes.tldr: Omni-SMoLA mixes soft low-rank multimodal experts in a large multimodal model to improve both specialist and generalist performance across many tasks.
nodes.problem: Generalist multimodal models degrade when fine-tuned on a wide range of tasks.
nodes.approach: Soft mixture of low-rank experts architecture added to large multimodal model fine-tuning.
secondary_topics: Architectures & Training › Mixture of Experts & Sparsity
nodes.niche_reason: LoRA-style mixture-of-experts for multimodal models is common.

nodes.title: On the Estimation of Image-matching Uncertainty in Visual Place Recognition
nodes.tldr: Compares ways to estimate whether a visual place recognition match is correct and proposes SUE, a simple L2-distance baseline using reference poses.
nodes.problem: Confidence in retrieved VPR matches is rarely quantified, and confident wrong matches cause localization failure.
nodes.approach: Benchmarks retrieval, aleatoric, and geometric-verification uncertainty; SUE uses descriptor distance and reference poses.
nodes.niche_reason: uncertainty in visual place recognition is specialised

nodes.title: One-dimensional Adapter to Rule Them All: Concepts Diffusion Models and Erasing Applications
nodes.tldr: Erases multiple concepts from text-to-image diffusion models using pluggable one-dimensional adapters with latent anchoring, transferable across models without re-tuning.
nodes.problem: Concept erasure by full fine-tuning distorts other generations and does not transfer across models.
nodes.approach: Concept-semipermeable one-dimensional adapters with latent anchoring fine-tuning.
nodes.primary_topic: Trustworthy ML › Machine Unlearning & Privacy Attacks
nodes.confidence_reason: Unlearning versus safety or controllable generation.
nodes.niche_reason: Pluggable adapters for concept erasure are specialised.

nodes.title: OneTracker: Unifying Visual Object Tracking with Foundation Models and Efficient Tuning
nodes.tldr: OneTracker unifies RGB and RGB+X tracking by pretraining a foundation tracker and adding parameter-efficient prompt trackers for other modalities, state-of-the-art across 11 benchmarks.
nodes.problem: Different tracking tasks and input modalities are handled by separate models despite shared temporal matching.
nodes.approach: Pretrain RGB Foundation Tracker, freeze it, and tune prompt-based modality adapters for RGB+X tasks.
nodes.niche_reason: Established tracking area with a multimodal unification angle.

nodes.title: Open-Vocabulary 3D Semantic Segmentation with Foundation Models
nodes.tldr: OV3D aligns 3D point features with enriched entity text descriptions from vision and language foundation models for open-vocabulary 3D semantic segmentation.
nodes.problem: Recognizing diverse objects in 3D scenes beyond predefined categories.
nodes.approach: Align point features to context-enriched textual entity descriptions using vision-language foundation model knowledge.
nodes.niche_reason: Open-vocabulary 3D segmentation is established but specialised.

nodes.title: Open-Vocabulary Object 6D Pose Estimation
nodes.tldr: Introduces open-vocabulary 6D pose estimation where a text prompt specifies the object and no CAD model is needed, using a vision-language model to segment and estimate relative pose from two RGBD views.
nodes.problem: Estimating relative 6D pose of text-specified novel objects without object models.
nodes.approach: Fuse prompt-level object information with local features from a VLM to segment and register RGBD views.
nodes.niche_reason: Open-vocabulary pose estimation is established but specialised.

nodes.title: OpenBias: Open-set Bias Detection in Text-to-Image Generative Models
nodes.tldr: OpenBias detects open-set biases in text-to-image models by having an LLM propose biases and a VQA model measure them in generated images.
nodes.problem: Existing bias detection in text-to-image models only covers predefined closed sets of biases.
nodes.approach: LLM proposes biases from captions, the model generates images, and a VQA model quantifies bias presence.
secondary_topics: Generative Models › Generative Model Evaluation & Theory
nodes.niche_reason: Bias auditing of generative models is established; open-set angle is moderate.

nodes.title: OpenESS: Event-based Semantic Scene Understanding with Open Vocabularies
nodes.tldr: Transfers CLIP's image-text knowledge to event camera streams, enabling open-vocabulary semantic segmentation without event or frame labels.
nodes.problem: Event-based semantic segmentation is hard to scale because event data is hard to annotate.
nodes.approach: Frame-to-event contrastive distillation and text-to-event semantic consistency regularization.
secondary_topics: Architectures & Training › Domain Adaptation & OOD Generalization
nodes.niche_reason: Event-camera open-vocabulary segmentation is a rare sensing niche

nodes.title: OrCo: Towards Better Generalization via Orthogonality and Contrast for Few-Shot Class-Incremental Learning
nodes.tldr: OrCo combines supervised and self-supervised contrastive pretraining with an orthogonality-based loss that reserves feature space for future classes in few-shot class-incremental learning.
nodes.problem: Few-shot class-incremental learning suffers catastrophic forgetting and overfitting from scarce incremental data.
nodes.approach: Contrastive pretraining plus OrCo loss using feature perturbation and class orthogonality to maximize margins.
nodes.niche_reason: FSCIL is an established but specialised subarea.

nodes.title: Orthogonal Adaptation for Modular Customization of Diffusion Models
nodes.tldr: Fine-tunes independent diffusion customizations to have orthogonal residual weights, so they can be summed into one model without interference.
nodes.problem: Merging separately customized diffusion models causes concept interference
nodes.approach: Orthogonal residual weights encouraged across independently fine-tuned customization adapters
nodes.niche_reason: Orthogonal merging of customized diffusion models

nodes.title: Outdoor Scene Extrapolation with Hierarchical Generative Cellular Automata
nodes.tldr: hGCA extrapolates fine 3D street geometry beyond sparse LiDAR scan limits using a hierarchical generative cellular automata model with a planner for global consistency.
nodes.problem: Generating large-scale, high-resolution simulation-ready 3D street environments from sparse AV LiDAR scans.
nodes.approach: Coarse-to-fine hierarchical generative cellular automata with local kernels and a lightweight global planner.
nodes.niche_reason: Cellular-automata-based outdoor 3D generation is a rare approach.

nodes.title: PAPR in Motion: Seamless Point-level 3D Scene Interpolation
nodes.tldr: PAPR in Motion proposes point-level 3D scene interpolation, deforming a point cloud with regularized proximity attention rendering for smooth geometry and appearance transitions.
nodes.problem: Smooth point-level interpolation between two 3D scene states with large non-rigid changes without supervision.
nodes.approach: Extend PAPR point-cloud renderer with temporal-consistency regularizers for deformation.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: New task of point-level scene interpolation; few similar works.

nodes.title: PIGEON: Predicting Image Geolocations
nodes.tldr: PIGEON geolocates photos worldwide using semantic geocells, multi-task contrastive pretraining and cluster retrieval, beating top GeoGuessr players and prior state of the art.
nodes.problem: Planet-scale image geolocalization that generalizes to unseen places.
nodes.approach: Semantic geocells, multi-task contrastive pretraining, new loss, and retrieval over location clusters for refinement.
nodes.confidence_reason: Image geolocation fits recognition and geospatial equally well.
nodes.niche_reason: Specialised vision task with moderate community interest.

nodes.title: PLACE: Adaptive Layout-Semantic Fusion for Semantic Image Synthesis
nodes.tldr: Fuses layout and semantic features in a timestep-adaptive way within pretrained text-to-image models for semantic image synthesis with aligned layouts.
nodes.problem: Semantic image synthesis from pretrained text-to-image models struggles with consistent layout and semantics.
nodes.approach: Layout control maps fused with semantic features, plus semantic alignment and layout-free prior losses.
nodes.niche_reason: Layout-controlled text-to-image synthesis is a common, active direction.

nodes.title: PanoPose: Self-supervised Relative Pose Estimation for Panoramic Images
nodes.tldr: PanoPose self-supervised network estimates scaled relative pose between panoramic images using depth-net and pose-net with rotation pretraining and depth fusion, enabling global SfM.
nodes.problem: Scaled relative pose estimation, since two-view translation is scaleless in global Structure-from-Motion.
nodes.approach: Self-supervised view reconstruction with depth and pose networks, rotation pretraining, and depth-pose fusion block.
nodes.niche_reason: Panoramic self-supervised pose and SfM is a rare niche.

nodes.title: PerceptionGPT: Effectively Fusing Visual Perception into LLM
nodes.tldr: Fuses visual perception outputs like boxes and masks into an LLM's embedding space via lightweight encoders and decoders, avoiding lossy discrete tokens.
nodes.problem: Making LLMs perform detection and segmentation accurately, since discrete token representations of perception signals lose precision.
nodes.approach: Lightweight encoders and decoders map perception signals to continuous LLM token embeddings.
nodes.niche_reason: Perception-in-LLM is a common VLLM direction.

nodes.title: PhyScene: Physically Interactable 3D Scene Synthesis for Embodied AI
nodes.tldr: Generates interactive 3D scenes with articulated objects by guiding a conditional diffusion model with collision, layout and reachability constraints.
nodes.problem: Scene synthesis ignores the physical plausibility and interactivity that embodied agents need
nodes.approach: Conditional diffusion for layouts with physics and interactivity guidance functions
nodes.niche_reason: Scene synthesis is established; physics-interactive scenes are niche

nodes.title: PhysGaussian: Physics-Integrated 3D Gaussians for Generative Dynamics
nodes.tldr: Embeds Newtonian continuum mechanics (MPM) into 3D Gaussians so scenes are simulated and rendered with the same representation, producing physically plausible novel motion.
nodes.problem: Synthesizing physically realistic dynamics for 3D scenes without meshing or separate geometry.
nodes.approach: Material Point Method evolves 3D Gaussian kernels with kinematic and stress attributes.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: Physics simulation integrated into Gaussian splatting is a specialised direction.

nodes.title: Point2CAD: Reverse Engineering CAD Models from 3D Point Clouds
nodes.tldr: Reconstructs CAD models from point clouds via a hybrid analytic-neural scheme with a new implicit freeform-surface representation.
nodes.problem: CAD reconstruction from segmented point clouds yields poor topology.
nodes.approach: Analytic primitive fitting combined with a learned implicit representation of freeform surfaces.
secondary_topics: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: Point-cloud-to-CAD reverse engineering is a rare niche

nodes.title: Polos: Multimodal Metric Learning from Human Feedback for Image Captioning
nodes.tldr: Trains Polos, a supervised metric that scores image captions from multimodal embeddings using 131K human judgments, correlating better with humans than CIDEr.
nodes.problem: Caption metrics track human judgment poorly, and data-driven ones struggle with hallucinations and generalization.
nodes.approach: Parallel multimodal feature extraction over contrastive embeddings, trained on human feedback via M2LHF framework.
nodes.niche_reason: Learned captioning metrics from human feedback are a specialised evaluation niche

nodes.title: Pose-Guided Self-Training with Two-Stage Clustering for Unsupervised Landmark Discovery
nodes.tldr: Discovers object landmarks without labels by clustering diffusion-model features in a zero-shot baseline, then refining with pose-guided self-training and two-stage clustering.
nodes.problem: Unsupervised landmark discovery for an object category.
nodes.approach: Cluster diffusion features for a zero-shot baseline, then pose-guided self-training with two-stage clustering.
secondary_topics: Computer Vision › Vision Foundation Models & Self-Supervision
nodes.niche_reason: Unsupervised landmark discovery is a rare topic.

nodes.title: Predicated Diffusion: Predicate Logic-Based Attention Guidance for Text-to-Image Diffusion Models
nodes.tldr: Expresses text prompts as predicate-logic propositions over attention maps, yielding a differentiable loss that guides diffusion toward faithful text-to-image generation.
nodes.problem: Text-to-image diffusion often omits objects, misapplies adjectives, and misses possession relations.
nodes.approach: Treat attention-map pixels as fuzzy predicates and optimize a differentiable logic loss during generation.
nodes.niche_reason: Predicate-logic guidance for diffusion is a specialised idea

nodes.title: Programmable Motion Generation for Open-Set Motion Control Tasks
nodes.tldr: Programmable motion generation lets any motion control task be composed from atomic constraint functions, supporting open-set control of character animation without task-specific training.
nodes.problem: Existing motion control methods handle only closed sets of constraints and are hard to extend.
nodes.approach: Compose atomic constraint functions into programmable tasks and optimize motion via pretrained motion diffusion models.
secondary_topics: Computer Vision › Human Pose, Avatars & Faces
nodes.niche_reason: Open-set programmable motion control is specialised.

nodes.title: Progressive Divide-and-Conquer via Subsampling Decomposition for Accelerated MRI
nodes.tldr: Progressive divide-and-conquer unrolled network for accelerated MRI that decomposes subsampling into moderate-degradation stages with learned masks and severity conditioning.
nodes.problem: Deep unfolding networks struggle with highly ill-posed accelerated MRI reconstruction in a single step per iteration.
nodes.approach: Decompose the MAP problem by subsampling mask, predict decomposition, and unfold with severity conditioning.
nodes.niche_reason: MRI reconstruction is established but domain-specialised.

nodes.title: Putting the Object Back into Video Object Segmentation
nodes.tldr: Cutie is a video object segmentation network using top-down object-level memory reading with object queries and masked attention, beating pixel-level memory methods.
nodes.problem: Pixel-level memory reading in video object segmentation suffers from matching noise and distractors.
nodes.approach: Query-based object transformer reading object-level memory iteratively with pixel features and foreground-background masked attention.
nodes.niche_reason: Established VOS subfield, specialised relative to mainstream vision.

nodes.title: QUADify: Extracting Meshes with Pixel-level Details and Materials from Images
nodes.tldr: Extracts editable quad-dominant meshes with pixel-level displacement and material detail from posed images, using differentiable remeshing of a neural implicit surface.
nodes.problem: Image-based 3D reconstruction yields irregular triangle meshes that are hard for artists to edit.
nodes.approach: Differentiable re-meshing with Catmull-Clark subdivision, vertex displacement, and differentiable material and lighting decomposition.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: quad-mesh extraction from images is a specialised niche

nodes.title: Question Aware Vision Transformer for Multimodal Reasoning
nodes.tldr: Makes the vision encoder question-aware so visual features focus on query-relevant image regions, plugging into any vision-language architecture.
nodes.problem: Vision encoders are decoupled from the user question, so visual features may miss query-specific details.
nodes.approach: Injects question conditioning into the vision transformer, yielding model-agnostic query-dependent visual features.
nodes.niche_reason: Question-aware vision encoders are a fairly common VLM direction

nodes.title: RAVE: Randomized Noise Shuffling for Fast and Consistent Video Editing with Diffusion Models
nodes.tldr: RAVE is a training-free video editing method that shuffles noise across frames with a text-to-image diffusion model for fast, temporally consistent, memory-efficient edits.
nodes.problem: Diffusion-based video editing lacks visual quality, temporal consistency and user control.
nodes.approach: Zero-shot randomized noise shuffling exploiting spatio-temporal frame interactions in pretrained text-to-image diffusion.
nodes.niche_reason: Diffusion video editing is a common topic.

nodes.title: Rapid 3D Model Generation with Intuitive 3D Input
nodes.tldr: Generates 3D models from rough VR sketches by pretraining a conditional diffusion model and fine-tuning a sketch encoder, plus a new dataset.
nodes.problem: Conventional CAD is hard for novices, so intuitive 3D creation from VR sketches is needed.
nodes.approach: Conditional diffusion pretrained on 3D shapes, with an encoder fine-tuned to map sketches via adaptive curriculum.
nodes.niche_reason: sketch-to-shape generation is an established application

nodes.title: Readout Guidance: Learning Control from Diffusion Features
nodes.tldr: Readout heads trained on frozen diffusion features extract signals like pose or correspondence, and their gradients guide sampling for conditional control with few added parameters.
nodes.problem: Conditional control of text-to-image diffusion needs many parameters and training samples per control type.
nodes.approach: Lightweight readout heads on frozen diffusion features; backpropagate readout-to-target loss to guide sampling.
nodes.niche_reason: Controllable diffusion guidance is a common, crowded topic.

nodes.title: Real Acoustic Fields: An Audio-Visual Room Acoustics Dataset and Benchmark
nodes.tldr: Introduces a dense real-world room acoustics dataset pairing room impulse responses with multi-view images and 6DoF poses, and benchmarks acoustic synthesis methods.
nodes.problem: Neural acoustic field models lack densely captured real-world room acoustic data, relying on synthetic data.
nodes.approach: Dense capture of impulse responses with synchronized images and pose tracking, plus sim2real fine-tuning baselines.
secondary_topics: Audio, Speech & Multimodal › Audio-Visual & Cross-modal Learning
nodes.niche_reason: Real-world dense acoustic-visual capture is rare

nodes.title: Real-Time Simulated Avatar from Head-Mounted Sensors
nodes.tldr: Controls a physics-simulated humanoid avatar from AR/VR headset pose and head-mounted camera images, using physics to fill in body parts out of view.
nodes.problem: Egocentric body pose from head-mounted cameras is hard since the body is often clipped out of view.
nodes.approach: End-to-end mapping of headset pose and images to humanoid control, with physics filling unseen parts.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › Human Pose, Avatars & Faces
nodes.confidence_reason: Blends avatar pose estimation with physics-based humanoid control; primary is judgment call
nodes.niche_reason: Headset-driven physics avatar control is an unusual combination

nodes.title: Real-time 3D-aware Portrait Video Relighting
nodes.tldr: First real-time 3D-aware NeRF-based portrait video relighting, inferring albedo and shading tri-planes with dual encoders and temporal consistency, running at about 33 fps.
nodes.problem: Existing portrait relighting is slow or cannot change viewpoint for talking face videos.
nodes.approach: Dual encoders infer albedo and lighting-conditioned shading tri-planes, with a temporal consistency network.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › Human Pose, Avatars & Faces
secondary_topics: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: Real-time 3D-aware face relighting is a specialised topic.

nodes.title: Referring Expression Counting
nodes.tldr: Introduces Referring Expression Counting, counting objects with given attributes within a class, with the REC-8K dataset and a method beating text-based counting baselines.
nodes.problem: Class-level counting ignores fine-grained attributes within a class that referring expressions can specify.
nodes.approach: New task and REC-8K dataset with a text-conditioned counting model.
nodes.niche_reason: Rare object counting task with language referring.

nodes.title: Relightable and Animatable Neural Avatar from Sparse-View Video
nodes.tldr: Recovers relightable and animatable neural avatars from sparse or monocular video using hierarchical distance queries and sphere tracing for visibility.
nodes.problem: Relighting dynamic humans under unknown illumination needs costly SDF intersection on deformed surfaces.
nodes.approach: Hierarchical Distance Query approximates deformed SDFs, enabling sphere-traced light visibility.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › Human Pose, Avatars & Faces
secondary_topics: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: Relightable dynamic avatars are a specialised niche

nodes.title: Residual Learning in Diffusion Models
nodes.tldr: A learned residual correction function rectifies the reverse-SDE sampling trajectory of diffusion models, improving image quality and transferring across different pretrained models.
nodes.problem: Score-estimation and discretization errors accumulate in reverse-SDE sampling, leaving residuals that degrade generated images.
nodes.approach: Optimizes a correction function that rectifies sampling trajectories, and the correction transfers to other diffusion models on the same dataset.
nodes.confidence_reason: Sampling-correction and diffusion-model topics both fit this method.
nodes.niche_reason: Learned trajectory correction for diffusion sampling is established but specialised.

nodes.title: Restoration by Generation with Constrained Priors
nodes.tldr: Adapts a pretrained diffusion model for image restoration by finetuning on anchor images to constrain its generative space, then noising and denoising the input; supports personalized restoration.
nodes.problem: Restoring real-world degraded images while preserving identity and fine detail.
nodes.approach: Finetune diffusion model on anchor images, then add noise to input and denoise.
nodes.niche_reason: Diffusion-based restoration is a common direction.

nodes.title: Rethinking FID: Towards a Better Evaluation Metric for Image Generation
nodes.tldr: Shows FID is an unreliable metric for text-to-image models and proposes CMMD, a CLIP-based MMD distance that is more robust.
nodes.problem: FID is unreliable for evaluating modern image generators.
nodes.approach: CLIP embeddings compared with maximum mean discrepancy using a Gaussian RBF kernel.
nodes.primary_topic: Generative Models › Generative Model Evaluation & Theory
nodes.niche_reason: Metric critique is a common evaluation topic

nodes.title: Rethinking Generalizable Face Anti-spoofing via Hierarchical Prototype-guided Distribution Refinement in Hyperbolic Space
nodes.tldr: HPDR learns hyperbolic embeddings with hierarchical prototypes and a prototype-oriented classifier to improve domain generalization for face anti-spoofing.
nodes.problem: Generalizable face anti-spoofing ignores hierarchical relations among samples when aligning domains.
nodes.approach: Hyperbolic-space hierarchical prototype learning with prototype-oriented classifier for distribution refinement.
nodes.primary_topic: Architectures & Training › Domain Adaptation & OOD Generalization
secondary_topics: Computer Vision › Human Pose, Avatars & Faces
nodes.niche_reason: Hyperbolic prototypes for face anti-spoofing is a niche combination.

nodes.title: RichDreamer: A Generalizable Normal-Depth Diffusion Model for Detail Richness in Text-to-3D
nodes.tldr: Learns a generalizable normal-depth diffusion model from LAION data, plus an albedo diffusion model, to improve geometry and detail in text-to-3D generation.
nodes.problem: Text-to-3D relies on RGB diffusion for normals, which is unstable due to a distribution gap.
nodes.approach: Normal-depth diffusion prior trained with image-to-depth and normal estimators, plus albedo diffusion constraints.
nodes.niche_reason: Text-to-3D is a crowded area; normal-depth priors are a variant

nodes.title: RobustSAM: Segment Anything Robustly on Degraded Images
nodes.tldr: RobustSAM adapts Segment Anything to degraded images with few added parameters while preserving promptability, supported by a 688K-pair dataset of degraded images and masks.
nodes.problem: Segment Anything performs poorly on low-quality, degraded images.
nodes.approach: Lightweight additional modules on pretrained SAM trained on a new multi-degradation Robust-Seg dataset.
nodes.niche_reason: SAM variants are common, but degradation robustness is specialised.

nodes.title: SCEdit: Efficient and Controllable Image Diffusion Generation via Skip Connection Editing
nodes.tldr: SCEdit tunes diffusion models by editing only skip connections in the U-Net with a lightweight module, enabling efficient controllable image generation.
nodes.problem: Efficient adaptation and controllable generation for image diffusion models without modifying the main backbone.
nodes.approach: Lightweight skip-connection editing modules plus controllable variants for conditions such as edges and depth.
nodes.niche_reason: Common PEFT/controllable diffusion theme with a novel locus.

nodes.title: SCINeRF: Neural Radiance Fields from a Snapshot Compressive Image
nodes.tldr: SCINeRF recovers a 3D NeRF scene representation from a single snapshot compressive image by modeling the SCI physical imaging process during training.
nodes.problem: Reconstructing 3D scenes from a single temporally compressed snapshot compressive image.
nodes.approach: Incorporate the SCI mask-based imaging model into NeRF training.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: NeRF from coded snapshot imaging is an unusual combination.

nodes.title: SDDGR: Stable Diffusion-based Deep Generative Replay for Class Incremental Object Detection
nodes.tldr: Uses iterative stable-diffusion generative replay with L2 distillation and pseudo-labels to reduce forgetting when adding new classes to object detection.
nodes.problem: Generative replay fails for class-incremental object detection with multi-label scenes.
nodes.approach: Diffusion-generated old-class images with iterative refinement, L2 distillation, and pseudo-labeling.
nodes.niche_reason: Generative replay for incremental detection is specialised

nodes.title: SG-BEV: Satellite-Guided BEV Fusion for Cross-View Semantic Segmentation
nodes.tldr: SG-BEV fuses street-view features projected into bird's-eye view with satellite guidance for fine-grained building attribute segmentation, improving mIoU on four city datasets.
nodes.problem: Large perspective differences between street-view and satellite images hinder cross-view building segmentation.
nodes.approach: BEV mapping of street-view features with a satellite-guided reprojection module.
nodes.niche_reason: Satellite and street-view building attribute segmentation is a rare niche.

nodes.title: SHiNe: Semantic Hierarchy Nexus for Open-vocabulary Object Detection
nodes.tldr: Builds a training-free classifier from class hierarchies that makes open-vocabulary detectors robust across vocabulary granularities.
nodes.problem: Open-vocabulary detectors vary widely in accuracy when class names differ in semantic granularity.
nodes.approach: Retrieves super- and sub-categories from hierarchies, forms hierarchy-aware sentences, and fuses their embeddings into a classifier.
nodes.niche_reason: Hierarchy-based open-vocabulary classifiers are a specialised angle

nodes.title: SIFU: Side-view Conditioned Implicit Function for Real-world Usable Clothed Human Reconstruction
nodes.tldr: Reconstructs clothed 3D humans from single in-the-wild images using side-view decoupled transformer features and diffusion-based texture refinement.
nodes.problem: Single-image clothed human reconstruction struggles with complex poses, loose clothing, and unseen-area textures.
nodes.approach: Cross-attention with SMPL-X normals as queries decouples side-view features, then text-to-image diffusion prior refines textures.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › Human Pose, Avatars & Faces
secondary_topics: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: Clothed human reconstruction is established but specialised.

nodes.title: SLICE: Stabilized LIME for Consistent Explanations for Image Classification
nodes.tldr: SLICE stabilizes LIME explanations for image classifiers using superpixel feature selection and adaptive perturbation, improving run-to-run consistency and fidelity.
nodes.problem: LIME explanations are inconsistent across runs in sign and importance rank of superpixels.
nodes.approach: Novel feature selection removing spurious superpixels plus adaptive perturbation sampling near the instance.
nodes.niche_reason: Post-hoc XAI stabilization is established but specialised.

nodes.title: SPOT: Self-Training with Patch-Order Permutation for Object-Centric Learning with Autoregressive Transformers
nodes.tldr: SPOT improves slot-attention object-centric learning by self-training encoder masks from decoder attention and permuting patch order for autoregressive transformer decoders.
nodes.problem: Slot-based autoencoders struggle to produce object-specific slots and make decoders actually use them.
nodes.approach: Attention-based self-training distillation from decoder to encoder plus patch-order permutation in autoregressive decoding.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › Vision Foundation Models & Self-Supervision
nodes.niche_reason: Object-centric learning is a specialised unsupervised niche.

nodes.title: SVDinsTN: A Tensor Network Paradigm for Efficient Structure Search from Regularized Modeling Perspective
nodes.tldr: SVD-inspired tensor network decomposition that finds compact tensor network structure by learning sparse diagonal edge factors, avoiding repeated structure evaluations and accelerating search 100-1000 times.
nodes.problem: Tensor network structure search is NP-hard and sampling-evaluation methods are very costly.
nodes.approach: Insert diagonal factors on each edge of a fully connected network and use factor sparsity to reveal structure.
nodes.niche_reason: Tensor network structure search is very rare in mainstream ML.

nodes.title: Sat2Scene: 3D Urban Scene Generation from Satellite Images with Diffusion
nodes.tldr: Generates explorable 3D urban scenes from satellite imagery by running diffusion over 3D sparse point representations, then neural rendering for arbitrary views.
nodes.problem: Generating consistent street-level views of city scenes from satellite images faces large viewpoint change.
nodes.approach: Point-level 3D diffusion for texture on satellite-derived geometry, converted feed-forward into a renderable scene.
nodes.niche_reason: Satellite-to-street-view 3D scene generation is a rare cross-view niche.

nodes.title: Scaffold-GS: Structured 3D Gaussians for View-Adaptive Rendering
nodes.tldr: Scaffold-GS organizes 3D Gaussians around anchor points whose attributes are predicted from view direction, reducing redundancy while keeping high-quality rendering.
nodes.problem: 3D Gaussian Splatting creates redundant Gaussians that overfit training views and fail under large view changes.
nodes.approach: Anchor-based structured Gaussians with on-the-fly attribute prediction and importance-driven anchor growing and pruning.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: Gaussian splatting is a very active, crowded area

nodes.title: Scaling Up Dynamic Human-Scene Interaction Modeling
nodes.tldr: Introduces TRUMANS, a large motion-captured human-scene interaction dataset, and a diffusion-based autoregressive model generating long HSI motion with zero-shot generalization to unseen 3D scenes.
nodes.problem: Scarce data and limited methods for realistic, dynamic human-scene interaction motion synthesis.
nodes.approach: 15-hour mocap dataset with scene and motion augmentation, plus autoregressive diffusion conditioned on scene and action.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › Human Pose, Avatars & Faces
nodes.niche_reason: Human-scene interaction synthesis is established but specialised.

nodes.title: SceneTex: High-Quality Texture Synthesis for Indoor Scenes via Diffusion Priors
nodes.tldr: Generates style-consistent indoor scene textures by optimizing a multiresolution texture field with score distillation from depth-to-image diffusion priors.
nodes.problem: Texturing indoor meshes often loses style and geometric consistency across views.
nodes.approach: Score-distillation optimization in RGB space with a cross-attention decoder for view-consistent style.
secondary_topics: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: Common: diffusion-prior texturing is a crowded direction.

nodes.title: Selective-Stereo: Adaptive Frequency Information Selection for Stereo Matching
nodes.tldr: Stereo matching network that adaptively fuses disparity information across frequencies with a recurrent update unit, ranking first on major leaderboards.
nodes.problem: Iterative stereo methods lose edge detail and fail in textureless regions due to fixed receptive fields.
nodes.approach: Selective Recurrent Unit fusing multi-frequency hidden disparity via contextual spatial attention weights.
nodes.niche_reason: Common: iterative stereo matching is a crowded area.

nodes.title: Self-Supervised Dual Contouring
nodes.tldr: Self-Supervised Dual Contouring trains neural meshing with first-order distance-consistency losses, avoiding axiomatic ground truth, and also regularizes implicit networks.
nodes.problem: Learned isosurface extraction relies on supervised axiomatically computed ground truths, inheriting their biases.
nodes.approach: Two self-supervised losses linking inferred mesh and input SDF distances up to first order.
secondary_topics: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: Learned isosurface meshing is a rare niche.

nodes.title: Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking with Path Consistency
nodes.tldr: Self-supervised multi-object tracking via path consistency: association results must agree across observation paths that skip different frames.
nodes.problem: Learning object association for tracking typically needs manual identity labels.
nodes.approach: Path Consistency Loss enforcing consistent association across frame-skipping observation paths.
nodes.niche_reason: Established but specialised: unsupervised multi-object tracking.

nodes.title: Semantic-aware SAM for Point-Prompted Instance Segmentation
nodes.tldr: Uses SAM point prompts with multiple instance learning to select representative masks, producing category-aware instance segmentation from single-point annotations.
nodes.problem: SAM's class-agnostic masks make category-specific segmentation from single points ambiguous
nodes.approach: MIL-based selection of SAM mask proposals with point distance guidance and box mining
secondary_topics: Computer Vision › Vision Foundation Models & Self-Supervision
nodes.niche_reason: SAM-based weak supervision is active but specialised

nodes.title: SleepVST: Sleep Staging from Near-Infrared Video Signals using Pre-Trained Transformers
nodes.tldr: Classifies sleep stages from near-infrared video by transferring a transformer pre-trained on contact-sensor cardio-respiratory signals to video-derived waveforms.
nodes.problem: Sleep staging needs cumbersome contact polysomnography, unsuitable for long-term studies.
nodes.approach: Transformer pre-trained on contact cardio-respiratory data, transferred to camera-extracted respiration and pulse waveforms.
nodes.niche_reason: Camera-based sleep staging with video transformers is unusual.

nodes.title: SmartEdit: Exploring Complex Instruction-based Image Editing with Multimodal Large Language Models
nodes.tldr: Instruction-based image editor that feeds MLLM reasoning into a diffusion model through a bidirectional interaction module, handling complex editing instructions.
nodes.problem: Instruction-based editors like InstructPix2Pix fail on complex instructions due to weak CLIP text encoders.
nodes.approach: Bidirectional interaction between image and MLLM outputs, with perception pretraining and complex-instruction editing data.
nodes.niche_reason: Instruction-based image editing is an active mainstream area

nodes.title: Snap Video: Scaled Spatiotemporal Transformers for Text-to-Video Synthesis
nodes.tldr: Snap Video extends EDM for redundant video pixels and replaces the U-Net with a scalable transformer, training 3.3x faster for billion-parameter text-to-video models.
nodes.problem: Image generators adapted to video lose motion fidelity and scale poorly because video is redundant.
nodes.approach: EDM extension for spatiotemporal redundancy plus a transformer architecture replacing the U-Net.
nodes.niche_reason: Text-to-video diffusion is a crowded mainstream area.

nodes.title: Spatial-Aware Regression for Keypoint Localization
nodes.tldr: Spatial-Aware Regression keeps the spatial location map and predicts coordinates and confidence per grid cell, improving regression-based keypoint localization across 2D/3D, multi-person and whole-body pose.
nodes.problem: Regression-based keypoint methods discard spatial priors via global pooling and handle only single instances.
nodes.approach: Per-grid-cell coordinate and confidence outputs with a unified objective preserving the spatial map.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › Human Pose, Avatars & Faces
nodes.niche_reason: Pose estimation is common; regression variant is mainstream.

nodes.title: SpatialTracker: Tracking Any 2D Pixels in 3D Space
nodes.tldr: Tracks dense 2D pixels through video by lifting them to 3D triplane features and iteratively estimating 3D trajectories with rigidity constraints.
nodes.problem: Long-range dense pixel motion estimation suffers from 3D-to-2D projection occlusions.
nodes.approach: Lift pixels to 3D with monocular depth, triplane features, transformer updates, ARAP and rigidity embeddings.
nodes.niche_reason: Mainstream point-tracking direction with a 3D twist

nodes.title: SpecNeRF: Gaussian Directional Encoding for Specular Reflections
nodes.tldr: SpecNeRF uses a learnable Gaussian directional encoding to model view-dependent specular reflections under near-field lighting in NeRFs, aided by a geometry prior.
nodes.problem: NeRFs struggle with glossy, view-dependent appearance under complex near-field indoor lighting.
nodes.approach: Learnable Gaussian directional encoding emulating prefiltered environment maps, plus a data-driven geometry prior.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: Specialised NeRF reflection modeling within a large NeRF literature.

nodes.title: Spectral and Polarization Vision: Spectro-polarimetric Real-world Dataset
nodes.tldr: Introduces trichromatic and hyperspectral Stokes image datasets with linear and circular polarization across diverse real-world scenes, and evaluates spectral dependence of shape-from-polarization.
nodes.problem: Polarization and spectral light data are underrepresented in existing vision datasets.
nodes.approach: Collect Stokes-image datasets with multiple spectral channels and analyse their statistics and representations.
nodes.niche_reason: Spectro-polarimetric vision datasets are a rare niche.

nodes.title: Stationary Representations: Optimally Approximating Compatibility and Implications for Improved Model Replacements
nodes.tldr: Shows fixed-classifier stationary representations optimally approximate representation compatibility, enabling model upgrades without reprocessing retrieval galleries.
nodes.problem: Replacing a retrieval model normally requires reprocessing the entire gallery.
nodes.approach: Theoretical analysis of d-Simplex fixed classifiers under two compatibility inequality constraints.
nodes.niche_reason: Backward-compatible representation learning is established but specialised

nodes.title: StreamingFlow: Streaming Occupancy Forecasting with Asynchronous Multi-modal Data Streams via Neural Ordinary Differential Equation
nodes.tldr: Forecasts BEV occupancy at any future time from asynchronous multi-sensor streams by integrating neural ODEs into recurrent networks.
nodes.problem: Occupancy forecasting needs synchronized sensors and predicts only uniformly spaced future snapshots.
nodes.approach: Neural ODE-driven BEV feature derivatives updated with sensor fusion, then propagated to requested future timestamps.
secondary_topics: Architectures & Training › Time Series & Sequential Data
nodes.niche_reason: BEV occupancy forecasting is a crowded autonomous-driving topic

nodes.title: Strong Transferable Adversarial Attacks via Ensembled Asymptotically Normal Distribution Learning
nodes.tldr: MultiANDA models adversarial perturbations as a learned mixture of Gaussians via stochastic gradient ascent asymptotic normality and deep ensembles, improving black-box transferability.
nodes.problem: Adversarial examples overfit source models and transfer poorly to unknown architectures and defenses.
nodes.approach: Approximate perturbation posterior using asymptotic normality of SGA and ensembles; sample unlimited perturbations.
nodes.niche_reason: Transfer-based adversarial attacks are a common topic.

nodes.title: Style Injection in Diffusion: A Training-free Approach for Adapting Large-scale Diffusion Models for Style Transfer
nodes.tldr: Training-free style transfer with a pretrained diffusion model, swapping self-attention keys and values with the style image's, plus query preservation and AdaIN.
nodes.problem: Diffusion style transfer methods need slow inference-time optimization or underuse large-scale model generative ability.
nodes.approach: Replace content key/value with style key/value in self-attention, with query preservation, temperature scaling, and initial latent AdaIN.
nodes.niche_reason: Diffusion-based image editing and style transfer is common.

nodes.title: Suppress and Rebalance: Towards Generalized Multi-Modal Face Anti-Spoofing
nodes.tldr: Multi-modal face anti-spoofing that suppresses unreliable depth and infrared regions with uncertainty-guided adapters and rebalances modality gradients for domain generalization.
nodes.problem: Multi-modal face anti-spoofing fails to generalize due to unreliable modalities and modality imbalance.
nodes.approach: Uncertainty-guided cross-adapter for unreliable regions plus adaptive gradient modulation across modalities.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › Human Pose, Avatars & Faces
secondary_topics: Audio, Speech & Multimodal › Audio-Visual & Cross-modal Learning
nodes.confidence_reason: Face anti-spoofing spans face, multimodal fusion, and security topics.
nodes.niche_reason: Multimodal face anti-spoofing is specialised.

nodes.title: SurroundSDF: Implicit 3D Scene Understanding Based on Signed Distance Field
nodes.tldr: Predicts signed distance and semantic fields from surround-view camera images for continuous 3D obstacle surfaces, using weakly supervised Eikonal constraints.
nodes.problem: Voxel-based camera perception for driving yields inaccurate, discontinuous obstacle surfaces.
nodes.approach: Query-based implicit SDF network with a Sandwich Eikonal loss applying dense constraints on both sides of the surface.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.confidence_reason: Spans 3D reconstruction and autonomous driving perception.
nodes.niche_reason: Implicit SDF for surround-camera driving perception is a fairly specialised topic.

nodes.title: SwitchLight: Co-design of Physics-driven Architecture and Pre-training Framework for Human Portrait Relighting
nodes.tldr: SwitchLight relights human portraits with a Cook-Torrance-inspired physics-guided architecture and self-supervised pre-training to overcome scarce lightstage data.
nodes.problem: Realistic portrait relighting limited by scarce high-quality lightstage data.
nodes.approach: Physically based reflectance architecture combined with self-supervised pre-training on unlabeled data.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › Human Pose, Avatars & Faces
nodes.niche_reason: Portrait relighting is established but specialised.

nodes.title: TFMQ-DM: Temporal Feature Maintenance Quantization for Diffusion Models
nodes.tldr: Post-training quantization for diffusion models that preserves temporal features, nearly matching full precision at 4-bit weights.
nodes.problem: Existing PTQ methods disturb diffusion time-step features and denoising trajectories, hurting quality.
nodes.approach: Temporal Information Block reconstruction targets with finite-set calibration aligning full-precision time features.
nodes.primary_topic: Architectures & Training › Efficient Training, Compression & Pruning
nodes.niche_reason: Diffusion quantization is a common, active efficiency direction

nodes.title: Tackling the Singularities at the Endpoints of Time Intervals in Diffusion Models
nodes.tldr: Analyzes singularities at the endpoints of diffusion time intervals and proposes SingDiffusion, a plug-and-play initial-step sampler that fixes average brightness issues and lowers FID.
nodes.problem: Gaussian reverse-process assumptions break at t=0 and t=1, causing average brightness bias in diffusion outputs.
nodes.approach: Error-bound theory at singular time steps and a plug-and-play method for the initial singular step sampling.
secondary_topics: Generative Models › Generative Model Evaluation & Theory
nodes.niche_reason: Diffusion endpoint singularity analysis is specialised within a crowded area.

nodes.title: Taming Stable Diffusion for Text to 360 Panorama Image Generation
nodes.tldr: Generates 360-degree panoramas from text with a dual-branch diffusion model that uses Stable Diffusion priors and projection-aware cross-attention.
nodes.problem: Text-to-panorama generation lacks paired data and suffers domain gap from perspective images.
nodes.approach: Stable Diffusion branch provides natural-image priors, registered to a panorama branch via projection-aware cross-attention.
nodes.niche_reason: Panorama generation is a niche within text-to-image

nodes.title: Task2Box: Box Embeddings for Modeling Asymmetric Task Relationships
nodes.tldr: Task2Box embeds tasks as axis-aligned boxes whose volumetric overlaps capture asymmetric relations like containment and transferability, supporting prediction and visualization of dataset relationships.
nodes.problem: Task and dataset relationships are asymmetric but symmetric embeddings and visualizations cannot capture them.
nodes.approach: Box embeddings of tasks, learned from task representations such as CLIP or Task2Vec.
nodes.niche_reason: Box embeddings for task relations are an unusual angle.

nodes.title: Template Free Reconstruction of Human-object Interaction with Procedural Interaction Generation
nodes.tldr: ProciGen procedurally generates 1M+ human-object interaction pairs to train a hierarchical diffusion model that reconstructs humans and unseen objects from one RGB image, template-free.
nodes.problem: Template-free 3D human-object interaction reconstruction fails to generalize beyond curated datasets.
nodes.approach: Procedural interaction data generation plus image-conditioned hierarchical diffusion model for joint reconstruction.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
secondary_topics: Computer Vision › Human Pose, Avatars & Faces
Data, Benchmarks & Evaluation › Synthetic Data & Data Curation
nodes.niche_reason: Human-object reconstruction is established but specialised.

nodes.title: Text Is MASS: Modeling as Stochastic Embedding for Text-Video Retrieval
nodes.tldr: Models text as a stochastic embedding with a learned radius, so each caption covers a range of semantics, improving text-video retrieval recall.
nodes.problem: Short text captions give a single embedding too little expressiveness to match rich video content.
nodes.approach: Stochastic text mass with similarity-aware radius and support-text regularization.
nodes.niche_reason: Text-video retrieval is crowded; stochastic text modeling is less common.

nodes.title: The Devil is in the Fine-Grained Details: Evaluating Open-Vocabulary Object Detectors for Fine-Grained Understanding
nodes.tldr: Benchmarks open-vocabulary object detectors on fine-grained attributes such as color, pattern, and material, using hard-negative classes.
nodes.problem: Unclear whether open-vocabulary detectors truly understand fine-grained object properties and parts.
nodes.approach: Dynamic vocabulary generation protocol with a graded benchmark suite that probes attributes against hard negatives.
nodes.niche_reason: Common open-vocabulary detection evaluation; fine-grained angle.

nodes.title: The More You See in 2D the More You Perceive in 3D
nodes.tldr: Reconstructs 3D objects and novel views from arbitrary unposed images by test-time fine-tuning a view-conditioned diffusion model with camera pose estimation.
nodes.problem: Reconstructing 3D objects from a few unposed images requires accurate camera poses and strong priors.
nodes.approach: Test-time fine-tuning of a view-conditioned diffusion model jointly with camera poses as instance-specific priors.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: Diffusion-prior few-view 3D reconstruction is a common direction

nodes.title: The Unreasonable Effectiveness of Pre-Trained Features for Camera Pose Refinement
nodes.tldr: Shows generic pre-trained features with a particle filter and renderable scene representation reach state-of-the-art camera pose refinement without training.
nodes.problem: Camera pose refinement usually needs task-specific feature or scene representation training.
nodes.approach: Pre-trained generic features combined with a particle filter over a renderable scene representation.
secondary_topics: Computer Vision › Vision Foundation Models & Self-Supervision
nodes.niche_reason: Pose refinement with generic features is specialized.

nodes.title: Time- Memory- and Parameter-Efficient Visual Adaptation
nodes.tldr: Parameter-, time- and memory-efficient visual adaptation that trains a parallel lightweight network on frozen backbone features, with no backbone backpropagation.
nodes.problem: Adapter methods save trainable parameters but still backpropagate through the whole backbone.
nodes.approach: Lightweight parallel network operating on frozen pretrained backbone features, scaled to a 4B-parameter ViT.
secondary_topics: Computer Vision › Vision Foundation Models & Self-Supervision
nodes.confidence_reason: PEFT for vision lacks a dedicated topic; placement is a judgment call
nodes.niche_reason: PEFT for vision is a crowded adaptation area

nodes.title: Total Selfie: Generating Full-Body Selfies
nodes.tldr: Generates full-body selfies in a target pose and background from four close-up selfies of face and body using a diffusion-based approach.
nodes.problem: Close-up selfies have limited field of view and distorted perspective versus photos taken from a distance.
nodes.approach: Diffusion model conditioned on face and body selfies, target pose and background image.
nodes.niche_reason: Selfie extension to full-body is an unusual application.

nodes.title: Total-Decom: Decomposed 3D Scene Reconstruction with Minimal Interaction
nodes.tldr: Total-Decom decomposes multi-view 3D scene reconstruction into objects with minimal interaction, combining SAM with hybrid implicit-explicit surfaces and mesh region growing.
nodes.problem: Reconstructed neural surface scenes lack decomposed, editable object entities.
nodes.approach: SAM masks fused with hybrid neural surface representation and mesh-based region growing for object decomposition.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: Decomposed reconstruction is established but specialised.

nodes.title: Towards Accurate Post-training Quantization for Diffusion Models
nodes.tldr: Post-training quantization for diffusion models using timestep-specific quantizers and timestep-informed calibration image selection to reduce errors.
nodes.problem: Shared quantizers and random calibration timesteps cause large errors in quantized diffusion models.
nodes.approach: Timestep-group distribution-aware quantizers found by differentiable search, plus informative calibration image generation.
nodes.primary_topic: Architectures & Training › Efficient Training, Compression & Pruning
nodes.niche_reason: Quantizing diffusion models is a common efficiency direction

nodes.title: Towards Learning a Generalist Model for Embodied Navigation
nodes.tldr: NaviLLM is a generalist embodied navigation model that adapts an LLM using schema-based instructions to unify navigation, QA and captioning tasks.
nodes.problem: Task-specific embodied navigation agents lack generalization
nodes.approach: Cast diverse tasks as generation via schema-based instruction; train LLM on mixed datasets
secondary_topics: Audio, Speech & Multimodal › Embodied Multimodal Agents
nodes.niche_reason: LLM-based embodied navigation is established but specialised.

nodes.title: Towards a Simultaneous and Granular Identity-Expression Control in Personalized Face Generation
nodes.tldr: Diffusion-based multimodal face generation framework giving simultaneous identity and fine-grained expression control, down to emotional vocabulary.
nodes.problem: Text-to-image models fail to keep identity while varying expressions in portraits.
nodes.approach: Diffusion model with multimodal identity and expression conditioning, including fine-grained emotion words.
secondary_topics: Computer Vision › Human Pose, Avatars & Faces
nodes.niche_reason: Personalized face generation is a well-trodden diffusion application.

nodes.title: Transductive Zero-Shot and Few-Shot CLIP
nodes.tldr: Transductive zero-shot and few-shot CLIP classification jointly infers labels over unlabeled query batches using a Dirichlet model and block majorization-minimization.
nodes.problem: CLIP adaptation treats test samples independently, ignoring transductive batch structure.
nodes.approach: Dirichlet class models on vision-text probability features, optimized with block majorization-minimization.
nodes.niche_reason: Transductive CLIP inference is a specialised sub-direction.

nodes.title: Tri-Modal Motion Retrieval by Learning a Joint Embedding Space
nodes.tldr: Aligns text, video, and 3D human motion in one embedding space via contrastive learning, using video as a bridge to enable video-to-motion retrieval.
nodes.problem: Text-to-motion performance is limited by scarce motion data and the large text-motion modality gap.
nodes.approach: Video-language-motion contrastive alignment with a motion reconstruction branch.
nodes.primary_topic: Audio, Speech & Multimodal › Audio-Visual & Cross-modal Learning
secondary_topics: Computer Vision › Human Pose, Avatars & Faces
nodes.confidence_reason: tri-modal motion alignment has no exact vocabulary topic
nodes.niche_reason: tri-modal motion retrieval is a specialised niche

nodes.title: Tune-An-Ellipse: CLIP Has Potential to Find What You Want
nodes.tldr: Differentiable Visual Prompting uses CLIP and tuned ellipses to localise objects from text prompts, enabling zero-shot referring expression comprehension without object proposals.
nodes.problem: CLIP's visual prompts such as red circles cannot localise objects without precise object proposals.
nodes.approach: Optimise ellipse coefficients with three differentiable losses starting from anchor ellipses.
nodes.niche_reason: visual prompting for localization is specialised

nodes.title: TutteNet: Injective 3D Deformations by Composition of 2D Mesh Deformations
nodes.tldr: Represents injective 3D deformations as compositions of differentiable 2D Tutte-embedding mesh maps, enabling artifact-free NeRF and SDF deformations.
nodes.problem: Injective 3D deformations are inaccurate, fragile, and hard to combine with learning frameworks.
nodes.approach: Stacks differentiable Tutte-embedding mesh layers over multiple planes to build 3D injective maps.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
secondary_topics: Architectures & Training › Differentiable Optimization & Structured Layers
nodes.confidence_reason: Could fit 3D deformation or NeRF geometry topics about equally.
nodes.niche_reason: Injective 3D deformation via 2D Tutte embeddings is unusual

nodes.title: Tyche: Stochastic In-Context Learning for Medical Image Segmentation
nodes.tldr: Segments unseen medical image tasks in-context from a context set, producing diverse plausible masks for annotator uncertainty without retraining.
nodes.problem: Medical segmentation needs retraining per task and gives one mask despite annotator disagreement.
nodes.approach: Convolution blocks enabling inter-prediction interaction plus in-context test-time augmentation for stochasticity.
nodes.niche_reason: Stochastic in-context medical segmentation is specialised

nodes.title: UFOGen: You Forward Once Large Scale Text-to-Image Generation via Diffusion GANs
nodes.tldr: UFOGen generates high-quality text-to-image outputs in a single step by combining diffusion models with a GAN objective, initialized from pretrained diffusion.
nodes.problem: Multi-step text-to-image diffusion inference is computationally expensive, limiting real-time generation.
nodes.approach: Diffusion-GAN objective initialized from a pretrained diffusion model for one-step generation.
secondary_topics: Generative Models › GANs, VAEs & Normalizing Flows
nodes.confidence_reason: Diffusion-GAN hybrid straddles diffusion and GAN topics
nodes.niche_reason: Few-step text-to-image generation is a crowded mainstream direction.

nodes.title: Unbiased Estimator for Distorted Conics in Camera Calibration
nodes.tldr: Moment-based formulation for conic camera calibration, showing the first moment of a distorted conic is unbiased, enabling accurate sub-pixel circle detection and calibration under distortion.
nodes.problem: Conic features lose their shape under lens distortion, hampering conic-based camera calibration.
nodes.approach: Track conic moments through projection and distortion using an unbiased first-moment estimator.
nodes.niche_reason: Classical geometric camera calibration is rare at ML venues.

nodes.title: Unbiased Faster R-CNN for Single-source Domain Generalized Object Detection
nodes.tldr: Uses a causal structural model to build augmentation and attention modules that reduce scene and attribute confounding for single-source domain generalized detection.
nodes.problem: Detectors trained on one domain learn biased, non-causal features that fail on unseen domains.
nodes.approach: Global-local transformation augmentation, invariance-trained causal attention, and causal prototype learning.
secondary_topics: Architectures & Training › Domain Adaptation & OOD Generalization
Learning Theory & Optimization › Causality & Causal Inference
nodes.niche_reason: Domain generalization for detection is a common, active area

nodes.title: Uncertainty-aware Action Decoupling Transformer for Action Anticipation
nodes.tldr: Decouples action anticipation into verb and noun predictions that assist each other, fusing two uncertainty-weighted Transformer streams for joint prediction.
nodes.problem: Predicting verb-noun action pairs jointly ignores their separate, complementary structure.
nodes.approach: Two-stream verb-to-noun and noun-to-verb Transformers with probabilistic uncertainty-based feature selection and fusion.
nodes.niche_reason: Action anticipation is an established video topic

nodes.title: Understanding Video Transformers via Universal Concept Discovery
nodes.tldr: Unsupervised discovery of spatiotemporal concepts inside video transformers, ranked by importance, revealing object-centric reasoning mechanisms.
nodes.problem: Concept-based interpretability has only covered images, not video transformers' temporal concepts.
nodes.approach: Unsupervised unit identification in transformer representations, ranked by output importance and shared across models.
nodes.niche_reason: Concept discovery in video transformers is rare.

nodes.title: UniDepth: Universal Monocular Metric Depth Estimation
nodes.tldr: UniDepth predicts metric 3D points from a single image across domains, using a self-promptable camera module and geometric invariance losses.
nodes.problem: Monocular metric depth estimation generalizes poorly to unseen domains and unknown cameras.
nodes.approach: Self-promptable camera module with pseudo-spherical output representation and geometric invariance loss.
nodes.niche_reason: Monocular depth is a common topic.

nodes.title: UniMODE: Unified Monocular 3D Object Detection
nodes.tldr: UniMODE is a BEV-based monocular 3D detector handling indoor and outdoor data jointly via uneven BEV grids, sparse projection and domain alignment.
nodes.problem: Training one monocular 3D detector on diverse indoor and outdoor datasets suffers from geometry and domain heterogeneity.
nodes.approach: Two-stage BEV detector with uneven BEV grid, sparse BEV feature projection, and unified domain alignment.
nodes.niche_reason: Monocular 3D detection is established; unified indoor-outdoor is specialised.

nodes.title: Unified-IO 2: Scaling Autoregressive Multimodal Models with Vision Language Audio and Action
nodes.tldr: Presents Unified-IO 2, a single encoder-decoder transformer that takes and generates text, images, audio and video through shared tokens across over 120 datasets.
nodes.problem: Unifying understanding and generation across text, image, audio and video in one model.
