nodes.approach: Tokenizes all modalities into a shared semantic space, trained from scratch then multi-task fine-tuned.
secondary_topics: Computer Vision › Vision Foundation Models & Self-Supervision
Audio, Speech & Multimodal › Audio-Visual & Cross-modal Learning
nodes.niche_reason: Unified multimodal models are a crowded mainstream direction

nodes.title: Unifying Correspondence Pose and NeRF for Generalized Pose-Free Novel View Synthesis
nodes.tldr: Jointly trains correspondence matching, camera pose estimation and NeRF rendering end-to-end from stereo pairs, enabling novel view synthesis without known poses.
nodes.problem: Novel view synthesis needs accurate camera poses, which are often unavailable for stereo inputs.
nodes.approach: Shared representation feeding correspondence, pose and NeRF heads, trained with a unified end-to-end objective.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: Pose-free NeRF is an active, common research direction

nodes.title: Unsupervised Keypoints from Pretrained Diffusion Models
nodes.tldr: Finds unsupervised keypoints by optimizing text embeddings so cross-attention maps in a pretrained text-to-image diffusion model localize as small Gaussians, rivaling supervised methods.
nodes.problem: Unsupervised keypoint discovery lags supervised methods, especially on non-aligned, less curated data.
nodes.approach: Optimize text embeddings so denoising network cross-attention maps become compact Gaussian regions marking keypoints.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › Vision Foundation Models & Self-Supervision
nodes.confidence_reason: Keypoint discovery fits several vision topics; no exact match.
nodes.niche_reason: Unsupervised keypoints from diffusion models is an unusual direction.

nodes.title: Unsupervised Occupancy Learning from Sparse Point Cloud
nodes.tldr: Learns occupancy fields from sparse point clouds without ground truth, sampling the decision boundary via a margin-based uncertainty measure.
nodes.problem: Learning signed distance fields from point clouds without supervision is very challenging.
nodes.approach: Predict occupancy instead of SDF, supervise boundary samples with the input cloud, and regularize entropy early.
secondary_topics: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: Established but specialised: unsupervised occupancy learning.

nodes.title: Upscale-A-Video: Temporal-Consistent Diffusion Model for Real-World Video Super-Resolution
nodes.tldr: A text-guided latent diffusion framework for real-world video super-resolution with local temporal layers and a training-free flow-guided recurrent latent propagation for global consistency.
nodes.problem: Diffusion models give fidelity and temporal consistency problems when applied to video super-resolution.
nodes.approach: Temporal layers in U-Net and VAE decoder plus flow-guided recurrent latent propagation, with text and noise controls.
nodes.niche_reason: Diffusion-based video super-resolution is a common direction.

nodes.title: VA3: Virtually Assured Amplification Attack on Probabilistic Copyright Protection for Text-to-Image Generative Models
nodes.tldr: Shows probabilistic copyright protections for text-to-image models can be defeated by an online attack that amplifies infringing generation with a theoretical success lower bound.
nodes.problem: Probabilistic copyright protections for text-to-image models may fail under repeated interactions
nodes.approach: Online attack framework that repeatedly queries the model to amplify the probability of infringing outputs
nodes.niche_reason: Copyright attacks on probabilistic protection are rare

nodes.title: VBench: Comprehensive Benchmark Suite for Video Generative Models
nodes.tldr: VBench is a hierarchical benchmark suite of 16 disentangled dimensions for evaluating video generation, validated against human preference annotations.
nodes.problem: Existing video generation metrics do not align well with human perception or reveal model weaknesses.
nodes.approach: Decomposes quality into dimensions with tailored prompts, evaluation methods, and a human preference dataset.
nodes.primary_topic: Generative Models › Generative Model Evaluation & Theory
nodes.niche_reason: video generation evaluation is a busy, mainstream area

nodes.title: VGGSfM: Visual Geometry Grounded Deep Structure From Motion
nodes.tldr: Introduces a fully differentiable structure-from-motion pipeline that recovers all cameras at once from 2D point tracks, trained end-to-end with differentiable bundle adjustment.
nodes.problem: Classical SfM pipelines are non-differentiable and built from separately tuned, incremental steps.
nodes.approach: Deep 2D point tracking for pixel-accurate tracks, simultaneous camera recovery, and differentiable bundle adjustment.
secondary_topics: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: End-to-end differentiable SfM is specialised yet an active research line

nodes.title: VMINer: Versatile Multi-view Inverse Rendering with Near- and Far-field Light Sources
nodes.tldr: Recovers scene geometry and materials from multi-view images under near- and far-field lights, disentangling lighting and exporting textured meshes.
nodes.problem: Inverse rendering is ambiguous: geometry, material, and lighting are entangled in captured images.
nodes.approach: Lightweight lighting model combining neural radiance field and physically-based surface rendering on implicit fields.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: Near- and far-field inverse rendering is a specialised niche

nodes.title: VTimeLLM: Empower LLM to Grasp Video Moments
nodes.tldr: VTimeLLM is a video LLM trained in three boundary-aware stages to localize event start and end times, excelling at temporal grounding and dense captioning.
nodes.problem: Video LLMs describe videos coarsely and cannot capture precise temporal boundaries of events.
nodes.approach: Three-stage training: image-text alignment, multi-event boundary awareness, and video instruction tuning.
nodes.niche_reason: Video LLMs are common; temporal grounding focus is moderately specialised.

nodes.title: Vanishing-Point-Guided Video Semantic Segmentation of Driving Scenes
nodes.tldr: Video semantic segmentation for driving that uses vanishing-point priors for motion-guided cross-frame correspondence and dense feature mining at low computational cost.
nodes.problem: Video segmentation for driving needs costly cross-frame correspondence and struggles with distant regions
nodes.approach: Vanishing-point guided motion fusion and dense feature mining in a context-detail network
nodes.niche_reason: Driving VSS is established; vanishing-point priors are a rare angle

nodes.title: VecFusion: Vector Font Generation with Diffusion
nodes.tldr: Cascaded diffusion generating vector fonts: a raster diffusion model gives low-res glyphs with control points, then a transformer vector diffusion model synthesizes precise curves.
nodes.problem: Generating vector fonts with varied topology and precise control point positions.
nodes.approach: Cascaded raster-then-vector diffusion with a transformer and a novel vector representation.
nodes.niche_reason: Vector graphics and font generation is a rare generative niche.

nodes.title: ViT-CoMer: Vision Transformer with Convolutional Multi-scale Feature Interaction for Dense Predictions
nodes.tldr: A plain pre-training-free ViT backbone augmented with multi-scale convolutional features and CNN-transformer bidirectional fusion for dense prediction like detection and segmentation.
nodes.problem: Plain ViTs underperform on dense prediction due to weak local interaction and single-scale features.
nodes.approach: Inject multi-receptive-field convolutional pyramid features into ViT with a bidirectional CNN-Transformer fusion module.
nodes.niche_reason: ViT adapters for dense prediction are a common direction.

nodes.title: ViVid-1-to-3: Novel View Synthesis with Video Diffusion Models
nodes.tldr: Synthesizes novel object views from one image by denoising a camera-orbit scanning video with a pretrained video diffusion model.
nodes.problem: Single-image novel view synthesis struggles with multi-view consistency and following the target camera pose.
nodes.approach: Reformulates view synthesis as video generation along a smooth camera trajectory, denoised by view and video diffusion models.
nodes.niche_reason: novel view synthesis is a popular direction

nodes.title: View-Category Interactive Sharing Transformer for Incomplete Multi-View Multi-Label Learning
nodes.tldr: Proposes a transformer that models view-label interactions with KNN-style missing-view generation for incomplete multi-view multi-label classification.
nodes.problem: Real multi-view multi-label data has missing views and labels that existing methods ignore.
nodes.approach: Two-layer view-category transformer, KNN missing-view generation, and consistency-guided embedding enhancement.
nodes.confidence_reason: Multi-view multi-label has no clean topic; architecture chosen
nodes.niche_reason: Multi-view multi-label with missing data is a specialised setting

nodes.title: Visual Concept Connectome (VCC): Open World Concept Discovery and their Interlayer Connections in Deep Models
nodes.tldr: Visual Concept Connectome discovers interpretable concepts and their interlayer connections across a whole vision network without supervision, enabling failure-mode debugging.
nodes.problem: Understanding concepts learned across all layers of vision models, not just single layers.
nodes.approach: Unsupervised concept discovery per layer with interlayer connection weightings forming a concept graph.
nodes.niche_reason: Concept-based interpretability is established; multilayer connectome is specialised.

nodes.title: Visual Objectification in Films: Towards a New AI Task for Video Interpretation
nodes.tldr: Introduces the task of detecting character objectification in films, with the ObyGaze12 dataset of 1914 expert-annotated clips and concept bottleneck model baselines.
nodes.problem: Detecting and quantifying cinematic objectification (male gaze) in film clips.
nodes.approach: New expert-annotated video dataset and concept bottleneck evaluation of vision models.
nodes.confidence_reason: Task-and-dataset paper; topic between video understanding and societal analysis.
nodes.niche_reason: Film gender studies applied to video AI is very rare.

nodes.title: Visual Point Cloud Forecasting enables Scalable Autonomous Driving
nodes.tldr: Pretrains visual encoders for driving by forecasting future point clouds from past images, improving 3D detection, motion forecasting, and planning.
nodes.problem: Driving encoders need semantics, 3D geometry, and temporal cues, which standard vision pretraining misses.
nodes.approach: Latent Rendering operator maps encoder features into 3D space to predict future point clouds.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › Vision Foundation Models & Self-Supervision
nodes.niche_reason: Point-cloud forecasting as driving pretraining is a specialised angle.

nodes.title: Volumetric Environment Representation for Vision-Language Navigation
nodes.tldr: Builds a voxelized 3D volumetric environment representation from multi-view features for vision-language navigation, trained with occupancy, layout and detection tasks, improving VLN benchmarks.
nodes.problem: VLN agents using 2D perspective features capture incomplete 3D geometry and semantics.
nodes.approach: Voxelize the scene via 2D-3D sampling, multi-task learn occupancy/layout/boxes, and use episodic memory.
nodes.niche_reason: VLN is an established but specialised embodied subfield.

nodes.title: Wonder3D: Single Image to 3D using Cross-Domain Diffusion
nodes.tldr: Generates textured meshes from a single image by diffusing multi-view normal maps and colors with cross-domain attention, fusing them into surfaces in minutes.
nodes.problem: Score distillation is slow and inconsistent, while direct feed-forward 3D is low quality.
nodes.approach: Cross-domain diffusion for multi-view normals and colors with cross-view attention and normal fusion.
secondary_topics: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: Single-image 3D diffusion is a crowded direction.

nodes.title: XCube: Large-Scale 3D Generative Modeling using Sparse Voxel Hierarchies
nodes.tldr: XCube generates high-resolution sparse voxel grids feed-forward via hierarchical voxel latent diffusion, scaling to 1024^3 objects and 100m outdoor scenes.
nodes.problem: Generating high-resolution 3D shapes and large outdoor scenes without slow test-time optimization.
nodes.approach: Coarse-to-fine hierarchical voxel latent diffusion built on the VDB sparse data structure.
nodes.niche_reason: Large-scale sparse voxel 3D generation is specialised.

nodes.title: Your Transferability Barrier is Fragile: Free-Lunch for Transferring the Non-Transferable Learning
nodes.tldr: Shows non-transferable learning IP protections are fragile, then recovers target-domain performance from few source samples via impairment-repair self-distillation.
nodes.problem: The transferability barrier of non-transferable learning, used for model IP protection, has not been stress-tested.
nodes.approach: Perturbs few source samples into third-party domains and fine-tunes with impairment-repair self-distillation.
secondary_topics: Architectures & Training › Domain Adaptation & OOD Generalization
nodes.confidence_reason: IP protection is closest to provenance, but the work is about domain generalization.
nodes.niche_reason: Attacks on non-transferable learning for model IP are rare.

nodes.title: Zero-Shot Structure-Preserving Diffusion Model for High Dynamic Range Tone Mapping
nodes.tldr: Zero-shot HDR tone mapping that transfers an LDR-trained model via a diffusion reverse process that preserves structure, using a dual-control network for detail.
nodes.problem: Paired HDR and high-quality LDR training data is hard to obtain for tone mapping
nodes.approach: Structure-preserving diffusion reverse sampling with structure and tonal decomposition
nodes.niche_reason: Diffusion-based tone mapping is specialised; zero-shot variant is rarer

nodes.title: eTraM: Event-based Traffic Monitoring Dataset
nodes.tldr: eTraM is a fully event-camera traffic monitoring dataset with 10 hours of data and 2M bounding boxes across eight traffic participant classes.
nodes.problem: Event cameras' potential for static traffic monitoring is unexplored for lack of datasets.
nodes.approach: Collect and annotate 10 hours of event data, then benchmark detectors like RVT, RED, and YOLOv8.
nodes.niche_reason: Event-based static traffic monitoring is a rare sensing and application niche.

nodes.title: mPLUG-Owl2: Revolutionizing Multi-modal Large Language Model with Modality Collaboration
nodes.tldr: Proposes mPLUG-Owl2, an MLLM with shared functional modules and a modality-adaptive module so text and vision tasks benefit from each other.
nodes.problem: Prior MLLMs focus on multimodal gains and do not exploit collaboration between text and vision modalities.
nodes.approach: Modularized design with a language decoder as universal interface, shared modules, and a modality-adaptive module.
nodes.niche_reason: Multimodal LLM architectures are a crowded mainstream area.

nodes.title: pix2gestalt: Amodal Segmentation by Synthesizing Wholes
nodes.tldr: pix2gestalt performs zero-shot amodal segmentation with a conditional diffusion model that synthesizes whole occluded objects, transferring large pretrained diffusion representations.
nodes.problem: Occluded objects are only partially visible, so amodal segmentation must estimate the shape and appearance of the whole object.
nodes.approach: Conditional diffusion trained on a synthetic dataset of occluded objects paired with their whole counterparts.
nodes.confidence_reason: Amodal segmentation task vs diffusion-based synthesis method
nodes.niche_reason: Zero-shot amodal completion via diffusion is a specialised niche.

nodes.title: 3D Convex Splatting: Radiance Field Rendering with 3D Smooth Convexes
nodes.tldr: Replaces Gaussians with smooth 3D convex primitives for radiance fields, capturing hard edges and flat surfaces with fewer primitives and better quality than 3DGS.
nodes.problem: 3D Gaussians struggle with hard edges and flat surfaces, needing many primitives and regularizers.
nodes.approach: Use smooth convex shapes as splatting primitives with a custom CUDA rasterizer.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: Gaussian splatting variants are very active, though new primitives are less common.

nodes.title: 3D Student Splatting and Scooping
nodes.tldr: Replaces Gaussians in 3D Gaussian Splatting with Student's t mixtures with positive and negative densities, plus a principled sampling optimizer, improving quality and parameter efficiency.
nodes.problem: Improving the fundamental representation of 3D Gaussian Splatting for expressivity and efficiency.
nodes.approach: Mixture of Student's t components with negative densities, learned via a principled sampling approach.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: 3DGS variants are common, though the negative-density mixture is unusual.

nodes.title: 3DTopia-XL: Scaling High-quality 3D Asset Generation via Primitive Diffusion
nodes.tldr: Generates high-resolution 3D assets with PBR materials from text or images using a primitive-based representation and a Diffusion Transformer.
nodes.problem: Existing 3D generators are slow, lack geometric fidelity, and rarely produce PBR-ready assets.
nodes.approach: PrimX tensorial primitive representation of shape, albedo and materials, with latent primitive diffusion over a DiT.
nodes.niche_reason: Primitive-based 3D asset generation with PBR is specialized.

nodes.title: 4Real-Video: Learning Generalizable Photo-Realistic 4D Video Diffusion
nodes.tldr: 4Real-Video generates 4D video grids over time and viewpoint with a two-stream diffusion transformer and synchronization layers exchanging information between viewpoint and temporal streams.
nodes.problem: Generating photorealistic, temporally and viewpoint-consistent 4D videos quickly and generalizably.
nodes.approach: Two-stream diffusion transformer, with viewpoint and temporal updates, connected by hard or soft synchronization layers.
nodes.niche_reason: 4D video generation is newer and less crowded than 2D video.

nodes.title: A Polarization-Aided Transformer for Image Deblurring via Motion Vector Decomposition
nodes.tldr: Deblurs images by decomposing motion into translational and rotational parts, using a Cartesian branch and a polar-system transformer for rotational blur.
nodes.problem: Deblurring treats rotational and translational motion jointly, performing poorly on complex rotation blur
nodes.approach: Motion Decomposition Transformer with deformable Cartesian and polar branches plus radial stripe attention
nodes.niche_reason: Rotational motion deblurring is a specialised subproblem

nodes.title: A Unified Approach to Interpreting Self-supervised Pre-training Methods for 3D Point Clouds via Interactions
nodes.tldr: Uses game-theoretic interactions to show 3D point-cloud pretraining strengthens high-order structure, and proposes a pretraining-free method that mimics it.
nodes.problem: Unclear what common mechanism makes different 3D point-cloud pre-training methods effective.
nodes.approach: Decompose DNN outputs into interaction effects and compare how pre-training shifts their strengths across orders.
nodes.confidence_reason: Could be interpretability or point-cloud self-supervision; both central.
nodes.niche_reason: Game-theoretic interaction analysis of point-cloud pretraining is an unusual angle.

nodes.title: AIpparel: A Multimodal Foundation Model for Digital Garments
nodes.tldr: AIpparel fine-tunes large multimodal models on a 120k garment dataset with a new sewing-pattern tokenization to generate and edit garments from text and images.
nodes.problem: Garment design is manual; no foundation model generates and edits sewing patterns.
nodes.approach: Fine-tune LMMs on curated multimodal garment data using a concise sewing pattern tokenization scheme.
nodes.niche_reason: Sewing pattern generation with LMMs is a very rare niche.

nodes.title: ALIEN: Implicit Neural Representations for Human Motion Prediction under Arbitrary Latency
nodes.tldr: Predicts future human poses under arbitrary latency by modelling motion as an implicit neural function with a Mamba-like hypernetwork and low-rank modulation.
nodes.problem: Human motion prediction ignoring network and compute latency, which varies across samples.
nodes.approach: Implicit neural representation weights from a linear-attention hypernetwork, with multi-task variable-delay pose reconstruction.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › Human Pose, Avatars & Faces
secondary_topics: Architectures & Training › Time Series & Sequential Data
nodes.niche_reason: Latency-aware motion prediction is a new, unusual task.

nodes.title: ARM: Appearance Reconstruction Model for Relightable 3D Generation
nodes.tldr: Reconstructs 3D meshes and relightable appearance from sparse-view images by decoupling geometry from appearance in UV texture space with a material prior.
nodes.problem: Image-to-3D models generate geometry well but produce unrealistic appearance from sparse views.
nodes.approach: UV-space appearance module with back-projected measurements and a material prior for appearance decomposition.
secondary_topics: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: Appearance-focused image-to-3D reconstruction is specialised.

nodes.title: Active Hyperspectral Imaging Using an Event Camera
nodes.tldr: Event-camera hyperspectral imaging that pairs a sweeping rainbow illumination with a rotating mirror to sample spectra continuously at low bandwidth.
nodes.problem: Hyperspectral cameras trade off capture speed, spectral resolution, and bandwidth in dynamic scenes.
nodes.approach: Encode spectral variation as temporal contrast in event streams, reducing reconstruction to geometric constraints.
nodes.confidence_reason: Imaging-system design fits no topic cleanly; Low-level Vision chosen.
nodes.niche_reason: Rare: event-camera hyperspectral sensing with active illumination.

nodes.title: AdaCM^2: On Understanding Extremely Long-Term Video with Adaptive Cross-Modality Memory Reduction
nodes.tldr: AdaCM^2 adaptively reduces cross-modality memory in an autoregressive manner for LLM-based long-video understanding, improving results while cutting GPU memory up to 65 percent.
nodes.problem: LLM-based video models handle only short videos, and visual-only memory compression ignores correlation with textual queries.
nodes.approach: Adaptive cross-modality memory reduction merging video tokens guided by text queries over streaming video.
secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › Long Context & Memory
nodes.niche_reason: Video LLM long-context methods are common.

nodes.title: Advancing Multiple Instance Learning with Continual Learning for Whole Slide Imaging
nodes.tldr: Analyzes forgetting in attention MIL models and proposes attention knowledge distillation and a pseudo-bag memory pool for continual learning on whole slide images.
nodes.problem: Multiple instance learning models for whole slide images cannot adapt to evolving data without retraining.
nodes.approach: Attention Knowledge Distillation plus Pseudo-Bag Memory Pool storing informative patches.
nodes.niche_reason: Continual learning for pathology MIL is a rare combination.

nodes.title: Align3R: Aligned Monocular Depth Estimation for Dynamic Videos
nodes.tldr: Makes monocular depth temporally consistent across video frames by aligning per-frame depths with fine-tuned DUSt3R, recovering poses too.
nodes.problem: Single-image depth estimators give inconsistent depth across frames of dynamic videos.
nodes.approach: Fine-tunes DUSt3R with estimated monocular depth as input, then jointly optimizes depth maps and camera poses.
secondary_topics: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: video depth consistency is an active area

nodes.title: All Languages Matter: Evaluating LMMs on Culturally Diverse 100 Languages
nodes.tldr: ALM-bench evaluates large multimodal models on culturally diverse images and questions across 100 languages and 13 cultural aspects, emphasizing low-resource languages.
nodes.problem: LMMs focus on few regions and languages and lack evaluation of cultural and multilingual understanding.
nodes.approach: Large benchmark with true/false, multiple-choice and open-ended questions on culturally curated images in 100 languages.
nodes.niche_reason: Cultural and multilingual multimodal evaluation is specialised.

nodes.title: All-Optical Nonlinear Diffractive Deep Network for Ultrafast Image Denoising
nodes.tldr: All-optical nonlinear diffractive network that denoises images at the speed of light, fabricated via 3D printing and about 3,800 times faster than electronic denoisers.
nodes.problem: Electronic chip denoisers suffer latency and high computational cost.
nodes.approach: Diffractive network with image encoding, nonlinear phase activation, and reinforcement-learned parameters.
nodes.confidence_reason: Optical hardware denoising straddles low-level vision and ML systems.
nodes.niche_reason: Optical diffractive denoising networks are a very rare direction.

nodes.title: All-directional Disparity Estimation for Real-world QPD Images
nodes.tldr: Estimates horizontal and vertical disparity from quad-pixel sensors using illumination-invariant features, coarse-to-fine refinement, and a new real-world QPD dataset.
nodes.problem: Uneven illumination, narrow baselines and scarce data hinder QPD disparity estimation.
nodes.approach: Dual-pixel network with illumination-invariant module and edge-aware fusion of two-directional disparities.
nodes.niche_reason: Quad-photodiode disparity estimation is a rare sensor niche

nodes.title: Annotation Ambiguity Aware Semi-Supervised Medical Image Segmentation
nodes.tldr: Semi-supervised medical segmentation that uses multi-annotator labels and pruned decoders to produce diverse, plausible segmentation maps.
nodes.problem: Segmentation models give one mask despite annotator disagreement and scarce labeled medical data
nodes.approach: Diverse pseudo-labels from randomly pruned decoders, a shared latent space, and cross-decoder supervision.
nodes.niche_reason: Specialised medical segmentation with annotator ambiguity

nodes.title: AnySat: One Earth Observation Model for Many Resolutions, Scales, and Modalities
nodes.tldr: AnySat is a JEPA-based self-supervised Earth observation model handling varied resolutions, scales and modalities with scale-adaptive encoders, trained on the GeoPlex collection.
nodes.problem: Geospatial models assume fixed input configurations and fail to unify diverse sensors.
nodes.approach: JEPA with scale-adaptive spatial encoders trained jointly on five heterogeneous multimodal datasets.
secondary_topics: Computer Vision › Vision Foundation Models & Self-Supervision
nodes.niche_reason: Earth observation foundation models are established but specialised.

nodes.title: ArcPro: Architectural Programs for Structured 3D Abstraction of Sparse Points
nodes.tldr: Maps sparse, noisy building point clouds to architectural programs with an encoder-decoder, producing structured 3D abstractions via a domain-specific language.
nodes.problem: Recovering structured 3D building abstractions from highly sparse, low-quality point clouds is hard.
nodes.approach: Transformer decoder autoregressively predicts tokenized architectural programs from 3D convolutional point features.
secondary_topics: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: Procedural architectural modeling from points is specialised.

nodes.title: Assessing and Learning Alignment of Unimodal Vision and Language Models
nodes.tldr: Presents SAIL, a transfer framework aligning pretrained unimodal vision and language models with a fraction of CLIP's paired data, reaching 73.4% ImageNet zero-shot.
nodes.problem: CLIP-style vision-language models need huge paired image-text data and training from scratch.
nodes.approach: Linear-probe-inspired alignment assessment, then transfer-learning alignment of pretrained vision and language models.
secondary_topics: Computer Vision › Vision Foundation Models & Self-Supervision
nodes.niche_reason: Vision-language alignment via transfer is a crowded CLIP-adjacent area

nodes.title: Augmented Deep Contexts for Spatially Embedded Video Coding
nodes.tldr: SEVC neural video codec compresses low-resolution video as spatial reference, combining spatial and temporal contexts and priors to handle large motion, saving 11.9% bitrate.
nodes.problem: Temporal-only neural video codecs struggle with large motions and newly emerging objects.
nodes.approach: Spatial references plus augmented motion vectors, spatial-guided latent priors, and joint spatial-temporal optimization.
nodes.niche_reason: Neural video coding is a small specialised community.

nodes.title: BADGR: Bundle Adjustment Diffusion Conditioned by Gradients for Wide-Baseline Floor Plan Reconstruction
nodes.tldr: Jointly refines camera poses and floor plan layouts with a diffusion model conditioned on Levenberg-Marquardt bundle adjustment outputs, trained only on 2D floor plans.
nodes.problem: Recovering precise poses and floor layouts from sparse wide-baseline panoramas is unsolved.
nodes.approach: Diffusion-based layout generation complements per-column LM bundle adjustment with learned wall-structure constraints.
nodes.niche_reason: panorama floor-plan reconstruction is a rare geometry problem

nodes.title: BEVDiffuser: Plug-and-Play Diffusion Model for BEV Denoising with Ground-Truth Guidance
nodes.tldr: Uses a diffusion model, guided by ground-truth object layouts, to denoise BEV feature maps, boosting existing 3D detectors without architecture changes.
nodes.problem: Sensor and learning noise in bird's-eye-view representations degrades downstream autonomous driving perception.
nodes.approach: Plug-and-play training-time diffusion denoiser conditioned on ground-truth object layout, operating on BEV feature maps.
nodes.confidence_reason: Diffusion used as a BEV feature denoiser; driving vs diffusion is a judgment call
nodes.niche_reason: BEV detection is crowded; diffusion denoising for BEV is a modest twist

nodes.title: BWFormer: Building Wireframe Reconstruction from Airborne LiDAR Point Cloud with Transformer
nodes.tldr: BWFormer reconstructs building wireframes from airborne LiDAR by predicting 2D corners from a height map, lifting them to 3D, and linking edges with attention.
nodes.problem: Building wireframe reconstruction from irregular airborne LiDAR has a large 3D search space and few datasets.
nodes.approach: 2D height-map corner detection, 3D corner lifting with a Transformer, and edge attention, with diffusion-based LiDAR data augmentation.
nodes.niche_reason: Building wireframe reconstruction from airborne LiDAR is a specialised niche.

nodes.title: Balanced Rate-Distortion Optimization in Learned Image Compression
nodes.tldr: Reformulates learned image compression rate-distortion optimization as multi-objective optimization, with gradient strategies that balance rate and distortion updates.
nodes.problem: Diverse rate and distortion gradients cause imbalanced updates that let one objective dominate.
nodes.approach: Coarse-to-fine gradient descent for training from scratch, and quadratic programming for fine-tuning.
nodes.niche_reason: learned compression is established; gradient balancing for R-D is specialised

nodes.title: BlenderGym: Benchmarking Foundational Model Systems for Graphics Editing
nodes.tldr: A benchmark for VLM systems on 3D graphics editing in Blender via code-based reconstruction, also studying how inference scaling and verifiers affect performance.
nodes.problem: No comprehensive benchmark exists for evaluating VLM systems on realistic 3D graphics editing.
nodes.approach: Code-based Blender 3D reconstruction tasks, evaluating VLM systems and inference scaling with generation and verification.
secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › Code Generation & Software
nodes.niche_reason: VLM benchmark for Blender 3D editing is an unusual niche.

nodes.title: Blurred LiDAR for Sharper 3D: Robust Handheld 3D Scanning with Diffuse LiDAR and RGB
nodes.tldr: Uses diffuse (blurred) LiDAR flash fused with RGB in a Gaussian surfel renderer with adaptive loss, giving denser depth for handheld 3D scanning.
nodes.problem: Sparse handheld LiDAR gives poor scene coverage; RGB-based reconstruction fails in low-texture scenes.
nodes.approach: Diffuse LiDAR fused with RGB via Gaussian surfel rendering and scene-adaptive loss balancing.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: Diffuse LiDAR as a scanning sensor is an unusual modality for reconstruction

nodes.title: Boost Your Human Image Generation Model via Direct Preference Optimization
nodes.tldr: HG-DPO improves human image generation by applying DPO with real images as winners, using a curriculum to make training feasible, and extends to personalized generation.
nodes.problem: Generated human images have anatomy, pose and detail errors that harm realism.
nodes.approach: DPO with real images as winning samples plus a curriculum learning schedule.
secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › Alignment & Preference Optimization
nodes.niche_reason: Preference-tuning of diffusion models is a common recent direction.

nodes.title: Breaking the Memory Barrier of Contrastive Loss via Tile-Based Strategy
nodes.tldr: Computes contrastive loss in tiles with ring-based multi-GPU communication and fused kernels, cutting memory so CLIP trains with 4M batches on 8 GPUs.
nodes.problem: Full similarity matrix materialization in contrastive loss makes large-batch training memory-prohibitive.
nodes.approach: Tile-based loss computation with multi-level tiling: ring communication across GPUs and fused CUDA kernels.
nodes.niche_reason: Memory-efficient contrastive training is a common systems concern.

nodes.title: CADDreamer: CAD Object Generation from Single-view Images
nodes.tldr: CADDreamer generates compact, structured B-rep CAD models from one image using a primitive-aware multi-view diffusion model and primitive fitting/optimization.
nodes.problem: 3D generative models produce dense unstructured meshes unlike compact, clean CAD models.
nodes.approach: Primitive-aware multi-view diffusion encoding primitive semantics in color, then fitting to produce B-rep.
nodes.niche_reason: Structured CAD B-rep generation is uncommon versus mesh/NeRF 3D generation.

nodes.title: CAP-Net: A Unified Network for 6D Pose and Size Estimation of Categorical Articulated Parts from a Single RGB-D Image
nodes.tldr: CAP-Net is a single-stage RGB-D network predicting 6D pose and size of categorical articulated parts, with the new RGBD-Art dataset and demonstrated sim-to-real robotic use.
nodes.problem: Category-level articulated part pose estimation ignoring RGB semantics in multi-stage geometric pipelines.
nodes.approach: Unified network predicting point-wise class, centroid offsets and NPCS maps, followed by clustering and alignment.
nodes.niche_reason: Specialised articulated object pose estimation.

nodes.title: CARE Transformer: Mobile-Friendly Linear Visual Transformer via Decoupled Dual Interaction
nodes.tldr: Introduces a decoupled dual-interactive linear attention for mobile-friendly visual transformers, separating local and global learning with a memory unit and interaction module.
nodes.problem: Linear-complexity visual transformers either gain little efficiency or lose much accuracy on mobile.
nodes.approach: Asymmetric feature decoupling, dynamic memory unit, and dual local-global interaction module.
nodes.niche_reason: Efficient linear attention for vision is a common direction

nodes.title: CASAGPT: Cuboid Arrangement and Scene Assembly for Interior Design
nodes.tldr: CASAGPT autoregressively arranges cuboid primitives for indoor scene synthesis, using rejection sampling to reduce collisions, and releases a cleaned 3D-FRONT-NC dataset.
nodes.problem: Indoor scene synthesis with physically plausible, collision-free object layouts.
nodes.approach: Autoregressive cuboid arrangement model with rejection-sampling fine-tuning to filter collisions.
nodes.niche_reason: Indoor scene synthesis is established but specialised.

nodes.title: CASP: Compression of Large Multimodal Models Based on Attention Sparsity
nodes.tldr: CASP compresses large multimodal models by exploiting attention sparsity: low-rank decomposition of Query/Key weights plus optimal bit allocation, boosting 2-bit quantization.
nodes.problem: Extreme low-bit compression of large multimodal models is underexplored.
nodes.approach: Data-aware low-rank decomposition of Q and K weights, then quantization with optimal bit allocation.
nodes.primary_topic: Architectures & Training › Efficient Training, Compression & Pruning
nodes.niche_reason: LLM quantization is a crowded area, with a multimodal twist.

nodes.title: CCIN: Compositional Conflict Identification and Neutralization for Composed Image Retrieval
nodes.tldr: CCIN identifies conflicting attributes between a reference image and modification text via an LLM, then neutralizes them with kept-instruction guidance for composed image retrieval.
nodes.problem: Conflicts between reference image attributes and modification instructions hinder composed image retrieval.
nodes.approach: LLM-based conflict identification followed by neutralization guided by a kept instruction and the modified instruction.
nodes.niche_reason: Composed image retrieval is a focused subfield.

nodes.title: CH3Depth: Efficient and Flexible Depth Foundation Model with Flow Matching
nodes.tldr: CH3Depth is a flow-matching depth foundation model with non-uniform sampling and a latent temporal stabilizer, giving efficient, temporally consistent zero-shot image and video depth.
nodes.problem: Depth estimation needing fine detail, temporal consistency and efficiency simultaneously.
nodes.approach: Flow matching reframed as Inversion by Direct Iteration, non-uniform sampling, latent temporal stabilizer.
nodes.niche_reason: Generative depth estimation is specialised but increasingly common.

nodes.title: CL-MoE: Enhancing Multimodal Large Language Model with Dual Momentum Mixture-of-Experts for Continual Visual Question Answering
nodes.tldr: CL-MoE adds dual-router and momentum mixture-of-experts to multimodal LLMs for continual visual question answering, reducing forgetting across 10 VQA tasks.
nodes.problem: MLLMs suffer catastrophic forgetting on non-stationary data streams in continual VQA.
nodes.approach: Task- and instance-level routers select experts, with momentum updates based on expert-task relationships.
secondary_topics: Architectures & Training › Mixture of Experts & Sparsity
nodes.niche_reason: Continual learning for MLLMs is specialised.

nodes.title: COUNTS: Benchmarking Object Detectors and Multimodal Large Language Models under Distribution Shifts
nodes.tldr: COUNTS is a large OOD dataset with 14 natural distribution shifts and 1.2M boxes, providing benchmarks for object detector and multimodal LLM grounding generalization.
nodes.problem: No large fine-grained benchmark exists for OOD generalization of object detection and grounding.
nodes.approach: Collect 222K-sample dataset across 14 shifts and define OODOD and OODG benchmarks.
secondary_topics: Architectures & Training › Domain Adaptation & OOD Generalization
nodes.niche_reason: OOD detection benchmarks are specialised but established.

nodes.title: CRISP: Object Pose and Shape Estimation with Test-Time Adaptation
nodes.tldr: Category-agnostic RGB-D object pose and shape estimation, with test-time self-training that uses a correct-and-certify corrector to adapt across domain gaps.
nodes.problem: Object pose and shape estimation degrades under domain gaps between training and test data.
nodes.approach: FiLM-conditioned shape decoder with active-shape-model least-squares correction, then self-training on pseudo-labels.
secondary_topics: Architectures & Training › Domain Adaptation & OOD Generalization
nodes.niche_reason: Common pose estimation area with a correct-and-certify twist

nodes.title: Can Generative Video Models Help Pose Estimation?
nodes.tldr: InterPose uses pretrained generative video models to hallucinate frames between non-overlapping images, then ranks pose predictions by a self-consistency score, beating DUSt3R.
nodes.problem: Pairwise pose estimation from images with little or no overlap.
nodes.approach: Generate intermediate video frames and select poses via self-consistency across sampled videos.
nodes.niche_reason: Using video generators for pose estimation is an unusual angle.

nodes.title: Can Machines Understand Composition? Dataset and Benchmark for Photographic Image Composition Embedding and Understanding
nodes.tldr: Presents a dataset and benchmark for photographic image composition embedding and understanding, probing whether MLLMs and specialist models grasp composition.
nodes.problem: Models' ability to embed and understand photographic composition is unmeasured.
nodes.approach: Build a composition dataset and benchmark specialist and multimodal LLM models.
nodes.niche_reason: Photographic composition understanding is an unusual niche.

nodes.title: Change3D: Revisiting Change Detection and Captioning from A Video Modeling Perspective
nodes.tldr: Recasts bi-temporal change detection and captioning as tiny video modeling, using learnable perception frames, a unified light model across eight benchmarks.
nodes.problem: Image encoders are task-agnostic and miss changed regions; task-specific change extractors are needed
nodes.approach: Video encoder with learnable perception frames inserted between bi-temporal images, replacing change extractors
nodes.niche_reason: Established change detection area with unusual video-model reframing

nodes.title: CheckManual: A New Challenge and Benchmark for Manual-based Appliance Manipulation
nodes.tldr: A benchmark where robots must read multi-page appliance manuals before manipulating, plus a baseline planning model for it.
nodes.problem: Robots ignore appliance manuals, which are needed to operate devices correctly.
nodes.approach: Generated manuals from CAD appliance models in simulators, with a manual-based planning baseline.
nodes.confidence_reason: Benchmark and planning baseline both proposed; primary contribution split
nodes.niche_reason: Manual-driven appliance manipulation is an unusual robotics direction

nodes.title: Circumventing Shortcuts in Audio-visual Deepfake Detection Datasets with Unsupervised Learning
nodes.tldr: Reveals a leading-silence shortcut in popular audio-video deepfake datasets and proposes unsupervised training on real data only, aligning self-supervised audio-video representations for robust detection.
nodes.problem: Deepfake datasets contain spurious shortcuts that detection models exploit and fail to generalize beyond.
nodes.approach: Identify leading silence artifact; train on real data with aligned self-supervised audio-visual representations.
nodes.primary_topic: Audio, Speech & Multimodal › Audio-Visual & Cross-modal Learning
nodes.niche_reason: Dataset shortcut analysis in audio-visual deepfakes is specialised.

nodes.title: ClimbingCap: Multi-Modal Dataset and Method for Rock Climbing in World Coordinate
nodes.tldr: Introduces AscendMotion, a large RGB-LiDAR-IMU climbing motion dataset, and ClimbingCap, which jointly optimizes camera- and global-coordinate reconstructions to recover 3D climbing motion.
nodes.problem: Capturing off-ground climbing motion in global coordinates, lacking datasets and suitable methods.
nodes.approach: Multi-modal dataset plus RGB and LiDAR motion recovery in camera and world coordinates optimized jointly.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › Human Pose, Avatars & Faces
nodes.niche_reason: Rock climbing motion capture is a rare application.

nodes.title: CoMM: A Coherent Interleaved Image-Text Dataset for Multimodal Understanding and Generation
nodes.tldr: Introduces CoMM, a filtered dataset of coherent interleaved image-text sequences, with new tasks to train and evaluate MLLM interleaved generation.
nodes.problem: Interleaved image-text generation suffers from poor-quality, incoherent training data.
nodes.approach: Collect instructional and storytelling content, apply multi-perspective model-based filtering, and define evaluation tasks.
nodes.niche_reason: Interleaved multimodal data is established but specialised.

nodes.title: CoSER: Towards Consistent Dense Multiview Text-to-Image Generator for 3D Creation
nodes.tldr: Generates dense, consistent multiview images from text prompts for text-to-3D, combining attention with a selective state-space model for efficiency.
nodes.problem: Existing multiview text-to-image generators produce sparse, inconsistent views with poor space-view correspondence.
nodes.approach: Neighbour-view interaction along physical motion paths, plus bidirectional spiral scanning with score-weighted down-sampling.
secondary_topics: Architectures & Training › State-Space Models & Linear Attention
nodes.niche_reason: 3D generation is a crowded, active area.

nodes.title: Coeff-Tuning: A Graph Filter Subspace View for Tuning Attention-Based Large Models
nodes.tldr: Coeff-Tuning fine-tunes transformers by learning a few combination coefficients over multi-head attention maps, viewed as a graph filter subspace, complementing existing PEFT methods.
nodes.problem: Parameter-efficient tuning of attention models from a view beyond tensor decomposition.
nodes.approach: Learn residual-parameterized coefficients combining attention maps into a more expressive filter subspace, with dropout regularization.
nodes.niche_reason: PEFT variants are common, though the graph filter view is slightly novel.

nodes.title: Compositional Caching for Training-free Open-vocabulary Attribute Detection
nodes.tldr: ComCa detects open-vocabulary attributes without training by building an image cache with LLM-checked attribute-object compatibility and refining VLM predictions.
nodes.problem: Attribute detectors need costly annotation and fixed attribute sets, limiting open-vocabulary use.
nodes.approach: Training-free cache of web images with soft attribute labels, aggregated by similarity at inference.
nodes.niche_reason: Training-free VLM adaptation is a crowded direction.

nodes.title: Comprehensive Information Bottleneck for Unveiling Universal Attribution to Interpret Vision Transformers
nodes.tldr: Explains Vision Transformer decisions by applying the information bottleneck jointly across multiple layers with a shared damping ratio, yielding more faithful feature attribution maps.
nodes.problem: Single-layer information-bottleneck attributions miss decision evidence distributed across layers.
nodes.approach: Multi-layer information bottleneck with shared parametric damping ratio and variational layer-wise bounds.
nodes.niche_reason: Established attribution subfield with a specialised information-theoretic angle.

nodes.title: Context-Aware Multimodal Pretraining
nodes.tldr: Extends contrastive image-text pretraining so representations can use extra context, improving few-shot adaptation up to fourfold in sample efficiency while retaining zero-shot performance.
nodes.problem: Standard contrastive multimodal pretraining optimizes zero-shot transfer but not few-shot adaptation.
nodes.approach: Context-aware pretraining objective enabling training-free metric-based adaptation of vision-language representations.
nodes.niche_reason: CLIP-style pretraining improvements are common.

nodes.title: Convex Relaxation for Robust Vanishing Point Estimation in Manhattan World
nodes.tldr: Applies convex relaxation with an SDP and a globally optimal outlier-robust solver to jointly estimate Manhattan-world vanishing points and line associations.
nodes.problem: Vanishing point estimation trades off between suboptimal solvers and slow global methods.
nodes.approach: Soft line-VP association, QCQP relaxed to SDP, iterative robust solver with orthogonality refinement.
nodes.niche_reason: Specialised geometric optimization, rarely tackled with convex relaxation

nodes.title: Creating Your Editable 3D Photorealistic Avatar with Tetrahedron-constrained Gaussian Splatting
nodes.tldr: Builds editable photorealistic 3D avatars from monocular video using tetrahedron-constrained Gaussian splatting with local spatial adaptation and coarse-to-fine appearance learning.
nodes.problem: Existing 3D avatar editing yields poor results from unstable joint optimization of geometry and texture.
nodes.approach: Hybrid tetrahedral grid plus Gaussian splatting, optimized progressively with decoupled spatial adaptation and appearance generation.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › Human Pose, Avatars & Faces
secondary_topics: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: Gaussian-splatting avatars are common; tetrahedral constraint adds some variation.

nodes.title: Cross-View Completion Models are Zero-shot Correspondence Estimators
nodes.tldr: Analyzes cross-view completion models like CroCo-v2, showing their cross-attention maps act as zero-shot dense geometric correspondence estimators, also useful for multi-frame depth.
nodes.problem: Understanding what correspondence information cross-view completion pretraining learns.
nodes.approach: Compare cross-attention maps with encoder and decoder features for correspondence and depth evaluation.
secondary_topics: Computer Vision › Vision Foundation Models & Self-Supervision
nodes.confidence_reason: Short abstract; unclear whether analysis or method contribution.
nodes.niche_reason: Cross-view completion pretraining analysis is a rare subtopic.

nodes.title: Cross-modal Causal Relation Alignment for Video Question Grounding
nodes.tldr: Grounds video questions to time intervals while removing spurious cross-modal correlations via Gaussian smoothing, bidirectional contrastive alignment, and causal front-door and back-door interventions.
nodes.problem: Video QA grounding models rely on spurious cross-modal correlations, missing the visual scenes the question targets.
nodes.approach: Gaussian-smoothed cross-attention grounding, contrastive QA-segment alignment, and multimodal deconfounding interventions.
nodes.niche_reason: Video question grounding is specialised but established.

nodes.title: CrossOver: 3D Scene Cross-Modal Alignment
nodes.tldr: Learns a modality-agnostic scene embedding by aligning images, point clouds, CAD, floorplans, and text with relaxed scene-level constraints, supporting retrieval with missing modalities.
nodes.problem: Existing 3D cross-modal methods assume complete data and rigid per-object alignment across all modalities.
nodes.approach: Dimensionality-specific encoders with a multi-stage training pipeline, learning scene-level alignment without object semantics.
secondary_topics: Audio, Speech & Multimodal › Audio-Visual & Cross-modal Learning
nodes.confidence_reason: judgment call between 3D understanding and cross-modal learning
nodes.niche_reason: Scene-level multi-modal 3D alignment with floorplans and CAD is specialised

nodes.title: Cubify Anything: Scaling Indoor 3D Object Detection
nodes.tldr: Introduces a 1M-object indoor 3D detection dataset and a Transformer that predicts 3D boxes directly from 2D RGB(-D) features, outperforming point-based methods.
nodes.problem: Existing indoor 3D detection datasets are small and narrow, and 3D inductive biases fail to scale.
nodes.approach: Transformer predicts 3D boxes from 2D image features without 3D inductive biases, pretrained on a 400K-object labeled dataset.
nodes.niche_reason: Single-image indoor 3D detection is established, with a dataset angle.

nodes.title: DAMM-Diffusion: Learning Divergence-Aware Multi-Modal Diffusion Model for Nanoparticles Distribution Prediction
nodes.tldr: A diffusion model predicts nanoparticle distribution in tumors from multi-modal microenvironment images, adaptively choosing between uni-modal and multi-modal predictions using uncertainty-aware fusion.
nodes.problem: Predicting nanoparticle distribution in tumors when multi-modal components diverge and joint models can underperform uni-modal ones.
nodes.approach: Divergence-aware diffusion with uni-modal and multi-modal branches, uncertainty-aware fusion, and a predictor selecting the more consistent output.
nodes.confidence_reason: Medical imaging vs diffusion method; judgment call on primary topic.
nodes.niche_reason: Nanoparticle distribution prediction in tumors is a rare application.

nodes.title: DIFIX3D+: Improving 3D Reconstructions with Single-Step Diffusion Models
nodes.tldr: Difix3D+ uses a single-step diffusion model to clean up pseudo-training views and remove residual artifacts, improving NeRF and 3DGS reconstructions.
nodes.problem: Extreme novel viewpoints show artifacts in NeRF and Gaussian splatting reconstructions.
nodes.approach: Single-step diffusion enhancer trained to fix rendered views, used in both reconstruction and inference.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: diffusion-enhanced 3D reconstruction is a crowded direction

nodes.title: DIV-FF: Dynamic Image-Video Feature Fields For Environment Understanding in Egocentric Videos
nodes.tldr: DIV-FF decomposes egocentric scenes into persistent, dynamic and actor components with image and video-language feature fields for segmentation and affordances.
nodes.problem: Understanding dynamic egocentric environments by integrating semantic and geometric information beyond isolated clips.
nodes.approach: Feature field decomposing scene into persistent, dynamic and actor parts, fusing image and video-language features.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: Egocentric dynamic feature fields are a specialised niche.

nodes.title: DPU: Dynamic Prototype Updating for Multimodal Out-of-Distribution Detection
nodes.tldr: DPU is a plug-and-play framework for multimodal OOD detection that dynamically updates class prototypes to handle intra-class variation, improving Far-OOD by up to 80%.
nodes.problem: Multimodal OOD detection ignoring intra-class variability
nodes.approach: Dynamically update class centers from in-batch sample variance to amplify prediction discrepancies
nodes.primary_topic: Architectures & Training › Domain Adaptation & OOD Generalization
secondary_topics: Audio, Speech & Multimodal › Audio-Visual & Cross-modal Learning
nodes.niche_reason: Multimodal OOD detection is specialised.

nodes.title: DashGaussian: Optimizing 3D Gaussian Splatting in 200 Seconds
nodes.tldr: Accelerates 3D Gaussian Splatting optimization by scheduling rendering resolution and primitive count progressively from low to high frequency, giving 45.7% average speedup without quality loss.
nodes.problem: 3DGS optimization is slow due to rendering resolution and primitive number complexity.
nodes.approach: Dynamic rendering resolution scheduling synchronized with primitive growth, based on frequency-progressive fitting.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: Gaussian splatting variants are very common.

nodes.title: Dataset Distillation with Neural Characteristic Function: A Minmax Perspective
nodes.tldr: Reformulates dataset distillation as minmax optimization with Neural Characteristic Function Discrepancy, a learned distribution-matching metric capturing full distributional information.
nodes.problem: Distribution-matching distance metrics in dataset distillation poorly capture distributional differences.
nodes.approach: Neural-network-optimized characteristic function discrepancy used adversarially in a minmax objective.
nodes.primary_topic: Data, Benchmarks & Evaluation › Synthetic Data & Data Curation
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Optimal Transport & Divergences
nodes.confidence_reason: Could be data curation or distribution-matching theory.
nodes.niche_reason: Dataset distillation is specialised but established.

nodes.title: Decoupled Distillation to Erase: A General Unlearning Method for Any Class-centric Tasks
nodes.tldr: Unlearns a target class by splitting forgetting and retention logits with a mask and distilling dark knowledge, without access to the remaining data.
nodes.problem: Class unlearning damages retained knowledge of other classes in pretrained models
nodes.approach: Unlearning loss decomposition with mask distillation of forgetting and retention logits
nodes.primary_topic: Trustworthy ML › Machine Unlearning & Privacy Attacks
nodes.niche_reason: Machine unlearning is a crowded, active area

nodes.title: Deep Change Monitoring: A Hyperbolic Representative Learning Framework and a Dataset for Long-term Fine-grained Tree Change Detection
nodes.tldr: Introduces UAVTC, a long-term high-resolution UAV tree dataset, and a hyperbolic Siamese network that detects fine-grained tree changes.
nodes.problem: Existing tree datasets are low-resolution and miss continuous fine-grained physiological changes.
nodes.approach: Hyperbolic Siamese network embedding hierarchical tree changes compactly, robust to environmental variation.
nodes.niche_reason: Long-term UAV tree change monitoring is a rare niche

nodes.title: Deep Fair Multi-View Clustering with Attention KAN
nodes.tldr: Fair deep multi-view clustering that uses attention-augmented Kolmogorov-Arnold networks to model cross-view interactions and align clusters across sensitive groups.
nodes.problem: Multi-view clustering amplifies sensitive attributes, producing unfair clusters.
nodes.approach: Attention-KAN fused multi-view encoder with distribution alignment to balance sensitive groups.
nodes.confidence_reason: Fairness-aware clustering; could also fit representation learning.
nodes.niche_reason: Fair multi-view clustering with KAN; specialised intersection of fairness and clustering.

nodes.title: DefectFill: Realistic Defect Generation with Inpainting Diffusion Model for Visual Inspection
nodes.tldr: DefectFill generates realistic defects for visual inspection by fine-tuning an inpainting diffusion model on a few reference defect images with custom losses.
nodes.problem: Visual inspection models lack defect data, and synthetic defects are often unrealistic.
nodes.approach: Inpainting diffusion fine-tuned with defect, object and attention losses, plus low-fidelity sample selection.
secondary_topics: Data, Benchmarks & Evaluation › Synthetic Data & Data Curation
nodes.niche_reason: Industrial defect synthesis is a specialised application niche

nodes.title: DepthCrafter: Generating Consistent Long Depth Sequences for Open-world Videos
nodes.tldr: Estimates temporally consistent long depth sequences for open-world videos by adapting an image-to-video diffusion model, stitching segments for very long videos.
nodes.problem: Open-world video depth estimation with temporal consistency across varied content and long lengths.
nodes.approach: Three-stage training of a video-to-depth model initialized from an image-to-video diffusion model, plus segment-wise stitching.
nodes.niche_reason: Video depth estimation is a common, active direction.

nodes.title: Descriptor-In-Pixel : Point-Feature Tracking For Pixel Processor Arrays
nodes.tldr: Performs point-feature detection and tracking entirely inside pixel-processor arrays, reducing sensor output over 1000x and running above 3000 FPS.
nodes.problem: Feature tracking usually requires transferring raw images off the sensor, costing bandwidth and latency.
nodes.approach: Descriptors held in each pixel-processor compute response maps in parallel, read out as sparse feature locations.
nodes.confidence_reason: Tracking versus sensor hardware topic is a judgment call.
nodes.niche_reason: In-pixel feature tracking on pixel processor arrays is a very rare niche.

nodes.title: Detecting Backdoor Attacks in Federated Learning via Direction Alignment Inspection
nodes.tldr: Defends federated learning against backdoors by filtering model updates whose directions and sign patterns deviate from the consensus.
nodes.problem: Federated learning is vulnerable to backdoor updates that existing defenses handle poorly.
nodes.approach: Direction alignment inspection comparing each update to the overall direction and principal sign patterns of significant parameters.
nodes.niche_reason: Sign-alignment inspection for federated backdoor defense is a specific niche.

nodes.title: Detection-Friendly Nonuniformity Correction: A Union Framework for Infrared UAV Target Detection
nodes.tldr: UniCD jointly performs infrared nonuniformity correction and UAV target detection end-to-end, with a new 50,000-image benchmark IRBFD.
nodes.problem: Treating infrared nonuniformity correction as preprocessing gives suboptimal infrared UAV target detection.
nodes.approach: Joint end-to-end NUC and detection with parameter-estimation NUC, mask auxiliary loss, and detection-guided self-supervised loss.
nodes.niche_reason: Infrared UAV detection with nonuniformity correction is a rare specialised domain.

nodes.title: DexGrasp Anything: Towards Universal Robotic Dexterous Grasping with Physics Awareness
nodes.tldr: Integrates physical constraints into training and sampling of a diffusion model for dexterous grasp generation, and releases a 3.4-million-pose grasping dataset.
nodes.problem: Generating physically usable dexterous grasps for diverse objects is hard
nodes.approach: Physics-aware diffusion with constraints in both training and sampling
nodes.niche_reason: Diffusion grasp generation is common; dexterous universal grasping is active

nodes.title: DiffCAM: Data-Driven Saliency Maps by Capturing Feature Differences
nodes.tldr: Saliency method that explains predictions by comparing a target example's features with the reference-class data distribution, not decision boundaries.
nodes.problem: CAM-based saliency relies on decision-boundary gradients, limiting use on some models.
nodes.approach: Data-driven feature-difference maps between target and reference-class examples, independent of prediction results.
nodes.niche_reason: saliency maps are a crowded XAI area

nodes.title: Diffusion-based Realistic Listening Head Generation via Hybrid Motion Modeling
nodes.tldr: Diffusion-based listening head video generation with hybrid motion modeling and pose/expression control guidance, producing 512x512 responsive listener videos.
nodes.problem: Two-stage 3DMM pipelines give limited expressiveness and low resolution for listener head video generation.
nodes.approach: Diffusion model for both motion generation and rendering, with hybrid motion modeling and tailored control guidance.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › Human Pose, Avatars & Faces
nodes.niche_reason: Listening head generation is a specialised sub-area of face synthesis.

nodes.title: DiffusionDrive: Truncated Diffusion Model for End-to-End Autonomous Driving
nodes.tldr: Truncates the diffusion schedule from multi-mode driving anchors, cutting denoising steps 10x and running at 45 FPS for end-to-end driving.
nodes.problem: Diffusion policies need many denoising steps, too slow for real-time diverse driving action generation.
nodes.approach: Truncated diffusion initialized from prior multi-mode anchors, with a cascade diffusion decoder conditioned on scene context.
nodes.niche_reason: Diffusion policies are common; driving application is well explored

nodes.title: Digital Twin Catalog: A Large-Scale Photorealistic 3D Object Digital Twin Dataset
nodes.tldr: Releases Digital Twin Catalog, 2,000 digital-twin-quality scanned 3D objects with DSLR and egocentric AR-glasses image sequences for reconstruction benchmarking.
nodes.problem: No large real-world digital-twin benchmark exists to evaluate 3D object reconstruction methods.
nodes.approach: Captures object image sequences under varied lighting using DSLR cameras and egocentric AR glasses.
secondary_topics: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: Digital-twin object benchmarks with egocentric capture are specialised

nodes.title: DistinctAD: Distinctive Audio Description Generation in Contexts
nodes.tldr: A two-stage framework for movie audio description generation that adapts CLIP to movie-AD alignment and reduces contextual redundancy with EMA attention and distinctive word loss.
nodes.problem: AD generation suffers a domain gap and redundancy from highly similar neighboring clips in long movies.
nodes.approach: CLIP-AD adaptation, contextual EMA attention extracting common bases, and a distinctive word prediction loss.
nodes.niche_reason: Movie audio description generation is a rare task.

nodes.title: Distraction is All You Need for Multimodal Large Language Model Jailbreaking
nodes.tldr: CS-DJ jailbreaks multimodal LLMs by distracting their alignment with query decomposition and contrasting subimages, reaching high attack success rates on closed models.
nodes.problem: Visual inputs in MLLMs create interaction vulnerabilities that can bypass safety alignment.
nodes.approach: Structured query decomposition plus visual-enhanced contrasting subimages to disperse model attention.
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › LLM Safety & Jailbreaks
nodes.niche_reason: Distraction-based MLLM jailbreaking is a specialised safety attack line.

nodes.title: Do Computer Vision Foundation Models Learn the Low-level Characteristics of the Human Visual System?
nodes.tldr: Tests 45 foundation and generative encoders on nine low-level human vision protocols; DINOv2 most closely mirrors human contrast perception.
nodes.problem: Whether vision foundation models learn low-level characteristics of human vision is unclear.
nodes.approach: Psychophysics-style protocol of nine contrast detection, masking, and constancy tests on encoders.
secondary_topics: Computer Vision › Vision Foundation Models & Self-Supervision
nodes.niche_reason: Comparing foundation-model encoders to human contrast perception is rare

nodes.title: Doppelgangers and Adversarial Vulnerability
nodes.tldr: Defines adversarial Doppelgangers, perceptually close inputs that fool classifiers, shows most classifiers are vulnerable and some tasks admit no robust classifier.
nodes.problem: Classifiers make mistakes humans do not, such as adversarial visual metamers, with unclear causes.
nodes.approach: Perceptual-metric analysis of adversarial pairs, with conceptual entropy and criteria for well-defined classes.
nodes.niche_reason: Human-vs-machine perceptual ambiguity theory is a rare angle

nodes.title: Doppelgangers++: Improved Visual Disambiguation with Geometric 3D Features
nodes.tldr: Doppelgangers++ detects visually aliased image pairs with a transformer classifier on MASt3R 3D-aware features, improving structure-from-motion reconstruction accuracy.
nodes.problem: Visual aliasing from doppelganger image pairs corrupts structure-from-motion reconstructions.
nodes.approach: Transformer classifier over MASt3R features, trained on diverse geo-tagged everyday scenes.
secondary_topics: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.confidence_reason: Pairwise disambiguation for SfM sits between geometry and reconstruction
nodes.niche_reason: Pairwise aliasing detection for SfM is a specialised geometry niche

nodes.title: Dr. Splat: Directly Referring 3D Gaussian Splatting via Direct Language Embedding Registration
nodes.tldr: Dr. Splat registers CLIP embeddings directly onto dominant 3D Gaussians along pixel rays, compressed via product quantization, for open-vocabulary 3D segmentation and object localization.
nodes.problem: Language-embedded Gaussian splatting methods rely on rendering rather than directly associating language with 3D Gaussians.
nodes.approach: Assign CLIP embeddings to dominant Gaussians per pixel-ray and compress with pretrained product quantization.
secondary_topics: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: Language-embedded 3DGS is an active but specialised subarea.

nodes.title: DriveGPT4-V2: Harnessing Large Language Model Capabilities for Enhanced Closed-Loop Autonomous Driving
nodes.tldr: DriveGPT4-V2 is a multimodal LLM that takes multi-view camera images and vehicle states to output low-level control for closed-loop driving, trained with an expert LLM.
nodes.problem: Applying multimodal LLMs to closed-loop end-to-end autonomous driving rather than open-loop tasks.
nodes.approach: Multi-view visual tokenizer, control-signal output, and a privileged-information expert LLM for online imitation learning.
nodes.niche_reason: LLM-for-driving is a popular, crowded direction.

nodes.title: Driving by the Rules: A Benchmark for Integrating Traffic Sign Regulations into Vectorized HD Map
nodes.tldr: MapDR dataset and benchmark for extracting traffic sign driving rules and linking them to vectorized HD map lanes, with baselines.
nodes.problem: Online HD maps omit the traffic regulation layer from traffic signs.
nodes.approach: Annotated video dataset plus VLE-MEE and RuleVLM modular and end-to-end baselines.
nodes.niche_reason: Traffic regulation layer of HD maps is a specialised gap

nodes.title: DroneSplat: 3D Gaussian Splatting for Robust 3D Reconstruction from In-the-Wild Drone Imagery
nodes.tldr: 3D Gaussian Splatting for in-the-wild drone imagery that removes dynamic distractors via adaptive masking and handles limited views with MVS and voxel guidance.
nodes.problem: Drone reconstruction suffers from dynamic distractors violating static assumptions and limited-view geometry ambiguity.
nodes.approach: Adaptive segmentation-based masking, multi-view stereo priors, and voxel-guided optimization for Gaussian splatting.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: Gaussian splatting is popular; drone in-the-wild focus is specialised.

nodes.title: DualPM: Dual Posed-Canonical Point Maps for 3D Shape and Pose Reconstruction
nodes.tldr: Predicts paired point maps, one camera-space and one canonical rest-pose, for shape and pose of deformable quadrupeds from images, trained on synthetic data.
nodes.problem: Reconstructing 3D shape and pose of deformable objects like quadrupeds from single images
nodes.approach: Dual point-map regression with amodal, self-occlusion-aware prediction, trained purely on synthetic 3D models
secondary_topics: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: Quadruped point-map reconstruction is specialised

nodes.title: DyFo: A Training-Free Dynamic Focus Visual Search for Enhancing LMMs in Fine-Grained Visual Understanding
nodes.tldr: Training-free dynamic focusing that uses MCTS between a multimodal LLM and visual experts to improve fine-grained understanding and reduce hallucination.
nodes.problem: Large multimodal models miss fine-grained details in cluttered images and hallucinate
nodes.approach: Bidirectional interaction between the LMM and visual experts, with MCTS simulating human-like focus adjustments.
nodes.niche_reason: MCTS-driven visual focusing for LMMs is somewhat unusual

nodes.title: Dyn-HaMR: Recovering 4D Interacting Hand Motion from a Dynamic Camera
nodes.tldr: Dyn-HaMR recovers global 4D interacting hand motion from monocular videos with moving cameras via multi-stage optimization combining SLAM, an interacting-hand prior, and hierarchical initialization.
nodes.problem: Reconstructing global 3D hand trajectories from monocular videos captured by dynamic or egocentric cameras.
nodes.approach: Multi-stage optimization with SLAM camera motion, generative interacting-hand prior, and hierarchical hand-tracker initialization.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › Human Pose, Avatars & Faces
nodes.niche_reason: Hand motion recovery is specialised but an established subarea.

nodes.title: EBS-EKF: Accurate and High Frequency Event-based Star Tracking
nodes.tldr: EBS-EKF tracks star attitude from event-based sensors using a circuit-grounded signal model and extended Kalman filter, with higher accuracy.
nodes.problem: Event-based star tracking was only tested in simulation with simplified signal models.
nodes.approach: Circuit-grounded event signal model with an extended Kalman filter, validated on real night-sky data against an APS tracker.
nodes.confidence_reason: Star tracking could also fit robot perception; topic is a judgment call.
nodes.niche_reason: Event-camera star tracking is a rare sensing and application niche.

nodes.title: ESC: Erasing Space Concept for Knowledge Deletion
nodes.tldr: Training-free ESC erases a forgotten concept by removing its activation subspace from features, plus a learnable-mask variant balancing forgetting and retention.
nodes.problem: Deployed models retain personal knowledge in features, and existing unlearning methods leak it.
nodes.approach: Eliminate forget-concept activations within a restricted feature subspace, optionally with a learned mask.
nodes.primary_topic: Trustworthy ML › Machine Unlearning & Privacy Attacks
nodes.niche_reason: Established but specialised: feature-level knowledge deletion.

nodes.title: ETAP: Event-based Tracking of Any Point
nodes.tldr: ETAP is the first event-camera tracking-any-point method, using high temporal resolution events and a feature alignment loss for motion-robust high-speed tracking, with large gains over baselines.
nodes.problem: Tracking any point fails in difficult lighting and high-speed motion due to frame camera sensor limits.
nodes.approach: Event-based TAP model with global context, motion-robust feature alignment loss, and a new event data generation pipeline.
nodes.niche_reason: Event-camera point tracking is a rare sensor-specific niche.

nodes.title: EffiDec3D: An Optimized Decoder for High-Performance and Efficient 3D Medical Image Segmentation
nodes.tldr: An optimized lightweight decoder for 3D medical segmentation networks that cuts decoder parameters and FLOPs by over 90% via channel reduction and removing high-resolution layers.
nodes.problem: 3D medical segmentation networks have costly decoders that hinder real-time and resource-constrained use.
nodes.approach: Reduce decoder channels to the minimum needed and drop high-resolution decoder layers with little contribution.
secondary_topics: Architectures & Training › Efficient Training, Compression & Pruning
nodes.niche_reason: Efficient medical segmentation architectures are common.

nodes.title: Efficient Motion-Aware Video MLLM
nodes.tldr: EMA is a video MLLM taking compressed-video GOP structure as input, fusing sparse RGB frames with dense motion vectors, plus MotionBench for motion understanding evaluation.
nodes.problem: Video MLLMs use uniform frame sampling and image encoders, being inefficient and weak at motion awareness.
nodes.approach: Motion-aware GOP encoder fusing RGB frames and motion vectors from compressed video; new MotionBench benchmark.
nodes.niche_reason: Compressed-domain video LLM input is unusual among video MLLMs.

nodes.title: EgoPressure: A Dataset for Hand Pressure and Pose Estimation in Egocentric Vision
nodes.tldr: Introduces an egocentric dataset with pressure intensities and hand meshes, plus baselines showing pressure and hand pose help each other.
nodes.problem: No egocentric datasets provide both hand pose and contact pressure annotations
