nodes.title: GigaHands: A Massive Annotated Dataset of Bimanual Hand Activities
nodes.tldr: GigaHands is a 34-hour markerless-captured dataset of bimanual hand activities with 3D hand and object estimates and 84k text annotations.
nodes.problem: Existing bimanual hand activity datasets lack scale, diversity, and detailed annotations.
nodes.approach: Markerless multi-view capture with automatic 3D hand and object estimation and efficient text annotation.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › Human Pose, Avatars & Faces
nodes.niche_reason: Hand-activity datasets are established but specialised.

nodes.title: Glossy Object Reconstruction with Cost-effective Polarized Acquisition
nodes.tldr: Reconstructs glossy objects from multi-view images taken with a linear polarizer on ordinary RGB cameras, without polarizer-angle calibration.
nodes.problem: Separating diffuse and specular components of glossy surfaces from RGB images is ambiguous and needs expensive hardware.
nodes.approach: Neural implicit fields for polarimetric BRDF and Stokes vectors, optimized with a polarization rendering loss.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: Polarization-aided neural reconstruction is an unusual sensing angle

nodes.title: Goku: Flow Based Video Generative Foundation Models
nodes.tldr: Presents Goku, rectified-flow Transformers that generate both images and videos, covering data curation, architecture and large-scale training infrastructure.
nodes.problem: High-quality joint image and video generation at scale needs careful data, architecture, and training choices.
nodes.approach: Rectified-flow Transformers trained jointly on images and videos with a curated data pipeline and efficient infrastructure.
nodes.niche_reason: Large joint image-video generative models are mainstream

nodes.title: Good, Cheap, and Fast: Overfitted Image Compression with Wasserstein Distortion
nodes.tldr: Optimizes the overfitted codec C3 for Wasserstein Distortion, matching generative codecs like HiFiC perceptually with under 1% of decoding compute, validated by human ratings.
nodes.problem: Generative learned image compression gives good quality but has prohibitive decoding complexity.
nodes.approach: Train overfitted C3 codec with Wasserstein Distortion perceptual objective and validate against human ratings.
nodes.niche_reason: Neural compression with perceptual objectives is specialised.

nodes.title: Gradient-Guided Annealing for Domain Generalization
nodes.tldr: Gradient-Guided Annealing perturbs parameters early in training to find points where gradients across domains align, improving domain generalization on five image classification benchmarks.
nodes.problem: Gradient conflicts between domains early in training lead to minima that fail to generalize to unseen domains.
nodes.approach: Iteratively anneal parameters in early training to find domain-gradient-aligned points.
nodes.primary_topic: Architectures & Training › Domain Adaptation & OOD Generalization
nodes.niche_reason: Domain generalization methods are a common topic.

nodes.title: Graph Neural Network Combining Event Stream and Periodic Aggregation for Low-Latency Event-based Vision
nodes.tldr: Combines an asynchronous event-graph branch with periodic aggregation to predict per-event optical flow at tens-of-microseconds latency with far fewer operations.
nodes.problem: Frame-based event methods lose sparsity and latency, while asynchronous event graphs lack temporal accumulation.
nodes.approach: Accumulation-free event graph branch plus a periodic aggregation branch that adds global context.
nodes.niche_reason: Asynchronous event-graph optical flow is a rare direction.

nodes.title: GroundingFace: Fine-grained Face Understanding via Pixel Grounding Multimodal Large Language Model
nodes.tldr: Adds pixel-grounded face understanding to a multimodal LLM, with a 240K face caption and QA dataset for part segmentation and attribute reasoning.
nodes.problem: Grounding MLLMs handle common objects but struggle with fine-grained face parts and attributes.
nodes.approach: Pixel-grounded face caption and QA dataset for alignment pretraining, then instruction tuning.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › Human Pose, Avatars & Faces
nodes.niche_reason: Fine-grained grounded face MLLMs are specialised

nodes.title: H-MoRe: Learning Human-centric Motion Representation for Action Analysis
nodes.tldr: Self-supervised human-centric motion representation learned from real videos, capturing absolute and relative body-point movement as world-local flows.
nodes.problem: Human motion features are polluted by background movement and rely on synthetic supervision.
nodes.approach: Kinematics-inspired world-local flow matrices from pose and body shape, learned self-supervised on real video.
secondary_topics: Computer Vision › Human Pose, Avatars & Faces
nodes.niche_reason: Human motion representation is established; world-local flows are new

nodes.title: HELVIPAD: A Real-World Dataset for Omnidirectional Stereo Depth Estimation
nodes.tldr: HELVIPAD is a real-world dataset of 360-degree stereo video with LiDAR-derived depth labels, plus benchmarks and adaptations for omnidirectional stereo depth.
nodes.problem: Omnidirectional stereo depth estimation is underexplored because appropriate real-world training data is lacking.
nodes.approach: Top-bottom 360 camera rig with LiDAR projection to labels, plus a depth-completion densified training set.
nodes.niche_reason: Omnidirectional stereo is a specialised but growing sensing niche.

nodes.title: HOT3D: Hand and Object Tracking in 3D from Egocentric Multi-View Videos
nodes.tldr: Releases an 833-minute egocentric multi-view dataset of hands and objects with mocap ground truth, showing multi-view methods outperform single-view baselines.
nodes.problem: Egocentric hand-object tracking lacks large multi-view datasets with accurate 3D ground truth.
nodes.approach: Motion-capture-labeled recordings from Project Aria and Quest 3 headsets with multi-view benchmarks.
nodes.niche_reason: Egocentric 3D hand-object datasets are specialised but established

nodes.title: HSI-GPT: A General-Purpose Large Scene-Motion-Language Model for Human Scene Interaction
nodes.tldr: HSI-GPT casts human-scene interaction as next-token prediction, tokenizing text, motion and scenes into an LLM to support multiple controlled generation and understanding tasks.
nodes.problem: Language-conditioned human-scene interaction methods are task-specific with limited control modalities and unfaithful motions.
nodes.approach: Multi-modal tokenizers align scene, text and motion tokens in an LLM fine-tuned on instruction prompts.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › Human Pose, Avatars & Faces
nodes.niche_reason: Unified scene-motion-language LLM for human-scene interaction is uncommon.

nodes.title: HaWoR: World-Space Hand Motion Reconstruction from Egocentric Videos
nodes.tldr: Reconstructs world-frame hand motion from egocentric video using camera-space hand estimation, adaptive SLAM, and a network that fills in out-of-view frames.
nodes.problem: Hand pose methods work per image in camera frame, ignoring world-space motion in moving egocentric video
nodes.approach: Decouples camera-space hand reconstruction from world camera trajectory estimated with adaptive egocentric SLAM and motion infilling
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › Human Pose, Avatars & Faces
nodes.niche_reason: Egocentric world-space hand reconstruction is specialised

nodes.title: Hardware-Rasterized Ray-Based Gaussian Splatting
nodes.tldr: Renders ray-based 3D Gaussian Splatting models with standard hardware rasterizers for real-time novel view synthesis and alias-free output.
nodes.problem: Ray-based Gaussian splatting renders too slowly for VR and MR and aliases under varying scales.
nodes.approach: Derives RayGS rendering in standard hardware rasterization shaders, plus MIP-style anti-aliasing for diverging scales.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: Hardware-rasterized ray-based splatting is a specialised rendering niche

nodes.title: High-Fidelity Lightweight Mesh Reconstruction from Point Clouds
nodes.tldr: Extracts compact, curvature-adaptive triangle meshes from learned SDFs of point clouds using a Delaunay meshing algorithm, avoiding high-resolution Marching Cubes.
nodes.problem: Marching Cubes on SDFs yields redundant mesh elements, too heavy for practical use.
nodes.approach: Curvature-adaptive vertex generator plus Delaunay meshing on a hybrid grid and tri-plane SDF.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: Curvature-adaptive mesh extraction from SDFs; specialised geometry task.

nodes.title: High-fidelity 3D Object Generation from Single Image with RGBN-Volume Gaussian Reconstruction Model
nodes.tldr: GS-RGBN generates high-fidelity 3D objects from a single image with a hybrid voxel-Gaussian representation that fuses RGB and normal features to structure Gaussians.
nodes.problem: Single-view Gaussian-splatting 3D generation suffers geometric ambiguity and unstructured Gaussians, causing distortion and blur.
nodes.approach: Fuse RGB and surface normal features into a 3D voxel volume that guides a Gaussian reconstruction model.
secondary_topics: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: Single-image 3D generation with Gaussians is a popular direction.

nodes.title: Holmes-VAU: Towards Long-term Video Anomaly Understanding at Any Granularity
nodes.tldr: Introduces HIVAU-70k, a hierarchical multi-granularity video anomaly understanding benchmark, and an anomaly-focused temporal sampler that helps multimodal LLMs reason over long videos.
nodes.problem: Video anomaly understanding lacks hierarchical annotations and efficient handling of long videos.
nodes.approach: LLM-assisted hierarchical annotation engine and anomaly-score-driven density-aware frame sampler for a multimodal LLM.
nodes.niche_reason: Specialised video anomaly niche combined with mainstream multimodal LLMs.

nodes.title: HotSpot: Signed Distance Function Optimization with an Asymptotically Sufficient Condition
nodes.tldr: Replaces the eikonal loss with a screened Poisson-based loss that guarantees a true distance function and stabilizes neural SDF surface reconstruction.
nodes.problem: Eikonal loss is only a necessary constraint, so learned implicit functions may not be true distance fields.
nodes.approach: Loss from the solution of a screened Poisson equation, asymptotically sufficient for distance-function convergence, naturally penalizing surface area.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: Neural SDF optimization is established, with a theoretical loss angle.

nodes.title: How Do I Do That? Synthesizing 3D Hand Motion and Contacts for Everyday Interactions
nodes.tldr: Predicts 3D hand motion and contact maps from one RGB view, action text and a contact point, via a VQVAE interaction codebook and transformer.
nodes.problem: Predicting 3D hand interaction trajectories and contacts from an image, action text, and object contact point.
nodes.approach: VQVAE codebook tokenizes hand poses and contacts; transformer decoder with indexer predicts interaction trajectories.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › Human Pose, Avatars & Faces
nodes.confidence_reason: Hand-object interaction prediction spans human pose, generation, and robotics.
nodes.niche_reason: Hand interaction trajectory synthesis with contacts is a rare task.

nodes.title: HuPerFlow: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Human vs. Machine Motion Estimation Comparison
nodes.tldr: HuPerFlow is a benchmark of human-perceived optical flow measured at 2,400 locations across ten datasets, used to compare human and machine motion estimation.
nodes.problem: Human-perceived flow in natural scenes is unmeasured, limiting human-machine motion perception alignment.
nodes.approach: Online psychophysical experiments collecting 38,400 response vectors, compared against optical flow algorithms.
nodes.niche_reason: Human psychophysics benchmark for optical flow is very unusual.

nodes.title: HumanRig: Learning Automatic Rigging for Humanoid Character in a Large Scale Dataset
nodes.tldr: HumanRig releases an 11k-mesh humanoid rigging dataset and a data-driven framework that predicts 3D skeletons and skinning for AI-generated meshes.
nodes.problem: Automatic rigging lacks a large dataset and struggles with complex AI-generated humanoid meshes.
nodes.approach: Prior-guided skeleton estimator plus mesh-skeleton mutual attention over point-transformer features.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › Human Pose, Avatars & Faces
nodes.niche_reason: Large-scale automatic rigging of AI-generated humanoids is rare

nodes.title: HyperLoRA: Parameter-Efficient Adaptive Generation for Portrait Synthesis
nodes.tldr: HyperLoRA generates LoRA weights with an adaptive plug-in network for zero-shot, natural-looking personalized portrait synthesis, avoiding per-person fine-tuning.
nodes.problem: Personalized portrait synthesis needs slow per-person fine-tuning or yields unnatural adapter outputs.
nodes.approach: Hypernetwork-style plug-in generating LoRA weights from identity inputs for diffusion models.
nodes.niche_reason: Personalized diffusion generation is a crowded area.

nodes.title: Hyperbolic Safety-Aware Vision-Language Models
nodes.tldr: HySAC encodes safe and unsafe image-text pairs as an entailment hierarchy in hyperbolic space, letting CLIP be safety-aware instead of unlearning unsafe concepts.
nodes.problem: Unlearning unsafe concepts from CLIP reduces its ability to distinguish safe from unsafe content.
nodes.approach: Hyperbolic CLIP with entailment losses placing safe and unsafe content in different hierarchical regions.
secondary_topics: Trustworthy ML › AI Safety & Alignment Research
nodes.confidence_reason: Safety-aware retrieval with hyperbolic embeddings straddles VLMs, safety, and representation learning.
nodes.niche_reason: Hyperbolic geometry for multimodal safety is an unusual combination.

nodes.title: ICE: Intrinsic Concept Extraction from a Single Image via Diffusion Models
nodes.tldr: ICE extracts intrinsic visual concepts from a single image with a text-to-image diffusion model via automatic concept localization and decomposition into intrinsic and general concepts.
nodes.problem: Reliably extracting interpretable intrinsic concepts from a single image for generative models.
nodes.approach: Two-stage pipeline: concept localization with masks, then decomposing object concepts using a T2I model.
nodes.niche_reason: Concept extraction is a specialised branch of personalization.

nodes.title: ICP: Immediate Compensation Pruning for Mid-to-high Sparsity
nodes.tldr: ICP is a pruning method for 7B-scale models at 50-70% sparsity that rearranges sparsity and compensates errors immediately, avoiding full fine-tuning.
nodes.problem: Pruning large models at mid-to-high sparsity without costly full fine-tuning.
nodes.approach: Sparsity rearrangement with immediate error compensation, balancing between zero and full fine-tuning.
nodes.primary_topic: Architectures & Training › Efficient Training, Compression & Pruning
nodes.niche_reason: Active, fairly crowded LLM pruning area.

nodes.title: Identity-Preserving Text-to-Video Generation by Frequency Decomposition
nodes.tldr: ConsisID is a tuning-free DiT text-to-video model that preserves human identity by injecting low- and high-frequency facial control signals.
nodes.problem: Generating text-to-video with consistent human identity without per-subject finetuning.
nodes.approach: Frequency-aware identity control for diffusion transformer using low-frequency global and high-frequency intrinsic facial features.
nodes.niche_reason: Identity-preserving video generation is an active, fairly common subarea.

nodes.title: ImViD: Immersive Volumetric Videos for Enhanced VR Engagement
nodes.tldr: ImViD is a multi-view, multi-modal dataset with moving video-audio capture for reconstructing immersive volumetric videos with large 6-DoF space.
nodes.problem: Datasets for immersive volumetric video reconstruction lack complete space capture and audio.
nodes.approach: Capture rig supporting mobile multi-view video-audio acquisition across indoor and outdoor scenes plus baseline reconstruction.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: Volumetric video with audio capture is specialised.

nodes.title: Image Quality Assessment: From Human to Machine Preference
nodes.tldr: Defines machine preference for image quality, builds a 2.25M-annotation Machine Preference Database, and shows human-centric IQA metrics fail for machines.
nodes.problem: Image quality assessment targets human appeal, while machines' preferences depend on downstream tasks.
nodes.approach: Formalizes machine preference via downstream tasks, test models, and metrics, then benchmarks mainstream IQA algorithms.
nodes.confidence_reason: Dataset paper; could also be low-level vision IQA topic
nodes.niche_reason: Machine-centric quality assessment is a rare reframing of IQA

nodes.title: Image Reconstruction from Readout-Multiplexed Single-Photon Detector Arrays
nodes.tldr: Recovers images from multiplexed single-photon readouts by probabilistically resolving up to four coincident photons, gaining 3-4 dB PSNR in simulation.
nodes.problem: Conventional multiplexed readouts discard or bias frames with multiple detected photons.
nodes.approach: Row-column multiplexing model with a probabilistic estimator resolving coincident photon incidences.
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Probabilistic & Bayesian Methods
nodes.confidence_reason: Inverse imaging with sensor-specific estimator; could be sensing or restoration
nodes.niche_reason: Multiphoton coincidence resolution for multiplexed single-photon readouts is very specialised

nodes.title: ImagineFSL: Self-Supervised Pretraining Matters on Imagined Base Set for VLM-based Few-shot Learning
nodes.tldr: ImagineFSL pretrains CLIP on a synthetic 'imagined base set' from text-to-image models, then fine-tunes on few-shot tasks, with self-supervised pretraining working best.
nodes.problem: Data scarcity limits few-shot adaptation of CLIP models.
nodes.approach: Self-supervised pretraining on generated synthetic images before few-shot fine-tuning, using a CoT-driven generation pipeline.
secondary_topics: Data, Benchmarks & Evaluation › Synthetic Data & Data Curation
nodes.niche_reason: CLIP few-shot adaptation is a crowded area.

nodes.title: Implicit Correspondence Learning for Image-to-Point Cloud Registration
nodes.tldr: Image-to-point-cloud registration via implicit correspondence learning, with geometric-prior overlap detection and end-to-end pose regression, achieving state-of-the-art on KITTI and nuScenes.
nodes.problem: Unreliable overlap detection and indirect objectives make image-to-point-cloud registration inaccurate.
nodes.approach: Geometric prior-guided overlap detection, implicit cross-modal correspondence learning, and a pose regression module.
nodes.niche_reason: Cross-modal 2D-3D registration is a rare niche.

nodes.title: Improving Gaussian Splatting with Localized Points Management
nodes.tldr: Localized Point Management is a plugin for Gaussian Splatting that uses multiview geometry and rendering errors to find zones needing densification and resets opacity of occluding points.
nodes.problem: Adaptive density control in Gaussian splatting fails in intricate regions and leaves ill-conditioned points.
nodes.approach: Identify error-contributing 3D zones via multiview constraints, densify there, and reset opacity of points in front of them.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: Gaussian splatting improvements are very common.

nodes.title: Improving Personalized Search with Regularized Low-Rank Parameter Updates
nodes.tldr: Adapts a vision-language dual encoder for personalized retrieval via regularized low-rank updates to the text encoder last layer, merging concepts by parameter addition.
nodes.problem: Recognizing personal concepts from few examples while preserving general knowledge in vision-language retrieval.
nodes.approach: Regularized low-rank adaptation of the language encoder's final layer, merging concepts by parameter addition.
nodes.niche_reason: Personalized vision-language retrieval is established but specialised.

nodes.title: InPO: Inversion Preference Optimization with Reparametrized DDIM for Efficient Diffusion Model Alignment
nodes.tldr: DDIM-InPO aligns text-to-image diffusion with human preferences by assigning implicit rewards to latents via reparameterization and inverting to select latents, reaching state-of-the-art in 400 steps.
nodes.problem: Preference alignment of diffusion models is inefficient due to long Markov chains and intractable reverse process.
nodes.approach: Treat diffusion as single-step generator, reparameterized DDIM implicit rewards, and inversion to choose latents for DPO.
secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › Alignment & Preference Optimization
nodes.niche_reason: Diffusion preference alignment is a common recent direction.

nodes.title: IncEventGS: Pose-Free Gaussian Splatting from a Single Event Camera
nodes.tldr: Incremental pose-free 3D Gaussian Splatting reconstruction from a single event camera stream using a SLAM-style tracker and mapper.
nodes.problem: Novel view synthesis from event cameras without known camera poses.
nodes.approach: Tracking-and-mapping pipeline: tracker estimates motion against the 3D-GS map, mapper jointly refines scene and trajectory from event stream.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: Event-camera Gaussian splatting is a rare sensor-specific niche.

nodes.title: Insight-V: Exploring Long-Chain Visual Reasoning with Multimodal Large Language Models
nodes.tldr: Insight-V generates long reasoning data for multimodal tasks and trains a reasoning agent plus summary agent with iterative DPO, improving MLLM visual reasoning.
nodes.problem: Multimodal LLMs lack high-quality long-chain reasoning data and training pipelines for visual reasoning.
nodes.approach: Progressive data generation pipeline, multi-agent reasoner/summarizer design, and iterative DPO training.
nodes.niche_reason: Very crowded reasoning-for-MLLM and DPO space.

nodes.title: Inst3D-LMM: Instance-Aware 3D Scene Understanding with Multi-modal Instruction Tuning
nodes.tldr: A unified 3D multimodal LLM that fuses multi-view 2D semantics into instance tokens and models spatial relations for multi-task 3D scene understanding.
nodes.problem: Encoding 3D point and 2D image features separately limits 3D scene understanding in multimodal models
nodes.approach: Multi-view cross-modal fusion and 3D instance spatial relation modules with end-to-end instruction tuning
nodes.niche_reason: 3D multimodal LLMs are an active area

nodes.title: Instant Gaussian Stream: Fast and Generalizable Streaming of Dynamic Scene Reconstruction via Gaussian Splatting
nodes.tldr: Instant Gaussian Stream reconstructs dynamic scenes in a streaming fashion with a generalizable anchor-driven Gaussian motion network, cutting per-frame time to about 2 seconds.
nodes.problem: Streaming free-viewpoint video reconstruction is slow per frame and accumulates errors.
nodes.approach: Generalized anchor-driven Gaussian motion network plus key-frame-guided refinement strategy.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: Dynamic Gaussian splatting is hot but streaming variant is specialised.

nodes.title: Instruction-based Image Manipulation by Watching How Things Move
nodes.tldr: Builds an image-editing dataset from video frame pairs with MLLM-written instructions, training a model for realistic pose and camera-motion edits.
nodes.problem: Synthetic editing datasets cannot capture natural non-rigid motion and camera changes.
nodes.approach: Samples frame pairs from videos and prompts multimodal LLMs to write editing instructions.
nodes.niche_reason: Video-derived editing data is a growing but specialised idea

nodes.title: InterMimic: Towards Universal Whole-Body Control for Physics-Based Human-Object Interactions
nodes.tldr: A curriculum-trained physics policy that imitates imperfect mocap of diverse human-object interactions, distilled from per-subject teachers and refined with RL.
nodes.problem: Physics-based imitation of human-object interactions breaks on imperfect mocap and varied objects.
nodes.approach: Perfect-first curriculum: subject teachers, distilled into a student with online RL fine-tuning.
secondary_topics: Computer Vision › Human Pose, Avatars & Faces
nodes.confidence_reason: Physics-based HOI imitation spans robotics and human animation.
nodes.niche_reason: Physics-based whole-body HOI imitation is specialised.

nodes.title: InteractAnything: Zero-shot Human Object Interaction Synthesis via LLM Feedback and Object Affordance Parsing
nodes.tldr: Zero-shot text-to-3D human-object interaction synthesis using LLM-inferred relations, diffusion-based affordance parsing and multi-view SDS plus LLM feedback optimization for contact-accurate poses.
nodes.problem: Generating realistic 3D human-object interactions from text for open-set objects.
nodes.approach: LLM relation reasoning, 2D diffusion affordance parsing, SDS pose sampling, and LLM-feedback contact optimization.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › Human Pose, Avatars & Faces
nodes.confidence_reason: Straddles human-object interaction and 3D generation.
nodes.niche_reason: Zero-shot open-set HOI synthesis is a rare cross-model pipeline.

nodes.title: Interpreting Object-level Foundation Models via Visual Precision Search
nodes.tldr: Visual Precision Search yields sparse, faithful attribution maps for object-level foundation models like Grounding DINO and Florence-2 via black-box region search.
nodes.problem: Interpreting object-level foundation models, where gradient and perturbation attribution methods are imprecise or noisy.
nodes.approach: Divide input into sparse sub-regions and search them with consistency and collaboration scores, ignoring model internals.
nodes.niche_reason: Attribution for grounding and detection foundation models is specialised.

nodes.title: Is this Generated Person Existed in Real-world? Fine-grained Detecting and Calibrating Abnormal Human-body
nodes.tldr: Introduces fine-grained detection and calibration of abnormal human bodies in generated images, and a VLM-based framework that repairs them.
nodes.problem: Generated human photos often have abnormal body structures that VLMs cannot reliably detect.
nodes.approach: HumanCalibrator: localize and classify body abnormalities, then repair them while preserving other content.
nodes.primary_topic: Generative Models › Generative Model Evaluation & Theory
secondary_topics: Computer Vision › Human Pose, Avatars & Faces
nodes.confidence_reason: Detection and repair both central; primary topic is a judgment call.
nodes.niche_reason: Anatomical-artifact detection in generated humans is a rare task.

nodes.title: Just Dance with pi! A Poly-modal Inductor for Weakly-supervised Video Anomaly Detection
nodes.tldr: pi-VAD augments RGB features with pose, depth, panoptic masks, optical flow and language cues for weakly-supervised video anomaly detection, needing extra backbones only in training.
nodes.problem: RGB-only features cannot distinguish visually similar anomalies in weakly-supervised video anomaly detection.
nodes.approach: Pseudo-modality generation and cross-modal induction modules inject five auxiliary modalities into RGB representations.
nodes.niche_reason: Established but specialised anomaly detection task.

nodes.title: KAC: Kolmogorov-Arnold Classifier for Continual Learning
nodes.tldr: Replaces linear classifiers with a Kolmogorov-Arnold classifier using radial basis functions, reducing forgetting across continual learning benchmarks.
nodes.problem: Linear classifiers in continual learning struggle to keep a stable classification space across tasks.
nodes.approach: KAN-based classifier head using radial basis functions, swapped into several existing continual learning methods.
nodes.niche_reason: Kolmogorov-Arnold classifiers for continual learning are unusual

nodes.title: LLMDet: Learning Strong Open-Vocabulary Object Detectors under the Supervision of Large Language Models
nodes.tldr: LLMDet co-trains an open-vocabulary detector with an LLM on detailed image and region captions, improving detection with a new grounding-caption dataset.
nodes.problem: Open-vocabulary detectors rely on region-level annotations and underuse rich language supervision.
nodes.approach: Fine-tune detector with grounding loss and caption generation loss using LLM-generated captions from GroundingCap-1M.
nodes.niche_reason: Open-vocabulary detection with LLMs is a common direction.

nodes.title: LP-Diff: Towards Improved Restoration of Real-World Degraded License Plate
nodes.tldr: Restores real-world degraded license plates from multiple frames using a diffusion network and a new paired real-world dataset.
nodes.problem: Restoration methods trained on synthetic degradation fail on severely degraded real license plates.
nodes.approach: Diffusion network with inter-frame cross attention, texture enhancement, and dual-pathway channel-spatial fusion.
nodes.niche_reason: License plate restoration is a specific application niche.

nodes.title: LaTexBlend: Scaling Multi-concept Customized Generation with Latent Textual Blending
nodes.tldr: Scales multi-concept text-to-image customization by blending individually learned concepts in a latent textual space after the text encoder, avoiding denoising deviation.
nodes.problem: Customizing many concepts in one text-to-image generation degrades quality and efficiency.
nodes.approach: Per-concept latent textual features stored in a concept bank and combined at inference.
nodes.niche_reason: Customized text-to-image generation is a crowded subfield

nodes.title: Label Shift Meets Online Learning: Ensuring Consistent Adaptation with Universal Dynamic Regret
nodes.tldr: Addresses online label shift with a new convex risk estimator and an optimistic online learner plus ensemble, proving minimax-optimal universal dynamic regret.
nodes.problem: Adapting to label distribution shift on streaming data, where offline methods give inconsistent estimates.
nodes.approach: Convex risk estimator with optimistic online algorithm base learner and ensemble, with dynamic regret analysis.
nodes.primary_topic: Learning Theory & Optimization › Online Learning & Regret
secondary_topics: Architectures & Training › Domain Adaptation & OOD Generalization
nodes.niche_reason: Online label shift with dynamic regret is a rare theory-driven niche.

nodes.title: Latent Drifting in Diffusion Models for Counterfactual Medical Image Synthesis
nodes.tldr: Introduces Latent Drifting to condition diffusion models for counterfactual medical image generation, such as changing age or disease, across brain MRI and chest X-ray.
nodes.problem: Medical diffusion models suffer distribution shift and scarce data for counterfactual image synthesis.
nodes.approach: Latent drifting term usable with any fine-tuning method or as an inference-time condition.
nodes.niche_reason: Specialised medical counterfactual synthesis with a distinct conditioning trick

nodes.title: Learning 4D Panoptic Scene Graph Generation from Rich 2D Visual Scene
nodes.tldr: Generates 4D panoptic scene graphs with a 4D LLM and transfers abundant 2D scene graph annotations to 4D scenes to overcome data scarcity.
nodes.problem: 4D panoptic scene graph generation suffers from data scarcity, out-of-vocabulary labels and pipeline errors.
nodes.approach: End-to-end 4D-LLM with chained inference and 2D-to-4D transfer learning of dimension-invariant features.
nodes.niche_reason: 4D panoptic scene graphs are a rare representation.

nodes.title: Learning Class Prototypes for Unified Sparse-Supervised 3D Object Detection
nodes.tldr: Detects 3D objects from one labeled object per scene by matching class prototypes to unlabeled features via optimal transport, mining pseudo-labels indoors and outdoors.
nodes.problem: Sparse-supervised 3D detection ignores indoor scenes and leaves unlabeled objects unused.
nodes.approach: Prototype-based object mining via optimal transport matching plus multi-label cooperative refinement.
nodes.niche_reason: Sparse-supervised 3D detection is specialised but established

nodes.title: Learning Conditional Space-Time Prompt Distributions for Video Class-Incremental Learning
nodes.tldr: Models distribution of space-time prompts conditioned on input video with a diffusion model for video class-incremental learning, transferring image transformer token relations to video.
nodes.problem: Prompts in video class-incremental learning fail to capture video diversity
nodes.approach: Diffusion-generated conditional space-time prompts plus image-to-video token relation transfer
nodes.niche_reason: Video continual learning is a specialised niche.

nodes.title: Learning Phase Distortion with Selective State Space Models for Video Turbulence Mitigation
nodes.tldr: MambaTM, a selective state space turbulence mitigation network guided by a learned latent phase distortion map, beats prior methods with faster inference on video.
nodes.problem: Atmospheric turbulence degrades long-range video, and existing deep restoration methods are slow and generalize poorly.
nodes.approach: Selective state space network over space-time plus a learned latent phase distortion map replacing Zernike representations.
secondary_topics: Architectures & Training › State-Space Models & Linear Attention
nodes.niche_reason: Atmospheric turbulence restoration is an uncommon sub-problem.

nodes.title: Learning to Filter Outlier Edges in Global SfM
nodes.tldr: Filters outlier relative-translation edges in global SfM by classifying dual line-graph nodes with a Transformer, using clustering to scale to large pose graphs.
nodes.problem: Inaccurate pose graph edges degrade camera position accuracy in global structure-from-motion.
nodes.approach: Cast edge filtering as node classification on the line graph with a Transformer and clustering-based processing.
nodes.niche_reason: Learned outlier filtering for global SfM is a rare niche.

nodes.title: Less is More: Efficient Model Merging with Binary Task Switch
nodes.tldr: Binarizes fine-tuned task vectors into mask, sign, and scale switches for model merging, cutting parameter conflicts and storage to 1-3% with little performance loss.
nodes.problem: Model merging suffers from parameter conflicts and heavy storage of fine-tuned task vectors.
nodes.approach: Binarized task vectors (T-Switch) with training-free retrieval-based switch combination (Auto-Switch).
nodes.primary_topic: Architectures & Training › Efficient Training, Compression & Pruning
nodes.confidence_reason: Model merging fits compression, PEFT, and transfer topics; no exact topic.
nodes.niche_reason: Model merging is an active but specialised area.

nodes.title: Lessons and Insights from a Unifying Study of Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) in Visual Recognition
nodes.tldr: Unifying empirical study of parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods on Vision Transformers, finding tuned methods perform similarly, make complementary errors, work in many-shot regimes, and preserve robustness.
nodes.problem: Unclear when to apply PEFT and which method to use in visual recognition.
nodes.approach: Carefully hyperparameter-tuned comparison of PEFT methods on ViTs across low-shot, many-shot, and distribution-shift settings.
nodes.confidence_reason: PEFT topic is language-centric in vocabulary but paper is vision-specific.
nodes.niche_reason: PEFT is common, though a unifying empirical vision study is useful.

nodes.title: LeviTor: 3D Trajectory Oriented Image-to-Video Synthesis
nodes.tldr: LeviTor extends drag-based image-to-video control to 3D by letting users assign a relative depth to each trajectory point, fed to a video diffusion model.
nodes.problem: 2D drag-based video control is ambiguous for out-of-plane object motion.
nodes.approach: Abstract object masks into cluster points with depth and instance cues as a video diffusion control signal.
nodes.niche_reason: Depth-aware drag control for video diffusion is a specialised angle.

nodes.title: Lifting Motion to the 3D World via 2D Diffusion
nodes.tldr: MVLift predicts global 3D motion using only 2D pose training data, via multi-stage 2D motion diffusion producing consistent multi-view pose sequences.
nodes.problem: Estimating 3D motion requires 3D ground truth, limiting generalization to athletic, human-object, and animal motion.
nodes.approach: Multi-stage 2D motion diffusion generating multi-view consistent 2D poses to recover global 3D motion.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › Human Pose, Avatars & Faces
nodes.niche_reason: 3D motion lifting without 3D supervision is specialised.

nodes.title: Light Transport-aware Diffusion Posterior Sampling for Single-View Reconstruction of 3D Volumes
nodes.tldr: Reconstructs volumetric clouds from a single view by sampling a diffusion prior in a monoplanar latent space, guided by a differentiable light-transport renderer.
nodes.problem: Single-view reconstruction of multiply-scattering volumes like clouds is ill-posed and NeRF-style methods misalign with observed data.
nodes.approach: Diffusion posterior sampling in latent codes of a monoplanar representation, with physically based volume rendering gradients.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: Light-transport-aware volumetric reconstruction of clouds is rare

nodes.title: Light3R-SfM: Towards Feed-forward Structure-from-Motion
nodes.tldr: Light3R-SfM is a feed-forward structure-from-motion system that replaces global optimization with a learnable latent global alignment module and a sparse retrieval-guided scene graph.
nodes.problem: Large-scale structure-from-motion is slow and memory-heavy due to costly matching and global optimization.
nodes.approach: Learnable attention-based latent global alignment with sparse scene graph built from retrieval-score shortest path tree.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: Feed-forward SfM is a hot but specialised geometry direction.

nodes.title: Locally Orderless Images for Optimization in Differentiable Rendering
nodes.tldr: Replaces sparse image gradients in differentiable rendering with histogram-based locally orderless images, enabling a histogram-distance objective that recovers scene parameters.
nodes.problem: Scene-parameter gradients from differentiable rendering are sparse in image space, so optimization converges poorly.
nodes.approach: Locally orderless images: per-pixel intensity histograms, minimized with histogram distance.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.confidence_reason: Rendering vs optimization; topic straddles two areas.
nodes.niche_reason: Histogram-based gradient support for inverse rendering is unusual.

nodes.title: MAR-3D: Progressive Masked Auto-regressor for High-Resolution 3D Generation
nodes.tldr: MAR-3D generates high-resolution 3D shapes with a pyramid VAE and a cascaded masked autoregressive transformer that upscales latent tokens progressively in continuous space.
nodes.problem: Autoregressive 3D generation clashes with unordered 3D data and loses detail under vector quantization.
nodes.approach: Random-order masked autoregressive denoising in continuous latent space, with cascaded training and condition augmentation for upscaling.
nodes.niche_reason: 3D generation is established; masked autoregression for it is a moderate variant.

nodes.title: MASH-VLM: Mitigating Action-Scene Hallucination in Video-LLMs through Disentangled Spatial-Temporal Representations
nodes.tldr: Reduces action-scene hallucination in Video-LLMs by masking spatial-temporal attention interactions and extending RoPE positional IDs, evaluated on the new UNSCENE benchmark.
nodes.problem: Video-LLMs mispredict actions from scene context and vice versa, due to entangled tokens and RoPE bias.
nodes.approach: Masked disentangled spatial-temporal attention plus Harmonic-RoPE that extends positional IDs for balanced positions.
nodes.niche_reason: Video-LLM hallucination is an active, crowded direction

nodes.title: MASt3R-SLAM: Real-Time Dense SLAM with 3D Reconstruction Priors
nodes.tldr: MASt3R-SLAM is a real-time monocular dense SLAM system built on MASt3R two-view reconstruction priors, with pointmap matching, loop closure, and global optimization at 15 FPS.
nodes.problem: Monocular dense SLAM is fragile on in-the-wild video without fixed camera model assumptions.
nodes.approach: Build tracking, local fusion, loop closure, and second-order global optimisation around MASt3R pointmap matching priors.
secondary_topics: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: Learned-prior SLAM is active but specialised.

nodes.title: MATCHA: Towards Matching Anything
nodes.tldr: Unified feature model for image correspondence that fuses diffusion features with DINOv2 via attention, matching geometric, semantic, and temporal correspondences.
nodes.problem: Correspondence methods are specialized per type and lack a single unified feature.
nodes.approach: Attention-based fusion of diffusion features with DINOv2 object-level features.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › Vision Foundation Models & Self-Supervision
nodes.confidence_reason: Correspondence spans geometric, semantic, and temporal matching.
nodes.niche_reason: Correspondence matching is a well-studied area; unified feature is mainstream.

nodes.title: MAtCha Gaussians: Atlas of Charts for High-Quality Geometry and Photorealism From Sparse Views
nodes.tldr: MAtCha models scene geometry as an atlas of charts rendered with 2D Gaussian surfels, distilling monocular depth to get meshes and photorealistic novel views from sparse views.
nodes.problem: Getting both high-quality explicit surface meshes and photorealism from very few input views.
nodes.approach: Charts initialized from monocular depth with neural deformation and structure loss, rendered via attached Gaussian surfels.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: Gaussian-splatting surface reconstruction is popular; atlas-of-charts is more specialised.

nodes.title: MITracker: Multi-View Integration for Visual Object Tracking
nodes.tldr: Multi-view object tracker that lifts 2D features into a 3D volume compressed to a bird's-eye view, plus a 234K-frame multi-view tracking dataset.
nodes.problem: Single-view tracking fails under occlusion and target loss, and multi-view tracking lacks data and fusion methods.
nodes.approach: 2D-to-3D feature volume compressed to BEV for cross-view fusion, with geometry-guided attention refining tracks per view.
nodes.niche_reason: Multi-view object tracking is a less explored direction than single-view tracking

nodes.title: MLLM-as-a-Judge for Image Safety without Human Labeling
nodes.tldr: Detects unsafe images zero-shot by querying MLLMs with a safety constitution, using debiased token probabilities and cascaded reasoning.
nodes.problem: Image safety judgment needs costly human labels that go stale as rules change.
nodes.approach: Objectified safety rules, debiased token probabilities, and cascaded chain-of-thought.
nodes.confidence_reason: Zero-shot MLLM judging spans vision and safety; topic is a judgment call
nodes.niche_reason: Using MLLMs as zero-shot judges is a common direction

nodes.title: MPDrive: Improving Spatial Understanding with Marker-Based Prompt Learning for Autonomous Driving
nodes.tldr: MPDrive represents spatial coordinates as numbered visual markers overlaid on detected objects, giving an LLM dual-granularity visual prompts for driving visual question answering.
nodes.problem: Textual coordinate representations create semantic gaps and hurt spatial understanding in driving VQA.
nodes.approach: Marker images from a detector, fused scene and instance features as visual prompts to an LLM.
nodes.niche_reason: Driving VQA with marker prompts is specialised.

nodes.title: MUSt3R: Multi-view Network for Stereo 3D Reconstruction
nodes.tldr: Extends DUSt3R from image pairs to multiple views with a symmetric architecture and multi-layer memory, enabling scalable offline and online reconstruction and SLAM.
nodes.problem: DUSt3R's pairwise processing scales quadratically and needs costly global alignment on large collections.
nodes.approach: Symmetric multi-view network directly predicting pointmaps in a common frame, with multi-layer memory.
secondary_topics: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: DUSt3R-style feed-forward reconstruction is a crowded trend.

nodes.title: Make-It-Animatable: An Efficient Framework for Authoring Animation-Ready 3D Characters
nodes.tldr: Make-It-Animatable predicts blend weights, bones, and pose transformations to make any humanoid 3D model animation-ready in under a second, supporting meshes and Gaussian splats.
nodes.problem: Rigging and skinning 3D characters is manual, with automatic tools limited by fixed skeletons and poor generalization.
nodes.approach: Data-driven unified framework with particle-based shape autoencoder, coarse-to-fine representation, and structure-aware modeling.
secondary_topics: Computer Vision › Human Pose, Avatars & Faces
nodes.niche_reason: Automatic rigging and skinning is a rare graphics-oriented task.

nodes.title: Mamba as a Bridge: Where Vision Foundation Models Meet Vision Language Models for Domain-Generalized Semantic Segmentation
nodes.tldr: MFuser fuses vision foundation models and CLIP-style VLMs with Mamba-based co-adaptation and text-embedding refinement for domain-generalized semantic segmentation, with linear sequence scaling.
nodes.problem: Combining VFM fine-grained features and VLM text alignment for domain-generalized segmentation despite long patch sequences.
nodes.approach: Mamba-based co-adapter (MVFuser) and hybrid attention-Mamba text enhancer (MTEnhancer).
secondary_topics: Architectures & Training › Domain Adaptation & OOD Generalization
Architectures & Training › State-Space Models & Linear Attention
nodes.niche_reason: Domain-generalized segmentation with Mamba fusion is specialised.

nodes.title: MambaVLT: Time-Evolving Multimodal State Space Model for Vision-Language Tracking
nodes.tldr: MambaVLT uses a time-evolving Mamba state space model with a selective locality block to track objects from language and visual references.
nodes.problem: Vision-language trackers poorly exploit temporal information and dynamic reference updating.
nodes.approach: Time-evolving hybrid state space block plus selective locality enhancement block for multimodal temporal modeling.
secondary_topics: Architectures & Training › State-Space Models & Linear Attention
nodes.niche_reason: Vision-language tracking is a specialised subfield; Mamba angle adds some novelty.

nodes.title: MammAlps: A Multi-view Video Behavior Monitoring Dataset of Wild Mammals in the Swiss Alps
nodes.tldr: Releases MammAlps, a multi-view multimodal camera-trap video dataset of Alpine wildlife with behavior and species labels, plus two behavior and ecological event benchmarks.
nodes.problem: Lack of annotated video datasets limits automated wildlife behavior monitoring from camera traps.
nodes.approach: Collect 14 hours of multi-view video with audio and segmentation, label behaviors, and define hierarchical behavior and ecological event benchmarks.
nodes.niche_reason: Wildlife behavior video datasets for ecology are a rare application.

nodes.title: MangaNinja: Line Art Colorization with Precise Reference Following
nodes.tldr: MangaNinja is a diffusion model for reference-guided line art colorization, using patch shuffling for correspondence and point-driven control for fine-grained color matching.
nodes.problem: Colorizing line art while precisely following details of a reference color image.
nodes.approach: Diffusion model with patch shuffling for correspondence learning and interactive point-driven control.
nodes.niche_reason: Specialised creative application of diffusion; moderately niche.

nodes.title: ManiVideo: Generating Hand-Object Manipulation Video with Dexterous and Generalizable Grasping
nodes.tldr: Generates consistent bimanual hand-object manipulation videos from hand and object motion sequences, using a multi-layer occlusion representation and Objaverse objects.
nodes.problem: Hand-object video generation struggles with 3D occlusion consistency and scarce video data for diverse objects.
nodes.approach: Multi-layer occlusion representation embedded in a UNet, trained with Objaverse for object generalization.
secondary_topics: Computer Vision › Human Pose, Avatars & Faces
nodes.niche_reason: Hand-object manipulation video generation is specialised.

nodes.title: Material Anything: Generating Materials for Any 3D Object via Diffusion
nodes.tldr: Material Anything generates PBR materials for 3D objects with a pretrained image diffusion model, triple-head architecture, confidence masks and UV-space refinement.
nodes.problem: Automatically generating physically-based materials for textured or texture-less objects under varied lighting.
nodes.approach: Image diffusion with triple heads, rendering loss, confidence-mask switching and progressive generation plus UV refiner.
nodes.niche_reason: Material generation is narrower than general 3D generation.

nodes.title: Matrix3D: Large Photogrammetry Model All-in-One
nodes.tldr: Matrix3D is a unified multi-modal diffusion transformer performing pose estimation, depth prediction and novel view synthesis, trained with masked learning over partially complete data.
nodes.problem: Photogrammetry subtasks are handled by separate models and need fully paired data.
nodes.approach: Multi-modal DiT over images, cameras and depth with mask learning enabling partial-modality training.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: Unified diffusion model for several geometry tasks is somewhat specialised.

nodes.title: MegaSaM: Accurate, Fast and Robust Structure and Motion from Casual Dynamic Videos
nodes.tldr: Camera pose and depth estimation from casual monocular dynamic videos by adapting deep visual SLAM with modified training and inference schemes.
nodes.problem: Robust camera and depth estimation in dynamic scenes with little parallax
nodes.approach: Deep visual SLAM with careful training/inference modifications for dynamic videos
nodes.niche_reason: Active area of dynamic-scene geometry, several concurrent works.

nodes.title: Memories of Forgotten Concepts
nodes.tldr: Shows concept-ablated diffusion models still retain erased concepts: inversion finds latent seeds generating them, suggesting full concept erasure may be intractable.
nodes.problem: Whether concept ablation in text-to-image diffusion models truly removes the erased concept information.
nodes.approach: Latent inversion to find seeds producing erased-concept images, and analysis of their likelihood overlap with other images.
nodes.primary_topic: Trustworthy ML › Machine Unlearning & Privacy Attacks
nodes.niche_reason: Concept erasure attacks are an established but specialised area.

nodes.title: MeshGen: Generating PBR Textured Mesh with Render-Enhanced Auto-Encoder and Generative Data Augmentation
nodes.tldr: MeshGen generates PBR-textured 3D meshes from images using a render-enhanced shape autoencoder, data augmentation, and a multi-view ControlNet texture pipeline.
nodes.problem: Existing 3D diffusion models have weak autoencoders, limited controllability, and inconsistent PBR texturing.
nodes.approach: Render-enhanced point-to-shape autoencoder, geometric and generative rendering augmentation, and multi-view PBR decomposition with ControlNet.
nodes.niche_reason: Image-to-3D generation is crowded; PBR texturing adds some specialisation.

nodes.title: Meta-Learning Hyperparameters for Parameter Efficient Fine-Tuning
nodes.tldr: MetaPEFT meta-learns adaptive scalers that adjust PEFT module insertion, layer selection and learning rates, improving tail-class accuracy on remote sensing images.
nodes.problem: Fixed PEFT hyperparameters hurt fine-tuning on long-tailed remote sensing images
nodes.approach: Meta-learned adaptive scalers controlling module insertion, layer choice and module-wise learning rates
nodes.niche_reason: PEFT is common; meta-learned PEFT hyperparameters for remote sensing is specialised

nodes.title: MetricGrids: Arbitrary Nonlinear Approximation with Elementary Metric Grids based Implicit Neural Representation
nodes.tldr: Grid-based implicit neural representation combining elementary metric grids as Taylor-style high-order terms to fit complex nonlinear 2D and 3D signals.
nodes.problem: Linear-indexed feature grids give degenerate latent representations for nonlinear signals
nodes.approach: Multiple elementary metric grids with hash encoding and a high-order extrapolation decoder
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
secondary_topics: Architectures & Training › Efficient Training, Compression & Pruning
nodes.confidence_reason: Neural fields topic straddles reconstruction and compact representation
nodes.niche_reason: Specialised implicit neural representation architecture

nodes.title: Mind the Trojan Horse: Image Prompt Adapter Enabling Scalable and Deceptive Jailbreaking
nodes.tldr: Reveals a hijacking jailbreak attack where adversarial images uploaded to IP-Adapter equipped text-to-image services make benign users generate harmful content, and explores defenses.
nodes.problem: IP-Adapter in text-to-image diffusion services opens a new scalable and deceptive jailbreak vulnerability.
nodes.approach: Craft imperceptible adversarial image prompts exploiting open-source encoders; evaluate defenses including adversarial training.
nodes.niche_reason: Image-prompt adapter attacks are a specialised safety niche.

nodes.title: MoSca: Dynamic Gaussian Fusion from Casual Videos via 4D Motion Scaffolds
nodes.tldr: MoSca reconstructs dynamic scenes from casual monocular video using 4D motion scaffolds and fused Gaussians, jointly solving camera pose and focal length.
nodes.problem: Novel view synthesis of dynamic scenes from casual monocular videos
nodes.approach: Motion scaffold deformation representation with globally fused Gaussian splatting and bundle adjustment
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: Dynamic Gaussian splatting is a very active area.

nodes.title: Modeling Thousands of Human Annotators for Generalizable Text-to-Image Person Re-identification
nodes.tldr: Human Annotator Modeling prompts MLLMs to mimic thousands of annotator description styles, producing diverse captions to build a large database for text-to-image person ReID.
nodes.problem: Costly manual annotation and low caption style diversity limit generalization of text-to-image person ReID.
nodes.approach: Cluster human description styles, learn a prompt per cluster, sample the style space uniformly to generate captions.
secondary_topics: Data, Benchmarks & Evaluation › Synthetic Data & Data Curation
nodes.confidence_reason: Retrieval task; topics for cross-modal retrieval are not a close vocabulary match.
nodes.niche_reason: Text-based person ReID is a specialised retrieval niche.

nodes.title: Molmo and PixMo: Open Weights and Open Data for State-of-the-Art Vision-Language Models
nodes.tldr: Releases Molmo, open-weight and open-data vision-language models trained on newly collected PixMo datasets (captions, Q&A, 2D pointing) without distilling proprietary VLMs.
nodes.problem: Strong VLMs depend on proprietary models or synthetic data, so building them from scratch is poorly understood.
nodes.approach: Collect new human-annotated PixMo datasets and train a well-tuned open VLM family up to 72B.
nodes.niche_reason: Open VLM training is a very crowded mainstream area.

nodes.title: MonSter: Marry Monodepth to Stereo Unleashes Power
nodes.tldr: MonSter fuses monocular depth and stereo matching in a dual-branch architecture that iteratively refine each other, topping five stereo leaderboards and generalizing zero-shot.
nodes.problem: Stereo matching fails in ill-posed regions such as occlusions and textureless areas.
nodes.approach: Dual-branch mutual refinement using confidence-guided scale-shift recovery for monodepth and monodepth priors for stereo.
nodes.niche_reason: Stereo depth estimation is a common vision task.

nodes.title: MotionPRO: Exploring the Role of Pressure in Human MoCap and Beyond
nodes.tldr: Uses pressure sensing with RGB to estimate human pose and global trajectory in motion capture, with a new 12.4M-frame pressure-RGB-optical dataset.
nodes.problem: Visual motion capture ignores physical plausibility, causing sliding, penetration, and trajectory drift.
nodes.approach: Pressure-only and pressure-RGB fusion networks with long-short-term attention and contact constraints.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › Human Pose, Avatars & Faces
nodes.confidence_reason: Dataset and method contributions both prominent; judgment call.
nodes.niche_reason: Pressure-based mocap is a rare sensing modality for human pose

nodes.title: Multi-Label Prototype Visual Spatial Search for Weakly Supervised Semantic Segmentation
nodes.tldr: MuP-VSS learns class prototype tokens that search image patches, using contrastive and consistency losses, to produce more complete weakly supervised segmentation masks.
nodes.problem: CAM and self-attention maps give incomplete masks from image-level labels due to classification bias.
nodes.approach: Learnable multi-label prototype queries trained with cross-class, cross-image and patch-to-prototype losses.
nodes.niche_reason: Weakly supervised segmentation is a crowded mainstream area.

nodes.title: Multi-modal Vision Pre-training for Medical Image Analysis
nodes.tldr: Pretrains on multi-parametric brain MRI with cross-modal reconstruction, modality-aware contrastive learning, and template distillation, improving downstream segmentation and classification.
nodes.problem: Self-supervised medical pretraining ignores inter-modal correlations in naturally grouped multi-modal MRI data.
nodes.approach: Three proxy tasks: cross-modal reconstruction, modality-aware contrastive learning, and modality template distillation.
nodes.niche_reason: Medical self-supervised pretraining is established but specialised.

nodes.title: Multimodal Autoregressive Pre-training of Large Vision Encoders
nodes.tldr: AIMv2 pretrains vision encoders by autoregressively generating image patches and text tokens with a multimodal decoder, outperforming CLIP and SigLIP on many tasks.
nodes.problem: Pretraining scalable generalist vision encoders that excel at both multimodal understanding and vision benchmarks.
nodes.approach: Pair a vision encoder with a multimodal autoregressive decoder predicting raw patches and text tokens.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › Vision Foundation Models & Self-Supervision
nodes.niche_reason: Vision encoder pretraining is common, though autoregressive route is less so.

nodes.title: Multirate Neural Image Compression with Adaptive Lattice Vector Quantization
nodes.tldr: Adaptive lattice vector quantization for learned image compression that achieves variable-rate coding by scaling the lattice basis and adapting domains with a learned linear transform.
nodes.problem: Existing lattice quantizers lack multirate coding and adapt poorly to source distributions.
nodes.approach: Scaled lattice basis for rate control and learned invertible transform for domain reshaping.
secondary_topics: Architectures & Training › Efficient Training, Compression & Pruning
nodes.niche_reason: Lattice quantization for learned compression is specialised.

nodes.title: Multitwine: Multi-Object Compositing with Text and Layout Control
nodes.tldr: Multitwine is a generative model for simultaneous multi-object compositing guided by text and layout, handling interactions like hugging and generating implied props.
nodes.problem: Compositing multiple objects with complex interactions into a scene under text and layout control.
nodes.approach: Joint training of compositing and subject-driven generation for balanced text and visual conditioning.
nodes.niche_reason: Image compositing with diffusion is a common theme.

nodes.title: NLPrompt: Noise-Label Prompt Learning for Vision-Language Models
nodes.tldr: Makes CLIP prompt learning robust to noisy labels using MAE loss plus optimal-transport purification routing clean samples to cross-entropy, noisy ones to MAE.
nodes.problem: Real-world noisy labels degrade prompt learning for vision-language models.
nodes.approach: PromptMAE loss plus PromptOT optimal-transport purification using text prototypes to split clean and noisy subsets.
secondary_topics: Architectures & Training › Domain Adaptation & OOD Generalization
nodes.niche_reason: Noisy-label prompt learning is a specialised subtopic.

nodes.title: NSD-Imagery: A Benchmark Dataset for Extending fMRI Vision Decoding Methods to Mental Imagery
nodes.tldr: Releases NSD-Imagery, paired fMRI and mental-image data, and benchmarks NSD-trained visual decoders, showing mental imagery performance is largely decoupled from seen-image reconstruction.
nodes.problem: Visual decoders are only tested on seen images, not on the mental imagery needed for BCI.
nodes.approach: Benchmark dataset of fMRI paired with mental images, evaluating five open-source NSD-trained decoding models.
nodes.niche_reason: Mental-imagery fMRI decoding is a rare cross-disciplinary niche.

nodes.title: NTClick: Achieving Precise Interactive Segmentation With Noise-tolerant Clicks
nodes.tldr: Click-based interactive segmentation that tolerates imprecise clicks on fine structures, using a coarse perception network followed by a high-resolution refinement network.
nodes.problem: Precisely clicking narrow, fine regions is hard in click-based interactive segmentation.
nodes.approach: Noise-tolerant click interaction with two-stage coarse perception and high-resolution refinement networks.
nodes.niche_reason: Interactive segmentation is established but specialised.

nodes.title: Navigation World Models
nodes.tldr: Navigation World Model is a 1B-parameter conditional diffusion transformer that predicts future egocentric observations from navigation actions and plans trajectories by simulating and ranking them.
nodes.problem: Planning navigation with flexible constraints using a learned predictive model of visual observations.
nodes.approach: Conditional Diffusion Transformer video world model trained on egocentric data, used for trajectory simulation and ranking.
secondary_topics: Reinforcement Learning › Model-Based RL & World Models
nodes.niche_reason: World models and diffusion transformers are mainstream, though navigation use is more focused.

nodes.title: NeRFPrior: Learning Neural Radiance Field as a Prior for Indoor Scene Reconstruction
nodes.tldr: NeRFPrior uses a fast-trained radiance field as a prior providing density and colour cues for signed distance surface reconstruction from multi-view images.
nodes.problem: Neural implicit surface reconstruction needs large pre-training and ignores colour cues.
nodes.approach: Learn signed distance fields from NeRF density with multi-view consistency per ray and depth loss for textureless areas.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: NeRF-based surface reconstruction is a common, well-populated area.

nodes.title: NexusGS: Sparse View Synthesis with Epipolar Depth Priors in 3D Gaussian Splatting
nodes.tldr: Sparse-view Gaussian splatting that initializes from epipolar depth priors and optical flow, yielding denser point clouds for stable few-shot novel view synthesis.
nodes.problem: Few-shot novel view synthesis fails with sparse supervision in 3DGS
nodes.approach: Epipolar depth nexus and flow-filtered depth blending for dense 3DGS initialization
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: Sparse-view 3DGS is a crowded, active area

nodes.title: No Pains, More Gains: Recycling Sub-Salient Patches for Efficient High-Resolution Image Recognition
nodes.tldr: Recycles sub-salient image patches through an auxiliary buffer used only in forward passes, letting high-resolution recognition train on more patches at low cost.
nodes.problem: High-resolution recognition methods discard sub-salient patches, missing context needed for accuracy.
nodes.approach: Dual buffer with MIL aggregation and random patch drop, backpropagating only through salient patches.
nodes.niche_reason: Patch-based high-resolution recognition is established but specialised

nodes.title: Not Only Text: Exploring Compositionality of Visual Representations in Vision-Language Models
nodes.tldr: Shows pretrained VLM image embeddings carry compositional structure, and proposes a geodesic decomposition that improves compositional classification and group robustness.
nodes.problem: Whether compositional structure exists in visual embedding spaces, where image noise and sparsity complicate analysis.
nodes.approach: Geodesically Decomposable Embeddings that approximate image representations with geometry-aware compositional structure.
nodes.confidence_reason: Could equally sit under interpretability; VLM topic chosen
nodes.niche_reason: Established interpretability question, specialised to visual embeddings

nodes.title: O-TPT: Orthogonality Constraints for Calibrating Test-time Prompt Tuning in Vision-Language Models
nodes.tldr: Adds orthogonality constraints on learned textual prompt features so test-time prompt tuning for VLMs yields better calibrated predictions.
nodes.problem: Test-time prompt tuning boosts VLM accuracy but leaves the resulting models poorly calibrated.
nodes.approach: Orthogonalize textual features of learnable prompts to increase dispersion and reduce calibration error.
nodes.niche_reason: Test-time prompt tuning calibration is a specialised but active VLM subfield.

nodes.title: OPTICAL: Leveraging Optimal Transport for Contribution Allocation in Dataset Distillation
nodes.tldr: Improves dataset distillation by using an optimal transport matrix to allocate per-instance contributions from real samples to each synthetic sample, via bi-level matching-and-approximating.
nodes.problem: Equal contribution of real instances in distillation ignores instance-level relationships and geometric structure.
nodes.approach: Bi-level optimization using an optimal transport plan to weight real samples when updating synthetic ones.
nodes.primary_topic: Data, Benchmarks & Evaluation › Synthetic Data & Data Curation
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Optimal Transport & Divergences
nodes.niche_reason: Dataset distillation is established but specialised.

nodes.title: Octopus: Alleviating Hallucination via Dynamic Contrastive Decoding
nodes.tldr: Octopus adaptively identifies the hallucination type at each decoding step and builds a dynamic contrastive decoding workflow to reduce hallucinations in large vision-language models.
nodes.problem: Contrastive decoding for LVLM hallucination uses a one-size-fits-all strategy despite varied per-step causes.
nodes.approach: Octopus-like framework that adaptively selects hallucination-specific contrastive decoding at each generation step.
nodes.niche_reason: LVLM hallucination mitigation is a crowded topic.

nodes.title: Overcoming Shortcut Problem in VLM for Robust Out-of-Distribution Detection
nodes.tldr: OSPCoOp decouples foreground and background regions in CLIP prompt learning to create pseudo-OOD samples, fixing background shortcuts in OOD detection, with a new ImageNet-Bg dataset.

nodes.title: PGC: Physics-Based Gaussian Cloth from a Single Pose
nodes.tldr: PGC reconstructs simulation-ready garments from a multi-view capture of one static frame using hybrid mesh-embedded Gaussian splats, enabling physics simulation and novel poses.

nodes.title: Panorama Generation From NFoV Image Done Right
nodes.tldr: Decouples panorama generation into a distortion-guidance network and a content-completion network, plus a distortion-specific CLIP metric to expose visual cheating.

nodes.niche_reason: Panorama generation from narrow views is specialised

nodes.title: Parallelized Autoregressive Visual Generation
nodes.tldr: Speeds up autoregressive image and video generation by generating distant weakly dependent tokens in parallel while keeping local tokens sequential, with no architecture change.
nodes.problem: Slow token-by-token inference in autoregressive visual generation.

nodes.title: PartGen: Part-level 3D Generation and Reconstruction with Multi-view Diffusion Models
nodes.tldr: Generates and reconstructs 3D objects composed of meaningful parts using multi-view diffusion for part segmentation and contextual part completion before 3D reconstruction.

nodes.title: Perceptually Accurate 3D Talking Head Generation: New Definitions, Speech-Mesh Representation, and Evaluation Metrics
nodes.tldr: Learns a speech-mesh representation used as a perceptual loss and metric, improving lip synchronization of speech-driven 3D talking heads.

nodes.title: PhD: A ChatGPT-Prompted Visual Hallucination Evaluation Dataset
nodes.tldr: PhD is a ChatGPT-assisted dataset of 102k VQA items for evaluating multimodal LLM visual hallucination across tasks and modes, including counter-common-sense images.

nodes.title: Pippo: High-Resolution Multi-View Humans from a Single Image
nodes.tldr: Generates 1K multi-view turnaround videos of a person from one casual photo using a multi-view diffusion transformer, without fitted body models or camera inputs.

nodes.title: PlanarSplatting: Accurate Planar Surface Reconstruction in 3 Minutes
nodes.tldr: PlanarSplatting reconstructs indoor surfaces in about 3 minutes by directly optimizing 3D plane primitives splatted into depth and normal maps, without plane detection or matching.

nodes.niche_reason: Plane-primitive reconstruction is a specialised branch of splatting.

nodes.title: Point-to-Region Loss for Semi-Supervised Point-Based Crowd Counting
nodes.tldr: Semi-supervised crowd counting that replaces point-to-point supervision with point-to-region loss, so pseudo-label confidence spreads to background pixels.
nodes.problem: Point-based counters need many annotated points, and pseudo-label confidence fails to reach background.

nodes.title: Polarized Color Screen Matting
nodes.tldr: A single-shot per-pixel matting theory combining color and polarization cues recovers alpha and foreground color with closed-form methods using an LCD screen and polarization camera.
nodes.problem: Alpha matting with known background is ill-posed when relying on color or polarization alone.
nodes.approach: Diffuse-specular polarimetric compositing equation yielding closed-form matting solutions with solvability conditions.
nodes.niche_reason: Polarization-based matting is very rare.

nodes.title: Prior-free 3D Object Tracking
nodes.tldr: Tracks objects in 3D without any model or training priors, by iteratively generating a mesh and optimizing pose so each module improves the other.
nodes.problem: 3D object tracking normally needs known CAD models or training datasets, limiting applicability.

nodes.niche_reason: Prior-free 3D tracking without models is an unusual direction

nodes.title: Project-Probe-Aggregate: Efficient Fine-Tuning for Group Robustness
nodes.tldr: Fine-tunes foundation models for worst-group accuracy without group labels, by projecting features, inferring groups, and aggregating weights.
nodes.problem: Spurious correlations hurt image-text foundation models on minority groups.

nodes.title: QuCOOP: A Versatile Framework for Solving Composite and Binary-Parametrised Problems on Quantum Annealers
nodes.tldr: QuCOOP extends adiabatic quantum annealers beyond QUBO by iteratively approximating composite binary-parametrised objectives with local QUBO forms, applied to assignment, shape matching, and point set registration.
nodes.problem: Quantum annealers only support QUBO problems, limiting vision applications.

nodes.title: Question-Aware Gaussian Experts for Audio-Visual Question Answering
nodes.tldr: QA-TIGER models question-conditioned Gaussian temporal focus with a mixture of experts to select relevant frames for audio-visual question answering, reaching state-of-the-art results.

nodes.title: RGBAvatar: Reduced Gaussian Blendshapes for Online Modeling of Head Avatars
nodes.tldr: Reconstructs animatable photorealistic head avatars in real time by mapping 3DMM parameters to a compact set of Gaussian blendshape bases with an MLP.

nodes.title: RLAIF-V: Open-Source AI Feedback Leads to Super GPT-4V Trustworthiness

nodes.title: ROLL: Robust Noisy Pseudo-label Learning for Multi-View Clustering with Noisy Correspondence
