nodes.problem: Current X-ray security datasets lack realistic threats and closed-set labels limit detection.
nodes.approach: Domain-aware caption generation producing instruction data to fine-tune a vision-language assistant.
nodes.niche_reason: Rare application: X-ray security screening with VLMs

nodes.title: SURGEON: Memory-Adaptive Fully Test-Time Adaptation via Dynamic Activation Sparsity
nodes.tldr: Memory-efficient fully test-time adaptation that prunes activations at layer-specific dynamic ratios, keeping most accuracy gains while cutting adaptation memory.
nodes.problem: Backpropagation-based test-time adaptation is too memory-hungry for resource-constrained mobile devices.
nodes.approach: Dynamic activation sparsity with layer ratios set by gradient importance and activation memory.
nodes.primary_topic: Architectures & Training › Efficient Training, Compression & Pruning
secondary_topics: Architectures & Training › Domain Adaptation & OOD Generalization
nodes.niche_reason: Established but specialised: memory-constrained test-time adaptation.

nodes.title: SaMam: Style-aware State Space Model for Arbitrary Image Style Transfer
nodes.tldr: SaMam uses Mamba state-space models with a style-aware decoder and zigzag scanning for arbitrary style transfer at linear cost.
nodes.problem: CNN and Transformer style transfer backbones are too costly for global receptive fields.
nodes.approach: Mamba encoder and style-aware Mamba decoder with local enhancement and zigzag scanning.
secondary_topics: Architectures & Training › State-Space Models & Linear Attention
nodes.niche_reason: Mamba-based style transfer is specialised but not rare.

nodes.title: Samba: A Unified Mamba-based Framework for General Salient Object Detection
nodes.tldr: Samba is a pure Mamba-based framework for salient object detection across RGB, RGB-D, RGB-T, and video, with saliency-guided scanning and context-aware upsampling.
nodes.problem: CNN and Transformer salient object detectors are limited by receptive field or quadratic cost.
nodes.approach: Saliency-guided Mamba blocks with spatial neighboring scanning and context-aware upsampling.
secondary_topics: Architectures & Training › State-Space Models & Linear Attention
nodes.niche_reason: Salient object detection with Mamba is a specialised subarea.

nodes.title: Satellite Observations Guided Diffusion Model for Accurate Meteorological States at Arbitrary Resolution
nodes.tldr: Conditional diffusion model that downscales ERA5 meteorological fields to arbitrary resolution, conditioned on satellite observations and station data via zero-shot guidance.
nodes.problem: Low-resolution meteorological grids disagree with station observations at specific locations.
nodes.approach: Attention fusion of satellite data during training, guided zero-shot sampling with learned upscaling kernels, patch-based sampling.
nodes.niche_reason: Unusual cross-disciplinary use of diffusion for weather downscaling

nodes.title: Scaling Inference Time Compute for Diffusion Models
nodes.tldr: Shows diffusion models keep improving with inference compute by searching for better initial noise, guided by verifiers and search algorithms.
nodes.problem: Quality gains from more denoising steps flatten after a few dozen, leaving extra compute unexploited.
nodes.approach: Search over initial noise candidates, with a design space of verifier feedback and search algorithms.
nodes.niche_reason: Inference-time scaling is a hot topic; noise-search variants are increasingly common.

nodes.title: Scaling Vision Pre-Training to 4K Resolution
nodes.tldr: PS3 scales CLIP-style pretraining to 4K by contrasting selectively processed local regions with detailed captions; VILA-HD built on it improves high-resolution MLLM perception, with a new 4KPro benchmark.
nodes.problem: Vision pre-training is limited to low resolutions due to quadratic cost of high-resolution processing.
nodes.approach: Selective local-region high-resolution encoding contrasted with local captions, integrated into a multimodal LLM.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › Vision Foundation Models & Self-Supervision
nodes.niche_reason: High-resolution vision encoders are specialised within a crowded VLM area.

nodes.title: Scene-Centric Unsupervised Panoptic Segmentation
nodes.tldr: First unsupervised panoptic segmentation method trained directly on scene-centric images, building high-resolution pseudo labels from visual features, depth and motion, then self-training.
nodes.problem: Unsupervised panoptic segmentation previously needed object-centric data and could not handle complex scenes.
nodes.approach: Pseudo labels from representations, depth and motion cues, followed by pseudo-label training and panoptic self-training.
secondary_topics: Computer Vision › Vision Foundation Models & Self-Supervision
nodes.niche_reason: Unsupervised segmentation is established but specialised.

nodes.title: SeCap: Self-Calibrating and Adaptive Prompts for Cross-view Person Re-Identification in Aerial-Ground Networks
nodes.tldr: SeCap uses self-calibrating adaptive prompts and local feature refinement for aerial-ground person re-identification, and contributes two new large-scale aerial-ground ReID datasets.
nodes.problem: Large viewpoint differences between aerial and ground cameras make person identity matching difficult.
nodes.approach: Prompt Re-calibration Module and Local Feature Refinement Module extracting view-invariant features; new datasets LAGPeR and G2APS-ReID.
nodes.niche_reason: Aerial-ground person re-identification is a rare vision subtask.

nodes.title: SeedVR: Seeding Infinity in Diffusion Transformer Towards Generic Video Restoration
nodes.tldr: SeedVR is a diffusion transformer with shifted window attention and variable-sized boundary windows for real-world video restoration at arbitrary length and resolution.
nodes.problem: Video restoration needs fidelity and temporal consistency under unknown degradations with limited sampling efficiency.
nodes.approach: Diffusion transformer with shifted variable-size window attention, causal video autoencoder, progressive training.
nodes.niche_reason: Diffusion-based restoration is a common direction.

nodes.title: Seeing More with Less: Human-like Representations in Vision Models
nodes.tldr: Applies human-like foveated, variable-resolution sampling to existing vision-language models, showing accuracy gains under tight pixel budgets.
nodes.problem: Uniform image resolution wastes compute on non-critical regions of VLM inputs.
nodes.approach: Foveated, variable-resolution sampling applied to existing LMM architectures, evaluated under pixel budgets.
secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › Efficient LLM Inference & Architectures
nodes.confidence_reason: Efficiency angle versus VLM analysis; topic is a judgment call.
nodes.niche_reason: Human-visual-system-inspired sampling in VLMs is an unusual angle.

nodes.title: Self-Supervised Cross-View Correspondence with Predictive Cycle Consistency
nodes.tldr: Predictive Cycle Consistency learns object correspondence between extremely disjoint views without paired segmentation, bootstrapping pseudolabels via grayscale colorization and cycle consistency to train ViTs iteratively.
nodes.problem: Self-supervised correspondence methods fail under large viewpoint changes such as ego-exo settings.
nodes.approach: Bootstrap pseudolabels via conditional colorization and cycle-consistency refinement, then iteratively train ViTs.
secondary_topics: Computer Vision › Vision Foundation Models & Self-Supervision
nodes.niche_reason: Cross-view correspondence is specialised within self-supervised vision.

nodes.title: Seurat: From Moving Points to Depth
nodes.tldr: Seurat infers relative depth from monocular video by feeding tracked 2D point trajectories to spatial and temporal transformers, generalizing zero-shot from synthetic to real data.
nodes.problem: Monocular video depth estimation is ambiguous without stereo cues.
nodes.approach: Spatial and temporal transformers over off-the-shelf point-track trajectories predict depth changes over time.
nodes.niche_reason: Depth from point trajectories rather than pixels is an unusual formulation.

nodes.title: Shape Abstraction via Marching Differentiable Support Functions
nodes.tldr: Represents convex shapes as differentiable support functions for compact, accurate primitive abstraction that also yields differentiable contact features.
nodes.problem: Shape abstraction into primitives is hard to make both accurate and versatile with few parameters.
nodes.approach: Differentiable shape parameterization with hyperplane-based marching to reduce support-function count.
nodes.niche_reason: Differentiable support-function shape abstraction is rare

nodes.title: Show and Tell: Visually Explainable Deep Neural Nets via Spatially-Aware Concept Bottleneck Models
nodes.tldr: SALF-CBM turns any vision backbone into a self-explaining model by projecting features into spatial concept maps without labels, giving concept-grounded heatmaps.
nodes.problem: Black-box vision networks cannot show where and which concepts drive their decisions.
nodes.approach: Spatially-aware label-free concept bottleneck layer over backbone features, with a classifier trained on concept maps.
nodes.niche_reason: Concept bottleneck models are established; the spatial label-free variant is specialised.

nodes.title: SimLingo: Vision-Only Closed-Loop Autonomous Driving with Language-Action Alignment
nodes.tldr: SimLingo is a camera-only VLM-based model for closed-loop driving, vision-language understanding and language-action alignment, winning the CARLA challenge 2024 and topping Bench2Drive.
nodes.problem: Driving LLMs do not combine strong driving with language understanding consistent with actions.
nodes.approach: Fine-tune a VLM on driving, VQA and language-action alignment tasks using cameras only.
nodes.niche_reason: Language-conditioned driving is a common current direction.

nodes.title: Simulator HC: Regression-based Online Simulation of Starting Problem-Solution Pairs for Homotopy Continuation in Geometric Vision
nodes.tldr: Predicts a rough starting solution, generates a matching problem with an online simulator, then tracks it with homotopy continuation for geometric vision solvers.
nodes.problem: Polynomial elimination templates become intractable for high-degree or many-unknown geometric vision problems.
nodes.approach: Regressed initial solutions with online simulated problem-solution pairs, refined by homotopy continuation tracking.
nodes.niche_reason: Homotopy continuation with learned starts is a rare geometric-solver niche

nodes.title: SkillMimic: Learning Basketball Interaction Skills from Demonstrations
nodes.tldr: Learns a single policy for diverse basketball interaction skills from HOI demonstrations using one unified imitation reward instead of skill-specific rewards.
nodes.problem: Human-object interaction RL needs labor-intensive, hand-designed skill rewards that do not generalize.
nodes.approach: Unified HOI imitation reward from demonstrations, plus a high-level controller composing learned skills.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › Human Pose, Avatars & Faces
secondary_topics: Reinforcement Learning › Reward Learning, Inverse RL & Preferences
nodes.confidence_reason: HOI animation spans CV and RL; placement is a judgment call.
nodes.niche_reason: Established physics-based character animation with a specific sport focus.

nodes.title: SmartCLIP: Modular Vision-language Alignment with Identification Guarantees
nodes.tldr: Modular CLIP-style vision-language alignment that matches the most relevant visual and textual representations across granularities, with identification guarantees.
nodes.problem: CLIP misaligns image-text granularity and learns entangled representations.
nodes.approach: Theoretically grounded modular alignment that identifies and matches relevant visual and textual concepts.
nodes.confidence_reason: Theory and method; could fit alignment or representation learning
nodes.niche_reason: Crowded area: CLIP-style vision-language training

nodes.title: SnapGen: Taming High-Resolution Text-to-Image Models for Mobile Devices with Efficient Architectures and Training
nodes.tldr: SnapGen is a ~380M-parameter text-to-image diffusion model with efficient architecture, cross-architecture distillation and adversarial few-step training, generating 1024px images on mobile in about 1.2-2.3 seconds.
nodes.problem: Text-to-image diffusion models are too large and slow for mobile devices.
nodes.approach: Efficient network design, multi-level knowledge distillation, and adversarial guidance for few-step generation.
secondary_topics: Architectures & Training › Efficient Training, Compression & Pruning
nodes.niche_reason: Efficient diffusion is common, though mobile focus is somewhat distinct.

nodes.title: SoMA: Singular Value Decomposed Minor Components Adaptation for Domain Generalizable Representation Learning
nodes.tldr: Fine-tunes minor singular components of pretrained weights via SVD and freezes generalizable blocks to boost domain generalization.
nodes.problem: PEFT of foundation models struggles to balance preserving generalizable features with task learning.
nodes.approach: SVD-based adaptation tuning minor singular components with residuals frozen, plus annealed weight decay.
nodes.primary_topic: Architectures & Training › Domain Adaptation & OOD Generalization
nodes.niche_reason: PEFT for domain generalization is a common active direction.

nodes.title: Sonata: Self-Supervised Learning of Reliable Point Representations
nodes.tldr: Sonata is a self-distilled point cloud model that avoids geometric shortcuts, so simple linear probing yields reliable 3D features with limited data.
nodes.problem: Self-supervised point cloud models collapse to low-level spatial features, weakening linear probing.
nodes.approach: Obscure spatial information and rely on input features, trained by self-distillation on 140k point clouds.
nodes.niche_reason: Self-supervised 3D point representations are a common direction.

nodes.title: SoundVista: Novel-View Ambient Sound Synthesis via Visual-Acoustic Binding
nodes.tldr: Synthesizes ambient sound at novel viewpoints from sparse microphone recordings using a visual-acoustic binding module over panoramic RGB-D, also optimizing microphone placement.
nodes.problem: Novel-view ambient sound synthesis without knowing sound source details, across varied rooms and microphone setups.
nodes.approach: Visual-acoustic binding embeddings from RGB-D guide adaptive weighting of reference microphone signals.
nodes.primary_topic: Audio, Speech & Multimodal › Audio-Visual & Cross-modal Learning
secondary_topics: Generative Models › Audio, Speech & Music Generation
nodes.niche_reason: Novel-view sound synthesis is a rare audio-visual task.

nodes.title: Spatial457: A Diagnostic Benchmark for 6D Spatial Reasoning of Large Mutimodal Models
nodes.tldr: Synthetic diagnostic benchmark with cascading difficulty levels testing 6D spatial reasoning in large multimodal models, revealing declines in 3D tasks.
nodes.problem: Existing benchmarks focus on 2D spatial understanding, leaving 6D spatial reasoning in multimodal models unmeasured.
nodes.approach: Unbiased synthetic dataset with 7 question types over 5 difficulty levels, plus a Relative Performance Dropping Rate metric.
nodes.niche_reason: 6D spatial reasoning benchmarks are a specialised evaluation niche.

nodes.title: SpatialLLM: A Compound 3D-Informed Design towards Spatially-Intelligent Large Multimodal Models
nodes.tldr: SpatialLLM studies 3D-informed data, architecture and training for large multimodal models, curating orientation-aware VQA data and surpassing GPT-4o by 8.7% on 3D spatial reasoning.
nodes.problem: Large multimodal models lack 3D spatial reasoning due to scarce 3D data and 2D-biased designs.
nodes.approach: Build 3D-informed probing and conversation datasets and systematically study architecture and training choices.
nodes.niche_reason: 3D spatial reasoning for LMMs is an active but specialised area.

nodes.title: SpecTRe-GS: Modeling Highly Specular Surfaces with Reflected Nearby Objects by Tracing Rays in 3D Gaussian Splatting
nodes.tldr: SpecTRe-GS models highly specular, inter-reflective surfaces in 3D Gaussian splatting via an embedded ray tracer and separate specular and rough reflection modeling.
nodes.problem: 3DGS struggles with high-frequency view-dependent appearance and inter-reflections on specular surfaces.
nodes.approach: Separate specular and rough reflections; embedded ray tracer for secondary rays; normal prior guided joint geometry optimization.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: Reflection-aware 3DGS is specialised within a popular area.

nodes.title: SplatFlow: Self-Supervised Dynamic Gaussian Splatting in Neural Motion Flow Field for Autonomous Driving
nodes.tldr: Reconstructs dynamic urban scenes with self-supervised 4D Gaussian splatting in neural motion flow fields, needing no tracked 3D bounding box labels.
nodes.problem: Dynamic Gaussian splatting for driving scenes depends on expensive manual object labels.
nodes.approach: Motion flow fields for LiDAR and Gaussians, separating static 3D and dynamic 4D Gaussian primitives.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: Self-supervised 4D splatting for driving scenes is specialised

nodes.title: Structure from Collision
nodes.tldr: Introduces structure from collision: estimating an object's hidden internal structure from appearance changes in collision videos via SfC-NeRF with volume annealing.
nodes.problem: Estimating invisible internal object structure that multiview reconstruction cannot recover.
nodes.approach: NeRF optimised under physical, appearance-preserving and keyframe constraints with volume annealing.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: Inferring hidden interior structure from collisions is a very rare task.

nodes.title: Structure-Aware Correspondence Learning for Relative Pose Estimation
nodes.tldr: Estimates relative pose of unseen objects by extracting structure-aware keypoints and modeling their intra- and inter-image relations to predict 3D-3D correspondences without explicit feature matching.
nodes.problem: Relative pose estimation with small overlap or invisible regions where feature matching is unreliable.
nodes.approach: Structure-aware keypoint extraction with reconstruction loss and keypoint relation modeling for correspondence estimation.
nodes.niche_reason: Established geometry task with a specialised low-overlap angle.

nodes.title: Structure-from-Motion with a Non-Parametric Camera Model
nodes.tldr: Generic Structure-from-Motion pipeline using a non-parametric, self-calibrated camera model that handles pinhole, fisheye and catadioptric cameras.
nodes.problem: Standard SfM fails to self-calibrate parametric models for non-pinhole or extreme optics.
nodes.approach: Adaptive partial calibration that models only image regions with sufficient constraints.
secondary_topics: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: Classic SfM area; non-parametric calibration is specialised.

nodes.title: Structured 3D Latents for Scalable and Versatile 3D Generation
nodes.tldr: Introduces a structured 3D latent representation and rectified-flow transformers to generate high-quality 3D assets decodable to radiance fields, Gaussians, or meshes.
nodes.problem: Generating versatile, high-quality 3D assets with flexible output formats and local editing.
nodes.approach: Unified sparse-grid plus multiview-feature latent with rectified flow transformers at 2B scale.
nodes.niche_reason: Active area of feed-forward 3D generation with many similar papers

nodes.title: Style Evolving along Chain-of-Thought for Unknown-Domain Object Detection
nodes.tldr: Evolves style prompts progressively along a chain of thought with vision-language models to improve single-domain generalized object detection under combined styles like rain at night.
nodes.problem: One-step prompts poorly capture combined styles for generalizing detectors to unseen domains.
nodes.approach: Progressively refine and expand style descriptions along a chain of thought to simulate diverse styles.
secondary_topics: Architectures & Training › Domain Adaptation & OOD Generalization
nodes.niche_reason: Single-domain generalized detection is specialised.

nodes.title: Style-Editor: Text-driven Object-centric Style Editing
nodes.tldr: Text-driven style editing that localizes objects via text-matched patches and CLIP directional losses, preserving background structure without segmentation masks.
nodes.problem: Text-driven style editing must localize target objects and keep background structure without masks.
nodes.approach: CLIP-based patch-wise directional and distribution losses with text-matched patch selection.
nodes.niche_reason: CLIP-guided image style editing is a common direction

nodes.title: StyleSSP: Sampling StartPoint Enhancement for Training-free Diffusion-based Method for Style Transfer
nodes.tldr: StyleSSP improves training-free diffusion style transfer by choosing a better sampling startpoint via frequency manipulation and negative guidance during inversion.
nodes.problem: Training-free diffusion style transfer distorts content layout and leaks style-image content.
nodes.approach: Low-frequency suppression of DDIM latent plus negative guidance in inversion for startpoint.
nodes.niche_reason: Training-free diffusion style transfer is a crowded area.

nodes.title: Supervising Sound Localization by In-the-wild Egomotion
nodes.tldr: Learns binaural sound localization by supervising audio predictions with camera ego-motion estimated from multi-view geometry in in-the-wild videos.
nodes.problem: Binaural sound localization needs labeled data, and sound direction changes with camera motion.
nodes.approach: Weak supervision from visual ego-motion estimates combined with traditional binaural cues.
nodes.primary_topic: Audio, Speech & Multimodal › Audio-Visual & Cross-modal Learning
nodes.niche_reason: Established audio-visual topic with an unusual egomotion supervision signal

nodes.title: Symmetry Strikes Back: From Single-Image Symmetry Detection to 3D Generation
nodes.tldr: Reflect3D is a zero-shot transformer detector of 3D reflection symmetry from one image, using multi-view diffusion priors, improving single-image 3D generation.
nodes.problem: Detecting 3D reflection symmetry from a single image and exploiting it for 3D generation.
nodes.approach: Scaled transformer symmetry detector with multi-view diffusion priors and symmetry-aware 3D generation optimization.
nodes.niche_reason: Symmetry detection is an uncommon topic, tied to 3D generation.

nodes.title: T2ICount: Enhancing Cross-modal Understanding for Zero-Shot Counting
nodes.tldr: T2ICount uses a pretrained diffusion model for text-guided zero-shot counting, with a module and loss restoring text sensitivity, plus a harder re-annotated FSC147 subset.
nodes.problem: Zero-shot counting methods based on CLIP are insensitive to text prompts.
nodes.approach: One-step diffusion features with hierarchical semantic correction and cross-attention-based regional coherence loss.
nodes.niche_reason: Object counting is an established but specialised vision task.

nodes.title: TFCustom: Customized Image Generation with Time-Aware Frequency Feature Guidance
nodes.tldr: TFCustom improves subject-driven image generation by injecting reference features with time-aware frequency filtering and a reward-based alignment loss.
nodes.problem: ReferenceNet features are latent-level and misaligned across timesteps, hurting consistency.
nodes.approach: Synchronized ReferenceNet with time-aware high/low-frequency filtering and a reward loss.
nodes.niche_reason: Subject-driven personalization is a crowded mainstream area.

nodes.title: TIDE: Training Locally Interpretable Domain Generalization Models Enables Test-time Correction
nodes.tldr: Trains single-source domain generalization models to attend to local concepts, then uses concept saliency at test time to iteratively correct predictions.
nodes.problem: Models learn global features that break under semantic shifts such as background and viewpoint changes.
nodes.approach: Concept saliency alignment and local concept contrastive losses, with concept annotations generated by diffusion and LLMs.
nodes.primary_topic: Architectures & Training › Domain Adaptation & OOD Generalization
nodes.niche_reason: Domain generalization is crowded; concept saliency adds a twist

nodes.title: TKG-DM: Training-free Chroma Key Content Generation Diffusion Model
nodes.tldr: Training-free diffusion method that optimizes initial noise so generated images place foreground objects over a specified chroma-key background, separating layers without fine-tuning.
nodes.problem: Text-to-image diffusion models struggle to place foreground objects on chroma-key backgrounds.
nodes.approach: Manipulate color aspects of the initial noise to control background color, with no fine-tuning.
nodes.niche_reason: Chroma-key control via noise manipulation is a specialised niche.

nodes.title: TacoDepth: Towards Efficient Radar-Camera Depth Estimation with One-stage Fusion
nodes.tldr: TacoDepth fuses radar and camera in one stage using a graph-based radar extractor and pyramid fusion, improving accuracy 12.8% and speed 91.8% over prior work.
nodes.problem: Multi-stage radar-camera depth estimation is slow and not robust due to sparse radar returns.
nodes.approach: One-stage fusion with graph-based radar structure extractor and pyramid radar fusion module.
nodes.niche_reason: Radar-camera depth is specialised sensor-fusion work.

nodes.title: Taming Video Diffusion Prior with Scene-Grounding Guidance for 3D Gaussian Splatting from Sparse Inputs
nodes.tldr: Uses video diffusion priors guided by rendered 3DGS sequences to fill unseen and occluded regions, enabling sparse-input Gaussian splatting without fine-tuning the diffusion model.
nodes.problem: Sparse-input 3DGS fails on regions outside the field of view or occluded.
nodes.approach: Training-free scene-grounding guidance on video diffusion, plus trajectory initialisation to find unseen regions.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: Sparse-view 3DGS with diffusion priors is a crowded, active direction.

nodes.title: TaoAvatar: Real-Time Lifelike Full-Body Talking Avatars for Augmented Reality via 3D Gaussian Splatting
nodes.tldr: Creates a lightweight real-time full-body talking avatar via 3D Gaussian Splatting, distilling pose-dependent deformations into an MLP for mobile AR devices.
nodes.problem: Full-body 3DGS avatars lack fine control of expressions and body motion and cannot run in real time on mobile.
nodes.approach: Distills a StyleUnet deformation network into a lightweight MLP and adds blend shapes for detail.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › Human Pose, Avatars & Faces
secondary_topics: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: gaussian splatting avatars are a popular direction

nodes.title: Task-driven Image Fusion with Learnable Fusion Loss
nodes.tldr: TDFusion learns the multi-modal image fusion loss with a neural loss generator supervised by downstream task loss in a meta-learning manner, improving segmentation and detection.
nodes.problem: Predefined fusion objectives mismatch downstream tasks, limiting adaptive guidance.
nodes.approach: Meta-learned loss generation module trained to minimize downstream task loss of fused images.
nodes.niche_reason: Multi-modal image fusion is a niche low-level vision subfield.

nodes.title: Text-guided Sparse Voxel Pruning for Efficient 3D Visual Grounding
nodes.tldr: Real-time 3D visual grounding with sparse convolution, pruning voxels with text cross-attention and restoring over-pruned regions.
nodes.problem: Two-stage or point-based 3D visual grounding is too slow for real time, and dense voxel-text fusion is costly.
nodes.approach: Text-guided pruning of sparse voxels via cross-attention, plus completion-based addition to recover pruned geometry.
secondary_topics: Architectures & Training › Efficient Training, Compression & Pruning
nodes.confidence_reason: Efficiency contribution for 3D grounding straddles grounding and pruning topics.
nodes.niche_reason: Efficient 3D visual grounding is specialised but established.

nodes.title: The PanAf-FGBG Dataset: Understanding the Impact of Backgrounds in Wildlife Behaviour Recognition
nodes.tldr: Presents PanAf-FGBG, 21 hours of wild chimpanzee video paired with matching background-only videos, enabling analysis of background effects on OOD behaviour recognition.
nodes.problem: Behaviour-correlated backgrounds affect out-of-distribution generalization in wildlife behaviour recognition but were unmeasured.
nodes.approach: Paired foreground-background camera-trap dataset with in/out-of-distribution splits and a latent-space normalisation baseline.
secondary_topics: Architectures & Training › Domain Adaptation & OOD Generalization
nodes.niche_reason: Primate camera-trap behaviour recognition is very rare.

nodes.title: The Scene Language: Representing Scenes with Programs, Words, and Embeddings
nodes.tldr: Represents scenes with programs for structure, words for semantic classes, and embeddings for identity, inferred training-free from pre-trained language models.
nodes.problem: Scene graphs lack fidelity and precise control for generating complex 3D and 4D scenes.
nodes.approach: Hierarchical scene program with per-entity words and embeddings, rendered by traditional, neural, or hybrid renderers.
nodes.confidence_reason: program-based scene representation spans 3D generation and vision-language
nodes.niche_reason: program-word-embedding scene representation is an unusual design

nodes.title: Theoretical Insights in Model Inversion Robustness and Conditional Entropy Maximization for Collaborative Inference Systems
nodes.tldr: Proves conditional entropy of inputs given intermediate features lower-bounds reconstruction MSE under any inversion attack, and proposes a maximization method to boost robustness.
nodes.problem: Intermediate features in collaborative inference can leak raw data via model inversion.
nodes.approach: Conditional entropy maximization using a differentiable Gaussian-mixture bound on feature entropy.
nodes.primary_topic: Trustworthy ML › Machine Unlearning & Privacy Attacks
nodes.niche_reason: Information-theoretic inversion defenses are a specialized privacy niche.

nodes.title: Timestep Embedding Tells: It's Time to Cache for Video Diffusion Model
nodes.tldr: Training-free caching for video diffusion that reuses outputs at timesteps chosen by estimating output differences from modulated inputs, giving up to 4.4x speedup.
nodes.problem: Uniform caching of video diffusion outputs across timesteps hurts the speed-quality balance.
nodes.approach: Timestep-embedding-modulated input differences, rescaled, decide when to reuse cached model outputs.
nodes.niche_reason: Training-free video diffusion caching is a common acceleration direction.

nodes.title: TinyFusion: Diffusion Transformers Learned Shallow
nodes.tldr: Learnable depth pruning for diffusion transformers that optimizes post-fine-tuning performance, giving 2x speedup with strong FID at low pre-training cost.
nodes.problem: Diffusion transformers are over-parameterised and slow at inference.
nodes.approach: Differentiable layer sampling with a co-optimized parameter that simulates future fine-tuning.
nodes.primary_topic: Architectures & Training › Efficient Training, Compression & Pruning
nodes.niche_reason: Established compression area applied to diffusion transformers

nodes.title: Towards Autonomous Micromobility through Scalable Urban Simulation
nodes.tldr: Presents URBAN-SIM, a scalable urban simulator for training embodied agents, and URBAN-BENCH, eight micromobility tasks evaluated across four robots.
nodes.problem: Autonomous micromobility lacks scalable simulation and benchmarks for urban public spaces.
nodes.approach: Hierarchical urban scene generation, interactive dynamics and asynchronous scene sampling.
nodes.niche_reason: Rare focus on urban micromobility robots in simulation

nodes.title: Towards Enhanced Image Inpainting: Mitigating Unwanted Object Insertion and Preserving Color Consistency
nodes.tldr: ASUKA is a post-processing add-on for inpainting models: an MAE prior curbs hallucinated objects and a harmonizing VAE decoder fixes color shifts.
nodes.problem: Inpainting models insert unwanted objects and cause color inconsistency in filled regions.
nodes.approach: MAE reconstruction prior plus a specialized locally harmonizing VAE decoder applied without retraining the generator.
nodes.niche_reason: Diffusion-based inpainting improvements are common.

nodes.title: Towards Explainable and Unprecedented Accuracy in Matching Challenging Finger Crease Patterns
nodes.tldr: Releases an 805K-image deformed knuckle dataset and an interpretable keypoint matcher robust to severe pose deformation, plus a uniqueness model.
nodes.problem: Matching deformed, contactless finger knuckle images is hard, yet needed for forensics and security.
nodes.approach: Recovers interpretable knuckle crease keypoint templates and matches them via graph-structured correspondences.
nodes.confidence_reason: Biometric matching has no exact topic; best fit chosen
nodes.niche_reason: Knuckle-crease biometrics with uniqueness modelling is very rare

nodes.title: Towards Improved Text-Aligned Codebook Learning: Multi-Hierarchical Codebook-Text Alignment with Long Text
nodes.tldr: Generates longer captions with a VLM to align a VQ codebook with text at word, phrase, and sentence granularity.
nodes.problem: Short image captions give weak, fine-grained supervision for aligning VQ codebooks with text.
nodes.approach: Hierarchical text encoder plus sampling-based codebook-text alignment, plug-in to existing VQ models.
nodes.confidence_reason: Codebook tokenizer versus vision-language alignment is a close call.
nodes.niche_reason: Text-aligned VQ tokenizers are a fairly common direction.

nodes.title: Towards In-the-wild 3D Plane Reconstruction from a Single Image

nodes.primary_topic: Trustworthy ML › Machine Unlearning & Privacy Attacks
secondary_topics: Architectures & Training › Efficient Training, Compression & Pruning

nodes.title: Should I Stop or Should I Go: Early Stopping with Heterogeneous Populations
nodes.tldr: CLASH uses causal machine learning to estimate heterogeneous treatment effects for stopping experiments early when treatment harms a minority subgroup, for clinical trials and A/B tests.
nodes.problem: Existing early-stopping methods ignore treatment effect heterogeneity and miss harm to minority groups.

nodes.primary_topic: Learning Theory & Optimization › Causality & Causal Inference
nodes.niche_reason: Heterogeneous early stopping of randomized experiments is a rare topic.

nodes.title: Banana: Banach Fixed-Point Network for Pointcloud Segmentation with Inter-Part Equivariance
nodes.tldr: Equivariant pointcloud segmentation built as a Banach fixed-point iteration, where part assignments and per-part SE(3) equivariance co-evolve to generalize to unseen part configurations.
nodes.problem: Capturing inter-part transformations in articulated objects and multi-object scenes with equivariance.
nodes.approach: Fixed-point iteration jointly solving point-part assignment and per-part SE(3)-equivariant features.

nodes.title: Gaussian Partial Information Decomposition: Bias Correction and Application to High-dimensional Data
nodes.tldr: Computes partial information decomposition for Gaussians efficiently, corrects its finite-sample bias, and applies it to inter-areal mouse brain communication.
nodes.problem: Partial information decompositions are computationally hard and their estimates are biased at finite sample sizes.

nodes.title: Alternating Updates for Efficient Transformers
nodes.tldr: AltUp widens transformer token representations but updates only one sub-block per layer with a predict-and-correct step, increasing capacity with negligible latency cost.
nodes.problem: Scaling transformer capacity without prohibitive compute and inference latency.
nodes.approach: Alternating sub-block updates with predict-and-correct mechanism over a widened representation.
secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › Efficient LLM Inference & Architectures
Architectures & Training › Mixture of Experts & Sparsity

nodes.title: Unexpected Improvements to Expected Improvement for Bayesian Optimization
nodes.tldr: LogEI reformulates Expected Improvement acquisition functions to avoid vanishing values, making them easier to optimize numerically and matching state-of-the-art Bayesian optimization.
nodes.problem: Expected Improvement acquisition values vanish numerically, making them hard to optimize.
nodes.approach: Log-transformed EI family with numerically stable reformulations for constrained, noisy, parallel, and multi-objective variants.
nodes.primary_topic: Learning Theory & Optimization › Probabilistic & Bayesian Methods
nodes.niche_reason: Bayesian optimization is established but specialised.

nodes.title: Rethinking Bias Mitigation: Fairer Architectures Make for Fairer Face Recognition
nodes.tldr: Shows face recognition bias is architectural and runs the first neural architecture search for fairness, finding models that Pareto-dominate existing bias mitigation methods.
nodes.problem: Bias in face recognition persists despite data-centric and training-time mitigation.

nodes.niche_reason: Architecture-level fairness is a specialised angle on a known topic.

nodes.title: Computing a human-like reaction time metric from stable recurrent vision models
nodes.tldr: Introduces a reaction-time metric from stable recurrent vision models via subjective logic evidence accumulation, matching human reaction-time patterns across four visual decision-making tasks.
nodes.problem: Aligning vision models with humans on temporal aspects of decision-making, not just choices.
nodes.approach: Metric summarizing evidence accumulation in equilibrium recurrent networks using subjective logic theory.
nodes.niche_reason: Modeling human reaction times with recurrent vision nets is rare.

nodes.title: DiffuseBot: Breeding Soft Robots With Physics-Augmented Generative Diffusion Models
nodes.tldr: Generates soft robot morphologies with a diffusion model augmented by physics simulation, co-optimizing body design and control via differentiable simulation.
nodes.problem: Computational design of soft creatures lacks diversity and functional performance; morphology and control must co-design.
nodes.approach: Physics-augmented diffusion with co-design that uses differentiable simulation sensitivities.
nodes.niche_reason: Diffusion-generated soft robot morphologies are a rare cross-disciplinary angle

nodes.title: Going beyond persistent homology using persistent homology
nodes.tldr: Characterizes which attributed graphs persistent homology can distinguish via color-separating sets, and proposes RePHINE, combining vertex- and edge-level PH to provably exceed both.
nodes.problem: The class of attributed graphs distinguishable by persistent homology was unresolved.
nodes.approach: Color-separating set theory and RePHINE, a combined vertex-edge persistence scheme integrated into message-passing GNNs.

nodes.niche_reason: Topological deep learning on graphs is a rare area.

nodes.title: Learning Functional Transduction
nodes.tldr: Meta-learns a kernel-Banach-space-based transductive regressor that acts as an in-context neural operator, quickly fitting new functional relationships from few examples.
nodes.problem: Efficient regression over function spaces that adapts to new functional relationships with little data.
nodes.approach: Meta-learned transductive Transducer based on vector-valued RKBS theory acting as in-context operator regressor.
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Kernels, GPs & Nonparametrics
nodes.confidence_reason: Straddles meta-learning, kernel theory and neural operators.
nodes.niche_reason: Kernel Banach space meets in-context neural operators; unusual.

nodes.title: Characterizing the Optimal $0-1$ Loss for Multi-class Classification with a Test-time Attacker
nodes.tldr: Computes information-theoretic lower bounds on robust 0-1 loss for multi-class classifiers under a test-time attacker, using a conflict hypergraph.
nodes.problem: Unknown how close practical classifiers are to optimal robustness under test-time attacks.
nodes.approach: Conflict hypergraph construction from data and adversarial constraints, with tractable attacker-game relaxations.
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Learning Theory Lower Bounds & Complexity
nodes.niche_reason: Adversarial robustness is crowded; optimal-loss information-theoretic bounds are rare.

nodes.title: Unifying Predictions of Deterministic and Stochastic Physics in Mesh-reduced Space with Sequential Flow Generative Model
nodes.tldr: Models stochastic and deterministic physical dynamics on unstructured meshes by pairing an autoencoder latent space with a transformer and conditional normalizing flow.
nodes.problem: Simulating dynamical systems on unstructured meshes needs both deterministic and stochastic components.
nodes.approach: Autoencoder latent representation, transformer sequence model, and conditional normalizing flow over latent rollouts.
secondary_topics: Generative Models › GANs, VAEs & Normalizing Flows
nodes.niche_reason: Mesh-reduced physics surrogates are specialised but established

nodes.title: On the Connection between Pre-training Data Diversity and Fine-tuning Robustness
nodes.tldr: Finds that pre-training data quantity, not label space, semantics, or diversity, mainly determines the effective robustness of fine-tuned models under distribution shift.
nodes.problem: How properties of the pre-training distribution affect downstream robustness of fine-tuned models.
nodes.approach: Controlled pre-training ablations of class count, diversity, domain, and size, evaluated on iWildCam-WILDS shift.
nodes.primary_topic: Architectures & Training › Domain Adaptation & OOD Generalization
nodes.niche_reason: Robustness-of-pretraining analyses are fairly common.

nodes.title: CLIP-OGD: An Experimental Design for Adaptive Neyman Allocation in Sequential Experiments
nodes.tldr: Proposes Clip-OGD, an adaptive treatment-assignment design using online gradient descent that nearly matches the optimal Neyman variance in randomized experiments.
nodes.problem: Adaptive sequential experiments should allocate treatments nearly as efficiently as the optimal Neyman design.
nodes.approach: Online gradient descent with clipped allocation updates and a conservative variance estimator.
nodes.primary_topic: Learning Theory & Optimization › Online Learning & Regret
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Causality & Causal Inference
nodes.niche_reason: Adaptive Neyman allocation via online optimization is rare

nodes.title: Efficient Online Clustering with Moving Costs
nodes.tldr: Gives the first polynomial-time online k-clustering algorithm with O(log n) regret on total connection plus moving cost against the best fixed solution.
nodes.problem: Online k-clustering where moving facilities between rounds incurs additional movement costs.
nodes.approach: Polynomial-time online learning algorithm achieving O(log n) regret for combined connection and moving cost.
nodes.primary_topic: Learning Theory & Optimization › Online Learning & Regret
nodes.niche_reason: Online clustering with movement costs is very rare.

nodes.title: Schema-learning and rebinding as mechanisms of in-context learning and emergence
nodes.tldr: Shows clone-structured causal graphs achieve in-context learning via schema circuits, context-sensitive retrieval and token rebinding, offering an interpretable model of how ICL and emergence arise.
nodes.problem: Mechanisms underlying in-context learning and emergence in LLMs are poorly understood.
nodes.approach: Train interpretable clone-structured causal graphs and analyze schema learning, retrieval and slot rebinding.

secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › Language Model Interpretability
nodes.niche_reason: CSCG-based account of ICL is a very unusual cognitive-science angle.

nodes.title: Ego4D Goal-Step: Toward Hierarchical Understanding of Procedural Activities
nodes.tldr: Ego4D Goal-Step adds a hierarchical taxonomy of goals, steps, and substeps with dense annotations on 48K procedural segments, enabling goal-oriented activity understanding in egocentric video.
nodes.problem: Activity recognition focuses on short atomic actions and lacks hierarchical goal-oriented procedural annotations.

nodes.niche_reason: Procedural video understanding is established; goal-step hierarchy is specialised

nodes.title: GLIME: General, Stable and Local LIME Explanation
nodes.tldr: GLIME is a stable, local LIME variant that converges faster, uses a local unbiased sampling distribution, and yields higher-fidelity explanations independent of reference choice.
nodes.problem: LIME explanations are unstable across random seeds and have low local fidelity because of biased, non-local sampling.
nodes.approach: Reformulates LIME for faster convergence and replaces its sampling with a local, unbiased distribution that users can choose.
nodes.niche_reason: LIME-style post-hoc explanation is common; this is a refinement.

nodes.title: The Pursuit of Human Labeling: A New Perspective on Unsupervised Learning
nodes.tldr: HUME infers a dataset's human labeling without supervision by searching labelings that stay linearly separable across pretrained representation spaces.
nodes.problem: Unsupervised learning lacks a way to recover the human-defined class structure of a dataset.

nodes.niche_reason: Recovering human labelings via linear separability is an unusual framing

nodes.title: From Pixels to UI Actions: Learning to Follow Instructions via Graphical User Interfaces
nodes.tldr: Learns web agents that act from raw pixel screenshots with generic keyboard and mouse actions, outperforming human crowdworkers on MiniWob++ tasks.

nodes.niche_reason: Pixel-based GUI agents with generic actions are a specialised agent niche

nodes.title: Birth of a Transformer: A Memory Viewpoint
nodes.tldr: Studies how a two-layer transformer learns global bigram statistics quickly and in-context bigrams slowly via induction heads, tracing weight matrices as associative memories.
nodes.problem: How transformers balance memorized global knowledge against in-context adaptation during training.
nodes.approach: Synthetic bigram setup, empirical training analysis of a two-layer transformer, plus gradient theory.

nodes.title: QuantSR: Accurate Low-bit Quantization for Efficient Image Super-Resolution
nodes.tldr: QuantSR is an accurate low-bit quantized super-resolution network using a redistribution-driven learnable quantizer and a depth-dynamic quantized architecture with weight sharing.
nodes.problem: Quantized super-resolution models lose accuracy at ultra-low bit widths.
nodes.approach: Redistribution-driven learnable quantizer plus depth-dynamic architecture trading efficiency and accuracy at inference.
nodes.primary_topic: Architectures & Training › Efficient Training, Compression & Pruning
nodes.niche_reason: Quantization for super-resolution is a common applied compression topic.

nodes.title: The Pick-to-Learn Algorithm: Empowering Compression for Tight Generalization Bounds and Improved Post-training Performance
nodes.tldr: Pick-to-Learn wraps any learning algorithm in a meta-algorithm with compression properties to give tight generalization bounds and improved post-training performance.
nodes.problem: Obtaining tight, practical generalization bounds for learned models.
nodes.approach: Embed a base learner in a meta-algorithm that iteratively picks data to induce compression-based bounds.
nodes.primary_topic: Learning Theory & Optimization › Generalization & Statistical Learning
nodes.niche_reason: Compression-based certified generalization bounds are a rare theory niche.

nodes.title: Learning to Receive Help: Intervention-Aware Concept Embedding Models
nodes.tldr: Trains a concept bottleneck model to accept test-time concept interventions via a learned intervention policy, improving accuracy after user corrections.

nodes.niche_reason: Concept bottleneck interventions are specialised

nodes.title: On the Variance, Admissibility, and Stability of Empirical Risk Minimization
nodes.tldr: Shows ERM's minimax suboptimality in mean squared error comes from bias, not variance, and proves ERM admissibility and stability results.

nodes.primary_topic: Learning Theory & Optimization › Generalization & Statistical Learning

nodes.title: Generalization in the Face of Adaptivity: A Bayesian Perspective

nodes.title: What Makes Data Suitable for a Locally Connected Neural Network? A Necessary and Sufficient Condition Based on Quantum Entanglement.

nodes.niche_reason: Entanglement-based data suitability conditions for deep nets are a very rare niche.

nodes.title: AlpacaFarm: A Simulation Framework for Methods that Learn from Human Feedback

nodes.title: Common Ground in Cooperative Communication

nodes.title: A Spectral Theory of Neural Prediction and Alignment
nodes.tldr: Applies a spectral generalization theory of regression to decompose neural prediction error into model eigenspectra and eigenvector-response alignment, interpreting how DNNs predict visual cortex.

nodes.tldr: Condenses ImageNet-scale datasets by decoupling bilevel optimization into squeeze, recover and relabel steps, much faster than prior methods.

nodes.title: Debias Coarsely, Sample Conditionally: Statistical Downscaling through Optimal Transport and Probabilistic Diffusion Models

nodes.title: Characteristic Circuits

nodes.niche_reason: Tractable probabilistic circuits are a niche community.

nodes.title: Tree of Thoughts: Deliberate Problem Solving with Large Language Models

nodes.title: Counterfactual Memorization in Neural Language Models

nodes.title: Exploring Loss Functions for Time-based Training Strategy in Spiking Neural Networks

nodes.title: Bootstrapping Vision-Language Learning with Decoupled Language Pre-training

nodes.title: No Change, No Gain: Empowering Graph Neural Networks with Expected Model Change Maximization for Active Learning

nodes.title: Understanding Social Reasoning in Language Models with Language Models

nodes.title: Constant Approximation for Individual Preference Stable Clustering

nodes.title: Distribution-Free Statistical Dispersion Control for Societal Applications

nodes.title: Distance-Restricted Folklore Weisfeiler-Leman GNNs with Provable Cycle Counting Power

nodes.title: The Behavior and Convergence of Local Bayesian Optimization

nodes.title: Convergence of mean-field Langevin dynamics: time-space discretization, stochastic gradient, and variance reduction
nodes.tldr: Proves uniform-in-time propagation of chaos and quantitative convergence for mean-field Langevin dynamics under finite particles, discretization and stochastic gradients.

nodes.niche_reason: Specialised mean-field optimization theory

nodes.title: Brain Diffusion for Visual Exploration: Cortical Discovery using Large Scale Generative Models
nodes.tldr: BrainDiVE synthesizes images predicted to activate a given brain region, using diffusion models guided by paired fMRI and natural images.
nodes.problem: Functional organization of visual cortex is hard to probe without manually built, non-ecological stimulus sets.

nodes.title: Hierarchical Decomposition of Prompt-Based Continual Learning: Rethinking Obscured Sub-optimality
nodes.tldr: Prompt-based continual learning method that decomposes the objective into within-task prediction, task-identity inference, and task-adaptive prediction.

nodes.title: Reinforcement-Enhanced Autoregressive Feature Transformation: Gradient-steered Search in Continuous Space for Postfix Expressions

nodes.title: Digital Typhoon: Long-term Satellite Image Dataset for the Spatio-Temporal Modeling of Tropical Cyclones

nodes.title: Maximize to Explore: One Objective Function Fusing Estimation, Planning, and Exploration
nodes.tldr: Proposes a single unconstrained objective that fuses estimation and planning so exploration happens automatically, with sublinear regret and practical deep RL variants.

nodes.title: Image Captioners Are Scalable Vision Learners Too

nodes.title: Universal Online Learning with Gradient Variations: A Multi-layer Online Ensemble Approach
nodes.tldr: A multi-layer online ensemble achieves universal gradient-variation regret bounds for strongly convex, exp-concave and convex losses with only one gradient query per round.

nodes.title: Linguistic Binding in Diffusion Models: Enhancing Attribute Correspondence through Attention Map Alignment

nodes.title: A Deep Instance Generative Framework for MILP Solvers Under Limited Data Availability

nodes.title: Demystifying Oversmoothing in Attention-Based Graph Neural Networks

nodes.problem: Whether attention mechanisms in GNNs mitigate oversmoothing with depth.
nodes.approach: Model attention GNNs as nonlinear time-varying dynamical systems; use products of inhomogeneous matrices and joint spectral radius.
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Deep Learning Theory
nodes.niche_reason: Theory of GNN depth; established but specialised.

nodes.title: VoxDet: Voxel Learning for Novel Instance Detection
nodes.tldr: Lifts multi-view template images into a 3D voxel representation and matches query voxels after rotation estimation to detect novel object instances.
nodes.problem: Detecting unseen object instances under pose changes and occlusion is poorly handled by 2D template matching.
nodes.approach: Template voxel aggregation module plus query voxel matching, with 3D reconstruction pretraining for the 2D-3D mapping.
nodes.niche_reason: Specialised 3D voxel approach to instance detection

nodes.title: Online Label Shift: Optimal Dynamic Regret meets Practical Algorithms
nodes.tldr: Algorithms for supervised and unsupervised online label shift that reduce adaptation to online regression, guaranteeing optimal dynamic regret without knowing the drift magnitude.

secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Online Learning & Regret
nodes.niche_reason: Established but specialised online distribution shift theory.

nodes.title: Generalizing Importance Weighting to A Universal Solver for Distribution Shift Problems
nodes.tldr: Generalizes importance weighting into GIW, a universal solver for distribution shift that splits test support into in-training and out-of-training parts.
nodes.problem: Importance weighting fails when test support is wider or only partially overlaps training support.
nodes.approach: Split validation data by one-class SVM; weight in-training part with IW and classify out-of-training part directly.
nodes.primary_topic: Architectures & Training › Domain Adaptation & OOD Generalization
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Probabilistic & Bayesian Methods

nodes.title: Tester-Learners for Halfspaces: Universal Algorithms
nodes.tldr: Gives a polynomial-time tester-learner for halfspaces that works universally over Poincare distributions, testing hypercontractivity via sum-of-squares.
nodes.problem: Testable learning of halfspaces usually tailors the tester to one target distribution.

nodes.primary_topic: Learning Theory & Optimization › Generalization & Statistical Learning
nodes.niche_reason: Niche testable-learning theory with SOS certification.

nodes.title: Spatial-frequency channels, shape bias, and adversarial robustness

nodes.title: Explaining the Uncertain: Stochastic Shapley Values for Gaussian Process Models
nodes.tldr: Extends Shapley values to stochastic cooperative games to explain Gaussian processes, yielding random-variable explanations with tractable covariance and a Shapley prior for prediction.

nodes.title: Dynamic Tensor Decomposition via Neural Diffusion-Reaction Processes
nodes.tldr: DEMOTE learns dynamic entity embeddings for sparse temporal tensor decomposition using a neural graph diffusion-reaction process over a multipartite graph of entities.

nodes.title: Sample Efficient Reinforcement Learning in Mixed Systems through Augmented Samples and Its Applications to Queueing Networks
nodes.tldr: Accelerates RL in mixed stochastic and deterministic systems by generating augmented samples, reducing sample complexity on queueing network tasks.

nodes.title: Training shallow ReLU networks on noisy data using hinge loss: when do we overfit and is it benign?

nodes.title: Restless Bandits with Average Reward: Breaking the Uniform Global Attractor Assumption

nodes.title: Protein Design with Guided Discrete Diffusion
nodes.tldr: NOS guides discrete diffusion models via gradients in denoiser hidden states; LaMBO-2 uses it for sequence-space antibody design optimizing expression and binding.

nodes.title: Mitigating the Popularity Bias of Graph Collaborative Filtering: A Dimensional Collapse Perspective

nodes.title: State Sequences Prediction via Fourier Transform for Representation Learning
nodes.tldr: Predicts the Fourier transform of future state sequences to learn structured representations that improve sample efficiency in deep RL.

nodes.title: A Holistic Approach to Unifying Automatic Concept Extraction and Concept Importance Estimation

nodes.title: Alternation makes the adversary weaker in two-player games

nodes.title: Prefix-Tree Decoding for Predicting Mass Spectra from Molecules
nodes.tldr: Predicts mass spectra by decoding sets of molecular subformulae with a prefix-tree structure, then predicting peak intensities with a second model.

nodes.niche_reason: Predicting mass spectra from molecules is an unusual niche.

nodes.title: Lexinvariant Language Models

nodes.title: Evaluating the Moral Beliefs Encoded in LLMs

nodes.title: Hierarchically Gated Recurrent Neural Network for Sequence Modeling
