nodes.niche_reason: Privacy auditing is an established but specialised topic.

nodes.title: Calibrated Stackelberg Games: Learning Optimal Commitments Against Calibrated Agents
nodes.tldr: Introduces calibrated Stackelberg games where the agent best-responds to calibrated forecasts, and shows the principal can still reach the optimal Stackelberg value.
nodes.problem: Stackelberg games assume agents know the principal's actions, which is often unrealistic.
nodes.approach: Adaptive calibration algorithms that let the principal learn optimal commitments against calibrated agents.
nodes.primary_topic: Learning Theory & Optimization › Game Theory & Mechanism Design
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Online Learning & Regret
nodes.niche_reason: Calibrated agents in Stackelberg games is a rare game-theoretic framing

nodes.title: Entropic Neural Optimal Transport via Diffusion Processes
nodes.tldr: Proposes a single-step neural solver for entropic optimal transport between sample-accessible distributions via a saddle-point reformulation of the Schrodinger bridge, handling small entropy regularization.
nodes.problem: Computing large-scale entropic optimal transport plans end-to-end, including small regularization coefficients.
nodes.approach: Saddle-point reformulation of dynamic EOT (Schrodinger bridge) trained as a neural algorithm.
nodes.primary_topic: Learning Theory & Optimization › Optimal Transport & Divergences
nodes.niche_reason: Neural optimal transport solvers are a small specialised community.

nodes.title: Dynamics of Finite Width Kernel and Prediction Fluctuations in Mean Field Neural Networks
nodes.tldr: Characterizes finite-width fluctuations of kernels and predictions in feature-learning networks using dynamical mean field theory, non-perturbative in feature learning strength.
nodes.problem: Understanding finite-width fluctuations of kernels and predictions in wide networks beyond the lazy regime.
nodes.approach: Extend dynamical mean field theory to compute O(1/sqrt(width)) fluctuations of order parameters across initializations.
nodes.primary_topic: Learning Theory & Optimization › Deep Learning Theory
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › High-dimensional & Random Matrix Theory
nodes.niche_reason: DMFT-based finite-width analysis is a rare theoretical physics-style niche.

nodes.title: Provable Guarantees for Nonlinear Feature Learning in Three-Layer Neural Networks
nodes.tldr: Proves three-layer networks trained with layer-wise gradient descent learn nonlinear hierarchical features with better sample complexity than two-layer networks, plus a depth separation.
nodes.problem: Feature learning in deep networks is poorly understood beyond two-layer theory.
nodes.approach: Layer-wise gradient descent analysis with a general sample complexity and width theorem.
nodes.primary_topic: Learning Theory & Optimization › Deep Learning Theory
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Generalization & Statistical Learning
nodes.niche_reason: Feature learning theory in three-layer networks is specialized within theory.

nodes.title: Multi Time Scale World Models
nodes.tldr: MTS3 is a probabilistic hierarchical state-space world model operating at multiple time scales, giving accurate long-horizon action-conditional predictions with uncertainty on system identification benchmarks.
nodes.problem: Learning world models with multiple temporal abstractions and calibrated long-horizon uncertainty.
nodes.approach: Multi Time Scale State Space model with efficient multi-scale probabilistic inference.
nodes.primary_topic: Reinforcement Learning › Model-Based RL & World Models
secondary_topics: Architectures & Training › Time Series & Sequential Data
nodes.niche_reason: Hierarchical probabilistic world models are specialised.

nodes.title: Neural Foundations of Mental Simulation: Future Prediction of Latent Representations on Dynamic Scenes
nodes.tldr: Tests latent future-prediction models against primate neural and behavioral data; video foundation model latents fit best.
nodes.problem: Explaining how primate brains predict future physical states in dynamic scenes.
nodes.approach: Goal-driven networks predicting future latents, benchmarked against neurophysiology and human behavior.
secondary_topics: Computer Vision › Vision Foundation Models & Self-Supervision
nodes.confidence_reason: Cross-disciplinary neuroscience and ML; topic is a judgment call
nodes.niche_reason: Neuro-behavioral benchmarking of future prediction models is rare in ML

nodes.title: Rotating Features for Object Discovery
nodes.tldr: Generalizes complex-valued features to higher dimensions as Rotating Features, enabling distributed object-centric representations and object extraction on real-world data.
nodes.problem: Solving the binding problem with continuous, distributed object representations beyond toy data.
nodes.approach: Higher-dimensional rotating feature vectors plus a new evaluation procedure, applied to pretrained features.
nodes.niche_reason: Distributed object-centric binding with continuous features is a rare direction.

nodes.title: Efficient Adversarial Contrastive Learning via Robustness-Aware Coreset Selection
nodes.tldr: Speeds up adversarial contrastive learning by selecting a label-free coreset that minimizes representational divergence between natural and adversarial data via submodular maximization, scaling to ImageNet-1K.
nodes.problem: Adversarial contrastive learning is too slow on large datasets because of adversarial example generation.
nodes.approach: Robustness-aware coreset selection recast as submodular maximization solved greedily.
secondary_topics: Data, Benchmarks & Evaluation › Synthetic Data & Data Curation
nodes.niche_reason: Efficient robust self-supervised pre-training is specialised.

nodes.title: Text-to-Image Diffusion Models are Zero Shot Classifiers
nodes.tldr: Evaluates text-to-image diffusion models as zero-shot classifiers by scoring how well they denoise an image under each label's text, rivaling CLIP.
nodes.problem: Unclear what knowledge diffusion models' representations capture, and how they do on downstream tasks.
nodes.approach: Use denoising likelihood under each label's text prompt as a proxy for label probability.
nodes.confidence_reason: Judgment call between diffusion analysis and zero-shot classification
nodes.niche_reason: Generative diffusion used discriminatively is unusual, though zero-shot evaluation is common

nodes.title: LeanDojo: Theorem Proving with Retrieval-Augmented Language Models
nodes.tldr: Releases LeanDojo, an open Lean toolkit and 98k-theorem benchmark, plus ReProver, a retrieval-augmented LLM prover that selects premises from a large math library.
nodes.problem: LLM theorem proving research is hard to reproduce due to private code, data, and compute.
nodes.approach: Open Lean data extraction and environment, premise-annotated benchmark, and retrieval-augmented prover with hard negatives.
nodes.niche_reason: Formal theorem proving with LLMs is established but specialised.

nodes.title: Theoretical and Practical Perspectives on what Influence Functions Do
nodes.tldr: Analyzes five assumptions behind influence functions, showing parameter divergence limits their predictive power though they remain useful for correcting mispredictions.
nodes.problem: Influence functions predict leave-one-out retraining effects poorly in deep networks.
nodes.approach: Theoretical analysis of five IF assumptions, validated on BERT and ResNet fine-tuning.
secondary_topics: Data, Benchmarks & Evaluation › Data Attribution & Influence
nodes.niche_reason: Established but specialised theoretical analysis of influence functions.

nodes.title: Generalizing Nonlinear ICA Beyond Structural Sparsity
nodes.tldr: Gives new identifiability results for nonlinear ICA under undercompleteness, partial sparsity, source dependence, and flexible grouping, without requiring full structural sparsity.
nodes.problem: Nonlinear ICA is unidentifiable without assumptions, and existing sparsity conditions often fail in practice.
nodes.approach: Prove identifiability when observations outnumber sources and when sparsity or independence assumptions are relaxed.
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Probabilistic & Bayesian Methods
nodes.confidence_reason: Identifiability theory for latent sources; representation and probabilistic framing both fit.
nodes.niche_reason: Nonlinear ICA identifiability beyond sparsity is a rare theory niche

nodes.title: One Fits All: Power General Time Series Analysis by Pretrained LM
nodes.tldr: Reuses a frozen pretrained language or image transformer for general time series tasks, matching specialised models across major task types.
nodes.problem: Time series analysis lacks large training data, blocking pretrained models for the domain.
nodes.approach: Frozen self-attention and feedforward layers of a pretrained transformer, fine-tuned for time series tasks.
nodes.primary_topic: Architectures & Training › Time Series & Sequential Data
nodes.niche_reason: Pretrained LLMs for time series is a crowded direction.

nodes.title: Best Arm Identification with Fixed Budget: A Large Deviation Perspective
nodes.tldr: Links large-deviation rates of arm proportions and rewards to derive a new adaptive best-arm algorithm, CR, with better fixed-budget error bounds.
nodes.problem: Fixed-budget best-arm identification lacks tight error bounds for adaptive sampling strategies.
nodes.approach: Large-deviation principle connecting empirical arm proportions to empirical rewards for any adaptive algorithm.
nodes.niche_reason: Large-deviation analysis of fixed-budget bandits is specialised

nodes.title: Object-Centric Slot Diffusion
nodes.tldr: Latent Slot Diffusion replaces slot decoders with a latent diffusion model conditioned on object slots, improving object-centric learning and enabling unsupervised compositional generation.
nodes.problem: Object-centric learning lacks powerful diffusion-based decoders for complex scenes.
nodes.approach: Latent diffusion decoder conditioned on object slots, optionally with pre-trained diffusion models.
nodes.niche_reason: Object-centric learning is established but specialised.

nodes.title: Combating Representation Learning Disparity with Geometric Harmonization
nodes.tldr: Geometric Harmonization adds category-level uniformity to self-supervised learning on long-tailed data, calibrating embeddings to stop tail-class collapse without hurting head classes.
nodes.problem: Self-supervised learning on long-tailed data yields representation disparity where tail classes collapse.
nodes.approach: Measure embedding-space population statistics and apply instance-wise calibration to encourage category-level uniformity.
nodes.niche_reason: Long-tailed SSL is an established but specialised area.

nodes.title: SimMTM: A Simple Pre-Training Framework for Masked Time-Series Modeling
nodes.tldr: SimMTM pre-trains time-series models by reconstructing masked series through weighted aggregation of multiple neighbors, easing reconstruction and improving forecasting and classification.
nodes.problem: Random masking destroys temporal variations, making masked time-series reconstruction too hard for pre-training.
nodes.approach: Manifold-learning-inspired recovery of masked points via weighted aggregation of multiple masked series' neighbors.
nodes.primary_topic: Architectures & Training › Time Series & Sequential Data
nodes.niche_reason: Time-series self-supervised pre-training is specialised.

nodes.title: Coop: Memory is not a Commodity
nodes.tldr: Evicts tensors in a sliding window so evictions are contiguous and immediately reused, cutting memory fragmentation and recomputation cost during DNN training.
nodes.problem: Tensor rematerialization ignores allocator fragmentation, evicting discontiguous memory under tight budgets.
nodes.approach: Co-optimize sliding-window eviction, cheap tensor partitioning, and recomputable in-place ops.
nodes.niche_reason: memory-aware rematerialization is specialised systems work

nodes.title: Diffusion with Forward Models: Solving Stochastic Inverse Problems Without Direct Supervision
nodes.tldr: Trains diffusion models on signals never observed directly, by integrating a differentiable forward model into denoising so samples match partial observations.

nodes.approach: End-to-end conditional diffusion training with a known differentiable forward model inside the denoising loop.

nodes.niche_reason: Established but specialised: diffusion without direct supervision.

nodes.title: Improved Convergence in High Probability of Clipped Gradient Methods with Heavy Tailed Noise
nodes.tldr: Proves improved high-probability convergence for clipped stochastic gradient methods under heavy-tailed noise, removing a factor-T failure probability blowup via supermartingale analysis.
nodes.problem: High-probability convergence of clipped SGD when gradient noise has heavy tails.
nodes.approach: Moment generating function bounds on a well-chosen supermartingale, avoiding union bounds over iterations.
nodes.niche_reason: Heavy-tailed clipped SGD analysis is specialized but established.

nodes.title: Optimal Guarantees for Algorithmic Reproducibility and Gradient Complexity in Convex Optimization
nodes.tldr: Shows smooth convex and minimax optimization can achieve both optimal reproducibility and near-optimal gradient complexity, removing the assumed trade-off.
nodes.problem: Prior work suggested first-order methods must sacrifice convergence rate for algorithmic reproducibility.
nodes.approach: Regularization-based algorithms analyzed under inexact initialization, gradient, and stochastic oracles.
nodes.niche_reason: reproducibility theory for convex optimization is specialised

nodes.title: Distributionally Robust Linear Quadratic Control
nodes.tldr: Shows the optimal controller for distributionally robust LQG with Wasserstein ambiguity sets is linear in observations, and computes it via Frank-Wolfe and Kalman filtering.
nodes.problem: LQG control is fragile when the noise distributions are unknown and non-Gaussian.
nodes.approach: Frank-Wolfe finds least-favourable distributions in Wasserstein balls; Kalman filter estimation then gives the policy.
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Optimal Transport & Divergences
nodes.niche_reason: Distributionally robust LQG control is specialised but established.

nodes.title: Unified Embedding: Battle-Tested Feature Representations for Web-Scale ML Systems
nodes.tldr: Feature Multiplexing shares one embedding table across many categorical features, giving Pareto-better space-accuracy tradeoffs for web-scale recommenders.
nodes.problem: Web-scale categorical features need huge per-feature embedding tables with billions of parameters.
nodes.approach: Share a single representation space across features, decomposable into per-feature components.
nodes.primary_topic: Architectures & Training › Efficient Training, Compression & Pruning
nodes.confidence_reason: Embedding compression vs. representation learning overlap.
nodes.niche_reason: Established but specialised: recommender embedding compression.

nodes.title: $SE(3)$ Equivariant Convolution and Transformer in Ray Space
nodes.tldr: Introduces SE(3)-equivariant convolution and attention on the space of rays, giving pose-equivariant multi-view 3D reconstruction and neural rendering without augmentation.

nodes.niche_reason: Equivariant ray-space networks are a rare geometric deep learning angle.

nodes.title: AMDP: An Adaptive Detection Procedure for False Discovery Rate Control in High-Dimensional Mediation Analysis
nodes.tldr: Develops an adaptive FDR-controlling procedure for detecting significant mediators in high-dimensional mediation analysis, using optimal ranking and a data-driven threshold.
nodes.problem: Controlling false discovery rate when detecting mediators in high-dimensional mediation analysis is conservative or suboptimal.

nodes.niche_reason: Multiple-testing FDR control for mediators is rare in ML venues.

nodes.title: GloptiNets: Scalable Non-Convex Optimization with Certificates
nodes.tldr: Certified non-convex optimization over hypercube or torus functions by fitting tractable Fourier-based models that GPUs can optimize at scale.
nodes.problem: Non-convex polynomial optimization with certificates scales poorly; Lasserre-style methods are intractable at high coefficient counts.
nodes.approach: Fourier-spectrum-regularized neural model family optimized with GPU techniques, yielding certificates.

nodes.title: Segment Any Point Cloud Sequences by Distilling Vision Foundation Models
nodes.tldr: Seal distills vision foundation models into automotive LiDAR point cloud sequences for annotation-free, spatio-temporally consistent segmentation pretraining.
nodes.problem: Segmenting driving point cloud sequences without annotations by leveraging vision foundation models.

nodes.niche_reason: Cross-modal LiDAR pretraining is a specialised area.

nodes.title: Cinematic Mindscapes: High-quality Video Reconstruction from Brain Activity
nodes.tldr: Mind-Video reconstructs videos from fMRI using masked brain modeling, contrastive learning, and an inflated Stable Diffusion with adversarial guidance.
nodes.problem: Reconstructing continuous visual experience as video from non-invasive brain recordings.
nodes.approach: Masked brain modeling plus multimodal contrastive learning feeding a temporally inflated Stable Diffusion model.
nodes.niche_reason: Brain-to-video decoding is a rare cross-disciplinary direction.

nodes.title: Parallel Submodular Function Minimization
nodes.tldr: Gives new query-versus-depth tradeoffs for parallel submodular function minimization, including a highly-parallel algorithm for minimizing l-infinity Lipschitz functions over the hypercube.
nodes.problem: Parallel complexity of submodular function minimization lacks algorithms beyond sequential or convex-based methods.
nodes.approach: Two algorithms: depth-2 with large query complexity and depth n^(1/3) with polynomial queries.

nodes.title: Adversarial Training from Mean Field Perspective
nodes.tldr: Mean-field analysis of adversarial training in random deep networks, giving tight bounds on adversarial loss and showing networks without shortcuts are not adversarially trainable.

nodes.primary_topic: Learning Theory & Optimization › Deep Learning Theory
nodes.niche_reason: Mean-field theory of adversarial training is a rare niche.

nodes.title: Provable benefits of annealing for estimating normalizing constants: Importance Sampling, Noise-Contrastive Estimation, and beyond
nodes.tldr: Asymptotic analysis of annealed estimators of normalizing constants, showing NCE beats importance sampling, and comparing path and design choices with optimal annealing paths.

nodes.title: AIMS: All-Inclusive Multi-Level Segmentation for Anything
nodes.tldr: Introduces All-Inclusive Multi-Level Segmentation, a unified model segmenting image regions into part, entity and relation levels via multi-dataset training.

nodes.title: Saddle-to-Saddle Dynamics in Diagonal Linear Networks

nodes.niche_reason: Exact trajectory analysis of toy networks is a narrow theory niche.

nodes.title: MetaBox: A Benchmark Platform for Meta-Black-Box Optimization with Reinforcement Learning
nodes.tldr: Introduces MetaBox, an open benchmark platform with over 300 problem instances, 19 baselines and standard metrics for evaluating RL-driven meta-black-box optimisers.

nodes.title: Scaling Data-Constrained Language Models

nodes.niche_reason: Scaling laws are widely studied, though data-constrained angle is specific.

nodes.title: Jailbroken: How Does LLM Safety Training Fail?
nodes.tldr: Identifies two failure modes of LLM safety training, competing objectives and mismatched generalization, and uses them to design jailbreaks that beat GPT-4 and Claude.
nodes.problem: Why safety-trained LLMs remain vulnerable to jailbreak attacks.

nodes.title: The Surprising Effectiveness of Diffusion Models for Optical Flow and Monocular Depth Estimation
nodes.tldr: Repurposes diffusion models for optical flow and monocular depth, reaching state-of-the-art accuracy and capturing uncertainty via Monte Carlo sampling.

nodes.title: Is Learning in Games Good for the Learners?
nodes.tldr: Studies reward-regret tradeoffs in repeated games via generalized equilibria, showing players can gain by deviating from no-swap-regret play and characterizing Stackelberg learnability.

nodes.title: Spuriosity Rankings: Sorting Data to Measure and Mitigate Biases

nodes.title: Statistical Guarantees for Variational Autoencoders using PAC-Bayesian Theory

secondary_topics: Generative Models › Generative Model Evaluation & Theory
nodes.niche_reason: PAC-Bayes theory for VAEs is a rare topic.

nodes.title: Deep Reinforcement Learning with Plasticity Injection

nodes.title: Coherent Soft Imitation Learning

nodes.title: On Learning Necessary and Sufficient Causal Graphs
nodes.tldr: Learns necessary and sufficient causal graphs that keep only causally relevant features for an outcome, using probabilities of causation to filter spurious variables.

nodes.title: Abide by the law and follow the flow: conservation laws for gradient flows
nodes.tldr: Formalises gradient-flow conservation laws and gives Lie-algebra algorithms that compute the maximal number of independent laws.

nodes.title: DecodingTrust: A Comprehensive Assessment of Trustworthiness in GPT Models
nodes.tldr: Comprehensive trustworthiness benchmark for GPT-3.5 and GPT-4 across toxicity, bias, robustness, privacy, ethics and fairness, revealing new vulnerabilities.

nodes.tldr: Gradient-based attack that learns a Gumbel-Softmax distribution over word substitutions, generating prompt perturbations that make diffusion models drop or blend subjects.
nodes.problem: Text-to-image diffusion models are fragile to small prompt perturbations that drop or blend subjects.
nodes.approach: Gumbel-Softmax relaxation over word replacements and extensions to optimize differentiable attack prompts.
nodes.niche_reason: Adversarial prompt attacks on diffusion models are specialised but established

nodes.title: Bypassing spike sorting: Density-based decoding using spike localization from dense multielectrode probes
nodes.tldr: Decodes behavior directly from spike features with a time-varying mixture of Gaussians, skipping spike sorting and modeling assignment uncertainty.
nodes.problem: Spike sorting is error-prone and discards uncertainty that could improve neural decoding.
nodes.approach: Variational inference on a behavior-modulated mixture of Gaussians over extracted spike features.
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Probabilistic & Bayesian Methods
nodes.niche_reason: Spike sorting-free decoding is an unusual neural decoding angle.

nodes.title: The Harvard USPTO Patent Dataset: A Large-Scale, Well-Structured, and Multi-Purpose Corpus of Patent Applications
nodes.tldr: Releases a 4.5M-document corpus of USPTO patent applications with structured metadata, plus patent-acceptance prediction and summarization tasks.
nodes.problem: NLP research on patents lacks large, structured corpora of inventor-submitted filings for studying patentability.
nodes.approach: Collects inventor-submitted application texts with metadata fields, enabling tasks like acceptance prediction under concept shift.
nodes.niche_reason: Patent NLP with inventor-submitted filings is a rare, cross-disciplinary niche.

nodes.title: Uncovering motifs of concurrent signaling across multiple neuronal populations
nodes.tldr: A latent-variable dimensionality reduction method identifies which neuronal populations share each latent, signal flow direction, and temporal evolution, applied to macaque V1/V2/V3d Neuropixels recordings.
nodes.problem: Characterizing concurrent signal flow among more than two simultaneously recorded neuronal populations.
nodes.approach: Latent variable model with Gaussian processes selecting populations per dimension and modeling directional delays across trials.
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Probabilistic & Bayesian Methods
nodes.niche_reason: Computational neuroscience of inter-area communication; rare at ML venues.

nodes.title: Real-World Image Variation by Aligning Diffusion Inversion Chain
nodes.tldr: Generates high-quality variations of real photos from one exemplar by aligning the diffusion generation process to the source image's inversion chain, with no fine-tuning.
nodes.problem: Diffusion models' generated images have a latent distribution gap from real images, hurting real-image variations.
nodes.approach: Cross-image self-attention injection and step-wise latent distribution normalization aligned to the inversion chain.
nodes.niche_reason: Training-free diffusion image variation is a common direction

nodes.title: Exploring Geometry of Blind Spots in Vision models
nodes.tldr: Studies under-sensitivity in vision models, using a level-set traversal algorithm to find perceptually distant inputs sharing a source image's high-confidence region.
nodes.problem: Deep vision models can be under-sensitive, so large input changes leave confidence unchanged; geometry is unclear.
nodes.approach: Iterative gradient-orthogonal traversal of equi-confidence level sets, exploring connected high-confidence paths.
nodes.confidence_reason: Under-sensitivity fits robustness or classifier-geometry analysis
nodes.niche_reason: Under-sensitivity geometry is rarer than adversarial work

nodes.title: HyenaDNA: Long-Range Genomic Sequence Modeling at Single Nucleotide Resolution
nodes.tldr: HyenaDNA is a Hyena-based genomic foundation model with up to 1M-token single-nucleotide context, state of the art on many benchmarks, enabling in-context learning.
nodes.problem: Transformer genomic models have short contexts and lose single-nucleotide resolution through tokenization.
nodes.approach: Pretrain a Hyena long-convolution model on the human genome at nucleotide level with million-token context.
secondary_topics: Architectures & Training › State-Space Models & Linear Attention
Language Models & NLP › Long Context & Memory
nodes.niche_reason: Genomics foundation models are specialised but established.

nodes.title: Can semi-supervised learning use all the data effectively? A lower bound perspective
nodes.tldr: Proves a tight minimax lower bound for 2-Gaussian mixtures, showing semi-supervised learning cannot beat SL or UL minimax rates there.
nodes.problem: Whether semi-supervised learning can beat both supervised and unsupervised learning in theory.
nodes.approach: Derives a lower bound depending on labeled and unlabeled sample sizes and signal-to-noise ratio.
nodes.primary_topic: Learning Theory & Optimization › Learning Theory Lower Bounds & Complexity
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Generalization & Statistical Learning
nodes.niche_reason: Specialised: minimax analysis of semi-supervised learning.

nodes.title: Dynamic Context Pruning for Efficient and Interpretable Autoregressive Transformers
nodes.tldr: Learns to dynamically prune uninformative tokens from the context of autoregressive transformers, dropping up to 80% with little degradation and up to 2x throughput gain.
nodes.problem: Quadratic attention cost over long sequences in autoregressive LLMs.
nodes.approach: Learnable dynamic context pruning mechanism with a sparsity parameter, applied via fine-tuning of pretrained models.
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › Efficient LLM Inference & Architectures
nodes.niche_reason: Efficient attention and KV pruning are crowded topics.

nodes.title: Deep Neural Collapse Is Provably Optimal for the Deep Unconstrained Features Model
nodes.tldr: Proves deep neural collapse is the global optimum of a deep nonlinear unconstrained features model for binary classification, explaining its propagation to earlier layers.
nodes.problem: Theoretical understanding of neural collapse propagating beyond the last layer in deep networks.
nodes.approach: Generalizes unconstrained features model to multiple nonlinear layers and proves global optimum properties.
nodes.primary_topic: Learning Theory & Optimization › Deep Learning Theory
nodes.niche_reason: Neural collapse theory is established but specialised.

nodes.title: MVDiffusion: Enabling Holistic Multi-view Image Generation with Correspondence-Aware Diffusion
nodes.tldr: MVDiffusion generates consistent multi-view images (e.g. panoramas) from text by running a pretrained diffusion model in parallel with correspondence-aware attention across views.
nodes.problem: Generating globally consistent multi-view images without error accumulation from iterative warping and inpainting.
nodes.approach: Parallel denoising of perspective views with a pretrained text-to-image model plus correspondence-aware cross-view attention layers.
nodes.niche_reason: Multi-view/panorama diffusion is specialised but active.

nodes.title: Accelerated Quasi-Newton Proximal Extragradient: Faster Rate for Smooth Convex Optimization
nodes.tldr: An accelerated quasi-Newton proximal extragradient method that provably beats Nesterov's accelerated gradient in smooth convex optimization, via online learning of Hessian approximations.
nodes.problem: No quasi-Newton method was known to provably outperform Nesterov acceleration on smooth convex problems.
nodes.approach: Monteiro-Svaiter acceleration with Hessian approximations updated through online convex optimization, tied to dynamic regret.
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Online Learning & Regret
nodes.niche_reason: Specialised convex optimization theory with an established community.

nodes.title: Imitation Learning from Imperfection: Theoretical Justifications and Algorithms
nodes.tldr: Formalizes offline imitation learning with imperfect extra data, shows naive behavioral cloning on mixed data can underperform expert-only BC, and proposes importance-sampling data selection.
nodes.problem: Imperfect supplementary data causes distribution shift that can make combined behavioral cloning worse than expert-only cloning.
nodes.approach: Importance-sampling-based selection of supplementary samples within the expert distribution, with theoretical analysis.
nodes.niche_reason: Offline imitation learning is common, though supplementary-data theory is somewhat distinct.

nodes.title: Faster Margin Maximization Rates for Generic Optimization Methods
nodes.tldr: Gives faster implicit-bias margin-maximization rates for mirror descent and steepest descent by casting them as online learning dynamics solving a regularized bilinear game.
nodes.problem: Generic optimizers like mirror and steepest descent have slow implicit bias convergence to max-margin classifiers.
nodes.approach: Reduce optimizer to online learning on a regularized bilinear zero-sum game and use regret bounds.
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Online Learning & Regret
nodes.niche_reason: Implicit bias rates for generic optimizers via game framing is rare.

nodes.title: Conditional score-based diffusion models for Bayesian inference in infinite dimensions
nodes.tldr: Proves the conditional denoising score estimator works in infinite dimensions, enabling amortized diffusion-based posterior sampling for Bayesian linear inverse problems.
nodes.problem: Posterior sampling for infinite-dimensional inverse problems is heuristic and needs costly forward evaluations.
nodes.approach: Amortized conditional score-based diffusion model trained with a conditional denoising estimator.
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Probabilistic & Bayesian Methods
nodes.niche_reason: Function-space diffusion for Bayesian inverse problems is rare

nodes.title: The Geometry of Neural Nets' Parameter Spaces Under Reparametrization
nodes.tldr: Argues neural net invariance under reparametrization follows from Riemannian geometry when the metric is explicit, clarifying flatness, optimization and density maximization.
nodes.problem: Reparametrization makes flatness measures and optimization trajectories inconsistent.
nodes.approach: Riemannian-geometry framing with explicit metric and correct transformation rules.
nodes.primary_topic: Learning Theory & Optimization › Deep Learning Theory
nodes.niche_reason: Riemannian-geometry treatment of reparametrization invariance is an uncommon angle.

nodes.title: Train Once, Get a Family: State-Adaptive Balances for Offline-to-Online Reinforcement Learning
nodes.tldr: FamO2O trains a family of policies with varying improvement-constraint balances and a balance model picks one per state, improving offline-to-online RL on D4RL.
nodes.problem: One-size-fits-all policy constraint balance in offline-to-online RL ignores state-wise data quality
nodes.approach: Universal model for policy family plus state-adaptive balance model selecting intensity
secondary_topics: Reinforcement Learning › Online & Deep RL Algorithms
nodes.niche_reason: Offline-to-online RL is a crowded subarea

nodes.title: Adaptive whitening with fast gain modulation and slow synaptic plasticity
nodes.tldr: Normative neural model where fast gain modulation and slow synaptic plasticity jointly perform adaptive statistical whitening of sensory responses.
nodes.problem: Mechanistic models of adaptive whitening use either synaptic plasticity or gain modulation alone, each with limits.
nodes.approach: Multi-timescale objective factorizing the inverse whitening matrix into synaptic basis vectors and neuronal gains.
nodes.niche_reason: Neural adaptive whitening models are rare within ML venues

nodes.title: Visual Instruction Tuning
nodes.tldr: Connects a vision encoder to an LLM, instruction-tuned on GPT-4-generated image-text data for general visual chat.
nodes.problem: Instruction tuning has been shown for LLMs but is less explored for multimodal models.
nodes.approach: Language-only GPT-4 generates multimodal instruction data, used to train an end-to-end vision-language model.
nodes.niche_reason: Mainstream multimodal LLM instruction tuning

nodes.title: Optimal Learners for Realizable Regression: PAC Learning and Online Learning
nodes.tldr: The paper characterizes realizable regression learnability in PAC and online settings with a new dimension, an instance-optimal learner, and optimal online regret.
nodes.problem: Which real-valued predictor classes are learnable in the realizable setting is not fully characterized.
nodes.approach: Minimax instance-optimal learner plus a new dimension, and a graph-dimension-based ERM characterization.
nodes.primary_topic: Learning Theory & Optimization › Generalization & Statistical Learning
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Online Learning & Regret
nodes.niche_reason: Characterizing realizable regression learnability is a rare theory topic.

nodes.title: How Far Can Camels Go? Exploring the State of Instruction Tuning on Open Resources
nodes.tldr: Trains 6.7B-65B models on 12 open instruction datasets and evaluates them broadly, finding no single dataset is best across skills.
nodes.problem: Unclear which open instruction-tuning data best unlocks LLM skills relative to proprietary models.
nodes.approach: Compares instruction-tuning datasets across automatic, model-based and human evaluations; releases the Tulu suite.
secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › LLM Evaluation & Benchmarks
nodes.niche_reason: Instruction tuning on open data is a mainstream direction.

nodes.title: A Single-Loop Accelerated Extra-Gradient Difference Algorithm with Improved Complexity Bounds for Constrained Minimax Optimization
nodes.tldr: A single-loop accelerated extra-gradient difference algorithm for constrained nonconvex-nonconcave minimax problems reaches O(eps^-2) complexity versus prior eps^-4.
nodes.problem: Slow convergence rates for constrained nonconvex-nonconcave minimax optimization.
nodes.approach: Extra-gradient difference step giving quasi-cocoercivity, plus momentum acceleration on the dual update.
nodes.niche_reason: Minimax optimization theory is established but specialised.

nodes.title: Critical Initialization of Wide and Deep Neural Networks using Partial Jacobians: General Theory and Applications
nodes.tldr: Introduces partial Jacobians to diagnose criticality in wide deep networks, deriving recurrences for their norms to guide initialization for ResNets and LayerNorm.
nodes.problem: Selecting critical initialization hyperparameters for deep networks in the infinite-width Gaussian process regime.
nodes.approach: Derive recurrence relations for partial-Jacobian norms across layers to detect and tune criticality.
nodes.primary_topic: Learning Theory & Optimization › Deep Learning Theory
nodes.niche_reason: Criticality in wide networks via partial Jacobians is a rare theory niche.

nodes.title: Provable benefits of score matching
nodes.tldr: Proves score matching is computationally and statistically efficient for exponentials of polynomials, where maximum likelihood is NP-hard to optimize.
nodes.problem: Unclear when score matching beats maximum likelihood computationally and statistically.
nodes.approach: Theory on exponentials of fixed-degree polynomials, with hardness proofs for ML and sample-complexity bounds for score matching.
nodes.primary_topic: Learning Theory & Optimization › Learning Theory Lower Bounds & Complexity
secondary_topics: Generative Models › Generative Model Evaluation & Theory
nodes.niche_reason: Score matching theory is specialised with few analogues.

nodes.title: High-dimensional Asymptotics of Denoising Autoencoders
nodes.tldr: Closed-form high-dimensional asymptotics for denoising Gaussian mixtures with a tied two-layer autoencoder, quantifying the advantage of a skip connection over PCA-like models.
nodes.problem: Precise denoising error of nonlinear autoencoders with skip connections is not well characterised.
nodes.approach: Replica-method analysis in the proportional high-dimensional limit yields closed-form test error.
nodes.primary_topic: Learning Theory & Optimization › High-dimensional & Random Matrix Theory
nodes.niche_reason: Statistical-physics analysis of autoencoders is rare

nodes.title: Stein $\Pi$-Importance Sampling
nodes.tldr: Designs the proposal Markov chain for Stein importance sampling, showing the optimal chain differs from the target and giving a construction and convergence conditions.
nodes.problem: No guidance exists on designing Markov chains suited to Stein post-processing.
nodes.approach: Stein importance sampling with weights on a surrogate-invariant chain, built via a variational argument.
nodes.primary_topic: Learning Theory & Optimization › Probabilistic & Bayesian Methods
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Kernels, GPs & Nonparametrics
nodes.niche_reason: Stein-based importance sampling design is a rare MCMC post-processing niche

nodes.title: Maximization of Average Precision for Deep Learning with Adversarial Ranking Robustness
nodes.tldr: Combines an average-precision surrogate loss with an adversarial ranking robustness regularizer and a stochastic optimizer to make AP maximization robust to adversarial perturbations.
nodes.problem: Adversarial training protects accuracy but not average precision ranking under class imbalance.
nodes.approach: AP surrogate loss plus ranking-consistency regularization between clean and perturbed data, with efficient stochastic optimization.
nodes.niche_reason: Robust AP optimization is a specialised corner of adversarial training.

nodes.title: Online Constrained Meta-Learning: Provable Guarantees for Generalization
nodes.tldr: Proposes online meta-learning under hard constraints with provable bounds on optimality gap and constraint violation, validated on meta-imitation learning and few-shot classification.
nodes.problem: Existing meta-learning ignores hard constraints on sequentially arriving tasks and lacks guarantees.
nodes.approach: Online constrained meta-learning framework with dynamic regret and generalization analysis of task-specific models.
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Online Learning & Regret
nodes.niche_reason: Constrained online meta-learning with guarantees is a rare combination.

nodes.title: Validated Image Caption Rating Dataset
nodes.tldr: Validated image caption rating dataset of 68,217 ratings on 15,646 pairs, collected with a gamified scale that improves inter-rater agreement.
nodes.problem: Caption quality is subjective, and existing caption rating datasets have weaker human agreement.
nodes.approach: Novel robust rating scale and gamified human rating collection, with learned rating predictors trained on the data.
nodes.niche_reason: Human-rating methodology for caption quality is a less common data angle

nodes.title: Proximity-Informed Calibration for Deep Neural Networks
nodes.tldr: Identifies proximity bias, where sparse-region samples are more overconfident, and proposes ProCal, a plug-in per-sample confidence adjustment.
nodes.problem: Calibration methods leave inconsistent miscalibration across low- and high-proximity samples.
nodes.approach: Proximity-based confidence adjustment with a theoretical guarantee, plus a proximity-informed calibration error metric.
nodes.niche_reason: Proximity bias in calibration is a niche but specific direction.

nodes.title: Robust Model Reasoning and Fitting via Dual Sparsity Pursuit
nodes.tldr: Unifies outlier rejection, model selection, and parameter estimation as sparse subspace recovery, solved by a fast proximal alternating optimizer.
nodes.problem: Robust fitting must jointly reject outliers, identify the true model, and estimate parameters.
nodes.approach: Sparse basis and error estimation via proximal approximation under alternating optimization with sub-gradient descent.
nodes.confidence_reason: Robust geometric model fitting spans vision and sparse optimization.
nodes.niche_reason: Joint outlier rejection and model selection via sparse subspace recovery is unusual.

nodes.title: QuIP: 2-Bit Quantization of Large Language Models With Guarantees
nodes.tldr: Post-training 2-bit LLM quantization using incoherence processing with random orthogonal transforms and adaptive rounding, plus a theoretical guarantee.
nodes.problem: Weight quantization of LLMs to two bits per weight usually collapses model quality.
nodes.approach: Incoherence preprocessing via random orthogonal matrices plus adaptive rounding minimizing a quadratic proxy.
nodes.primary_topic: Architectures & Training › Efficient Training, Compression & Pruning
secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › Efficient LLM Inference & Architectures
nodes.niche_reason: Common LLM compression direction with a theory angle

nodes.title: Adversarial Robustness in Graph Neural Networks: A Hamiltonian Approach
nodes.tldr: Builds adversarially robust graph neural networks from conservative Hamiltonian neural flows, showing Lyapunov stability alone does not guarantee robustness.
nodes.problem: GNNs are vulnerable to feature and topology adversarial perturbations.
nodes.approach: Compare neural-flow GNNs under stability notions and use conservative Hamiltonian flows for robustness.
nodes.niche_reason: Physics-inspired Hamiltonian GNN robustness is unusual.

nodes.title: WITRAN: Water-wave Information Transmission and Recurrent Acceleration Network for Long-range Time Series Forecasting
nodes.tldr: WITRAN is a recurrent forecasting network that captures long- and short-term patterns with sqrt(L) time complexity for long-range series.
nodes.problem: Long-range forecasting must capture global, local, and repetitive patterns at low time and memory cost.
nodes.approach: Bi-granular water-wave information transmission with a gated selective unit and recurrent acceleration.
nodes.primary_topic: Architectures & Training › Time Series & Sequential Data
nodes.niche_reason: Time series forecasting architectures are a common direction

nodes.title: Private Everlasting Prediction
nodes.tldr: Introduces private everlasting prediction, answering a stream of adaptive queries while protecting both training set and queries, enabling tasks impossible for private learning.
nodes.problem: Private learners need higher sample complexity; prediction over query streams must protect training data and queries.
nodes.approach: Generic PAC-model construction with sample complexity quadratic in VC dimension.
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Generalization & Statistical Learning
nodes.niche_reason: Theoretical private prediction is a rare, specialised topic.

nodes.title: Siamese Masked Autoencoders
nodes.tldr: SiamMAE learns visual correspondence from video by asymmetrically masking frame pairs, masking 95% of the future frame and reconstructing it via cross-attention, learning object-centric features.
nodes.problem: Learning visual correspondence representations from videos under occlusion and viewpoint change.
nodes.approach: Siamese masked autoencoder with unmasked past frame and heavily masked future frame, cross-attention decoder.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › Vision Foundation Models & Self-Supervision
nodes.niche_reason: Masked autoencoder self-supervision is a crowded area.

nodes.title: Convergence of Adam Under Relaxed Assumptions
nodes.tldr: Proves Adam converges to stationary points under generalized smoothness without bounded gradients, and proposes a variance-reduced Adam with improved gradient complexity.
nodes.problem: Adam's convergence proofs need unrealistically strong assumptions like globally bounded gradients.
nodes.approach: New gradient boundedness proof under sub-quadratic generalized smoothness, plus a variance-reduced Adam variant.
nodes.niche_reason: Adam convergence theory is a common topic.

nodes.title: Encoding Time-Series Explanations through Self-Supervised Model Behavior Consistency
nodes.tldr: Trains an interpretable surrogate to mimic a pretrained time-series model by preserving latent relations, producing discrete attribution maps and a reusable space of explanations.
nodes.problem: Explainers from other modalities transfer poorly to time series, which needs localizing signal segments and matching temporal patterns.
nodes.approach: Model behavior consistency loss that preserves latent-space relations of the pretrained model in the surrogate's latent space.
secondary_topics: Architectures & Training › Time Series & Sequential Data
nodes.niche_reason: Time-series explanation with learned explanation latent space is specialised

nodes.title: Mechanism Design for Collaborative Normal Mean Estimation
nodes.tldr: Designs a Nash incentive-compatible data-sharing mechanism for collaborative mean estimation, within factor 2 of optimal social cost.
nodes.problem: Strategic agents under-collect or fabricate data when sharing samples in naive collaboration.
nodes.approach: Corrupts shared data proportional to disagreement with the agent's report, paired with minimax-optimal estimators.
nodes.primary_topic: Learning Theory & Optimization › Game Theory & Mechanism Design
nodes.niche_reason: strategic data-sharing mechanism for estimation, rare in ML

nodes.title: Uncertainty Quantification over Graph with Conformalized Graph Neural Networks
nodes.tldr: Extends conformal prediction to GNNs, producing prediction sets with guaranteed coverage and a topology-aware correction that shrinks set sizes.
nodes.problem: GNN predictions lack rigorous uncertainty guarantees needed for reliable deployment.
nodes.approach: Conformal prediction adapted to graphs, with a topology-aware correction model that shrinks prediction sets.
nodes.niche_reason: Conformal GNN prediction is an established but specialised niche

nodes.title: Would I have gotten that reward? Long-term credit assignment by counterfactual contribution analysis
nodes.tldr: Model-based credit assignment that measures each action's counterfactual contribution to later rewards, giving lower-variance policy gradients than hindsight credit assignment.
nodes.problem: Long-term credit assignment in RL has high variance when rewarding states are used.
nodes.approach: Counterfactual contributions measured w.r.t. rewards or rewarding-object representations.
nodes.primary_topic: Reinforcement Learning › Model-Based RL & World Models
secondary_topics: Reinforcement Learning › Online & Deep RL Algorithms
nodes.niche_reason: Counterfactual model-based credit assignment is uncommon.

nodes.title: Pre-RMSNorm and Pre-CRMSNorm Transformers: Equivalent and Efficient Pre-LN Transformers
nodes.tldr: Shows Pre-LN Transformers are exactly equivalent to Pre-RMSNorm and a compressed variant, enabling a near-free 1-10% training and inference speedup.
nodes.problem: LayerNorm and RMSNorm Transformers are hard to convert between, though one is cheaper.
nodes.approach: Removes redundant mean information in Pre-LN, reducing LayerNorm to RMSNorm via lossless compression of zero-mean vectors.
secondary_topics: Architectures & Training › Efficient Training, Compression & Pruning
nodes.niche_reason: Normalization variants are crowded, but the equivalence result is specific

nodes.title: Online List Labeling with Predictions
nodes.tldr: Shows learned predictions improve online list labeling, staying optimal for any prediction error and worst-case safe when predictions fail.
nodes.problem: Learned predictions are underused in data structures that carry strong worst-case guarantees.
nodes.approach: New list-labeling structure with worst-case and stochastic error models bounding relabeling cost.
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Online Learning & Regret
nodes.confidence_reason: Learning-augmented data structures fit no clean topic
nodes.niche_reason: Learning-augmented data structures are a rare niche

nodes.title: Quasi-Monte Carlo Graph Random Features
nodes.tldr: Introduces antithetic termination to make graph random-walk features less variable, giving provably lower-variance estimates of graph Laplacian kernels.
nodes.problem: Variance of graph random feature estimators for graph kernels is too high.
nodes.approach: Quasi-Monte Carlo random walks with antithetic termination inducing negative correlation.
nodes.primary_topic: Learning Theory & Optimization › Kernels, GPs & Nonparametrics
nodes.confidence_reason: kernel approximation vs graph learning is a judgment call
nodes.niche_reason: Established kernel-approximation line; QMC applied to graph walks is specialised.

nodes.title: Sounding Bodies: Modeling 3D Spatial Sound of Humans Using Body Pose and Audio
nodes.tldr: Generates a 3D sound field around a human body from headset audio and body pose, renderable at any position in space.
nodes.problem: 3D spatial audio produced by body motion and speech is largely unmodeled, unlike 3D body modeling.
nodes.approach: Maps headset audio and body pose to a sound field, trained on a new dataset recorded with 345 microphones.
nodes.primary_topic: Audio, Speech & Multimodal › Audio-Visual & Cross-modal Learning
secondary_topics: Computer Vision › Human Pose, Avatars & Faces
nodes.niche_reason: Very rare: pose-driven 3D sound fields around human bodies.

nodes.title: Unpaired Multi-Domain Causal Representation Learning
nodes.tldr: Proves identifiability of the joint distribution and shared causal graph from unpaired multi-domain marginals in a linear setting, and gives a recovery method.
nodes.problem: Recovering shared causal latent structure when observations across domains are unpaired.
nodes.approach: Identifiability theory for linear SEMs via ICA-style arguments, converted into a recovery algorithm.
nodes.primary_topic: Learning Theory & Optimization › Causality & Causal Inference
nodes.niche_reason: Unpaired multi-domain causal representation learning is rare.

nodes.title: Optimistic Natural Policy Gradient: a Simple Efficient Policy Optimization Framework for Online RL
nodes.tldr: Combines natural policy gradient with optimistic policy evaluation for online RL, achieving optimal dimension dependence in linear MDPs.
nodes.problem: Policy optimization has weak sample-complexity guarantees for online RL needing exploration.
nodes.approach: Natural policy gradient updates paired with optimistic policy evaluation subroutines that drive exploration.
nodes.niche_reason: Policy optimization theory is a common, well-populated direction.

nodes.title: Curriculum Learning With Infant Egocentric Videos
nodes.tldr: Self-supervised models trained on infant egocentric video learn best starting from the youngest age group, due to slow, simple visual input.
nodes.problem: Unclear whether the developmental order of infant visual experience matters for learning visual systems.
nodes.approach: Train self-supervised learners on age-separated head-mounted camera data under curriculum and ablation conditions.
nodes.niche_reason: Developmental curricula from infant video are very rare in ML

nodes.title: Reliable Learning of Halfspaces under Gaussian Marginals
nodes.tldr: Gives an algorithm for reliable agnostic PAC learning of Gaussian halfspaces, with a statistical query lower bound showing the dependence is nearly optimal.
nodes.problem: Learning halfspaces when one error type is costlier, under reliable agnostic PAC learning.
nodes.approach: Algorithm with quasi-polynomial dependence on the bias, matched by a statistical query lower bound.
nodes.primary_topic: Learning Theory & Optimization › Learning Theory Lower Bounds & Complexity
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Generalization & Statistical Learning
nodes.niche_reason: Reliable agnostic learning of Gaussian halfspaces is very rare.

nodes.title: Not All Tokens Are What You Need for Pretraining
nodes.tldr: Selectively trains on high-scoring tokens chosen by a reference model, improving math and general performance with far fewer pretraining tokens.
nodes.problem: Standard pretraining applies next-token loss uniformly, wasting compute on unimportant tokens.
nodes.approach: Selective Language Modeling: score tokens with a reference model and train on the top-scoring ones.
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › Pretraining, Scaling & Data
secondary_topics: Data, Benchmarks & Evaluation › Synthetic Data & Data Curation
nodes.niche_reason: Data selection for pretraining is a crowded area

nodes.title: The Road Less Scheduled
nodes.tldr: Schedule-Free optimization removes the need for learning rate schedules and stopping time by unifying scheduling and iterate averaging, matching schedule-based performance.
nodes.problem: Learning rate schedules need a known stopping step, while schedule-free alternatives underperform.
nodes.approach: Combines interpolation and averaging in a momentum-based optimizer, without extra hyperparameters.
nodes.niche_reason: Optimizer design is common, though schedule-free is distinctive.

nodes.title: ProgressGym: Alignment with a Millennium of Moral Progress
nodes.tldr: Introduces progress alignment and ProgressGym, a framework with historical LLMs and benchmarks for aligning AI values to evolving moral progress.
nodes.problem: Alignment methods lock in contemporary moral blindspots and miss moral progress over time.
nodes.approach: Lifelong and extrapolative baseline algorithms evaluated on historical-text-based moral progress tasks.
nodes.primary_topic: Trustworthy ML › AI Safety & Alignment Research
secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › Alignment & Preference Optimization
nodes.niche_reason: Temporal moral-progress alignment is a very rare, distinctive direction.

nodes.title: SegVol: Universal and Interactive Volumetric Medical Image Segmentation
nodes.tldr: Trains a 3D CT segmentation foundation model with semantic and spatial prompts that segments over 200 anatomical categories interactively.
nodes.problem: No 3D foundation model segments many anatomical categories with easy user interaction.
nodes.approach: Scales training to 90K unlabeled and 6K labeled CT volumes, with a zoom-out-zoom-in inference mechanism.
nodes.niche_reason: Medical segmentation is established; a universal 3D promptable CT model is specialised.

nodes.title: Bayesian-guided Label Mapping for Visual Reprogramming
nodes.tldr: Adapts pretrained vision models to new labels by replacing one-to-one label mapping with a probabilistic Bayesian mapping matrix, improving over prior label mapping methods.
nodes.problem: One-to-one label mappings miss complex relationships between pretrained and downstream labels.
nodes.approach: Iteratively update a probabilistic mapping matrix guided by Bayesian conditional probability over predicted and true labels.
secondary_topics: Computer Vision › Vision Foundation Models & Self-Supervision
nodes.niche_reason: Visual reprogramming label mapping is specialised but established.

nodes.title: A Unified Debiasing Approach for Vision-Language Models across Modalities and Tasks
nodes.tldr: Training-free debiasing for vision-language models that prunes biased features and imputes low-confidence ones, reducing gender bias across classification, retrieval, captioning, and generation.
nodes.problem: VLMs inherit societal stereotypes, and existing debiasing methods are task-specific or need retraining.
nodes.approach: Selective feature pruning plus low-confidence imputation (LCI) applied at inference time.
nodes.niche_reason: Common fairness topic applied to VLMs

nodes.title: Schrodinger Bridge Flow for Unpaired Data Translation
nodes.tldr: Computes entropic Schrodinger bridges for unpaired data translation via a flow of path measures, avoiding repeated training of diffusion models.
nodes.problem: Existing optimal-transport approximations need training a diffusion model per iteration or use noisy mini-batches.
nodes.approach: Discretises the Schrodinger Bridge Flow, a dynamic entropy-regularised optimal transport whose stationary point is the bridge.
nodes.primary_topic: Learning Theory & Optimization › Optimal Transport & Divergences
nodes.niche_reason: Optimal-transport generative translation is specialised but established

nodes.title: Multilingual Diversity Improves Vision-Language Representations
nodes.tldr: Shows translating and keeping non-English image-text pairs in web data improves English vision-language pretraining.
nodes.problem: Curation pipelines discard non-English image-text data, which may hurt vision models.
nodes.approach: Translate multilingual web pairs to English, re-filter, then pretrain CLIP-style models.
nodes.primary_topic: Data, Benchmarks & Evaluation › Synthetic Data & Data Curation
nodes.niche_reason: Multilingual data curation for VLMs is less common

nodes.title: MotionBooth: Motion-Aware Customized Text-to-Video Generation
nodes.tldr: Fine-tunes a text-to-video model on a few subject images to generate videos with controlled subject and camera motion.
nodes.problem: Animating customised subjects in text-to-video with precise control of both object and camera motion.
nodes.approach: Subject region and preservation losses with training-free cross-attention manipulation and a latent-shift camera module.
nodes.niche_reason: Customised text-to-video with motion control is crowded and active.

nodes.title: Reparameterization invariance in approximate Bayesian inference
nodes.tldr: Shows Bayesian neural network posteriors break reparameterization invariance, explains linearized Laplace's success geometrically, and extends invariance via Riemannian diffusion sampling.
nodes.problem: Approximate BNN posteriors assign different densities to different parametrizations of the same function.
nodes.approach: Geometric view of reparameterizations and a Riemannian diffusion process for posterior sampling.
nodes.primary_topic: Learning Theory & Optimization › Probabilistic & Bayesian Methods
nodes.niche_reason: Geometric Bayesian NN inference is specialised.

nodes.title: GREATS: Online Selection of High-Quality Data for LLM Training in Every Iteration
nodes.tldr: Selects training batches online with a greedy algorithm over Taylor-approximated batch quality, speeding LLM training convergence and generalization.
nodes.problem: Online batch selection relies on impractical reference models or weak heuristics.
nodes.approach: Greedy selection over batch quality approximated by Taylor expansion, scaled to large models.
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › Pretraining, Scaling & Data
secondary_topics: Data, Benchmarks & Evaluation › Synthetic Data & Data Curation
nodes.niche_reason: Data selection for LLM training is a common, crowded direction

nodes.title: You Only Cache Once: Decoder-Decoder Architectures for Language Models
nodes.tldr: YOCO is a decoder-decoder LLM architecture caching key-value pairs once via a self-decoder feeding a cross-decoder, cutting memory and prefill latency while supporting 1M context.
nodes.problem: Decoder-only Transformers have heavy KV cache memory and slow prefill at long context.
nodes.approach: Self-decoder builds a global KV cache reused by a cross-decoder through cross-attention.
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › Efficient LLM Inference & Architectures
secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › Long Context & Memory
nodes.niche_reason: Efficient LLM architectures are a common topic.

nodes.title: Differentiable Task Graph Learning: Procedural Activity Representation and Online Mistake Detection from Egocentric Videos
nodes.tldr: Learns task graphs of procedural activities differentiably via maximum likelihood on edge weights, improving task graph prediction and online mistake detection in egocentric videos.
nodes.problem: Extracting task graphs from procedural videos relies on hand-crafted procedures and is not learnable end-to-end.
nodes.approach: Direct maximum likelihood optimization of edge weights, enabling gradient-based task graph learning plugged into networks.
nodes.niche_reason: Procedural task graph learning and mistake detection is a rare direction.

nodes.title: Overcoming Common Flaws in the Evaluation of Selective Classification Systems
nodes.tldr: Identifies flaws in selective classification evaluation and proposes AUGRC, a multi-threshold metric measuring average risk of undetected failures, which changes rankings on 5 of 6 datasets.
nodes.problem: Current selective classification evaluation uses fixed working points or metrics misaligned with the task.
nodes.approach: Five metric requirements and the Area under the Generalized Risk Coverage curve, benchmarked over 13 scoring functions.
nodes.niche_reason: Selective classification evaluation is established but specialised.

nodes.title: When Is Inductive Inference Possible?
nodes.tldr: Characterizes when inductive inference with finitely many errors is possible: iff the hypothesis class is a countable union of online learnable classes, with matching agnostic regret bounds.
nodes.problem: Characterizing when a hypothesis class can be learned with finite errors over infinite observation sequences.
nodes.approach: Link to online learning via a non-uniform online learning framework.
nodes.primary_topic: Learning Theory & Optimization › Online Learning & Regret
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Learning Theory Lower Bounds & Complexity
nodes.niche_reason: Philosophical learning-theory question with few similar papers.

nodes.title: Exclusively Penalized Q-learning for Offline Reinforcement Learning
nodes.tldr: Proposes Exclusively Penalized Q-learning, which penalizes only states prone to estimation error, reducing underestimation bias in penalized offline RL and improving control performance.
nodes.problem: Penalized value functions in offline RL introduce unnecessary bias and underestimation.
nodes.approach: Selectively penalize only states likely to produce overestimation errors in Q-learning.
secondary_topics: Reinforcement Learning › Online & Deep RL Algorithms
nodes.niche_reason: Offline RL value-penalty variants are a crowded mainstream topic

nodes.title: Automated Efficient Estimation using Monte Carlo Efficient Influence Functions
nodes.tldr: MC-EIF automatically approximates efficient influence functions via Monte Carlo and autodiff in probabilistic programs, yielding consistent estimators with optimal root-N rates, including for portfolio selection.
nodes.problem: Efficient influence function-based estimation requires custom analytic derivations for each model and functional.
nodes.approach: Monte Carlo approximation of efficient influence functions integrated with differentiable probabilistic programming.
nodes.primary_topic: Learning Theory & Optimization › Causality & Causal Inference
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Probabilistic & Bayesian Methods
nodes.niche_reason: Automated semiparametric estimation via probabilistic programming is very rare.

nodes.title: Generative Retrieval Meets Multi-Graded Relevance
nodes.tldr: Extends generative retrieval, where a model generates document IDs, to multi-graded relevance by learning distinct, relevance-aware identifiers and grade-constrained contrastive training.
nodes.problem: Generative retrieval only handles binary relevance and struggles with shared or ambiguous docids.
nodes.approach: Jointly optimize docid relevance and distinctness, then train with multi-graded constrained contrastive loss.
nodes.niche_reason: Specialized extension of an established retrieval paradigm

nodes.title: X-Ray: A Sequential 3D Representation For Generation
nodes.tldr: X-Ray encodes a 3D object as a multi-frame video of layered surface frames via ray casting, enabling video-diffusion-style single-image-to-3D generation of visible and hidden surfaces.
nodes.problem: Efficient 3D representations suited to generating complete 3D objects from images.
nodes.approach: Sequential ray-cast surface frames (depth, normal, color) modeled with an X-Ray diffusion model and upsampler.
nodes.niche_reason: Novel sequential representation but within active 3D generation.

nodes.title: Multiclass Transductive Online Learning
nodes.tldr: Characterizes online learnability for multiclass transductive settings with unbounded labels via a new Level-constrained Littlestone dimension, giving a trichotomy of mistake rates.
nodes.problem: Optimal mistake bounds for multiclass transductive online learning with unbounded label spaces were open.
nodes.approach: Combinatorial dimensions (Level-constrained Littlestone and Branching) with new shattering notion and algorithms.
nodes.primary_topic: Learning Theory & Optimization › Online Learning & Regret
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Learning Theory Lower Bounds & Complexity
nodes.niche_reason: unbounded-label transductive online learning is rare

nodes.title: Langevin Unlearning: A New Perspective of Noisy Gradient Descent for Machine Unlearning
nodes.tldr: Langevin unlearning uses noisy gradient descent to give differential-privacy-style certified approximate unlearning, including for non-convex problems and sequential or batch requests.
nodes.problem: Provide certified approximate machine unlearning with privacy guarantees cheaper than retraining.
nodes.approach: Noisy gradient descent / Langevin dynamics unifying DP learning and certified unlearning.
nodes.primary_topic: Trustworthy ML › Machine Unlearning & Privacy Attacks
nodes.niche_reason: Certified unlearning is established but specialised.

nodes.title: Stylus: Automatic Adapter Selection for Diffusion Models
nodes.tldr: Stylus automatically retrieves and composes relevant LoRA adapters for a prompt from a database of 75K adapters, improving Stable Diffusion CLIP/FID efficiency and human preference.
nodes.problem: Choosing among 100K+ poorly described community adapters to generate high-quality custom images.
nodes.approach: Three-stage pipeline: summarize adapters, retrieve relevant ones, and compose them by prompt keywords.
nodes.niche_reason: Automatic adapter retrieval and composition is a fairly specific problem.

nodes.title: Can Transformers Smell Like Humans?
nodes.tldr: Shows representations from transformers pretrained on chemical structures align with human olfactory perception, predicting expert labels, ratings and odorant similarity.
nodes.problem: Whether pretrained chemical transformers encode representations aligned with human smell perception.
nodes.approach: Probe pretrained chemical transformer embeddings on multiple olfactory datasets and perceptual representation types.
nodes.niche_reason: Olfaction and machine representation alignment is very rare.

nodes.title: Cluster-wise Graph Transformer with Dual-granularity Kernelized Attention
nodes.tldr: Node-to-Cluster Attention lets graph transformers pass information between node clusters using multiple-kernel kernelized attention at node and cluster granularity.
nodes.problem: Fixed graph coarsening yields homogeneous cluster representations and loses node-level information.
nodes.approach: N2C-Attn with multiple kernel learning in kernelized attention over node sets, without compressing clusters.
nodes.niche_reason: Graph transformer variants are common but specialised.

nodes.title: Fearless Stochasticity in Expectation Propagation
nodes.tldr: Reframes expectation propagation moment-matching as natural-gradient optimization of a variational objective, yielding Monte Carlo-friendly EP variants stable with one sample.
nodes.problem: EP updates are not robust to Monte Carlo noise in moment estimation.
nodes.approach: Natural-gradient view of EP updates leading to new single-sample variants without debiasing.
nodes.primary_topic: Learning Theory & Optimization › Probabilistic & Bayesian Methods
nodes.niche_reason: Approximate Bayesian inference is established but specialised

nodes.title: Nearly Optimal Approximation of Matrix Functions by the Lanczos Method
nodes.tldr: Proves Lanczos for matrix functions matches the best Krylov error for rational functions, up to a factor independent of iteration count.
nodes.problem: Explaining why the classic Lanczos method beats newer Krylov methods in practice.
nodes.approach: Error analysis of Lanczos-FA for rational functions relative to optimal Krylov methods.
nodes.confidence_reason: Numerical linear algebra; no close ML vocabulary topic
nodes.niche_reason: Lanczos matrix-function theory is an unusual ML-adjacent direction

nodes.title: SA3DIP: Segment Any 3D Instance with Potential 3D Priors
nodes.tldr: SA3DIP improves zero-shot open-world 3D instance segmentation by adding 3D priors to superpoint construction and reducing reliance on SAM masks.
nodes.problem: Superpoint plus SAM approaches under-segment similar-geometry instances and over-rely on 2D masks.
nodes.approach: Build superpoints using additional 3D priors, and use 3D guidance for merging instead of hand-crafted 2D steps.
nodes.niche_reason: SAM-based 3D segmentation is a common current direction.

nodes.title: E2E-MFD: Towards End-to-End Synchronous Multimodal Fusion Detection
nodes.tldr: End-to-end multimodal image fusion and object detection trained jointly in one phase, improving detection on autonomous-driving benchmarks.
nodes.problem: Multi-stage training of multimodal fusion and detection is complex and yields suboptimal joint results.
nodes.approach: Synchronous joint optimization with a gradient-matrix strategy for shared parameters.
secondary_topics: Audio, Speech & Multimodal › Audio-Visual & Cross-modal Learning
nodes.confidence_reason: fusion and detection straddle two topics
nodes.niche_reason: Joint fusion-detection training is specialised but established

nodes.title: Expectile Regularization for Fast and Accurate Training of Neural Optimal Transport
nodes.tldr: Expectile regularization on dual Kantorovich potentials enables fast, stable neural optimal transport training without costly c-transform approximation or fine-tuning.
nodes.problem: Neural optimal transport needs expensive near-exact c-transform approximations or non-convex max-min objectives.
nodes.approach: Expectile-based loss regularizing dual potentials to bound conjugate potentials and stabilize learning.
nodes.primary_topic: Learning Theory & Optimization › Optimal Transport & Divergences
nodes.niche_reason: Neural OT solvers are a rare specialised niche.

nodes.title: Linear Regression using Heterogeneous Data Batches
nodes.tldr: A gradient-based algorithm learns mixed linear regressions from heterogeneous small batches, handling distinct, unknown, heavy-tailed input distributions and removing separation requirements.
nodes.problem: Recovering regression vectors of unknown subgroups from batches with unknown non-Gaussian input distributions.
nodes.approach: Novel gradient-based algorithm with list-decodable guarantees reducing batch and batch-size requirements.
nodes.primary_topic: Learning Theory & Optimization › Generalization & Statistical Learning
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Learning Theory Lower Bounds & Complexity
nodes.niche_reason: Batch mixed regression and list-decodable learning are rare niches.

nodes.title: LLM Evaluators Recognize and Favor Their Own Generations
nodes.tldr: Finds LLMs can recognize their own outputs, and that self-recognition ability linearly correlates with the strength of self-preference bias in judging.
nodes.problem: LLM evaluators score their own outputs higher, and it is unclear whether they actually recognize them.
nodes.approach: Test self-recognition out of the box, then finetune models to vary it and measure self-preference correlation.
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › LLM Evaluation & Benchmarks
secondary_topics: Trustworthy ML › AI Safety & Alignment Research
nodes.niche_reason: LLM-as-judge self-preference bias is a busy area

nodes.title: Private Edge Density Estimation for Random Graphs: Optimal, Efficient and Robust
nodes.tldr: Gives a polynomial-time, node-private, robust estimator for random graph edge density with near-optimal error, via sum-of-squares exponential mechanisms.
nodes.problem: Prior private edge-density estimators are exponential-time or have suboptimal error rates
nodes.approach: A new sum-of-squares algorithm for robust edge density estimation, plus a privacy-to-robustness reduction.
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Learning Theory Lower Bounds & Complexity
nodes.niche_reason: Private, robust estimation of random graph density is a rare niche

nodes.title: AgentBoard: An Analytical Evaluation Board of Multi-turn LLM Agents
nodes.tldr: AgentBoard is a benchmark and open-source toolkit for multi-turn LLM agents with a fine-grained progress rate metric and interactive visualization for analytical evaluation.
nodes.problem: Agent benchmarks mostly report final success rates, offering little insight into multi-turn agent abilities.
nodes.approach: Unified partially-observable multi-round environments with progress rate metric and an analysis toolkit.

secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › LLM Evaluation & Benchmarks
nodes.niche_reason: LLM agent benchmarks are very common.

nodes.title: A Near-optimal Algorithm for Learning Margin Halfspaces with Massart Noise
nodes.tldr: Efficient PAC learner for margin halfspaces under Massart noise, nearly matching the information-computation sample lower bound, using online SGD on chosen convex losses.
nodes.problem: Efficiently learning margin halfspaces with Massart noise at near-optimal sample complexity.
nodes.approach: Online SGD on a carefully selected sequence of convex losses.
nodes.primary_topic: Learning Theory & Optimization › Learning Theory Lower Bounds & Complexity
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Generalization & Statistical Learning
nodes.niche_reason: Computational learning theory with noise models is niche.

nodes.title: Convolutional Differentiable Logic Gate Networks
nodes.tldr: Scales differentiably learned logic gate networks with gate-tree convolutions and OR pooling, reaching 86.29% CIFAR-10 accuracy with 29x smaller models than prior work.

nodes.niche_reason: Logic gate networks are rare; few papers extend them to convolutions.

nodes.title: Resolving Discrepancies in Compute-Optimal Scaling of Language Models
nodes.tldr: Explains why Kaplan and Chinchilla scaling laws disagree via last-layer cost, warmup and optimizer tuning, and derives scaling laws for learning rate and batch size.

nodes.niche_reason: Scaling laws are a common, heavily studied topic.

nodes.title: Motion Forecasting in Continuous Driving
nodes.tldr: Forecasts agent motion for self-driving cars by accumulating scene context over time and relaying past predictions, instead of treating each scene independently.

nodes.niche_reason: Motion forecasting for driving is a crowded mainstream direction.

nodes.title: Do Finetti: On Causal Effects for Exchangeable Data
nodes.tldr: Extends causal effect identification and estimation to exchangeable (non-i.i.d.) data with a truncated factorization formula, a causal Polya urn, and joint discovery-estimation algorithm.
nodes.problem: Causal effect estimation frameworks assume i.i.d. data, missing exchangeable multi-environment data.

nodes.title: VLM Agents Generate Their Own Memories: Distilling Experience into Embodied Programs of Thought
nodes.tldr: Lets VLM and LLM agents turn sub-optimal demonstrations into abstracted programs with causal and subgoal annotations, improving in-context decisions while reducing manual prompt engineering.
nodes.problem: In-context agents need high-quality exemplar demonstrations that are costly to write.
nodes.approach: VLM abstracts trajectories into annotated programs, refined by human feedback and stored as exemplars.
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › In-context Learning & Prompting
secondary_topics: Audio, Speech & Multimodal › Embodied Multimodal Agents
nodes.niche_reason: Self-generated exemplars for agents is a fairly common direction

nodes.title: TOPA: Extending Large Language Models for Video Understanding via Text-Only Pre-Alignment
nodes.tldr: Extends LLMs to video understanding by pre-aligning them on generated text-only videos, with no real video pretraining, reaching strong long-form video QA.

nodes.title: EHRCon: Dataset for Checking Consistency between Unstructured Notes and Structured Tables in Electronic Health Records

nodes.problem: Discrepancies between unstructured clinical notes and structured tables in electronic health records threaten patient safety.
nodes.approach: Manually annotate 3,943 entities across 105 notes against database entries, in original and modified versions.
nodes.niche_reason: EHR note-table consistency checking is an unusual task.

nodes.title: Toxicity Detection for Free
nodes.tldr: MULI detects toxic prompts via sparse logistic regression on the LLM's own first-response-token logits, outperforming state-of-the-art detectors.
nodes.problem: Toxicity detectors have low detection rates at low false-positive rates, which is costly in practice.

nodes.niche_reason: Logit-based moderation is specialised but established.

nodes.title: Peri-midFormer: Periodic Pyramid Transformer for Time Series Analysis
nodes.tldr: Decomposes time series into a periodic pyramid of nested periodic components and applies attention across levels for forecasting and anomaly detection.
nodes.problem: Modeling complex multi-periodic variation in time series is hard from raw 1D points.
nodes.approach: Periodic pyramid of inclusion and overlap relations with attention between components.

nodes.niche_reason: Periodicity-based time-series transformers are specialised

nodes.title: Unlocking Tokens as Data Points for Generalization Bounds on Larger Language Models
nodes.tldr: Derives non-vacuous generalization bounds for billion-parameter LLMs using martingale properties and treating tokens as data points, allowing less restrictive compression.

nodes.title: Text2CAD: Generating Sequential CAD Designs from Beginner-to-Expert Level Text Prompts
