nodes.problem: Efficiently computing exact equilibria in extensive-form games
nodes.approach: Generalized Ellipsoid Against Hope with good-enough-response oracles for saddle-point computation
nodes.primary_topic: Learning Theory & Optimization › Game Theory & Mechanism Design
nodes.niche_reason: Exact equilibrium computation in sequential games is rare

nodes.title: Non-asymptotic Global Convergence Analysis of BFGS with the Armijo-Wolfe Line Search
nodes.tldr: Gives the first explicit non-asymptotic global convergence rates for BFGS with Armijo-Wolfe line search, including linear and superlinear bounds.
nodes.problem: Global convergence guarantees for BFGS with inexact line search were missing.
nodes.approach: Non-asymptotic analysis under Armijo-Wolfe line search conditions and a step-size selection mechanism.
nodes.niche_reason: Classical quasi-Newton convergence theory is established but specialised.

nodes.title: HEST-1k: A Dataset For Spatial Transcriptomics and Histology Image Analysis
nodes.tldr: HEST-1k is a dataset of 1,229 spatial transcriptomic profiles paired with H&E whole-slide images, plus a Python library and benchmark for pathology foundation models.
nodes.problem: Spatial transcriptomics datasets are small and narrow, limiting computational methods and morphology-expression studies.
nodes.approach: Assemble 153 cohorts with WSI pairing and processing into expression-morphology pairs, plus a Python library.
nodes.niche_reason: Spatial transcriptomics paired with histology is a specialised biomedical niche.

nodes.title: Validating Climate Models with Spherical Convolutional Wasserstein Distance
nodes.tldr: Introduces a spherical convolutional Wasserstein distance to compare global climate model outputs with reanalysis data, applied to CMIP5 and CMIP6 models.
nodes.problem: Standard metrics miss local distribution differences when validating climate models.
nodes.approach: Convolutional projections on the sphere quantify local differences in climate variable distributions.
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Optimal Transport & Divergences
nodes.niche_reason: Optimal-transport climate model validation is an unusual cross-disciplinary angle

nodes.title: DuQuant: Distributing Outliers via Dual Transformation Makes Stronger Quantized LLMs
nodes.tldr: Post-training quantization for LLMs using block-wise rotation and zigzag permutation to distribute massive and normal activation outliers, enabling strong 4-bit weight-activation quantization.
nodes.problem: Massive activation outliers degrade low-bit quantization of large language models.
nodes.approach: Outlier-guided rotation matrices and zigzag permutation balancing outliers across blocks, followed by another rotation.
nodes.primary_topic: Architectures & Training › Efficient Training, Compression & Pruning
secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › Efficient LLM Inference & Architectures
nodes.niche_reason: LLM quantization variants are very crowded.

nodes.title: The FineWeb Datasets: Decanting the Web for the Finest Text Data at Scale
nodes.tldr: Releases FineWeb, a 15-trillion-token Common Crawl dataset, and FineWeb-Edu, documenting deduplication and filtering ablations that yield stronger open pretraining data and models.
nodes.problem: Open LLM pretraining datasets and curation recipes are undisclosed, hindering understanding of quality data.
nodes.approach: Curate 96 Common Crawl snapshots with ablated filtering and deduplication choices; release data and code.
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › Pretraining, Scaling & Data
secondary_topics: Data, Benchmarks & Evaluation › Synthetic Data & Data Curation
nodes.niche_reason: LLM pretraining data curation is a common and heavily studied topic.

nodes.title: DiffSF: Diffusion Models for Scene Flow Estimation
nodes.tldr: Applies conditional denoising diffusion to scene flow estimation between two point clouds, achieving state of the art and uncertainty from multiple samples.
nodes.problem: Scene flow estimators lack reliability measures, which autonomous systems need.
nodes.approach: Transformer-based scene flow estimator inside a denoising diffusion process; sampling multiple hypotheses for uncertainty.

nodes.niche_reason: Skinned-mesh retargeting is specialised but established.

nodes.title: Optimal deep learning of holomorphic operators between Banach spaces
nodes.tldr: Shows deep networks with approximate encoders and decoders learn holomorphic Banach-space operators at provably optimal generalization rates.
nodes.problem: Operator learning between Banach spaces, beyond the Hilbert-space setting, lacks optimal generalization guarantees.
nodes.approach: Constant-width-exceeds-depth DNNs trained with l2 loss, with matching lower bounds and PDE experiments.
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Generalization & Statistical Learning
nodes.niche_reason: Banach-space operator learning is rare versus Hilbert-space work

nodes.title: ERBench: An Entity-Relationship based Automatically Verifiable Hallucination Benchmark for Large Language Models
nodes.tldr: ERBench converts relational databases into LLM hallucination benchmarks, using functional dependencies and foreign keys to build verifiable, multi-hop questions and check rationales.
nodes.problem: Existing LLM benchmarks cannot automatically verify answers and reasoning with arbitrary complexity.
nodes.approach: Use database integrity constraints to generate complex questions and verify answers and rationales.
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › LLM Evaluation & Benchmarks
secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › Knowledge Editing & Factuality
nodes.niche_reason: Database-grounded benchmark construction is a less common angle.

nodes.title: Learning Segmentation from Point Trajectories
nodes.tldr: Trains a segmentation network without labels by grouping long-term point trajectories into low-rank subspaces, complementing optical flow with long-range motion cues.
nodes.problem: Unsupervised motion segmentation relies on instantaneous optical flow, ignoring long-term object motion.
nodes.approach: Subspace-clustering loss expressing each track as a linear combination of other tracks.
nodes.niche_reason: motion segmentation from long-term trajectories is specialised

nodes.title: Humor in AI: Massive Scale Crowd-Sourced Preferences and Benchmarks for Cartoon Captioning
nodes.tldr: Releases a 250-million-vote New Yorker cartoon caption preference dataset with benchmarks showing RLHF and DPO struggle and top models trail human contestants.
nodes.problem: Lack of large preference data and benchmarks for evaluating humor in captions
nodes.approach: Crowd-sourced preference votes on captions with GPT-4 and human ranking-based evaluation
secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › Alignment & Preference Optimization
nodes.niche_reason: Humor preference data for creative captioning is rare

nodes.title: Probabilistic Weather Forecasting with Hierarchical Graph Neural Networks
nodes.tldr: Graph-EFM is a probabilistic weather forecaster that pairs a latent-variable model with a hierarchical graph network for fast, spatially coherent large ensembles.
nodes.problem: Deterministic weather models miss forecast uncertainty in a chaotic system.
nodes.approach: Latent-variable graph forecasting on a hierarchical graph, one forward pass per step.
nodes.niche_reason: Probabilistic graph-based weather forecasting is specialised.

nodes.title: Parsimony or Capability? Decomposition Delivers Both in Long-term Time Series Forecasting
nodes.tldr: Shows decomposition curbs parameter inflation in long-term time series forecasting, with a theoretically motivated lightweight decomposition model that outperforms larger ones.
nodes.problem: Long-term forecasting models become huge as input sequences lengthen.
nodes.approach: Tailor series decomposition to intrinsic dynamics for a compact, robust forecasting model.
nodes.primary_topic: Architectures & Training › Time Series & Sequential Data
nodes.niche_reason: Long-term forecasting model papers are common.

nodes.title: An Analysis of Tokenization: Transformers under Markov Data
nodes.tldr: Analyzes why tokenization helps: transformers fail on k-th order Markov data without it but near-optimally model it with tokenization, even with unigram token models.
nodes.problem: Why tokenization is necessary for transformers to model sequences, studied on simple Markov data sources.
nodes.approach: Analyze cross-entropy loss of transformers with and without tokenization on k-th order Markov processes, proving near-optimality with tokenization.
nodes.primary_topic: Learning Theory & Optimization › Deep Learning Theory
secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › Pretraining, Scaling & Data
nodes.niche_reason: Theoretical study of tokenization on Markov sources is rare.

nodes.title: LLMCBench: Benchmarking Large Language Model Compression for Efficient Deployment
nodes.tldr: LLMCBench is a benchmark evaluating LLM compression algorithms across many models, datasets, tracks and metrics to guide choosing methods for specific deployment needs.
nodes.problem: LLM compression methods are validated on limited settings, making it unclear which to use in practice.
nodes.approach: Design evaluation tracks and metrics from production requirements, then run extensive comparisons of compression algorithms.
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › Efficient LLM Inference & Architectures
nodes.niche_reason: LLM compression is common, though a dedicated benchmark is somewhat less so.

nodes.title: Human Expertise in Algorithmic Prediction
nodes.tldr: Uses human expert judgment only on inputs algorithms cannot distinguish, provably improving predictors; in X-ray classification about 30% of patients benefit.
nodes.problem: How to principled incorporate human expertise and side information into algorithmic predictions.
nodes.approach: Algorithmic indistinguishability via multicalibration identifies instances where human judgment selectively improves predictions.
nodes.niche_reason: Unusual human-AI complementarity framing built on multicalibration theory.

nodes.title: MeshFormer : High-Quality Mesh Generation with 3D-Guided Reconstruction Model
nodes.tldr: MeshFormer reconstructs high-quality textured meshes from sparse views using 3D sparse voxels, normal-map guidance, and SDF supervision, usable with 2D diffusion for image-to-3D.
nodes.problem: Open-world 3D reconstruction is costly to train and struggles to extract high-quality meshes without 3D inductive bias.
nodes.approach: Sparse-voxel transformer with 3D convolutions, predicted normal maps as input guidance, and SDF plus surface rendering supervision.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.confidence_reason: Reconstruction and 3D generation framing overlap; judgment call.
nodes.niche_reason: Feed-forward sparse-view 3D reconstruction is a common direction.

nodes.title: Benchmarking Uncertainty Disentanglement: Specialized Uncertainties for Specialized Tasks
nodes.tldr: Benchmarks uncertainty disentanglement on ImageNet across abstention, OOD detection and aleatoric tasks, finding no existing approach yields disentangled estimator pairs.
nodes.problem: Uncertainty tasks such as abstention, OOD detection and aleatoric estimation need separate, disentangled estimators.
nodes.approach: Reimplements Bayesian, evidential and deterministic estimators and evaluates them across uncertainty tasks on ImageNet.
nodes.niche_reason: Uncertainty disentanglement is a specialised but active benchmark niche.

nodes.title: Dynamic 3D Gaussian Fields for Urban Areas
nodes.tldr: Scalable dynamic urban scene model: 3D Gaussians for geometry, neural fields for appearance, and a scene graph for dynamics, enabling fast rendering.
nodes.problem: Novel-view synthesis for large dynamic urban scenes with varying weather and lighting does not scale or render fast.
nodes.approach: Gaussian scaffold for geometry, neural fields for appearance, scene-graph global dynamics and local deformations for articulated motion.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: Gaussian-splatting scene reconstruction is a very active area.

nodes.title: Co-occurrence is not Factual Association in Language Models
nodes.tldr: Finds LMs learn co-occurrence rather than factual associations during finetuning, and proposes implicit-association training and forgetting to improve generalization to multi-hop reasoning.
nodes.problem: Language models struggle to learn new facts from limited text in ways usable for reasoning.
nodes.approach: Layer-wise analysis of knowledge encoding plus implicit-association training and active forgetting.
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › Knowledge Editing & Factuality
secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › Language Model Interpretability
nodes.niche_reason: Knowledge-learning analysis is specialised but established.

nodes.title: LLM-ESR: Large Language Models Enhancement for Long-tailed Sequential Recommendation
nodes.tldr: Uses LLM semantic embeddings with collaborative signals to address long-tail items, and retrieval-augmented self-distillation from similar users for long-tail users in sequential recommendation.
nodes.problem: Sequential recommenders fail on long-tail users and items with scarce interactions.
nodes.approach: Dual-view LLM-semantic and collaborative modeling plus retrieval-augmented self-distillation.
nodes.confidence_reason: Recommender systems have no vocabulary area; best-fit chosen
nodes.niche_reason: LLM-enhanced recommendation is specialised but not rare

nodes.title: Data curation via joint example selection further accelerates multimodal learning
nodes.tldr: JEST selects data batches jointly rather than per example using multimodal contrastive learnability, cutting pretraining iterations up to 13x.
nodes.problem: Independent per-example data selection misses dependencies, slowing multimodal pretraining.
nodes.approach: Joint batch learnability scoring over super-batches with model approximation and pretrained reference models.
nodes.primary_topic: Data, Benchmarks & Evaluation › Synthetic Data & Data Curation
nodes.niche_reason: Data curation for pretraining is a crowded direction.

nodes.title: On the Use of Anchoring for Training Vision Models
nodes.tldr: Systematically studies anchored training for vision models, identifies a shortcut-learning failure mode, and adds a simple regulariser that improves generalisation and safety.
nodes.problem: Anchored training can learn undesirable shortcuts, limiting generalisation of vision models.
nodes.approach: Anchored training protocol with a simple regulariser that mitigates shortcut learning.
secondary_topics: Architectures & Training › Domain Adaptation & OOD Generalization
nodes.confidence_reason: Anchoring spans uncertainty and OOD generalisation; primary topic is a judgment call.
nodes.niche_reason: Anchoring is a recent, niche training principle with few followers.

nodes.title: MMLU-Pro: A More Robust and Challenging Multi-Task Language Understanding Benchmark
nodes.tldr: Harder, reasoning-focused MMLU successor with ten answer options and reduced prompt sensitivity, where chain-of-thought now helps.
nodes.problem: MMLU scores have plateaued and are sensitive to prompt style, so they discriminate poorly.
nodes.approach: Adds reasoning-heavy questions, expands choices to ten, and removes noisy items from MMLU.
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › LLM Evaluation & Benchmarks
nodes.niche_reason: Mainstream LLM benchmark revision; very crowded area.

nodes.title: Learning diffusion at lightspeed
nodes.tldr: Learns the potential, interaction, and internal energy terms of diffusion dynamics from observational data with a simple quadratic loss, based on the JKO scheme.
nodes.problem: Existing methods for learning diffusion terms need complex bilevel optimization and model only drift.
nodes.approach: Quadratic loss on JKO energy functionals with closed-form solutions for linear parametrizations.
nodes.primary_topic: Learning Theory & Optimization › Optimal Transport & Divergences
nodes.confidence_reason: Judgment call between optimal transport and scientific dynamics learning.
nodes.niche_reason: Learning energy-based diffusion via JKO is a rare, unusual direction.

nodes.title: Text-DiFuse: An Interactive Multi-Modal Image Fusion Framework based on Text-modulated Diffusion Model
nodes.tldr: Fuses multi-modal images with a text-modulated diffusion model that removes compound degradations and lets user text highlight foreground objects in the fused output.
nodes.problem: Image fusion methods leave noise, colour bias and exposure errors, and weaken foreground salience.
nodes.approach: Embeds feature-level fusion inside the diffusion process, plus text-controlled re-modulation with zero-shot location.
nodes.niche_reason: Text-controlled diffusion fusion is a specialised intersection of fusion and generation.

nodes.title: On the Effects of Data Scale on UI Control Agents
nodes.tldr: Shows fine-tuning LLM UI agents on a new 15k-demo Android dataset scales in-domain but generalizes poorly out of domain.
nodes.problem: Whether fine-tuning on human demonstrations alone can yield robust real-world UI control agents is unclear.
nodes.approach: Collects AndroidControl demonstrations and measures how performance scales with data, in and out of domain.
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › Agents & Tool Use
nodes.niche_reason: Data-scaling studies for UI agents are an emerging but specialised area.

nodes.title: GTSinger: A Global Multi-Technique Singing Corpus with Realistic Music Scores for All Singing Tasks
nodes.tldr: Large multilingual singing corpus with technique and phoneme-level annotations, realistic music scores, and benchmarks for singing synthesis and recognition tasks.
nodes.problem: Existing singing datasets are low quality, small, and lack technique labels and realistic scores.
nodes.approach: Curated multi-technique singing corpus with alignments, style labels, and four benchmark experiments.
secondary_topics: Generative Models › Audio, Speech & Music Generation
nodes.niche_reason: Singing synthesis is specialised but established.

nodes.title: Scene Graph Disentanglement and Composition for Generalizable Complex Image Generation
nodes.tldr: Generates complex multi-object images from scene graphs by combining a layout-semantics VAE with diffusion using compositional masked attention, plus a sampler for isolated edits.
nodes.problem: Faithfully generating complex scenes with multiple objects and relationships from scene graph conditions.
nodes.approach: SL-VAE derives layouts and semantics; compositional masked attention guides diffusion; multi-layered sampler enables graph editing.
nodes.niche_reason: Scene-graph-conditioned generation is established but specialised.

nodes.title: Logarithmic Smoothing for Pessimistic Off-Policy Evaluation, Selection and Learning
nodes.tldr: Introduces logarithmic smoothing of importance weights for pessimistic off-policy evaluation, selection and learning in contextual bandits, with provably tighter empirical bounds.
nodes.problem: Reliable off-policy evaluation, selection and learning from logged bandit data.
nodes.approach: Fully empirical concentration bounds yielding a logarithmically smoothed importance-weight estimator.
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Generalization & Statistical Learning
nodes.niche_reason: Off-policy bandit theory is established but specialised.

nodes.title: ResAD: A Simple Framework for Class Generalizable Anomaly Detection
nodes.tldr: ResAD trains one anomaly detector that generalizes to new classes without retraining by modeling residual features relative to reference normal features, reducing class-specific variation.
nodes.problem: One-for-one anomaly detectors generalize poorly to unseen classes from different domains.
nodes.approach: Learn residual feature distributions so normal residuals stay similar across classes, enabling a unified class-generalizable detector.
secondary_topics: Architectures & Training › Domain Adaptation & OOD Generalization
nodes.niche_reason: Anomaly detection is established but specialised; class-generalizable setting is less common.

nodes.title: Exploring Context Window of Large Language Models via Decomposed Positional Vectors
nodes.tldr: Decomposes LLM hidden states into positional vectors to explain length extrapolation, then proposes two training-free context-window extension methods.
nodes.problem: LLMs degrade beyond their context window, and extension methods lack mechanistic explanation.
nodes.approach: Mean-based decomposition of hidden states; positional vector replacement and attention window extension.
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › Language Model Interpretability
secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › Long Context & Memory
nodes.niche_reason: Mechanistic positional-vector analysis is specialised

nodes.title: Enhancing Robustness of Graph Neural Networks on Social Media with Explainable Inverse Reinforcement Learning
nodes.tldr: Reconstructs graph attack policies with mixture-of-experts inverse RL, then generates extra adversarial samples to make GNN rumor detectors more robust.
nodes.problem: GNN rumor detectors are vulnerable to structural graph perturbations from diverse attackers.
nodes.approach: Maximum-entropy inverse RL with mixture-of-experts and bidirectional policy updates on social graphs.
secondary_topics: Reinforcement Learning › Reward Learning, Inverse RL & Preferences
nodes.niche_reason: Inverse RL for graph attacks is an unusual combination.

nodes.title: DevBench: A multimodal developmental benchmark for language learning
nodes.tldr: A multimodal benchmark of seven language tasks comparing vision-language models with children and adults on behavioral response patterns.
nodes.problem: Models are evaluated on adult benchmarks, not compared to how children learn language.
nodes.approach: Human-comparable language tasks scored by response-pattern similarity to child and adult data.
nodes.niche_reason: Comparing VLM response patterns with child language data is an unusual angle.

nodes.title: Procedure-Aware Surgical Video-language Pretraining with Hierarchical Knowledge Augmentation
nodes.tldr: PeskaVLP is surgical video-language pretraining using LLM-refined surgical knowledge and a dynamic-time-warping loss, improving zero-shot surgical scene understanding.
nodes.problem: Surgical video-language pretraining suffers from lost lecture text and spatial-temporal misalignment.
nodes.approach: Hierarchical LLM knowledge augmentation plus hard negatives, visual self-supervision and DTW alignment.
nodes.niche_reason: surgical video-language pretraining is specialised

nodes.title: How Well Can Differential Privacy Be Audited in One Run?
nodes.tldr: Characterizes the maximum achievable efficacy of one-run privacy auditing, identifying interference between data elements as the key barrier.
nodes.problem: One-run privacy auditing may not reveal the true differential privacy parameter precisely.
nodes.approach: Theoretical characterization of efficacy limits plus conceptual approaches to reduce interference.
secondary_topics: Trustworthy ML › Machine Unlearning & Privacy Attacks
nodes.niche_reason: Specialised auditing theory with few direct parallels.

nodes.title: Theory-Driven Label-Specific Representation for Incomplete Multi-View Multi-Label Learning
nodes.tldr: TDLSR handles incomplete multi-view multi-label data via proximity-aware imputation, disentangled label-specific representations guided by information principles, with generalization analysis.
nodes.problem: Multi-view multi-label learning suffers from missing views and missing labels simultaneously.
nodes.approach: Graph-based imputation, information shift/interaction/orthogonality disentanglement, and label-semantic-guided feature learning.
nodes.niche_reason: Incomplete multi-view multi-label learning is a narrow niche.

nodes.title: SmallKV: Small Model Assisted Compensation of KV Cache Compression for Efficient LLM Inference
nodes.tldr: SmallKV uses a small model's attention to compensate for information lost in KV cache eviction, addressing saliency shift and marginal-token over-compression.
nodes.problem: Irreversible token-level KV cache eviction misses saliency shifts and over-compresses marginally important tokens.
nodes.approach: A small LLM's attention matrices guide compensation for evicted important and marginal tokens in the large model.
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › Efficient LLM Inference & Architectures
secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › Long Context & Memory
nodes.niche_reason: KV cache compression is a crowded topic.

nodes.title: Quantum Doubly Stochastic Transformers
nodes.tldr: QDSFormer replaces softmax attention with a variational quantum circuit producing doubly stochastic matrices, improving small-scale ViT accuracy and training stability.
nodes.problem: Softmax attention can destabilize training; Sinkhorn doubly stochastic attention is iterative and inflexible.
nodes.approach: Hybrid quantum-classical transformer using a variational circuit to output doubly stochastic attention matrices.
nodes.confidence_reason: Quantum ML plus attention; topic placement between transformers and quantum is a judgment.
nodes.niche_reason: Quantum circuits inside attention layers are very rare.

nodes.title: On the Hardness of Approximating Distributions with Tractable Probabilistic Models
nodes.tldr: Shows approximating an arbitrary distribution with probabilistic circuits under bounded f-divergence is NP-hard, and proves an exponential size gap between PC classes.
nodes.problem: Exact tractable representations can blow up exponentially; whether approximation avoids this is unknown.
nodes.approach: Analyzes approximation guarantees under f-divergences, checking which inference queries stay well-approximated.
nodes.primary_topic: Learning Theory & Optimization › Learning Theory Lower Bounds & Complexity
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Probabilistic & Bayesian Methods
nodes.niche_reason: Rare: hardness of approximating distributions with probabilistic circuits.

nodes.title: DERD-Net: Learning Depth from Event-based Ray Densities
nodes.tldr: DERD-Net estimates depth from event cameras using disparity space images of ray densities, processed by 3D convolutions and recurrence for monocular and stereo setups.
nodes.problem: Standard deep networks handle asynchronous event data poorly for multi-view stereo depth estimation.
nodes.approach: Back-project events into disparity space images, then 3D convolutions plus recurrent structure predict per-pixel depth.
nodes.niche_reason: Event-based vision is a rare sensing modality in the ML mainstream.

nodes.title: RidgeLoRA: Matrix Ridge Enhanced Low-Rank Adaptation of Large Language Models
nodes.tldr: Enhances LoRA with a ridge-enhanced full-rank approximation that improves representation capacity at similar parameter cost, with a proof of better bounds.
nodes.problem: Low-rank LoRA updates limit representational capacity and underperform full-rank fine-tuning.
nodes.approach: Lightweight architecture with matrix ridge enhanced full-rank approximation.
nodes.niche_reason: Yet another LoRA variant; a very crowded mainstream direction

nodes.title: Refinement Methods for Distributed Distribution Estimation under $\ell^p$-Losses
nodes.tldr: Minimax-optimal rates for communication-constrained estimation of discrete distributions under lp losses, using refinement methods, and identifying an elbow effect at p=2.
nodes.problem: Optimal rates for distributed distribution estimation under bit constraints across parameter regimes.
nodes.approach: Coarse-to-fine refinement protocols with compression, thresholding, and random hashing, plus matching lower bounds.
nodes.primary_topic: Learning Theory & Optimization › Learning Theory Lower Bounds & Complexity
nodes.confidence_reason: Minimax-rate theory of communication-limited estimation; topic is a close call.
nodes.niche_reason: Communication-constrained minimax estimation is a rare theory niche.

nodes.title: Bigram Subnetworks: Mapping to Next Tokens in Transformer Language Models
nodes.tldr: Finds tiny subnetworks, mostly in the first MLP layer, that implement bigram next-token predictions in language models up to 1B parameters.
nodes.problem: Isolating a minimal circuit that maps current-token activations to next-token predictions in Transformers.
nodes.approach: Find subnetworks via pruning-style optimization that make bigram predictions; analyze overlap and first-layer mechanism.
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › Language Model Interpretability
nodes.niche_reason: Mechanistic interpretability is established but minimal-circuit angle is specialised.

nodes.title: OpenHOI: Open-World Hand-Object Interaction Synthesis with Multimodal Large Language Model
nodes.tldr: OpenHOI synthesizes open-world 3D hand-object interactions from language, using a 3D MLLM for affordance grounding and task decomposition plus affordance-driven diffusion with physics refinement.
nodes.problem: Existing hand-object interaction synthesis fails on unseen objects and open-vocabulary instructions.
nodes.approach: 3D MLLM for affordance grounding and decomposition, affordance-driven diffusion, training-free physics refinement.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › Human Pose, Avatars & Faces
nodes.niche_reason: Rare open-world hand-object interaction synthesis from language.

nodes.title: RGB-Only Supervised Camera Parameter Optimization in Dynamic Scenes
nodes.tldr: ROS-Cam estimates camera parameters in dynamic scenes from a single RGB video using patch tracking filters and outlier-aware optimization, without motion masks or depth priors.
nodes.problem: Accurate, fast camera parameter estimation in dynamic scenes without GT masks, depth, or poses.
nodes.approach: Patch tracking filters, outlier-aware joint optimization, and a two-stage optimization strategy.
secondary_topics: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: Dynamic-scene SfM is established but specialised.

nodes.title: Reinforcement Learning for Out-of-Distribution Reasoning in LLMs: An Empirical Study on Diagnosis-Related Group Coding
nodes.tldr: Applies GRPO reinforcement learning with rule-based rewards to DRG medical coding, and finds RL gains depend on prior SFT knowledge infusion.
nodes.problem: LLMs lack the private clinical billing knowledge needed for out-of-distribution DRG coding.
nodes.approach: Qwen2.5-7B trained with GRPO and rule-based rewards, plus RL enhancements for knowledge-intensive tasks.
secondary_topics: Reinforcement Learning › RL for LLMs & Reasoning
Language Models & NLP › Pretraining, Scaling & Data
nodes.confidence_reason: Clinical application with an RL-for-LLM method; healthcare vs RL topic is close.
nodes.niche_reason: Clinical billing-code RL is a rare, knowledge-intensive domain.

nodes.title: Position: Bridge the Gaps between Machine Unlearning and AI Regulation
nodes.tldr: Position paper arguing machine unlearning could help EU AI Act compliance, cataloguing applications and the technical gaps that must be closed first.
nodes.problem: Whether machine unlearning research can practically support emerging AI regulation like the EU AI Act.
nodes.approach: Maps AIA compliance use cases for unlearning and flags technical gaps with the state of the art.
nodes.primary_topic: Trustworthy ML › Machine Unlearning & Privacy Attacks
nodes.niche_reason: Unlearning for AI regulation compliance is an emerging policy-facing niche.

nodes.title: A Principled Approach to Randomized Selection under Uncertainty: Applications to Peer Review and Grant Funding
nodes.tldr: MERIT is a randomized top-k selection rule that maximizes worst-case expected top candidates under overlapping quality intervals, with a polynomial-time algorithm.
nodes.problem: Randomized selection for peer review and grants is ad hoc and misaligned with its objectives under uncertainty.
nodes.approach: Maximin randomized allocation over interval estimates of item quality, solved in polynomial time.
nodes.primary_topic: Learning Theory & Optimization › Game Theory & Mechanism Design
nodes.confidence_reason: Judgment between mechanism design and robust optimization for selection.
nodes.niche_reason: Randomized peer-review selection under interval uncertainty is rare.

nodes.title: CALM-PDE: Continuous and Adaptive Convolutions for Latent Space Modeling of Time-dependent PDEs
nodes.tldr: CALM-PDE solves time-dependent PDEs in a compressed latent space using continuous convolutions with adaptive query points, handling irregular meshes with less memory than transformers.
nodes.problem: Latent neural PDE surrogates for irregular domains rely on memory-heavy attention; CNNs need regular grids.
nodes.approach: Continuous-convolution encoder-decoder with epsilon-neighborhood kernel and learned adaptive query points.
nodes.niche_reason: Neural PDE surrogates are established but specialised.

nodes.title: Reconstruction and Secrecy under Approximate Distance Queries
nodes.tldr: Characterizes optimal error for locating a hidden point from noisy distance queries via the Chebyshev radius, and studies asymptotic reconstruction rates in metric spaces.
nodes.problem: Rate and limits of reconstructing a target from approximate distance queries, relevant to privacy.
nodes.approach: Learning-theoretic geometric analysis of optimal error using Chebyshev radius and pseudo-finite spaces.
nodes.primary_topic: Learning Theory & Optimization › Learning Theory Lower Bounds & Complexity
nodes.niche_reason: Pure geometric learning theory on distance-query reconstruction is very rare.

nodes.title: Fully Autonomous Neuromorphic Navigation and Dynamic Obstacle Avoidance
nodes.tldr: A fully neuromorphic, event-camera-based UAV pipeline for dynamic obstacle avoidance with 2.3 ms latency, with a new event-based pose correction dataset, validated on a quadrotor.
nodes.problem: Onboard UAV navigation and dynamic obstacle avoidance under tight latency and energy limits.
nodes.approach: Bio-inspired end-to-end spiking pipeline on event streams detecting and avoiding moving objects without recognition or trajectory computation.
nodes.niche_reason: Fully neuromorphic onboard UAV avoidance with event cameras is very rare.

nodes.title: How do Transformers Learn Implicit Reasoning?
nodes.tldr: Trains transformers from scratch on symbolic multi-hop tasks, revealing a three-stage trajectory of implicit reasoning and diagnosing it with cross-query patching and cosine clustering.
nodes.problem: The mechanisms by which transformers learn implicit multi-hop reasoning are poorly understood.
nodes.approach: Controlled symbolic training, cross-query semantic patching, and a cosine-based representational analysis.
secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › Language Model Interpretability
nodes.niche_reason: Mechanistic study of implicit reasoning is established but specialised.

nodes.title: Why Do Some Language Models Fake Alignment While Others Don't?
nodes.tldr: Tests 25 LLMs for alignment faking; only 5 comply more in training than deployment, and analyzes their motivations and why post-training changes this.
nodes.problem: Which language models fake alignment, and why most others do not.
nodes.approach: Behavioral experiments across 25 models with scenario perturbations and post-training ablations.
nodes.primary_topic: Trustworthy ML › AI Safety & Alignment Research
secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › LLM Evaluation & Benchmarks
nodes.niche_reason: Empirical study of alignment faking is a rare, new direction.

nodes.title: Real-Time Hyper-Personalized Generative AI Should Be Regulated to Prevent the Rise of "Digital Heroin"
nodes.tldr: Position paper arguing real-time hyper-personalized generative AI could become addictive, and calling for government oversight, especially for minors.
nodes.problem: Real-time personalized generative content may drive compulsive use and harm mental health, especially for minors.
nodes.approach: Draws on clinical, neuroscientific, and policy research to argue for regulation and design guidelines.
nodes.niche_reason: Position paper on regulating addictive generative AI is unusual.

nodes.title: MAESTRO : Adaptive Sparse Attention and Robust Learning for Multimodal Dynamic Time Series
nodes.tldr: MAESTRO fuses many sensor modalities with task-relevant sparse cross-modal attention and a sparse mixture-of-experts, robust to missing modalities in time series.
nodes.problem: Multimodal time-series methods assume a primary modality and complete observations, which real sensors violate.
nodes.approach: Symbolic tokenization, adaptive attention budgeting, sparse cross-modal attention, and MoE routing.
nodes.primary_topic: Architectures & Training › Time Series & Sequential Data
secondary_topics: Architectures & Training › Mixture of Experts & Sparsity
nodes.niche_reason: Heterogeneous sensor time-series fusion is established but specialised

nodes.title: PatientSim: A Persona-Driven Simulator for Realistic Doctor-Patient Interactions
nodes.tldr: PatientSim is an open-source LLM patient simulator with clinically grounded personas across four axes, for training and evaluating doctor LLMs.
nodes.problem: Doctor LLMs need realistic, diverse patient interactions, but existing simulators miss the range of clinical personas.
nodes.approach: Builds profiles from MIMIC-ED and MIMIC-IV, with personas defined by personality, language, recall and confusion.
secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › LLM Evaluation & Benchmarks
nodes.niche_reason: Persona-driven clinical patient simulation is an unusual application angle

nodes.title: Gated Attention for Large Language Models: Non-linearity, Sparsity, and Attention-Sink-Free
nodes.tldr: Shows a head-specific sigmoid gate after scaled dot-product attention consistently improves LLM training, stability, and long-context extrapolation by curbing attention sinks.
nodes.problem: The effects of gating in softmax attention are rarely studied, despite gating's wide use elsewhere.
nodes.approach: Systematic comparison of 30 gated softmax attention variants across MoE and dense models trained on 3.5T tokens.
secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › Efficient LLM Inference & Architectures
nodes.niche_reason: Gating variants of attention are a common LLM architecture topic

nodes.title: UniRelight: Learning Joint Decomposition and Synthesis for Video Relighting
nodes.tldr: UniRelight jointly estimates albedo and synthesizes relit video in one pass with a video diffusion model, beating two-stage pipelines in generalization and consistency.
nodes.problem: Relighting suffers from scarce paired data in end-to-end models and error accumulation in two-stage pipelines.
nodes.approach: Single video diffusion model jointly predicting albedo and relit output, trained on synthetic and auto-labeled real videos.
nodes.niche_reason: Relighting with video diffusion is a specialised graphics-vision niche.

nodes.title: Provable Gradient Editing of Deep Neural Networks
nodes.tldr: ProGrad edits a DNN's parameters to provably enforce hard linear constraints on its input gradients while minimally changing weights, via a relaxed conditional variable gradient.
nodes.problem: Provable DNN editing handles input-output constraints but not hard constraints on gradients.
nodes.approach: Conditional variable gradient relaxation of NP-hard gradient constraints, solved to minimally modify parameters.
nodes.confidence_reason: Topic is between network editing/verification and interpretability; no exact vocabulary fit.
nodes.niche_reason: Provable gradient-constraint editing of DNNs is very rare.

nodes.title: FlexOLMo: Open Language Models for Flexible Data Use
nodes.tldr: Trains independent mixture-of-experts modules on private datasets and combines them via nonparametric routing, letting data owners opt out at inference without retraining.
nodes.problem: Language models cannot use restricted datasets without sharing data or joint training across owners.
nodes.approach: Each expert trained independently on private data, integrated by new nonparametric routing with no joint training.
nodes.primary_topic: Architectures & Training › Mixture of Experts & Sparsity
nodes.niche_reason: Distributed MoE with private data routing is specialized.

nodes.title: Fixing It in Post: A Comparative Study of LLM Post-Training Data Quality and Model Performance
nodes.tldr: Compares two open post-training datasets, Tulu-3-SFT-Mix and SmolTalk, with Magpie annotations and builds TuluTalk, a smaller curated mixture matching or beating both.
nodes.problem: Unclear how samples, task types, and curation affect downstream LLM post-training performance.
nodes.approach: Annotate samples with quality metrics, compare datasets, and design a principled curation recipe producing TuluTalk.
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › Pretraining, Scaling & Data
secondary_topics: Data, Benchmarks & Evaluation › Synthetic Data & Data Curation
nodes.niche_reason: LLM post-training data curation is a mainstream topic.

nodes.title: Forecasting in Offline Reinforcement Learning for Non-stationary Environments
nodes.tldr: Offline RL framework for non-stationary environments that forecasts time-varying offsets by combining diffusion-based state candidates with zero-shot time-series foundation models.
nodes.problem: Offline RL policies fail when abrupt, unforeseen offsets make states partially observable.
nodes.approach: Conditional diffusion state generation plus zero-shot time-series forecasting, integrated with agent experience.
secondary_topics: Architectures & Training › Time Series & Sequential Data
nodes.niche_reason: Specialised non-stationary offline RL

nodes.title: OPTFM: A Scalable Multi-View Graph Transformer for Hierarchical Pre-Training in Combinatorial Optimization
nodes.tldr: OPTFM is a graph foundation model for combinatorial optimization, pretrained on multi-view graphs with a scalable transformer, whose embeddings beat task-specific approaches without fine-tuning.
nodes.problem: Combinatorial optimization lacks a general graph foundation model across diverse, large heterogeneous problem graphs.
nodes.approach: Multi-view graph transformer with hybrid self-attention and dual-level graph reconstruction and contrastive pretraining.
nodes.confidence_reason: Graph foundation model for optimization; could fit GNN or combinatorial optimization
nodes.niche_reason: Graph foundation model for general combinatorial optimization is rare

nodes.title: EGGS: Exchangeable 2D/3D Gaussian Splatting for Geometry-Appearance Balanced Novel View Synthesis
nodes.tldr: EGGS hybridizes 2D and 3D Gaussians with unified rasterization, adaptive type exchange and frequency-decoupled optimization to balance geometry and appearance in novel view synthesis.
nodes.problem: 3DGS has multi-view inconsistent geometry while 2DGS loses texture detail in novel view synthesis.
nodes.approach: Hybrid 2D/3D Gaussian rasterization with adaptive type exchange and frequency-decoupled optimization.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: Gaussian splatting variants are very common.

nodes.title: EuroSpeech: A Multilingual Speech Corpus
nodes.tldr: EuroSpeech is a multilingual speech corpus built from parliamentary recordings with a scalable alignment pipeline for non-verbatim transcripts and long-form audio.
nodes.problem: Multilingual speech datasets provide insufficient per-language data for strong ASR across languages.
nodes.approach: Pipeline for media retrieval and two-stage alignment of parliamentary audio with imperfect transcripts.
nodes.primary_topic: Audio, Speech & Multimodal › Speech Recognition & Synthesis
nodes.niche_reason: Speech corpora are established but language-specialised.

nodes.title: Scent of Knowledge: Optimizing Search-Enhanced Reasoning with Information Foraging
nodes.tldr: InForage is an RL framework that rewards intermediate retrieval quality, so LLMs learn adaptive search-and-reason behavior during inference.
nodes.problem: Static pre-inference retrieval fails on ambiguous, multi-step information needs.
nodes.approach: Information Foraging Theory inspired RL with per-step retrieval-quality rewards and a human-guided search dataset.
secondary_topics: Reinforcement Learning › RL for LLMs & Reasoning
nodes.niche_reason: RL-trained retrieval agents are a common direction

nodes.title: Detecting Generated Images by Fitting Natural Image Distributions
nodes.tldr: Flags generated images by checking whether manifold-direction transformations sharply change a self-supervised model's loss, amplified with normalizing flows.
nodes.problem: Binary classifiers for generated-image detection depend heavily on the quantity and quality of fake training data.
nodes.approach: Gradient-orthogonal function pair on natural-image manifolds, with normalizing flows pushing generated images off-manifold.
secondary_topics: Generative Models › GANs, VAEs & Normalizing Flows
nodes.confidence_reason: detection framed via manifold geometry; close to provenance
nodes.niche_reason: manifold-geometry detection of generated images is a less common angle

nodes.title: GUARD: Constructing Realistic Two-Player Matrix and Security Games for Benchmarking Game-Theoretic Algorithms
nodes.tldr: Framework that builds realistic two-player matrix and security game instances from open-access datasets, to benchmark game-theoretic algorithms beyond random games.
nodes.problem: Benchmarks rely on classical or random games, and security-game target data is inaccessible.
nodes.approach: Generates matrix and security game instances from animal movement, demographic, and infrastructure datasets with customizable utilities.
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Game Theory & Mechanism Design
nodes.niche_reason: Realistic security-game benchmarks from open data are a rare niche.

nodes.title: Characterizing the Expressivity of Fixed-Precision Transformer Language Models
nodes.tldr: Proves fixed-precision transformers with strict masking and no positional encodings equal a past-only fragment of temporal logic in expressivity, confirmed by length-generalization experiments.
nodes.problem: Exact expressive power of idealized fixed-precision transformer language models is poorly understood.
nodes.approach: Formal-language characterization linking transformers to a temporal logic fragment, automata and algebra, with empirical validation.
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Deep Learning Theory
nodes.niche_reason: Logic and automata characterizations of transformers are a rare theoretical niche.

nodes.title: Spectral Estimation with Free Decompression
nodes.tldr: Estimates the eigenspectrum of huge matrices that can only be seen through small submatrices, by extrapolating submatrix spectra with free probability.
nodes.problem: Eigenspectra of very large matrices cannot be computed when only masked submatrices are accessible
nodes.approach: Free-probability decompression of empirical spectral densities from small submatrices
nodes.primary_topic: Learning Theory & Optimization › High-dimensional & Random Matrix Theory
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Kernels, GPs & Nonparametrics
nodes.niche_reason: Rare: free-probability spectral extrapolation has few ML analogues

nodes.title: Predictable Scale (Part II) --- Farseer: A Refined Scaling Law in LLMs
nodes.tldr: Introduces a refined scaling law fitted to about 1,000 trained LLMs that extrapolates loss far better than Chinchilla for planning training.
nodes.problem: Small-scale LLM experiments often fail to predict large-scale training outcomes.
nodes.approach: Fits a refined loss surface L(N,D) over model size and data, validated with a large open model suite.
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › Pretraining, Scaling & Data
nodes.niche_reason: Scaling-law fitting is a common LLM direction

nodes.title: Environment Inference for Learning Generalizable Dynamical System
nodes.tldr: Infers environment labels for dynamical-system data from per-round prediction errors of fixed networks, enabling generalization without labels.
nodes.problem: Generalizing dynamical-system models needs environment labels that are often unavailable
nodes.approach: Alternating optimization assigning environments from prediction errors each training round
nodes.primary_topic: Architectures & Training › Domain Adaptation & OOD Generalization
secondary_topics: Architectures & Training › Time Series & Sequential Data
nodes.confidence_reason: Unlabeled environment inference; topic sits between domain adaptation and time-series.
nodes.niche_reason: Dynamical-systems generalization is specialised; label-free variant rarer

nodes.title: Whose View of Safety? A Deep DIVE Dataset for Pluralistic Alignment of Text-to-Image Models
nodes.tldr: DIVE is a multimodal dataset of intersectional demographic rater feedback on 1000 prompts for pluralistic safety alignment of text-to-image models, showing context-dependent differences in harm perception.
nodes.problem: Text-to-image models ignore diverse and conflicting human safety perspectives.
nodes.approach: Collect extensive safety ratings from demographically intersectional raters and analyze demographic effects.
secondary_topics: Trustworthy ML › AI Safety & Alignment Research
nodes.niche_reason: Pluralistic alignment for text-to-image safety is relatively rare.

nodes.title: UMoE: Unifying Attention and FFN with Shared Experts
nodes.tldr: Reformulates attention to reveal an FFN-like structure, enabling MoE layers in attention that share experts with feed-forward layers.
nodes.problem: Attention-based MoE layers need specialized implementations and underperform FFN-based MoE.
nodes.approach: Unified attention reformulation with shared experts between attention and FFN components.
nodes.primary_topic: Architectures & Training › Mixture of Experts & Sparsity
nodes.niche_reason: MoE architecture variants are a crowded mainstream area

nodes.title: Multimodal Disease Progression Modeling via Spatiotemporal Disentanglement and Multiscale Alignment
nodes.tldr: Disentangles static anatomy from dynamic pathology in sequential chest X-rays and aligns them with irregular EHR data at local and global timescales for prediction.
nodes.problem: Sequential chest X-rays are redundant and misaligned in time with irregular EHR data.
nodes.approach: Region-aware static-dynamic disentanglement plus hierarchical local and global alignment with EHR.
nodes.niche_reason: longitudinal CXR-EHR fusion is a specialised clinical niche

nodes.title: Direct Fisher Score Estimation for Likelihood Maximization
nodes.tldr: Maximizes intractable likelihoods using simulations by fitting a local linear surrogate of the Fisher score with closed-form least squares.
nodes.problem: Likelihood maximization is hard when the likelihood is intractable and the landscape is complex
nodes.approach: Local score matching on simulations near each iterate, with a linear surrogate score model giving a closed-form solution.
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Probabilistic & Bayesian Methods
nodes.confidence_reason: Likelihood-free optimization straddles optimization and simulation-based inference
nodes.niche_reason: Likelihood-free maximization via local score matching is specialised

nodes.title: AuroRA: Breaking Low-Rank Bottleneck of LoRA with Nonlinear Mapping
nodes.tldr: Adds a learnable nonlinear layer between LoRA's low-rank projectors, matching or beating full fine-tuning with 6–25% of LoRA's parameters.
nodes.problem: LoRA's low-rank bottleneck forces high ranks, and linear variants stay linear in expressiveness.
nodes.approach: Adaptive nonlinear layer between two linear projectors creates a compact MLP-like adapter.
nodes.niche_reason: LoRA variants are a crowded PEFT direction

nodes.title: Unleashing Hour-Scale Video Training for Long Video-Language Understanding
nodes.tldr: Introduces a 3.3M-QA hour-long video instruction dataset and Hour-LLaVA, a Video-LMM with memory augmentation for hour-scale training and inference.
nodes.problem: Hour-long video-language models are underexplored because well-annotated long videos are scarce
nodes.approach: Memory augmentation adaptively integrates question-relevant semantics from a cached full video context at 1 FPS.
nodes.niche_reason: Long video-LLM training is a growing but common direction

nodes.title: SpecMER: Fast Protein Generation with K-mer Guided Speculative Decoding
nodes.tldr: Accelerates autoregressive protein generation with speculative decoding whose candidates are scored against k-mer motifs from multiple sequence alignments, improving speed and plausibility.
nodes.problem: Autoregressive protein models are slow, and speculative draft models ignore biological and structural constraints.
nodes.approach: Score parallel draft candidates using k-mer motifs from MSAs to select biologically consistent sequences.
secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › Efficient LLM Inference & Architectures
nodes.niche_reason: Speculative decoding for protein generation is rare.

nodes.title: ProtInvTree: Deliberate Protein Inverse Folding with Reward-guided Tree Search
nodes.tldr: Reward-guided tree search for protein inverse folding that treats sequence design as step-wise decisions with lookahead and backtracking, yielding diverse structure-consistent sequences.
nodes.problem: Inverse folding recovers native-like sequences but ignores that many sequences fold alike.
nodes.approach: Tree search over focus-and-grounding actions with jumpy denoising for cheap state evaluation.
nodes.niche_reason: Reward-guided tree search for protein design is specialised.

nodes.title: ReCon: Region-Controllable Data Augmentation with Rectification and Alignment for Object Detection
nodes.tldr: Region-controllable diffusion augmentation that rectifies misgenerated regions using detector feedback and aligns text cues to image regions, producing better training data for object detection.
nodes.problem: Generative data augmentation for detection suffers from content-position mismatches and semantic leakage.
nodes.approach: Detector-feedback rectification inside diffusion sampling plus region-aligned cross-attention.
secondary_topics: Data, Benchmarks & Evaluation › Synthetic Data & Data Curation
nodes.confidence_reason: Generation vs. detection-data augmentation is a judgment call
nodes.niche_reason: Diffusion-based synthetic data for detection is a crowded direction

nodes.title: A machine learning approach that beats Rubik's cubes
nodes.tldr: Learns a diffusion-distance estimator with a neural network plus beam search to solve huge-graph pathfinding, achieving shortest known 4x4x4 and 5x5x5 Rubik's cube solutions.
nodes.problem: Finding short solutions on extremely large state graphs like larger Rubik's cubes.
nodes.approach: Neural diffusion distance estimation guiding beam search over Cayley graphs.
nodes.confidence_reason: Topic is a judgment call; no clean pathfinding or search area in vocabulary.
nodes.niche_reason: Neural solver for Rubik's cubes and Cayley graphs is unusual.

nodes.title: Deno-IF: Unsupervised Noisy Visible and Infrared Image Fusion Method
nodes.tldr: Unsupervised fusion of noisy visible and infrared images using convolutional low-rank priors and a joint denoising-and-fusion network, without paired clean data.
nodes.problem: Image fusion fails under noise, and noise-aware fusion methods need supervised paired data.
nodes.approach: Convolutional low-rank optimization plus a unified denoising and fusion network with low-rankness loss.
nodes.niche_reason: Image fusion is specialised but established.

nodes.title: ⁠When Data Can't Meet: Estimating Correlation Across Privacy Barriers
nodes.tldr: Derives minimax-optimal rates and estimators for correlation between variables split across two servers with different privacy budgets, comparing interactive and non-interactive mechanisms.
nodes.problem: Estimating correlation when X and Y sit on separate servers under differing privacy constraints.
nodes.approach: Minimax analysis with rate-optimal private estimators, interactive mechanisms, and confidence intervals.
nodes.niche_reason: Specialised DP statistics in a vertical-partition setting.

nodes.title: Cost-aware LLM-based Online Dataset Annotation
nodes.tldr: Labels datasets with LLMs by adaptively choosing which models to query per instance via LinUCB, balancing cost against majority-vote accuracy.
nodes.problem: Majority voting over many LLMs improves labels but multiplies querying costs for dataset annotation.
nodes.approach: Contextual-bandit selection of LLM subsets per instance with Bayesian confidence estimates and weighted voting.
nodes.primary_topic: Data, Benchmarks & Evaluation › Synthetic Data & Data Curation
nodes.confidence_reason: LLM labeling is data curation; LinUCB selection is a bandit method
nodes.niche_reason: Cost-aware LLM ensemble labeling is specialised but emerging

nodes.title: ENMA: Tokenwise Autoregression for Continuous Neural PDE Operators
nodes.tldr: A generative neural operator that predicts PDE dynamics in latent space with a masked autoregressive transformer trained by flow matching, supporting in-context one-shot surrogate modeling.
nodes.problem: Generalizing neural PDE solvers across parameters and dynamics under uncertain or incomplete data.
nodes.approach: Latent masked autoregressive transformer with flow matching loss and attention-based encoding of irregular observations.
nodes.niche_reason: Neural PDE surrogates are specialised but growing.

nodes.title: HBLLM: Wavelet-Enhanced High-Fidelity 1-Bit Quantization for LLMs
nodes.tldr: Post-training 1-bit quantization of LLMs using Haar wavelet frequency decomposition and structure-aware weight grouping for better fidelity.
nodes.problem: Preserving LLM accuracy when weights are quantized to about one bit.
nodes.approach: Haar wavelet frequency decomposition with saliency-driven column selection and grouped quantization.
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › Efficient LLM Inference & Architectures
secondary_topics: Architectures & Training › Efficient Training, Compression & Pruning
nodes.niche_reason: Post-training quantization of LLMs is a common research direction

nodes.title: SHF: Symmetrical Hierarchical Forest with Pretrained Vision Transformer Encoder for High-Resolution Medical Segmentation
nodes.tldr: SHF adaptively patches high-resolution medical images into hierarchical forests to raise token information density for pretrained ViTs, then depatches for segmentation.
nodes.problem: Applying Vision Transformers to high-resolution medical images is costly due to long token sequences.
nodes.approach: Adaptive hierarchical patching of inputs into a symmetrical forest with reverse depatching decoder.
nodes.niche_reason: Efficient ViT for high-res medical segmentation is specialised.

nodes.title: On the Value of Cross-Modal Misalignment in Multimodal Representation Learning
nodes.tldr: Theory of multimodal contrastive learning under cross-modal misalignment, showing learned representations capture only semantic variables invariant to selection and perturbation biases.
nodes.problem: Whether to mitigate or exploit image-text misalignment in multimodal contrastive learning.
nodes.approach: Latent variable model of selection and perturbation bias with identifiability analysis and empirical validation.
nodes.niche_reason: Identifiability theory for multimodal contrastive learning is specialised.

nodes.title: ErrorTrace: A Black-Box Traceability Mechanism Based on Model Family Error Space
nodes.tldr: ErrorTrace is a black-box method that traces LLM derivative models to their base family by analyzing characteristic error spaces, robust to fine-tuning, pruning and merging.
nodes.problem: Detecting unauthorized derivative LLMs for IP protection without parameter access or fine-tuning vulnerability.
nodes.approach: Map and analyze the distinct error patterns of model families to attribute suspect models.
nodes.niche_reason: Black-box LLM family attribution is an uncommon direction.

nodes.title: Bubbleformer: Forecasting Boiling with Transformers
nodes.tldr: Bubbleformer is a transformer with factorized axial attention for autonomous long-range forecasting of boiling dynamics, plus the BubbleML 2.0 dataset and physics-based metrics.
nodes.problem: Neural surrogates fail to forecast boiling and nucleation without future inputs
nodes.approach: Axial-attention transformer with frequency-aware scaling and thermophysical conditioning
nodes.niche_reason: Boiling multiphase flow surrogates are a rare niche.

nodes.title: The Implicit Bias of Structured State Space Models Can Be Poisoned With Clean Labels
nodes.tldr: Proves that special clean-labeled examples can distort the implicit bias of structured state space models, breaking generalization despite correct labels.
nodes.problem: Whether SSM implicit bias, which yields generalization, is robust to training-data choice.
nodes.approach: Formal analysis of gradient-descent implicit bias with constructed clean-label poisoning examples, validated empirically.
nodes.primary_topic: Architectures & Training › State-Space Models & Linear Attention
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Deep Learning Theory
nodes.niche_reason: SSM theory is growing; clean-label poisoning of implicit bias is specialised.

nodes.title: STARFlow: Scaling Latent Normalizing Flows for High-resolution Image Synthesis
nodes.tldr: Scales normalizing flows to high-resolution image synthesis by modeling latent autoencoder space with a deep-shallow transformer and new guidance.
nodes.problem: Normalizing flows have lagged diffusion models in scalability and sample quality at high resolution.
nodes.approach: Transformer autoregressive flow with deep-shallow blocks, latent-space training, and a novel guidance algorithm.
nodes.primary_topic: Generative Models › GANs, VAEs & Normalizing Flows
nodes.niche_reason: Scaled normalizing flows are rare against dominant diffusion models

nodes.title: Quantization-Free Autoregressive Action Transformer
nodes.tldr: Imitation learning policy that models continuous actions with a Generative Infinite-Vocabulary Transformer instead of quantized tokens, achieving state-of-the-art simulated robotics results.
nodes.problem: Discrete action tokenization breaks the continuous structure of actions and limits generation.
nodes.approach: Continuous autoregressive transformer policy parametrized directly by GIVT, with sampling study.
nodes.niche_reason: Continuous autoregressive imitation policies are specialised.

nodes.title: Spectral Graph Neural Networks are Incomplete on Graphs with a Simple Spectrum
nodes.tldr: Introduces an expressivity hierarchy for spectral GNNs by eigenvalue multiplicity, proves many are incomplete even with simple spectrum, and proposes rotation-equivariant fixes.
nodes.problem: Understand expressive power limits of spectrally enhanced GNNs beyond WL-based frameworks.
nodes.approach: Hierarchy by largest eigenvalue multiplicity, incompleteness proofs, and rotation-equivariant networks on eigenspaces.
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Deep Learning Theory
nodes.niche_reason: Spectral expressivity theory for GNNs is a specialised niche.

nodes.title: ResearchCodeBench: Benchmarking LLMs on Implementing Novel Machine Learning Research Code
nodes.tldr: ResearchCodeBench evaluates 30+ LLMs on implementing novel 2024-2025 ML paper contributions as executable code; the best implement under 40% correctly.
nodes.problem: Measuring whether LLMs can implement genuinely novel research ideas unseen in pretraining.
nodes.approach: Benchmark of code snippets from recent papers with executable tests across many LLMs.
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › Code Generation & Software
secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › LLM Evaluation & Benchmarks
nodes.niche_reason: Code benchmarks are common; research-paper implementation is more specialised.

nodes.title: Mind-the-Glitch: Visual Correspondence for Detecting Inconsistencies in Subject-Driven Generation
nodes.tldr: Disentangles visual from semantic features in diffusion backbones using an automated paired-data pipeline and contrastive architecture, yielding a metric that quantifies and localizes inconsistencies in subject-driven generation.
nodes.problem: Detecting and localizing visual inconsistencies in subject-driven image generation lacks suitable metrics.
nodes.approach: Contrastive disentanglement of diffusion features and a Visual Semantic Matching metric.
nodes.primary_topic: Generative Models › Generative Model Evaluation & Theory
nodes.confidence_reason: Contribution spans correspondence features and generation evaluation metric.
nodes.niche_reason: Visual correspondence from diffusion features for evaluation is a specialised angle.

nodes.title: Does Reinforcement Learning Really Incentivize Reasoning Capacity in LLMs Beyond the Base Model?
nodes.tldr: Analysis finding RLVR-trained LLMs do not gain fundamentally new reasoning; pass@k shows base models cover reasoning paths and reasoning boundaries narrow with training.
nodes.problem: Whether RLVR elicits genuinely new reasoning beyond the base model's capabilities.
nodes.approach: Pass@k evaluation at large k, coverage and perplexity analysis across models and algorithms.
nodes.primary_topic: Reinforcement Learning › RL for LLMs & Reasoning
nodes.niche_reason: RLVR reasoning-boundary analyses are a crowded current topic.

nodes.title: Offline Guarded Safe Reinforcement Learning for Medical Treatment Optimization Strategies
nodes.tldr: Model-based offline safe RL that constrains policies to clinically validated state-action regions plus a physiological safety cost for treatment optimization.
nodes.problem: Offline RL in healthcare drifts out of distribution, and action-only regularization ignores downstream state trajectories.
nodes.approach: OOD guardian restricting optimization to clinically valid regions, plus a safety cost constraint, with theoretical guarantees.
nodes.niche_reason: Safety-constrained offline RL for clinical treatment is a specialised application

nodes.title: SpecEdge: Scalable Edge-Assisted Serving Framework for Interactive LLMs
nodes.tldr: SpecEdge splits LLM inference between consumer edge GPUs drafting and servers verifying via speculative decoding, improving server throughput and cost efficiency.
nodes.problem: LLM serving is costly and ignores idle consumer-grade edge GPUs.
nodes.approach: Edge-assisted speculative decoding with proactive edge drafting and pipeline-aware multi-request scheduling.
secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › Efficient LLM Inference & Architectures
nodes.niche_reason: Edge-server LLM serving is specialised systems work.

nodes.title: Cost-Aware Contrastive Routing for LLMs
nodes.tldr: Routes each prompt to the cheapest accurate LLM via a contrastive embedding space, so routing becomes one fast kNN lookup.
nodes.problem: Cost-aware LLM routing ignores prompt context, needs costly profiling, or uses trial and error.
nodes.approach: Contrastive encoder maps prompts and models into a shared space; FAISS kNN retrieves the expert.
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › Efficient LLM Inference & Architectures
nodes.niche_reason: Model routing is active; contrastive cost-band routing is specialised.

nodes.title: InterMT: Multi-Turn Interleaved Preference Alignment with Human Feedback
nodes.tldr: InterMT is a multi-turn interleaved text-image preference dataset with human feedback and a benchmark, enabling alignment of multimodal LLMs for multi-turn multimodal interaction.
nodes.problem: Multimodal models lack alignment data and evaluation for multi-turn interleaved text-image interaction.
nodes.approach: Collect human preference data on multi-turn interleaved conversations, train a judge, and build a benchmark.
secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › Alignment & Preference Optimization
nodes.niche_reason: Interleaved multimodal preference alignment is specialised.

nodes.title: MARS-VFL: A Unified Benchmark for Vertical Federated Learning with Realistic Evaluation
nodes.tldr: MARS-VFL is a unified benchmark for vertical federated learning with realistic multi-party datasets and evaluation across methods.
nodes.problem: Few public real-world datasets exist for evaluating vertical federated learning.
nodes.approach: Curate realistic feature-partitioned datasets and benchmark VFL methods under a unified protocol.
nodes.niche_reason: Vertical federated learning benchmarks are quite rare.

nodes.title: Towards a Pairwise Ranking Model with Orderliness and Monotonicity for Label Enhancement
nodes.tldr: PROM is a pairwise ranking probability model with orderliness and monotonicity assumptions, powering a generative algorithm that infers label distributions from multi-label data.
nodes.problem: Existing label enhancement methods poorly model probabilistic links between label distributions and rankings, ignoring ties.
nodes.approach: Pairwise ranking model with monotonicity and orderliness assumptions, derived mass functions, and a generative label enhancement algorithm.
nodes.primary_topic: Learning Theory & Optimization › Probabilistic & Bayesian Methods
nodes.confidence_reason: Label distribution learning fits no topic cleanly; probabilistic modeling is closest.
nodes.niche_reason: Label distribution learning is a rare, specialised weak-supervision niche.

nodes.title: Scaling and context steer LLMs along the same computational path as the human brain
nodes.tldr: Shows LLM layers and human brain responses align in matching order over audiobook listening, with alignment depending on model size and context length.
nodes.problem: Unclear whether LLM-brain representational alignment reflects similar computation order.
nodes.approach: Temporally resolved MEG recordings compared against layer activations of 17 LLMs.
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › Language Model Interpretability
nodes.niche_reason: Layer-wise LLM-brain alignment over time is a rare cross-disciplinary angle.

nodes.title: Complete Structure Guided Point Cloud Completion via Cluster- and Instance-Level Contrastive Learning
nodes.tldr: A self-supervised framework learns a complete point cloud structure from incomplete scans, then uses cluster- and instance-level contrast to guide completion without complete data.
nodes.problem: Point cloud completion usually needs complete ground-truth clouds that are rarely available.
nodes.approach: Self-supervised complete-structure reconstruction module plus cluster- and instance-level contrastive learning.
nodes.niche_reason: Self-supervised point cloud completion is a moderately common topic.

nodes.title: Accelerating Visual-Policy Learning through Parallel Differentiable Simulation
nodes.tldr: Decouples rendering from the computation graph to do visual policy learning with differentiable simulation and analytic policy gradients, training humanoid running in four hours on one GPU.
nodes.problem: Slow and unstable visual policy learning with differentiable simulation and rendering.
nodes.approach: First-order analytical policy gradients with rendering decoupled from the differentiable simulation graph.
nodes.primary_topic: Reinforcement Learning › Online & Deep RL Algorithms
nodes.niche_reason: Differentiable-simulation policy gradients are a specialised RL branch.

nodes.title: The Best Instruction-Tuning Data are Those That Fit
nodes.tldr: GRAPE selects, for each instruction, the candidate response most likely under the target model's pretrained distribution, then runs standard SFT, improving efficiency.
nodes.problem: Instruction-tuning responses from other models are often out of distribution for the target model, hurting SFT.
nodes.approach: Gather responses from multiple sources and select the one with highest normalized probability under the target model.
nodes.primary_topic: Data, Benchmarks & Evaluation › Synthetic Data & Data Curation
nodes.niche_reason: Data selection for SFT is an active, fairly common direction.

nodes.title: WISA: World simulator assistant for physics-aware text-to-video generation
nodes.tldr: WISA injects hierarchical physical knowledge (text, categories, quantitative properties) into text-to-video models via mixture-of-physical-experts attention, and releases WISA-80K physics video dataset.
nodes.problem: Text-to-video models generate videos that violate physical laws.
nodes.approach: Physics decomposition modules (MoPA, physical classifier) plus a curated 80K-video dataset of physical phenomena.
nodes.niche_reason: Physics-aware video generation is an active but specialised direction.

nodes.title: VL-Rethinker: Incentivizing Self-Reflection of Vision-Language Models with Reinforcement Learning
nodes.tldr: Uses RL with selective sample replay and forced rethinking tokens to make vision-language models self-reflect, reaching state-of-the-art math multimodal scores without distillation.
nodes.problem: RL-trained vision-language models reason poorly and rarely self-reflect or self-verify.
nodes.approach: GRPO with selective sample replay plus appended rethinking trigger token during rollouts.
nodes.primary_topic: Reinforcement Learning › RL for LLMs & Reasoning
nodes.niche_reason: RL for multimodal reasoning is a crowded, active area

nodes.title: Achilles' Heel of Mamba: Essential difficulties of the Mamba architecture demonstrated by synthetic data
nodes.tldr: Uses synthetic tasks to show Mamba's nonlinear convolution creates an asymmetry bias that hurts symmetric pattern and reversed-sequence matching.
nodes.problem: Mamba's limitations relative to Transformers on structured sequence tasks are poorly understood.
nodes.approach: Designed composite-function and inverse-sequence matching tasks that isolate the effect of the convolution.
nodes.primary_topic: Architectures & Training › State-Space Models & Linear Attention
nodes.niche_reason: Mamba limitations via synthetic tasks is specialised but an active research thread.

nodes.title: Sheetpedia: A 300K-Spreadsheet Corpus for Spreadsheet Intelligence and LLM Fine-Tuning
nodes.tldr: Releases a corpus of over 290,000 spreadsheets with formulas, and fine-tunes LLMs on it for range and formula prediction tasks.
nodes.problem: Spreadsheet formulas and structure are poorly covered by existing table datasets, which lack formula semantics.
nodes.approach: Collect and clean Enron and web spreadsheets with rejection-sampled data generation for NL-to-range and NL-to-formula tasks.
secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › Code Generation & Software
nodes.niche_reason: Spreadsheet formula intelligence is a rare, applied niche

nodes.title: PRIMT: Preference-based Reinforcement Learning with Multimodal Feedback and Trajectory Synthesis from Foundation Models
nodes.tldr: Teaches robots from preference feedback generated by combined vision-language and language models, plus synthesized trajectories to reduce human labeling and ambiguity.
nodes.problem: Preference-based RL needs heavy human input and suffers query ambiguity and credit assignment problems.
nodes.approach: Multimodal foundation-model feedback fusing VLMs and LLMs, plus foresight and hindsight trajectory synthesis.
nodes.primary_topic: Reinforcement Learning › Reward Learning, Inverse RL & Preferences
secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › Alignment & Preference Optimization
nodes.niche_reason: Foundation-model preference feedback for robots is an emerging niche

nodes.title: ConnectomeBench: Can LLMs proofread the connectome?
nodes.tldr: Benchmarks multimodal LLMs on connectome proofreading, finding strong segment identification but weak merge-error detection relative to expert annotations.
nodes.problem: Connectome proofreading needs huge human effort; it is unclear whether LLMs can automate parts of it.
nodes.approach: Expert-annotated benchmark covering segment typing, split correction and merge detection on EM datasets.
nodes.niche_reason: LLM proofreading of connectomes is a rare cross-disciplinary application.

nodes.title: StelLA: Subspace Learning in Low-rank Adaptation using Stiefel Manifold
nodes.tldr: StelLA extends LoRA with a USV^T factorization whose U and V lie on the Stiefel manifold, optimized by Riemannian-converted optimizers, improving across language and vision tasks.
nodes.problem: LoRA underuses the geometry of low-rank manifolds and lags behind full fine-tuning.
nodes.approach: Three-factor adapter with Stiefel-constrained orthonormal subspaces and modular Euclidean-to-Riemannian optimizer conversion.
nodes.niche_reason: LoRA variants are a very crowded topic.

nodes.title: MJ-Video: Benchmarking and Rewarding Video Generation with Fine-Grained Video Preference
nodes.tldr: Introduces a fine-grained video preference benchmark and a mixture-of-experts reward model that judges text-video alignment, safety, and bias across 28 criteria.
nodes.problem: Text-to-video models suffer misalignment, hallucination and bias, and existing video reward models are coarse.
nodes.approach: MoE reward model dynamically selects relevant experts per text-video pair, then preference fine-tuning.
secondary_topics: Generative Models › Generative Model Evaluation & Theory
nodes.confidence_reason: Benchmark and reward model span evaluation and generation topics
nodes.niche_reason: Video reward modelling with MoE is specialised

nodes.title: Does Object Binding Naturally Emerge in Large Pretrained Vision Transformers?
nodes.tldr: Shows self-supervised ViTs (DINO, MAE, CLIP) represent whether patches share an object, and this signal guides attention.
nodes.problem: Unclear whether object binding emerges naturally in pretrained vision transformers without explicit object-centric attention.
nodes.approach: Similarity probe on patch embeddings across layers, plus low-dimensional subspace analysis and ablations.
secondary_topics: Computer Vision › Vision Foundation Models & Self-Supervision
nodes.confidence_reason: Analysis of ViT representations; interpretability vs foundation-model topic
nodes.niche_reason: Object binding in pretrained ViTs is a rare cognitive-science angle

nodes.title: The Computational Advantage of Depth in Learning High-Dimensional Hierarchical Targets
nodes.tldr: Shows deep networks trained by gradient descent learn hierarchical Gaussian targets with far fewer samples than shallow ones by successively reducing effective dimensionality.
nodes.problem: Theoretical understanding of the advantage of depth for learning high-dimensional hierarchical targets.
nodes.approach: Analyze GD dynamics on single and multi-index Gaussian hierarchical targets in the high-dimensional limit.
nodes.primary_topic: Learning Theory & Optimization › Deep Learning Theory
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › High-dimensional & Random Matrix Theory
nodes.niche_reason: Established but specialised deep learning theory topic.

nodes.title: PerceptionLM: Open-Access Data and Models for Detailed Visual Understanding
nodes.tldr: PLM is a fully open vision-language model trained without proprietary distillation, released with 2.8M human-labeled fine-grained video QA pairs and a video benchmark.
nodes.problem: Closed or distilled vision-language models obscure data and hinder reproducible progress in video understanding.
nodes.approach: Open training recipe with new human-labeled video QA data and spatio-temporally grounded captions.
