nodes.problem: Dynamic GNNs on EEG use temporally fixed graphs and handle temporal-graph interactions poorly.
nodes.approach: Time-then-graph modeling with explicitly dynamic nodes and edges, plus theoretical expressivity analysis.
secondary_topics: Architectures & Training › Time Series & Sequential Data
nodes.niche_reason: Dynamic EEG graphs for seizure detection, specialised application

nodes.title: Rethinking Joint Maximum Mean Discrepancy for Visual Domain Adaptation
nodes.tldr: Derives a concise joint MMD via the Representer theorem, unifying prior distribution distances, and pairs it with HSIC graph embedding for visual domain adaptation.
nodes.problem: JMMD is hard to use in subspace-learning domain adaptation because its estimator involves a tensor-product operator.
nodes.approach: Representer-theorem-based concise JMMD with label kernels, plus HSIC graph similarity weights for intra-class compactness.
nodes.primary_topic: Architectures & Training › Domain Adaptation & OOD Generalization
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Kernels, GPs & Nonparametrics
nodes.niche_reason: Kernel-based subspace domain adaptation is a rare, classical-style niche.

nodes.title: The Temporal Graph of Bitcoin Transactions
nodes.tldr: Releases an ML-ready temporal heterogeneous graph of Bitcoin's full transaction history, reconstructing fund flows, with sampling methods and graph database snapshots.
nodes.problem: Bitcoin's pseudonymous UTXO design makes its transaction data hard to use for ML.
nodes.approach: Reconstructed fund-flow graph with community sampling and graph database tooling.
nodes.niche_reason: Bitcoin transaction graph datasets for ML are a rare niche.

nodes.title: The Structure of Relation Decoding Linear Operators in Large Language Models
nodes.tldr: Shows linear relation-decoding operators in LLMs are compressible by tensor networks and actually encode coarse semantic properties rather than distinct relations.
nodes.problem: What structure do linear operators that decode relational facts in transformer language models have across relations?
nodes.approach: Compress operator collections with order-3 tensor networks and cross-evaluate decoders on other relations' subjects.
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › Language Model Interpretability
nodes.niche_reason: Tensor-network analysis of relation decoders is quite unusual.

nodes.title: OnlineSplatter: Pose-Free Online 3D Reconstruction for Free-Moving Objects
nodes.tldr: Online feed-forward framework producing object-centric 3D Gaussians from monocular video of free-moving objects without poses or depth, using a dual-key memory module with constant cost.
nodes.problem: Reconstructing free-moving objects from monocular video without camera pose, depth priors, or bundle optimization.
nodes.approach: Feed-forward Gaussian primitive field refined online via dual-key appearance-geometry and directional memory with sparsification.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: Active 3D topic with specialised free-moving-object online setting.

nodes.title: MONITRS: Multimodal Observations of Natural Incidents Through Remote Sensing
nodes.tldr: MONITRS is a dataset of about 10,000 FEMA disaster events with temporal satellite imagery, news text and QA pairs; fine-tuning MLLMs on it helps.
nodes.problem: Disaster monitoring lacks datasets with temporal granularity and natural language annotations for multimodal models.
nodes.approach: Build multimodal dataset pairing temporal satellite imagery with news text and geotags; fine-tune MLLMs as benchmark.
nodes.niche_reason: Remote sensing vision-language datasets are specialised.

nodes.title: On the Empirical Power of Goodness-of-Fit Tests in Watermark Detection
nodes.tldr: Systematically benchmarks eight goodness-of-fit tests for detecting text watermarks, finding they boost detection power and robustness for LLM outputs.
nodes.problem: Watermark detection rarely uses classic goodness-of-fit tests, despite pivotal statistics being i.i.d. under human text.
nodes.approach: Empirical comparison of eight GoF tests across three watermark schemes, three LLMs, two datasets and post-editing.
nodes.niche_reason: Statistical tests for watermark detection are specialised but growing

nodes.title: DenseDPO: Fine-Grained Temporal Preference Optimization for Video Diffusion Models
nodes.tldr: Creates DPO pairs by denoising corrupted copies of a video and labels preferences on short segments, reducing motion bias and enabling automatic VLM labels.
nodes.problem: Video DPO compares independent clips, which biases annotators toward low-motion videos.
nodes.approach: Aligned video pairs from a ground-truth video, with segment-level preference labels to densify the signal.
secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › Alignment & Preference Optimization
nodes.niche_reason: Preference-tuning variants for generative models are crowded

nodes.title: Mitigating the Privacy–Utility Trade-off in Decentralized Federated Learning via f-Differential Privacy
nodes.tldr: Develops f-DP-based privacy accounting for decentralized federated learning, capturing amplification from sparse communication and correlated noise, yielding tighter bounds than Renyi DP.
nodes.problem: Accurately quantifying privacy budgets of differentially private decentralized federated learning algorithms.
nodes.approach: Pairwise Network f-DP and Secret-based f-LDP accounting using f-DP theory and Markov chain concentration.
nodes.niche_reason: f-DP accounting for decentralized settings is a narrow specialty.

nodes.title: Imitation Beyond Expectation Using Pluralistic Stochastic Dominance
nodes.tldr: Reformulates imitation learning so policies match a demonstrator's reward distribution under stochastic dominance, using optimal transport to support diverse behaviors.
nodes.problem: Expectation-matching imitation cannot support qualitatively distinct demonstrated behaviors.
nodes.approach: Optimal transport matches imitator samples to demonstrations, defining a trajectory-pair objective.
nodes.primary_topic: Reinforcement Learning › Reward Learning, Inverse RL & Preferences
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Optimal Transport & Divergences
nodes.confidence_reason: Imitation via stochastic dominance; could fit robotics imitation.
nodes.niche_reason: Pluralistic imitation via stochastic dominance over reward distributions is uncommon.

nodes.title: Light-Weight Diffusion Multiplier and Uncertainty Quantification for Fourier Neural Operators
nodes.tldr: Replaces the dense Fourier multiplier with a single learnable diffusion time per channel, giving a light Bayesian neural operator with calibrated uncertainty.
nodes.problem: Fourier neural operators are overparameterized and lack native uncertainty quantification.
nodes.approach: Heat-kernel-inspired diffusion multiplier with priors over time parameters, giving spatially correlated outputs.
nodes.niche_reason: Specialised: Bayesian uncertainty for neural operators.

nodes.title: Vision-centric Token Compression in Large Language Model
nodes.tldr: Renders distant context tokens as images for a frozen vision encoder while a slow path reads nearby text, matching accuracy with 2.3x fewer tokens.
nodes.problem: Long-context LLMs have prohibitive compute and memory costs from large token counts.
nodes.approach: Slow-fast split: distant tokens rendered to images and resampled; probability-informed masking focuses training.
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › Long Context & Memory
secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › Efficient LLM Inference & Architectures
nodes.niche_reason: Rendering text tokens as images for LLM compression is an unusual angle.

nodes.title: To Think or Not To Think: A Study of Thinking in Rule-Based Visual Reinforcement Fine-Tuning
nodes.tldr: Finds explicit thinking is unnecessary for visual perception in rule-based reinforcement fine-tuning of multimodal LLMs, and proposes adaptive thinking.
nodes.problem: Whether explicit chain-of-thought helps or hurts rule-based reinforcement fine-tuning of multimodal models.
nodes.approach: Compares thinking and no-thinking RFT with equality-accuracy rewards across six tasks and model sizes.
nodes.primary_topic: Reinforcement Learning › RL for LLMs & Reasoning
nodes.niche_reason: Thinking ablations in visual RFT are an emerging niche

nodes.title: MedChain: Bridging the Gap Between LLM Agents and Clinical Practice with Interactive Sequence
nodes.tldr: MedChain is a 12,163-case benchmark of five-stage interactive, personalized, sequential clinical workflows, plus MedChain-Agent, a feedback and case-RAG agent system that outperforms baselines.
nodes.problem: LLM agent benchmarks do not mirror real clinical decision making workflows.
nodes.approach: Build a sequential clinical case dataset and an agent with a feedback mechanism and MedCase-RAG module.
secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › Agents & Tool Use
nodes.niche_reason: Clinical LLM agent benchmarks are specialised but increasingly common.

nodes.title: Aligning Text-to-Image Diffusion Models to Human Preference by Classification
nodes.tldr: ABC aligns text-to-image diffusion models to human preferences by recasting preference learning as classification toward an ideal reference, using augmented preference data.
nodes.problem: Diffusion models misalign with human preferences and DPO methods rely on suboptimal SFT references.
nodes.approach: Classification-based alignment loss with data augmentation turning preference pairs into fully supervised signals.
secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › Alignment & Preference Optimization
nodes.niche_reason: Preference alignment for diffusion is a common variant space.

nodes.title: Optimal Neural Compressors for the Rate-Distortion-Perception Tradeoff
nodes.tldr: Builds low-complexity neural compressors using lattice coding and shared dithering, proven RDP-optimal under infinite and zero shared randomness.
nodes.problem: Rate-distortion-perception compressors are known in theory but lack constructive, low-complexity designs.
nodes.approach: Lattice quantization for packing efficiency plus dithered shared randomness over lattice cells.
nodes.niche_reason: Neural compression is established; RDP-optimal lattice-dithered design is specialised.

nodes.title: From Experts to a Generalist: Toward General Whole-Body Control for Humanoid Robots
nodes.tldr: Clusters motions by behaviour, trains expert policies per cluster with real-world refinement, then distills them into one generalist humanoid whole-body controller.
nodes.problem: One humanoid policy struggles across diverse motions due to conflicting controls and data.
nodes.approach: Autoencoder motion clustering, expert policies with delta-action sim-to-real, then distillation.
nodes.niche_reason: Expert-generalist humanoid control is specialised.

nodes.title: Efficient Knowledge Transfer in Federated Recommendation for Joint Venture Ecosystem
nodes.tldr: FR-JVE enables privacy-preserving federated recommendation across subsidiaries with overlapping users by transferring distilled rating preferences.
nodes.problem: Federated recommendation across joint-venture subsidiaries with overlapping, exclusive user bases lacks privacy-safe knowledge transfer.
nodes.approach: Distill local rating preferences via model inversion, then align them with a bridge function and match similar users.
nodes.niche_reason: Federated recommendation across joint-venture subsidiaries with overlapping users is rare

nodes.title: The Non-Linear Representation Dilemma: Is Causal Abstraction Enough for Mechanistic Interpretability?
nodes.tldr: Proves that with arbitrarily powerful alignment maps, any neural network maps to any algorithm, making causal abstraction vacuous for mechanistic interpretability without linearity assumptions.
nodes.problem: Whether causal abstraction is meaningful when alignment maps are not restricted to linear functions.
nodes.approach: Theoretical proof plus experiments mapping random language models perfectly to algorithms on IOI task.
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › Language Model Interpretability
nodes.niche_reason: Mechanistic interpretability is established; critical theoretical analysis of causal abstraction is specialised.

nodes.title: DexGarmentLab: Dexterous Garment Manipulation Environment with Generalizable Policy
nodes.tldr: Introduces DexGarmentLab, a simulator with 15 garment task scenarios, and HALO, a hierarchical policy that generalizes to unseen garment shapes.
nodes.problem: Dexterous garment manipulation lacks realistic simulators, and collecting data by teleoperation is labor-intensive.
nodes.approach: Affordance-point localization followed by trajectories generated from one expert demonstration via garment structural correspondence.
nodes.confidence_reason: Benchmark environment plus policy; contributions straddle two topics
nodes.niche_reason: Garment manipulation is a specialised manipulation niche

nodes.title: Solving Inequality Proofs with Large Language Models
nodes.tldr: IneqMath recasts inequality proving as verifiable bound estimation and relation prediction, with an Olympiad dataset and step-wise judges showing top LLMs score under 10%.
nodes.problem: LLM inequality proving lacks informal yet verifiable datasets and evaluation beyond final-answer matching.
nodes.approach: Curate expert Olympiad inequalities and build final-answer plus step-wise LLM-as-judge evaluation suite.
secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › LLM Evaluation & Benchmarks
nodes.niche_reason: Math reasoning benchmarks are common; inequality proving is a specialised slice.

nodes.title: Learning with Calibration: Exploring Test-Time Computing of Spatio-Temporal Forecasting
nodes.tldr: ST-TTC performs test-time calibration for spatio-temporal forecasting, using a spectral-domain calibrator to correct periodic bias from non-stationarity in real time.
nodes.problem: Spatio-temporal forecasts degrade with anomalies, noise and distribution shift, and robust retraining is costly.
nodes.approach: Test-time spectral-domain calibrator with periodic bias correction applied to predictions.
nodes.primary_topic: Architectures & Training › Time Series & Sequential Data
secondary_topics: Architectures & Training › Domain Adaptation & OOD Generalization
nodes.confidence_reason: Test-time adaptation and forecasting; could also be filed under domain shift.
nodes.niche_reason: Test-time calibration for spatio-temporal forecasting is specialised.

nodes.title: Dense Associative Memory with Epanechnikov Energy
nodes.tldr: Proposes log-sum-ReLU, an Epanechnikov-kernel energy for dense associative memory that retrieves patterns exactly with exponential capacity and many extra local minima.
nodes.problem: Dense associative memory energies based on log-sum-exp need exponential separation functions for capacity.
nodes.approach: Kernel-density-inspired energy using the Epanechnikov kernel, yielding exact retrieval without separation functions.
nodes.primary_topic: Learning Theory & Optimization › Kernels, GPs & Nonparametrics
nodes.confidence_reason: Energy-based associative memory has no clear vocabulary topic.
nodes.niche_reason: Epanechnikov-kernel associative memory is rare.

nodes.title: Conservative classifiers do consistently well with improving agents: characterizing statistical and online learning
nodes.tldr: Characterizes PAC and online learnability when classified agents genuinely improve within Euclidean regions, giving exact proper-learning results and mistake bounds.
nodes.problem: Learning when agents genuinely improve differs from standard PAC learning, and open questions remain.
nodes.approach: Asymmetric minimally consistent concept classes, plus analysis for Euclidean-ball improvement sets and bounded noise.
nodes.primary_topic: Learning Theory & Optimization › Generalization & Statistical Learning
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Online Learning & Regret
nodes.niche_reason: Learning with agents who genuinely improve is a rare theory niche.

nodes.title: ElasticMM: Efficient Multimodal LLMs Serving with Elastic Multimodal Parallelism
nodes.tldr: Serving system for multimodal LLMs using elastic multimodal parallelism, modality-aware load balancing and multimodal prefix caching to cut time-to-first-token.
nodes.problem: Tightly coupled MLLM serving handles mixed request types and inference stages poorly, raising time-to-first-token.
nodes.approach: Modality-aware balancing, decoupled inference stages with elastic partition scheduling, and unified multimodal prefix caching.
secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › Efficient LLM Inference & Architectures
nodes.niche_reason: MLLM serving systems are an active, fast-growing systems area

nodes.title: Causal Differentiating Concepts: Interpreting LM Behavior via Causal Representation Learning
nodes.tldr: Unsupervised discovery of sparse causal concept directions in LM activations, whose changes elicit different behavior; tested on synthetic data and refusals.
nodes.problem: Entangled LM activations make it hard to interpret the concepts that drive behavior.
nodes.approach: Constrained contrastive learning with a sparsity assumption on causal differentiating concepts.
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › Language Model Interpretability
nodes.niche_reason: Unsupervised causal concept discovery in LMs is a specialized interpretability niche.

nodes.title: Implicit Bias of Spectral Descent and Muon on Multiclass Separable Data
nodes.tldr: Proves that normalized steepest descent and momentum variants, including Spectral Descent, Muon and Adam, converge to max-margin solutions under various p-norms in multiclass linear classification.
nodes.problem: Characterizing implicit optimization bias of matrix-parameter optimizers in multiclass classification.
nodes.approach: Reduction of general p-norm steepest descent to max-norm analysis, proving margin maximization with convergence rates.
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Deep Learning Theory
nodes.niche_reason: Specialised theory, though Muon topic is currently hot.

nodes.title: Robust learning of halfspaces under log-concave marginals
nodes.tldr: Agnostically learns linear threshold functions under log-concave marginals with boundary volume O(r+epsilon), matching polynomial regression's sample and time complexity.
nodes.problem: Polynomial-regression classifiers can have constant boundary volume even for tiny perturbation radii.
nodes.approach: Augments polynomial regression with l1 noise-sensitivity regression, structured rounding, and a local smoothing corrector.
nodes.primary_topic: Learning Theory & Optimization › Generalization & Statistical Learning
nodes.confidence_reason: Robustness theory versus learning theory is a close call
nodes.niche_reason: Boundary-volume robust learning theory is a rare theoretical niche

nodes.title: Conformal Mixed-Integer Constraint Learning with Feasibility Guarantees
nodes.tldr: C-MICL uses conformal prediction to give probabilistic feasibility guarantees for data-driven constraints in mixed-integer optimization, without true constraint access.
nodes.problem: Learned mixed-integer constraints often violate true constraints due to model error.
nodes.approach: Conformal prediction calibrates learned constraints for regression and classification.
secondary_topics: Architectures & Training › Differentiable Optimization & Structured Layers
nodes.confidence_reason: Conformal guarantees in constraint learning; could be uncertainty or optimization
nodes.niche_reason: Conformal feasibility for learned MIP constraints is a rare intersection.

nodes.title: Sharper Convergence Rates for Nonconvex Optimisation via Reduction Mappings
nodes.tldr: Shows that reduction mappings which parametrise the solution manifold improve objective curvature, giving better-conditioned problems and faster gradient-method convergence.
nodes.problem: Gradient methods on problems with manifold-shaped solution sets have redundant directions and poor conditioning.
nodes.approach: Reparametrise variables onto the solution manifold via inner-problem reduction mappings, analysing the resulting curvature.
nodes.niche_reason: Reduction-map reparametrisation for convergence is specialised theory.

nodes.title: InfiFPO: Implicit Model Fusion via Preference Optimization in Large Language Models
nodes.tldr: InfiFPO fuses multiple source LLMs during preference optimization by replacing the DPO reference with a fused source model using sequence-level probabilities and max-margin fusion.
nodes.problem: Model fusion methods neglect the preference alignment stage and discard source model probabilities.
nodes.approach: DPO variant with fused multi-source reference probabilities, probability clipping, and max-margin fusion.
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › Alignment & Preference Optimization
nodes.niche_reason: DPO variants are crowded, though fusion adds slight novelty.

nodes.title: QoQ-Med: Building Multimodal Clinical Foundation Models with Domain-Aware GRPO Training
nodes.tldr: QoQ-Med is an open clinical multimodal model reasoning over images, time series and text, trained with a domain-aware GRPO variant that rescales rewards by domain rarity.
nodes.problem: Clinical multimodal models are vision-centric and generalize poorly across specialties with skewed data.
nodes.approach: Domain-aware Relative Policy Optimization scaling normalized rewards by domain rarity and modality difficulty.
secondary_topics: Reinforcement Learning › RL for LLMs & Reasoning
nodes.niche_reason: Clinical multimodal RL training is specialised but active.

nodes.title: DexFlyWheel: A Scalable and Self-improving Data Generation Framework for Dexterous Manipulation
nodes.tldr: Generates diverse dexterous manipulation demonstrations via a self-improving loop of imitation learning, residual RL, and augmentation, transferred to real robots.
nodes.problem: Diverse, high-quality dexterous manipulation data is scarce and costly to collect.
nodes.approach: Closed-loop cycle of IL, residual RL rollouts in simulation, and augmentation feeding the next cycle.
secondary_topics: Data, Benchmarks & Evaluation › Synthetic Data & Data Curation
nodes.niche_reason: Data flywheels for manipulation are a common direction

nodes.title: NeurIPS should lead scientific consensus on AI policy
nodes.tldr: Position paper arguing NeurIPS should catalyze scientific consensus on AI policy, drawing lessons from the IPCC and pilots.
nodes.problem: No mechanism exists for forming scientific consensus on AI policy.
nodes.approach: Argue for NeurIPS leadership, compare with the IPCC, propose pilots and rebut counterarguments.
nodes.niche_reason: Meta-level policy and community governance argument is unusual.

nodes.title: Fast Training of Large Kernel Models with Delayed Projections
nodes.tldr: Scales kernel machines to large data and models by adding delayed projections to preconditioned SGD, speeding training without losing accuracy.
nodes.problem: Kernel machines do not scale well to large datasets and model sizes.
nodes.approach: Delayed projections inside preconditioned SGD (EigenPro 4).
nodes.primary_topic: Learning Theory & Optimization › Kernels, GPs & Nonparametrics
nodes.niche_reason: Specialised kernel-scaling line, rare in current ML mainstream.

nodes.title: Nemotron-CLIMB: Clustering-based Iterative Data Mixture Bootstrapping for Language Model Pre-training
nodes.tldr: Nemotron-CLIMB clusters web corpora semantically and iteratively searches data mixtures with proxy models, releasing ClimbLab and ClimbMix corpora that improve pretraining over baselines.
nodes.problem: Finding optimal pretraining data mixtures when web corpora lack domain labels.
nodes.approach: Embed and cluster data, then iteratively bootstrap mixture search using proxy models and a predictor.
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › Pretraining, Scaling & Data
secondary_topics: Data, Benchmarks & Evaluation › Synthetic Data & Data Curation
nodes.niche_reason: Data mixture optimization is common in LLM pretraining work.

nodes.title: Co-Reinforcement Learning for Unified Multimodal Understanding and Generation
nodes.tldr: CoRL applies GRPO-based reinforcement learning jointly to unified multimodal LLMs, improving both image generation and multimodal understanding via a shared policy.
nodes.problem: Jointly improving generation and understanding abilities in unified multimodal LLMs with RL.
nodes.approach: Two-stage RL: unified GRPO stage for joint optimization, then a refined task-specific RL stage, yielding ULM-R1.
secondary_topics: Reinforcement Learning › RL for LLMs & Reasoning
nodes.niche_reason: RL on unified multimodal LLMs is trendy and fairly common.

nodes.title: Extrapolation by Association: Length Generalization Transfer In Transformers
nodes.tldr: Shows length generalization transfers across related tasks in transformers: training with a longer auxiliary task enables extrapolation on a target task, via shared attention heads.
nodes.problem: How transformers acquire length generalization and whether it transfers across tasks.
nodes.approach: Joint training on algorithmic tasks with auxiliary longer tasks, plus mechanistic analysis of attention head reuse.
nodes.niche_reason: Length generalization is established; transfer across tasks angle is more specialised.

nodes.title: ControlFusion: A Controllable Image Fusion Network with Language-Vision Degradation Prompts
nodes.tldr: Controllable image fusion that uses language-vision degradation prompts and a physics-based degradation model to restore and fuse composite-degraded images.
nodes.problem: Image fusion fails on real composite degradations and ignores user preferences.
nodes.approach: Prompt-modulated restoration-fusion network with a text encoder and spatial-frequency visual adapter.
nodes.niche_reason: Language-prompted fusion is specialised but not rare

nodes.title: RepoMaster: Autonomous Exploration and Understanding of GitHub Repositories for Complex Task Solving
nodes.tldr: Lets code agents explore GitHub repositories by building call and dependency graphs and pruning context, boosting task pass rate and cutting tokens.
nodes.problem: Repository reuse is limited by overwhelming information and tangled dependencies within LLM context.
nodes.approach: Function-call graphs, module-dependency graphs, and hierarchical code trees for progressive exploration.
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › Code Generation & Software
secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › Agents & Tool Use
nodes.niche_reason: Repository-level code agents are emerging

nodes.title: Practical do-Shapley Explanations with Estimand-Agnostic Causal Inference
nodes.tldr: Makes do-SHAP practical by using estimand-agnostic causal inference to answer any identifiable interventional query from one model, plus a faster algorithm.
nodes.problem: do-SHAP causal explanations are impractical because of reliance on specific estimands.
nodes.approach: Estimand-agnostic causal models and an accelerated do-Shapley computation, including for inaccessible data generating processes.
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Causality & Causal Inference
nodes.niche_reason: Causal Shapley explanations are established but specialised.

nodes.title: Class-wise Balancing Data Replay for Federated Class-Incremental Learning
nodes.tldr: FedCBDR balances class-wise data replay in federated class-incremental learning via global coordination of replay memory and task-aware temperature scaling, improving accuracy by 2-15%.
nodes.problem: Federated class-incremental learning suffers class imbalance in replay buffers and between old and new classes.
nodes.approach: Global-perspective class-aware replay sampling plus task-aware class and instance temperature scaling of logits.
nodes.niche_reason: Combines federated and continual learning, a specialised intersection.

nodes.title: Meta CLIP 2: A Worldwide Scaling Recipe
nodes.tldr: Trains CLIP from scratch on worldwide web image-text data with curation that lifts both multilingual and English performance.
nodes.problem: Scaling CLIP to worldwide web data is hampered by no non-English curation and the curse of multilinguality.
nodes.approach: Train CLIP from scratch on worldwide image-text pairs with curation and ablation-driven recipe changes.
secondary_topics: Data, Benchmarks & Evaluation › Synthetic Data & Data Curation
nodes.niche_reason: CLIP pretraining is crowded; multilingual web-scale variant is less common

nodes.title: CSBrain: A Cross-scale Spatiotemporal Brain Foundation Model for EEG Decoding
nodes.tldr: EEG foundation model that tokenizes signals across temporal and regional scales with structured sparse attention, beating baselines on 11 tasks.
nodes.problem: Scale-agnostic dense modeling ignores cross-scale spatiotemporal structure in EEG.
nodes.approach: Cross-scale spatiotemporal tokenization alternated with structured sparse attention over windows and regions.
secondary_topics: Architectures & Training › Time Series & Sequential Data
nodes.niche_reason: Cross-scale spatiotemporal EEG foundation model; specialised neuro application.

nodes.title: TimeWak: Temporal Chained-Hashing Watermark for Time Series Data
nodes.tldr: Watermarks multivariate time series diffusion models directly in data space using chained hashing and an epsilon-exact inversion for reliable detection.
nodes.problem: Latent-space watermarks fail for time-series generators that operate in data space.
nodes.approach: Temporal chained-hashing watermark in data space, detected via epsilon-exact diffusion inversion.
secondary_topics: Architectures & Training › Time Series & Sequential Data
nodes.niche_reason: Watermarking time-series diffusion data is a rare direction.

nodes.title: Projection-based Lyapunov method for fully heterogeneous weakly-coupled MDPs
nodes.tldr: Projection-based Lyapunov functions prove an O(1/sqrt N) optimality gap for fully heterogeneous weakly-coupled MDPs, the first such asymptotic result.
nodes.problem: Curse of dimensionality in large heterogeneous weakly-coupled MDPs with distinct arm parameters.
nodes.approach: Efficiently computable policy certified by projection-based Lyapunov functions.
nodes.niche_reason: Fully heterogeneous WCMDPs are rarely studied

nodes.title: SciArena: An Open Evaluation Platform for Non-Verifiable Scientific Literature-Grounded Tasks
nodes.tldr: SciArena is an open Chatbot-Arena-style platform where researchers vote on model answers to literature-grounded questions, plus SciArena-Eval for meta-evaluating LLM judges.
nodes.problem: Evaluating models on open-ended, non-verifiable scientific literature tasks
nodes.approach: Community pairwise voting leaderboard and a preference-based meta-evaluation benchmark
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › LLM Evaluation & Benchmarks
nodes.niche_reason: Arena-style eval is common; science-literature focus is specialised

nodes.title: Spend Wisely: Maximizing Post-Training Gains in Iterative Synthetic Data Bootstrapping
nodes.tldr: Theoretically analyzes how to allocate generation and training budget across iterations of verifier-filtered synthetic data bootstrapping, showing exponential-growth schedules beat constant ones.
nodes.problem: How to allocate a fixed budget across iterations of synthetic data bootstrapping to maximize final performance.
nodes.approach: Theoretical analysis of budget allocation policies, validated on diffusion denoising and LLM math reasoning.
nodes.primary_topic: Data, Benchmarks & Evaluation › Synthetic Data & Data Curation
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Generalization & Statistical Learning
nodes.niche_reason: Theory of iterative self-training budget allocation is specialised.

nodes.title: Transfer Learning for Benign Overfitting in High-Dimensional Linear Regression
nodes.tldr: Analyzes transfer learning with minimum-norm interpolators in overparameterized linear regression, characterizing excess risk, free-lunch covariate shift regimes, and informative source detection.
nodes.problem: How transfer learning interacts with benign overfitting in high-dimensional linear regression.
nodes.approach: Two-step Transfer MNI with non-asymptotic excess risk analysis and data-driven informative source selection.
nodes.primary_topic: Learning Theory & Optimization › Generalization & Statistical Learning
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › High-dimensional & Random Matrix Theory
nodes.niche_reason: Specialised statistical theory on interpolation and transfer.

nodes.title: PCA++: How Uniformity Induces Robustness to Background Noise in Contrastive Learning
nodes.tldr: PCA++ adds a uniformity constraint to contrastive PCA, giving closed-form robust recovery of shared signal subspaces under structured background noise.
nodes.problem: Standard PCA fails to recover signal under strong structured background noise in high dimensions.
nodes.approach: Hard uniformity-constrained contrastive PCA solved by a generalized eigenproblem.
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › High-dimensional & Random Matrix Theory
nodes.confidence_reason: Contrastive PCA straddles SSL and random matrix theory
nodes.niche_reason: Uniformity-constrained contrastive PCA with asymptotics is rare

nodes.title: A Controllable Examination for Long-Context Language Models
nodes.tldr: LongBioBench uses synthetic biographies to evaluate long-context LMs on understanding, reasoning and trustworthiness with exact-match scoring, and finds continual pretraining mostly adjusts RoPE.
nodes.problem: Existing long-context benchmarks are either hard to interpret or lack coherent needle-haystack context.
nodes.approach: Controllable synthetic biography benchmark with coherent context, configurable abilities and deterministic evaluation of 18 models.
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › LLM Evaluation & Benchmarks
secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › Long Context & Memory
nodes.niche_reason: Long-context LLM benchmarks are numerous.

nodes.title: Balancing Multimodal Training Through Game-Theoretic Regularization
nodes.tldr: Game-theoretic regularizer based on mutual-information decomposition that balances modality contributions during joint multimodal training, reducing modality competition and underoptimized modalities.
nodes.problem: Multimodal training suffers modality competition, leaving some modalities underoptimized.
nodes.approach: Game-theoretic regularizer from an MI decomposition, with refined MI bounds and latent permutation estimates.
nodes.primary_topic: Audio, Speech & Multimodal › Audio-Visual & Cross-modal Learning
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Game Theory & Mechanism Design
nodes.niche_reason: Modality balancing via game theory is a specialised training problem

nodes.title: Understanding Prompt Tuning and In-Context Learning via Meta-Learning
nodes.tldr: Views prompting as conditioning meta-trained Bayesian predictors, showing where prompts can and cannot elicit target behavior, and that soft prefixes give strong prompts.
nodes.problem: Prompt optimization is empirical, with no conceptual account of its fundamental limits.
nodes.approach: Bayesian analysis of prefix tuning and weight tuning, tested on LSTMs and Transformers.
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › In-context Learning & Prompting
nodes.niche_reason: Bayesian theory of prompting and soft prefixes is a rare angle

nodes.title: THUNDER: Tile-level Histopathology image UNDERstanding benchmark
nodes.tldr: THUNDER is a tile-level benchmark for digital pathology foundation models, comparing 23 models on 16 datasets across downstream tasks, feature-space analysis, robustness and uncertainty.
nodes.problem: Assessing and comparing many histopathology foundation models reliably, including robustness and uncertainty.
nodes.approach: Unified dynamic benchmark with diverse datasets, feature analysis, robustness and uncertainty evaluation.
nodes.niche_reason: Pathology foundation-model benchmarking is specialised but active.

nodes.title: Wide-Horizon Thinking and Simulation-Based Evaluation for Real-World LLM Planning with Multifaceted Constraints
nodes.tldr: MAoP has LLMs pre-plan across multiple aspects of constraints before planning, and Travel-Sim evaluates plans via agent-based simulation to capture causal dependencies.
nodes.problem: Long-horizon LLM planning struggles with multifaceted, conflicting constraints; benchmarks check constraints in isolation.
nodes.approach: Wide-horizon pre-planning over multiple aspects as a blueprint for planners, plus simulation-based evaluation.
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › Agents & Tool Use
nodes.niche_reason: LLM travel planning benchmarks are an active area.

nodes.title: Sharp Gaussian approximations for Decentralized Federated Learning
nodes.tldr: Proves Berry-Esseen and time-uniform Gaussian approximations for local SGD iterates, enabling bootstrap inference and tests for adversarial attacks.
nodes.problem: Asymptotic statistical guarantees for local SGD in decentralized federated learning are limited.
nodes.approach: Gaussian approximation theorems for final and full-trajectory local SGD iterates.
nodes.confidence_reason: Judgment between statistical inference and federated optimization.
nodes.niche_reason: Berry-Esseen results for decentralized local SGD are rare.

nodes.title: Vision Transformers Don't Need Trained Registers
nodes.tldr: Finds sparse register neurons causing high-norm outlier tokens in ViTs, and removes the artifacts training-free by shifting their activations into an extra untrained token.
nodes.problem: Vision transformers show high-norm outlier tokens that degrade attention maps; fixing requires retraining with registers.
nodes.approach: Identify register neurons and redirect their high-norm activations to an added untrained token at test time.
secondary_topics: Computer Vision › Vision Foundation Models & Self-Supervision
nodes.confidence_reason: Split between transformer architecture and interpretability.
nodes.niche_reason: Mechanistic analysis of ViT artifacts is specialised but active.

nodes.title: Rectified Point Flow: Generic Point Cloud Pose Estimation
nodes.tldr: Unifies point cloud registration and multi-part shape assembly as one conditional generative problem using a learned point-wise velocity field from unposed clouds.
nodes.problem: Pose estimation for pairwise registration and multi-part assembly from unposed point clouds.
nodes.approach: Rectified flow transports noisy points to targets; part poses recovered; overlap-aware encoder.
nodes.niche_reason: Generative formulation of registration is specialised but emerging

nodes.title: Fast Projection-Free Approach (without Optimization Oracle) for Optimization over Compact Convex Set
nodes.tldr: Hom-PGD builds a homeomorphism from a compact convex set to a unit ball, enabling projection-free gradient optimization with optimal rates and no linear optimization oracle.
nodes.problem: Optimizing over general compact convex sets needs costly projections or linear optimization oracles.
nodes.approach: Gauge-mapping homeomorphism converts the problem to ball-constrained gradient descent with proven optimal convergence rates.
nodes.niche_reason: Specialised constrained convex optimization technique.

nodes.title: Towards Understanding the Mechanisms of Classifier-Free Guidance
nodes.tldr: Analyses classifier-free guidance in a linear diffusion model, showing it works through a mean shift plus contrastive principal component terms.
nodes.problem: The mechanism behind classifier-free guidance's improvement of generation quality is poorly understood.
nodes.approach: Linear diffusion analysis decomposing guidance into mean-shift and positive and negative CPC terms, verified on nonlinear models.
nodes.niche_reason: diffusion guidance is crowded; the mechanistic angle is less common

nodes.title: VLMs have Tunnel Vision: Evaluating Nonlocal Visual Reasoning in Leading VLMs
nodes.tldr: Benchmark showing leading VLMs fail nonlocal visual reasoning tasks such as comparing images and chained visual search, performing near random on simple variants.
nodes.problem: VLMs are assumed to reason across distant image regions, but this is untested
nodes.approach: Structured tests for comparative perception, saccadic search and smooth visual search
nodes.niche_reason: VLM nonlocal reasoning benchmark is specialised

nodes.title: Incremental Sequence Classification with Temporal Consistency
nodes.tldr: Trains incremental sequence classifiers with a temporal-consistency loss from TD learning, improving early predictions on text and LLM math verification.
nodes.problem: Predicting from a partial sequence needs successive predictions that stay consistent as new elements arrive.
nodes.approach: Temporal-consistency loss inspired by temporal-difference learning, applied to text classification and LLM verification.
nodes.primary_topic: Architectures & Training › Time Series & Sequential Data
secondary_topics: Reinforcement Learning › Online & Deep RL Algorithms
nodes.confidence_reason: Blends sequence classification with TD-learning; primary topic judgment call
nodes.niche_reason: Temporal-difference consistency for incremental classifiers is rare

nodes.title: DEXTER: Diffusion-Guided EXplanations with TExtual Reasoning for Vision Models
nodes.tldr: Data-free method that uses diffusion models and LLMs to synthesize class images and write natural-language reports on a vision classifier's decision patterns and biases.
nodes.problem: Explaining what a visual classifier has learned, including biases, without access to training data or labels.
nodes.approach: Optimize text prompts to generate class-conditional images that activate the classifier, then elicit LLM reports from them.
nodes.niche_reason: Natural-language global explanation of classifiers is a specialised niche

nodes.title: Is Noise Conditioning Necessary? A Unified Theory of Unconditional Graph Diffusion Models
nodes.tldr: Shows graph diffusion denoisers can infer noise levels implicitly from corrupted graphs, so explicit noise conditioning is unnecessary and cheaper.
nodes.problem: Whether graph diffusion models need explicit noise-level conditioning is unclear.
nodes.approach: Theory of Bernoulli edge-flip and coupled structure-attribute corruption, validated on GDSS and DiGress.
nodes.niche_reason: Graph diffusion is specialised; questioning noise conditioning is a focused theory angle.

nodes.title: Go With the Flow: Fast Diffusion for Gaussian Mixture Models
nodes.tldr: Analytically parametrized Schrodinger bridge policies between Gaussian mixtures are found via a low-dimensional linear program, avoiding costly neural training and extending to multi-marginal momentum bridges.
nodes.problem: Computing Schrodinger bridges is expensive, even for low-dimensional distribution steering problems.
nodes.approach: Analytic policy family for GMM-to-GMM steering solved by a linear program with dimension linear in mixture components.
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Optimal Transport & Divergences
nodes.niche_reason: Analytic Schrodinger bridges via GMMs are uncommon.

nodes.title: ALINE: Joint Amortization for Bayesian Inference and Active Data Acquisition
nodes.tldr: ALINE is an RL-trained transformer that jointly performs amortized Bayesian inference and active data acquisition, rewarded by self-estimated information gain.
nodes.problem: Existing amortized inference and experimental design methods do not jointly handle acquiring new data and instant inference.
nodes.approach: Transformer trained with RL using information-gain rewards from its own inference head, targetable at parameter subsets or predictions.
nodes.primary_topic: Learning Theory & Optimization › Probabilistic & Bayesian Methods
nodes.niche_reason: Joint amortized inference and experimental design is a rare combination.

nodes.title: Deep Value Benchmark: Measuring Whether Models Generalize Deep values or Shallow Preferences
nodes.tldr: Deep Value Benchmark confounds deep values with shallow features in preference training then breaks the correlation, finding LLMs generalize deep values less than chance.
nodes.problem: Whether LLMs learn human values or surface preferences
nodes.approach: Controlled confounding between value and shallow features; measure Deep Value Generalization Rate
nodes.primary_topic: Trustworthy ML › AI Safety & Alignment Research
secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › Alignment & Preference Optimization
nodes.niche_reason: Value generalization evaluation is specialised alignment research.

nodes.title: Unlocking Dataset Distillation with Diffusion Models
nodes.tldr: LD3M distills datasets by learning gradient-based latents and class embeddings end-to-end through a pretrained latent diffusion model, using a decaying skip connection to preserve gradients.
nodes.problem: Dataset distillation avoids diffusion models because backpropagation through long denoising chains vanishes.
nodes.approach: Optimize distilled latents and class embeddings through latent diffusion with a linearly decaying skip connection from the initial noise.
nodes.primary_topic: Data, Benchmarks & Evaluation › Synthetic Data & Data Curation
nodes.niche_reason: Dataset distillation with diffusion is a rare niche.

nodes.title: Algorithms and SQ Lower Bounds for Robustly Learning Real-valued Multi-Index Models
nodes.tldr: Gives a PAC learner for real-valued multi-index models under Gaussian inputs with label noise, plus a matching SQ lower bound for dimension dependence.
nodes.problem: Robustly learning real-valued multi-index models under adversarial label noise has unclear complexity.
nodes.approach: Algorithm with d^O(m) complexity using distinguishing moments, matched by SQ lower bounds.
nodes.primary_topic: Learning Theory & Optimization › Learning Theory Lower Bounds & Complexity
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Generalization & Statistical Learning
nodes.niche_reason: Multi-index model learning with SQ lower bounds is rare

nodes.title: Restoring Pruned Large Language Models via Lost Component Compensation
nodes.tldr: Restores pruned LLMs by contrastively probing key attention heads and reinjecting lost activation components, keeping sparsity and inference efficiency intact.
nodes.problem: Pruned LLMs degrade, and PEFT methods designed for dense models recover them suboptimally.
nodes.approach: Activation-editing probes locate critical attention heads; lost components are injected back into pruned heads.
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › Efficient LLM Inference & Architectures
secondary_topics: Architectures & Training › Efficient Training, Compression & Pruning
nodes.niche_reason: LLM pruning restoration is common, though the method is specific.

nodes.title: High-dimensional neuronal activity from low-dimensional latent dynamics: a solvable model
nodes.tldr: Solvable RNN shows low-dimensional latents can produce high-dimensional activity; a nonlinear latent model finds visual cortex activity reduces to few latents under some stimuli.
nodes.problem: Whether high-dimensional neural activity is explained by low-dimensional latent dynamics.
nodes.approach: Analytically solvable RNN plus Neural Cross-Encoder for nonlinear latent variable modeling.
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › High-dimensional & Random Matrix Theory
nodes.niche_reason: Solvable RNN plus neural cross-encoder for cortex is very rare.

nodes.title: Axial Neural Networks for Dimension-Free Foundation Models
nodes.tldr: A dimension-agnostic parameter-sharing architecture that lets PDE foundation models train and generalize across varying spatial dimensionalities, including unseen dimensions.
nodes.problem: PDE foundation models struggle with systems of varying dimensionality, requiring fixed maximum dimension or separate encoders.
nodes.approach: Axial neural networks with axis-permutation-equivariant parameter sharing, converting existing PDE foundation models.
nodes.niche_reason: Dimension-free PDE foundation models are a rare direction.

nodes.title: Beyond Scalar Rewards: An Axiomatic Framework for Lexicographic MDPs
nodes.tldr: Shows when MDP preferences cannot be captured by scalar rewards, characterizes the needed lexicographic vector rewards, and studies optimal policies.
nodes.problem: Whether MDP preferences can always be represented by scalar rewards.
nodes.approach: Axiomatic utility theory extended to lexicographic vector-valued utilities, with characterization theorems.
nodes.niche_reason: Axiomatic utility-theory angle on MDP rewards is unusual.

nodes.title: Knowledge Insulating Vision-Language-Action Models: Train Fast, Run Fast, Generalize Better
nodes.tldr: Shows that adding continuous flow-matching action experts to VLAs harms VLM knowledge and training speed, and proposes insulating the VLM backbone to fix it.
nodes.problem: Real-time continuous control modules may degrade a pretrained VLM's semantic knowledge in VLAs.
nodes.approach: Analysis of action-expert design choices and a backbone-insulation training technique.
nodes.niche_reason: VLA training recipes are a crowded, fast-moving area.

nodes.title: The Hawthorne Effect in Reasoning Models: Evaluating and Steering Test Awareness
nodes.tldr: Quantifies how test awareness alters reasoning LLMs' behavior on safety tasks, using linear probes to identify and steer awareness-related activations.
nodes.problem: Reasoning LLMs may behave differently when they detect evaluation, undermining safety evaluations.
nodes.approach: White-box probing to find awareness directions and steering toward or away from them.
nodes.primary_topic: Trustworthy ML › AI Safety & Alignment Research
secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › Language Model Interpretability
nodes.niche_reason: Evaluation awareness is an emerging, specialised safety topic.

nodes.title: ESCA: Contextualizing Embodied Agents via Scene-Graph Generation

nodes.title: Affine-Invariant Global Non-Asymptotic Convergence Analysis of BFGS under Self-Concordance

nodes.title: Angular Steering: Behavior Control via Rotation in Activation Space

nodes.title: High-Performance Arithmetic Circuit Optimization via Differentiable Architecture Search

nodes.title: GnnXemplar: Exemplars to Explanations - Natural Language Rules for Global GNN Interpretability

nodes.title: Neural Entropy

nodes.title: OpenWorldSAM: Extending SAM2 for Universal Image Segmentation with Language Prompts
