nodes.title: HealthGPT: A Medical Large Vision-Language Model for Unifying Comprehension and Generation via Heterogeneous Knowledge Adaptation
nodes.tldr: Presents HealthGPT, a medical vision-language model that unifies image understanding and generation via heterogeneous low-rank adaptation and a new medical dataset.
nodes.problem: Medical vision-language models typically handle comprehension but not generation together.
nodes.approach: Heterogeneous LoRA, hierarchical visual perception, and a three-stage learning strategy on a new dataset.
nodes.niche_reason: Unified medical comprehension and generation is specialised but emerging.

nodes.title: Scaling Laws for Task-Optimized Models of the Primate Visual Ventral Stream
nodes.tldr: Evaluates over 600 models to study scaling laws for brain alignment with primate ventral stream, finding behavioral alignment keeps scaling while neural alignment saturates.
nodes.problem: How scaling compute, model and data size affects alignment with primate visual cortex and behavior.

nodes.niche_reason: Scaling laws for neuroscience alignment is a rare cross-disciplinary angle.

nodes.title: Retrieval-Augmented Perception: High-resolution Image Perception Meets Visual RAG
nodes.tldr: Training-free method that retrieves and fuses high-resolution image crops for multimodal LLMs, preserving spatial layout and adaptively choosing the crop count.

nodes.title: A Unified Theoretical Analysis of Private and Robust Offline Alignment: from RLHF to DPO

nodes.title: Learning the RoPEs: Better 2D and 3D Position Encodings with STRING
nodes.tldr: STRING generalizes rotary position encodings to separable, exactly translation-invariant encodings for 2D and 3D token coordinates, improving vision transformers and robotics controllers.

nodes.title: Monte Carlo Tree Diffusion for System 2 Planning

nodes.title: Weakly-Supervised Contrastive Learning for Imprecise Class Labels
nodes.tldr: A graph-theoretic weakly supervised contrastive method uses iteratively refined semantic similarity instead of imprecise labels, and improves noisy and partial label learning.

nodes.title: Position: Don't Use the CLT in LLM Evals With Fewer Than a Few Hundred Datapoints
nodes.tldr: Argues CLT-based error bars underestimate uncertainty for LLM evaluations on small benchmarks, and recommends frequentist and Bayesian alternatives.

nodes.title: PASS: Private Attributes Protection with Stochastic Data Substitution

nodes.title: Foundation Model Insights and a Multi-Model Approach for Superior Fine-Grained One-shot Subset Selection

nodes.title: Privacy Amplification by Structured Subsampling for Deep Differentially Private Time Series Forecasting
nodes.tldr: Shows DP-SGD's amplification analysis does not fit forecasting, and proves tight event- and user-level guarantees for structured subsampling.

nodes.niche_reason: Privacy amplification for structured time-series batches is specialised

nodes.title: Video Prediction Policy: A Generalist Robot Policy with Predictive Visual Representations
nodes.tldr: Trains a robot policy that infers actions from predicted future representations inside a fine-tuned video diffusion model, improving generalist manipulation.

nodes.title: No Soundness in the Real World: On the Challenges of the Verification of Deployed Neural Networks

nodes.title: Efficient and Separate Authentication Image Steganography Network
nodes.tldr: Hides multiple secret images in one cover image with per-recipient lock-key authentication, using a single network to keep capacity and model size efficient.
nodes.problem: Multi-recipient steganography lacks authentication, and adding it reduces hiding capacity

nodes.title: Investigating Non-Transitivity in LLM-as-a-Judge
nodes.tldr: Shows LLM judges give non-transitive pairwise preferences that distort rankings, and proposes round-robin Bradley-Terry and Swim tournaments for more reliable rankings.

nodes.niche_reason: LLM-as-judge evaluation is a crowded area.

nodes.title: Position: Not All Explanations for Deep Learning Phenomena Are Equally Valuable

nodes.title: Sanity Checking Causal Representation Learning on a Simple Real-World System

nodes.niche_reason: Physical-experiment benchmark for causal representation learning is unusual.

nodes.title: TabFlex: Scaling Tabular Learning to Millions with Linear Attention
nodes.tldr: Replaces quadratic attention in TabPFN with linear attention so in-context tabular classification scales to millions of samples.

nodes.niche_reason: scaling tabular foundation models is a common direction

nodes.title: Discovering Symbolic Cognitive Models from Human and Animal Behavior

nodes.title: Masked Autoencoders Are Effective Tokenizers for Diffusion Models

nodes.title: Learning with Exact Invariances in Polynomial Time

nodes.title: Position: The Categorization of Race in ML is a Flawed Premise
nodes.tldr: Argues that rigid racial categories in ML are US-centric, oversimplify identity and erase mixed-race people, and proposes research beyond categorical race variables.

nodes.title: Position: We Need An Algorithmic Understanding of Generative AI
nodes.tldr: Position paper proposing AlgEval, a framework to uncover the algorithms LLMs learn, illustrated with circuit-level analysis of emergent search.

nodes.title: Strategy Coopetition Explains the Emergence and Transience of In-Context Learning

nodes.title: General framework for online-to-nonconvex conversion: Schedule-free SGD is also effective for nonconvex optimization

nodes.title: Where is the Truth? The Risk of Getting Confounded in a Continual World
nodes.tldr: Formalises confounders that change across tasks in continual learning, shows sequential training makes spurious correlations harder to avoid, and introduces the CLEVR-based ConCon dataset.

nodes.title: AutoGFM: Automated Graph Foundation Model with Adaptive Architecture Customization
nodes.tldr: AutoGFM applies graph neural architecture search to graph foundation models, using invariant-guided architecture customization and curriculum to adapt architectures per domain and task.

nodes.title: Sharp Generalization for Nonparametric Regression by Over-Parameterized Neural Networks: A Distribution-Free Analysis in Spherical Covariate

nodes.title: Position: Generative AI Regulation Can Learn from Social Media Regulation
nodes.tldr: Argues generative AI regulation should draw on social media regulation experience, offering four recommendations on bias, trust and safety, computational social science, and global perspective.

nodes.title: CodeIO: Condensing Reasoning Patterns via Code Input-Output Prediction
nodes.tldr: Trains LLMs to predict code inputs/outputs as natural-language chain-of-thought, distilling broad reasoning patterns from code and improving diverse reasoning benchmarks.

nodes.title: Position: Principles of Animal Cognition to Improve LLM Evaluations

nodes.title: Feature Learning beyond the Lazy-Rich Dichotomy: Insights from Representational Geometry
nodes.tldr: Analyzes feature learning through the geometry of task-relevant representational manifolds, revealing learning stages and strategies beyond the lazy versus rich regime dichotomy.

nodes.title: Stronger Neyman Regret Guarantees for Adaptive Experimental Design
nodes.tldr: Designs adaptive experiments with sublinear Neyman regret, achieving logarithmic anytime regret and multigroup guarantees for treatment-effect estimation.

nodes.title: Functional Alignment Can Mislead: Examining Model Stitching
nodes.tldr: Shows model stitching succeeds even between models trained on different tasks, modalities, or clustered noise, so functional alignment does not imply similar represented information.

nodes.title: Position: Human Baselines in Model Evaluations Need Rigor and Transparency (With Recommendations & Reporting Checklist)

nodes.title: ActionPiece: Contextually Tokenizing Action Sequences for Generative Recommendation

nodes.title: On the Benefits of Active Data Collection in Operator Learning

nodes.title: MCU: An Evaluation Framework for Open-Ended Game Agents

nodes.title: Instance Correlation Graph-based Naive Bayes

nodes.title: Automatically Identify and Rectify: Robust Deep Contrastive Multi-view Clustering in Noisy Scenarios

nodes.title: Neural Encoding and Decoding at Scale
nodes.tldr: NEDS is a multimodal multi-task masked model doing neural encoding and decoding jointly, pretrained on multi-animal recordings, enabling bidirectional prediction between neural activity and behavior.
nodes.problem: Existing large-scale models handle only encoding or only decoding of neural activity and behavior, not both.
nodes.approach: Transformer with multi-task masking alternating neural, behavioral, within- and cross-modality masks, pretrained on IBL data.
nodes.niche_reason: Neural population foundation models are a rare niche.

nodes.title: Accelerating LLM Inference with Lossless Speculative Decoding Algorithms for Heterogeneous Vocabularies
nodes.tldr: Three lossless speculative decoding methods that let any off-the-shelf model draft for a target model with a different vocabulary, with no retraining.
nodes.problem: Speculative decoding needs drafter and target to share a vocabulary, which limits drafter choice.
nodes.approach: Three vocabulary-alignment algorithms that keep the target distribution exactly, using no extra training.
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › Efficient LLM Inference & Architectures
nodes.niche_reason: Speculative decoding is a crowded inference topic; cross-vocabulary is a twist

nodes.title: Latent Diffusion Planning for Imitation Learning
nodes.tldr: Imitation learning with a latent-space diffusion planner trained on action-free data and a diffusion inverse dynamics model trained on suboptimal data.
nodes.problem: Imitation learning needs many expert demonstrations and cannot exploit action-free or suboptimal data.
nodes.approach: VAE latent space, diffusion planner for future states plus diffusion inverse dynamics model, trained separately.
nodes.niche_reason: Diffusion-based imitation learning is a common direction.

nodes.title: ABKD: Pursuing a Proper Allocation of the Probability Mass in Knowledge Distillation via $\alpha$-$\beta$-Divergence
nodes.tldr: Generalizes forward and reverse KL for knowledge distillation with an alpha-beta divergence that balances how student probability mass concentrates on teacher modes.
nodes.problem: Forward and reverse KL distillation misallocate probability mass between hardness and confidence effects.
nodes.approach: Alpha-beta divergence interpolating smoothly between forward and reverse KL.
nodes.primary_topic: Architectures & Training › Efficient Training, Compression & Pruning
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Optimal Transport & Divergences
nodes.niche_reason: Distillation divergence design is a common, crowded theme.

nodes.title: Mitigating Object Hallucination in Large Vision-Language Models via Image-Grounded Guidance
nodes.tldr: MARINE reduces object hallucination in vision-language models at inference time, training-free and API-free, by guiding generation with object information from open-source vision models.
nodes.problem: Large vision-language models hallucinate non-existent objects, and fixes need training or proprietary APIs.
nodes.approach: Inference-time image-grounded guidance using object-level outputs from open-source vision models, combinable across models.
nodes.niche_reason: Hallucination mitigation in LVLMs is very common.

nodes.title: Beyond the Permutation Symmetry of Transformers: The Role of Rotation for Model Fusion
nodes.tldr: Introduces continuous rotation symmetry in transformer attention parameters and uses it for theoretically optimal parameter matching to improve model fusion.
nodes.problem: Permutation symmetry is too limited for aligning transformer parameters during model fusion.
nodes.approach: Rotate attention parameter matrices to expand the equivalence set, with an optimal matching algorithm.
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Deep Learning Theory
nodes.niche_reason: Parameter-space symmetry for merging is established but specialised.

nodes.title: Mixture of Lookup Experts
nodes.tldr: Re-parameterizes MoE experts as lookup tables offloaded to storage, giving dense-model-like inference speed with MoE-level performance.
nodes.problem: MoE experts must sit in VRAM, and offloading them adds large inference latency.
nodes.approach: Train FFN experts on embedding outputs, then precompute them as token-indexed lookup tables.
nodes.primary_topic: Architectures & Training › Mixture of Experts & Sparsity
secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › Efficient LLM Inference & Architectures
nodes.niche_reason: Lookup-table reparameterized experts are an unusual efficiency angle.

nodes.title: Learning to (Learn at Test Time): RNNs with Expressive Hidden States
nodes.tldr: Turns an RNN hidden state into a learned model updated by self-supervised steps at test time, giving linear-complexity long-context layers.
nodes.problem: RNN layers scale linearly but their hidden states limit performance on long context versus Transformers.
nodes.approach: Hidden state is a linear model or two-layer MLP, updated by a self-supervised learning step per token.
nodes.primary_topic: Architectures & Training › State-Space Models & Linear Attention
secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › Long Context & Memory
nodes.niche_reason: Test-time training layers are a novel but growing sequence-model direction

nodes.title: Nonparametric Teaching for Graph Property Learners
nodes.tldr: GraNT reframes GCN training as nonparametric teaching, selecting graph-property examples to cut training time by 30-47% without hurting generalization.
nodes.problem: Training graph property learners like GCNs is costly.
nodes.approach: Teacher selects example subsets using functional gradient descent view of structure-aware nonparametric learners.
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Kernels, GPs & Nonparametrics
Architectures & Training › Efficient Training, Compression & Pruning
nodes.niche_reason: Nonparametric teaching for graph learners is very rare.

nodes.title: FlashTP: Fused, Sparsity-Aware Tensor Product for Machine Learning Interatomic Potentials
nodes.tldr: FlashTP is a fused, sparsity-aware tensor-product library that speeds up equivariant interatomic potentials and cuts their memory use.
nodes.problem: The tensor-product layer of equivariant MLIPs dominates training time and memory.
nodes.approach: Kernel fusion, sparse computation, and path-aggregated execution of the tensor product.
nodes.niche_reason: Specialised GPU kernels for equivariant force fields.

nodes.title: From Weight-Based to State-Based Fine-Tuning: Further Memory Reduction on LoRA with Parallel Control
nodes.tldr: Tunes forward states within residual blocks instead of weights, cutting memory and compute below LoRA while matching or improving accuracy on ViT and LLaMA.
nodes.problem: Weight-centric LoRA still stores large intermediate activations, limiting memory savings during fine-tuning.
nodes.approach: Parameterized perturbations to states across a residual block, avoiding storage of large intermediate states.
secondary_topics: Architectures & Training › Efficient Training, Compression & Pruning
nodes.niche_reason: State-based tuning is a novel angle on a crowded PEFT area

nodes.title: Relational Invariant Learning for Robust Solvation Free Energy Prediction
nodes.tldr: RILOOD improves out-of-distribution solvation free energy prediction with mixup-based environment modeling, multi-granularity refinement and invariant learning on molecular graphs.
nodes.problem: Poor OOD generalization of GNNs predicting molecular solvation free energy.
nodes.approach: Mixup conditional modeling, multi-granularity substructure refinement and invariant relational learning.
secondary_topics: Architectures & Training › Domain Adaptation & OOD Generalization
nodes.niche_reason: Molecular property OOD learning is specialised.

nodes.title: SWE-Lancer: Can Frontier LLMs Earn $1 Million from Real-World Freelance Software Engineering?
nodes.tldr: Benchmarks LLMs on 1400+ real Upwork freelance software tasks worth $1M, covering independent coding and managerial choice, mapping performance to monetary value.
nodes.problem: Unclear whether frontier LLMs can perform real-world freelance software engineering work.
nodes.approach: Triple-verified end-to-end tests for coding tasks and comparison with hired managers' decisions.
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › LLM Evaluation & Benchmarks
secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › Code Generation & Software
nodes.niche_reason: Coding-agent benchmarks are a crowded direction.

nodes.title: AffectGPT: A New Dataset, Model, and Benchmark for Emotion Understanding with Multimodal Large Language Models
nodes.tldr: Introduces MER-Caption, a 115K-sample descriptive emotion dataset, the AffectGPT multimodal LLM with pre-fusion, and MER-UniBench for MLLM-based emotion understanding.
nodes.problem: Lack of large descriptive emotion datasets and multimodal-centric models for MLLM-based emotion recognition.
nodes.approach: Model-based crowd-sourced annotation dataset, pre-fusion MLLM architecture, and unified benchmark with tailored metrics.
secondary_topics: Audio, Speech & Multimodal › Audio-Visual & Cross-modal Learning
nodes.niche_reason: Emotion understanding with MLLMs is a specialised application niche.

nodes.title: Novelty Detection in Reinforcement Learning with World Models
nodes.tldr: Detects sudden environment changes in world-model RL agents by using the mismatch between hallucinated and observed states as a novelty score with bounding approaches.
nodes.problem: World-model RL agents degrade when environment mechanics or visuals suddenly change, and need novelty detection.
nodes.approach: Use misalignment between world-model predicted states and true observations as a bounded novelty score.
nodes.primary_topic: Reinforcement Learning › Model-Based RL & World Models
nodes.niche_reason: Novelty detection inside world-model RL is a rare topic.

nodes.title: Covered Forest: Fine-grained generalization analysis of graph neural networks
nodes.tldr: Extends graph-similarity theory to bound MPNN generalization, showing how graph structure, aggregation and loss choice affect generalization, supported by experiments.
nodes.problem: Generalization of MPNNs is poorly understood and often ignores graph structure.
nodes.approach: Graph-similarity (Weisfeiler-Leman) analysis yielding fine-grained bounds for general aggregations and losses.
nodes.primary_topic: Learning Theory & Optimization › Generalization & Statistical Learning
nodes.niche_reason: Fine-grained GNN generalization theory is specialised.

nodes.title: Addressing Misspecification in Simulation-based Inference through Data-driven Calibration
nodes.tldr: RoPE handles misspecified simulators in simulation-based inference by using a small real calibration set and optimal transport to model the misspecification gap.
nodes.problem: Model misspecification harms the reliability of simulation-based inference when only imperfect simulators are available.
nodes.approach: Learn representations of real and simulated data, use optimal transport to model the misspecification gap with a calibration set.
nodes.primary_topic: Learning Theory & Optimization › Probabilistic & Bayesian Methods
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Optimal Transport & Divergences
nodes.niche_reason: Misspecification-robust simulation-based inference is a rare specialised niche.

nodes.title: Learning with Expected Signatures: Theory and Applications
nodes.tldr: Proves convergence of discrete-time expected signature estimators to continuous-time values and gives a lower-variance estimator for martingale data, improving prediction on sequences.
nodes.problem: Gap between empirical discrete-time expected signature estimators and their continuous-time theoretical values.
nodes.approach: Convergence proofs plus a modified estimator for martingale processes with lower mean squared error.
nodes.primary_topic: Learning Theory & Optimization › Probabilistic & Bayesian Methods
secondary_topics: Architectures & Training › Time Series & Sequential Data
nodes.niche_reason: Rough-path signature methods are very rare in mainstream ML.

nodes.title: VideoJAM: Joint Appearance-Motion Representations for Enhanced Motion Generation in Video Models
nodes.tldr: VideoJAM trains video generators to predict both pixels and motion from a joint representation and uses Inner-Guidance at inference, improving motion coherence in generated videos.
nodes.problem: Pixel reconstruction objectives bias video models toward appearance over motion coherence.
nodes.approach: Joint appearance-motion prediction objective plus inference-time Inner-Guidance using the model's own motion prediction.
nodes.niche_reason: Video diffusion improvements are a crowded area.

nodes.title: P(all-atom) Is Unlocking New Path For Protein Design
nodes.tldr: Pallatom generates protein structures with all-atom coordinates by modeling the joint distribution of structure and sequence through a dual-track token and atom architecture.
nodes.problem: Protein generation models treat sequence and structure separately, missing their interdependence and side-chain detail.
nodes.approach: Dual-track token-level and atomic-level representations, with recycling, plus an atom14 representation that unifies unknown side-chain coordinates.
nodes.confidence_reason: Primary is clear; the secondary topic choice is a judgment call.
nodes.niche_reason: All-atom protein generation is an active, moderately specialised niche.

nodes.title: Improved Regret Analysis in Gaussian Process Bandits: Optimality for Noiseless Reward, RKHS norm, and Non-Stationary Variance
nodes.tldr: Tighter regret bounds for Gaussian process bandits, including near-optimal noiseless regret, RKHS-norm-optimal bounds, and time-varying noise, via an improved maximum posterior variance bound.
nodes.problem: Existing GP bandit regret analyses are suboptimal in noiseless, RKHS-norm, and non-stationary noise settings.
nodes.approach: Improved maximum posterior variance bound used to refine MVR and phased elimination algorithms.
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Kernels, GPs & Nonparametrics
nodes.niche_reason: Kernelized bandit regret theory is a narrow theoretical subfield.

nodes.title: Beyond Matryoshka: Revisiting Sparse Coding for Adaptive Representation
nodes.tldr: Maps pretrained embeddings into a sparse high-dimensional space with autoencoding and contrastive loss, giving flexible-cost retrieval that beats Matryoshka embeddings.
nodes.problem: Adaptive-length embeddings need full retraining in Matryoshka methods and degrade at short lengths.
nodes.approach: Lightweight sparse autoencoder over frozen embeddings with task-aware contrastive objectives.
secondary_topics: Architectures & Training › Mixture of Experts & Sparsity
nodes.confidence_reason: Sparse-coding representation method; could also fit efficient or sparsity topics
nodes.niche_reason: Adaptive embedding and sparse autoencoder area is established but specialised

nodes.title: Cross-environment Cooperation Enables Zero-shot Multi-agent Coordination
nodes.tldr: Trains RL agents on huge procedurally generated coordination tasks with one partner, yielding general cooperative skills that transfer zero-shot to new partners and humans.
nodes.problem: Agents trained on single cooperative tasks fail to coordinate with new partners on new problems.
nodes.approach: Cross-Environment Cooperation: RL over billions of Jax-generated environments with one partner.
secondary_topics: Reinforcement Learning › Transfer, Meta & Continual RL
nodes.niche_reason: Zero-shot coordination is established but specialised.

nodes.title: Data-Juicer Sandbox: A Feedback-Driven Suite for Multimodal Data-Model Co-development
nodes.tldr: An open-source sandbox suite with a Probe-Analyze-Refine workflow for co-developing multimodal data and models, validated on CLIP, LLaVA-like, and text-to-video models.
nodes.problem: Data-centric and model-centric multimodal development are isolated, yielding inefficient iteration.
nodes.approach: Feedback-driven sandbox running cheap experiments to probe, analyze and refine data and models together.
nodes.primary_topic: Data, Benchmarks & Evaluation › Synthetic Data & Data Curation
nodes.confidence_reason: Part system/toolkit, part data curation methodology; topic is a judgment call.
nodes.niche_reason: Data-centric multimodal tooling is established but specialised.

nodes.title: Lightweight Protocols for Distributed Private Quantile Estimation
nodes.tldr: Gives adaptive local-DP and shuffle-DP protocols for quantile estimation that need fewer users than prior work, with matching lower bounds for adaptive LDP.
nodes.problem: Private quantile estimation across users needs many users when queried non-adaptively.
nodes.approach: Adaptive single-query LDP and shuffle-DP protocols over a bounded domain, with lower bounds.
nodes.niche_reason: Adaptive private quantile protocols are a rare niche.

nodes.title: On the Tension between Byzantine Robustness and No-Attack Accuracy in Distributed Learning
nodes.tldr: Proves robust aggregators worsen aggregation error and convergence rates when no attack occurs, revealing a tension between Byzantine robustness and no-attack accuracy.
nodes.problem: Cost of Byzantine-robust aggregation when no Byzantine workers are present.
nodes.approach: Worst-case aggregation error analysis and tight convergence lower bounds for non-convex and PL objectives.
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Learning Theory Lower Bounds & Complexity
nodes.niche_reason: Byzantine-robust distributed learning theory is a narrow niche.

nodes.title: From Mechanistic Interpretability to Mechanistic Biology: Training, Evaluating, and Interpreting Sparse Autoencoders on Protein Language Models
nodes.tldr: Trains sparse autoencoders on ESM-2 protein language model activations, finding generic and family-specific features and recovering known determinants of thermostability and localisation.
nodes.problem: Protein language models are powerful, but their learned features and biological meaning are poorly understood.
nodes.approach: Sparse autoencoders on residual-stream features, characterised and probed linearly for functional properties.
secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › Language Model Interpretability
nodes.niche_reason: SAEs on protein LMs for biology discovery is rare

nodes.title: Exploring and Mitigating Adversarial Manipulation of Voting-Based Leaderboards
nodes.tldr: Shows an attacker can manipulate Chatbot Arena-style voting leaderboards with about a thousand votes by identifying which model produced a reply, and proposes mitigations.
nodes.problem: Voting-based LLM leaderboards may be vulnerable to adversarial manipulation without bot protection.
nodes.approach: De-anonymize model responses with over 95 percent accuracy then vote strategically; implement defenses with Arena developers.
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › LLM Evaluation & Benchmarks
secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › LLM Safety & Jailbreaks
nodes.niche_reason: Security of human-vote leaderboards is a rare angle.

nodes.title: Score-of-Mixture Training: One-Step Generative Model Training Made Simple via Score Estimation of Mixture Distributions
nodes.tldr: Trains one-step generators by minimizing alpha-skew Jensen-Shannon divergence via score estimation of real-fake mixtures, with a distillation variant from diffusion models.
nodes.problem: Training one-step generators stably usually needs adversarial or complicated distillation schemes.
nodes.approach: Estimate the score of real-fake mixtures across noise levels and minimize skew Jensen-Shannon divergence.
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Optimal Transport & Divergences
nodes.confidence_reason: Blends diffusion score estimation with divergence-based one-step training.
nodes.niche_reason: One-step diffusion distillation is a crowded area.

nodes.title: RAGEN-2: Reasoning Collapse in Agentic RL
nodes.tldr: Identifies template collapse in multi-turn LLM agent RL, diagnoses it with a mutual-information proxy, and fixes it with SNR-aware prompt filtering.
nodes.problem: Entropy-stable RL agents can collapse into input-agnostic boilerplate that entropy metrics miss
nodes.approach: Mutual-information proxy for cross-input distinguishability plus filtering high-reward-variance prompts each iteration.
nodes.primary_topic: Reinforcement Learning › RL for LLMs & Reasoning
secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › Agents & Tool Use
nodes.confidence_reason: Diagnostic and method mix; RL-for-LLMs vs agents is a judgment call
nodes.niche_reason: Input-dependence diagnosis for agentic RL is a specialised angle

nodes.title: The Tell-Tale Norm: $\ell_2$ Magnitude as a Signal for Reasoning Dynamics in Large Language Models
nodes.tldr: Shows hidden-state l2 norm signals LLM layer-wise reasoning intensity, bounds sparse autoencoder reasoning feature activation, and uses it for three training-free test-time scaling techniques.
nodes.problem: No principled model-intrinsic signal captures layer-wise reasoning dynamics in LLMs.
nodes.approach: Probe with SAEs, prove norm bounds feature activation, then use norm for layer recursion, steering and response selection.
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › Language Model Interpretability
nodes.niche_reason: LLM reasoning plus interpretability is a busy area.

nodes.title: Steer Like the LLM: Activation Steering that Mimics Prompting
nodes.tldr: Learns position-specific activation steering coefficients that imitate prompt-based interventions, approaching or exceeding prompt steering while staying interpretable.
nodes.problem: Activation steering usually underperforms prompt-based steering of LLMs.
nodes.approach: Position-specific steering coefficients trained to distill prompt-induced activation interventions.
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › Language Model Interpretability
secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › In-context Learning & Prompting
nodes.confidence_reason: Activation steering sits between interpretability and prompting.
nodes.niche_reason: Activation steering that imitates prompting; specialised LLM control niche.

nodes.title: Latent Spherical Flow Policy for Reinforcement Learning with Combinatorial Actions
nodes.tldr: Learns a stochastic latent spherical flow policy that uses a combinatorial solver to guarantee feasible actions, with a smoothed Bellman operator for stable learning.
nodes.problem: Combinatorial action spaces are exponentially large with complex feasibility constraints.
nodes.approach: Spherical flow matching in latent space, solver-decoded actions, and a smoothed Bellman operator.
nodes.primary_topic: Reinforcement Learning › Online & Deep RL Algorithms
nodes.niche_reason: Generative policies with solver-based feasibility for combinatorial RL is rare.

nodes.title: Protein Autoregressive Modeling via Multiscale Structure Generation
nodes.tldr: Generates protein backbones coarse-to-fine by next-scale autoregressive prediction, with a flow-based decoder, noisy context learning, and zero-shot motif scaffolding.
nodes.problem: Autoregressive protein backbone generation suffers exposure bias from train-generation mismatch.
nodes.approach: Multi-scale autoregressive transformer with a flow-based backbone decoder, trained with noisy context and scheduled sampling.
nodes.niche_reason: Protein backbone autoregressive generation is specialised.

nodes.title: Catch-22: On the Fundamental Tradeoff Between Detectability and Robustness in LLM Watermarking
nodes.tldr: Gives an information-theoretic framework showing a trilemma between robustness, stealth and detectability in LLM watermarking, and proposes a hybrid scheme choosing the Pareto-optimal watermark per edit regime.
nodes.problem: Fundamental tradeoff between watermark robustness to edits and detectability by keyless observers is not characterized.
nodes.approach: Additive KL information measure yielding bounds, plus hybrid strategy over distribution-preserving, semantic, token-level schemes.
nodes.niche_reason: Information-theoretic watermark limits are specialised.

nodes.title: Enhancing Reasoning for Diffusion LLMs via Distribution Matching Policy Optimization
nodes.tldr: DMPO fine-tunes diffusion LLMs for reasoning with RL by matching the policy to a reward-tilted target distribution through cross-entropy, without supervised fine-tuning.
nodes.problem: Existing RL algorithms are poorly suited to diffusion LLMs, which lag autoregressive models on reasoning.
nodes.approach: Distribution-matching cross-entropy objective with a weight-baseline subtraction that stabilizes training at small batch sizes.
nodes.primary_topic: Reinforcement Learning › RL for LLMs & Reasoning
nodes.niche_reason: RL for diffusion LLMs is an emerging, less-explored variant of LLM RL.

nodes.title: Mixtures Closest To A Given Measure: A Semidefinite Programming Approach
nodes.tldr: Approximates a target measure known through its moments by mixtures from a parametric family via a semidefinite relaxation hierarchy with convergence guarantees, applied to clustering.
nodes.problem: Determining mixture order and parameters when the target is given only through finitely many moments.
nodes.approach: Moment-SOS hierarchy of semidefinite relaxations minimizing W2 or total variation distance over semi-algebraic parameter sets.
nodes.primary_topic: Learning Theory & Optimization › Probabilistic & Bayesian Methods
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Optimal Transport & Divergences
nodes.niche_reason: Algebraic moment-based optimization approach to mixtures is very rare.

nodes.title: LIMSSR: LLM-Driven Sequence-to-Score Reasoning under Training-Time Incomplete Multimodal Observations
nodes.tldr: Handles missing modalities during training by having an LLM impute latent semantics from available context, scoring action quality without full-modal training data.
nodes.problem: Multimodal models need full-modal training data for reconstruction supervision, which is often unavailable.
nodes.approach: LLM prompt-guided modality imputation and mask-aware dual-path aggregation to calibrate uncertainty.
nodes.primary_topic: Audio, Speech & Multimodal › Audio-Visual & Cross-modal Learning
nodes.confidence_reason: Missing-modality imputation with an LLM straddles multimodal and LLM topics
nodes.niche_reason: Incomplete multimodal learning is specialised; LLM-based imputation is a newer twist

nodes.title: Solving Time-Dependent Differential Equations with Physical Dynamical Systems
nodes.tldr: Solves time-dependent differential equations with dynamical system machines using continuous physical evolution, reaching high accuracy ~1000x faster than baselines.
nodes.problem: Time-discretized TDDE solvers force a latency-accuracy trade-off, and prior DSMs miss spatiotemporal complexity.
nodes.approach: Excitatory-inhibitory-inspired coupling, state-aware dynamic nonlinearity, and hierarchical temporal integration in a DSM.
nodes.confidence_reason: Physical dynamical-system computing overlaps hardware and PDE solving.
nodes.niche_reason: Physical dynamical-system computing for differential equations is very rare.

nodes.title: Unsupervised Partner Design Enables Robust Ad-hoc Teamwork
nodes.tldr: Unsupervised Partner Design generates training partners on the fly and picks them by learnability, giving robust ad-hoc teamwork without pre-trained partner populations.
nodes.problem: Ad-hoc teamwork agents need diverse partners but population-based training is costly and requires tuning.
nodes.approach: Population-free on-the-fly partner generation selected by a learnability criterion, extendable to joint partner-environment selection.
secondary_topics: Reinforcement Learning › Transfer, Meta & Continual RL
nodes.niche_reason: Ad-hoc teamwork is established but specialised.

nodes.title: ClinTutor-R1: Advancing Scalable and Robust One-to-Many Alignment in Clinical Socratic Education
nodes.tldr: ClinTutor-R1 is a multimodal agent for one-to-many clinical Socratic teaching, built with a multi-agent simulator and dialogue dataset, modeling individual and group beliefs.
nodes.problem: LLM tutors handle one-on-one teaching but fail at one-to-many settings like clinical ward rounds.
nodes.approach: Multi-agent pedagogical simulator, Socratic dialogue dataset, and an agent with explicit thinking over individual and group belief states.
secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › Agents & Tool Use
nodes.confidence_reason: Mixes education application, multi-agent simulator, dataset, and agent training.
nodes.niche_reason: Group-based clinical tutoring agents are a rare application.

nodes.title: Quantifying Frontier LLM Capabilities for Container Sandbox Escape
nodes.tldr: SandboxEscapeBench is an open CTF benchmark that measures whether LLM agents can escape container sandboxes, finding they exploit added vulnerabilities.
nodes.problem: Autonomous LLM agents create security risks that sandbox containment must withstand.
nodes.approach: Nested-sandbox Inspect AI capture-the-flag evaluation spanning misconfigurations and kernel flaws.
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › LLM Evaluation & Benchmarks
secondary_topics: Trustworthy ML › AI Safety & Alignment Research
nodes.niche_reason: Sandbox escape evaluation for LLM agents is a rare, security-focused angle.

nodes.title: LiftQuant: Continuous Bit-Width LLM via Dimensional Lifting and Projection
nodes.tldr: Compresses LLM weights to continuous bit-widths by lifting vectors to a higher dimension and projecting a 1-bit lattice, fitting memory budgets precisely.
nodes.problem: Integer bit-widths create a deployment gap, so LLMs cannot be fitted optimally to specific memory budgets.
nodes.approach: Lift-then-project: lattice projection from a higher-dimensional space, using only linear maps and 1-bit quantizers.
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › Efficient LLM Inference & Architectures
secondary_topics: Architectures & Training › Efficient Training, Compression & Pruning
nodes.niche_reason: Weight quantization is a crowded mainstream area.

nodes.title: Base Models Know How to Reason, Thinking Models Learn When
nodes.tldr: Introduces constructive model diffing, finding that RL-trained thinking models mostly learn when to apply base-model reasoning mechanisms, while SFT-distilled models learn new mechanisms.
nodes.problem: Understanding what different training paradigms teach thinking language models relative to their base models.
nodes.approach: Decompose model diff into SAE-derived reasoning mechanism vectors and a heuristic classifier, building hybrid models measured by performance recovery.
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › Language Model Interpretability
nodes.niche_reason: Model diffing of reasoning models is a fresh but specialised interpretability angle.

nodes.title: From Abstraction to Instantiation: Learning Behavioral Representation for Vision-Language-Action Model
nodes.tldr: Learns temporally coherent behavior representations for VLA models using a causal Mamba encoder and phase-conditioned action decoder for robust manipulation.
nodes.problem: VLA policies degrade under distribution shift due to short-horizon, static behavior representations.
nodes.approach: Causal Mamba behavior encoder plus phase-conditioned decoder aligning priors with execution progress.
secondary_topics: Architectures & Training › State-Space Models & Linear Attention
nodes.niche_reason: VLA is crowded; behavior-representation angle is moderately specialised.

nodes.title: Rare Event Analysis of Large Language Models
nodes.tldr: Framework using large deviation theory and efficient sampling to estimate probabilities of rare but significant LLM behaviors, with error analysis.
nodes.problem: Rare but significant LLM behaviors are unseen in development yet likely in large-scale deployment
nodes.approach: Large-deviation theory with efficient generation, probability estimation and error analysis
secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › LLM Safety & Jailbreaks
nodes.confidence_reason: Evaluation method versus safety framing; abstract is general
nodes.niche_reason: LLM rare-event analysis via large deviations is rare

nodes.title: Towards Efficient LLMs Annealing with Principled Sample Selection
nodes.tldr: DiReCT selects annealing-phase pretraining samples by imposing Hessian-spectrum-based directional constraints on per-sample gradients, improving LLM final quality efficiently.
nodes.problem: Data selection during LLM annealing relies on heuristics without optimization-theoretic grounding.
nodes.approach: Constrained optimization selecting samples whose gradients satisfy eigen-direction constraints from loss-landscape curvature.
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › Pretraining, Scaling & Data
secondary_topics: Data, Benchmarks & Evaluation › Synthetic Data & Data Curation
nodes.niche_reason: Annealing-phase data selection is specialised within pretraining data work.

nodes.title: Beyond Log Likelihood: Probability-Based Objectives for Supervised Fine-Tuning across the Model Capability Continuum
nodes.tldr: Shows NLL is not always optimal for SFT: prior-leaning losses win for capable models, while NLL wins for weak ones.
nodes.problem: Standard SFT with negative log likelihood generalizes poorly after LLM post-training.
nodes.approach: Systematic comparison of probability-based objectives across model capability levels, with theory.
nodes.niche_reason: SFT objective tweaks are a crowded post-training area

nodes.title: Transformer Circuits Can Realize Clustering Algorithms
nodes.tldr: Specifies a transformer circuit, the k-means transformer, that exactly implements Lloyd's algorithm using standard attention, residual and feed-forward blocks, and learns clustering that surpasses Lloyd's.
nodes.problem: Whether transformers can implement and learn exact algorithmic computations such as clustering.
nodes.approach: Construct transformer circuits realizing Lloyd's k-means, prove correctness, train, and vary architecture for variants.
secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › In-context Learning & Prompting
nodes.niche_reason: Exact algorithm realization by transformers for clustering is unusual.

nodes.title: Why Deep Jacobian Spectra Separate: Depth-Induced Scaling and Singular-Vector Alignment
nodes.tldr: Proves Lyapunov-exponent scaling of deep Jacobian singular values and shows strong depth-induced spectral separation, explaining implicit bias in deep networks.
nodes.problem: Singular-value dynamics of deep nonlinear networks lack tractable analysis beyond balanced linear models.
