nodes.tldr: Known symmetries do not make gradient descent learning of equivariant networks efficient; lower bounds show superpolynomial or exponential complexity in the CSQ model.
nodes.problem: Whether symmetry inductive bias makes gradient-based learning of neural nets tractable.
nodes.approach: Correlational statistical query lower bounds for GNNs, convolutional nets, invariant polynomials and frame-averaged networks.
nodes.primary_topic: Learning Theory & Optimization › Learning Theory Lower Bounds & Complexity
nodes.niche_reason: Hardness of symmetric learning is a rare theory angle.

nodes.title: Implicit regularization of deep residual networks towards neural ODEs
nodes.tldr: Proves deep residual networks initialized as discretized neural ODEs stay discretized under gradient-flow training, with convergence under a Polyak-Lojasiewicz condition.
nodes.problem: The theoretical link between discrete residual networks and continuous neural ODEs is unclear.
nodes.approach: Gradient-flow analysis showing implicit regularization towards ODE discretizations.
nodes.primary_topic: Learning Theory & Optimization › Deep Learning Theory
nodes.niche_reason: Residual network to neural ODE theory is an established but specialised topic.

nodes.title: Rotation Has Two Sides: Evaluating Data Augmentation for Deep One-class Classification
nodes.tldr: Finds rotation-prediction accuracy strongly tracks one-class classification performance, and proposes estimating the dataset's transformation distribution to select semantics-preserving augmentations.
nodes.problem: Rotation-based pseudo-anomalies work, but rotations already present in the dataset hurt representation learning.
nodes.approach: Two-stage method: contrastive pretraining, then density matching to select semantics-preserving samples from all rotations.
secondary_topics: Architectures & Training › Domain Adaptation & OOD Generalization
nodes.confidence_reason: One-class anomaly detection has no exact topic; self-supervised vs OOD is a judgment call.
nodes.niche_reason: One-class classification is a specialised, moderately active anomaly niche.

nodes.title: Ghost on the Shell: An Expressive Representation of General 3D Shapes
nodes.tldr: Represents non-watertight meshes by a manifold signed distance field on watertight templates, enabling differentiable reconstruction and generative modeling of open surfaces.
nodes.problem: Mesh representations handle only watertight shapes; open surfaces lack fast differentiable models.
nodes.approach: Manifold signed distance field defined on watertight templates, parametrized on a differentiable grid.
secondary_topics: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: Open, non-watertight surface modeling is a rare mesh-representation niche

nodes.title: Role of Locality and Weight Sharing in Image-Based Tasks: A Sample Complexity Separation between CNNs, LCNs, and FCNs
nodes.tldr: Proves for gradient-descent-like algorithms that CNNs need far fewer samples than locally connected or fully connected networks on a translation-invariant sparse-signal task.
nodes.problem: Quantifying the statistical benefit of locality and weight sharing in CNNs beyond upper bounds.
nodes.approach: Dynamic Signal Distribution task with separating lower bounds for orthogonally equivariant algorithms, plus information-theoretic tools.
nodes.primary_topic: Learning Theory & Optimization › Deep Learning Theory
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Learning Theory Lower Bounds & Complexity
nodes.niche_reason: Sample-complexity separations for CNN inductive bias are specialised theory.

nodes.title: How Well Do Supervised 3D Models Transfer to Medical Imaging Tasks?
nodes.tldr: Builds AbdomenAtlas 1.1, a 9,262-volume annotated 3D CT dataset, and shows supervised pretraining on it transfers well to medical segmentation.
nodes.problem: ImageNet pretraining is 2D and classification-oriented, so it transfers poorly to 3D medical segmentation.
nodes.approach: Large per-voxel annotated CT dataset used to train supervised 3D models for downstream transfer.
nodes.niche_reason: 3D medical pretraining transfer is specialised

nodes.title: Critical Learning Periods Emerge Even in Deep Linear Networks
nodes.tldr: Shows critical learning periods emerge in analytically tractable deep linear networks, depending on depth and data structure, and explains how pretraining can damage transfer.
nodes.problem: Why critical learning periods arise in biological and artificial networks and what they depend on.
nodes.approach: Analytical and simulation study of deep linear networks, source competition, and multi-task pretraining transfer.
nodes.primary_topic: Learning Theory & Optimization › Deep Learning Theory
nodes.niche_reason: Biology-inspired critical periods in tractable networks is an unusual angle.

nodes.title: Understanding Augmentation-based Self-Supervised Representation Learning via RKHS Approximation and Regression
nodes.tldr: Gives generalization bounds for augmentation-based self-supervised learning via RKHS approximation, introducing augmentation complexity to compare augmentations.
nodes.problem: The exact role of data augmentation in self-supervised representation learning is unclear.
nodes.approach: Isometry property analysis with RKHS regression bounds and augmentation complexity.
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Generalization & Statistical Learning
nodes.niche_reason: Augmentation theory for SSL is specialised

nodes.title: Learning Energy-Based Models by Cooperative Diffusion Recovery Likelihood
nodes.tldr: Cooperative diffusion recovery likelihood trains energy-based models at multiple noise levels with initializer models, greatly improving EBM sample quality and speed on CIFAR-10 and ImageNet.
nodes.problem: Energy-based models lag behind GANs and diffusion models in sample quality and are slow to train.
nodes.approach: Jointly train an EBM by recovery likelihood and an initializer whose samples are refined by short-run MCMC.
nodes.primary_topic: Generative Models › GANs, VAEs & Normalizing Flows
nodes.niche_reason: Energy-based model training is a rarer generative direction.

nodes.title: Hybrid Directional Graph Neural Network for Molecules
nodes.tldr: Introduces HDGNN, which combines strictly equivariant message passing with learnable modules to relax constraints, reaching state-of-the-art molecular property prediction on QM9 and OC20.
nodes.problem: Strictly equivariant GNN layers overly constrain function form and limit network flexibility for molecules.
nodes.approach: Hybrid architecture mixing strictly equivariant operations with learnable, non-equivariant modules.
nodes.niche_reason: Equivariant molecular GNNs are a crowded, mainstream area.

nodes.title: LMSYS-Chat-1M: A Large-Scale Real-World LLM Conversation Dataset
nodes.tldr: Releases LMSYS-Chat-1M, one million real-world conversations with 25 LLMs, and demonstrates uses in moderation, safety benchmarks and instruction tuning.
nodes.problem: Little public data on how people actually use LLMs in the wild.
nodes.approach: Curate and release a large logged chatbot conversation dataset with statistics and four use cases.
secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › LLM Safety & Jailbreaks
nodes.niche_reason: Real-world LLM interaction logs are specialised but increasingly common.

nodes.title: Accelerating Distributed Stochastic Optimization via Self-Repellent Random Walks
nodes.tldr: Uses a non-linear self-repellent random walk token in distributed stochastic approximation, proving almost-sure convergence and a CLT with asymptotic covariance shrinking as 1/alpha squared.
nodes.problem: Accelerating token-based distributed stochastic optimization driven by Markov chain sampling.
nodes.approach: Replace the linear Markov token with a self-repellent random walk and analyze via stochastic approximation and CLT.
nodes.niche_reason: Non-linear Markov chain tokens for distributed optimization are rare.

nodes.title: Fine-tuning Multimodal LLMs to Follow Zero-shot Demonstrative Instructions
nodes.tldr: Adds a lightweight Visual Prompt Generator Complete module that recovers visual details missed by captioning-trained prompts, improving zero-shot demonstrative instruction following.
nodes.problem: Captioning-trained visual prompts drop details needed for demonstrative instructions.
nodes.approach: Synthetic discriminative training of a lightweight completion module, plus the DEMON benchmark.
nodes.niche_reason: MLLMs are crowded; demonstrative-instruction angle is less common.

nodes.title: WildChat: 1M ChatGPT Interaction Logs in the Wild
nodes.tldr: Releases WildChat, one million real user-ChatGPT conversations with demographic metadata, showing diverse prompts, many languages, toxic use cases, and instruction-tuning utility.
nodes.problem: No large public dataset shows how people actually use chatbots in the wild.
nodes.approach: Collect consented ChatGPT transcripts via free access, enrich with demographics, and analyze and fine-tune on them.
secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › Alignment & Preference Optimization
nodes.niche_reason: Conversation datasets are common, though real-user logs are less so.

nodes.title: Out-Of-Domain Unlabeled Data Improves Generalization
nodes.tldr: Semi-supervised classification with out-of-domain unlabeled data via DRO and self-supervised training, with provable generalization gains on Gaussian mixtures.
nodes.problem: Unlabeled data drawn slightly out of domain can hurt or be underused in semi-supervised classification.
nodes.approach: Combines distributionally robust optimization with self-supervised training and derives non-asymptotic generalization bounds.
nodes.primary_topic: Learning Theory & Optimization › Generalization & Statistical Learning
secondary_topics: Architectures & Training › Domain Adaptation & OOD Generalization
nodes.confidence_reason: generalization theory vs semi-supervised/OOD framing is a judgment call
nodes.niche_reason: semi-supervised DRO with theory is a fairly established direction

nodes.title: InfoBatch: Lossless Training Speed Up by Unbiased Dynamic Data Pruning
nodes.tldr: InfoBatch speeds up training losslessly by randomly pruning low-loss samples and rescaling remaining gradients to keep the expected gradient unbiased, saving about 40% cost.
nodes.problem: Data pruning for training acceleration introduces gradient expectation bias and performance loss.
nodes.approach: Dynamic random pruning of less informative samples by loss distribution with gradient rescaling.
nodes.primary_topic: Architectures & Training › Efficient Training, Compression & Pruning
secondary_topics: Data, Benchmarks & Evaluation › Synthetic Data & Data Curation
nodes.niche_reason: Data pruning for efficient training is a common direction.

nodes.title: SEAL: A Framework for Systematic Evaluation of Real-World Super-Resolution
nodes.tldr: A systematic evaluation framework for real-world super-resolution that clusters degradations into a representative test set and uses new acceptance-rate metrics.
nodes.problem: Real-SR methods are judged on random degradation subsets, giving misleading comparisons.
nodes.approach: Clustered degradation test set with coarse-to-fine acceptance and relative-performance metrics.
nodes.niche_reason: Systematic evaluation of real-world super-resolution under degradation space.

nodes.title: Online Stabilization of Spiking Neural Networks
nodes.tldr: Proposes Online Spiking Renormalization and Online Threshold Stabilizer enabling normalization in memory-efficient online training of spiking neural networks.
nodes.problem: Online SNN training lacks future information, preventing batch normalization and stable firing rates.
nodes.approach: Online spiking renormalization with online-computed statistics over time, plus a threshold stabilizer for firing rates.
secondary_topics: Architectures & Training › Efficient Training, Compression & Pruning
nodes.niche_reason: Spiking neural network training is a niche subfield.

nodes.title: FLASK: Fine-grained Language Model Evaluation based on Alignment Skill Sets
nodes.tldr: Proposes FLASK, a fine-grained LLM evaluation protocol scoring each instruction across alignment skill sets, with high correlation between model and human judges.
nodes.problem: Coarse overall preference scores hide which skills an LLM lacks for a given instruction.
nodes.approach: Decomposes coarse scores into instance-wise skill-set scores for human and model-based judging.
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › LLM Evaluation & Benchmarks
nodes.niche_reason: LLM evaluation benchmarks are crowded.

nodes.title: Generative Learning for Financial Time Series with Irregular and Scale-Invariant Patterns
nodes.tldr: Generates financial time series with irregular, scale-invariant patterns by recognizing recurring patterns, diffusion-synthesizing segments, and modeling their transitions.
nodes.problem: Financial series have irregular scale-invariant patterns that existing generators fail to capture.
nodes.approach: Scale-invariant pattern extraction, diffusion segment synthesis, and transition modeling.
nodes.primary_topic: Architectures & Training › Time Series & Sequential Data
nodes.niche_reason: Scale-invariant financial pattern synthesis is specialised

nodes.title: On Penalty Methods for Nonconvex Bilevel Optimization and First-Order Stochastic Approximation
nodes.tldr: Analyzes penalty methods for nonconvex bilevel optimization, linking penalty function to hyper-objective, and gives first-order stochastic algorithms with non-asymptotic guarantees.
nodes.problem: Solving constrained nonconvex bilevel problems with first-order methods and convergence guarantees.
nodes.approach: Penalty-function landscape analysis relating values and gradients to the hyper-objective.
nodes.niche_reason: Bilevel optimization theory is established and specialised.

nodes.title: Idempotence and Perceptual Image Compression
nodes.tldr: Shows idempotent unconditional generative models match conditional perceptual codecs, enabling training-free perceptual compression from a pretrained MSE codec.
nodes.problem: Perceptual image codecs typically require training dedicated conditional generative models.
nodes.approach: Invert an unconditional generative model under an idempotence constraint atop a pretrained MSE codec.
nodes.niche_reason: Unusual idempotence-based link between codecs and generative inversion.

nodes.title: Finite-State Autoregressive Entropy Coding for Efficient Learned Lossless Compression
nodes.tldr: Improves learned lossless compression ratio at near-baseline cost using a lookup-table autoregressive entropy coder and a straight-through quantizer.
nodes.problem: Learned lossless compressors gain ratio but autoregressive entropy coding is too slow to be practical.
nodes.approach: Finite-state autoregressive entropy coder with lookup table, plus straight-through hardmax quantization of latents.
nodes.confidence_reason: Abstract is generic data compression; image focus not stated
nodes.niche_reason: Learned lossless compression with autoregressive entropy coding is specialised

nodes.title: Beyond Worst-case Attacks: Robust RL with Adaptive Defense via Non-dominated Policies
nodes.tldr: Treats test-time robustness to state-adversarial attacks as regret minimization, using a set of non-dominated policies to adapt online and beat worst-case-only defenses.
nodes.problem: Worst-case robust RL sacrifices performance when attacks are weak or absent.
nodes.approach: Define non-dominated policies and adaptively select among them at test time via regret minimization.
nodes.niche_reason: Robust RL beyond worst case is a specialised but established area.

nodes.title: Improving Domain Generalization with Domain Relations
nodes.tldr: Learns domain-specific functions and reweights them at test time using domain relations derived from metadata, with theory showing improved generalization to new domains.
nodes.problem: Models degrade under domain shift, and invariance-based methods ignore relations among domains.
nodes.approach: Train per-domain functions, then reweight them using domain relations learned from domain metadata.
nodes.primary_topic: Architectures & Training › Domain Adaptation & OOD Generalization
nodes.niche_reason: Domain generalization is a well-trodden area.

nodes.title: Robustifying State-space Models for Long Sequences via Approximate Diagonalization
nodes.tldr: Proposes perturb-then-diagonalize, a backward-stable way to diagonalize HiPPO-based SSMs, yielding S4-PTD and S5-PTD with better robustness and accuracy.
nodes.problem: Diagonalizing HiPPO-based state-space models is ill-posed, so simplified diagonal SSMs lose robustness.
nodes.approach: Perturb-then-diagonalize using pseudospectral theory of non-normal matrices.
nodes.primary_topic: Architectures & Training › State-Space Models & Linear Attention
nodes.niche_reason: SSMs are established; pseudospectral diagonalization angle is unusual

nodes.title: CLIPSelf: Vision Transformer Distills Itself for Open-Vocabulary Dense Prediction
nodes.tldr: CLIPSelf adapts CLIP ViT to local regions by distilling image-crop representations into dense region features, improving open-vocabulary detection and segmentation without region-text pairs.
nodes.problem: CLIP's global alignment transfers poorly to local regions for open-vocabulary dense prediction.
nodes.approach: Self-distillation aligning region features from the dense map with CLIP embeddings of corresponding crops.
nodes.niche_reason: Open-vocabulary detection with CLIP is a common direction.

nodes.title: Point2SSM: Learning Morphological Variations of Anatomies from Point Clouds
nodes.tldr: Unsupervised network building correspondence-based statistical shape models of anatomy from raw point clouds using attention, with a benchmark of point cloud networks.
nodes.problem: Constructing anatomical statistical shape models traditionally needs clean meshes or volumes and slow cohort optimization.
nodes.approach: Attention-based module on learned point features produces correspondence mappings from raw point clouds, trained unsupervised.
nodes.niche_reason: Statistical shape modeling from point clouds is a rare niche.

nodes.title: Single Motion Diffusion
nodes.tldr: SinMDM is a diffusion model trained on one motion sequence of any skeleton, with a shallow local-attention denoiser enabling in-betweening, expansion, and style transfer.
nodes.problem: Motion data for animals and exotic creatures is scarce, so large-dataset motion models do not apply.
nodes.approach: Lightweight single-instance diffusion denoiser with shallow network and local attention to avoid overfitting.
secondary_topics: Computer Vision › Human Pose, Avatars & Faces
nodes.niche_reason: Single-sequence motion generation with arbitrary skeletons is unusual.

nodes.title: Enhancing Group Fairness in Online Settings Using Oblique Decision Forests
nodes.tldr: Aranyani, an ensemble of oblique decision trees, enforces group fairness in online streams by reusing aggregate statistics instead of extra passes.
nodes.problem: Group fairness objectives in online learning need extra storage and computation, since they require group-level expectations.
nodes.approach: Hierarchical oblique decision trees whose parameter isolation lets fairness gradients come from aggregate decision statistics.
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Online Learning & Regret
nodes.niche_reason: Online fairness is specialised; tree ensembles for fairness are established

nodes.title: CAS: A Probability-Based Approach for Universal Condition Alignment Score
nodes.tldr: CAS is a universal alignment score from a diffusion model own conditional probability, enabling self-rejection of misaligned samples across text, image, edge and audio conditions.
nodes.problem: Evaluating whether conditional diffusion samples comply with conditions without condition-specific scoring models.
nodes.approach: Compute alignment score from conditional likelihood measured through the diffusion process, needing no extra models.
nodes.primary_topic: Generative Models › Generative Model Evaluation & Theory
nodes.niche_reason: Alignment scoring for conditional diffusion is specialised.

nodes.title: Prompt Gradient Projection for Continual Learning
nodes.tldr: Prompt Gradient Projection combines prompt tuning with gradient projection, using SVD to enforce orthogonal prompt gradients and reduce forgetting in vision-transformer continual learning.
nodes.problem: Catastrophic forgetting in prompt-based continual learning lacks theoretical guarantees.
nodes.approach: Derive orthogonality condition for prompt gradients and realize it via SVD on combined input-prompt space.
nodes.niche_reason: Prompt-based continual learning is a common subfield.

nodes.title: ResFields: Residual Neural Fields for Spatiotemporal Signals
nodes.tldr: ResFields adds time-dependent residual layers to MLP neural fields, increasing capacity for spatiotemporal signals like dynamic SDFs and NeRFs.
nodes.problem: MLP neural fields have limited capacity for large, complex temporal signals.
nodes.approach: Time-dependent residual weight layers, with low-rank factorization, added to existing neural fields.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: Dynamic neural field capacity is established but specialised.

nodes.title: Open-ended VQA benchmarking of Vision-Language models by exploiting Classification datasets and their semantic hierarchy
nodes.tldr: Builds an open-ended VQA benchmark from classification datasets, using label hierarchies to ask follow-up questions that fairly score coarse answers.
nodes.problem: Existing VQA benchmarks cannot granularly evaluate generative vision-language models against discriminative ones.
nodes.approach: Label-hierarchy follow-up questions and a human-validated comparison of NLP and LLM-based answer metrics.
nodes.niche_reason: VQA benchmarking of VLMs is a crowded evaluation area

nodes.title: Cameras as Rays: Pose Estimation via Ray Diffusion
nodes.tldr: Represents cameras as bundles of rays predicted from image patches, with regression and diffusion variants for sparse-view camera pose estimation.
nodes.problem: Estimating camera poses from sparse views (under 10) is hard for global extrinsic parametrizations.
nodes.approach: Set-level transformer maps image patches to rays, with a denoising diffusion model to sample plausible poses.
nodes.niche_reason: Established pose estimation area; ray-bundle camera representation is distinctive.

nodes.title: Privileged Sensing Scaffolds Reinforcement Learning
nodes.tldr: Scaffolder uses privileged training-only sensors in critics, world models and reward estimators to improve a policy that deploys with cheap sensors.
nodes.problem: Robots must deploy with cheap sensors, yet expensive training-time sensors could still aid learning.
nodes.approach: Asymmetric RL that feeds privileged observations only to training-time auxiliary components.
nodes.primary_topic: Reinforcement Learning › Online & Deep RL Algorithms
secondary_topics: Reinforcement Learning › Model-Based RL & World Models
nodes.confidence_reason: Privileged-sensing RL could be filed under RL algorithms or robot learning
nodes.niche_reason: Sensory scaffolding with training-only sensors is an unusual angle

nodes.title: Leveraging Low-Rank and Sparse Recurrent Connectivity for Robust Closed-Loop Control
nodes.tldr: Parameterizes recurrent connectivity by rank and sparsity, yielding smaller CfC networks that outperform full-rank models under closed-loop distribution shift.
nodes.problem: Recurrent agents fit offline then deployed closed-loop often fail to generalize under distribution shift.
nodes.approach: Low-rank plus sparse recurrent weights, giving an interpretable prior on closed-form continuous-time networks.
nodes.primary_topic: Architectures & Training › Efficient Training, Compression & Pruning
secondary_topics: Architectures & Training › Domain Adaptation & OOD Generalization
nodes.confidence_reason: Efficiency versus robustness framing; primary topic is a judgment call.
nodes.niche_reason: Low-rank sparse CfC recurrent connectivity is a rare control niche.

nodes.title: RT-Trajectory: Robotic Task Generalization via Hindsight Trajectory Sketches
nodes.tldr: RT-Trajectory conditions robot policies on rough trajectory sketches, covering more new tasks than language or goal conditioning.
nodes.problem: Robot policies trained on pick-and-place do not generalize to new tasks, even with similar arm motions.
nodes.approach: Hindsight-labelled trajectory sketches serve as task specification, drawn by hand, from videos, or from automated generators.
nodes.niche_reason: Trajectory-sketch task specification is an unusual alternative to language goals.

nodes.title: Illusory Attacks: Information-theoretic detectability matters in adversarial attacks
nodes.tldr: Shows existing observation attacks on RL agents are detectable and proposes illusory attacks with bounded information-theoretic detectability, learned via dual ascent.
nodes.problem: Adversarial attacks on RL agents that are effective yet statistically undetectable.
nodes.approach: Dual ascent learning of attacks under epsilon-bounded statistical detectability constraint.
nodes.niche_reason: Detectability-constrained attacks on RL agents are an unusual angle.

nodes.title: GTMGC: Using Graph Transformer to Predict Molecule’s Ground-State Conformation
nodes.tldr: GTMGC is a graph transformer with a structural residual self-attention that predicts a molecule's 3D ground-state conformation directly from its 2D graph.
nodes.problem: Obtaining ground-state molecular conformations via DFT is slow; need fast learned prediction from 2D topology.
nodes.approach: Graph transformer with Molecule Structural Residual Self-Attention, trained end-to-end on 2D-to-3D conformation prediction.
nodes.niche_reason: Established molecular ML subarea with specialised conformer focus.

nodes.title: Post-hoc bias scoring is optimal for fair classification
nodes.tldr: Characterizes Bayes-optimal fair classifiers as simple post-hoc modifications of an unconstrained classifier via a per-instance bias score, without needing sensitive attributes at inference.
nodes.problem: Enforcing group fairness (DP, EOp, EO) in binary classification trades off against accuracy.
nodes.approach: Bayes-optimal classifier characterized as a linear modification of per-instance bias scores, applied post-hoc.
nodes.niche_reason: Post-hoc group fairness for classifiers is a crowded mainstream topic.

nodes.title: Multisize Dataset Condensation
nodes.tldr: Multisize Dataset Condensation compresses N condensation runs into one, using an adaptive subset loss so subsets of a condensed dataset stay representative at any size.
nodes.problem: Condensed datasets must be flexible in size on devices, but subsets of condensed data are unrepresentative.
nodes.approach: Single condensation process with an adaptive subset loss mitigating subset degradation.
nodes.primary_topic: Data, Benchmarks & Evaluation › Synthetic Data & Data Curation
secondary_topics: Architectures & Training › Efficient Training, Compression & Pruning
nodes.niche_reason: Dataset distillation is established but specialised.

nodes.title: Improving Non-Transferable Representation Learning by Harnessing Content and Style
nodes.tldr: Blocks transfer to target domains by disentangling content and style with a causal model, then distilling content into source and style into target representations.
nodes.problem: Existing non-transferable methods confuse style-label correlations with content-label relations, weakening robustness to shifts.
nodes.approach: Variational causal disentanglement of content and style factors, then dual-path distillation to guide representations.
nodes.primary_topic: Architectures & Training › Domain Adaptation & OOD Generalization
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Causality & Causal Inference
nodes.confidence_reason: Could be domain adaptation or causal representation learning; both plausible.
nodes.niche_reason: Non-transferable representation learning is a rare, unusual goal

nodes.title: Debiased Collaborative Filtering with Kernel-Based Causal Balancing
nodes.tldr: Proposes kernel-based causal balancing for debiased collaborative filtering, balancing functions in an RKHS adaptively to reduce selection bias in IPS and doubly robust estimators.
nodes.problem: Selection bias in collaborative filtering; unclear which function class to balance and how.
nodes.approach: Universal kernel-based balancing in RKHS with adaptive projection-driven causal balancing during alternating updates.
nodes.primary_topic: Learning Theory & Optimization › Causality & Causal Inference
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Kernels, GPs & Nonparametrics
nodes.confidence_reason: Straddles causal debiasing and recommender systems; no recommender topic in vocab.
nodes.niche_reason: Causal debiasing for recommenders is established but specialised.

nodes.title: Candidate Label Set Pruning: A Data-centric Perspective for Deep Partial-label Learning
nodes.tldr: Introduces candidate label set pruning, a training-free data-centric step removing likely false candidate labels in partial-label learning via nearest-neighbor label inconsistency, with error bounds.
nodes.problem: Large candidate label sets prevent label disambiguation methods from finding true labels in partial-label learning.
nodes.approach: Prune a candidate label if absent from its nearest neighbors' candidate sets in representation space.
secondary_topics: Data, Benchmarks & Evaluation › Synthetic Data & Data Curation
nodes.niche_reason: Partial-label learning is a rare weak-supervision niche.

nodes.title: AnimateDiff: Animate Your Personalized Text-to-Image Diffusion Models without Specific Tuning
nodes.tldr: AnimateDiff adds a plug-and-play motion module, trained once, that animates any personalized text-to-image diffusion model without tuning, with MotionLoRA for new motion styles.
nodes.problem: Animating personalized text-to-image models without model-specific tuning.
nodes.approach: Motion module learning transferable motion priors from videos, plus lightweight MotionLoRA adaptation.
nodes.niche_reason: Text-to-video diffusion is a crowded mainstream area.

nodes.title: PTaRL: Prototype-based Tabular Representation Learning via Space Calibration
nodes.tldr: Learns disentangled tabular representations by projecting samples onto global data prototypes via optimal transport, with diversity and orthogonality constraints.
nodes.problem: Deep tabular models suffer representation entanglement and localization, hurting prediction and consistency.
nodes.approach: Generate global prototypes as basis of a projection space, then project samples with optimal transport.
nodes.niche_reason: Prototype-based representations for tabular deep learning are specialised, not mainstream

nodes.title: Identifying the Risks of LM Agents with an LM-Emulated Sandbox
nodes.tldr: ToolEmu uses an LM to emulate tool execution and an LM safety evaluator to scalably find risky agent failures across 36 toolkits and 144 cases.
nodes.problem: Costly manual testing of LM agent risks across tools and scenarios
nodes.approach: LM-emulated tool sandbox plus automatic LM-based safety evaluator
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › LLM Safety & Jailbreaks
secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › Agents & Tool Use
nodes.niche_reason: Agent safety testing is established but specialised

nodes.title: Reward-Consistent Dynamics Models are Strongly Generalizable for Offline Reinforcement Learning
nodes.tldr: Selects generated transitions by a learned dynamics reward so model-based offline RL generalizes better, improving D4RL and NeoRL benchmarks.
nodes.problem: Learned dynamics models fail to generalize to unseen transitions in offline RL
nodes.approach: Learn a dynamics reward and use it as a filter over model-generated transitions in any offline MBRL method
secondary_topics: Reinforcement Learning › Model-Based RL & World Models
nodes.niche_reason: Offline model-based RL is a crowded, active research area

nodes.title: Noisy Interpolation Learning with Shallow Univariate ReLU Networks
nodes.tldr: Rigorously analyzes minimum-norm interpolation with univariate two-layer ReLU networks, showing tempered overfitting under L1 loss but catastrophic overfitting under L2 loss.
nodes.problem: How overparameterized networks generalize while interpolating noisy data lacks rigorous analysis of tempered overfitting.
nodes.approach: Theoretical analysis of min-norm regression with shallow univariate ReLU networks under different loss measures.
nodes.primary_topic: Learning Theory & Optimization › Generalization & Statistical Learning
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Deep Learning Theory
nodes.niche_reason: Interpolation theory is an established specialised theory area.

nodes.title: DreamFlow: High-quality text-to-3D generation by Approximating Probability Flow
nodes.tldr: Speeds text-to-3D generation by replacing random-timestep score distillation with a predetermined timestep schedule that approximates probability flow, yielding 1024px 3D content.
nodes.problem: Score distillation for text-to-3D uses random timesteps, causing high gradient variance and slow optimization.
nodes.approach: Three-stage coarse-to-fine optimization that treats text-to-3D as multi-view image-to-image translation via probability flow.
nodes.niche_reason: Score distillation for text-to-3D is a crowded direction.

nodes.title: MMD Graph Kernel: Effective Metric Learning for Graphs via Maximum Mean Discrepancy
nodes.tldr: Learns graph metrics by applying maximum mean discrepancy to message-passing node representations, with unsupervised and supervised deep graph kernels.
nodes.problem: Graph similarity metrics need to be learned, adaptive, and discriminative for clustering and classification.
nodes.approach: MMD between graphs' node embeddings from message passing, with deep kernels trained adaptively.
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Kernels, GPs & Nonparametrics
nodes.niche_reason: Graph metric learning with MMD is specialised but established.

nodes.title: Dictionary Contrastive Learning for Efficient Local Supervision without Auxiliary Networks
nodes.tldr: Dictionary Contrastive Learning trains layers locally without backprop or auxiliary networks by aligning features with label embeddings, improving forward learning.
nodes.problem: Local supervision without auxiliary networks is weak; forward learning lags backprop.
nodes.approach: Contrastive objective optimizing similarity between local features and static or adaptive label embeddings.
nodes.confidence_reason: Training-method topic straddles contrastive learning and optimization dynamics.
nodes.niche_reason: Backprop-free local and forward learning is a rare training direction.

nodes.title: PINNACLE: PINN Adaptive ColLocation and Experimental points selection
nodes.tldr: PINNACLE jointly selects collocation and experimental training points for physics-informed networks, adapting point proportions using NTK-based training dynamics.
nodes.problem: PINN training needs many point types, and prior methods select only one type of point.
nodes.approach: Neural-tangent-kernel analysis of interactions among point types drives adaptive joint selection.
nodes.niche_reason: adaptive PINN point selection is specialised

nodes.title: On the Humanity of Conversational AI: Evaluating the Psychological Portrayal of LLMs
nodes.tldr: Introduces PsychoBench, thirteen clinical psychology scales measuring LLM personality, relationships, motivation and emotion across five models.
nodes.problem: No systematic way to assess the psychological portrayal and traits of conversational LLMs.
nodes.approach: Administer clinical psychometric scales to LLMs in four categories, with jailbreak-based probing.
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › LLM Evaluation & Benchmarks
nodes.confidence_reason: Psychological benchmarking of LLMs straddles evaluation and cognitive science
nodes.niche_reason: Clinical psychometric scales applied to LLM personas is unusual

nodes.title: DMV3D: Denoising Multi-view Diffusion Using 3D Large Reconstruction Model
nodes.tldr: Single-stage 3D generation where a transformer large reconstruction model with triplane NeRF acts as the denoiser for multi-view diffusion, trained only with image losses.
nodes.problem: Generating diverse, sharp 3D objects from text or single images without 3D asset supervision.
nodes.approach: Use a triplane-NeRF large reconstruction model as the denoiser in multi-view image diffusion.
secondary_topics: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: Diffusion-based 3D generation is a popular direction.

nodes.title: Forward $\chi^2$ Divergence Based Variational Importance Sampling
nodes.tldr: Estimates and maximizes marginal log-likelihood using an importance sampler whose proposal minimizes forward chi-squared divergence, applied to latent variable models.
nodes.problem: Variational inference struggles to reach high marginal log-likelihood on complex posteriors.
nodes.approach: Optimal importance proposal from forward chi-squared minimization used for marginal likelihood estimates.
nodes.primary_topic: Learning Theory & Optimization › Probabilistic & Bayesian Methods
secondary_topics: Generative Models › GANs, VAEs & Normalizing Flows
nodes.niche_reason: Variational importance sampling is an established area

nodes.title: "What Data Benefits My Classifier?" Enhancing Model Performance and Interpretability through Influence-Based Data Selection
nodes.tldr: Uses influence estimation to select training data that improves a convex classifier's utility, fairness, and robustness, while aiding interpretability.
nodes.problem: Models are usually improved by changing architectures, not by asking which data benefits a fixed classifier.
nodes.approach: Influence estimation interprets feature-space data contributions, enabling influence-based selection for a target metric.
nodes.primary_topic: Data, Benchmarks & Evaluation › Data Attribution & Influence
nodes.niche_reason: Specialised: influence-based data selection for fairness and robustness.

nodes.title: Beyond Weisfeiler-Lehman: A Quantitative Framework for GNN Expressiveness
nodes.tldr: Introduces homomorphism expressivity, a complete and quantitative measure of GNN expressive power, and derives it for four prominent GNN classes including subgraph counting.
nodes.problem: Weisfeiler-Lehman expressivity is coarse, qualitative, and misses practical substructure counting.
nodes.approach: Characterizes GNN classes by their ability to count graphs under homomorphism, invariant and equivariant.
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Deep Learning Theory
nodes.niche_reason: Quantitative GNN expressivity is specialised but established.

nodes.title: SGD Finds then Tunes Features in Two-Layer Neural Networks with near-Optimal Sample Complexity: A Case Study in the XOR problem
nodes.tldr: Proves minibatch SGD on a two-layer ReLU network learns the quadratic XOR function with near-optimal sample complexity, via signal-finding then signal-heavy phases.
nodes.problem: Sample complexity of learning XOR-type quadratic targets with standard SGD was not characterized.
nodes.approach: Analyze two-phase training dynamics where few neurons find features and simultaneous layer growth amplifies them.
nodes.primary_topic: Learning Theory & Optimization › Deep Learning Theory
nodes.niche_reason: Established theory line; XOR case is specialised.

nodes.title: Towards a statistical theory of data selection under weak supervision
nodes.tldr: Develops a statistical theory of subsampling with a surrogate model, showing data selection can beat full-sample training and common methods like influence-based subsampling are suboptimal.
nodes.problem: How to select a labeled subsample using a surrogate model for efficient estimation or learning.
nodes.approach: Low- and high-dimensional asymptotic analysis of regularized ERM with selection, plus numerical experiments.
nodes.primary_topic: Learning Theory & Optimization › Generalization & Statistical Learning
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › High-dimensional & Random Matrix Theory
Data, Benchmarks & Evaluation › Synthetic Data & Data Curation
nodes.niche_reason: Theory of data selection is established but specialised.

nodes.title: GNNCert: Deterministic Certification of Graph Neural Networks against Adversarial Perturbations
nodes.tldr: Provides deterministic certified robustness for graph classifiers against both structure and node feature perturbations by dividing graphs into subgraphs and voting.
nodes.problem: Graph classifiers lack deterministic provable defenses against structure and feature adversarial perturbations.
nodes.approach: Divide graph into subgraphs, classify each, and combine by majority voting with certified bounds.
nodes.niche_reason: Certified robustness for graphs is established but specialised.

nodes.title: Learning Hierarchical Image Segmentation For Recognition and By Recognition
nodes.tldr: Integrates a hierarchical segmenter into a ViT using adaptive segment tokens and graph pooling, learning part-whole segmentation from recognition objectives alone without mask labels.
nodes.problem: Segmentation is treated separately from recognition and needs heavy supervision.
nodes.approach: ViT with adaptive segment tokens and graph pooling trained only on image-level recognition objectives.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › Vision Foundation Models & Self-Supervision
nodes.niche_reason: Segmentation learned within recognition is a specialised angle.

nodes.title: Improved Active Learning via Dependent Leverage Score Sampling
nodes.tldr: Active learning via pivotal sampling, a non-independent leverage score method that spreads samples spatially, with sample complexity bounds for linear and polynomial regression.
nodes.problem: Reducing samples needed for accurate agnostic active learning of regression.
nodes.approach: Pivotal sampling over leverage scores, analyzed under one-sided l-infinity independence.
nodes.primary_topic: Learning Theory & Optimization › Generalization & Statistical Learning
secondary_topics: Data, Benchmarks & Evaluation › Synthetic Data & Data Curation
nodes.confidence_reason: Active learning has no clear vocabulary topic; theory-heavy.
nodes.niche_reason: Active learning theory is established but specialized within learning theory.

nodes.title: DP-OPT: Make Large Language Model Your Privacy-Preserving Prompt Engineer
nodes.tldr: Generates differentially private prompts client-side from private demonstrations, then transfers them to cloud LLMs without exposing the underlying data.
nodes.problem: Prompt tuning on private data needs local model hosting or sends sensitive data to an untrusted provider.
nodes.approach: DP ensemble of in-context learning over private demonstrations generates discrete prompts for offsite transfer.
secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › In-context Learning & Prompting
nodes.niche_reason: Private prompt generation is specialised but has a clear community.

nodes.title: Sample-Efficient Quality-Diversity by Cooperative Coevolution
nodes.tldr: Cooperative Coevolution Quality-Diversity splits a policy network into representation and decision layers coevolved as two subpopulations, roughly doubling sample efficiency.
nodes.problem: Low sample efficiency of quality-diversity algorithms for RL.
nodes.approach: Cooperatively coevolve representation-layer and decision-layer subpopulations within a QD framework.
nodes.confidence_reason: Quality-diversity evolution has no exact topic; Exploration is a judgment call.
nodes.niche_reason: Quality-diversity evolutionary methods are a rare corner of RL.

nodes.title: On the Stability of Iterative Retraining of Generative Models on their own Data
nodes.tldr: Proves iterative retraining of generative models on mixed real and synthetic data is stable if clean data dominates, validated on CIFAR10 and FFHQ.
nodes.problem: Web data will increasingly contain synthetic content, so future generative models train on it.
nodes.approach: Theory of mixed-data iterative training, validated by retraining normalizing flows and diffusion models.
nodes.primary_topic: Generative Models › Generative Model Evaluation & Theory
secondary_topics: Data, Benchmarks & Evaluation › Synthetic Data & Data Curation
nodes.niche_reason: Self-consuming generative model stability is a specialised theory topic.

nodes.title: On the Role of General Function Approximation in Offline Reinforcement Learning
nodes.tldr: Clarifies how general function approximation should be assumed in offline RL, and gives generic information-theoretic lower bounds that exploit model realizability.
nodes.problem: Function approximation assumptions in offline RL are often ambiguous, blurring what they restrict.
nodes.approach: Taxonomy of assumption types, and realizability-based lower bounds transferable to other function classes.
nodes.niche_reason: Theory of general function approximation in offline RL is specialised.

nodes.title: iTransformer: Inverted Transformers Are Effective for Time Series Forecasting
nodes.tldr: Applies Transformer attention and feed-forward layers across inverted dimensions, treating each variate as a token for better multivariate forecasting.
nodes.problem: Transformer forecasters degrade with longer lookbacks and fuse variates into uninformative temporal tokens.
nodes.approach: Embed each series as a variate token; attention captures cross-variate correlations, feed-forward learns per-variate representations.
nodes.primary_topic: Architectures & Training › Time Series & Sequential Data
nodes.niche_reason: Transformer forecasting variants are a common direction

nodes.title: A Mutual Information Perspective on Federated Contrastive Learning
nodes.tldr: Extends federated SimCLR with a user-verification loss that lower-bounds global multi-view mutual information, plus a supervised variant for semi-supervised federated learning.
nodes.problem: Federated contrastive learning lacks a clear objective linking local client training to global mutual information.
nodes.approach: Adds a user-verification loss to local SimCLR and a label-aware contrastive head with auxiliary classifier.
nodes.niche_reason: Federated contrastive learning is established but specialised

nodes.title: Efficient Inverse Multiagent Learning
nodes.tldr: Gives polynomial-time algorithms for inverse game theory and inverse multiagent learning via min-max formulations, and predicts Spanish electricity prices better than ARIMA.
nodes.problem: Finding game payoff parameters for which observed behavior is an equilibrium, efficiently.
nodes.approach: Generative-adversarial min-max formulation with polynomial-time first-order solvers, extended to simulacral learning.
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Game Theory & Mechanism Design
nodes.niche_reason: Inverse game theory with polynomial guarantees is uncommon.

nodes.title: At Which Training Stage Does Code Data Help LLMs Reasoning?
nodes.tldr: Systematically tests when adding code data helps LLM reasoning, finding mixing code during pretraining broadly improves reasoning while instruction-tuning code adds task-specific reasoning.
nodes.problem: Unclear at which training stage code data improves LLM reasoning ability.
nodes.approach: Controlled comparison of code-text mixtures at pretraining, instruction tuning, and both, across six reasoning tasks.
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › Pretraining, Scaling & Data
nodes.niche_reason: Data-mixture and reasoning studies are mainstream LLM topics.

nodes.title: Retroformer: Retrospective Large Language Agents with Policy Gradient Optimization
nodes.tldr: Retroformer trains a retrospective LLM that writes verbal reflections to improve language agents, optimized with policy gradients from environment rewards.
nodes.problem: Language agents are not optimized with environment-specific rewards.
nodes.approach: Retrospective model fine-tuned by policy gradient to refine agent prompts from past trials.
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › Agents & Tool Use
secondary_topics: Reinforcement Learning › RL for LLMs & Reasoning
nodes.niche_reason: LLM agents with RL feedback are common.

nodes.title: Proving Test Set Contamination in Black-Box Language Models
nodes.tldr: Detects benchmark contamination in black-box LMs with exact false-positive guarantees by testing whether canonical example ordering is more likely than shuffled orderings.
nodes.problem: Detecting test set contamination without access to pretraining data or model weights.
nodes.approach: Exchangeability-based permutation test comparing likelihood of canonical versus shuffled benchmark orderings.
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › LLM Evaluation & Benchmarks
secondary_topics: Trustworthy ML › Machine Unlearning & Privacy Attacks
nodes.niche_reason: Contamination detection is a specialised but active topic.

nodes.title: MathVista: Evaluating Mathematical Reasoning of Foundation Models in Visual Contexts
nodes.tldr: Introduces a 6,141-example benchmark of visual mathematical reasoning drawn from 31 datasets, revealing a large gap between foundation models and humans.
nodes.problem: Mathematical reasoning in visual contexts had not been systematically evaluated for foundation models.
nodes.approach: Benchmark combining diverse math and visual tasks, evaluating twelve foundation models against human performance.
nodes.niche_reason: Multimodal math benchmarks are a common category.

nodes.title: NetInfoF Framework: Measuring and Exploiting Network Usable Information
nodes.tldr: Presents NetInfoF, which measures network usable information in graph structure and node features without training, and uses it for link prediction and node classification.
nodes.problem: Unclear whether a graph's structure and features carry enough usable information for a GNN task.
nodes.approach: Closed-form, training-free probe measuring information, plus a similarity-adjusted solver sharing the same backbone.
nodes.niche_reason: Training-free information measurement on graphs, specialised but principled

nodes.title: SNIP: Bridging Mathematical Symbolic and Numeric Realms with Unified Pre-training
nodes.tldr: Pretrains a model with contrastive learning between symbolic equations and their numeric evaluations, transferring to math property prediction and symbolic regression.
nodes.problem: Symbolic and numeric math representations are learned separately, missing shared structure from task-agnostic pretraining.
nodes.approach: Contrastive pre-training aligning symbolic expression and numeric data embeddings in a shared latent space.
secondary_topics: Science & Applications › Scientific Discovery & Symbolic Regression
nodes.confidence_reason: contrastive pretraining vs symbolic regression application; close topics
nodes.niche_reason: Symbolic-numeric contrastive pretraining is an unusual cross-domain pairing

nodes.title: Online GNN Evaluation Under Test-time Graph Distribution Shifts
nodes.tldr: Proposes LeBeD, a learning-behavior discrepancy score from GNN re-training, to estimate test-time generalization error of trained GNNs on unlabeled graphs under distribution shift.
nodes.problem: Evaluating deployed GNNs on unlabeled test graphs under unknown distribution shift.
nodes.approach: LeBeD score combining node prediction and structure reconstruction discrepancies via GNN re-training.
secondary_topics: Architectures & Training › Domain Adaptation & OOD Generalization
nodes.niche_reason: Label-free GNN model evaluation is a rare problem setting.

nodes.title: Cascading Reinforcement Learning
nodes.tldr: Generalizes cascading bandits to cascading RL with user states, using a BestPerm oracle to build efficient algorithms with near-optimal regret and sample complexity.
nodes.problem: Cascading bandits ignore user state and its transitions
nodes.approach: BestPerm oracle plus CascadingVI and CascadingBPI algorithms with theoretical guarantees
nodes.niche_reason: Cascading RL is a rare theoretical setting.

nodes.title: On the Markov Property of Neural Algorithmic Reasoning: Analyses and Methods
nodes.tldr: Neural algorithmic reasoning model that drops historical embeddings to match the Markov nature of algorithmic tasks, with a gated variant for early training.
nodes.problem: Historical embeddings in neural algorithmic reasoning contradict the Markov nature of tasks.
nodes.approach: Markov-consistent step predictor without history, plus gated selective history integration.
secondary_topics: Architectures & Training › Time Series & Sequential Data
nodes.confidence_reason: GNN vs sequence-model architecture classification is unclear.
nodes.niche_reason: Markov-consistent neural algorithmic reasoning is rare.

nodes.title: MetaPhysiCa: Improving OOD Robustness in Physics-informed Machine Learning
nodes.tldr: MetaPhysiCa improves out-of-distribution forecasting of ODE systems in physics-informed ML by meta-learning causal structure discovery, giving 2x to 28x lower OOD errors.
nodes.problem: Physics-informed ML methods are fragile under out-of-support initial conditions and ODE parameters.
nodes.approach: Meta-learning procedure with causal structure discovery across systems with varying unknown ODE parameters.
secondary_topics: Architectures & Training › Domain Adaptation & OOD Generalization
nodes.niche_reason: Combines PIML, meta-learning and causality, an unusual cross-disciplinary angle.

nodes.title: Thin-Shell Object Manipulations With Differentiable Physics Simulations
nodes.tldr: ThinShellLab, a differentiable simulation platform for thin-shell object manipulation tasks, with a coupled sampling and gradient trajectory optimization scheme and sim-to-real transfer.
nodes.problem: Teaching robots to manipulate diverse thin-shell materials, lacking suitable simulators and methods.
nodes.approach: Differentiable simulator with task suite and hybrid sampling-based plus gradient-based trajectory optimization.
nodes.niche_reason: Differentiable thin-shell simulation for manipulation is rare.

nodes.title: Large Multilingual Models Pivot Zero-Shot Multimodal Learning across Languages
nodes.tldr: MPM trains multimodal models for low-resource languages by pivoting on a multilingual LLM so English-only image-text training transfers zero-shot, yielding VisCPM for Chinese.
nodes.problem: Non-English multimodal models lack large-scale, high-quality image-text data.
nodes.approach: Pretrain on English image-text data atop a multilingual LLM for quasi-zero-shot cross-lingual transfer.
nodes.niche_reason: Cross-lingual multimodal transfer is established but specialised.

nodes.title: The False Promise of Imitating Proprietary Language Models
nodes.tldr: Critical analysis showing imitation models mimic ChatGPT's style but not its factuality, leaving a capability gap that more imitation data cannot close.
nodes.problem: Whether cheaply imitating proprietary chat models closes the gap to them.
nodes.approach: Finetune 1.5B-13B base models on ChatGPT outputs, then compare crowd ratings with targeted benchmarks.
secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › LLM Evaluation & Benchmarks
nodes.confidence_reason: Analysis of imitation distillation spans fine-tuning and evaluation.
nodes.niche_reason: Imitation-learning critiques of open LLMs are common in current discourse.

nodes.title: Improving Convergence and Generalization Using Parameter Symmetries
nodes.tldr: Shows teleportation through parameter symmetries speeds overall convergence and that teleporting to minima of different curvature improves generalization.
nodes.problem: Unclear why loss-invariant parameter teleportation accelerates optimization and how it affects generalization.
nodes.approach: Analyze symmetry teleportation and combine it with diverse optimizers and meta-learning.
nodes.niche_reason: Symmetry-based optimizer acceleration is specialised but established

nodes.title: ODICE: Revealing the Mystery of Distribution Correction Estimation via Orthogonal-gradient Update
nodes.tldr: Explains DICE offline RL underperformance via conflicting forward and backward gradients, fixing it by projecting the backward gradient orthogonally to the forward one.
nodes.problem: DICE-based offline RL and IL methods underperform action-constraint methods despite state-action-level regularization.
nodes.approach: Orthogonal-gradient update projecting backward gradient onto normal plane of forward gradient in value learning.
nodes.niche_reason: Offline RL algorithm variants are common.

nodes.title: In-Context Pretraining: Language Modeling Beyond Document Boundaries
nodes.tldr: Pretrains language models on sequences of related documents rather than random concatenations, sorting documents by similarity to improve in-context and long-context reasoning.
nodes.problem: Pretraining concatenates random documents, giving no signal for predicting the next document.
nodes.approach: Approximate nearest-neighbor search to find related documents, then graph-cover batching.
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › Pretraining, Scaling & Data
secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › Long Context & Memory
nodes.niche_reason: Data ordering for LM pretraining is an active but mainstream topic.

nodes.title: H-GAP: Humanoid Control with a Generalist Planner
nodes.tldr: H-GAP trains a generative state-action trajectory model on humanoid motion-capture data and uses it with MPC to solve novel control tasks without online interaction.
nodes.problem: High-dimensional humanoid control is hard to optimize and unstable.
nodes.approach: Generative trajectory autoencoding planner trained on mocap-derived data, used with model predictive control.
secondary_topics: Reinforcement Learning › Model-Based RL & World Models
nodes.niche_reason: Generative planners for humanoids are specialised.

nodes.title: Instructive Decoding: Instruction-Tuned Large Language Models are Self-Refiner from Noisy Instructions
nodes.tldr: Improves instruction-tuned LLMs by contrasting next-token logits from the original instruction against a deliberately noisy instruction, with no parameter updates.
nodes.problem: Instruction-tuned LLMs often fail on instructions outside their training distribution.
nodes.approach: Contrastive logit adjustment using predictions from a manipulated 'noisy' instruction such as 'opposite'.
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › In-context Learning & Prompting
nodes.confidence_reason: Decoding method versus prompting; topic is a judgement call
nodes.niche_reason: Contrastive decoding variant, moderately common

nodes.title: Efficient Episodic Memory Utilization of Cooperative Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
nodes.tldr: EMU speeds up cooperative multi-agent RL by recalling semantically coherent episodic memories and adding an episodic incentive reward that promotes desirable transitions.
nodes.problem: Cooperative MARL learns slowly and gets stuck in local optima on complex tasks.
nodes.approach: Learned state embeddings for episodic memory recall plus an episodic incentive added to the TD target.
nodes.niche_reason: Established MARL niche with episodic memory angle.

nodes.title: Bilevel Optimization under Unbounded Smoothness: A New Algorithm and Convergence Analysis
nodes.tldr: BO-REP is a bilevel optimization algorithm with convergence guarantees when the upper-level function has unbounded smoothness, as in RNNs and LSTMs.
nodes.problem: Bilevel optimization algorithms assume Lipschitz upper-level gradients, which fails for RNNs and LSTMs.
nodes.approach: Normalized momentum on the upper level plus initialization refinement and periodic updates for the lower-level variable.
nodes.niche_reason: Bilevel optimization under unbounded smoothness is a rare theory niche.

nodes.title: InstructScene: Instruction-Driven 3D Indoor Scene Synthesis with Semantic Graph Prior
nodes.tldr: Generates 3D indoor scenes from natural-language instructions using a semantic graph prior and layout decoder, with a new scene-instruction benchmark.
nodes.problem: Direct joint object distributions express relations implicitly, limiting controllability of 3D scene generation.
nodes.approach: Semantic graph prior that jointly learns scene appearance and layout, feeding a layout decoder.
nodes.niche_reason: Text-driven 3D scene synthesis is established but specialised

nodes.title: LoftQ: LoRA-Fine-Tuning-aware Quantization for Large Language Models
nodes.tldr: Jointly quantizes an LLM and initializes LoRA adapters, closing the gap to full fine-tuning, especially at 2-bit and mixed precision.
nodes.problem: Quantized LLMs with LoRA fine-tuning lag behind full fine-tuning on downstream tasks.
nodes.approach: Quantization-aware low-rank LoRA initialization that aligns quantized and full-precision models.
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › Efficient LLM Inference & Architectures
nodes.niche_reason: Quantization plus LoRA is a crowded PEFT direction.

nodes.title: AMAGO: Scalable In-Context Reinforcement Learning for Adaptive Agents
nodes.tldr: AMAGO trains long-sequence Transformers over entire rollouts with off-policy end-to-end RL, enabling scalable in-context RL for meta-RL, memory tasks and hindsight-relabeled goal-conditioned open-world problems.
nodes.problem: Scaling in-context RL with long memory, planning horizon and model size without heavy tuning.
nodes.approach: Off-policy Transformer agent trained in parallel over full rollouts, with multi-goal hindsight relabeling.
nodes.primary_topic: Reinforcement Learning › Transfer, Meta & Continual RL
nodes.niche_reason: In-context RL is established but specialised.

nodes.title: Improving Offline RL by Blending Heuristics
nodes.tldr: HUBL blends Monte-Carlo heuristic values into Bellman bootstrapping by relabeling offline rewards and discounts, improving four offline RL algorithms by about 9%.
nodes.problem: Bootstrapping-based offline RL has high complexity and limited finite-sample performance.
nodes.approach: Partially replace bootstrapped values with Monte-Carlo return heuristics via dataset relabeling of rewards and discount factors.
nodes.niche_reason: Offline RL algorithm improvements are common.

nodes.title: High-dimensional SGD aligns with emerging outlier eigenspaces
nodes.tldr: Proves that SGD trajectories align with emerging low-rank outlier eigenspaces of Hessian and gradient matrices in high-dimensional mixture classification with one or two layer networks.
nodes.problem: Rigorously explaining observed alignment between SGD dynamics and outlier spectra of Hessian and gradient matrices.
nodes.approach: High-dimensional analysis of SGD on Gaussian mixture and XOR tasks, tracking per-layer outlier eigenspace evolution.
nodes.primary_topic: Learning Theory & Optimization › High-dimensional & Random Matrix Theory
nodes.niche_reason: Random-matrix analysis of SGD and Hessian spectra is a rare theory niche.

nodes.title: InternVid: A Large-scale Video-Text Dataset for Multimodal Understanding and Generation
nodes.tldr: InternVid is a 7M-video, 234M-clip video-text dataset with LLM-generated captions, plus ViCLIP, a contrastive video-text model with strong zero-shot action recognition.
nodes.problem: Lack of large-scale, high-quality video-text data for video-language representation learning.
nodes.approach: LLM-driven multi-scale captioning pipeline and contrastive ViCLIP training on the resulting dataset.
nodes.niche_reason: Large video-language datasets are a common contribution type.

nodes.title: SyncDreamer: Generating Multiview-consistent Images from a Single-view Image
nodes.tldr: Generates multiview-consistent images from one view by synchronizing all generated views at every denoising step with 3D-aware feature attention.
nodes.problem: Novel views from a single image lose geometry and color consistency across views.
nodes.approach: Joint multiview diffusion with cross-view feature attention in a single reverse process.
nodes.niche_reason: Diffusion-based novel view synthesis is a common direction

nodes.title: Sudden Drops in the Loss: Syntax Acquisition, Phase Transitions, and Simplicity Bias in MLMs
nodes.tldr: Shows masked LMs abruptly acquire syntactic attention structure in a brief pretraining window alongside a loss drop, which is necessary for grammar.
nodes.problem: Interpretability studies usually examine trained models, missing how behaviours such as syntax emerge during training.
nodes.approach: Track syntactic attention heads over pretraining checkpoints, then manipulate them during training to test their causal role.
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › Language Model Interpretability
nodes.niche_reason: Training-trajectory interpretability of MLM syntax is specialised but established.

nodes.title: DrM: Mastering Visual Reinforcement Learning through Dormant Ratio Minimization
nodes.tldr: Identifies dormant neurons as a cause of inactive exploration in visual RL; DrM minimizes dormant ratio, solving hard Dog and Adroit tasks from pixels.
nodes.problem: Visual RL agents suffer early inactivity, poor sample efficiency and unstable seeds.
nodes.approach: Three mechanisms that actively minimize the policy network's dormant ratio to guide exploration-exploitation.
nodes.primary_topic: Reinforcement Learning › Online & Deep RL Algorithms
nodes.niche_reason: Deep RL algorithm tweaks are common, though the dormant neuron angle is modest.

nodes.title: Learning to Act from Actionless Videos through Dense Correspondences
nodes.tldr: Learns a video-based robot policy from RGB videos without action labels, by synthesizing robot videos and inferring actions from dense frame correspondences.
nodes.problem: Robot policies usually need action-labelled demonstrations, which are costly to collect across robots.
nodes.approach: Image-based task representation with video synthesis and dense correspondences to recover executable actions.
nodes.niche_reason: Actionless-video policy learning is a specialised robot-learning niche

nodes.title: DyST: Towards Dynamic Neural Scene Representations on Real-World Videos
nodes.tldr: DyST learns latent decomposition of monocular real-world videos into scene content, per-view dynamics and camera pose, enabling separate camera and dynamics control in view generation.
nodes.problem: Capturing 3D structure and dynamics of real scenes from monocular videos without 3D supervision.
nodes.approach: Dynamic Scene Transformer with latent decomposition trained via co-training on real videos and synthetic DySO.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: Latent scene representations for dynamic video are specialised.

nodes.title: Memorization Capacity of Multi-Head Attention in Transformers
nodes.tldr: Proves a multi-head attention layer with H heads and Theta(Hd^2) parameters can memorize Omega(Hn) sequences under linear-independence data assumptions, supported by synthetic experiments.
nodes.problem: Memorization capacity of multi-head attention as a function of heads and sequence length is poorly understood.
nodes.approach: Theoretical construction under linear independence assumptions using softmax saturation, validated on synthetic data.
nodes.primary_topic: Learning Theory & Optimization › Deep Learning Theory
nodes.niche_reason: Transformer memorization theory is established but specialised.

nodes.title: MetaMath: Bootstrap Your Own Mathematical Questions for Large Language Models
nodes.tldr: Bootstraps math questions by rewriting them from multiple perspectives into MetaMathQA, then finetunes LLaMA-2 to outperform open-source models on GSM8K and MATH.
nodes.problem: Open LLMs lag at multi-step mathematical reasoning.
nodes.approach: Question rewriting bootstrap to build an augmented math dataset, then supervised finetuning.
secondary_topics: Data, Benchmarks & Evaluation › Synthetic Data & Data Curation
nodes.niche_reason: LLM math finetuning is a crowded direction

nodes.title: Unified Generative Modeling of 3D Molecules with Bayesian Flow Networks
nodes.tldr: GeoBFN uses Bayesian Flow Networks to model multimodal 3D molecule geometry in distribution-parameter space with SE(3)-invariant density, achieving state-of-the-art generation and 20x faster sampling.
nodes.problem: Diffusion models fit poorly to multimodal, noise-sensitive 3D molecular geometry.
nodes.approach: Equivariant Bayesian Flow Networks unifying modalities in differentiable parameter space of distributions.
nodes.niche_reason: Bayesian flow networks are a rare generative family.

nodes.title: Optimal Sample Complexity of Contrastive Learning
nodes.tldr: Proves nearly tight sample complexity bounds for contrastive learning of lp-distances and tree metrics via VC/Natarajan dimension, which also predict experimental results.
nodes.problem: How many labeled tuples suffice to learn representations from contrastive supervision with high generalization accuracy.
nodes.approach: Derive VC/Natarajan dimension bounds for distance functions, giving Theta~(nd) for lp-distances.
nodes.primary_topic: Learning Theory & Optimization › Learning Theory Lower Bounds & Complexity
nodes.niche_reason: Statistical learning bounds for contrastive tuples are a rare theory niche.

nodes.title: GIM: Learning Generalizable Image Matcher From Internet Videos
nodes.tldr: GIM self-trains a single generalizable image matcher from internet videos using propagated, robustly filtered dense labels, and introduces ZEB, a zero-shot image matching benchmark.
nodes.problem: Learned image matchers generalize poorly across scene types because standard datasets lack diversity.
nodes.approach: Self-training on YouTube videos with complementary matchers, robust-fit filtering and label propagation; cross-domain benchmark.
nodes.niche_reason: Image matching is an established but specialised geometry subfield.

nodes.title: Predictive, scalable and interpretable knowledge tracing on structured domains
nodes.tldr: A hierarchical generative knowledge-tracing model that interpretably models learner traits and prerequisite structure with scalable Bayesian inference.
nodes.problem: Deep knowledge tracing models are accurate but sacrifice the interpretability of psychological models.
nodes.approach: Hierarchical generative model of cognitive traits and prerequisite structure, fit with scalable variational Bayesian inference.
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Probabilistic & Bayesian Methods
nodes.confidence_reason: Venue hint says neuroscience; abstract describes tutoring systems
nodes.niche_reason: Interpretable knowledge tracing with prerequisite maps is unusual

nodes.title: MOTOR: A Time-to-Event Foundation Model For Structured Medical Records
nodes.tldr: Self-supervised time-to-event foundation model pretrained on up to 55M patient EHR and claims records, improving downstream survival prediction and label efficiency.
nodes.problem: Time-to-event clinical prediction is hard to train with limited labeled data.
nodes.approach: Pretrain on timestamped clinical event sequences, then adapt to downstream tasks.
secondary_topics: Architectures & Training › Time Series & Sequential Data
nodes.niche_reason: Established medical foundation models; time-to-event focus is specialised.

nodes.title: A General Framework for User-Guided Bayesian Optimization
nodes.tldr: Lets domain experts encode beliefs about the optimizer location or value into Bayesian optimization, accelerating search when accurate and retaining near-default performance when misleading.
nodes.problem: Bayesian optimization cannot easily use expert prior knowledge beyond kernel structure.
nodes.approach: Bayesian-principled framework that adds user beliefs to Monte Carlo acquisition functions.
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Probabilistic & Bayesian Methods
nodes.confidence_reason: Judgment between AutoML and Bayesian methods.
nodes.niche_reason: Priors in Bayesian optimization are established but still a specialised niche.

nodes.title: Lagrangian Flow Networks for Conservation Laws
nodes.tldr: Models fluid density and velocity with invertible maps that satisfy the continuity equation by construction, without ODE solvers or PDE penalties.
nodes.problem: Neural fluid models often violate mass conservation or need costly ODE solvers and penalties.
nodes.approach: Transform a base density with time-conditioned invertible diffeomorphisms derived from Lagrangian flows.
secondary_topics: Generative Models › GANs, VAEs & Normalizing Flows
nodes.niche_reason: Physics-constrained density flows are specialised but established

nodes.title: DragonDiffusion: Enabling Drag-style Manipulation on Diffusion Models
nodes.tldr: DragonDiffusion enables drag-style image editing on a frozen pretrained diffusion model by turning feature correspondence into gradient guidance, with no fine-tuning.
nodes.problem: Text-to-image diffusion models generate well but struggle with accurate, localized image editing.
nodes.approach: Energy functions on diffusion features drive multi-scale gradient guidance, plus memory-bank cross-attention for consistency.
nodes.niche_reason: Training-free diffusion image editing is a crowded research direction.

nodes.title: Multi-View Causal Representation Learning with Partial Observability
nodes.tldr: Proves identifiability of shared latent variables from partially observed multi-view data via contrastive learning, with graphical criteria unifying multi-view ICA and causal representation learning.
nodes.problem: Identifying latent variables from multiple partial views (modalities) with possibly causally related latents.
nodes.approach: Identifiability theory with contrastive learning, per-view encoders, and graphical rules called identifiability algebra.
nodes.primary_topic: Learning Theory & Optimization › Causality & Causal Inference
nodes.niche_reason: Identifiable causal representation learning is a rare theory niche.

nodes.title: GenSim: Generating Robotic Simulation Tasks via Large Language Models
nodes.tldr: GenSim has LLMs write robotic simulation task code and demonstrations, expanding benchmarks tenfold to over 100 tasks and improving multitask policy generalization and sim-to-real transfer.
nodes.problem: Simulation data for robot policies lacks task-level diversity because new tasks need human effort.
nodes.approach: Prompt GPT-4 to generate task code via goal-directed and exploratory curricula, then train multitask policies.
secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › Code Generation & Software
nodes.niche_reason: LLM-generated simulation tasks are an emerging specialised direction.

nodes.title: Spectrally Transformed Kernel Regression
nodes.tldr: Revisits spectrally transformed kernel regression to exploit unlabeled data, giving scalable inductive estimators and statistical guarantees for known and unknown transformations.
nodes.problem: Semi-supervised kernel methods using unlabeled data were mostly limited to transductive settings.
nodes.approach: Spectral transformation of a base similarity kernel, with scalable inductive implementations and kernel PCA.
nodes.primary_topic: Learning Theory & Optimization › Kernels, GPs & Nonparametrics
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Generalization & Statistical Learning
nodes.niche_reason: Spectrally transformed kernel regression is classical yet rare

nodes.title: PILOT: An $\mathcal{O}(1/K)$-Convergent Approach for Policy Evaluation with Nonlinear Function Approximation
nodes.tldr: PILOT, a path-integrated primal-dual stochastic gradient method, achieves O(1/K) convergence for policy evaluation with nonlinear function approximation; PILOT+ adapts batch size.
nodes.problem: Policy evaluation with nonlinear function approximation has slow convergence and poor sample complexity.
nodes.approach: Path-integrated primal-dual stochastic gradient for non-convex strongly-concave minimax, with adaptive batch sizing.
nodes.niche_reason: Single-timescale minimax policy evaluation theory is rare.

nodes.title: Universal Humanoid Motion Representations for Physics-Based Control
nodes.tldr: Learns a universal humanoid motion representation by distilling a large-dataset imitator into a latent space with a variational bottleneck and proprioceptive prior for hierarchical RL.
nodes.problem: Prior humanoid skill embeddings cover only narrow movement styles, limiting use in complex tasks.
nodes.approach: Train an all-motion imitator, distill skills with an encoder-decoder and variational information bottleneck, plus a proprioception-conditioned prior.
nodes.niche_reason: Physics-based humanoid skill latent spaces are specialised.

nodes.title: Amortizing intractable inference in large language models
nodes.tldr: Fine-tunes LLMs with GFlowNet diversity-seeking RL so they sample from intractable posteriors, such as infilling and constrained generation, with data-efficient reasoning adaptation.
nodes.problem: Autoregressive LLMs can only sample tractably left-to-right, not from intractable posteriors.
nodes.approach: Amortized Bayesian inference via GFlowNet fine-tuning as an alternative to MLE and reward maximization.
nodes.primary_topic: Learning Theory & Optimization › Probabilistic & Bayesian Methods
secondary_topics: Reinforcement Learning › RL for LLMs & Reasoning
nodes.confidence_reason: Bayesian LLM sampling sits between probabilistic methods and RL.
nodes.niche_reason: GFlowNet fine-tuning of LLMs for posterior sampling is rare

nodes.title: Unlocking the Power of Representations in Long-term Novelty-based Exploration
nodes.tldr: RECODE estimates visit counts for state clusters in an embedding space, a non-parametric novelty bonus that reaches state-of-the-art on hard exploration.
nodes.problem: Count-based novelty exploration in deep RL breaks down because visitation statistics are nonstationary over long training.
nodes.approach: Online clustering-based density estimation plus a generalized inverse-dynamics loss using masked transformers for multi-step prediction.
nodes.niche_reason: Count-based exploration is a well-trodden direction in deep RL.

nodes.title: TD-MPC2: Scalable, Robust World Models for Continuous Control
nodes.tldr: TD-MPC2 improves latent-space model-based RL with decoder-free world models, solving 104 tasks with one hyperparameter set and scaling to a 317M-parameter 80-task agent.
nodes.problem: Scalable, robust model-based RL for continuous control across diverse tasks and embodiments.
nodes.approach: Decoder-free implicit world model with local trajectory optimization in latent space and architectural improvements.
nodes.primary_topic: Reinforcement Learning › Model-Based RL & World Models
nodes.niche_reason: Model-based RL for control is a common, established area.

nodes.title: Learning Energy Decompositions for Partial Inference in GFlowNets
nodes.tldr: Decomposes object energies into learned potentials on state transitions, reparameterizing GFlowNet flows to give smooth local credit without costly intermediate energy evaluation.
nodes.problem: Intermediate energy evaluation in GFlowNet partial inference is expensive and can mislead training.
nodes.approach: Learn an energy decomposition into transition potentials regularized to change smoothly.
nodes.confidence_reason: GFlowNet training could fit sampling or discrete generation
nodes.niche_reason: GFlowNet sampling is specialised; energy decomposition is niche
