nodes.title: FLD: Fourier Latent Dynamics for Structured Motion Representation and Learning
nodes.tldr: FLD learns a self-supervised Fourier latent dynamics representation of periodic motions, enabling interpolation and an online tracking controller with a safe fallback for unseen targets.
nodes.problem: Motion reference data is sparse, limiting generalization of physics-based motion learning.
nodes.approach: Self-supervised structured latent parameterization of periodic motion dynamics informing an RL tracking controller with fallback.
nodes.confidence_reason: Abstract omits robot type; topic split between motion representation and control.
nodes.niche_reason: Fourier-structured motion latent spaces are uncommon.

nodes.title: Dual RL: Unification and New Methods for Reinforcement and Imitation Learning
nodes.tldr: Dual RL unifies state-of-the-art offline RL and imitation methods as dual problems, then proposes discriminator-free and loss-fixing variants that improve robot benchmarks.
nodes.problem: Prior offline RL and imitation methods rely on restrictive coverage assumptions and training instability.
nodes.approach: Unified dual-RL view; ReCOIL imitates from arbitrary off-policy data and f-DVL replaces Gumbel regression loss.
nodes.niche_reason: Offline RL and imitation are crowded, mainstream areas.

nodes.title: ClimODE: Climate and Weather Forecasting with Physics-informed Neural ODEs
nodes.tldr: ClimODE models weather as value-conserving advection with a neural ODE flow, giving accurate global forecasts with uncertainty and far fewer parameters.
nodes.problem: Data-driven weather models ignore physics and lack uncertainty quantification.
nodes.approach: Continuous-time neural ODE implementing advection with value-conserving dynamics and uncertainty estimation.
secondary_topics: Architectures & Training › Time Series & Sequential Data
nodes.niche_reason: Physics-informed weather forecasting is established but specialised.

nodes.title: DreamLLM: Synergistic Multimodal Comprehension and Creation
nodes.tldr: Trains an MLLM that both understands and generates interleaved text and images by directly sampling raw multimodal content, avoiding CLIP feature bottlenecks.
nodes.problem: MLLMs handle comprehension and creation separately and rely on lossy external encoders like CLIP.
nodes.approach: Models language and image posteriors by direct sampling in raw multimodal space over interleaved documents.
nodes.niche_reason: Unified multimodal LLMs are crowded; raw-space sampling is less common.

nodes.title: PolyGCL: GRAPH CONTRASTIVE LEARNING via Learnable Spectral Polynomial Filters
nodes.tldr: Graph contrastive learning with learnable spectral polynomial filters contrasts low-pass and high-pass views, handling both homophilic and heterophilic graphs.
nodes.problem: Graph contrastive learning is low-pass biased and struggles on heterophilic graphs.
nodes.approach: Learnable polynomial spectral filters generate low/high-pass views for a contrastive objective, with theory.
nodes.niche_reason: Specialised spectral graph self-supervision niche.

nodes.title: Inverse Approximation Theory for Nonlinear Recurrent Neural Networks
nodes.tldr: Proves that nonlinear RNNs can only stably approximate sequence relations with exponentially decaying memory, and proposes a reparameterization.
nodes.problem: Unclear what memory structures RNNs can learn, especially long-term memory dependencies.
nodes.approach: Bernstein-type inverse approximation theorem, plus a reparameterization to overcome the memory limitation.
nodes.primary_topic: Learning Theory & Optimization › Deep Learning Theory
secondary_topics: Architectures & Training › Time Series & Sequential Data
nodes.niche_reason: Specialised approximation limits of RNNs for long-term memory.

nodes.title: Faithful and Efficient Explanations for Neural Networks via Neural Tangent Kernel Surrogate Models
nodes.tldr: Uses approximate empirical neural tangent kernels with random projections as kernel-machine surrogates for data attribution and explanation, introducing trace NTK as the most consistent variant.
nodes.problem: Explaining neural networks via kernel surrogates is limited by the high computational cost of the empirical NTK.
nodes.approach: Define random-projection approximate eNTKs and evaluate how well kernel surrogate models correlate with the network.
nodes.primary_topic: Data, Benchmarks & Evaluation › Data Attribution & Influence
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Kernels, GPs & Nonparametrics
nodes.niche_reason: NTK-based surrogates for attribution are a rare combination.

nodes.title: MAmmoTH: Building Math Generalist Models through Hybrid Instruction Tuning
nodes.tldr: Introduces MAmmoTH math LLMs fine-tuned on a hybrid chain-of-thought and program-of-thought dataset, outperforming open models on math benchmarks.
nodes.problem: Open-source LLMs lag at general math problem solving across diverse fields.
nodes.approach: Instruction tuning on MathInstruct, mixing CoT and PoT rationales compiled from 13 math datasets.
nodes.niche_reason: Math reasoning fine-tuning is a crowded mainstream direction

nodes.title: Provable Reward-Agnostic Preference-Based Reinforcement Learning
nodes.tldr: Provides a theoretical reward-agnostic preference-based RL framework that gathers exploratory trajectories before human feedback, reducing required feedback for optimal policies.
nodes.problem: Theory for preference-based RL ignores practical settings where trajectories are collected before feedback.
nodes.approach: Reward-agnostic exploration phase followed by preference queries, with sample complexity analysis.
nodes.primary_topic: Reinforcement Learning › Reward Learning, Inverse RL & Preferences
nodes.niche_reason: Theoretical PbRL is established but specialised.

nodes.title: ValUES: A Framework for Systematic Validation of Uncertainty Estimation in Semantic Segmentation
nodes.tldr: ValUES is an evaluation framework with controlled data ambiguity and ablations for validating uncertainty estimation methods in semantic segmentation across five downstream applications.
nodes.problem: Lack of systematic evaluation of uncertainty methods in semantic segmentation
nodes.approach: Controlled simulated environment, component ablations and test-beds for five uncertainty applications
nodes.niche_reason: Specialised uncertainty-in-segmentation validation study

nodes.title: Pre-Training and Fine-Tuning Generative Flow Networks
nodes.tldr: Introduces reward-free pretraining for GFlowNets via outcome-conditioned sampling, then amortised fine-tuning to quickly adapt the sampler to new downstream rewards.
nodes.problem: GFlowNets lack unsupervised pretraining, so adapting to new downstream rewards is inefficient.
nodes.approach: Outcome-conditioned GFlowNet learns to reach any target outcome, plus an amortised predictor for marginalisation.
nodes.primary_topic: Learning Theory & Optimization › Probabilistic & Bayesian Methods
secondary_topics: Reinforcement Learning › Transfer, Meta & Continual RL
nodes.confidence_reason: GFlowNets straddle amortised sampling and goal-conditioned RL
nodes.niche_reason: Reward-free GFlowNet pretraining is a rare direction

nodes.title: Equivariant Matrix Function Neural Networks
nodes.tldr: Matrix Function Neural Networks model non-local interactions via equivariant matrix functions and resolvent expansions, scaling near-linearly with system size.
nodes.problem: Message-passing GNNs struggle to model non-local interactions in large molecules and materials.
nodes.approach: Equivariant matrix functions parameterize non-local interactions via resolvent expansions with potential linear scaling.
nodes.niche_reason: Equivariant matrix-function networks are a specialised architecture direction

nodes.title: Empirical Analysis of Model Selection for Heterogeneous Causal Effect Estimation
nodes.tldr: Empirically compares surrogate metrics for selecting CATE models without observed counterfactuals, tuning them with AutoML on realistic synthetic datasets.
nodes.problem: Choosing CATE models is hard because counterfactual outcomes are never observed.
nodes.approach: Benchmark observed-data surrogate selection metrics fairly via AutoML tuning and propose causal ensembling strategies.
nodes.primary_topic: Learning Theory & Optimization › Causality & Causal Inference
nodes.niche_reason: Empirical CATE model selection is a rare, specialised topic.

nodes.title: Massively Scalable Inverse Reinforcement Learning in Google Maps
nodes.tldr: Scales inverse RL to planetary-scale route recommendation using graph compression and a receding-horizon inverse planner, improving route quality 16-24% globally.
nodes.problem: Learning latent route preferences from demonstrations is intractable at hundreds of millions of states.
nodes.approach: Receding Horizon Inverse Planning generalizing classic IRL, with graph compression and spatial parallelization.
nodes.primary_topic: Reinforcement Learning › Reward Learning, Inverse RL & Preferences
nodes.niche_reason: Planetary-scale IRL for routing is a rare real-world setting

nodes.title: Pre-training with Random Orthogonal Projection Image Modeling
nodes.tldr: ROPIM replaces binary masking in masked image modeling with random orthogonal projections that attenuate spatial token information with bounded noise variance, improving visual pre-training.
nodes.problem: Improving masked image modeling pre-training beyond crop-based binary masking.
nodes.approach: Random orthogonal projection as soft masking with recovery using the complementary subspace.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › Vision Foundation Models & Self-Supervision
nodes.niche_reason: MIM variants are common though the projection angle is slightly novel.

nodes.title: Protein Discovery with Discrete Walk-Jump Sampling
nodes.tldr: Trains a smoothed energy model on discrete sequences, samples with Langevin MCMC and denoises back to data, yielding lab-validated antibody designs.
nodes.problem: Discrete generative models are difficult to train and sample from, limiting protein design.
nodes.approach: Contrastive-divergence energy training plus single-noise-level denoising, with long-run MCMC chains.
nodes.niche_reason: Discrete energy-based protein generation is specialised

nodes.title: CADS: Unleashing the Diversity of Diffusion Models through Condition-Annealed Sampling
nodes.tldr: CADS raises diffusion output diversity at high guidance by annealing noise added to the conditioning vector during sampling, reaching FID 1.70 on ImageNet 256.
nodes.problem: Conditional diffusion models lose sample diversity at high classifier-free guidance or small datasets.
nodes.approach: Add scheduled, decreasing Gaussian noise to the conditioning signal during inference.
nodes.niche_reason: Diffusion sampler tweaks are a crowded direction.

nodes.title: Error Norm Truncation: Robust Training in the Presence of Data Noise for Text Generation Models
nodes.tldr: Proposes Error Norm Truncation, a training objective that filters noisy web-crawled data by considering the distribution of non-target tokens, improving generation robustness.
nodes.problem: Text generation models are vulnerable to noisy training data from web crawls.
nodes.approach: Truncates noisy examples using error norm over non-target token distributions.
nodes.primary_topic: Data, Benchmarks & Evaluation › Synthetic Data & Data Curation
nodes.confidence_reason: Data-curation objective versus generation training; judgment call.
nodes.niche_reason: Noise-robust text generation training is a common theme.

nodes.title: Task Adaptation from Skills: Information Geometry, Disentanglement, and New Objectives for Unsupervised Reinforcement Learning
nodes.tldr: Analyzes unsupervised skill learning theoretically and proposes a Wasserstein-based skill objective that yields more diverse, separable initial policies for downstream tasks.
nodes.problem: Mutual-information skill learning does not guarantee skills that help downstream task adaptation.
nodes.approach: Information-geometric analysis with Wasserstein distance replacing KL in the skill objective.
secondary_topics: Reinforcement Learning › Transfer, Meta & Continual RL
nodes.niche_reason: Unsupervised skill discovery is specialised but has an active community

nodes.title: On the Joint Interaction of Models, Data, and Features
nodes.tldr: Introduces an interaction tensor to analyze how data features and random seeds shape what models learn, giving closed-form accuracy and agreement predictions.
nodes.problem: Theory of how features in data and models drive deep learning generalization is still in early development.
nodes.approach: Interaction tensor analysis of data-model features, giving closed-form accuracy and agreement predictions.
nodes.primary_topic: Learning Theory & Optimization › Deep Learning Theory
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Generalization & Statistical Learning
nodes.confidence_reason: Theory of feature learning with empirical analysis; generalization topic is a close alternative
nodes.niche_reason: Feature-level interaction analysis of seeds and data is unusual

nodes.title: Long-Term Typhoon Trajectory Prediction: A Physics-Conditioned Approach Without Reanalysis Data
nodes.tldr: Predicts typhoon trajectories 72 hours ahead from real-time Unified Model forecast data instead of reanalysis data, and releases the PHYSICS TRACK dataset.
nodes.problem: Data-driven typhoon forecasting relies on reanalysis data that is unavailable in real time.
nodes.approach: Physics-conditioned deep model using real-time Unified Model forecasts to predict tracks at 6-hour intervals.
secondary_topics: Architectures & Training › Time Series & Sequential Data
nodes.niche_reason: Tropical cyclone track forecasting is a rare application topic.

nodes.title: Nemesis: Normalizing the Soft-prompt Vectors of Vision-Language Models
nodes.tldr: Finds that reducing norms of some learned soft prompts can improve CLIP-style VLM performance, and proposes normalizing them.
nodes.problem: Unknown how the norms of learnable soft prompts affect vision-language model performance.
nodes.approach: Normalize soft-prompt vectors to counteract the low-norm effect found by corruption experiments.
nodes.niche_reason: Soft-prompt norms are a less-explored VLM question

nodes.title: DataEnvGym: Data Generation Agents in Teacher Environments with Student Feedback
nodes.tldr: Introduces DataEnvGym, a testbed where data-generation agents act as teachers, iteratively improving a student model using its skill-level feedback across four tasks.
nodes.problem: Automating human-driven training data creation needs environments with closed feedback loops.
nodes.approach: Sequential decision teacher environments with a planning policy, data engine, and student feedback.
nodes.primary_topic: Data, Benchmarks & Evaluation › Synthetic Data & Data Curation
secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › Agents & Tool Use
nodes.confidence_reason: Straddles synthetic data curation and LLM agent evaluation
nodes.niche_reason: Teacher-student testbed for autonomous data-generation agents is rare

nodes.title: Adaptive Gradient Clipping for Robust Federated Learning
nodes.tldr: Adaptive Robust Clipping dynamically sets gradient clipping thresholds in Byzantine-robust distributed gradient descent, preserving guarantees and improving convergence and empirical robustness.
nodes.problem: Static pre-aggregation clipping gives inconsistent robustness across attacks in robust federated learning.
nodes.approach: Adaptive clipping thresholds computed from input gradients, with theoretical convergence analysis.
nodes.niche_reason: Byzantine-robust learning is an established specialised area.

nodes.title: Holistically Evaluating the Environmental Impact of Creating Language Models
nodes.tldr: Estimates real-world environmental impact of developing language models of 20M to 13B parameters, including hardware manufacturing, power and water usage.
nodes.problem: Environmental cost of model development beyond final training runs is poorly documented.
nodes.approach: Measured power, carbon and water across development stages with transparent accounting.
secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › Pretraining, Scaling & Data
nodes.niche_reason: Environmental accounting of LM development is uncommon.

nodes.title: Synthetic continued pretraining
nodes.tldr: EntiGraph synthesizes a large diverse corpus from a small domain document set by linking extracted entities, then continues pretraining so models learn facts data-efficiently.
nodes.problem: Language models acquire facts data-inefficiently, making adaptation to small domain-specific corpora hard.
nodes.approach: Entity-graph-based synthetic data augmentation followed by continued pretraining on the synthesized corpus.
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › Pretraining, Scaling & Data
secondary_topics: Data, Benchmarks & Evaluation › Synthetic Data & Data Curation
nodes.niche_reason: Synthetic data for pretraining is popular, but small-corpus knowledge acquisition angle is more specific.

nodes.title: Multi-modal Agent Tuning: Building a VLM-Driven Agent for Efficient Tool Usage
nodes.tldr: Synthesizes multimodal tool-usage trajectories with GPT-4o mini and tunes VLMs into controllers that outperform untrained VLMs by 20% on GTA and GAIA.
nodes.problem: VLMs lack the tool-usage reasoning needed to act as multimodal agent controllers.
nodes.approach: Generate verified multimodal tool-use trajectories as training data, then tune VLMs on them.
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › Agents & Tool Use
nodes.niche_reason: Multimodal tool-use agents are a common direction.

nodes.title: ProtComposer: Compositional Protein Structure Generation with 3D Ellipsoids
nodes.tldr: Generates protein structures conditioned on 3D ellipsoid layouts that control substructure location, size, orientation, and secondary structure, expanding the designability-novelty-diversity frontier.
nodes.problem: Protein generators lack controllable spatial layout and oversample simple helix bundles.
nodes.approach: Diffusion-based generation conditioned on ellipsoids from hand-made, extracted, or statistical layouts.
nodes.niche_reason: Ellipsoid-conditioned protein generation is specialised.

nodes.title: ThunderKittens: Simple, Fast, and $\textit{Adorable}$ Kernels
nodes.tldr: ThunderKittens is a small set of GPU abstractions (tiles, async templates, grid-level scheduling) for writing fast AI kernels that match or beat FlashAttention-3 and cuBLAS.
nodes.problem: Hand-written GPU kernels fail to reach theoretical performance and are hard to write.
nodes.approach: Provide warp, thread-block and grid-level abstractions built around 16x16 tiles.
secondary_topics: Architectures & Training › State-Space Models & Linear Attention
nodes.niche_reason: GPU kernel DSLs are specialised but actively studied.

nodes.title: PETRA: Parallel End-to-end Training with Reversible Architectures
nodes.tldr: PETRA uses reversible architectures to parallelize training across devices with delayed gradients, avoiding activation storage and enabling stage-independent computation.
nodes.problem: Model-parallel training requires costly communication and activation storage during backpropagation.
nodes.approach: Reversible stages with delayed gradients as an alternative to backprop.
nodes.primary_topic: Architectures & Training › Efficient Training, Compression & Pruning
nodes.niche_reason: Reversible-architecture parallel training is a rare direction.

nodes.title: Universal generalization guarantees for Wasserstein distributionally robust models
nodes.tldr: Establishes exact generalization guarantees for Wasserstein distributionally robust models with arbitrary transport costs and nonsmooth deep losses, plus an excess bound.
nodes.problem: Existing Wasserstein robust generalization bounds are approximate, special-case, or rely on hard-to-verify assumptions.
nodes.approach: Exact generalization analysis for arbitrary transport costs and parametric losses, plus an entropic-regularized extension.
nodes.primary_topic: Learning Theory & Optimization › Generalization & Statistical Learning
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Optimal Transport & Divergences
nodes.niche_reason: Specialised theory of robust Wasserstein generalization

nodes.title: Monitoring Latent World States in Language Models with Propositional Probes
nodes.tldr: Propositional probes decode latent world-state propositions from LM activations via a binding subspace, staying faithful under prompt injection and backdoors.
nodes.problem: LMs can respond unfaithfully to context through bias, injections or backdoors, and monitoring needs their internal states.
nodes.approach: Probes compose lexical concepts from token activations and bind them into propositions within a learned binding subspace.
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › Language Model Interpretability
nodes.niche_reason: Logical proposition decoding from LM activations is a rare interpretability niche

nodes.title: In vivo cell-type and brain region classification via multimodal contrastive learning
nodes.tldr: NEMO jointly embeds neurons' activity autocorrelations and extracellular waveforms with multimodal contrastive learning, achieving state-of-the-art cell-type and brain-region classification from electrophysiology.
nodes.problem: Identifying cell type and brain region of recorded neurons without molecular or histological analysis.
nodes.approach: Multimodal contrastive pretraining on waveforms and autocorrelograms, then supervised fine-tuning.
nodes.niche_reason: Electrophysiology neuron-type classification is a rare application niche.

nodes.title: OmniRe: Omni Urban Scene Reconstruction
nodes.tldr: Builds Gaussian-splatting scene graphs that reconstruct all dynamic urban actors, including pedestrians and cyclists, from driving logs to enable simulation.
nodes.problem: Holistic reconstruction of all dynamic objects in urban driving scenes, beyond vehicles, for simulation.
nodes.approach: Scene graphs on 3DGS with per-actor canonical Gaussian representations for vehicles, humans and others.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: Driving-scene splatting is established and specialised.

nodes.title: TimeMixer++: A General Time Series Pattern Machine for Universal Predictive Analysis
nodes.tldr: TimeMixer++ is a general time series model mixing multi-scale time and multi-resolution frequency patterns for forecasting, classification, anomaly detection and imputation.
nodes.problem: Universal time series pattern extraction across diverse tasks.
nodes.approach: Multi-scale time-domain and multi-resolution frequency-domain mixing to extract task-adaptive patterns.
nodes.primary_topic: Architectures & Training › Time Series & Sequential Data
nodes.niche_reason: Time series forecasting architectures are common.

nodes.title: Wide Neural Networks Trained with Weight Decay Provably Exhibit Neural Collapse
nodes.tldr: Proves neural collapse emerges in end-to-end gradient descent with weight decay for networks ending in two linear layers, given balancedness and bounded conditioning.
nodes.problem: Neural collapse theory assumes unconstrained features, which ignores how real DNNs are trained.
nodes.approach: Generic guarantees from low training error, layer balancedness, and feature conditioning under weight-decayed GD.
nodes.primary_topic: Learning Theory & Optimization › Deep Learning Theory
nodes.niche_reason: Neural collapse theory is active but a specialised area

nodes.title: MathCoder2: Better Math Reasoning from Continued Pretraining on Model-translated Mathematical Code
nodes.tldr: Builds a 19.2B-token math pretraining corpus by pairing reasoning steps with model-generated code, improving math ability of several base models.
nodes.problem: Math reasoning in LLMs lacks pretraining data that pairs reasoning with precise code
nodes.approach: Extract LaTeX expressions and conditions, generate paired code for each reasoning step, then continue pretraining.
secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › Pretraining, Scaling & Data
nodes.niche_reason: Math reasoning via continued pretraining is a crowded LLM direction

nodes.title: Century: A Framework and Dataset for Evaluating Historical Contextualisation of Sensitive Images
nodes.tldr: Century is a dataset of 1,500 sensitive historical images and an evaluation framework for how well multimodal models contextualise them on accuracy, thoroughness, and objectivity.
nodes.problem: Evaluating multimodal models on describing nuanced, contested historical events and figures in images.
nodes.approach: Dataset built via knowledge graphs and LLMs with museum-inspired criteria, plus automated and human evaluation.
nodes.niche_reason: Historical contextualisation of sensitive images is an unusual evaluation focus.

nodes.title: Open-Vocabulary Customization from CLIP via Data-Free Knowledge Distillation
nodes.tldr: Data-free knowledge distillation of CLIP using text-prompt-inverted synthetic images with style diversification and meta distillation, enabling small customized open-vocabulary models.
nodes.problem: Distilling CLIP into customizable small models without access to original training data.
nodes.approach: Invert surrogate images from text prompts, diversify styles, then meta-distill a student model.
secondary_topics: Architectures & Training › Efficient Training, Compression & Pruning
nodes.niche_reason: Data-free distillation applied to CLIP is specialised.

nodes.title: Fast Uncovering of Protein Sequence Diversity from Structure
nodes.tldr: InvMSAFold is a fast inverse folding method outputting pairwise sequence distribution parameters learned from MSAs, generating diverse protein sequences orders of magnitude faster.
nodes.problem: Inverse folding methods generate protein sequences slowly and with limited diversity for a given structure.
nodes.approach: Predict parameters of a pairwise (Potts-like) sequence distribution capturing MSA covariances conditioned on structure.
nodes.niche_reason: Protein design is established; MSA-based pairwise inverse folding is specialised.

nodes.title: Bayesian Optimization via Continual Variational Last Layer Training
nodes.tldr: Bayesian optimization surrogate using variational Bayesian last layers with online training tied to GP conditioning, matching GPs and beating them on complex correlations.
nodes.problem: GP surrogates struggle with complex correlation structures while BNNs perform poorly for Bayesian optimization.
nodes.approach: Variational Bayesian last layers with an efficient online algorithm interleaving conditioning and optimization.
nodes.primary_topic: Learning Theory & Optimization › Probabilistic & Bayesian Methods
nodes.niche_reason: BNN surrogates for Bayesian optimization are established but specialised.

nodes.title: RMP-SAM: Towards Real-Time Multi-Purpose Segment Anything
nodes.tldr: RMP-SAM is a real-time single model for interactive, panoptic and video instance segmentation, using dynamic convolution and an efficient decoupled adapter.
nodes.problem: Segmentation foundation models are too heavy for real-time multi-task use.
nodes.approach: Efficient encoder with dynamic-convolution prompt-driven decoding and decoupled adapter co-trained on multiple segmentation tasks.
secondary_topics: Computer Vision › Vision Foundation Models & Self-Supervision
nodes.niche_reason: Segment-Anything-style segmentation is a common direction.

nodes.title: NetMoE: Accelerating MoE Training through Dynamic Sample Placement
nodes.tldr: NetMoE reduces All-to-All communication in MoE training by dynamically placing training samples using routing locality, solved via integer programming.
nodes.problem: All-to-All communication bottlenecks distributed MoE training.
nodes.approach: Exploit intra-sample expert routing locality; optimise sample placement with an integer program.
secondary_topics: Architectures & Training › Mixture of Experts & Sparsity
nodes.niche_reason: MoE training systems optimisation is specialised but active.

nodes.title: High-dimensional Analysis of Knowledge Distillation: Weak-to-Strong Generalization and Scaling Laws
nodes.tldr: Gives sharp high-dimensional risk characterization for knowledge distillation under model and distribution shift, showing weak-to-strong training can beat strong labels yet cannot improve scaling laws.
nodes.problem: How surrogate-generated labels affect target-model risk and data scaling in distillation is unclear.
nodes.approach: Non-asymptotic risk bounds for ridgeless high-dimensional regression, deriving the optimal surrogate model.
nodes.primary_topic: Learning Theory & Optimization › High-dimensional & Random Matrix Theory
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Generalization & Statistical Learning
nodes.niche_reason: Theory-heavy weak-to-strong analysis, established but specialised

nodes.title: Towards Understanding Why FixMatch Generalizes Better Than Supervised Learning
nodes.tldr: Theory explaining why FixMatch-style semi-supervised learning generalizes better than supervised learning on CNNs, plus an improved variant, SA-FixMatch.
nodes.problem: No theory explains why FixMatch-like semi-supervised methods generalize better than supervised learning on DNNs.
nodes.approach: Feature-learning analysis showing FixMatch learns all discriminative features while supervised learning captures only a subset.
nodes.primary_topic: Learning Theory & Optimization › Generalization & Statistical Learning
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Deep Learning Theory
nodes.niche_reason: Semi-supervised generalization theory is a fairly active theory area

nodes.title: CREIMBO: Cross-Regional Ensemble Interactions in Multi-view Brain Observations
nodes.tldr: CREIMBO learns non-stationary interactions among neural ensembles from non-simultaneous multi-view brain recordings using shared sub-circuit dictionaries.
nodes.problem: Asynchronous neural recordings lack shared neuron identity, so brain-wide dynamics are hard to model.
nodes.approach: Graph-driven dictionary learning of ensembles plus sparse time-varying sub-circuit composition.
secondary_topics: Architectures & Training › Time Series & Sequential Data
nodes.confidence_reason: Neuroscience application with a general dynamical-model contribution; multiple fits
nodes.niche_reason: Few papers model non-simultaneous multi-session neural recordings this way.

nodes.title: DeFT: Decoding with Flash Tree-attention for Efficient Tree-structured LLM Inference
nodes.tldr: DeFT is a hardware-efficient tree attention algorithm with prefix-aware, load-balanced KV cache partitioning, cutting KV cache IO 73-99% and giving up to 3.59x attention speedup.
nodes.problem: Tree-structured LLM inference reloads shared-prefix KV cache repeatedly and balances GPU load poorly.
nodes.approach: KV-guided grouping and flattened tree KV splitting in a flash-style tree-attention kernel.
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › Efficient LLM Inference & Architectures
nodes.niche_reason: Inference systems work, specialised to tree-structured decoding.

nodes.title: On the Identification of Temporal Causal Representation with Instantaneous Dependence
nodes.tldr: Proves identifiability of latent causal processes with instantaneous dependence in time series under a sparse influence constraint, with a variational method tested on motion forecasting.
nodes.problem: Identifying latent temporal causal processes with instantaneous relations without interventions or groupings.
nodes.approach: Sparse time-delayed and instantaneous influence constraint with identifiability theory, temporal variational inference, and gradient-based sparsity regularization.
nodes.primary_topic: Learning Theory & Optimization › Causality & Causal Inference
secondary_topics: Architectures & Training › Time Series & Sequential Data
nodes.niche_reason: Temporal causal representation identifiability is a rare theoretical niche.

nodes.title: DeepRTL: Bridging Verilog Understanding and Generation with a Unified Representation Model
nodes.tldr: DeepRTL is a CodeT5+ model fine-tuned on Verilog aligned with multi-level descriptions, plus a Verilog understanding benchmark; beats GPT-4 on understanding, matches o1-preview on generation.
nodes.problem: LLMs for hardware design neglect Verilog understanding and align poorly natural language with Verilog.
nodes.approach: Fine-tune CodeT5+ with curriculum learning on a Verilog dataset with multi-level natural language descriptions.
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › Code Generation & Software
nodes.niche_reason: Hardware description language modeling is a rare code-generation niche.

nodes.title: Discovering Temporally Compositional Neural Manifolds with Switching Infinite GPFA
nodes.tldr: Infinite GPFA infers an unbounded set of neural latent factors, switching on per time point via an Indian Buffet Process prior.
nodes.problem: Standard GPFA needs the number of latent factors pre-specified and keeps all factors active always.
nodes.approach: Fully Bayesian GPFA extension with an IBP prior over factor loadings, fit by variational EM.
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Probabilistic & Bayesian Methods
nodes.niche_reason: Nonparametric latent factor models for neural data are rare in ML.

nodes.title: Towards hyperparameter-free optimization with differential privacy
nodes.tldr: Adapts automatic learning rate schedules to differentially private optimization, removing most learning-rate tuning cost while matching state-of-the-art DP performance.
nodes.problem: Grid-searching learning rates under differential privacy is costly and leaks training data.
nodes.approach: Automatic learning-rate schedule combined with automatic per-sample gradient clipping.
nodes.niche_reason: DP-SGD tuning is a specialised but established line of work.

nodes.title: The Superposition of Diffusion Models Using the Itô Density Estimator
nodes.tldr: SuperDiff combines multiple pretrained diffusion models at generation time via a superposition framework, using a new Itô density estimator for the diffusion SDE log likelihood.
nodes.problem: Combining pretrained diffusion models at generation without retraining a larger combined model.
nodes.approach: Derive superposition from the continuity equation and a scalable Itô log-density estimator with two combining algorithms.
nodes.niche_reason: Principled model-composition for diffusion is specialised.

nodes.title: uniINF: Best-of-Both-Worlds Algorithm for Parameter-Free Heavy-Tailed MABs
nodes.tldr: Gives a parameter-free multi-armed bandit algorithm with near-optimal regret in both stochastic and adversarial heavy-tailed settings, without knowing the environment type.
nodes.problem: Heavy-tailed bandits need known tail parameters and separate algorithms for stochastic versus adversarial losses
nodes.approach: Log-barrier-based learning rate with auto-balancing, adaptive skipping-clipping loss tuning, and stopping-time analysis
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Online Learning & Regret
nodes.niche_reason: Parameter-free heavy-tailed bandits are a rare niche

nodes.title: Learning Spatiotemporal Dynamical Systems from Point Process Observations
nodes.tldr: Learns spatiotemporal dynamical systems from randomly sampled point-process observations by combining neural ODEs, neural point processes, implicit neural representations, and amortized variational inference.
nodes.problem: Modeling spatiotemporal dynamics from observations collected randomly in space and time, as in sensor networks.
nodes.approach: Joint model of latent dynamics and observation locations using neural differential equations, point processes, and amortized inference.
secondary_topics: Architectures & Training › Time Series & Sequential Data
nodes.confidence_reason: Straddles dynamics modeling, neural operators, and point-process sequence models.
nodes.niche_reason: Point-process observations for dynamical systems is an uncommon setup.

nodes.title: OptionZero: Planning with Learned Options
nodes.tldr: Adds an option network to MuZero so it discovers options through self-play and plans deeper with learned option transitions, outperforming MuZero on 26 Atari games.
nodes.problem: Planning with options usually relies on predefined options or expert demonstrations.
nodes.approach: Option network inside MuZero with a modified dynamics model for option transitions under fixed simulation budgets.
secondary_topics: Reinforcement Learning › Model-Based RL & World Models
nodes.niche_reason: Option discovery inside MuZero planning is specialised but established.

nodes.title: RelitLRM: Generative Relightable Radiance for Large Reconstruction Models
nodes.tldr: RelitLRM is a feed-forward large reconstruction model producing relightable Gaussian splatting objects from 4-8 sparse images, combining a geometry reconstructor with a diffusion-based appearance generator.
nodes.problem: Inverse rendering needs dense captures and slow optimization, causing baked shadows and wrong highlights.
nodes.approach: Transformer geometry reconstructor plus diffusion relightable appearance generator trained end-to-end on synthetic renderings.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: Relightable feed-forward reconstruction is specialised within 3D vision.

nodes.title: Multi-Field Adaptive Retrieval
nodes.tldr: Indexes each document field separately with dense and lexical methods, then learns query-conditioned field weights for ranking semi-structured documents.
nodes.problem: Standard retrievers ignore the internal field structure of semi-structured documents.
nodes.approach: Per-field dense and lexical indices with a learned query-adaptive field importance predictor.
nodes.niche_reason: Retrieval over structured fields is a common IR research direction

nodes.title: LeFusion: Controllable Pathology Synthesis via Lesion-Focused Diffusion Models
nodes.tldr: Lesion-focused diffusion model that synthesizes lesion image-segmentation pairs from lesion-free scans, with controllable texture, size and location.
nodes.problem: Medical datasets are scarce and long-tailed; prior synthesis mixes lesions with backgrounds and gives weak control.
nodes.approach: Diffusion inpainting with lesion-focused objectives, histogram texture control, multi-channel decomposition and lesion mask diffusion.
nodes.niche_reason: Lesion-level diffusion synthesis for medical segmentation is a specialised application

nodes.title: Broaden your SCOPE! Efficient Multi-turn Conversation Planning for LLMs with Semantic Space
nodes.tldr: Plans multi-turn LLM conversations inside a dense semantic space, selecting responses 70x faster than simulation-based planning without extra LLM queries.
nodes.problem: Simulation-based conversation planning needs many LLM queries per turn, too slow for real-time chat.
nodes.approach: Learn transition and reward models over conversation embeddings and plan entirely in semantic space.
nodes.primary_topic: Reinforcement Learning › Model-Based RL & World Models
secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › Efficient LLM Inference & Architectures
nodes.confidence_reason: Planning-in-semantic-space fits RL or LLM inference; judgment call.
nodes.niche_reason: Semantic-space conversation planning is a specialised niche

nodes.title: What Does It Mean to Be a Transformer? Insights from a Theoretical Hessian Analysis
nodes.tldr: Derives the Hessian of a self-attention layer and shows how data, weight and attention dependencies explain Transformer-specific optimization choices.
nodes.problem: The reasons behind attention's distinctive optimization needs, such as adaptive optimizers and warmup, are poorly understood.
nodes.approach: Analytic Hessian derivation in matrix derivatives, compared structurally against MLP and CNN Hessians.
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Deep Learning Theory
nodes.niche_reason: Hessian-level analysis contrasting Transformers with MLPs and CNNs is specialised

nodes.title: DiffPuter: Empowering Diffusion Models for Missing Data Imputation
nodes.tldr: Introduces DiffPuter, which combines a diffusion model with EM to impute missing data, alternating joint-distribution training with conditional sampling of missing values.
nodes.problem: Diffusion models struggle to train on incomplete data and to sample conditionally for imputation.
nodes.approach: EM loop: maximum-likelihood diffusion training as M-step, tailored reversed sampling as E-step.
nodes.niche_reason: Diffusion-EM imputation is a specialised application of generative models

nodes.title: Compositional Entailment Learning for Hyperbolic Vision-Language Models
nodes.tldr: Hyperbolic vision-language model that learns compositional entailment between whole images and their object boxes with text descriptions, exploiting hierarchical structure beyond image-text pairs.
nodes.problem: Existing hyperbolic CLIP-style models ignore compositional hierarchy between images and object-level concepts.
nodes.approach: Entailment losses between box-level image-text and whole image-text in hyperbolic space, with boxes from noun extraction and detectors.
nodes.niche_reason: Hyperbolic vision-language embeddings are an unusual geometric angle.

nodes.title: On Quantizing Neural Representation for Variable-Rate Video Coding
nodes.tldr: NeuroQuant treats variable-rate implicit neural representation video coding as mixed-precision post-training quantization, adjusting quantization parameters for rate control without retraining per bitrate.
nodes.problem: Variable-rate INR video coding needs costly weight retraining per target bitrate.
nodes.approach: Post-training quantization with sensitivity criteria, network-wise calibration, and channel-wise quantization.
secondary_topics: Architectures & Training › Efficient Training, Compression & Pruning
nodes.niche_reason: Neural video coding via INR quantization is specialised.

nodes.title: Planning in Natural Language Improves LLM Search for Code Generation
nodes.tldr: PlanSearch searches over diverse natural-language plans before writing code, boosting pass@k on LiveCodeBench compared with repeated sampling.
nodes.problem: Repeated LLM sampling yields similar wrong code, so inference-time search is inefficient.
nodes.approach: Generate diverse observations about the problem, build plans from them, and search over plans.
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › Code Generation & Software
nodes.niche_reason: Inference-time search for code is a crowded direction.

nodes.title: Learning from negative feedback, or positive feedback or both
nodes.tldr: Decouples learning from positive and negative feedback via an EM-based objective, enabling stable preference optimization even with only unpaired negative feedback.
nodes.problem: Preference methods need paired feedback, limiting use when only positive or only negative examples exist.
nodes.approach: Extends expectation-maximization policy optimization to explicitly include negative examples.
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › Alignment & Preference Optimization
secondary_topics: Reinforcement Learning › Reward Learning, Inverse RL & Preferences
nodes.niche_reason: Learning from negative-only feedback is a less-explored alignment angle

nodes.title: Scaling LLM Test-Time Compute Optimally Can be More Effective than Scaling Parameters for Reasoning
nodes.tldr: Analyzes test-time compute scaling for LLM reasoning and shows compute-optimal, difficulty-adaptive allocation can beat best-of-N by 4x and outperform much larger models.
nodes.problem: How best to spend fixed inference-time compute versus scaling parameters for LLM reasoning.
nodes.approach: Study PRM-guided search and adaptive revision, then allocate test-time compute per prompt by difficulty.
secondary_topics: Reinforcement Learning › RL for LLMs & Reasoning
nodes.niche_reason: Test-time scaling for reasoning is extremely crowded.

nodes.title: ND-SDF: Learning Normal Deflection Fields for High-Fidelity Indoor Reconstruction
nodes.tldr: Learns a normal deflection field that adaptively weights geometric priors per sample, improving neural SDF surface reconstruction of indoor scenes, including thin structures.
nodes.problem: Geometric priors applied uniformly in neural implicit reconstruction bias accuracy and blur fine geometric detail.
nodes.approach: Normal deflection field plus deflection-angle-based ray sampling for unbiased volume rendering.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: Neural SDF reconstruction is a well-trodden area.

nodes.title: Beyond Squared Error: Exploring Loss Design for Enhanced Training of Generative Flow Networks
nodes.tldr: Shows GFlowNet regression-loss choice corresponds to divergences, and proposes Shifted-Cosh and Linex losses improving exploration and sample diversity.
nodes.problem: GFlowNet training defaults to squared log-space error, and its exploration effects have been overlooked.
nodes.approach: Maps regression losses to f-divergences and designs losses with zero-forcing or zero-avoiding behavior.
nodes.primary_topic: Learning Theory & Optimization › Optimal Transport & Divergences
nodes.confidence_reason: Loss-divergence theory straddles GFlowNet generative sampling and learning theory.
nodes.niche_reason: GFlowNet loss-divergence analysis is an unusual angle.

nodes.title: Flat Reward in Policy Parameter Space Implies Robust Reinforcement Learning
nodes.tldr: Shows theoretically and empirically that flatter reward landscapes in policy parameter space imply robustness of RL policies to action, transition, and reward perturbations.
nodes.problem: Connection between flat reward surfaces in policy parameter space and RL robustness is unexplored.
nodes.approach: Formal link from parameter-flatness to action-perturbation robustness to transition and reward robustness, validated in simulation.
nodes.primary_topic: Reinforcement Learning › Online & Deep RL Algorithms
secondary_topics: Reinforcement Learning › Transfer, Meta & Continual RL
nodes.niche_reason: Flatness for RL robustness is established but specialised.

nodes.title: Accelerating Goal-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning Algorithms and Research
nodes.tldr: Releases JaxGCRL, a GPU-accelerated codebase and benchmark for self-supervised goal-conditioned RL, cutting training time up to 22x.
nodes.problem: Self-supervised goal-conditioned RL is slow to simulate and unstable to train.
nodes.approach: GPU-accelerated replay buffers, environments, and a stable contrastive RL algorithm.
nodes.primary_topic: Reinforcement Learning › Online & Deep RL Algorithms
nodes.niche_reason: Goal-conditioned RL is established; GPU-accelerated codebase is less common.

nodes.title: Walk the Talk? Measuring the Faithfulness of Large Language Model Explanations
nodes.tldr: Defines and measures LLM explanation faithfulness via concept-level counterfactuals from an auxiliary LLM and a hierarchical Bayesian model of causal effects, uncovering hidden social bias.
nodes.problem: LLM explanations can misrepresent which input concepts truly influenced answers, with no rigorous faithfulness measure.
nodes.approach: Concept-based counterfactual generation by auxiliary LLM and hierarchical Bayesian estimation of concept causal effects.
secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › LLM Evaluation & Benchmarks
nodes.niche_reason: Faithfulness measurement via counterfactual concepts is specialised.

nodes.title: Exploring The Loss Landscape Of Regularized Neural Networks Via Convex Duality
nodes.tldr: Recasts regularized two-layer networks as an equivalent convex problem via duality to characterize stationary points, optimal solution sets, and their connectivity.
nodes.problem: Understanding the loss landscape of regularized neural networks: stationary points and optimal solution structure.
nodes.approach: Convex reformulation and dual analysis of two-layer and vector-valued networks.
nodes.primary_topic: Learning Theory & Optimization › Deep Learning Theory
nodes.niche_reason: Convex duality analysis of loss landscapes is unusual.

nodes.title: A Probabilistic Perspective on Unlearning and Alignment for Large Language Models
nodes.tldr: Proposes probabilistic evaluation of LLM output distributions with high-probability guarantees, showing greedy evaluations falsely indicate unlearning and alignment success.
nodes.problem: Deterministic greedy evaluations miss the full output distribution of LLMs.
nodes.approach: High-probability metrics on output distributions, plus entropy-based unlearning loss and adaptive temperature scaling.
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › LLM Evaluation & Benchmarks
secondary_topics: Trustworthy ML › Machine Unlearning & Privacy Attacks
nodes.niche_reason: Probabilistic LLM evaluation is specialised; unlearning is common.

nodes.title: Enhancing Compositional Text-to-Image Generation with Reliable Random Seeds
nodes.tldr: Shows initial noise seeds strongly affect compositional prompt success, mines reliable seeds to build a self-generated training set, and fine-tunes text-to-image models for better numerical and spatial composition.
nodes.problem: Text-to-image diffusion models produce inconsistent results for compositional prompts like counting and spatial relations.
nodes.approach: Analyze seed effects, mine reliable generations without annotation, and fine-tune Stable Diffusion and PixArt-alpha on them.
nodes.niche_reason: Seed-based compositional improvement is a specialised angle on text-to-image.

nodes.title: RegMix: Data Mixture as Regression for Language Model Pre-training
nodes.tldr: RegMix finds good pre-training data mixtures by training many small proxy models and regressing performance to predict the best mixture for large-scale training.
nodes.problem: Determining effective data mixtures for language model pre-training.
nodes.approach: Train hundreds of small models on varied mixtures, fit regression, apply best predicted mixture at scale.
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › Pretraining, Scaling & Data
secondary_topics: Data, Benchmarks & Evaluation › Synthetic Data & Data Curation
nodes.niche_reason: Data mixture optimization is established but specialised.

nodes.title: MAGNet: Motif-Agnostic Generation of Molecules from Scaffolds
nodes.tldr: MAGNet generates molecules by abstracting motifs into scaffolds and assigning atoms and bonds, learning its own motifs and yielding more structurally diverse compounds.
nodes.problem: Motif-based molecule generators cannot represent substructures outside their fixed motif vocabulary.
nodes.approach: Factorise molecules into scaffolds plus atom and bond assignments, with motifs learned freely.
nodes.niche_reason: Molecular graph generation is established; learned-motif scaffolds are specialised.

nodes.title: Prioritized Generative Replay
nodes.tldr: Replaces uniform replay with a parametric memory: conditional diffusion generates relevance-guided synthetic transitions that densify experience and improve sample efficiency.
nodes.problem: Uniform replay is inefficient, while prioritized replay overfits to rare transitions.
nodes.approach: Conditional diffusion model trained on online experience, guided by curiosity or value relevance functions.
nodes.primary_topic: Reinforcement Learning › Online & Deep RL Algorithms
nodes.confidence_reason: Judgment call between RL replay and diffusion generative modeling
nodes.niche_reason: Generative replay is an uncommon angle on RL memory

nodes.title: Energy-based Backdoor Defense Against Federated Graph Learning
nodes.tldr: Defends federated graph learning against backdoors by assigning energy to samples, clustering benign clients, and propagating energy on a global graph to reweight aggregation.
nodes.problem: Backdoor triggers in federated graph learning are diverse, defeating standard federated defenses.
nodes.approach: Topological graph energy with client clustering and global energy-graph aggregation weighting.
nodes.niche_reason: Backdoor defense for federated graph learning is rare

nodes.title: SD-LoRA: Scalable Decoupled Low-Rank Adaptation for Class Incremental Learning
nodes.tldr: SD-LoRA continually decouples LoRA magnitude and direction for rehearsal-free class incremental learning, scaling without growing pools and converging to a shared low-loss region.
nodes.problem: Prompt and LoRA pool methods for continual learning scale poorly or need rehearsal samples.
nodes.approach: Decoupled magnitude and direction LoRA components learned sequentially, with efficient variants.
nodes.niche_reason: Continual learning with LoRA is a fairly common topic.

nodes.title: NeuralPlane: Structured 3D Reconstruction in Planar Primitives with Neural Fields
nodes.tldr: NeuralPlane reconstructs scenes as planar primitives from multi-view images by distilling 2D plane observations into a neural field with a self-supervised coplanarity feature field.
nodes.problem: Compact structured 3D plane reconstruction from multi-view images without plane annotations.
nodes.approach: Plane-guided neural field training plus a self-supervised Neural Coplanarity Field fusing geometry and semantics.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: Specialised structured plane reconstruction within neural fields.

nodes.title: COPER: Correlation-based Permutations for Multi-View Clustering
nodes.tldr: End-to-end deep multi-view clustering that learns fused representations via a permutation-based canonical correlation objective and consistent pseudo-labels.
nodes.problem: Multi-view clustering is domain-specific or uses a suboptimal two-stage representation then clustering pipeline.
nodes.approach: Permutation-based canonical correlation objective with cross-view pseudo-label consistency, trained end to end.
nodes.confidence_reason: Clustering has no direct topic; representation learning chosen
nodes.niche_reason: Multi-view deep clustering is established but not mainstream

nodes.title: BlendRL: A Framework for Merging Symbolic and Neural Policy Learning
nodes.tldr: Blends a neural policy with a symbolic, first-order-logic policy in one RL framework, outperforming both on Atari and under environment changes.
nodes.problem: RL policies are either opaque neural nets or brittle symbolic rule systems.
nodes.approach: Differentiable reasoning over first-order logic combined with neural policy learning.
nodes.primary_topic: Reinforcement Learning › Online & Deep RL Algorithms
nodes.confidence_reason: No neuro-symbolic topic in vocabulary; closest is online deep RL
nodes.niche_reason: Neuro-symbolic RL policies are a rare cross-paradigm direction

nodes.title: Scaling up the Banded Matrix Factorization Mechanism for Large Scale Differentially Private ML
nodes.tldr: Scales the DP-BandMF correlated-noise differential privacy mechanism to over 10^4 iterations and 10^7 parameters through algorithmic and computational improvements.
nodes.problem: DP-BandMF's scalability limits prevent large-scale private training.
nodes.approach: Techniques to scale banded matrix factorization noise computation in iterations and parameters.
nodes.niche_reason: Correlated-noise DP mechanisms are a specialised subarea.

nodes.title: Variational Diffusion Posterior Sampling with Midpoint Guidance
nodes.tldr: Samples diffusion posteriors for inverse problems via a new transition decomposition with midpoint guidance, balancing guidance and prior complexity.
nodes.problem: Posterior sampling with diffusion priors for inverse problems requires an intractable guidance term.
nodes.approach: Decomposes transitions so guidance complexity can be traded against prior transition complexity; applied to ECG reconstruction.
nodes.niche_reason: Diffusion posterior sampling for inverse problems is established but specialised

nodes.title: Safety Alignment Should be Made More Than Just a Few Tokens Deep
nodes.tldr: Argues LLM safety alignment primarily shapes the first few output tokens, explaining many jailbreaks, and proposes deeper alignment and a regularized fine-tuning objective.
nodes.problem: Safety alignment is shallow, shaped mainly by the first few output tokens, enabling jailbreaks.
nodes.approach: Case studies unifying jailbreak vulnerabilities, plus a regularized fine-tuning objective constraining early-token updates.
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › LLM Safety & Jailbreaks
secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › Alignment & Preference Optimization
nodes.niche_reason: Shallow safety alignment is a crowded jailbreak research area

nodes.title: Answer, Assemble, Ace: Understanding How LMs Answer Multiple Choice Questions
nodes.tldr: Uses vocabulary projection and activation patching to show how LMs answer multiple-choice questions: a few middle-layer attention heads causally drive the answer symbol prediction.
nodes.problem: Unclear how successful transformer LMs internally perform formatted multiple-choice question answering.
nodes.approach: Vocabulary projection and activation patching to localize layers and attention heads, plus a synthetic disentangling task.
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › Language Model Interpretability
secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › LLM Evaluation & Benchmarks
nodes.niche_reason: LLM mechanistic interpretability is common.

nodes.title: MAD-TD: Model-Augmented Data stabilizes High Update Ratio RL
nodes.tldr: Augments off-policy TD learning with a small amount of data from a learned world model, stabilizing high update-ratio RL without periodic resets.
nodes.problem: High update-to-data ratio RL is unstable, and resets are impractical in many applications.
nodes.approach: Mix world-model-generated data into off-policy value learning to counter overestimation.
nodes.primary_topic: Reinforcement Learning › Model-Based RL & World Models
secondary_topics: Reinforcement Learning › Online & Deep RL Algorithms
nodes.niche_reason: Model-based data augmentation for off-policy RL is a crowded direction.

nodes.title: MLE-bench: Evaluating Machine Learning Agents on Machine Learning Engineering
nodes.tldr: MLE-bench evaluates AI agents on 75 Kaggle machine-learning engineering competitions against human leaderboard baselines, finding the best agent reaches bronze in 16.9%.
nodes.problem: No standard way to measure whether AI agents can do real machine-learning engineering work.
nodes.approach: Curated Kaggle competitions with human baselines, run through open-source agent scaffolds on frontier LLMs.
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › LLM Evaluation & Benchmarks
secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › Agents & Tool Use
nodes.niche_reason: agent benchmarks are a crowded direction

nodes.title: Gap-Dependent Bounds for Q-Learning using Reference-Advantage Decomposition
nodes.tldr: Proves logarithmic gap-dependent regret bounds for UCB-Advantage and Q-EarlySettled-Advantage in tabular episodic MDPs, plus the first gap-dependent policy switching cost bound.
nodes.problem: Gap-dependent regret bounds for Q-learning with variance estimators and reference-advantage decomposition were open.
nodes.approach: Novel error decomposition framework analyzing regret and policy switching cost.
nodes.niche_reason: RL regret theory is established but specialised.

nodes.title: TabWak: A Watermark for Tabular Diffusion Models
nodes.tldr: TabWak watermarks tabular diffusion synthetic tables by controlling Gaussian latent seeds per row, enabling row-wise detection that survives post-editing attacks.
nodes.problem: No method traced or audited synthetic tables from tabular diffusion models for misuse.
nodes.approach: Self-cloning and shuffling embed the key in seed positions, with valid-bit tail-focused detection.
nodes.niche_reason: Watermarking synthetic tabular data is a rare niche

nodes.title: When Attention Sink Emerges in Language Models: An Empirical View
nodes.tldr: Empirically shows attention sinks emerge in LM pretraining, shaped by optimization, data, loss, and softmax normalization, acting as key biases.
nodes.problem: Attention sinks are widely exploited, yet their origin in autoregressive language models is poorly understood.
nodes.approach: Controlled pretraining studies varying optimization, data, loss, and architecture, plus sigmoid attention replacements.
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › Language Model Interpretability
secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › Pretraining, Scaling & Data
nodes.niche_reason: Attention sinks are a popular analysis topic in LLM interpretability.

nodes.title: Graph Sparsification via Mixture of Graphs
nodes.tldr: Selects per-node sparsifier experts and merges their sparse graphs on the Grassmann manifold, speeding GNN inference with little accuracy loss.
nodes.problem: Global sparsity settings and uniform pruning ignore each node's local graph context
nodes.approach: Mixture-of-experts over graph sparsifiers, merged per node on the Grassmann manifold
secondary_topics: Architectures & Training › Mixture of Experts & Sparsity
nodes.niche_reason: Node-adaptive GNN sparsification is specialised

nodes.title: Geometry-aware RL for Manipulation of Varying Shapes and Deformable Objects
nodes.tldr: Heterogeneous equivariant graph policy (HEPi) for RL manipulation of varying-shape rigid and deformable objects, with SE(3)-equivariant message passing.
nodes.problem: RL manipulation of varying shapes and deformable objects has a very large search space.
nodes.approach: Heterogeneous graph of actuators and objects with an SE(3)-equivariant message-passing policy.
secondary_topics: Reinforcement Learning › Online & Deep RL Algorithms
nodes.niche_reason: Equivariant graph RL for deformable manipulation is specialised.

nodes.title: What Makes a Good Diffusion Planner for Decision Making?
nodes.tldr: Large-scale empirical study of diffusion planning in offline RL finding that unconditional sampling with selection and Transformer denoisers can beat common practice, yielding a strong baseline.
nodes.problem: Unclear which design choices make a good diffusion planner; inconsistent practices across studies.
nodes.approach: Train over 6,000 diffusion models, ablating guidance, architecture, action generation and planning strategy.
nodes.niche_reason: Diffusion for offline RL is a common, active topic.

nodes.title: Simplifying Deep Temporal Difference Learning
nodes.tldr: PQN is a simplified deep online Q-learning algorithm that drops target networks and replay buffers, using LayerNorm and vectorised environments for stable off-policy training.
nodes.problem: Off-policy TD learning needs target networks and large replay buffers for stability, adding cost.
nodes.approach: Parallel vectorised online sampling with LayerNorm regularisation, no replay buffer or target network.
nodes.primary_topic: Reinforcement Learning › Online & Deep RL Algorithms
nodes.niche_reason: Replay-free deep Q-learning variants are a common direction.

nodes.title: Theory on Mixture-of-Experts in Continual Learning
nodes.tldr: First theoretical analysis of mixture-of-experts in continual learning via overparameterized linear regression, characterizing expert specialization, router behavior, forgetting, and generalization error.
nodes.problem: No theory explains how MoE mitigates catastrophic forgetting in continual learning.
nodes.approach: Analyze MoE with gating on overparameterized linear regression tasks; derive forgetting and generalization expressions.
secondary_topics: Architectures & Training › Mixture of Experts & Sparsity
nodes.niche_reason: Theoretical treatment of MoE in continual learning is rare.

nodes.title: LiFT: Learning to Fine-Tune via Bayesian Parameter Efficient Meta Fine-Tuning
nodes.tldr: Learns a hierarchical Bayesian prior over LoRA modules via SGLD-Gibbs sampling so new tasks can be fine-tuned with shared meta-knowledge.
nodes.problem: Independent per-task LoRA fine-tuning ignores knowledge shared across related tasks.
nodes.approach: Hierarchical Bayesian LoRA prior, SGLD-Gibbs posterior sampling, and online EM Gaussian mixtures.
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Probabilistic & Bayesian Methods
nodes.confidence_reason: Blends meta-learning, PEFT and Bayesian methods; primary topic is a judgment call.
nodes.niche_reason: Meta-LoRA with Bayesian priors sits in an active, crowded PEFT space.

nodes.title: Better Instruction-Following Through Minimum Bayes Risk

nodes.confidence_reason: Judgment between biology application and Bayesian optimization method.
nodes.niche_reason: Unusual: immune clonal-family training for generative Bayesian optimization.

nodes.title: Cut Your Losses in Large-Vocabulary Language Models
nodes.tldr: Computes cross-entropy loss without materializing the full logit matrix, using a fused kernel that cuts LLM training memory dramatically without slowing convergence.
nodes.problem: Cross-entropy over huge vocabularies dominates LLM training memory footprint.
nodes.approach: Compute the correct-token logit and log-sum-exp on the fly in a custom kernel, skipping negligible gradients.
secondary_topics: Architectures & Training › Efficient Training, Compression & Pruning
nodes.niche_reason: Memory-efficient loss kernels are a known efficiency direction

nodes.title: AgentTrek: Agent Trajectory Synthesis via Guiding Replay with Web Tutorials
nodes.tldr: Synthesises GUI agent trajectories by replaying web tutorials with a VLM agent and filtering them with a VLM evaluator, cheaper than human annotation.
nodes.problem: GUI agents lack large, high-quality multi-step trajectory data, and human annotation does not scale.
nodes.approach: Converts tutorial texts into task goals with step-by-step instructions, then simulates them in a real environment.
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › Agents & Tool Use
secondary_topics: Data, Benchmarks & Evaluation › Synthetic Data & Data Curation
nodes.niche_reason: GUI agent data synthesis is an active, crowded area.

nodes.title: SymmetricDiffusers: Learning Discrete Diffusion on Finite Symmetric Groups
nodes.tldr: A discrete diffusion model over permutations using riffle shuffles as forward process and a generalized Plackett-Luce reverse distribution, solving sorting, jigsaw and TSP.
nodes.problem: Learning distributions over the symmetric group is hard due to its huge discrete size.
nodes.approach: Decompose into simple reverse transitions, with riffle-shuffle forward noise, generalized Plackett-Luce distribution, and denoising schedule.
nodes.niche_reason: Diffusion over permutation groups with random-walk theory is very rare.

nodes.title: Improved Approximation Algorithms for $k$-Submodular Maximization via Multilinear Extension
nodes.tldr: Gives improved approximation algorithms for k-submodular maximization via a multilinear extension and Frank-Wolfe frameworks under knapsack and matroid constraints.
nodes.problem: Approximating k-submodular maximization under knapsack and matroid constraints.
nodes.approach: Multilinear extension of k-submodular functions with unified Frank-Wolfe-type continuous algorithms.
nodes.confidence_reason: Topic is a judgment call between close topics.
nodes.niche_reason: Combinatorial approximation algorithms are very rare at ML venues.

nodes.title: How much of my dataset did you use? Quantitative Data Usage Inference in Machine Learning
nodes.tldr: Introduces dataset usage cardinality inference, estimating the exact fraction of a dataset used in training from debiased membership guesses, matching MLE at far lower cost.
nodes.problem: Binary dataset-usage inference fails to quantify how much of an owner's data was used in training.
nodes.approach: Aggregate debiased membership inference guesses to estimate the proportion of data used.
nodes.primary_topic: Trustworthy ML › Machine Unlearning & Privacy Attacks
secondary_topics: Data, Benchmarks & Evaluation › Data Attribution & Influence
nodes.niche_reason: Quantitative dataset-usage estimation is a rare framing of membership inference.

nodes.title: Lumina-T2X: Scalable Flow-based Large Diffusion Transformer for Flexible Resolution Generation
nodes.tldr: Lumina-T2X is a family of flow-matching diffusion transformers with zero-initialized attention and placeholder tokens, generating images, video, 3D views and audio at flexible resolutions.
nodes.problem: Scalable open recipes for diffusion transformers generating arbitrary resolutions, aspect ratios and durations across modalities are lacking.
nodes.approach: Flag-DiT with zero-init attention, RoPE, KQ-norm, flow matching, and nextline/nextframe tokens unifying spatial-temporal modalities.
nodes.niche_reason: Diffusion transformer text-to-image/video is a very crowded direction.

nodes.title: MIND over Body: Adaptive Thinking using Dynamic Computation
nodes.tldr: Introduces self-introspection so networks adjust parameter use and computation time to input complexity, reusing parameters across tasks.
nodes.problem: Networks spend the same computation on inputs regardless of complexity, wasting parameters.
nodes.approach: Self-introspection that adjusts how many parameters and how much compute each input uses, reusing parameters across tasks.
nodes.primary_topic: Architectures & Training › Mixture of Experts & Sparsity
nodes.confidence_reason: Dynamic computation fits sparsity or architecture topics.
nodes.niche_reason: Adaptive computation is established; self-introspective parameter reuse is specialised.

nodes.title: Poison-splat: Computation Cost Attack on 3D Gaussian Splatting
nodes.tldr: Poison-splat poisons input images to drastically inflate 3D Gaussian Splatting training memory and time, even causing denial-of-service, via bi-level optimization.
nodes.problem: Security vulnerability of 3DGS training cost to poisoned input data is overlooked.
nodes.approach: Bi-level optimization attack with objective approximation, proxy model rendering and optional constrained optimization.
secondary_topics: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: Computation-cost poisoning of 3DGS is rare.

nodes.title: Retrieval Head Mechanistically Explains Long-Context Factuality
nodes.tldr: Identifies sparse, universal retrieval attention heads responsible for long-context information retrieval, showing pruning them causes hallucination and hurts chain-of-thought reasoning.
nodes.problem: Which internal components let LLMs retrieve information from arbitrary positions in long contexts.
nodes.approach: Systematic head-level analysis and pruning experiments across models to characterize retrieval heads.
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › Language Model Interpretability
secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › Long Context & Memory
nodes.niche_reason: Popular LLM interpretability and long-context theme.

nodes.title: Topological Blindspots: Understanding and Extending Topological Deep Learning Through the Lens of Expressivity
nodes.tldr: Shows higher-order message passing cannot capture key topological invariants, and proposes scalable multi-cellular networks that mitigate many of these expressivity limits.
nodes.problem: Higher-order message passing may be too limited to capture topological invariants of complexes.
nodes.approach: Expressivity analysis of higher-order message passing, plus multi-cellular networks inspired by expressive GNNs.
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Deep Learning Theory
nodes.confidence_reason: Expressivity theory and new architectures straddle two topics
nodes.niche_reason: Topological deep learning is a rare, cross-disciplinary niche

nodes.title: Turning Up the Heat: Min-p Sampling for Creative and Coherent LLM Outputs
nodes.tldr: Proposes min-p sampling, which scales the truncation threshold by the top token's probability, keeping LLM text both coherent and diverse at high temperature.
nodes.problem: Top-p sampling balances quality and diversity poorly, producing incoherent outputs at higher temperatures.
nodes.approach: Dynamic truncation whose threshold adapts to model confidence, evaluated on GPQA, GSM8K and creative writing.
nodes.niche_reason: Truncation samplers for LLMs are a crowded decoding topic

nodes.title: Determine-Then-Ensemble: Necessity of Top-k Union for Large Language Model Ensembling
nodes.tldr: Studies what makes LLM ensembles work and proposes UniTE, which ensembles by only combining the union of each model's top-k tokens, avoiding full vocabulary alignment.
nodes.problem: Existing LLM ensembling ignores model compatibility and aligns probabilities across whole vocabularies inefficiently.
nodes.approach: Compatibility-based model selection plus union top-k token ensembling at decoding time.
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › Efficient LLM Inference & Architectures
nodes.confidence_reason: Could equally be filed under inference-time methods or model merging.
nodes.niche_reason: Decoding-time ensembling of heterogeneous LLMs is moderately specialised.

nodes.title: Proxy Denoising for Source-Free Domain Adaptation
nodes.tldr: Adapts a source model to unlabelled target data by denoising noisy vision-language pseudo-labels and distilling the corrected proxy.
nodes.problem: Vision-language pseudo-supervision for source-free adaptation is noisy, which can harm adaptation.
nodes.approach: Proxy denoising mechanism backed by confidence theory, plus a mutual knowledge distillation regulariser.
nodes.primary_topic: Architectures & Training › Domain Adaptation & OOD Generalization
nodes.niche_reason: Source-free adaptation with VLM pseudo-labels is a common direction.

nodes.title: Differentiable Integer Linear Programming
nodes.tldr: DiffILO reformulates integer linear programs as differentiable unconstrained probabilistic problems, enabling unsupervised learning to solve ILPs with faster training and higher feasibility than supervised methods.
nodes.problem: Supervised ML for ILPs needs expensive solver labels and yields infeasible solutions.
nodes.approach: Probabilistic continuous relaxation trained by gradient descent without solver supervision.
secondary_topics: Architectures & Training › Differentiable Optimization & Structured Layers
nodes.niche_reason: Learning-based combinatorial optimization is established but specialised.

nodes.title: Inference Scaling for Long-Context Retrieval Augmented Generation
nodes.tldr: Studies how scaling inference compute for long-context RAG, via more documents, in-context examples and iterative prompting, improves performance, and models the allocation.
nodes.problem: How to effectively scale test-time compute for retrieval-augmented generation beyond just adding more context.
nodes.approach: Empirical study of demonstration-based and iterative RAG strategies and a model to predict optimal compute allocation.
secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › Long Context & Memory
nodes.niche_reason: RAG and test-time scaling are common themes.

nodes.title: Population Transformer: Learning Population-level Representations of Neural Activity
nodes.tldr: Population Transformer is a self-supervised model aggregating spatially sparse neural channels on top of pretrained temporal embeddings, improving intracranial decoding and enabling neuroscience interpretation.
nodes.problem: Neural recordings have sparse, variable electrode layouts across subjects, hindering scalable population-level modeling.
nodes.approach: Self-supervised transformer stacked on pretrained temporal embeddings that learns aggregation over multi-channel recordings.
nodes.niche_reason: Foundation-style modeling of intracranial neural data is a niche domain.

nodes.title: Learning Equivariant Non-Local Electron Density Functionals
nodes.tldr: EG-XC is a learned non-local exchange-correlation functional using an equivariant GNN on a nuclei-centred density point cloud, trained only on energies.
nodes.problem: Density functional theory's non-local XC approximations are inaccurate, unscalable, or need costly reference data.
nodes.approach: Compress electron density into SO(3)-equivariant point clouds and differentiate through a self-consistent field solver.
nodes.niche_reason: learned non-local DFT functionals are a rare niche

nodes.title: In Search of Forgotten Domain Generalization
nodes.tldr: Builds LAION-based datasets that are strictly out-of-domain in style, showing much of CLIP's apparent OOD generalization comes from in-domain examples.
nodes.problem: Web-scale training data contaminates OOD test sets, hiding true out-of-domain robustness of CLIP models.
nodes.approach: Subsample LAION into natural and rendition sets, then tune their mixing ratios for generalization.
nodes.primary_topic: Architectures & Training › Domain Adaptation & OOD Generalization
nodes.niche_reason: OOD robustness of CLIP is a crowded evaluation topic

nodes.title: More RLHF, More Trust? On The Impact of Preference Alignment On Trustworthiness
nodes.tldr: Evaluates how RLHF on general preference data affects LLM trustworthiness across toxicity, bias, ethics, truthfulness and privacy, finding no guarantee, and applies influence-function data attribution.
nodes.problem: Whether RLHF with general human preference data improves or harms trustworthiness of LLMs.
nodes.approach: Benchmark aligned models on five trustworthiness verticals and adapt influence-function attribution to RLHF.
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › Alignment & Preference Optimization
secondary_topics: Data, Benchmarks & Evaluation › Data Attribution & Influence
Trustworthy ML › AI Safety & Alignment Research
nodes.niche_reason: RLHF effects analysis is a common topic.

nodes.title: EmbedLLM: Learning Compact Representations of Large Language Models
nodes.tldr: EmbedLLM learns compact vector embeddings of LLMs via an encoder-decoder, enabling model routing and benchmark performance forecasting without extra inference.
nodes.problem: Task-specific representations of many LLMs are repeatedly relearned, wasting compute in model selection.
nodes.approach: Encoder-decoder trained on model response correctness to learn reusable model embeddings.
secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › LLM Evaluation & Benchmarks
nodes.confidence_reason: Straddles representation learning and LLM evaluation/routing.
nodes.niche_reason: Embedding LLMs themselves is an unusual direction.

nodes.title: Realistic Evaluation of Deep Partial-Label Learning Algorithms
nodes.tldr: PLENCH is a benchmark for deep partial-label learning that adds model selection criteria and a human-annotated partial-label CIFAR-10 dataset.
nodes.problem: Deep partial-label learning methods are compared inconsistently, with no principled model selection.
nodes.approach: Standardised benchmark with theoretically grounded model-selection criteria and crowd-annotated partial labels.
nodes.confidence_reason: Venue area hint (representation learning) does not match benchmark focus
nodes.niche_reason: Partial-label learning is a specialised weak-supervision setting

nodes.title: GridMix: Exploring Spatial Modulation for Neural Fields in PDE Modeling
nodes.tldr: Models spatial modulation of neural fields as a mixture of grid-based representations, improving PDE modeling of local details.
nodes.problem: Global modulation of neural fields misses local PDE details, while vanilla grids overfit and lack global context.
nodes.approach: Mixture of grid-based representations for spatial modulation, plus spatial domain augmentation for robustness.
nodes.confidence_reason: PDE field data; modality and neural-field fit unclear.
nodes.niche_reason: neural-field PDE modeling, specialised
