nodes.title: Physics of Language Models: Part 3.3, Knowledge Capacity Scaling Laws
nodes.tldr: Estimates how many bits of factual knowledge language models store, about 2 per parameter, and how training, architecture, quantization, MoE and noise affect it.
nodes.problem: How much factual knowledge a language model of a given size can store, beyond loss-based scaling laws.
nodes.approach: Controlled synthetic knowledge datasets with information-theoretic bit estimation across training duration, architectures, quantization, sparsity and noise.
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › Pretraining, Scaling & Data
secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › Knowledge Editing & Factuality
nodes.niche_reason: Information-theoretic capacity scaling laws are specialised but actively studied.

nodes.title: Grounding Video Models to Actions through Goal Conditioned Exploration
nodes.tldr: Grounds pretrained video models to continuous actions by using generated video states as visual goals for self-exploration, needing no action labels or rewards.
nodes.problem: Video models lack embodiment grounding and inverse dynamics models need costly embodiment-specific data.
nodes.approach: Trajectory-level action generation with video guidance, exploring toward generated visual goals without external supervision.
nodes.niche_reason: Grounding video models via self-exploration is somewhat unusual.

nodes.title: MMQA: Evaluating LLMs with Multi-Table Multi-Hop Complex Questions
nodes.tldr: Introduces MMQA, a multi-table multi-hop question benchmark with a framework covering retrieval, text-to-SQL, and key selection, plus a new retrieval method.
nodes.problem: Existing table QA benchmarks are single-table, failing to reflect multi-table reasoning over foreign and primary keys.
nodes.approach: Multi-hop questions over linked tables, evaluated on retrieval, Text-to-SQL, multi-table QA and key selection.
nodes.niche_reason: Multi-table reasoning benchmarks are specialised

nodes.title: Restructuring Vector Quantization with the Rotation Trick
nodes.tldr: Replaces the straight-through estimator in VQ-VAEs with a rotation-and-rescaling transform that carries angle and magnitude information into gradients, improving reconstruction and codebook use.
nodes.problem: Non-differentiable vector quantization loses information in straight-through gradient estimation.
nodes.approach: Treat a rotation and rescaling mapping encoder output to codebook vector as constant in backpropagation.
nodes.primary_topic: Generative Models › GANs, VAEs & Normalizing Flows
nodes.niche_reason: Gradient estimation for VQ layers is a specialised niche.

nodes.title: Oscillatory State-Space Models
nodes.tldr: LinOSS is a state-space sequence model built from forced harmonic oscillators, with stable discretization and universal approximation, outperforming Mamba and LRU on long sequences.
nodes.problem: Efficiently modeling long-range dependencies while keeping stable long-horizon dynamics.
nodes.approach: Oscillator-based state-space layer with nonnegative diagonal state matrix and parallel associative scans.
nodes.primary_topic: Architectures & Training › State-Space Models & Linear Attention
secondary_topics: Architectures & Training › Time Series & Sequential Data
nodes.niche_reason: State-space sequence models are common; oscillator-based design is less so.

nodes.title: Presto! Distilling Steps and Layers for Accelerating Music Generation
nodes.tldr: Accelerates text-to-music diffusion transformers 10-18x by distilling sampling steps with GAN-based distribution matching and layers with variance-preserving layer distillation.
nodes.problem: High-quality text-to-music diffusion is too slow, needing many sampling steps and costly per-step computation.
nodes.approach: Score-based distribution matching distillation for steps, plus improved hidden-variance-preserving layer distillation.
nodes.primary_topic: Generative Models › Audio, Speech & Music Generation
nodes.niche_reason: Diffusion distillation is crowded; music is a specialised target.

nodes.title: Bi-Factorial Preference Optimization: Balancing Safety-Helpfulness in Language Models
nodes.tldr: Re-parameterizes joint safety-helpfulness RLHF into a single supervised objective with a labeling function, balancing both without human annotation.
nodes.problem: Safety and helpfulness conflict during LLM fine-tuning, and RLHF balancing is costly.
nodes.approach: Supervised objective derived from a joint RLHF objective with global preference labeling.
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › Alignment & Preference Optimization
secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › LLM Safety & Jailbreaks
nodes.niche_reason: Safety-helpfulness preference tuning is a crowded alignment area

nodes.title: Enhancing Pre-trained Representation Classifiability can Boost its Interpretability
nodes.tldr: Shows representation interpretability and classifiability are positively correlated, proposes the Inherent Interpretability Score, and uses interpretability maximization to improve classifiability.
nodes.problem: It is unclear whether pre-trained visual representations can be highly interpretable and classifiable at the same time.
nodes.approach: Inherent Interpretability Score measuring information loss and the ratio of interpretable semantics in representations.
nodes.niche_reason: Interpretability-classifiability coupling in pretrained vision models is specialised.

nodes.title: Atlas Gaussians Diffusion for 3D Generation
nodes.tldr: Atlas Gaussians represent shapes as patches that decode 3D Gaussians via UV sampling, enabling a VAE plus latent diffusion pipeline for high-detail feed-forward 3D generation.
nodes.problem: Finding an efficient high-fidelity 3D representation linking latent space for 3D diffusion generation.
nodes.approach: Patch-based Atlas Gaussians with UV-based sampling, VAE encoding and latent diffusion.
secondary_topics: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: Latent diffusion over Gaussian 3D representations is a crowded area.

nodes.title: Data Shapley in One Training Run
nodes.tldr: Computes Data Shapley values during a single training run by accumulating per-iteration gradient contributions, adding negligible overhead to foundation-model training.
nodes.problem: Data Shapley needs retraining on many subsets, infeasible for large models and specific runs.
nodes.approach: Accumulate Shapley values at each gradient update during training, with scaling techniques for foundation models.
nodes.primary_topic: Data, Benchmarks & Evaluation › Data Attribution & Influence
secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › Pretraining, Scaling & Data
nodes.niche_reason: In-run Shapley attribution is a specialised data-valuation niche

nodes.title: DLEFT-MKC: Dynamic Late Fusion Multiple Kernel Clustering with Robust Tensor Learning via Min-Max Optimization
nodes.tldr: DLEFT-MKC is a late-fusion multiple kernel clustering method with min-max robust tensor learning and dynamic base partitions to capture high-order cross-view correlations.
nodes.problem: Late-fusion multi-kernel clustering uses fixed base partitions, ignores high-order view correlations, and lacks adaptivity to distributions.
nodes.approach: Dynamic decision-layer reconstruction, tensor learning on stacked representations, min-max optimization solved via reduced gradient descent and ADMM.
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Kernels, GPs & Nonparametrics
nodes.niche_reason: Multiple kernel multi-view clustering is a rare, classical niche.

nodes.title: SAM 2: Segment Anything in Images and Videos
nodes.tldr: Promptable segmentation model for images and videos with streaming memory transformer, trained on a large video dataset from a user-interaction data engine.
nodes.problem: Segmenting objects in images and videos from prompts in real time, with fewer user interactions.
nodes.approach: Simple transformer with streaming memory for real-time video, plus a model-in-the-loop data engine.
nodes.niche_reason: Mainstream foundation segmentation model with many follow-ups.

nodes.title: MMIE: Massive Multimodal Interleaved Comprehension Benchmark for Large Vision-Language Models
nodes.tldr: MMIE is a 20K-query benchmark for evaluating interleaved image-text comprehension and generation in vision-language models, with a learned automatic scorer.
nodes.problem: Interleaved image-text evaluation lacks scale, breadth, and reliable automated metrics.
nodes.approach: Curates multiple-choice and open-ended multimodal queries across 12 fields, scored by a human-tuned judge model.
nodes.niche_reason: Large vision-language model benchmarks are a crowded area.

nodes.title: Union-over-Intersections: Object Detection beyond Winner-Takes-All
nodes.tldr: Regresses boxes only to intersection with ground truth and merges all candidate boxes by union, instead of winner-takes-all NMS.
nodes.problem: Box proposals must extrapolate to full ground truth; winner-takes-all NMS discards useful boxes.
nodes.approach: Intersection-only box regression plus union over regressed boxes in each region; plug-and-play across detector families.
nodes.niche_reason: Detection box regression is a crowded mainstream area

nodes.title: STAR: Synthesis of Tailored Architectures
nodes.tldr: Evolves tailored language model architectures using a search space from linear input-varying systems and gradient-free evolutionary optimization of quality and efficiency.
nodes.problem: Architecture search for language models has limited search spaces and yields simple resulting patterns.
nodes.approach: Hierarchical numerical genome encoding, refined and recombined with evolutionary algorithms.
secondary_topics: Architectures & Training › State-Space Models & Linear Attention
nodes.niche_reason: evolutionary architecture search is established; this search space is novel

nodes.title: AlphaEdit: Null-Space Constrained Knowledge Editing for Language Models
nodes.tldr: Knowledge editing method that projects parameter perturbations onto the null space of preserved knowledge, so sequential edits stop disrupting existing facts.
nodes.problem: Locate-then-edit perturbations disrupt preserved knowledge, especially in sequential editing.
nodes.approach: Null-space projection of the edit perturbation, provably preserving outputs on retained knowledge.
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › Knowledge Editing & Factuality
nodes.niche_reason: Model editing is an active area; null-space projection is a modest twist.

nodes.title: SVBench: A Benchmark with Temporal Multi-Turn Dialogues for Streaming Video Understanding
nodes.tldr: SVBench is a benchmark of multi-turn temporal QA chains over 1,353 streaming videos, plus a StreamingChat model that beats open-source LVLMs.
nodes.problem: Existing video benchmarks test isolated single-instance inputs, not temporal reasoning across long streams.
nodes.approach: Semi-automated pipeline generating 49,979 QA pairs organized as consecutive multi-turn dialogues over segments.
nodes.niche_reason: Streaming multi-turn video QA benchmark is an emerging niche.

nodes.title: Sparse Feature Circuits: Discovering and Editing Interpretable Causal Graphs in Language Models
nodes.tldr: Discovers causally implicated subnetworks of sparse, human-interpretable features in language models, and ablates them to improve classifier generalization.
nodes.problem: Circuits built from polysemantic neurons and attention heads are too hard to interpret for practical use.
nodes.approach: Causal attribution over sparse features to find circuits, then ablates task-irrelevant features for generalization.
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › Language Model Interpretability
secondary_topics: Architectures & Training › Domain Adaptation & OOD Generalization
nodes.niche_reason: Sparse-feature circuit discovery is an active but specialised interpretability direction.

nodes.title: Streamlining Redundant Layers to Compress Large Language Models
nodes.tldr: Introduces LLM-Streamline, which prunes consecutive low-importance layers and trains a lightweight replacement network, plus a stability metric for compression evaluation.
nodes.problem: Large language models are costly to deploy; layer pruning degrades performance.
nodes.approach: Importance-based consecutive layer pruning with a trained lightweight layer replacement module.
nodes.primary_topic: Architectures & Training › Efficient Training, Compression & Pruning
secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › Efficient LLM Inference & Architectures
nodes.niche_reason: LLM layer pruning is a crowded compression direction.

nodes.title: Implicit Bias of Mirror Flow for Shallow Neural Networks in Univariate Regression
nodes.tldr: Shows mirror flow in wide shallow networks matches gradient flow's implicit bias at infinite width, while scaled potentials induce biases no RKHS norm captures.
nodes.problem: The implicit bias of mirror descent in overparameterised shallow neural networks is poorly understood.
nodes.approach: Lazy-training analysis of mirror flow with variational characterization for univariate ReLU and absolute-value networks.
nodes.primary_topic: Learning Theory & Optimization › Deep Learning Theory
nodes.niche_reason: Implicit bias of mirror flow in shallow networks is specialised theory.

nodes.title: Differential learning kinetics govern the transition from memorization to generalization during in-context learning
nodes.tldr: Shows memorization and generalization in in-context learning are independent sub-circuits, with the transition set by their relative learning rates, not capacity.
nodes.problem: Why small transformers shift from memorizing to generalizing in-context learning as task diversity grows.
nodes.approach: Theory and experiments on a synthetic ICL task, deriving a memorization scaling law for the diversity threshold.
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › In-context Learning & Prompting
secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › Language Model Interpretability
nodes.niche_reason: mechanistic ICL dynamics are an active but specialised area

nodes.title: CEB: Compositional Evaluation Benchmark for Fairness in Large Language Models
nodes.tldr: Benchmark that unifies existing LLM bias datasets using a compositional taxonomy of bias type, social group, and task, enabling consistent cross-dataset bias comparison.
nodes.problem: LLM bias evaluations use inconsistent datasets and metrics, making results hard to compare.
nodes.approach: Compositional taxonomy over bias type, social group, and task used to curate a unified benchmark.
nodes.niche_reason: LLM bias benchmarks are a common, crowded evaluation area

nodes.title: Tell me about yourself: LLMs are aware of their learned behaviors
nodes.tldr: Finetuned LLMs can articulate behaviors they learned implicitly, such as risk-seeking decisions or backdoors, showing behavioral self-awareness through out-of-context reasoning.
nodes.problem: Whether LLMs can describe their own learned behavioral policies without in-context examples.
nodes.approach: Finetune on behavior-exhibiting examples without descriptions, then evaluate self-description via multiple-choice and free-form questions.
nodes.primary_topic: Trustworthy ML › AI Safety & Alignment Research
secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › Language Model Interpretability
nodes.niche_reason: Self-awareness and introspection in LLMs is an unusual direction.

nodes.title: Revisiting text-to-image evaluation with Gecko: on metrics, prompts, and human rating
nodes.tldr: Gecko introduces a large human-annotated T2I evaluation suite, a curated prompt set, a statistically grounded comparison method, and an interpretable auto-eval metric.
nodes.problem: T2I models and alignment metrics are judged on single data slices, giving unstable conclusions.
nodes.approach: Over 100K annotations across four templates, curated prompts, and an interpretable auto-eval metric.
secondary_topics: Generative Models › Generative Model Evaluation & Theory
nodes.niche_reason: Text-to-image evaluation is a crowded area.

nodes.title: Sparse components distinguish visual pathways & their alignment to neural networks
nodes.tldr: Sparse decomposition reveals distinct tunings across ventral, dorsal and lateral visual streams; a new alignment measure shows DNNs align most with ventral.
nodes.problem: Single-task DNNs match the whole visual system well despite functionally distinct visual pathways.
nodes.approach: Sparse decomposition of fMRI responses per stream plus Sparse Component Alignment metric between brains and networks.
nodes.niche_reason: Brain-DNN alignment with sparse components is rare.

nodes.title: Multi-session, multi-task neural decoding from distinct cell-types and brain regions
nodes.tldr: A multi-task transformer trained on Allen Brain Observatory two-photon data shows transfer of brain decoding across tasks, cell types and regions, with emergent region-specific latents.
nodes.problem: Whether neural decoding models can pretrain and transfer across tasks, cell types and brain regions
nodes.approach: Multi-task transformer with tokenized neural population activity trained on 100,000+ neurons
nodes.niche_reason: Large-scale neural decoding foundation models are uncommon

nodes.title: Enhancing Learning with Label Differential Privacy by Vector Approximation
nodes.tldr: Label local differential privacy method turning each label into a random K-component vector instead of flipping it, so accuracy degrades little with more classes.
nodes.problem: Label-DP randomization degrades performance badly as the number of classes grows.
nodes.approach: Replace randomized-response scalar labels with random vectors whose expectations equal class-conditional probabilities.
nodes.niche_reason: Label-DP is an established but specialised privacy subarea.

nodes.title: Measuring and Enhancing Trustworthiness of LLMs in RAG through Grounded Attributions and Learning to Refuse
nodes.tldr: Introduces Trust-Score to measure LLM trustworthiness in RAG, and Trust-Align, an alignment method that improves grounded answers, citations, and refusals.
nodes.problem: Prompting fails to adapt LLMs to RAG trustworthiness, including grounded citations and refusals.
nodes.approach: Alignment training targeting Trust-Score: grounded attributions and learning to refuse.
secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › Alignment & Preference Optimization
Language Models & NLP › LLM Evaluation & Benchmarks
nodes.confidence_reason: evaluation metric and alignment method span RAG and alignment topics
nodes.niche_reason: RAG alignment and trust evaluation are common, active directions.

nodes.title: Systems with Switching Causal Relations: A Meta-Causal Perspective
nodes.tldr: Introduces meta-causal states that group causal models by qualitative behavior, inferable from agent behavior and emergent from system dynamics.
nodes.problem: Causal graphs change when agents act or tipping points occur, but standard causality assumes a constant process.
nodes.approach: Clusters classical causal models into meta-causal states by equivalent qualitative behavior, consolidating mechanism parameters.
nodes.primary_topic: Learning Theory & Optimization › Causality & Causal Inference
nodes.confidence_reason: Concept paper spanning causality and dynamical systems; topic is a judgment call
nodes.niche_reason: Meta-causal states for switching causal graphs are very rare

nodes.title: Active Task Disambiguation with LLMs
nodes.tldr: Formalizes task ambiguity via Bayesian experimental design and trains LLM agents to ask informative clarifying questions that narrow the space of viable solutions.
nodes.problem: LLMs handle ambiguously specified tasks poorly and rarely ask useful clarifying questions.
nodes.approach: Bayesian experimental design framing with question selection by information gain over candidate solutions.
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › Agents & Tool Use
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Probabilistic & Bayesian Methods
nodes.niche_reason: Active clarification with experimental design is a specialised angle.

nodes.title: Accelerated training through iterative gradient propagation along the residual path
nodes.tldr: Approximates backpropagation by accumulating gradients along residual paths and backpropagating through layers in parallel, speeding training with minimal performance loss.
nodes.problem: Backpropagation is sequential across layers, limiting training speed of very deep models.
nodes.approach: Iterative algorithm alternating residual-path gradient accumulation with parallel per-layer backpropagation.
nodes.primary_topic: Architectures & Training › Efficient Training, Compression & Pruning
nodes.niche_reason: Parallelised approximate backpropagation is specialised

nodes.title: Residual Deep Gaussian Processes on Manifolds
nodes.tldr: Deep Gaussian processes on Riemannian manifolds with residual-style manifold-to-manifold layers, improving prediction and calibration for manifold data such as wind and Bayesian optimization.
nodes.problem: Shallow GPs on manifolds cannot model complex nonstationary manifold-supported data.
nodes.approach: Stack manifold-to-manifold GP layers in residual fashion with variational inference, modelling scalar functions and vector fields.
nodes.primary_topic: Learning Theory & Optimization › Kernels, GPs & Nonparametrics
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Probabilistic & Bayesian Methods
nodes.niche_reason: Gaussian processes on manifolds are a rare geometric niche.

nodes.title: To Trust or Not to Trust? Enhancing Large Language Models' Situated Faithfulness to External Contexts
nodes.tldr: Studies how LLMs should calibrate trust between internal knowledge and possibly wrong external contexts, proposing self-guided and rule-based confidence reasoning and CR-DPO training.
nodes.problem: LLMs over-rely on external context even when incorrect, conflicting with internal knowledge in RAG.
nodes.approach: Self-Guided and Rule-Based Confidence Reasoning plus confidence reasoning DPO fine-tuning, evaluated on QA including Reddit-sourced wrong contexts.
secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › Knowledge Editing & Factuality
nodes.niche_reason: Knowledge conflict in RAG is established but specialised.

nodes.title: miniCTX: Neural Theorem Proving with (Long-)Contexts
nodes.tldr: Introduces miniCTX, a benchmark of Lean theorems needing long repository context, showing context-conditioned provers beat state-only baselines.
nodes.problem: Theorem proving benchmarks do not test use of new long-range project context.
nodes.approach: Theorems from real Lean projects with repository context plus an automated extraction toolkit.
secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › Long Context & Memory
nodes.niche_reason: Formal theorem proving with context is specialised

nodes.title: ShEPhERD: Diffusing shape, electrostatics, and pharmacophores for bioisosteric drug design
nodes.tldr: ShEPhERD is an SE(3)-equivariant diffusion model that jointly generates 3D molecules with their shape, electrostatic surfaces and pharmacophores for interaction-aware bioisosteric drug design.
nodes.problem: Designing molecules with precise 3D interaction profiles for ligand-based drug design.
nodes.approach: Joint SE(3)-equivariant diffusion over 3D molecular graphs and shape, electrostatic and pharmacophore representations.
nodes.niche_reason: Molecular generative design is established but specialised.

nodes.title: PaRa: Personalizing Text-to-Image Diffusion via Parameter Rank Reduction
nodes.tldr: Personalizes text-to-image diffusion by reducing parameter rank during fine-tuning, matching target concepts while keeping prompt editability with 2x fewer parameters than LoRA.
nodes.problem: Personalization often trades target alignment against losing prompt editability.
nodes.approach: Explicit parameter rank reduction during diffusion model fine-tuning.
nodes.niche_reason: Parameter-rank personalization is a common fine-tuning variant.

nodes.title: Simple yet Effective Incomplete Multi-view Clustering: Similarity-level Imputation and Intra-view Hybrid-group Prototype Construction
nodes.tldr: SIIHPC handles incomplete multi-view clustering by similarity-level imputation via a consensus graph and per-view hybrid-size prototype groups, optimized with a monotone auxiliary function.
nodes.problem: Incomplete multi-view clustering ignores missing samples and uses a single prototype count for all views.
nodes.approach: Similarity-level recovery via consensus graph plus hybrid prototype quantities per view, solved with auxiliary function optimization.
nodes.confidence_reason: No clustering topic in vocabulary; representation learning is nearest.
nodes.niche_reason: Multi-view clustering is a niche, non-mainstream subfield.

nodes.title: Streaming Algorithms For $\ell_p$ Flows and $\ell_p$ Regression
nodes.tldr: First one-pass streaming algorithms for underdetermined lp regression in the column-arrival model, covering lp flows such as transshipment, electrical flow and max flow.
nodes.problem: Solving lp regression and lp flows in small space when columns arrive in a stream.
nodes.approach: Design column-arrival streaming algorithms with space much smaller than the stream, with bounds across p.
nodes.primary_topic: Learning Theory & Optimization › Learning Theory Lower Bounds & Complexity
nodes.niche_reason: Pure TCS streaming algorithms; far from ML mainstream.

nodes.title: TabReD: Analyzing Pitfalls and Filling the Gaps in Tabular Deep Learning Benchmarks
nodes.tldr: TabReD analyzes tabular deep learning benchmarks, finding they underrepresent temporal drift and rich feature engineering, and introduces industry-grade time-split datasets showing method rankings change.
nodes.problem: Academic tabular benchmarks miss industrial traits like temporal drift and engineered features.
nodes.approach: Release eight industry-derived tabular datasets with time-based splits and re-evaluate tabular methods.
nodes.niche_reason: Tabular benchmarking is specialised but established.

nodes.title: OASIS Uncovers: High-Quality T2I Models, Same Old Stereotypes
nodes.tldr: Proposes measures and tools to quantify stereotypes in text-to-image outputs and trace their origins inside the model, finding newer models still show strong stereotypes.
nodes.problem: Statistical-parity metrics mistake biases for stereotypes, misaligning with the sociological definition.
nodes.approach: Stereotype Score and WALS measure images; StOP and SPI trace stereotypes through internal representations.
nodes.niche_reason: Sociological stereotype measurement for text-to-image models is specialised but active.

nodes.title: Reducing Hallucinations in Large Vision-Language Models via Latent Space Steering
nodes.tldr: Reduces hallucinations in vision-language models by steering latent representations at inference time, stabilizing vision features without any extra training.
nodes.problem: Hallucinations in large vision-language models, where text outputs misalign with visual inputs.
nodes.approach: Visual and Textual Intervention: task-agnostic test-time latent space steering, no retraining.
secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › Knowledge Editing & Factuality
nodes.niche_reason: Hallucination mitigation in LVLMs is a crowded direction.

nodes.title: LoRA3D: Low-Rank Self-Calibration of 3D Geometric Foundation models
nodes.tldr: LoRA3D self-calibrates pretrained 3D geometric foundation models like DUSt3R to target scenes in five minutes, using confidence-weighted pseudo labels and low-rank adapters.
nodes.problem: Pretrained 3D geometric foundation models generalize poorly to hard scenes such as low overlap or low light.
nodes.approach: Robust multi-view optimization with calibrated confidence yields pseudo labels for LoRA fine-tuning without external priors.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: Test-time specialization of 3D foundation models is relatively new and specialised.

nodes.title: POTEC: Off-Policy Contextual Bandits for Large Action Spaces via Policy Decomposition
nodes.tldr: Off-policy contextual bandit method for large action spaces that clusters actions, learns cluster selection with a policy-gradient, and picks actions within clusters by regression.
nodes.problem: Off-policy learning in large discrete action spaces suffers from bias and variance.
nodes.approach: Two-stage policy decomposition: policy-gradient cluster selection plus regression within clusters.
nodes.niche_reason: Off-policy decomposition for large action spaces is specialised.

nodes.title: TANGO: Co-Speech Gesture Video Reenactment with Hierarchical Audio Motion Embedding and Diffusion Interpolation
nodes.tldr: Co-speech gesture video reenactment combining audio-motion latent retrieval via a hierarchical embedding with a diffusion model producing consistent transition frames in a graph-based framework.
nodes.problem: Audio-motion misalignment and GAN transition artifacts in gesture video reenactment.
nodes.approach: Hierarchical audio-motion joint embedding for retrieval and diffusion interpolation for appearance-consistent transition frames.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › Human Pose, Avatars & Faces
secondary_topics: Audio, Speech & Multimodal › Audio-Visual & Cross-modal Learning
nodes.niche_reason: Co-speech gesture video reenactment is a rare niche.

nodes.title: Nonlinear multiregion neural dynamics with parametric impulse response communication channels
nodes.tldr: A multi-region neural dynamics model combines nonlinear within-region dynamics with impulse-response communication channels, fit by variational filtering and validated on V1-V2 recordings.
nodes.problem: Modeling how multiple brain regions jointly compute and exchange information
nodes.approach: Nonlinear regional dynamics plus linear impulse-response channels, learned with variational filtering
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Probabilistic & Bayesian Methods
nodes.niche_reason: Computational neuroscience dynamics models are rare at ML venues

nodes.title: Efficient and Accurate Explanation Estimation with Distribution Compression
nodes.tldr: Compress Then Explain uses kernel thinning to pick a representative sample, making post-hoc feature attribution estimates 2-3x more sample-efficient than i.i.d. sampling.
nodes.problem: Reducing the number of model evaluations needed to approximate explanations accurately.
nodes.approach: Replace i.i.d. sampling with kernel-thinning distribution compression in explanation estimators.
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Kernels, GPs & Nonparametrics
nodes.niche_reason: Links explainability with distribution compression, an uncommon cross-over.

nodes.title: Generalized Principal-Agent Problem with a Learning Agent
nodes.tldr: Studies repeated generalized principal-agent problems with a no-regret learning agent, bounding principal utility via a reduction to approximate best response.
nodes.problem: Principal utility when an agent learns its responses and the principal lacks commitment.
nodes.approach: Reduce to one-shot approximate best-response problem and bound utility by regret and swap regret.
nodes.primary_topic: Learning Theory & Optimization › Game Theory & Mechanism Design
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Online Learning & Regret
nodes.niche_reason: Economics-flavored learning-agent theory is a rare niche.

nodes.title: Simplifying, Stabilizing and Scaling Continuous-time Consistency Models
nodes.tldr: Unifies diffusion and consistency model parameterizations, diagnoses continuous-time instability, and trains stable 1.5B-parameter continuous-time consistency models reaching near-diffusion FID with two sampling steps.
nodes.problem: Continuous-time consistency models are unstable to train, limiting scale and quality.
nodes.approach: Simplified theoretical framework with improved parameterization, architecture, and training objectives.
nodes.niche_reason: Diffusion sampler variant in a very crowded area.

nodes.title: A Periodic Bayesian Flow for Material Generation
nodes.tldr: CrysBFN introduces a periodic Bayesian flow with entropy conditioning for crystal generation and structure prediction, achieving state-of-the-art results and about 200x faster sampling.
nodes.problem: Modeling crystal distributions with periodic symmetry is hard and diffusion methods are slow.
nodes.approach: Periodic Bayesian flow networks with non-monotonic entropy dynamics and entropy conditioning on non-Euclidean variables.
nodes.niche_reason: Bayesian flow networks for periodic crystal data are rare.

nodes.title: CubeDiff: Repurposing Diffusion-Based Image Models for Panorama Generation
nodes.tldr: CubeDiff generates 360-degree panoramas from text or images by jointly synthesizing six cubemap faces with adapted multi-view diffusion models.
nodes.problem: Panorama generation with equirectangular or autoregressive methods is awkward and underuses image diffusion priors.
nodes.approach: Adapt multi-view diffusion models to jointly generate six cubemap faces without correspondence-aware attention.
nodes.niche_reason: Panorama generation is a relatively rare niche.

nodes.title: DynamicCity: Large-Scale 4D Occupancy Generation from Dynamic Scenes
nodes.tldr: Generates large-scale semantic 4D occupancy for driving scenes using a VAE that compresses 4D data into a HexPlane and a DiT diffusion model.
nodes.problem: Existing urban scene generation is static and single-frame, ignoring dynamics of driving environments.
nodes.approach: VAE with projection module builds HexPlane latents; DiT diffusion generates them, with padded rollout and conditioning.
nodes.niche_reason: Specialised 4D occupancy generation for driving, few direct peers.

nodes.title: Following the Human Thread in Social Navigation
nodes.tldr: Social Dynamics Adaptation infers human social dynamics from the robot's state-action history to follow a human while keeping a safe distance in social navigation.
nodes.problem: Robots must adapt to partially observable human trajectories during social navigation.
nodes.approach: Latent social dynamics inferred from robot state-action history, distilled from privileged trajectory information.
nodes.niche_reason: Social navigation is established but specialised.

nodes.title: D-FINE: Redefine Regression Task of DETRs as Fine-grained Distribution Refinement
nodes.tldr: Real-time DETR detector that refines bounding box regression as probability distributions and uses self-distillation, reaching 54-59 AP on COCO.
nodes.problem: DETR box regression predicts fixed coordinates, limiting real-time localization accuracy.
nodes.approach: Fine-grained distribution refinement plus global optimal self-distillation of localization knowledge.
nodes.niche_reason: Real-time DETR detectors are a crowded area.

nodes.title: Mitigating Memorization in Language Models
nodes.tldr: Compares regularization, fine-tuning and unlearning methods for curbing LM memorization, finding unlearning fastest and most effective, with a new BalancedSubnet method.
nodes.problem: Language models memorize and regurgitate private training data verbatim.
nodes.approach: TinyMem small LM suite to evaluate regularizer, fine-tuning and unlearning mitigations.
nodes.primary_topic: Trustworthy ML › Machine Unlearning & Privacy Attacks
nodes.niche_reason: Memorization mitigation for LLMs is a crowded area.

nodes.title: WildBench: Benchmarking LLMs with Challenging Tasks from Real Users in the Wild
nodes.tldr: WildBench evaluates LLMs on 1,024 hard real-user tasks using checklist-based LLM judging, WB-Reward and WB-Score metrics with length-bias mitigation, correlating 0.98 with Chatbot Arena.
nodes.problem: Evaluating LLMs on challenging real-world user queries reliably and cheaply.
nodes.approach: Tasks mined from chat logs, pairwise and individual LLM-judge metrics with checklists and length-bias mitigation.
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › LLM Evaluation & Benchmarks
nodes.niche_reason: LLM benchmarking with LLM judges is very crowded.

nodes.title: 3DIS: Depth-Driven Decoupled Image Synthesis for Universal Multi-Instance Generation
nodes.tldr: 3DIS decouples multi-instance image generation into depth-map layout generation and training-free attribute rendering with pretrained ControlNet, working across foundation models.
nodes.problem: Layout-controlled multi-instance generation is hard to build into modern text-to-image models like SDXL.
nodes.approach: Generate coarse scene depth with an LDM3D adapter, then render attributes with pretrained ControlNet without finetuning.
nodes.niche_reason: Layout-controlled diffusion generation is a common direction.

nodes.title: Learning to Discover Regulatory Elements for Gene Expression Prediction
nodes.tldr: Seq2Exp predicts gene expression from DNA by isolating causal regulatory elements from sequence and epigenomic signals using a Beta-distribution information bottleneck.
nodes.problem: Gene expression prediction requires identifying the regulatory elements that drive expression from DNA sequences.
nodes.approach: Causal decomposition of epigenomic signals and sequence with an information bottleneck extracting regulatory elements.
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Causality & Causal Inference
nodes.niche_reason: Regulatory genomics with causal bottleneck is a niche application.

nodes.title: Continuous Exposure Learning for Low-light Image Enhancement using Neural ODEs
nodes.tldr: Unsupervised low-light enhancement that models iterative curve adjustment as a Neural ODE, giving a continuous, better-converging enhancement process.
nodes.problem: Iterative curve-adjustment enhancement lacks convergence guarantees and is sensitive to iteration count.
nodes.approach: Formulate the curve update as a Neural ODE to learn continuous latent image dynamics.
nodes.niche_reason: Specialised enhancement niche with an unusual Neural ODE formulation

nodes.title: Anti-Exposure Bias in Diffusion Models
nodes.tldr: Reduces exposure bias in diffusion models by learning a lightweight per-step anti-bias prompt that corrects sampling trajectories at about 5 percent extra sampling cost.
nodes.problem: Training-sampling discrepancy (exposure bias) from score and discretization error limits diffusion model quality.
nodes.approach: Prompt prediction model trained on simulated exposure bias with a time-dependent weighting function.
nodes.niche_reason: Diffusion sampler improvements are a crowded area.

nodes.title: Multi-Draft Speculative Sampling: Canonical Decomposition and Theoretical Limits
nodes.tldr: Decomposes optimal multi-draft speculative sampling into importance-sampling selection followed by single-draft speculative sampling, deriving optimal acceptance and improving block efficiency.
nodes.problem: Multi-draft speculative decoding needs token selection that matches the target distribution while maximising acceptance.
nodes.approach: Two-step decomposition: importance-sampling token selection, then single-draft speculative sampling; weighted IS variants.
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › Efficient LLM Inference & Architectures
nodes.niche_reason: Multi-draft speculative decoding theory is specialised but active.

nodes.title: TOP-ERL: Transformer-based Off-Policy Episodic Reinforcement Learning
nodes.tldr: Enables off-policy learning for episodic RL over action trajectories by segmenting long action sequences and valuing segments with a transformer critic.
nodes.problem: Episodic RL is mostly on-policy because state-action values for whole trajectories are hard to estimate.
nodes.approach: Segment long action trajectories and value segments with a transformer critic plus n-step returns.
nodes.primary_topic: Reinforcement Learning › Online & Deep RL Algorithms
nodes.niche_reason: Episodic movement-primitive RL is specialised

nodes.title: SANA: Efficient High-Resolution Text-to-Image Synthesis with Linear Diffusion Transformers
nodes.tldr: Efficient text-to-image diffusion with a 32x deep-compression autoencoder, linear-attention DiT, and small LLM text encoder, generating 4K images quickly.
nodes.problem: High-resolution text-to-image diffusion is slow and expensive, too costly for laptop-scale deployment.
nodes.approach: Deep compression autoencoder with linear diffusion transformer and decoder-only LLM text encoder, plus Flow-DPM-Solver.
nodes.niche_reason: Efficient diffusion transformers are a crowded, mainstream direction.

nodes.title: How new data permeates LLM knowledge and how to dilute it
nodes.tldr: Learning a new fact primes LLMs to misapply it elsewhere; priming is predictable from prior token probabilities and reducible with new updates.
nodes.problem: New knowledge learned by LLMs can leak into unrelated contexts, causing hallucination.
nodes.approach: Outlandish dataset measures priming; stepping-stone augmentation and ignore-k update pruning limit it.
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › Knowledge Editing & Factuality
nodes.niche_reason: Specialised knowledge-injection analysis

nodes.title: MAP: Multi-Human-Value Alignment Palette
nodes.tldr: Aligns generative models to several human values at once by casting alignment as constrained optimization solved with a primal-dual method.
nodes.problem: Aligning generative AI to multiple, possibly conflicting human values with user-defined targets is hard.
nodes.approach: Constrained optimization with user-defined value targets, solved by primal-dual; linear weighted rewards suffice.
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › Alignment & Preference Optimization
nodes.niche_reason: Constrained multi-value alignment is an established but specialised angle

nodes.title: Limits to scalable evaluation at the frontier: LLM as judge won’t beat twice the data
nodes.tldr: Proves that when a judge is no more accurate than the evaluated model, debiasing cannot cut required ground-truth labels by more than half.
nodes.problem: Whether debiasing LLM-as-judge evaluation can reliably reduce costly labels at the evaluation frontier.
nodes.approach: Theoretical lower bound on label savings for debiasing methods, plus empirical evaluation.
nodes.primary_topic: Learning Theory & Optimization › Learning Theory Lower Bounds & Complexity
nodes.niche_reason: Theory of LLM-as-judge debiasing is specialised.

nodes.title: Towards Marginal Fairness Sliced Wasserstein Barycenter
nodes.tldr: Defines marginal fairness sliced Wasserstein barycenters, with tractable surrogate objectives and a new slicing distribution, so the barycenter is roughly equidistant from all marginals.
nodes.problem: Sliced Wasserstein barycenters give no control over fair distances to each marginal measure.
nodes.approach: Constrained barycenter formulation, three hyperparameter-free surrogates, and slicing distribution focused on unfair projecting directions.
nodes.primary_topic: Learning Theory & Optimization › Optimal Transport & Divergences
nodes.niche_reason: Specialised optimal transport barycenter fairness is rare.

nodes.title: Towards Automated Knowledge Integration From Human-Interpretable Representations
nodes.tldr: Integrates natural-language or other human-interpretable prior knowledge into models via conditional meta-learning, instantiated as Informed Neural Processes for data efficiency.
nodes.problem: Injecting inductive biases is manual and does not automatically use native-format knowledge.
nodes.approach: Conditional meta-learning selects inductive biases automatically from knowledge representations; Informed Neural Process.
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Probabilistic & Bayesian Methods
nodes.confidence_reason: informed priors versus neural-process meta-learning is a judgment call
nodes.niche_reason: knowledge-informed meta-learning is specialised

nodes.title: RAG-SR: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Neural Symbolic Regression
nodes.tldr: RAG-SR is a pre-training-free symbolic regression framework that builds expression features with an online-trained language model, using retrieval over searched expressions to curb hallucinations.
nodes.problem: Pretrained neural symbolic regressors struggle with unseen functions and variables and cost heavy compute.
nodes.approach: Evolutionary feature construction with an online-trained LM and retrieval-augmented generation of expression trees.
nodes.primary_topic: Science & Applications › Scientific Discovery & Symbolic Regression
nodes.niche_reason: Pre-training-free RAG symbolic regression is an unusual combination

nodes.title: Formation of Representations in Neural Networks
nodes.tldr: Proposes the Canonical Representation Hypothesis: latent features, weights and neuron gradients align during training, unifying neural collapse and the neural feature ansatz.
nodes.problem: How useful internal representations form in deep networks remains unexplained.
nodes.approach: Alignment hypotheses linking representations, weights and gradients, plus a gradient-noise and regularization theory.
nodes.primary_topic: Learning Theory & Optimization › Deep Learning Theory
nodes.niche_reason: Alignment-based theory of representation formation is an uncommon theoretical direction.

nodes.title: Signature Kernel Conditional Independence Tests in Causal Discovery for Stochastic Processes
nodes.tldr: Develops conditional independence constraints for stochastic dynamical systems from SDEs and a sound, complete causal discovery algorithm using signature kernel CI tests.
nodes.problem: Discovering causal structure in stochastic processes governed by SDEs from observational data.
nodes.approach: Derive CI constraints on coordinate processes; sound and complete algorithm with signature-kernel-based CI tests.
nodes.primary_topic: Learning Theory & Optimization › Causality & Causal Inference
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Kernels, GPs & Nonparametrics
nodes.niche_reason: Causal discovery for continuous-time SDEs with signature kernels is rare.

nodes.title: REGENT: A Retrieval-Augmented Generalist Agent That Can Act In-Context in New Environments
nodes.tldr: A retrieval-augmented generalist agent that adapts in-context to unseen robotics and game environments using retrieved neighbors, with fewer parameters and data than generalist baselines.
nodes.problem: Generalist agents need rapid adaptation to new environments without scaling model and data massively.
nodes.approach: Transformer policy trained on queries plus retrieved nearest-neighbor trajectories, enabling in-context adaptation without finetuning.
nodes.primary_topic: Reinforcement Learning › Transfer, Meta & Continual RL
nodes.confidence_reason: Straddles in-context RL, retrieval, and robot generalist policies.
nodes.niche_reason: Semi-parametric retrieval for generalist agents is established but specialised.

nodes.title: A Theoretically-Principled Sparse, Connected, and Rigid Graph Representation of Molecules
nodes.tldr: Hyperparameter-free molecular graph construction with guaranteed connectivity, sparsity, and rigidity, keeping edge-to-node ratio at most 3.
nodes.problem: Radial cutoff graphs for molecules lack connectivity, sparsity, and rigidity guarantees simultaneously.
nodes.approach: Geometric graph construction whose edges and dihedral angles uniquely determine atomic arrangements.
nodes.niche_reason: Established molecular GNN area with a specific geometric angle

nodes.title: A Second-Order Perspective on Model Compositionality and Incremental Learning
nodes.tldr: A second-order Taylor analysis explains when fine-tuned modules compose, and gives two incremental training algorithms that build multi-task models and support unlearning.
nodes.problem: Unclear what makes fine-tuned network modules composable into one multi-task model
nodes.approach: Second-order Taylor approximation of the loss with two dual incremental training algorithms
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Deep Learning Theory
nodes.niche_reason: Compositionality theory for non-linear nets is specialised but active

nodes.title: SPA-BENCH: A COMPREHENSIVE BENCHMARK FOR SMARTPHONE AGENT EVALUATION
nodes.tldr: A benchmark and plug-and-play framework for evaluating (M)LLM smartphone agents on Android tasks in English and Chinese, scoring seven completion and resource metrics.
nodes.problem: Smartphone agents are hard to compare fairly across implementations and tasks.
nodes.approach: Interactive Android environment integrating over ten agents with automated multi-metric evaluation.
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › LLM Evaluation & Benchmarks
secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › Agents & Tool Use
nodes.niche_reason: Smartphone GUI agent benchmark; growing but still specialised.

nodes.title: Moner: Motion Correction in Undersampled Radial MRI with Unsupervised Neural Representation
nodes.tldr: Moner jointly reconstructs artifact-free images and estimates rigid motion from undersampled radial MRI using an implicit neural representation with hash encoding, no training data needed.
nodes.problem: Motion correction in undersampled radial MRI without large pretraining datasets.
nodes.approach: Unsupervised INR with quasi-static motion model, Fourier-slice back-projection and coarse-to-fine hash encoding.
nodes.niche_reason: Training-free radial MRI motion correction is a rare niche.

nodes.title: Samba: Synchronized Set-of-Sequences Modeling for Multiple Object Tracking
nodes.tldr: Samba is a linear-time set-of-sequences state-space model that synchronizes memory across tracklets for multiple object tracking in coordinated, occluded scenes.
nodes.problem: Modeling long-range tracklet dependencies, inter-tracklet interactions and occlusions in multi-object tracking.
nodes.approach: Synchronized selective state spaces over tracklet sets, integrated into a tracking-by-propagation framework.
secondary_topics: Architectures & Training › State-Space Models & Linear Attention
nodes.niche_reason: Applying selective state spaces to multi-object tracking is specialised.

nodes.title: FlexPrefill: A Context-Aware Sparse Attention Mechanism for Efficient Long-Sequence Inference
nodes.tldr: FlexPrefill dynamically selects per-head sparse attention patterns using Jensen-Shannon divergence and cumulative-attention index selection to speed long-sequence LLM pre-filling.
nodes.problem: Quadratic attention cost in long-prompt pre-filling with inflexible sparse patterns
nodes.approach: Query-aware sparse pattern choice and cumulative-attention threshold index selection per head
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › Efficient LLM Inference & Architectures
secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › Long Context & Memory
nodes.niche_reason: Sparse attention for long-context inference is crowded

nodes.title: Programming Refusal with Conditional Activation Steering
nodes.tldr: Applies activation steering conditionally, based on activation patterns of the input, so LLMs refuse only specified content categories without weight changes.
nodes.problem: Activation steering alters LLM behavior indiscriminately, hurting selective response control.
nodes.approach: Detect input category from hidden-state patterns and apply or withhold steering vectors by rule.
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › LLM Safety & Jailbreaks
secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › Language Model Interpretability
nodes.niche_reason: conditional activation steering is a specialised safety control method

nodes.title: One Step Diffusion via Shortcut Models
nodes.tldr: Shortcut models condition one network on noise level and step size to skip ahead, giving good one- or few-step samples in one training phase.
nodes.problem: Diffusion sampling needs many passes, and prior speedups need complex multi-phase training or distillation.
nodes.approach: Single-network training conditioned on desired step size, enabling flexible step budgets without distillation.
nodes.niche_reason: Fast-sampling diffusion variants are extremely crowded.

nodes.title: Differential Transformer
nodes.tldr: Differential attention subtracts two softmax attention maps to cancel noise, yielding sparser attention and better language modeling, retrieval and in-context learning.
nodes.problem: Transformers over-allocate attention to irrelevant context.
nodes.approach: Compute attention as the difference of two softmax maps, canceling common-mode noise.
secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › Long Context & Memory
nodes.niche_reason: Attention variant for LLMs; crowded area but a distinctive mechanism.

nodes.title: Learning vector fields of differential equations on manifolds with geometrically constrained operator-valued kernels
nodes.tldr: Introduces a geometrically constrained operator-valued kernel for learning ODE vector fields on manifolds, with a geometry-preserving solver and error bound, tested on high-dimensional dynamics.
nodes.problem: Learning ODEs on manifolds efficiently while keeping solutions on or near the manifold.
nodes.approach: Operator-valued kernel on tangent bundles with kernel ridge regression and an exponential-map based geometry-preserving solver.
nodes.primary_topic: Learning Theory & Optimization › Kernels, GPs & Nonparametrics
secondary_topics: Architectures & Training › Time Series & Sequential Data
nodes.confidence_reason: Fits kernels, dynamical systems and manifold learning; topic is a judgment call.
nodes.niche_reason: Kernel methods for manifold ODEs are rare relative to neural approaches.

nodes.title: KAN: Kolmogorov–Arnold Networks
nodes.tldr: Proposes Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks with learnable spline activation functions on edges instead of linear weights, offering better accuracy and interpretability than MLPs on small science tasks.
nodes.problem: MLPs have fixed node activations and limited interpretability and scaling on small function-fitting and science tasks.
nodes.approach: Replace weights with learnable univariate spline functions on edges, based on the Kolmogorov-Arnold representation theorem.
secondary_topics: Science & Applications › Scientific Discovery & Symbolic Regression
nodes.confidence_reason: Architecture proposal also claims interpretability and AI-for-science use.
nodes.niche_reason: Novel MLP alternative, now widely studied but still specialised.

nodes.title: Instance-dependent Early Stopping
nodes.tldr: Stops backpropagating on individual training instances once the model has mastered them, using second-order loss differences, cutting backpropagation by 10-50% without losing accuracy.
nodes.problem: Conventional early stopping ignores per-instance learning status, wasting computation on already-learned examples.
nodes.approach: Per-instance mastery detection via second-order loss differences; mastered instances are excluded from backpropagation.
nodes.primary_topic: Architectures & Training › Efficient Training, Compression & Pruning
secondary_topics: Data, Benchmarks & Evaluation › Synthetic Data & Data Curation
nodes.niche_reason: Early stopping and data pruning are established training-efficiency topics.

nodes.title: No Pose, No Problem: Surprisingly Simple 3D Gaussian Splats from Sparse Unposed Images
nodes.tldr: NoPoSplat is a feed-forward model predicting 3D Gaussians from sparse unposed images in a canonical view space, with intrinsic token embeddings and a pose estimation pipeline.
nodes.problem: Generalizable 3D Gaussian reconstruction typically needs accurate camera poses from sparse views.
nodes.approach: Anchor first view as canonical space, predict Gaussians, embed intrinsics as tokens, train with photometric loss.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: Feed-forward Gaussian splatting is a crowded, active area.

nodes.title: On the Hölder Stability of Multiset and Graph Neural Networks
nodes.tldr: Analyzes how well multiset and message-passing GNNs separate inputs using Hölder-in-expectation stability, and proposes MPNNs with better separation quality.
nodes.problem: Graph separation power ignores whether separated embeddings remain distinguishable at finite precision.
nodes.approach: Hölder and Lipschitz stability analysis in expectation for parametric functions; two new MPNNs.
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Deep Learning Theory
nodes.niche_reason: Stability analysis of GNN separation is specialised theory

nodes.title: u-$\mu$P: The Unit-Scaled Maximal Update Parametrization
nodes.tldr: Combines Maximal Update Parametrization with Unit Scaling so default hyperparameters are near-optimal, enabling cheap proxy sweeps and out-of-the-box FP8 training.
nodes.problem: Tuning hyperparameters on full-size LLMs is expensive, and low-precision training needs careful scaling.
nodes.approach: Unit-scaled initialization and scaling rules combined with muP so activations, weights and gradients start at unit scale.
secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › Pretraining, Scaling & Data
nodes.niche_reason: Hyperparameter transfer via muP is established and specialised.

nodes.title: Unlearning-based Neural Interpretations
nodes.tldr: Learns an adaptive, debiased baseline for gradient attributions by perturbing inputs along an unlearning direction, avoiding static baselines that inject bias.
nodes.problem: Static attribution baselines inject colour, texture or frequency assumptions, biasing gradient explanations.
nodes.approach: Adaptive baseline found by ascending along an unlearning direction of the model.
nodes.niche_reason: Attribution baseline design is specialised but established.

nodes.title: DailyDilemmas: Revealing Value Preferences of LLMs with Quandaries of Daily Life
nodes.tldr: DailyDilemmas is a 1,360-item dataset of everyday moral dilemmas used to reveal which human values LLMs prioritize, analyzed through five value frameworks.
nodes.problem: LLMs increasingly guide everyday decisions, yet their implicit value priorities are unmeasured.
nodes.approach: Dilemmas with values per action, evaluated against five theoretical value frameworks and provider specs.
nodes.niche_reason: Value-preference benchmarks for LLM dilemmas are specialised.

nodes.title: Steering Protein Family Design through Profile Bayesian Flow
nodes.tldr: ProfileBFN extends discrete Bayesian Flow Networks with MSA profiles to generate protein families without large MSA data, producing diverse novel proteins with plausible function.
nodes.problem: Generative design of protein families without costly MSA construction.
nodes.approach: Profile Bayesian Flow Network trained on single sequences treated as degenerate profiles.
nodes.niche_reason: Bayesian flow networks for protein families is a rare combination.

nodes.title: Adam Exploits $\ell_\infty$-geometry of Loss Landscape via Coordinate-wise Adaptivity
nodes.tldr: Argues Adam beats SGD by exploiting l-infinity geometry of the loss, giving a convergence analysis under l-infinity smoothness with experiments on GPT-2 and ResNets.
nodes.problem: Why Adam outperforms SGD on language models is not theoretically understood.
nodes.approach: Convergence analysis under l-infinity smoothness assumptions, including blockwise Adam, with empirical smoothness checks.
nodes.confidence_reason: Optimization theory explaining Adam; training dynamics also plausible.
nodes.niche_reason: Adam analysis is a common theory topic.

nodes.title: SoftCVI: Contrastive variational inference with self-generated soft labels
nodes.tldr: SoftCVI derives variational inference objectives from a contrastive framework using self-generated soft labels computed from the unnormalized posterior, giving stable, mass-covering inference.
nodes.problem: Variational inference and MCMC are hard to apply reliably when the posterior has complex geometry.
nodes.approach: Parameterize a classifier by the variational distribution and train with soft labels from the unnormalized posterior.
nodes.primary_topic: Learning Theory & Optimization › Probabilistic & Bayesian Methods
nodes.niche_reason: Novel contrastive view of variational inference; specialised Bayesian niche.

nodes.title: Let SSMs be ConvNets: State-space Modeling with Optimal Tensor Contractions
nodes.tldr: Introduces Centaurus, a state-space network whose SSM operations are tensor contractions ordered for efficient training, reaching competitive fully state-space speech recognition.
nodes.problem: SSM blocks are limited to depthwise-separable designs, restricting efficient audio model architectures.
nodes.approach: Optimal tensor-contraction ordering per SSM block and a heterogeneous mix of group, full and bottleneck blocks.
nodes.primary_topic: Architectures & Training › State-Space Models & Linear Attention
secondary_topics: Audio, Speech & Multimodal › Speech Recognition & Synthesis
nodes.niche_reason: State-space audio architectures are an established specialised area

nodes.title: LoCoDL: Communication-Efficient Distributed Learning with Local Training and Compression
nodes.tldr: Combines local training with unbiased compression for distributed optimization, with doubly accelerated communication complexity under heterogeneity.
nodes.problem: Communication in distributed and federated learning is slow and costly.
nodes.approach: Local training to reduce communication rounds plus unbiased compressed updates, provably accelerated.
nodes.niche_reason: Common federated/distributed optimization topic with many similar papers.

nodes.title: MorphoDiff: Cellular Morphology Painting with Diffusion Models
nodes.tldr: A perturbation-conditioned latent diffusion model that generates high-resolution cell painting morphology images for chemical and genetic interventions.
nodes.problem: Predicting how cells morphologically respond to unseen perturbations, to explore drug responses in silico.
nodes.approach: Perturbation embeddings guide a 2D latent diffusion model trained on Cell Painting datasets.
nodes.confidence_reason: biology application versus conditional generative method
nodes.niche_reason: Perturbation-conditioned cell image generation is rare

nodes.title: Iterative Nash Policy Optimization: Aligning LLMs with General Preferences via No-Regret Learning
nodes.tldr: Frames RLHF with general preferences as a two-player game; a policy self-plays via no-regret learning to approximate the Nash policy.
nodes.problem: Reward-based RLHF under the Bradley-Terry assumption may not capture complex human preferences.
nodes.approach: Iterative self-play with a direct loss on preference data, avoiding per-response win-rate estimation.
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › Alignment & Preference Optimization
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Game Theory & Mechanism Design
nodes.niche_reason: RLHF is crowded; game-theoretic preference formulations are less common.

nodes.title: Topograph: An Efficient Graph-Based Framework for Strictly Topology Preserving Image Segmentation
nodes.tldr: Graph-based loss for topology-accurate segmentation: a component graph encodes prediction and label topology, up to 5x faster than persistent homology.
nodes.problem: Pixel-wise losses like Dice ignore topology, and topology-aware methods lack guarantees or are costly.
nodes.approach: Component graph of prediction and ground truth identifies critical regions; loss aggregates local neighbourhood information.
nodes.confidence_reason: Topology loss for generic segmentation; no clear application domain
nodes.niche_reason: Topology-preserving segmentation losses are specialised but established

nodes.title: Spectral Compressive Imaging via Unmixing-driven Subspace Diffusion Refinement
nodes.tldr: PSR-SCI predicts a rough multispectral image, decomposes it into subspace images via unmixing, and refines high frequencies with a pretrained RGB diffusion model.
nodes.problem: Recovering multispectral images from compressive measurements is ill-posed, and diffusion needs scarce, expensive spectral training data.
nodes.approach: Reversible unmixing-driven spectral embedding lets pretrained RGB diffusion refine subspace images under a high-dimensional consistency guidance.
nodes.niche_reason: Spectral compressive imaging with diffusion priors is a rare imaging niche.

nodes.title: PhysBench: Benchmarking and Enhancing Vision-Language Models for Physical World Understanding
nodes.tldr: A 10k-entry benchmark testing vision-language models on physical world understanding, plus a PhysAgent framework that boosts them by combining vision models.
nodes.problem: Vision-language models lack understanding of physical object properties, relations and dynamics.
nodes.approach: Interleaved video-image-text benchmark across four physics domains; PhysAgent pairs VLMs with specialist vision models.
nodes.niche_reason: VLM benchmarks are common; physics-focused variant is still fairly mainstream.

nodes.title: RM-Bench: Benchmarking Reward Models of Language Models with Subtlety and Style
nodes.tldr: Benchmarks reward models on sensitivity to subtle content differences and resistance to style bias, correlating with policy performance.
nodes.problem: Existing reward model benchmarks ignore subtle content changes and style bias, so they correlate poorly with policy performance.
nodes.approach: Benchmark pairing subtly different responses and style-varied responses, evaluating about 40 reward models.
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › LLM Evaluation & Benchmarks
secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › Alignment & Preference Optimization
nodes.niche_reason: Common reward-model evaluation work in a crowded alignment area.

nodes.title: Advantage Alignment Algorithms
nodes.tldr: Introduces Advantage Alignment, a simpler opponent-shaping algorithm family that aligns agents' advantages to reach cooperative equilibria in general-sum games.
nodes.problem: Naive RL agents converge to Pareto-suboptimal equilibria in general-sum social dilemmas.
nodes.approach: Opponent shaping by reweighting actions according to aligned advantages of interacting agents.
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Game Theory & Mechanism Design
nodes.niche_reason: Opponent shaping is a specialised but established multi-agent RL thread.

nodes.title: From Exploration to Mastery: Enabling LLMs to Master Tools via Self-Driven Interactions
nodes.tldr: DRAFT iteratively rewrites tool documentation using feedback from LLM trial-and-error interactions with tools, improving tool use and generalizing across models.
nodes.problem: Human-written tool documentation is inadequate and inaccurate, leaving a comprehension gap between LLMs and external tools.
nodes.approach: Trial-and-error loop of experience gathering, learning from experience, and documentation rewriting, with diversity-promoting exploration and adaptive termination.
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › Agents & Tool Use
nodes.niche_reason: Tool learning is active; documentation refinement is a narrower angle.

nodes.title: VisualPredicator: Learning Abstract World Models with Neuro-Symbolic Predicates for Robot Planning
nodes.tldr: Learns first-order neuro-symbolic predicates and an abstract world model online, enabling robot planning with better sample efficiency and out-of-distribution generalisation.
nodes.problem: Robots need task-specific abstractions that hide raw sensorimotor complexity while exposing task-essential elements.
nodes.approach: Invent predicates combining neural classifiers with symbolic first-order logic, then learn abstract transition models.
secondary_topics: Reinforcement Learning › Model-Based RL & World Models
nodes.niche_reason: Neuro-symbolic predicate invention for robot planning is a rare niche.

nodes.title: LVSM: A Large View Synthesis Model with Minimal 3D Inductive Bias
nodes.tldr: Transformer for sparse-view novel view synthesis with minimal 3D inductive bias, beating prior methods by 1.5 to 3.5 dB PSNR.
nodes.problem: Novel view synthesis relies on hand-designed 3D representations and geometric priors.
nodes.approach: Fully data-driven transformer, encoder-decoder or decoder-only, with no NeRF or epipolar priors.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.niche_reason: Fully data-driven view synthesis is an unusual direction.

nodes.title: Do LLMs Recognize Your Preferences? Evaluating Personalized Preference Following in LLMs
nodes.tldr: Introduces PrefEval, a benchmark of 3,000 preference-query pairs showing LLMs rapidly fail to follow user preferences over long multi-session conversations.
nodes.problem: Measuring whether LLMs infer, remember and follow user preferences in long conversations.
nodes.approach: Curated benchmark with explicit and implicit preferences, evaluated across prompting, feedback and RAG baselines.
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › LLM Evaluation & Benchmarks
secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › Long Context & Memory
nodes.niche_reason: LLM personalization benchmarks are established but specialised.

nodes.title: Learning from End User Data with Shuffled Differential Privacy over Kernel Densities
nodes.tldr: Shuffled differential privacy protocol for private kernel density estimation over distributed end-user data, enabling private classification near central-DP accuracy.
nodes.problem: Local DP hurts accuracy and central DP needs a fully trusted curator for distributed user data.
nodes.approach: Distributed kernel density estimation under the shuffle model, with a learned density per class as classifier.
nodes.niche_reason: Shuffled-DP kernel density classification is a rare combination

nodes.title: The Computational Complexity of Circuit Discovery for Inner Interpretability
nodes.tldr: Uses classical and parameterized complexity to show many circuit-discovery queries for MLPs are intractable, identifying tractable and useful subsets.
nodes.problem: Circuit discovery heuristics lack scalability and faithfulness guarantees, with unknown complexity.
nodes.approach: Formalizes mechanistic-explanation queries and analyzes them with complexity theory and approximation bounds.
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Learning Theory Lower Bounds & Complexity
nodes.niche_reason: complexity-theoretic analysis of interpretability queries is rare

nodes.title: Towards General-Purpose Model-Free Reinforcement Learning
nodes.tldr: Proposes MR.Q, a model-free deep RL algorithm using model-based representations to linearize value functions, competitive across benchmarks with one hyperparameter set.
nodes.problem: RL algorithms are tuned per benchmark, while model-based methods are costly.
nodes.approach: Model-based representations approximately linearize the value function, avoiding planning costs.
nodes.primary_topic: Reinforcement Learning › Online & Deep RL Algorithms
secondary_topics: Reinforcement Learning › Model-Based RL & World Models
nodes.niche_reason: General deep RL algorithm design is a common mainstream topic

nodes.title: SRSA: Skill Retrieval and Adaptation for Robotic Assembly Tasks
nodes.tldr: SRSA retrieves the most transferable skill from a library for a new assembly task by predicting zero-shot success, then fine-tunes it with fewer samples.
nodes.problem: Choosing which prior skill to fine-tune for new contact-rich assembly tasks is hard.
nodes.approach: Learned transfer-success predictor over task features of geometry, dynamics and expert actions guides retrieval.
nodes.primary_topic: Reinforcement Learning › Transfer, Meta & Continual RL
nodes.niche_reason: Skill retrieval for contact-rich assembly is specialised.

nodes.title: FairMT-Bench: Benchmarking Fairness for Multi-turn Dialogue in Conversational LLMs
nodes.tldr: Benchmark measuring LLM fairness across multi-turn dialogues in three stages, with a 10K-dialogue dataset and a harder 1K variant evaluated on 15 LLMs.
nodes.problem: Existing fairness benchmarks cover single-turn chats, missing bias that accumulates over multi-turn dialogue.
nodes.approach: Task taxonomy over context, interaction and trade-off fairness, with GPT-4, bias classifiers and human annotation.
secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › LLM Evaluation & Benchmarks
nodes.niche_reason: LLM fairness benchmarks are a crowded area

nodes.title: Brain Bandit: A Biologically Grounded Neural Network for Efficient Control of Exploration
nodes.tldr: Analyzes a biological Hopfield-style network for explore-exploit control, showing it performs posterior sampling and can speed up RL exploration.
nodes.problem: Humans explore novel environments efficiently, but the neural mechanism behind exploration is unclear
nodes.approach: Analyze a stochastic continuous Hopfield network as posterior sampling with tunable uncertainty bias, then embed in RL.
nodes.niche_reason: Brain-inspired Hopfield-network exploration is a rare cross-disciplinary angle

nodes.title: Easing Training Process of Rectified Flow Models Via Lengthening Inter-Path Distance
nodes.tldr: Matches noises to samples to lengthen inter-path distances in rectified flow training, speeding up training by 30-40% without hurting generation quality.
nodes.problem: Rectified flow and diffusion models train slowly because noise-sample paths are crowded.
nodes.approach: Distance-aware noise-sample matching with a closed-form inter-path distance surrogate for optimization.
secondary_topics: Architectures & Training › Efficient Training, Compression & Pruning
nodes.niche_reason: Specialised training-speed angle on flow models

nodes.title: Generator Matching: Generative modeling with arbitrary Markov processes
nodes.tldr: Generator Matching unifies diffusion, flow matching, and discrete diffusion by learning generators of arbitrary Markov processes, enabling jump processes and superpositions of models.
nodes.problem: Generative modeling frameworks lack a unified, modality-agnostic view over general Markov processes.
nodes.approach: Learn marginal generator from conditional generators of Markov processes; combine processes via superposition.
secondary_topics: Generative Models › Generative Model Evaluation & Theory
nodes.niche_reason: Theory-heavy generalization of a crowded area.

nodes.title: How to Find the Exact Pareto Front for Multi-Objective MDPs?
nodes.tldr: Finds the exact Pareto front of multi-objective MDPs by traversing neighboring deterministic policies that differ by one state-action pair, solving one MDP per vertex.
nodes.problem: Finding the Pareto front of multi-objective MDPs is hard, since prior methods approximate or handle only deterministic policies.
nodes.approach: Exploits the convex polytope geometry of the front, reducing global policy comparison to local edge traversal.
nodes.niche_reason: Exact Pareto fronts for MO-MDPs are a rare theoretical niche

nodes.title: ODE-based Smoothing Neural Network for Reinforcement Learning Tasks
nodes.tldr: Replaces MLP policy layers with smooth ODE neurons that low-pass filter noise and control Lipschitz constants, yielding smoother, more robust RL control actions.
nodes.problem: Deep RL policies produce non-smooth actions from input noise and unconstrained Lipschitz constants.
nodes.approach: Smooth ODE neurons with learnable state-based time constants and a state-based Lipschitz-controlling mapping.
nodes.primary_topic: Reinforcement Learning › Online & Deep RL Algorithms
nodes.niche_reason: Smooth ODE policy networks are a specialised architecture niche

nodes.title: Progressive Compositionality in Text-to-Image Generative Models
nodes.tldr: Trains diffusion text-to-image models with a multi-stage curriculum on LLM-composed hard-negative image pairs curated by VQA checkers to improve compositional generation.
nodes.problem: Diffusion text-to-image models struggle with attribute-object compositional relations in complex scenes.
nodes.approach: Multi-stage curriculum contrastive training on LLM-composed, VQA-verified hard-negative image pairs.
secondary_topics: Data, Benchmarks & Evaluation › Synthetic Data & Data Curation
nodes.niche_reason: Compositional text-to-image generation is a popular mainstream topic

nodes.title: ECD: A Machine Learning Benchmark for Predicting Enhanced-Precision Electronic Charge Density in Crystalline Inorganic Materials
nodes.tldr: ECD is a dataset of 140,646 crystal structures with PBE electronic charge density and a high-precision HSE subset, with benchmark tasks for charge density prediction.
nodes.problem: Electronic charge density prediction lacks large datasets, especially high-precision functional data.
nodes.approach: Build PBE and HSE DFT charge-density datasets and benchmark pretraining on PBE with HSE fine-tuning.
nodes.niche_reason: DFT charge density learning is a rare materials niche.

nodes.title: Revisiting Random Walks for Learning on Graphs
nodes.tldr: Shows that random-walk records of a graph, fed to a neural network or language model, give isomorphism-invariant, universal graph learners that avoid over-smoothing.
nodes.problem: Message-passing GNNs suffer over-smoothing and over-squashing, and graph models need isomorphism-invariant designs.
nodes.approach: Random walks recorded as anonymized text, processed by a neural network or language model with Markov-chain analysis.
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Deep Learning Theory
nodes.niche_reason: Random-walk text records read by language models is an unusual graph-learning route

nodes.title: Transfusion: Predict the Next Token and Diffuse Images with One Multi-Modal Model
nodes.tldr: Transfusion trains one transformer on text and images by combining next-token prediction with diffusion, scaling to 7B parameters and outperforming discrete image tokenization approaches.
nodes.problem: Jointly modeling discrete text and continuous image data in a single model.
nodes.approach: Single transformer with language modeling loss plus diffusion loss over mixed-modality sequences.
nodes.niche_reason: Unified multimodal generation is a mainstream, crowded area.

nodes.title: Lean-STaR: Learning to Interleave Thinking and Proving
nodes.tldr: Lean-STaR trains language models to generate informal thoughts before each formal proof step in Lean, using synthetic thoughts and expert iteration to improve theorem proving.
nodes.problem: Formal proof data omits the informal reasoning humans use, limiting language-model theorem provers.
nodes.approach: Generate retrospective synthetic thoughts for tactics, train thought-then-tactic model, then apply expert iteration with Lean verification.
secondary_topics: Reinforcement Learning › RL for LLMs & Reasoning
nodes.niche_reason: Formal theorem proving with LLMs is established but specialised.

nodes.title: Improved Convergence Rate for Diffusion Probabilistic Models
nodes.tldr: Proves an iteration complexity of d^(1/3) epsilon^(-2/3) for diffusion sampling via a randomized midpoint method, beating the prior d^(5/12) epsilon^(-1) bound without log-concavity.
nodes.problem: Theory of diffusion model convergence lags practice; prior complexity bounds were loose.
nodes.approach: Randomized midpoint discretization of the reverse process analyzed with epsilon-accurate score estimates.
nodes.primary_topic: Generative Models › Generative Model Evaluation & Theory
nodes.niche_reason: Convergence theory for diffusion sampling is specialised.

nodes.title: Context-Parametric Inversion: Why Instruction Finetuning May Not Actually Improve Context Reliance
nodes.tldr: Instruction finetuning can reduce rather than improve LLM reliance on context when it conflicts with parametric knowledge; the paper analyzes why and suggests mitigations.
nodes.problem: Instruction-tuned LLMs often ignore input context that contradicts parametric knowledge, causing hallucination.
