nodes.approach: Empirical controlled studies and theoretical analysis of context reliance across finetuning trajectories.
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › Knowledge Editing & Factuality
nodes.niche_reason: Specific phenomenon within a well-studied area of LLM tuning behavior.

nodes.title: Meta-Dynamical State Space Models for Integrative Neural Data Analysis
nodes.tldr: Meta-learns a low-dimensional manifold of latent neural dynamics across recordings, enabling few-shot reconstruction and forecasting of new neural activity from motor cortex.
nodes.problem: Latent dynamics models cannot readily share structure across heterogeneous neural recordings.
nodes.approach: Meta-learned low-dimensional family of state-space dynamics parametrized per recording.
secondary_topics: Architectures & Training › Time Series & Sequential Data
nodes.confidence_reason: Method is meta-learning applied to neuroscience data; topic choice is a judgment call.
nodes.niche_reason: Meta-learning across neural recordings is a rare angle.

nodes.title: Differentiation and Specialization of Attention Heads via the Refined Local Learning Coefficient
nodes.tldr: Uses refined local learning coefficients to track how transformer attention heads differentiate and specialise during training, revealing a multigram circuit.
nodes.problem: Understanding how internal structure develops in transformer components during training.
nodes.approach: Refined singular-learning-theory complexity measures applied per component of a two-layer attention transformer.
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › Language Model Interpretability
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Deep Learning Theory
nodes.niche_reason: Singular learning theory for developmental interpretability is rare

nodes.title: A Decade's Battle on Dataset Bias: Are We There Yet?
nodes.tldr: Shows modern networks can classify which dataset an image comes from with 84.7% accuracy, learning transferable features that suggest persistent dataset bias.
nodes.problem: Whether dataset bias identified a decade ago persists in large, diverse modern datasets.
nodes.approach: Revisits the Torralba and Efros dataset classification experiment with modern networks on YFCC, CC and DataComp.
secondary_topics: Architectures & Training › Domain Adaptation & OOD Generalization
nodes.niche_reason: Revisiting dataset bias via dataset classification is a specialised angle

nodes.title: Exploring the Camera Bias of Person Re-identification
nodes.tldr: Measures camera bias in person re-ID on unseen domains and shows feature normalization debiases embeddings, plus training strategies for unsupervised ReID.
nodes.problem: Person re-ID models are biased toward camera identity, especially under domain shift and unsupervised training.
nodes.approach: Embedding feature normalization as test-time debiasing, plus training strategies against camera-biased pseudo labels.
secondary_topics: Architectures & Training › Domain Adaptation & OOD Generalization
nodes.niche_reason: Person ReID is an established but specialised vision subfield.

nodes.title: Higher-Order Graphon Neural Networks: Approximation and Cut Distance
nodes.tldr: Extends higher-order invariant graph networks to graphons, proving expressivity at least k-WL and universal approximation, enabling transfer across graph sizes.
nodes.problem: Size transferability is studied mostly for message-passing GNNs, not for more powerful higher-order GNNs.
nodes.approach: Graphon-signal k-WL extension and an invariant graphon network built from bounded linear operators in the IGN basis.
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Deep Learning Theory
nodes.niche_reason: Graphon limits of higher-order GNNs are a rare theory niche.

nodes.title: REEF: Representation Encoding Fingerprints for Large Language Models
nodes.tldr: REEF fingerprints LLMs by comparing centered kernel alignment of representations between suspect and victim models, training-free and robust to fine-tuning, pruning, merging and permutation.
nodes.problem: Identifying whether a suspect model derives from an open-source victim LLM to protect intellectual property.
nodes.approach: Compare CKA similarity of hidden representations on shared samples, with no training.
secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › Language Model Interpretability
nodes.niche_reason: Model fingerprinting for LLM IP is specialised.

nodes.title: Attention with Markov: A Curious Case of Single-layer Transformers
nodes.tldr: Analyzes why single-layer transformers get stuck in unigram local minima instead of learning bigram structure of Markov chains; characterizes the loss landscape.
nodes.problem: Single-layer transformers fail to learn bigram Markov kernels, unlike deeper models
nodes.approach: Markov-chain analysis framework deriving loss landscape global and bad local minima conditions
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Deep Learning Theory
nodes.niche_reason: Specialised theory of toy transformer learning dynamics

nodes.title: Robustness Reprogramming for Representation Learning
nodes.tldr: Reprograms a trained model's feature transformation with robust non-linear pattern matching to improve adversarial and noise robustness without changing parameters.
nodes.problem: Improving robustness of a well-trained model without altering its parameters.
nodes.approach: Non-linear robust pattern matching replacing linear feature transformation, with three reprogramming paradigms.
nodes.confidence_reason: Robustness vs representation learning framing; both fit.
nodes.niche_reason: Robust-statistics-based reprogramming of trained models is unusual.

nodes.title: Deep Learning Alternatives Of The Kolmogorov Superposition Theorem
nodes.tldr: Introduces ActNet, a scalable Kolmogorov superposition-based network that outperforms KANs and competes with MLPs on physics-informed PDE benchmarks.
nodes.problem: Original Kolmogorov superposition formulations are impractical, and KANs show mixed results.
nodes.approach: Redesigned KST-based architecture with explicit inner and outer functions, evaluated in PINNs.
nodes.confidence_reason: Novel architecture could fit neural architecture or PDE surrogates
nodes.niche_reason: KST-based network design is a rare, unusual direction

nodes.title: TopoNets: High performing vision and language models with brain-like topography
nodes.tldr: Adds a topographic loss that makes vision and language model units spatially organized, matching brain-like cortical properties with little accuracy cost.
nodes.problem: Standard models lack brain-like spatial organization, and earlier topography methods hurt task performance.
nodes.approach: A TopoLoss regularizer applied during training of ResNet, ViT and GPT-style models.
nodes.confidence_reason: Topographic loss suits both neuroscience and representation-learning topics
nodes.niche_reason: Brain-topography regularization in deep models is a rare cross-disciplinary angle

nodes.title: Provable Uncertainty Decomposition via Higher-Order Calibration
nodes.tldr: Gives a principled decomposition of predictive uncertainty into aleatoric and epistemic parts, with formal guarantees via higher-order calibration using k-snapshot data.
nodes.problem: Aleatoric and epistemic decompositions of predictive uncertainty lack formal guarantees on real data.
nodes.approach: Higher-order calibration with k-snapshot data gives provable aleatoric uncertainty estimates.
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Probabilistic & Bayesian Methods
nodes.niche_reason: Formal uncertainty decomposition guarantees are a specialised niche

nodes.title: Surprising Effectiveness of pretraining Ternary Language Model at Scale
nodes.tldr: Pretrains ternary language models from scratch and shows they outperform quantized and float models of equal bit size above one billion parameters.
nodes.problem: Post-training quantization degrades LLM quality below 4-bit precision, limiting memory-efficient inference.
nodes.approach: Pretraining ternary (TriLM) models across scales and comparing against float and quantized models.
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › Efficient LLM Inference & Architectures
secondary_topics: Architectures & Training › Efficient Training, Compression & Pruning
Language Models & NLP › Pretraining, Scaling & Data
nodes.niche_reason: Ternary LLM pretraining is specialised but growing.

nodes.title: Proteina: Scaling Flow-based Protein Structure Generative Models
nodes.tldr: Scales flow-based protein backbone generation to 5x more parameters, with fold-class conditioning, LoRA fine-tuning and guidance, producing designable proteins up to 800 residues.
nodes.problem: De novo protein backbone design needs larger, controllable generators for longer designable proteins
nodes.approach: Large scalable transformer flow model with hierarchical fold labels and classifier-free guidance
nodes.niche_reason: Protein generation is established; long-length flow models are specialised

nodes.title: Uncertainty Modeling in Graph Neural Networks via Stochastic Differential Equations
nodes.tldr: LGNSDE extends graph neural ODEs with Bayesian priors and Brownian motion to give uncertainty-aware node representations, with theoretical variance bounds and robustness guarantees.
nodes.problem: Graph neural ODEs cannot quantify epistemic and aleatoric uncertainty.
nodes.approach: Latent graph neural SDEs combining Bayesian prior-posterior mechanism and Brownian noise with provable stability.
nodes.niche_reason: Stochastic differential equation GNNs for uncertainty are uncommon.

nodes.title: MMAU: A Massive Multi-Task Audio Understanding and Reasoning Benchmark
nodes.tldr: MMAU is a 10k-clip benchmark of expert-level audio understanding and reasoning across speech, sounds and music; top models like Gemini 2.0 Flash reach about 60%.
nodes.problem: Existing audio benchmarks do not test expert-level knowledge and complex reasoning in audio-language models.
nodes.approach: Curate human-annotated audio question-answer pairs spanning 27 skills and evaluate 18 audio-language models.
nodes.primary_topic: Audio, Speech & Multimodal › Audio & Music Understanding
nodes.niche_reason: Audio-language benchmarks are active but less crowded than vision.

nodes.title: First-Person Fairness in Chatbots
nodes.tldr: Introduces a scalable counterfactual method using an LLM research assistant to measure first-person fairness toward chatbot users across demographics in real-world chats.
nodes.problem: Evaluating fairness toward chatbot users in open-ended tasks, unlike traditional institutional decision settings.
nodes.approach: Counterfactual name-based comparison of responses with a language-model research assistant, validated by human annotation.
secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › LLM Evaluation & Benchmarks
nodes.niche_reason: LLM fairness evaluation is a common topic.

nodes.title: Regularization by Texts for Latent Diffusion Inverse Solvers
nodes.tldr: Regularizes latent diffusion inverse solvers with text descriptions of expected solutions, refined via null-text optimization to resolve ambiguity.
nodes.problem: Ill-posed inverse problems have ambiguous solutions that measurements alone cannot resolve.
nodes.approach: Inject text preconceptions during reverse sampling, with adaptive negation via null-text optimization.
nodes.niche_reason: Text-regularized diffusion inverse solvers are specialised

nodes.title: Approaching Rate-Distortion Limits in Neural Compression with Lattice Transform Coding
nodes.tldr: Replaces scalar rounding in neural compressors with lattice quantization, approaching optimal vector quantization and rate-distortion limits at reasonable complexity.
nodes.problem: Scalar rounding in neural compressors is suboptimal for sources with intrinsic dimension above one.
nodes.approach: Lattice quantization in the latent space, with block and nested lattice coding extensions.
nodes.niche_reason: Lattice quantization for neural compression is specialised.

nodes.title: HiRA: Parameter-Efficient Hadamard High-Rank Adaptation for Large Language Models
nodes.tldr: HiRA is a parameter-efficient fine-tuning method that uses a Hadamard product to keep high-rank updates, outperforming LoRA on several tasks.
nodes.problem: Low-rank LoRA updates limit expressiveness for adapting LLMs to new tasks.
nodes.approach: Hadamard-product update that retains high-rank structure at low parameter cost.
secondary_topics: Architectures & Training › Efficient Training, Compression & Pruning
nodes.niche_reason: PEFT variants are a crowded area of LLM research.

nodes.title: InverseBench: Benchmarking Plug-and-Play Diffusion Priors for Inverse Problems in Physical Sciences
nodes.tldr: InverseBench benchmarks 14 plug-and-play diffusion-prior algorithms across five scientific inverse problems, comparing them against domain-specific baselines.
nodes.problem: Diffusion priors for inverse problems are tested mainly on natural images, not scientific data.
nodes.approach: Open-source benchmark suite with datasets and pre-trained models for five physical-science inverse problems.
nodes.niche_reason: Scientific inverse-problem benchmarks are specialised but established.

nodes.title: On Disentangled Training for Nonlinear Transform in Learned Image Compression
nodes.tldr: Speeds up learned image compression training about 2x via a linear auxiliary wavelet transform that disentangles energy compaction, with a small rate-distortion gain.
nodes.problem: Learned image compression models take weeks to train because nonlinear transforms converge slowly.
nodes.approach: Plug-and-play linear auxiliary transform with wavelet-based linear shortcuts for decorrelation and subband scaling.
secondary_topics: Architectures & Training › Efficient Training, Compression & Pruning
nodes.niche_reason: Learned compression is established; the training-acceleration angle is common.

nodes.title: Nonlinear Sequence Embedding by Monotone Variational Inequality
nodes.tldr: Learns low-dimensional representations of nonlinear sequences without supervision, with recovery guarantees, using a convex monotone variational inequality with low-rank coupling.
nodes.problem: Unsupervised embedding of nonlinear multichannel or symbolic sequences that shares structure across sequences.
nodes.approach: Per-sequence autoregressive models linked by low-rank regularisation, cast as a monotone variational inequality recovery problem.
secondary_topics: Architectures & Training › Time Series & Sequential Data
nodes.confidence_reason: Sequence representation sits between representation learning and time series
nodes.niche_reason: Convex variational-inequality formulation of sequence embedding is unusual

nodes.title: Trust or Escalate: LLM Judges with Provable Guarantees for Human Agreement
nodes.tldr: Selective LLM-judge evaluation that escalates from cheap to strong models only when confident, guaranteeing a user-specified human-agreement level.
nodes.problem: LLM judges can fail to match human pairwise preferences, with no guarantee of agreement.
nodes.approach: Confidence-based selective evaluation with simulated annotators for calibration and cascaded model escalation.
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › LLM Evaluation & Benchmarks
nodes.niche_reason: LLM-as-judge is crowded; guarantee angle is distinctive

nodes.title: SlowFast-VGen: Slow-Fast Learning for Action-Driven Long Video Generation
nodes.tldr: Dual-speed learning for action-driven long video generation, pairing a slow conditional video diffusion world model with fast inference-time temporal LoRA storing episodic memory.
nodes.problem: Long generated videos become inconsistent across frames beyond the model's context window.
nodes.approach: Masked conditional video diffusion plus temporal LoRA fast learning in a slow-fast loop, with a 200k-video dataset.
secondary_topics: Reinforcement Learning › Model-Based RL & World Models
nodes.niche_reason: Fast inference-time LoRA memory for video world models is unusual.

nodes.title: Learning Randomized Algorithms with Transformers
nodes.tldr: Shows transformers can learn randomized algorithms from data and objectives alone, gaining robustness against oblivious adversaries on recall, graph coloring, and grid exploration.
nodes.problem: Neural networks lack learned use of randomness, which helps algorithms against adversaries.
nodes.approach: Train transformers with injected randomness via gradient descent or evolution strategies on adversarial objectives.
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Online Learning & Regret
nodes.niche_reason: Learning randomized algorithms inside transformers is very unusual.

nodes.title: AIR-BENCH 2024: A Safety Benchmark based on Regulation and Policies Specified Risk Categories
nodes.tldr: AIR-BENCH 2024 is a 5,694-prompt safety benchmark organized by a 314-category risk taxonomy derived from eight government regulations and sixteen company policies.
nodes.problem: Existing safety benchmarks use ad hoc risk categories misaligned with regulations and company policies.
nodes.approach: Decompose regulations and policies into a four-tier taxonomy and curate prompts for each category with human auditing.
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › LLM Safety & Jailbreaks
secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › LLM Evaluation & Benchmarks
nodes.niche_reason: Safety benchmarks are common; regulation-grounded taxonomy is more specialised.

nodes.title: Linear Mode Connectivity in Differentiable Tree Ensembles
nodes.tldr: Achieves linear mode connectivity for soft tree ensembles by accounting for subtree flip and splitting order invariances, or by using decision-list architectures that lack them.
nodes.problem: Whether linear mode connectivity holds for non-neural models such as differentiable tree ensembles.
nodes.approach: Identify tree-specific invariances beyond permutation, and design decision-list trees without extra invariances.
nodes.primary_topic: Learning Theory & Optimization › Deep Learning Theory
nodes.niche_reason: Mode connectivity for differentiable trees is very rare.

nodes.title: Unlocking State-Tracking in Linear RNNs Through Negative Eigenvalues
nodes.tldr: Shows linear RNNs fail at parity unless transition eigenvalues go negative, and extends this to DeltaNet and Mamba at 1.3B scale.
nodes.problem: Linear RNNs and Transformers cannot perform state-tracking tasks like parity.
nodes.approach: Allow negative eigenvalues in state-transition matrices, proved via finite-precision analysis.
nodes.primary_topic: Architectures & Training › State-Space Models & Linear Attention
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Deep Learning Theory
nodes.niche_reason: Formal state-tracking analysis of linear RNNs is specialised.

nodes.title: Biologically Constrained Barrel Cortex Model Integrates Whisker Inputs and Replicates Key Brain Network Dynamics
nodes.tldr: Builds a 4,218-neuron biophysically constrained spiking model of mouse barrel cortex that integrates whisker inputs and reproduces key brain network dynamics.
nodes.problem: Bridging biological realism and behavioral function in sensory-motor integration models.
nodes.approach: Anatomy-constrained recurrent spiking network of 13 neuron subtypes modelling superficial barrel cortex layers.
nodes.niche_reason: Detailed cortical column modelling is very rare at ML venues.

nodes.title: Attention as a Hypernetwork
nodes.tldr: Reformulates multi-head attention as a hypernetwork and shows a low-dimensional latent code predicts and reuses subtasks for compositional generalization.
nodes.problem: Explaining how transformers compositionally generalize to unseen combinations of known parts.
nodes.approach: Hypernetwork view of attention, plus nonlinear value-network ablation tested on symbolic Raven's matrices.
secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › Language Model Interpretability
nodes.confidence_reason: Architecture analysis straddles transformers and interpretability
nodes.niche_reason: Mechanistic view of attention compositionality is specialised

nodes.title: Joint Reward and Policy Learning with Demonstrations and Human Feedback Improves Alignment
nodes.tldr: Jointly learns reward and policy from both demonstrations and human preference feedback, improving LLM alignment over separate SFT, reward modeling and RL stages.
nodes.problem: Reward models from feedback alone ignore demonstration data, weakening alignment pipelines.
nodes.approach: Inverse-RL-style joint reward and policy learning with demonstrations and human feedback in one objective.
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › Alignment & Preference Optimization
secondary_topics: Reinforcement Learning › Reward Learning, Inverse RL & Preferences
nodes.niche_reason: Alignment is crowded; the IRL angle is somewhat distinctive.

nodes.title: Language Model Alignment in Multilingual Trolley Problems
nodes.tldr: Builds MultiTP, a multilingual trolley-problem corpus over 100 languages, and finds LLM moral judgments align with human preferences unevenly across languages.
nodes.problem: Unknown whether LLM moral judgments and alignment with humans hold consistently across languages.
nodes.approach: Cross-lingual moral dilemma vignettes compared with Moral Machine human judgments across six dimensions.
nodes.niche_reason: Cross-lingual moral alignment of LLMs is a distinctive, rare angle.

nodes.title: Fair Clustering in the Sliding Window Model
nodes.tldr: Proves proportionally fair clustering has no finite-ratio sliding-window streaming algorithm under exact fairness, but a relaxed (1+eps) fairness gives a poly-space approximation algorithm.
nodes.problem: Fair clustering in the sliding window streaming model.
nodes.approach: Lower-bound impossibility result plus a relaxed-fairness approximate streaming algorithm with empirical evaluation.
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Learning Theory Lower Bounds & Complexity
nodes.niche_reason: Streaming-algorithm theory for fair clustering is rare in ML venues.

nodes.title: Reasoning Elicitation in Language Models via Counterfactual Feedback
nodes.tldr: Proposes metrics balancing factual and counterfactual QA accuracy and fine-tuning methods that improve LLM causal reasoning generalization.
nodes.problem: Language models lack counterfactual causal reasoning, and factual-only metrics miss this.
nodes.approach: New balanced accuracy metrics and fine-tuning approaches evaluated on inductive and deductive reasoning tasks.
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Causality & Causal Inference
nodes.confidence_reason: Hint and abstract split between reasoning and causal inference topics.
nodes.niche_reason: Counterfactual reasoning elicitation in LLMs is specialised but established.

nodes.title: Co$^{\mathbf{3}}$Gesture: Towards Coherent Concurrent Co-speech 3D Gesture Generation with Interactive Diffusion
nodes.tldr: Co3Gesture generates coherent concurrent co-speech gestures for two-person conversations with interactive diffusion, and introduces the 7M-frame GES-Inter dataset.
nodes.problem: Existing co-speech gesture methods ignore concurrent gesture modeling in two-person interactive conversations.
nodes.approach: Two cooperative diffusion branches conditioned on speaker audio with a Temporal-Interaction Module and mutual attention.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › Human Pose, Avatars & Faces
secondary_topics: Audio, Speech & Multimodal › Audio-Visual & Cross-modal Learning
nodes.niche_reason: Concurrent two-speaker gesture generation is a rare niche.

nodes.title: Learning to Solve Differential Equation Constrained Optimization Problems
nodes.tldr: A dual-network learning-based optimizer for differential-equation-constrained problems combining optimization proxies with neural ODEs, fully satisfying dynamics and up to 25x more precise.
nodes.problem: Solving differential equation constrained optimization is computationally expensive for real-time use.
nodes.approach: One network approximates controls, another solves the DEs, combining proxy optimization with neural differential equations.
nodes.primary_topic: Architectures & Training › Differentiable Optimization & Structured Layers
nodes.confidence_reason: Spans optimization proxies, neural DEs and scientific applications.
nodes.niche_reason: Learning to solve DE-constrained optimization is a rare niche.

nodes.title: LoRA Done RITE: Robust Invariant Transformation Equilibration for LoRA Optimization
nodes.tldr: LoRA-RITE is a transformation-invariant adaptive matrix preconditioner for LoRA optimization, improving LLM fine-tuning accuracy over Adam.
nodes.problem: LoRA optimizers are not invariant to scaling or rotation of the two factors, hurting learning.
nodes.approach: Adaptive matrix preconditioning achieving transformation invariance while staying computationally efficient.
nodes.niche_reason: Optimizer design specifically for LoRA is a specialised niche.

nodes.title: Do I Know This Entity? Knowledge Awareness and Hallucinations in Language Models
nodes.tldr: Uses sparse autoencoders to find directions for whether a model recognizes an entity, which causally control refusal and hallucination in language models.
nodes.problem: Why language models hallucinate about unknown entities, and what mechanisms decide refusal.
nodes.approach: Sparse autoencoder feature discovery plus causal steering and attention-head analysis.
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › Knowledge Editing & Factuality
secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › Language Model Interpretability
nodes.niche_reason: Hallucination and SAE interpretability is a popular mainstream topic.

nodes.title: Self-Improvement in Language Models: The Sharpening Mechanism
nodes.tldr: Formalizes LLM self-improvement as sharpening; SFT is minimax optimal given coverage, while RLHF-style online exploration removes that coverage need.
nodes.problem: Whether LLM self-improvement can create capabilities beyond what the base model already contains.
nodes.approach: Statistical sharpening framework analyzing SFT-based and RLHF-based self-improvement with sample access to a base policy.
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › Alignment & Preference Optimization
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Learning Theory Lower Bounds & Complexity
nodes.niche_reason: Statistical theory of LLM self-improvement is specialised

nodes.title: Perm: A Parametric Representation for Multi-Style 3D Hair Modeling
nodes.tldr: Learned parametric 3D hair representation that separates global structure from curl patterns using PCA strands, enabling hair editing and reconstruction.
nodes.problem: Hair models entangle global hair structure with local curl patterns, limiting control.
nodes.approach: PCA-based strand representation in frequency domain, with guide and residual textures.
secondary_topics: Computer Vision › Human Pose, Avatars & Faces
nodes.confidence_reason: Hair modeling could sit under avatars or 3D generation.
nodes.niche_reason: Parametric hair modeling is a rare graphics-ML niche.

nodes.title: Knowing Your Target: Target-Aware Transformer Makes Better Spatio-Temporal Video Grounding
nodes.tldr: Generates target-aware object queries for spatio-temporal video grounding from the video-text pair, instead of zero-initialized queries, improving localization.
nodes.problem: Zero-initialized object queries lack target cues and struggle with distractors and occlusion.
nodes.approach: Text-guided temporal sampling then attribute-aware spatial activation to initialize queries, usable as a plug-in.
nodes.niche_reason: Video grounding with transformer queries is established

nodes.title: Learning-Augmented Frequent Directions
nodes.tldr: Learning-augmented Misra-Gries for frequency estimation and learning-augmented Frequent Directions for matrix streaming, using predictions to improve error with simple deterministic algorithms.
nodes.problem: Improving streaming frequency estimation and matrix sketching using learned predictions.
nodes.approach: Learned heavy-hitter predictions integrated into Misra-Gries and Frequent Directions with theoretical analysis.
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Learning Theory Lower Bounds & Complexity
nodes.niche_reason: Algorithms with predictions for streaming is a rare niche.

nodes.title: LARP: Tokenizing Videos with a Learned Autoregressive Generative Prior
nodes.tldr: LARP tokenizes videos with learned holistic queries and an AR prior, giving semantic discrete tokens that improve autoregressive video generation.
nodes.problem: Patchwise video tokenizers capture local detail and are poorly aligned with autoregressive generation.
nodes.approach: Holistic learned queries plus a lightweight training-time AR transformer prior over discrete tokens.
nodes.confidence_reason: Tokenizer serves autoregressive video generation; several generation topics fit
nodes.niche_reason: Video tokenizers for AR generation are a fairly active area

nodes.title: Topological Schrödinger Bridge Matching
nodes.tldr: Defines the Topological Schrodinger Bridge problem for matching signal distributions on graphs and simplicial complexes using topological heat diffusion, with closed-form Gaussian solutions.
nodes.problem: Schrodinger bridge methods do not apply to signals on topological domains like graphs.
nodes.approach: Topology-aware linear stochastic reference dynamics with closed-form Gaussian solution and a matching algorithm.
nodes.niche_reason: Schrodinger bridges on simplicial/topological domains are very rare.

nodes.title: Dynamic Multimodal Evaluation with Flexible Complexity by Vision-Language Bootstrapping
nodes.tldr: Dynamically generates new visual question-answering samples via multimodal bootstrapping to evaluate LVLMs with less contamination and flexible complexity.
nodes.problem: Static multimodal benchmarks overlap pretraining data and have fixed complexity.
nodes.approach: Judge-filtered image and language bootstrapping composed into dynamic benchmark variants.
nodes.niche_reason: Dynamic benchmark generation for LVLMs is specialised but growing

nodes.title: EmbodiedSAM: Online Segment Any 3D Thing in Real Time
nodes.tldr: Uses SAM masks lifted to 3D-aware queries and a dual-level decoder to do online, real-time 3D instance segmentation on streaming RGB-D video.
nodes.problem: Embodied agents need online real-time fine-grained 3D instance segmentation, but 3D data is scarce and offline methods are slow.
nodes.approach: Geometry-aware query lifting of SAM 2D masks, dual-level query decoder, and efficient query-based cross-view mask matching.
nodes.niche_reason: Established 3D segmentation, specialised online real-time embodied setting.

nodes.title: DartControl: A Diffusion-Based Autoregressive Motion Model for Real-Time Text-Driven Motion Control
nodes.tldr: DART is a latent-diffusion autoregressive motion primitive model producing real-time, text-driven human motion with spatial control via noise optimization or RL.
nodes.problem: Real-time long text-driven human motion generation with spatial constraints.
nodes.approach: Autoregressive latent diffusion over motion primitives conditioned on history and text; control by latent noise optimization or RL.
secondary_topics: Computer Vision › Human Pose, Avatars & Faces
nodes.confidence_reason: Straddles diffusion, motion generation, and RL-based control.
nodes.niche_reason: Text-to-motion generation is established but specialised.

nodes.title: Competition Dynamics Shape Algorithmic Phases of In-Context Learning
nodes.tldr: Uses a synthetic mixture-of-Markov-chains task to show in-context learning comprises competing algorithms whose dominance shifts with context size and training.
nodes.problem: Unclear how general mechanism claims about in-context learning are across disparate synthetic setups.
nodes.approach: Unified synthetic Markov-chain mixture task; decompose behavior into four retrieval/inference unigram/bigram algorithms.
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › In-context Learning & Prompting
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Deep Learning Theory
nodes.niche_reason: ICL mechanism studies are established; mixture-of-algorithms framing is specialised.

nodes.title: Spider 2.0: Evaluating Language Models on Real-World Enterprise Text-to-SQL Workflows
nodes.tldr: Spider 2.0 is a benchmark of 632 real-world enterprise text-to-SQL workflow tasks needing metadata search, multiple dialects, and long contexts; the best code agent solves 21.3%.
nodes.problem: Existing text-to-SQL benchmarks fail to reflect complex enterprise database workflows.
nodes.approach: Build a benchmark of real enterprise SQL workflow problems on BigQuery, Snowflake and local databases, with agent baselines.
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › Code Generation & Software
secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › Agents & Tool Use
nodes.niche_reason: Text-to-SQL is specialised but established.

nodes.title: On Conformal Isometry of Grid Cells: Learning Distance-Preserving Position Embedding
nodes.tldr: Tests the conformal isometry hypothesis for grid cells: learning distance-preserving position embeddings with recurrent networks yields hexagonal firing patterns, which are theoretically maximally distance preserving.
nodes.problem: Explaining why grid cells show hexagonal periodic firing patterns.
nodes.approach: Learn conformally isometric position embeddings with an RNN and prove hexagonal flat torus is optimal.
nodes.niche_reason: Computational neuroscience of grid cells is very rare at ML venues.

nodes.title: Eagle: Exploring The Design Space for Multimodal LLMs with Mixture of Encoders
nodes.tldr: Systematically studies mixtures of vision encoders for multimodal LLMs, finds simple token concatenation works well, and adds Pre-Alignment to yield the Eagle model family.
nodes.problem: Design choices for mixing vision encoders in MLLMs lack systematic comparison.
nodes.approach: Ablation study of encoder mixtures and resolutions, with a pre-alignment stage bridging vision and language tokens.
nodes.niche_reason: MLLM design-space studies are a common direction.

nodes.title: MOS: Model Synergy for Test-Time Adaptation on LiDAR-Based 3D Object Detection
nodes.tldr: Online test-time adaptation for LiDAR 3D detectors that assembles diverse historical checkpoints, weighted by synergy scores, to handle dataset and corruption shifts.
nodes.problem: LiDAR detectors degrade under cross-dataset shifts and sensor or weather corruptions at deployment.
nodes.approach: Model bank of past checkpoints combined by synergy weights, with lowest-scoring checkpoints replaced over time.
nodes.primary_topic: Architectures & Training › Domain Adaptation & OOD Generalization
nodes.niche_reason: Test-time adaptation for LiDAR detection is specialised but established.

nodes.title: Learning Transformer-based World Models with Contrastive Predictive Coding
nodes.tldr: Transformer world model trained with action-conditioned contrastive predictive coding to predict longer horizons, improving Dreamer-style agent performance on Atari 100k.
nodes.problem: Transformer world models underuse their capacity with next-state prediction alone.
nodes.approach: Action-conditioned contrastive predictive coding for multi-step latent representations.
nodes.primary_topic: Reinforcement Learning › Model-Based RL & World Models
nodes.niche_reason: Transformer world models are an active, fairly common line.

nodes.title: LaMPlace: Learning to Optimize Cross-Stage Metrics in Macro Placement
nodes.tldr: Trains an offline predictor of post-placement timing metrics and uses it to generate a grid mask that guides macro placement toward final chip quality.
nodes.problem: Online placement optimizes intermediate surrogate metrics that do not reflect final chip timing.
nodes.approach: Offline-learned cross-stage metric predictor generating a per-grid mask for placement decisions.
nodes.confidence_reason: Chip-design application; systems vs other is a judgment call.
nodes.niche_reason: ML for chip macro placement is rare within ML venues

nodes.title: ReGenesis: LLMs can Grow into Reasoning Generalists via Self-Improvement
nodes.tldr: Self-synthesizes reasoning training data by moving from general guidelines to task structures to paths, improving out-of-domain reasoning.
nodes.problem: Self-synthesized reasoning paths from methods like STaR are too task-specific and fail to generalize OOD.
nodes.approach: Abstract-to-concrete pipeline converts general reasoning guidelines into task-specific guidelines, structures, then paths.
secondary_topics: Data, Benchmarks & Evaluation › Synthetic Data & Data Curation
nodes.niche_reason: self-improvement for reasoning is a common theme

nodes.title: PABBO: Preferential Amortized Black-Box Optimization
nodes.tldr: PABBO fully amortizes preferential Bayesian optimization, meta-learning a transformer neural process surrogate and acquisition function trained with RL, running several orders of magnitude faster.
nodes.problem: Preferential Bayesian optimization needs heavy approximate inference each step, too slow for interactive use.
nodes.approach: Transformer neural process meta-learned with reinforcement learning and auxiliary losses, replacing GP inference.
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Probabilistic & Bayesian Methods
nodes.niche_reason: Amortized preference optimization is specialised but established.

nodes.title: Can Large Language Models Understand Symbolic Graphics Programs?
nodes.tldr: Benchmarks whether LLMs can infer the visual semantics of symbolic graphics programs without a vision encoder, and shows symbolic instruction tuning improves that ability.
nodes.problem: Hard to test LLM spatial-semantic reasoning on tasks not seen during training.
nodes.approach: Procedurally generated benchmark over symbolic graphics programs plus symbolic instruction tuning.
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › LLM Evaluation & Benchmarks
secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › Code Generation & Software
nodes.niche_reason: Symbolic graphics programs as an LLM probe is a rare angle.

nodes.title: BigCodeBench: Benchmarking Code Generation with Diverse Function Calls and Complex Instructions
nodes.tldr: Benchmark of 1,140 tasks requiring LLMs to compose function calls from 139 Python libraries; best models score up to 60%.
nodes.problem: Benchmarks test only short algorithmic tasks, not practical multi-library programming with complex instructions.
nodes.approach: Tasks with 5.6 test cases each, plus a short-instruction variant evaluated on 60 LLMs.
secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › Code Generation & Software
nodes.niche_reason: Code benchmarks with tool calls are a common evaluation direction.

nodes.title: Nesterov acceleration in benignly non-convex landscapes
nodes.tldr: Proves Nesterov-style accelerated gradient guarantees hold under benign non-convexity typical of overparameterized deep learning, including with stochastic noise.
nodes.problem: Momentum analysis covers only convex settings, yet deep learning loss landscapes are non-convex.
nodes.approach: Analysis of continuous and discrete NAG under geometric benign-non-convexity assumptions, including additive and multiplicative gradient noise.
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Deep Learning Theory
nodes.niche_reason: Acceleration theory is established; benign non-convex extension is specialised.

nodes.title: Latent Bayesian Optimization via Autoregressive Normalizing Flows
nodes.tldr: NF-BO performs latent Bayesian optimization with SeqFlow, an autoregressive normalizing flow giving one-to-one encoding that removes the reconstruction gap, improving molecule generation.
nodes.problem: Latent Bayesian optimization suffers value discrepancy from VAE reconstruction gaps between input and latent spaces.
nodes.approach: Autoregressive normalizing flow SeqFlow with left-inverse decoder and token-importance-based candidate sampling.
nodes.primary_topic: Learning Theory & Optimization › Probabilistic & Bayesian Methods
secondary_topics: Generative Models › GANs, VAEs & Normalizing Flows
nodes.niche_reason: Latent Bayesian optimization with flows is a rare specialised area.

nodes.title: Min-K%++: Improved Baseline for Pre-Training Data Detection from Large Language Models
nodes.tldr: Detects whether text was in an LLM's pretraining data by testing if samples are local likelihood maxima, beating Min-K% on WikiMIA and MIMIR.
nodes.problem: Detecting pre-training data in LLMs matters for copyright and test contamination; existing heuristics lack foundation.
nodes.approach: Theory-motivated score that identifies training samples as local maxima of the discrete conditional distribution.
nodes.primary_topic: Trustworthy ML › Machine Unlearning & Privacy Attacks
secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › Pretraining, Scaling & Data
nodes.niche_reason: Membership inference for LLMs is a crowded direction.

nodes.title: Fine-tuning with Reserved Majority for Noise Reduction
nodes.tldr: NoRM reduces noise in LoRA fine-tuning by keeping the majority subspace via SVD and subspace similarity, improving instruction tuning, math and code tasks.
nodes.problem: LoRA injects noisy parameters that limit benefits of higher ranks.
nodes.approach: Decompose LoRA parameters with randomized SVD, keep the subspace most similar to base weights, discard redundancy.
secondary_topics: Architectures & Training › Efficient Training, Compression & Pruning
nodes.niche_reason: Yet another LoRA variant in a very crowded area.

nodes.title: Problem-Parameter-Free Federated Learning
nodes.tldr: Parameter-free federated learning algorithm for nonconvex problems that combines adaptive stepsize and momentum, achieving convergence without heterogeneity bounds or tuned learning rates.
nodes.problem: Federated learning performance depends on manually tuned stepsizes, hard under data heterogeneity.
nodes.approach: Adaptive stepsize plus momentum with theory for partial participation and heterogeneous clients.
nodes.niche_reason: Problem-parameter-free federated optimization is a specialized theory niche.

nodes.title: Sharpness-Aware Minimization Efficiently Selects Flatter Minima Late In Training
nodes.tldr: SAM selects flatter minima efficiently late in training; applying it only for a few final epochs matches full SAM, with a two-phase theoretical analysis.
nodes.problem: The implicit bias and training dynamics behind Sharpness-Aware Minimization are poorly understood.
nodes.approach: Empirical and theoretical analysis of late-phase SAM dynamics, extended to adversarial training.
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Deep Learning Theory
nodes.niche_reason: SAM and sharpness analysis is established but specialised.

nodes.title: Can LLMs Really Learn to Translate a Low-Resource Language from One Grammar Book?
nodes.tldr: Finds grammar-book translation gains for low-resource languages come mostly from parallel examples, not grammatical explanations, and fine-tuning a small model matches them.
nodes.problem: Unclear whether LLMs use grammar-book explanations or the parallel examples for low-resource translation.
nodes.approach: Ablations on Kalamang, Nepali and Guarani, plus fine-tuning and typological feature prompts for grammaticality tasks.
secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › In-context Learning & Prompting
nodes.niche_reason: Extremely low-resource translation from one book is a rare setting.

nodes.title: TopoLM: brain-like spatio-functional organization in a topographic language model
nodes.tldr: Adds a 2D spatial layout and smoothness loss to a transformer LM, producing clusters that match the brain's language-system organization.
nodes.problem: Unclear mechanism behind spatially clustered functional organization of the human language system.
nodes.approach: Transformer LM with explicit 2D unit layout trained with next-token loss plus spatial smoothness loss.
secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › Language Model Interpretability
nodes.niche_reason: Brain-inspired topographic language modelling is unusual

nodes.title: Recovering Manifold Structure Using Ollivier Ricci Curvature
nodes.tldr: Prunes spurious edges from nearest-neighbor graphs using Ollivier-Ricci curvature, removing shortcuts through ambient space and improving manifold learning and clustering.
nodes.problem: Nearest-neighbor graphs from noisy manifold data contain edges that shortcut through ambient space.
nodes.approach: Edge pruning by Ollivier-Ricci curvature combined with estimated metric distortion.

nodes.title: A Geometric Framework for Understanding Memorization in Generative Models
nodes.tldr: Proposes a manifold memorization hypothesis explaining generative model memorization via true and learned data manifold dimensionalities, yielding tools to detect memorized samples.
nodes.problem: Deep generative models can memorize and reproduce training data, raising privacy and legal risks.
nodes.approach: Manifold memorization hypothesis comparing the dimensionality of true and learned data manifolds.

nodes.niche_reason: Geometric theory of memorization is a specialised angle

nodes.title: Targeted Attack Improves Protection against Unauthorized Diffusion Customization
nodes.tldr: Improves protection of images against unauthorized diffusion customization by using targeted adversarial attacks, which poison diffusion models more effectively than untargeted ones.
nodes.problem: Existing untargeted protective perturbations are not effective enough against diffusion customization.

nodes.title: Dense Video Object Captioning from Disjoint Supervision
nodes.tldr: Introduces dense video object captioning, jointly detecting, tracking, and captioning objects, with a unified model trained on mixed disjoint task data.

nodes.title: DARE the Extreme: Revisiting Delta-Parameter Pruning For Fine-Tuned Models
nodes.tldr: Extends delta-parameter pruning to high pruning rates with a corrected rescaling factor and delta regularization, so fine-tuned models can be stored compactly.

nodes.title: Generating Freeform Endoskeletal Robots
nodes.tldr: Generates endoskeletal robots, soft bodies with internal rigid skeletons, by encoding their cells into a latent space searched with evolution and RL.

nodes.title: Harnessing Diversity for Important Data Selection in Pretraining Large Language Models
nodes.tldr: Selects pretraining data by balancing influence-based quality with cluster-level diversity, using an efficient Kronecker-accelerated influence estimate.

nodes.title: The Geometry of Categorical and Hierarchical Concepts in Large Language Models
nodes.tldr: Extends the linear representation hypothesis so features are vectors, showing categorical concepts form polytopes and hierarchy shapes representation geometry in LLMs.
nodes.problem: Many natural concepts lack contrasts, so the linear representation hypothesis cannot express them.
nodes.approach: Formalize features as vectors using a causal inner product, then validate on Gemma and LLaMA-3 with WordNet.

nodes.title: MotionAura: Generating High-Quality and Motion Consistent Videos using Discrete Diffusion
nodes.tldr: MotionAura generates temporally coherent text-to-video using vector-quantized discrete diffusion, with a 3D VQ autoencoder that improves video compression and motion consistency.
nodes.problem: Video data is spatio-temporally complex, making compression, generation and inpainting hard to keep consistent.

nodes.title: NetFormer: An interpretable model for recovering dynamical connectivity in neuronal population dynamics
nodes.tldr: Introduces NetFormer, an interpretable attention model that recovers time-varying, cell-type-specific connectivity from neuronal population recordings.
nodes.problem: Static connectivity methods ignore nonstationary plasticity and modulation in neural activity.
nodes.approach: Neuron activity tokens with query-key attention yielding state-dependent connectivity matrices.

nodes.title: AutoDAN-Turbo: A Lifelong Agent for Strategy Self-Exploration to Jailbreak LLMs
nodes.tldr: AutoDAN-Turbo is a lifelong agent that automatically discovers and stores jailbreak strategies from scratch for black-box red-teaming, achieving high attack success on GPT-4.

nodes.niche_reason: Jailbreak attack papers are numerous.

nodes.title: Linear SCM Identification in the Presence of Confounders and Gaussian Noise
nodes.tldr: Proves linear structural causal models with Gaussian noise and non-Gaussian confounders are uniquely identifiable given known structure, and finitely identifiable (at most n! models) otherwise.
nodes.problem: Identifiability of linear SCMs when only some confounders or noise terms are Gaussian.
nodes.approach: Analytical identifiability proofs under conditions on confounder count, non-Gaussianity, and known causal structure.

nodes.niche_reason: Causal identifiability theory is established but specialised.

nodes.title: RB-Modulation: Training-Free Stylization using Reference-Based Modulation
nodes.tldr: Training-free diffusion stylization that uses stochastic optimal control with a terminal style cost to separate style from content and compose them without adapters.
nodes.problem: Training-free style transfer struggles with style extraction, content leakage and style-content composition.

nodes.title: One-Prompt-One-Story: Free-Lunch Consistent Text-to-Image Generation Using a Single Prompt
nodes.tldr: Training-free method that concatenates story prompts into one input and reweights attention to keep character identity consistent across diffusion images.

nodes.title: Subgraph Federated Learning for Local Generalization
nodes.tldr: FedLoG tackles local overfitting in subgraph federated learning with global synthetic data condensed from class representations, improving generalization to unseen nodes.
nodes.problem: Subgraph federated learning overfits local distributions and generalizes poorly to new nodes with shifted labels.

nodes.title: Comparing noisy neural population dynamics using optimal transport distances
nodes.tldr: Shows existing neural geometry metrics fail on noisy dynamic responses and proposes an optimal transport distance between Gaussian processes to compare them.

nodes.title: Self-play with Execution Feedback: Improving Instruction-following Capabilities of Large Language Models
nodes.tldr: AutoIF auto-generates instruction-following training data by having LLMs write instructions, verification code, and unit tests, then uses execution feedback for SFT and RLHF self-alignment.

nodes.title: BodyGen: Advancing Towards Efficient Embodiment Co-Design
nodes.tldr: Accelerates robot embodiment co-design with topology-aware self-attention for morphology and temporal credit assignment to balance design and control rewards.

nodes.title: Knowledge Distillation with Multi-granularity Mixture of Priors for Image Super-Resolution
nodes.tldr: Transfers knowledge from super-resolution teachers to students at feature and block levels via prior mixers, across architectures.
nodes.problem: Existing super-resolution distillation methods are tied to specific teacher-student architecture pairs.

nodes.title: Online Preference Alignment for Language Models via Count-based Exploration
nodes.tldr: Proposes COPO, an online RLHF method that turns a UCB exploration bonus into a count-based coin-flip pseudo-count to explore new prompt-response pairs.
nodes.problem: Fixed preference datasets limit coverage, so LLM alignment needs exploration beyond the initial data.

nodes.title: Feedback Favors the Generalization of Neural ODEs
nodes.tldr: Adds a feedback loop correcting learned neural ODE latent dynamics, improving generalization to unseen scenarios in trajectory prediction and quadrotor control.
nodes.problem: Neural ODEs generalize poorly in continuous-time prediction when latent dynamics vary across scenarios.

nodes.niche_reason: Feedback-corrected neural ODEs are an unusual control-inspired direction.

nodes.title: Wasserstein Distances, Neuronal Entanglement, and Sparsity
nodes.tldr: Measures neuron entanglement via Wasserstein distance to a Gaussian, finds a few critical Wasserstein neurons, and uses mixtures of sparse experts to disentangle them.

nodes.title: TAID: Temporally Adaptive Interpolated Distillation for Efficient Knowledge Transfer in Language Models
nodes.tldr: TAID distills large language models into small ones by adaptively interpolating from student to teacher distribution over training, mitigating capacity gap and mode collapse.
nodes.problem: Teacher-student gaps cause capacity gap, mode averaging and mode collapse in LM distillation.
nodes.approach: Temporally adaptive interpolated intermediate distribution gradually moving from student toward teacher distribution.

nodes.title: X-ALMA: Plug & Play Modules and Adaptive Rejection for Quality Translation at Scale

nodes.title: Credal Wrapper of Model Averaging for Uncertainty Estimation in Classification
nodes.tldr: Credal wrapper builds probability intervals from BNN or deep ensemble predictions into a credal set, improving uncertainty estimation and OOD detection in classification.

nodes.approach: Extract per-class upper and lower probability bounds, forming credal sets and an intersection probability prediction.

nodes.title: Decentralized Sporadic Federated Learning: A Unified Algorithmic Framework with Convergence Guarantees
nodes.tldr: DSpodFL unifies decentralized federated learning with sporadic local updates and model exchanges modeled as random indicators, with convergence guarantees for convex and non-convex settings.

nodes.title: Exact Certification of (Graph) Neural Networks Against Label Poisoning

nodes.title: Beyond Next Token Prediction: Patch-Level Training for Large Language Models
nodes.tldr: Patch-level training aggregates multiple tokens into patches for next-patch prediction before token-level training, halving LLM training cost without hurting performance.

nodes.title: BirdSet: A Large-Scale Dataset for Audio Classification in Avian Bioacoustics

nodes.title: Data Selection via Optimal Control for Language Models

nodes.primary_topic: Learning Theory & Optimization › Optimal Transport & Divergences
nodes.niche_reason: Spherical sliced transport embeddings are a rare geometric niche

nodes.title: Vision Language Models are In-Context Value Learners
nodes.tldr: GVL estimates task progress zero-shot by asking a VLM to order shuffled video frames, yielding value predictions for robot tasks without training.
nodes.problem: Learning temporal value functions across tasks needs diverse data and methods that generalize.
nodes.approach: Frame-ordering prompts let VLMs predict progress values in context, without robot-specific finetuning.
nodes.primary_topic: Reinforcement Learning › Reward Learning, Inverse RL & Preferences
secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › In-context Learning & Prompting
nodes.confidence_reason: Value estimation topic ambiguous between reward learning and VLMs
nodes.niche_reason: VLM-based zero-shot value estimation for robots is specialised

nodes.title: DRoP: Distributionally Robust Data Pruning
nodes.tldr: Shows existing data pruning can produce biased classifiers and proposes DRoP, class-wise pruning ratios with random within-class pruning, to improve worst-class accuracy.
nodes.problem: Data pruning can hurt classification fairness by degrading worst-class performance.
nodes.approach: Distributionally robust class-level pruning ratios plus random pruning within each class.
nodes.primary_topic: Data, Benchmarks & Evaluation › Synthetic Data & Data Curation
nodes.niche_reason: Data pruning is a common topic

nodes.title: A Computational Framework for Modeling Emergence of Color Vision in the Human Brain
nodes.tldr: Simulates eye and cortex to show that self-supervised cortical learning on optic nerve signals yields color vision with the correct dimensionality.
nodes.problem: How the brain infers color dimensionality from optic nerve signals without knowing eye encoding.
nodes.approach: Eye simulator generating optic nerve signals plus a bio-plausible model predicting signal fluctuations under eye motion.
nodes.niche_reason: Simulated emergence of color vision is very rare in ML

nodes.title: Composing Unbalanced Flows for Flexible Docking and Relaxation
nodes.tldr: Unbalanced Flow Matching generalizes flow matching to trade sample efficiency for transport accuracy, enabling flexible molecular docking with energetically favorable poses.
nodes.problem: Diffusion docking ignores protein flexibility and often produces nonphysical poses.
nodes.approach: Unbalanced transport between distributions, applied to flexible docking and structure relaxation.
nodes.niche_reason: Established but specialised: unbalanced flows for docking.

nodes.title: Bilinear MLPs enable weight-based mechanistic interpretability
nodes.tldr: Analyzes bilinear MLPs as third-order tensors, using eigendecomposition of weights to find interpretable low-rank structure and circuits without needing input data.
nodes.problem: Understanding how MLP weights construct features is hard because element-wise nonlinearities obscure computation.
nodes.approach: Express bilinear layers as tensors and eigendecompose weights for weight-based interpretability.
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › Language Model Interpretability
nodes.niche_reason: Weight-based interpretability with bilinear layers is a rare direction.

nodes.title: Learning stochastic dynamics from snapshots through regularized unbalanced optimal transport
nodes.tldr: Learns continuous unbalanced stochastic dynamics from sparse snapshots by deep regularized unbalanced optimal transport, inferring growth and transitions without prior growth models.
nodes.problem: Reconstructing continuous dynamics from sparse snapshots needs growth and death knowledge that is often unavailable.
nodes.approach: Deep solver for regularized unbalanced optimal transport, linked to Schrodinger bridges, learning growth directly from data.
nodes.primary_topic: Learning Theory & Optimization › Optimal Transport & Divergences
nodes.niche_reason: Unbalanced transport for snapshot dynamics is a rare cross-disciplinary angle.

nodes.title: LoRA-Pro: Are Low-Rank Adapters Properly Optimized?
nodes.tldr: Shows LoRA optimization is equivalent to full fine-tuning with a low-rank gradient, and adjusts LoRA matrix gradients to close the gap with full fine-tuning.
nodes.problem: LoRA still underperforms full fine-tuning because its low-rank updates are poorly optimized.
nodes.approach: Shows LoRA equals full fine-tuning with a low-rank gradient, then adjusts LoRA matrix gradients optimally.
nodes.niche_reason: Yet another LoRA variant; very crowded mainstream PEFT direction

nodes.title: Representative Guidance: Diffusion Model Sampling with Coherence
nodes.tldr: Representative Guidance steers diffusion sampling toward a coherent self-supervised representation target, improving on classifier guidance and complementing classifier-free guidance.
nodes.problem: Diffusion sampling is incoherent across timesteps and classifier guidance lacks meaningful representative information.
nodes.approach: Use pretrained self-supervised representations as a coherent target to guide sampling.
nodes.niche_reason: Diffusion guidance variants are a crowded area.

nodes.title: ImpScore: A Learnable Metric For Quantifying The Implicitness Level of Sentences
nodes.tldr: Defines implicitness as the divergence between semantic and pragmatic meaning, and trains a reference-free regression metric correlating with human judgments.
nodes.problem: No reference-free metric exists for measuring how implicit a sentence's language is.
nodes.approach: Interpretable regression trained with pairwise contrastive learning on implicit-explicit sentence pairs.
nodes.confidence_reason: Pragmatics metric fits linguistics or evaluation methodology
nodes.niche_reason: Implicitness metric for pragmatics is a rare, linguistics-driven niche

nodes.title: Unlocking the Power of Function Vectors for Characterizing and Mitigating Catastrophic Forgetting in Continual Instruction Tuning
nodes.tldr: Explains catastrophic forgetting in LLMs via function vectors, attributing it to biased function activation, and proposes an FV-stabilizing regularizer for continual instruction tuning.
nodes.problem: LLMs forget earlier tasks during continual instruction tuning, and forgetting depends on tasks and model.
nodes.approach: Analyze function vectors as model-dependent forgetting indicators; regularize them during training.
secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › Language Model Interpretability
nodes.niche_reason: catastrophic forgetting in LLMs is a crowded topic

nodes.title: Improving the Sparse Structure Learning of Spiking Neural Networks from the View of Compression Efficiency
nodes.tldr: A two-stage dynamic sparse training method for deep spiking neural networks using the PQ compressibility index to adaptively set rewiring ratios for pruning and regrowth.
nodes.problem: Deep SNNs are over-parameterized and static pruning ratios cause under- or over-pruning.
nodes.approach: Evaluate subnetwork compressibility with the PQ index, then adaptively rewire synapses by pruning and regrowth.
nodes.primary_topic: Architectures & Training › Efficient Training, Compression & Pruning
nodes.niche_reason: Sparse SNN structure learning is a rare niche.

nodes.title: Uncovering Gaps in How Humans and LLMs Interpret Subjective Language
nodes.tldr: Detects LLM misalignment by building a model-specific thesaurus of subjective phrases and finding disagreements with a human reference, exposing surprising failure modes.
nodes.problem: LLMs may read subjective instructions differently than humans intend, and such failures are hard to find.
nodes.approach: Compare an LLM-derived phrase-similarity thesaurus against a human reference to surface disagreements.
nodes.primary_topic: Trustworthy ML › AI Safety & Alignment Research
secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › LLM Evaluation & Benchmarks
nodes.niche_reason: Automated thesaurus-based misalignment detection is a niche evaluation approach.

nodes.title: On the Role of Attention Heads in Large Language Model Safety
nodes.tldr: Introduces Ships and Sahara to attribute safety to individual attention heads; ablating one head makes an aligned model answer 16x more harmful queries.
nodes.problem: Understanding how multi-head attention contributes to LLM safety guardrails.
nodes.approach: Head-level importance score and dataset-level attribution algorithm with ablation of critical safety heads.
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › LLM Safety & Jailbreaks
secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › Language Model Interpretability
nodes.niche_reason: Mechanistic safety analysis is established but specialised.

nodes.title: Mixture-of-Agents Enhances Large Language Model Capabilities
nodes.tldr: Layers multiple LLM agents so each layer refines answers using the previous layer's outputs, letting open-source models beat GPT-4 Omni on benchmarks.
nodes.problem: Harnessing the collective strengths of many LLMs is an open direction; single models are limited.
nodes.approach: Layered Mixture-of-Agents where each LLM refines its answer using all outputs from the previous layer.
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › Agents & Tool Use
secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › Efficient LLM Inference & Architectures
nodes.niche_reason: Multi-LLM collaboration is a crowded direction

nodes.title: Bayesian Experimental Design Via Contrastive Diffusions
nodes.tldr: Makes Bayesian optimal experimental design scalable by optimizing the expected information gain with diffusion-based sampling of a pooled posterior, without lower-bound approximations.
nodes.problem: Intractable, high-dimensional expected information gain maximization in Bayesian experimental design.
nodes.approach: Pooled posterior sampled by diffusion models with bi-level joint sampling-optimization loop.
nodes.primary_topic: Learning Theory & Optimization › Probabilistic & Bayesian Methods
nodes.niche_reason: Diffusion-based Bayesian experimental design is a rare niche.

nodes.title: Diffusion Bridge AutoEncoders for Unsupervised Representation Learning
nodes.tldr: Diffusion Bridge AutoEncoders make the diffusion endpoint a feed-forward function of a latent z, removing the information split and improving unsupervised representations.
nodes.problem: Diffusion autoencoders split information between an expensive diffusion endpoint and the latent code.
nodes.approach: Latent-dependent endpoint inference via a feed-forward bridge with a combined reconstruction and generative objective.
nodes.niche_reason: Established but specialised: diffusion-based autoencoders.

nodes.title: Probabilistic Neural Pruning via Sparsity Evolutionary Fokker-Planck-Kolmogorov Equation
nodes.tldr: Frames gradual neural pruning as evolution of a mask distribution and derives a Fokker-Planck-Kolmogorov equation to approximate the optimal sparsity-evolving mask distribution.
nodes.problem: Gradually sparsifying dense networks to a target sparsity with minimal performance drop.
nodes.approach: Probabilistic mask-distribution formulation with a sparsity-evolutionary Fokker-Planck-Kolmogorov equation approximation.
nodes.primary_topic: Architectures & Training › Efficient Training, Compression & Pruning
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Probabilistic & Bayesian Methods
nodes.niche_reason: Thermodynamic/PDE view of pruning is unusual.

nodes.title: MamKO: Mamba-based Koopman operator for modeling and predictive control
nodes.tldr: MamKO generates time-varying Koopman operators from online data using a Mamba-style structure, enabling model predictive control of nonlinear systems.
nodes.problem: Fixed Koopman operators cannot capture time-varying nonlinear system dynamics.
nodes.approach: Mamba-inspired online Koopman operator generation coupled with model predictive control.
nodes.primary_topic: Architectures & Training › State-Space Models & Linear Attention
nodes.confidence_reason: Control application with state-space and Mamba modeling; could fit two topics
nodes.niche_reason: Koopman-based control with Mamba operators is a rare intersection.

nodes.title: Rethinking and Improving Autoformalization: Towards a Faithful Metric and a Dependency Retrieval-based Approach
nodes.tldr: Proposes BEq, a neuro-symbolic metric for equivalence of formal statements, and RAutoformalizer, which retrieves dependent definitions and theorems to reduce hallucination in autoformalization.
nodes.problem: Autoformalization lacks faithful automated evaluation and suffers hallucinated formal definitions from missing context.
nodes.approach: Bidirectional extended definitional equivalence metric plus dependency retrieval-augmented autoformalizer.
secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › Code Generation & Software
nodes.niche_reason: Statement autoformalization and formal-equivalence metrics are a rare niche.

nodes.title: Correcting the Mythos of KL-Regularization: Direct Alignment without Overoptimization via Chi-Squared Preference Optimization
nodes.tldr: chiPO modifies DPO's log link to a chi-squared divergence regularizer, implementing pessimism to provably reduce overoptimization in offline LLM alignment.
nodes.problem: Offline alignment overoptimizes against a reward model, and KL regularization is too weak to prevent it.
nodes.approach: One-line change to DPO's link function with chi-squared regularization and single-policy concentrability.
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › Alignment & Preference Optimization
nodes.niche_reason: DPO variants are crowded; the chi-squared link is a distinct twist.

nodes.title: MixEval-X: Any-to-any Evaluations from Real-world Data Mixture
nodes.tldr: MixEval-X is an any-to-any benchmark built from real-world data mixtures whose model rankings correlate up to 0.98 with crowd-sourced real-world evaluations.
nodes.problem: Multimodal evaluations use inconsistent standards and suffer query, grading and generalization biases.
nodes.approach: Benchmark mixture and adaptation-rectification pipelines reconstruct real-world task distributions across modalities.
nodes.niche_reason: Multimodal benchmarks are a crowded, active area.

nodes.title: Cross-Entropy Is All You Need To Invert the Data Generating Process
nodes.tldr: Proves that cross-entropy classifiers recover ground-truth generative factors up to a linear transformation under a stated data-generating model, explaining linear representations.
nodes.problem: Why supervised cross-entropy models learn linearly interpretable factors of variation is unexplained.
nodes.approach: Extend nonlinear ICA identifiability from instance discrimination to supervised cross-entropy classification.
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Deep Learning Theory
nodes.niche_reason: Identifiability theory for supervised representations is specialised but active

nodes.title: Understanding Factual Recall in Transformers via Associative Memories
nodes.tldr: Proves associative memories store facts linearly in parameters, and that one-layer transformers reach optimal factual recall by trading off attention versus MLP storage.
nodes.problem: How shallow transformers achieve near-optimal factual storage capacity is not theoretically understood.
nodes.approach: Capacity proofs for associative memories, a synthetic recall task, and gradient flow analysis of linear attention.
nodes.primary_topic: Learning Theory & Optimization › Deep Learning Theory
secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › Knowledge Editing & Factuality
nodes.niche_reason: Theory of memorization in transformers is specialised but active.

nodes.title: Modeling Complex System Dynamics with Flow Matching Across Time and Conditions
nodes.tldr: Multi-Marginal Flow Matching builds spline-interpolated flows across time points and conditions with classifier-free guidance to impute missing snapshots in dynamics such as single-cell perturbation data.
nodes.problem: Modeling system dynamics from snapshots when some time and condition combinations are missing.
nodes.approach: Spline-based interpolation across time and conditions regressed with classifier-free guided flow matching.
secondary_topics: Architectures & Training › Time Series & Sequential Data
nodes.niche_reason: Snapshot dynamics modeling with conditions is a rare angle.

nodes.title: Computationally Efficient RL under Linear Bellman Completeness for Deterministic Dynamics
nodes.tldr: First computationally efficient algorithm for linear Bellman complete RL with deterministic dynamics, using noise injected only in the null space of training data for optimism.
nodes.problem: Whether computationally efficient algorithms exist for statistically tractable linear Bellman complete RL.
nodes.approach: Optimistic value iteration with randomized least squares, noise confined to null space of data.
nodes.niche_reason: Narrow RL theory question with few close neighbours.

nodes.title: Near-Optimal Online Learning for Multi-Agent Submodular Coordination: Tight Approximation and Communication Efficiency
nodes.tldr: MA-OSMA and projection-free MA-OSEA give near-optimal online multi-agent submodular maximization with tighter approximation and sparse communication graphs, tested on multi-target tracking.
nodes.problem: Existing multi-agent online submodular algorithms have weak approximation guarantees and need fully connected communication.
nodes.approach: Multi-linear extension with consensus, surrogate gradients, and a projection-free KL-based variant with regret bounds.
nodes.primary_topic: Learning Theory & Optimization › Online Learning & Regret
nodes.niche_reason: Distributed online submodular optimization is a rare theoretical niche.

nodes.title: Second-Order Min-Max Optimization with Lazy Hessians
nodes.tldr: Reuses Hessians across iterations for second-order convex-concave minimax optimization, cutting total computational complexity by a factor of d^(1/3) over prior methods.
nodes.problem: Prior second-order minimax methods have high total computational complexity for finding epsilon-saddle points.
nodes.approach: Lazy Hessian updates that reuse Hessians across iterations, extended to strongly-convex-strongly-concave problems.
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Learning Theory Lower Bounds & Complexity
nodes.niche_reason: Second-order minimax optimization is a specialised but established theory area.

nodes.title: Adaptive Batch Size for Privately Finding Second-Order Stationary Points
nodes.tldr: Gives an adaptive batch size SpiderBoost-based algorithm with a binary tree mechanism for privately finding second-order stationary points, matching the best first-order private rate.
nodes.problem: Whether privately finding second-order stationary points is harder than first-order ones.
nodes.approach: SpiderBoost with adaptive batch sizes and binary tree mechanism for private saddle escape.
nodes.niche_reason: Private non-convex optimization theory is established but specialised.

nodes.title: AI as Humanity’s Salieri: Quantifying Linguistic Creativity of Language Models via Systematic Attribution of Machine Text against Web Text
nodes.tldr: Quantifies linguistic creativity by reconstructing a text from web snippets via fast dynamic-programming search, and uses it to detect machine text.
nodes.problem: Whether LLM creativity is genuine or inherited from human web text is unclear.
nodes.approach: DJ Search: dynamic programming for verbatim and near-verbatim matches of snippets against the web.
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › LLM Evaluation & Benchmarks
nodes.confidence_reason: Creativity metric and machine-text detection both central; topic is a judgment call.
nodes.niche_reason: Web-reconstruction creativity metric is an unusual evaluation angle.

nodes.title: Can Neural Networks Achieve Optimal Computational-statistical Tradeoff? An Analysis on Single-Index Model
nodes.tldr: Shows gradient-trained two-layer networks match the optimal sample complexity for learning Gaussian single-index models, including sparse targets, up to log factors.
nodes.problem: Whether gradient-trained networks achieve the statistical-computational tradeoff for single-index models is open.
nodes.approach: Unified polynomial-time gradient algorithm using label transformation, landscape smoothing and weight perturbation.
nodes.primary_topic: Learning Theory & Optimization › Learning Theory Lower Bounds & Complexity
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Deep Learning Theory
nodes.niche_reason: single-index model theory is specialised but established

nodes.title: Recognize Any Surgical Object: Unleashing the Power of Weakly-Supervised Data
nodes.tldr: Presents RASO, an open-set surgical object recognition foundation model trained on tags automatically mined from surgical lecture videos, reducing manual annotation effort.
nodes.problem: Surgical recognition models need costly manual annotation, limiting coverage of surgical procedures and objects.
nodes.approach: Weakly-supervised pipeline producing 3.6M tag annotations over 2,066 surgical tags from 2,200 procedures.
nodes.niche_reason: Open-set surgical object recognition is a rare, specialised niche

nodes.title: SePer: Measure Retrieval Utility Through The Lens Of Semantic Perplexity Reduction
nodes.tldr: SePer measures retrieval utility in RAG as reduction in LLM semantic perplexity after retrieval, aligning with human preferences.
nodes.problem: Evaluating retrieval's distinct utility within RAG
nodes.approach: Semantic perplexity metric capturing information gain from retrieved content
secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › LLM Evaluation & Benchmarks
nodes.niche_reason: RAG evaluation metrics are specialised but active.

nodes.title: PerturboLLaVA: Reducing Multimodal Hallucinations with Perturbative Visual Training
nodes.tldr: Reduces multimodal LLM hallucinations in dense captions by training with adversarially perturbed text to cut language-prior reliance, and introduces the graph-based HalFscore metric.
nodes.problem: Multimodal LLMs hallucinate in dense captioning because they over-rely on language priors, and fine-grained metrics are lacking.
nodes.approach: Perturbative visual training with adversarially perturbed text, plus HalFscore, a language-graph concept-level caption metric.
nodes.niche_reason: MLLM hallucination mitigation is a crowded area.

nodes.title: Rethinking the generalization of drug target affinity prediction algorithms via similarity aware evaluation
nodes.tldr: Shows random-split evaluation of drug-target affinity models is misleading and proposes similarity-aware optimized data splitting to match desired test distributions.
nodes.problem: Standard random test splits are dominated by training-similar samples, overstating real-world generalization.
nodes.approach: Optimization-based split methodology solved with gradient descent to fit target similarity distributions.
nodes.niche_reason: Evaluation methodology for affinity prediction is a rare niche.

nodes.title: AnalogGenie: A Generative Engine for Automatic Discovery of Analog Circuit Topologies
nodes.tldr: AnalogGenie generates analog circuit topologies with a sequence-based graph representation trained on a new comprehensive dataset, discovering topologies beyond prior designs.
nodes.problem: Analog IC design lacks a comprehensive dataset and a representation for generative modeling.
nodes.approach: Sequence-based graph representation of circuits with a generative model trained on a foundational topology dataset.
nodes.confidence_reason: No analog circuit topic exists; placement is a judgment call.
nodes.niche_reason: Analog circuit topology generation is very rare in ML venues.

nodes.title: Training on the Test Task Confounds Evaluation and Emergence
nodes.tldr: Training on the test task confounds LLM comparisons and emergence claims; fine-tuning all models on identical task-relevant data before evaluation corrects for it.
nodes.problem: Benchmark comparisons and emergence claims are confounded by differing task-relevant pretraining data across models.
nodes.approach: Adjust evaluations by fine-tuning each compared model on identical task-relevant data before benchmarking.
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › LLM Evaluation & Benchmarks
secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › Pretraining, Scaling & Data
nodes.niche_reason: Evaluation methodology critique, established but specialised.

nodes.title: SimBa: Simplicity Bias for Scaling Up Parameters in Deep Reinforcement Learning
nodes.tldr: SimBa is a deep RL architecture using observation normalization, residual blocks, and layer norm to inject simplicity bias, enabling parameter scaling with better sample efficiency.
nodes.problem: Scaling network parameters in deep RL is under-explored and prone to overfitting.
nodes.approach: Architecture with running-statistic input normalization, residual linear pathway, and layer normalization to bias toward simple solutions.
nodes.primary_topic: Reinforcement Learning › Online & Deep RL Algorithms
nodes.niche_reason: Architecture scaling in RL is established but less crowded than algorithms.

nodes.title: Multimodality Helps Few-shot 3D Point Cloud Semantic Segmentation
nodes.tldr: MM-FSS leverages text labels and 2D images to improve few-shot 3D point cloud segmentation via multimodal correlation and semantic fusion plus test-time calibration.
nodes.problem: Few-shot point cloud segmentation methods ignore available multimodal information.
nodes.approach: Shared backbone with multimodal correlation and semantic fusion modules and test-time cross-modal calibration.
