nodes.title: Layer Swapping for Zero-Shot Cross-Lingual Transfer in Large Language Models
nodes.tldr: Swaps top and bottom transformer layers of an English math expert with those of a target-language expert to transfer math reasoning across languages without in-language math data.
nodes.problem: Fine-tuning LLMs for math in non-English languages is hard because task-specific data is scarce.
nodes.approach: Merge separately fine-tuned math and language experts by replacing top and bottom layers, guided by parameter-change analysis.
nodes.niche_reason: Model merging for cross-lingual transfer is specialised.

nodes.title: When is Task Vector Provably Effective for Model Editing? A Generalization Analysis of Nonlinear Transformers
nodes.tldr: First theoretical generalization guarantees for task vector arithmetic on nonlinear transformers, covering task addition, negation for unlearning, and coefficient choice for out-of-domain generalization.
nodes.problem: Why task vectors enable multi-task learning, forgetting, and OOD generalization is theoretically poorly understood.
nodes.approach: Generalization analysis of nonlinear transformers on binary classification tasks with discriminative patterns, validated on Phi-1.5 unlearning.
nodes.primary_topic: Learning Theory & Optimization › Deep Learning Theory
secondary_topics: Trustworthy ML › Machine Unlearning & Privacy Attacks
nodes.niche_reason: Theory of task arithmetic on transformers is a rare focus.

nodes.title: Decomposition Polyhedra of Piecewise Linear Functions
nodes.tldr: Characterizes decompositions of continuous piecewise linear functions into differences of convex CPWL functions as a polyhedron, identifying minimal and irreducible ones with ties to submodularity.
nodes.problem: Finding decompositions of CPWL functions into convex differences with minimal linear pieces is difficult.
nodes.approach: Fix a polyhedral complex and show decompositions form a polyhedron whose vertices are minimal solutions.
nodes.primary_topic: Learning Theory & Optimization › Deep Learning Theory
nodes.niche_reason: Polyhedral geometry of CPWL decompositions is very rare.

nodes.title: SVDQuant: Absorbing Outliers by Low-Rank Component for 4-Bit Diffusion Models
nodes.tldr: Quantizes diffusion model weights and activations to 4 bits by absorbing outliers into a low-rank branch, with a fused inference engine for real speedups.
nodes.problem: 4-bit quantization of diffusion models fails because both weights and activations are highly sensitive to outliers.
nodes.approach: Shift activation outliers into weights, absorb them with an SVD low-rank branch, and fuse kernels in Nunchaku.
nodes.primary_topic: Architectures & Training › Efficient Training, Compression & Pruning
nodes.niche_reason: Quantization of diffusion models is a common, active direction.

nodes.title: CyberHost: A One-stage Diffusion Framework for Audio-driven Talking Body Generation
nodes.tldr: One-stage diffusion framework for audio-driven talking body video generation, using a region attention module and human-prior conditions to improve hands, identity and motion.
nodes.problem: Audio-driven half-body animation suffers from poor hands, identity inconsistency and unnatural motion.
nodes.approach: Diffusion model with Region Attention Module and human structural prior conditions for zero-shot generation.
secondary_topics: Computer Vision › Human Pose, Avatars & Faces
nodes.niche_reason: Human animation diffusion is a crowded area.

nodes.title: DEPT: Decoupled Embeddings for Pre-training Language Models
nodes.tldr: Decouples token embeddings from the transformer body and trains across heterogeneous data sources, enabling vocabulary-agnostic federated pre-training with lower communication.
nodes.problem: Pretraining on heterogeneous multilingual corpora causes interference and high communication costs.
nodes.approach: Per-source embedding matrices with a shared transformer body trained over multiple data sources.
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › Pretraining, Scaling & Data
nodes.niche_reason: Decoupled embeddings for federated multilingual pretraining is specialised

nodes.title: Test-time Alignment of Diffusion Models without Reward Over-optimization
nodes.tldr: Aligns pretrained diffusion models to rewards at test time using tempered Sequential Monte Carlo, avoiding fine-tuning and reward over-optimization.
nodes.problem: Fine-tuning diffusion models for rewards over-optimizes, while guidance under-optimizes targets.
nodes.approach: Training-free SMC sampling from reward-tilted target distributions with tempering.
nodes.niche_reason: Reward alignment of diffusion models is a crowded direction

nodes.title: Faster Cascades via Speculative Decoding
nodes.tldr: Combines cascades and speculative decoding by implementing a deferral rule through speculative execution, yielding better cost-quality tradeoffs and faster LLM inference.
nodes.problem: LLM inference is costly; cascades and speculative decoding each trade quality and speed differently.
nodes.approach: Deferral rule implemented via speculative execution, with a plug-in approximation to the optimal rule.
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › Efficient LLM Inference & Architectures
nodes.niche_reason: Speculative decoding and cascades are common inference efficiency topics

nodes.title: Open-World Reinforcement Learning over Long Short-Term Imagination
nodes.tldr: LS-Imagine extends imagination horizon in model-based RL with a long short-term world model using jumpy goal-conditioned transitions, improving open-world visual control such as Minecraft.
nodes.problem: Short-sighted imagination limits exploration efficiency in high-dimensional open-world visual RL.
nodes.approach: Long short-term world model with affordance maps and jumpy state transitions for imagined long-horizon rollouts.
nodes.primary_topic: Reinforcement Learning › Model-Based RL & World Models
nodes.niche_reason: Active but fairly common model-based RL area.

nodes.title: Analyzing Neural Scaling Laws in Two-Layer Networks with Power-Law Data Spectra
nodes.tldr: Explains neural scaling-law power laws in two-layer networks using statistical mechanics of SGD on power-law data covariance spectra.
nodes.problem: Theory of why neural scaling laws emerge is limited, especially how data spectra shape learning.
nodes.approach: Analytic one-pass SGD student-teacher analysis of generalization error for linear and nonlinear two-layer networks.
nodes.primary_topic: Learning Theory & Optimization › Deep Learning Theory
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › High-dimensional & Random Matrix Theory
nodes.niche_reason: Established statistical-mechanics theory of learning curves

nodes.title: VLMaterial: Procedural Material Generation with Large Vision-Language Models
nodes.tldr: VLMaterial fine-tunes a vision-language model to emit Python programs for procedural materials from images, with a new dataset and LLM-based program augmentation.
nodes.problem: Creating procedural materials from images needs expert effort
nodes.approach: Fine-tune VLM to generate material node-graph Python code; augment programs via LLM

nodes.title: Effective Interplay between Sparsity and Quantization: From Theory to Practice
nodes.tldr: Proves that sparsity and quantization are non-orthogonal, so their order and combined error matter, supported by experiments on LLMs and vision models.
nodes.problem: Whether sparsity and quantization compress models independently without extra error.
nodes.approach: Mathematical proof of non-orthogonality plus experiments on OPT, LLaMA, ViT and ResNet.

nodes.title: Diffusion-Based Planning for Autonomous Driving with Flexible Guidance
nodes.tldr: A transformer diffusion planner for closed-loop driving that models multi-modal behaviour and steers trajectories with classifier guidance, without rule-based fallback.
nodes.problem: Imitation planners for driving struggle with multi-modal behaviour and safety guarantees
nodes.approach: Transformer diffusion model with learned gradient classifier guidance for joint prediction and planning
nodes.niche_reason: Diffusion-based driving planners are a growing, fairly common direction

nodes.title: Diffusion On Syntax Trees For Program Synthesis
nodes.tldr: Applies neural diffusion to syntax trees of context-free grammars so programs are iteratively edited with syntactic validity, combined with search for inverse graphics program synthesis.
nodes.problem: Autoregressive code generation lacks execution feedback and edit-based training data is scarce.
nodes.approach: Diffusion over syntax tree edits, guided by search with execution results.
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › Code Generation & Software
nodes.niche_reason: Diffusion over program syntax trees for inverse graphics is unusual.

nodes.title: Progressive distillation induces an implicit curriculum
nodes.tldr: Shows progressive distillation from intermediate teacher checkpoints speeds student learning via an implicit curriculum, proven on sparse parity and observed in transformers on PCFGs.

nodes.approach: Sparse parity sandbox with provable sample complexity benefit, extended to transformers on probabilistic context-free grammars.
nodes.primary_topic: Learning Theory & Optimization › Deep Learning Theory
nodes.niche_reason: Theory of distillation dynamics is specialised.

nodes.title: GrabS: Generative Embodied Agent for 3D Object Segmentation without Scene Supervision
nodes.tldr: GrabS segments objects in complex point clouds without 3D labels by learning generative object priors, then an embodied agent queries them to discover objects.
nodes.problem: Unsupervised 3D object segmentation in complex point clouds fails for lack of objectness in pretrained features.

nodes.title: Loopy: Taming Audio-Driven Portrait Avatar with Long-Term Motion Dependency
nodes.tldr: Loopy is an audio-only conditioned video diffusion model for portrait avatars that uses long-term motion dependencies for natural, stable talking-head videos.

nodes.title: Scaling Laws for Precision
nodes.tldr: Proposes precision-aware scaling laws predicting loss from low-precision training and post-training quantization, showing extra pretraining data can hurt quantized inference.
nodes.problem: Scaling laws ignore low-precision training and inference, so their quality and cost predictions are incomplete.
nodes.approach: Model low precision as reducing effective parameter count; unify training and post-training quantization degradation into one functional form.
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › Pretraining, Scaling & Data

nodes.title: Provably Accurate Shapley Value Estimation via Leverage Score Sampling
nodes.tldr: Leverage SHAP is a Kernel SHAP modification with provably accurate Shapley estimates using O(n log n) model evaluations.
nodes.problem: Kernel SHAP lacks non-asymptotic guarantees and exact Shapley values need exponentially many evaluations.

nodes.title: Tuning Frequency Bias of State Space Models
nodes.tldr: Shows SSMs have an implicit low-frequency bias set by initialization, and proposes two ways to tune it, improving long-range sequence learning.

nodes.title: CausalRivers - Scaling up benchmarking of causal discovery for real-world time-series

nodes.title: The Power of LLM-Generated Synthetic Data for Stance Detection in Online Political Discussions
nodes.tldr: LLM-generated synthetic data, plus uncertainty-based selection of informative unlabelled samples, improves stance detection in online political discussions with less labelling.

nodes.title: When Selection Meets Intervention: Additional Complexities in Causal Discovery

nodes.niche_reason: Selection bias combined with interventional causal discovery is a rare theoretical niche.

nodes.title: Learning to Discretize Denoising Diffusion ODEs

nodes.title: Better autoregressive regression with LLMs via regression-aware fine-tuning

nodes.problem: Decoder LLMs lack a principled way to perform regression, since they output tokens rather than real numbers.

nodes.title: Adjoint Matching: Fine-tuning Flow and Diffusion Generative Models with Memoryless Stochastic Optimal Control
nodes.tldr: Casts reward fine-tuning of flow and diffusion models as stochastic optimal control, solved by regression with a memoryless noise schedule.
nodes.problem: Reward fine-tuning of flow and diffusion models lacks theoretically sound methods.

nodes.title: OLMoE: Open Mixture-of-Experts Language Models

nodes.problem: Open, state-of-the-art MoE language models with full training transparency and routing analysis are lacking.

nodes.title: Stem-OB: Generalizable Visual Imitation Learning with Stem-Like Convergent Observation through Diffusion Inversion
nodes.tldr: Uses diffusion-model inversion to map observations to a shared representation, making visual imitation learning robust to lighting and texture changes without extra training.
nodes.problem: Visual imitation learning policies generalize poorly under lighting and texture perturbations.
nodes.approach: Invert observations with a pretrained image diffusion model to suppress low-level appearance differences while keeping scene structure.
nodes.niche_reason: Diffusion-inversion preprocessing for policy robustness is an unusual but specialised angle.

nodes.title: Computational Explorations of Total Variation Distance

nodes.title: Can a MISL Fly? Analysis and Ingredients for Mutual Information Skill Learning

nodes.title: Syntactic and Semantic Control of Large Language Models via Sequential Monte Carlo
nodes.tldr: Uses sequential Monte Carlo to impose syntactic and semantic constraints on LM generation at inference, letting small models beat much larger ones.

nodes.title: JudgeLM: Fine-tuned Large Language Models are Scalable Judges
nodes.tldr: Fine-tunes LLMs as scalable judges trained on a large judgment dataset, with swap augmentation and reference support to reduce position and format biases.

nodes.niche_reason: LLM-as-judge is a common evaluation direction.

nodes.title: Advantage-Guided Distillation for Preference Alignment in Small Language Models

nodes.title: DSPO: Direct Score Preference Optimization for Diffusion Model Alignment

nodes.title: GOLD: Graph Out-of-Distribution Detection via Implicit Adversarial Latent Generation
nodes.tldr: GOLD detects OOD graph nodes by adversarially training a latent generator whose synthetic embeddings become pseudo-OOD exposure, without real OOD data or pretrained generators.

nodes.title: Robust Function-Calling for On-Device Language Model via Function Masking

nodes.title: MaRS: A Fast Sampler for Mean Reverting Diffusion based on ODE and SDE Solvers

nodes.title: Adversarial Perturbations Cannot Reliably Protect Artists From Generative AI
nodes.tldr: Shows popular adversarial style-mimicry protections for artwork are easily bypassed by simple upscaling, so they give false security.

nodes.title: Revisiting Zeroth-Order Optimization: Minimum-Variance Two-Point Estimators and Directionally Aligned Perturbations

nodes.title: LOKI: A Comprehensive Synthetic Data Detection Benchmark using Large Multimodal Models

nodes.tldr: Jointly denoises node features and rewires the graph by aligning leading spectral spaces, improving GNN node classification.

nodes.niche_reason: Cross-modal transfer between physiological biosignals is a rare niche.

nodes.title: MrRoPE: Mixed-radix Rotary Position Embedding
nodes.tldr: MrRoPE unifies RoPE context-extension methods as radix conversion strategies, and its training-free MrRoPE-Pro reaches over 85% recall at 128K context.
nodes.problem: RoPE extensions for longer-than-pretraining sequences lack a unified theoretical foundation.
nodes.approach: Mixed-radix encoding formulation with uniform and progressive radix conversion for train-short, test-long generalization.
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › Long Context & Memory
nodes.confidence_reason: Venue area 'generative models' contradicts the RoPE/LLM abstract
nodes.niche_reason: Positional encoding for context extension is a crowded area

nodes.title: Plug-and-Play Compositionality for Boosting Continual Learning with Foundation Models
nodes.tldr: Plug-in framework that makes continual learners more robust to forgetting by learning concept slots from ImageNet-pretrained vision transformers.
nodes.problem: Vision learners forget catastrophically because they recognise classes by comparison, not as compositions of concepts.
nodes.approach: Object-centric slot extraction with primitive selection and self-supervised distillation of concept similarity into the classifier.
secondary_topics: Computer Vision › Vision Foundation Models & Self-Supervision
nodes.niche_reason: Continual learning is crowded, though object-centric slots add an angle.

nodes.title: FlashWorld: High-quality 3D Scene Generation within Seconds
nodes.tldr: Generates 3D Gaussian scenes from one image or text in seconds by directly producing 3D outputs during multi-view diffusion, with distillation for visual quality.
nodes.problem: 3D scene generation is slow, and 3D-oriented generators sacrifice visual quality compared with multi-view approaches.
nodes.approach: Dual-mode multi-view diffusion pretraining plus cross-mode distribution-matching distillation from 3D to MV mode.
nodes.niche_reason: Active 3D generation area, common diffusion-distillation recipe

nodes.title: CyberGym: Evaluating AI Agents' Real-World Cybersecurity Capabilities at Scale
nodes.tldr: Presents CyberGym, 1,507 real vulnerabilities for testing agents on proof-of-concept generation, finding about 20 percent success and 35 new zero-days.
nodes.problem: Existing cybersecurity evaluations of AI agents are small-scale and only measure static outcomes.
nodes.approach: Large-scale benchmark where agents reproduce vulnerabilities from text descriptions and codebases.
secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › Agents & Tool Use
nodes.niche_reason: Agent cybersecurity evaluation is specialised and fairly new

nodes.title: Spherical Watermark: Encryption-Free, Lossless Watermarking for Diffusion Models
nodes.tldr: Embeds watermark bits in diffusion latent noise via a spherical mapping that preserves the Gaussian prior, with no encryption or per-image keys.
nodes.problem: Watermarks for diffusion models distort outputs or need per-image keys and cryptographic overhead.
nodes.approach: Binary embedding with random padding, then spherical projection, rotation, and chi-square rescaling of noise.
nodes.niche_reason: Diffusion watermarking is specialised but active.

nodes.title: Quotient-Space Diffusion Model
nodes.tldr: Formalizes diffusion modeling on a quotient space under group symmetry and applies it to SE(3)-symmetric molecular structure generation, simplifying learning versus equivariant diffusion.
nodes.problem: Symmetric structures live on quotient spaces, but equivariant diffusion models must still learn the group-action component.
nodes.approach: Diffusion framework on general quotient spaces with a sampler that recovers the target distribution, applied to molecules.
nodes.niche_reason: Geometric quotient-space formulation of diffusion is an unusual theoretical angle.

nodes.title: Visual symbolic mechanisms: Emergent symbol processing in Vision Language Models
nodes.tldr: Identifies emergent symbol-like spatial indexing mechanisms in vision-language models that support feature binding, tracing binding errors to failures in these mechanisms.
nodes.problem: How VLMs solve the visual feature binding problem and why they fail on binding tasks.
nodes.approach: Mechanistic interpretability analysis finding content-independent spatial indices supporting binding.
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › Language Model Interpretability
nodes.niche_reason: Cognitive-science-inspired mechanistic study of VLMs is unusual.

nodes.title: Fast training of accurate physics-informed neural networks without gradient descent
nodes.tldr: Frozen-PINN solves time-dependent PDEs with random features instead of gradient descent, building temporal causality into a space-time separated model, training far faster.
nodes.problem: PINNs train slowly and inaccurately due to gradient descent on hard losses and non-causal time handling.
nodes.approach: Space-time separation with random features in place of gradient-based training, enforcing causality by construction.
nodes.niche_reason: Gradient-free random-feature PINNs are a rare alternative to mainstream PINNs

nodes.title: MomaGraph: State-Aware Unified Scene Graphs with Vision-Language Models for Embodied Task Planning
nodes.tldr: Introduces a unified scene graph joining spatial and functional relations with part-level interactive elements, and a 7B VLM that plans zero-shot from it.
nodes.problem: Household robots need scene representations that combine navigation and manipulation relations.
nodes.approach: Graph-then-Plan: an RL-trained VLM predicts task-oriented scene graphs, which then drive zero-shot planning.
nodes.niche_reason: Task-oriented scene graphs for mobile manipulation are specialised.

nodes.title: HATSolver: Learning Gröbner Bases with Hierarchical Attention Transformers
nodes.tldr: Uses hierarchical attention transformers with a tree-structured bias and curriculum learning to compute Groebner bases for polynomial systems much more cheaply than flat attention.
nodes.problem: Transformer-based Groebner basis computation for multivariate polynomial systems is computationally costly and limited to small instances.
nodes.approach: Hierarchical Attention Transformers with arbitrary depth and curriculum learning, plus a computational cost analysis.
nodes.primary_topic: Science & Applications › Scientific Discovery & Symbolic Regression
nodes.niche_reason: Learning symbolic computer algebra with transformers is very rare.

nodes.title: Difficult Examples Hurt Unsupervised Contrastive Learning: A Theoretical Perspective
nodes.tldr: Shows difficult examples hurt unsupervised contrastive learning, builds a theory of pair similarity explaining why removing them, margin tuning and temperature scaling improve generalization.
nodes.problem: Understanding the role of difficult examples in unsupervised contrastive learning and why they harm generalization.
nodes.approach: Theoretical similarity-pair framework with generalization bounds; difficult example removal, margin tuning and temperature scaling.
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Generalization & Statistical Learning
nodes.niche_reason: Contrastive theory is established; difficult-example angle is specialised.

nodes.title: Veritas: Generalizable Deepfake Detection via Pattern-Aware Reasoning
nodes.tldr: Introduces HydraFake, a diverse deepfake dataset, and Veritas, an MLLM detector trained with pattern-aware reasoning like planning and self-reflection for generalization.
nodes.problem: Deepfake detectors fail on unseen forgeries and in-the-wild data domains beyond homogeneous benchmarks.
nodes.approach: Pattern-aware reasoning (planning, self-reflection) internalized into MLLMs via a two-stage training pipeline.
nodes.confidence_reason: Deepfake detection has no exact topic; MLLM and dataset contributions straddle.
nodes.niche_reason: Deepfake detection with MLLM reasoning is specialised but growing.

nodes.title: Invisible Safety Threat: Malicious Finetuning for LLM via Steganography
nodes.tldr: Shows fine-tuning an LLM to steganographically hide harmful answers in benign-looking replies, evading content safety classification.
nodes.problem: Safety alignment checks may miss a compromised LLM that hides harmful content from observers.
nodes.approach: Finetune on a steganographic technique so hidden malicious prompts and replies are embedded in cover text.
nodes.primary_topic: Trustworthy ML › AI Safety & Alignment Research
secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › LLM Safety & Jailbreaks
nodes.niche_reason: Steganographic finetuning attacks on LLMs is a rare threat-model direction

nodes.title: FRABench and UFEval: Unified Fine-grained Evaluation with Task and Aspect Generalization
nodes.tldr: Introduces FRABench, a 60.4k-pair fine-grained aspect-level evaluation dataset, and UFEval, a unified MLLM judge generalizing across tasks and unseen aspects.
nodes.problem: MLLM-as-a-judge evaluators are limited to specific tasks and aspects.
nodes.approach: Hierarchical taxonomy of 112 aspects, human/GPT-4o labeled dataset, and jointly trained unified evaluator.
nodes.niche_reason: LLM-as-a-judge evaluation is a crowded area.

nodes.title: Temporal superposition and feature geometry of RNNs under memory demands
nodes.tldr: Introduces temporal superposition in RNNs, theoretically and empirically studying how memory demands shape representational geometry in linear recurrent networks on delayed serial recall.
nodes.problem: How memory demands over time affect feature geometry and capacity in recurrent networks is not understood.
nodes.approach: Theoretical framework for linear RNNs on delayed serial recall characterizing non-orthogonal feature superposition across time.
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Deep Learning Theory
nodes.confidence_reason: Could equally be filed under deep learning theory or neuroscience.
nodes.niche_reason: Superposition over time in RNNs is very rare, bridging neuroscience and interpretability.

nodes.title: OpenThoughts: Data Recipes for Reasoning Models
nodes.tldr: Open-source reasoning datasets and recipes (OpenThoughts) built via 1,000+ controlled experiments on the data pipeline, yielding OpenThinker3-7B with state-of-the-art results on AIME, code and GPQA.
nodes.problem: Best training data recipes for reasoning models are opaque because top models use proprietary data.
nodes.approach: Systematically ablate each distillation pipeline step and scale data with a strong teacher.
secondary_topics: Data, Benchmarks & Evaluation › Synthetic Data & Data Curation
nodes.niche_reason: Reasoning-model data distillation is a very crowded mainstream area.

nodes.title: Instilling an Active Mind in Avatars via Cognitive Simulation
nodes.tldr: Generates semantically rich video avatar animations by using MLLM-derived structured guidance and a multimodal diffusion transformer with Pseudo Last Frame.
nodes.problem: Avatar animation synchronizes motion to low-level audio rather than emotion or intent.
nodes.approach: MLLM-generated structured text conditions a multimodal diffusion transformer fusing audio, image, text.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › Human Pose, Avatars & Faces
nodes.niche_reason: Audio-driven human video animation is a common topic

nodes.title: Seeing Through the Brain: New Insights from Decoding Visual Stimuli with fMRI
nodes.tldr: Finds fMRI signals align better with language-model text space than vision or joint spaces, and uses this to improve image reconstruction from brain activity.
nodes.problem: Unclear which latent space best supports mapping fMRI signals for reconstructing visual stimuli.
nodes.approach: Compare latent spaces for fMRI mapping, then reconstruct images from text-like latents with a pretrained generative model.
nodes.niche_reason: Brain decoding from fMRI is a rare cross-disciplinary direction.

nodes.title: CounselBench: A Large-Scale Expert Evaluation and Adversarial Benchmarking of Large Language Models in Mental Health Question Answering
nodes.tldr: Expert-rated benchmark of 2,000 LLM and therapist answers to mental health questions, plus an adversarial set showing LLM judges overrate responses and miss safety issues.
nodes.problem: Open-ended mental health answers to real patient questions are rarely evaluated by experts.
nodes.approach: Clinician rating across six dimensions with span annotations, plus 120 expert-authored adversarial questions.
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › LLM Evaluation & Benchmarks
nodes.niche_reason: Expert-evaluated mental health QA is specialised.

nodes.title: Universal Inverse Distillation for Matching Models with Real-Data Supervision (No GANs)
nodes.tldr: Unifies distillation of diffusion, flow and bridge matching models into one-step generators, adding real data without adversarial discriminators.
nodes.problem: Distillation methods are tied to one framework and need GAN discriminators to use real data.
nodes.approach: Unified distillation objective for all matching models that incorporates real-data supervision without a discriminator.
nodes.niche_reason: Diffusion distillation is a crowded area; the unified real-data variant is less common.

nodes.title: From movement to cognitive maps: recurrent neural networks reveal how locomotor development shapes hippocampal spatial coding
nodes.tldr: RNNs trained to predict visual input under developmentally realistic rat locomotion statistics reproduce the sequential emergence of hippocampal spatial tuning, matching recordings.
nodes.problem: How developing locomotion shapes emergence of hippocampal spatial representations.
nodes.approach: Train shallow RNNs on visual and vestibular inputs along trajectories mimicking maturing rat movement statistics.
nodes.niche_reason: Computational neuroscience of developmental hippocampus is very rare at ML venues.

nodes.title: A Scalable Distributed Framework for Multimodal GigaVoxel Image Registration
nodes.tldr: FFDP provides IO-aware fused kernels and distributed sharding for gigavoxel multimodal image registration, registering a 100um human brain MRI in a minute.
nodes.problem: Image registration algorithms do not scale to extremely large biomedical images.
nodes.approach: IO-aware fused non-GEMM kernels with convolution-aware tensor sharding for distributed registration.
nodes.niche_reason: Systems-level scaling for medical image registration is rare.

nodes.title: Omni-Reward: Towards Generalist Omni-Modal Reward Modeling with Free-Form Preferences
nodes.tldr: Omni-Reward provides a benchmark, preference dataset, and discriminative and generative reward models for omni-modal reward modeling across text, image, video, audio and 3D with free-form preferences.
nodes.problem: Reward models lack multi-modal coverage and handle only rigid binary preference pairs.
nodes.approach: Build Omni-RewardBench, 317K-pair preference data, and discriminative and generative omni-modal reward models.
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › Alignment & Preference Optimization
nodes.niche_reason: Multimodal reward modeling beyond text/image is somewhat specialised.

nodes.title: Taming Momentum: Rethinking Optimizer States Through Low-Rank Approximation
nodes.tldr: Introduces LoRA-Pre, a low-rank optimizer that compresses Adam/Muon momentum states via an online linear regressor view, cutting memory while preserving pre-training quality.
nodes.problem: Adam and Muon momentum states impose heavy optimizer memory overhead for LLM training.
nodes.approach: Reframes EMA momentum as online linear regression and low-rank decomposes the momentum matrix.
secondary_topics: Architectures & Training › Efficient Training, Compression & Pruning
nodes.niche_reason: Memory-efficient optimizers for LLMs are a crowded research area.

nodes.title: Gaia2: Benchmarking LLM Agents on Dynamic and Asynchronous Environments
nodes.tldr: Benchmark evaluating LLM agents in asynchronous environments that evolve independently of actions, with action-level write verifiers usable for RL rewards.
nodes.problem: Static or synchronous agent evaluations miss temporal constraints, noisy events, and ambiguity found in realistic settings.
nodes.approach: Scenarios with independently evolving environments, paired with write-action verifiers, built on the ARE platform.
secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › Agents & Tool Use
nodes.niche_reason: Agent benchmarks are crowded; asynchronous setting adds some novelty.

nodes.title: Compactness and Consistency: A Conjoint Framework for Deep Graph Clustering
nodes.tldr: CoCo learns compact low-rank graph embeddings from local and global views, with consistency learning, for robust deep graph clustering.
nodes.problem: GNN node representations miss global structure and carry redundancy and noise, hurting clustering.
nodes.approach: Graph convolutional filters over local and global views, encoded into low-rank embeddings with a consistency loss.
nodes.niche_reason: Established but specialised: deep graph clustering.

nodes.title: How Do Transformers Learn to Associate Tokens: Gradient Leading Terms Bring Mechanistic Interpretability
nodes.tldr: Uses leading-term gradient approximations to derive closed-form early-training weights, explaining how attention models learn token associations like bird-flew.
nodes.problem: How do transformers learn semantic token associations from natural language data during training?
nodes.approach: Leading-term gradient approximation yielding closed-form weights at early training stages, verified empirically.
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › Language Model Interpretability
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Deep Learning Theory
nodes.niche_reason: Theory of training dynamics for interpretability is specialised.

nodes.title: The Coverage Principle: How Pre-Training Enables Post-Training
nodes.tldr: Explains via coverage, the probability mass on good responses, how pre-training enables post-training, with provable interventions for checkpoint selection and decoding.
nodes.problem: Why pre-training cross-entropy poorly predicts downstream post-training and test-time scaling success.
nodes.approach: Statistical learning theory of coverage generalization with provable algorithmic interventions.
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › Pretraining, Scaling & Data
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Generalization & Statistical Learning
nodes.niche_reason: Theory of pre-training for post-training is emerging and specialised.

nodes.title: Half-order Fine-Tuning for Diffusion Model: A Recursive Likelihood Ratio Optimizer
nodes.tldr: Proposes the Recursive Likelihood Ratio optimizer, a half-order unbiased lower-variance gradient estimator for fine-tuning diffusion models, validated on image and video generation.
nodes.problem: RL and truncated backprop fine-tuning of diffusion models suffer low sample efficiency and biased gradients.
nodes.approach: Half-order likelihood-ratio gradient estimator rearranging the computation graph across the recursive diffusion chain.
nodes.niche_reason: Diffusion alignment is crowded but gradient-estimator angle is specialised.

nodes.title: Fast Escape, Slow Convergence: Learning Dynamics of Phase Retrieval under Power-Law Data
nodes.tldr: Analyzes gradient-flow learning of phase retrieval with power-law anisotropic inputs, deriving a three-phase trajectory and explicit MSE scaling laws.
nodes.problem: Scaling-law behavior of nonlinear regression under anisotropic data is not rigorously understood.
nodes.approach: Tractable reduction of an infinite hierarchy of coupled equations governing summary statistics.
nodes.primary_topic: Learning Theory & Optimization › Deep Learning Theory
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › High-dimensional & Random Matrix Theory
nodes.niche_reason: Rare: scaling-law dynamics for anisotropic phase retrieval.

nodes.title: Task-free Adaptive Meta Black-box Optimization
nodes.tldr: Meta black-box optimizer that adapts its evolutionary operators online from the target task's own data, enabling zero-shot optimization with no handcrafted training tasks.
nodes.problem: MetaBBO needs handcrafted training task distributions that may not match real target tasks.
nodes.approach: Closed-loop adaptive parameter learning where parameterized evolutionary operators self-update during optimization.
nodes.confidence_reason: meta-learning versus black-box optimization is a judgment call
nodes.niche_reason: Task-free online meta-optimizers are rare

nodes.title: On the Reasoning Abilities of Masked Diffusion Language Models
nodes.tldr: Proves masked diffusion language models are equivalent to padded looped transformers, can simulate chain-of-thought, and are provably faster on some problems like regular languages.
nodes.problem: Characterizing the provable reasoning power and efficiency of masked diffusion language models.
nodes.approach: Formal expressivity analysis linking MDMs to chain-of-thought and padded looped transformers in finite precision.
nodes.niche_reason: Expressivity theory of diffusion language models is rare.

nodes.title: TRACE: Your Diffusion Model is Secretly an Instance Edge Detector
nodes.tldr: TRACE extracts instance boundaries from diffusion self-attention maps at an emergence point and distills them into a one-step edge decoder for unsupervised instance and weak panoptic segmentation.
nodes.problem: Instance and panoptic segmentation need costly dense annotations.
nodes.approach: Find the Instance Emergence Point in attention maps, compute Attention Boundary Divergence, and distill to a lightweight edge decoder.
nodes.confidence_reason: Mixes diffusion-feature analysis with segmentation; primary topic judgment call.
nodes.niche_reason: Repurposing diffusion attention for segmentation is a growing niche.

nodes.title: InfoNCE Induces Gaussian Distribution
nodes.tldr: Shows InfoNCE-trained embeddings are well approximated by multivariate Gaussians, proven asymptotically under alignment and concentration assumptions and verified on CIFAR-10 and foundation models.
nodes.problem: Characterizing the distribution of features emerging from InfoNCE contrastive training.
nodes.approach: Asymptotic theory of finite projections of high-dimensional representations, plus experiments on synthetic data, CIFAR-10, and pretrained models.
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Deep Learning Theory
nodes.niche_reason: Contrastive learning theory is established; Gaussianity result is specialised.

nodes.title: WebDevJudge: Evaluating (M)LLMs as Critiques for Web Development Quality
nodes.tldr: Benchmarks LLM and multimodal judges on web development quality using human preference pairs with rubrics, finding a large gap from human experts.
nodes.problem: Reliability of LLM-as-a-judge on open-ended, interactive web development tasks is unknown.
nodes.approach: Human-labeled paired web implementations with query-grounded rubrics, evaluated statically and interactively.
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › LLM Evaluation & Benchmarks
secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › Code Generation & Software
nodes.niche_reason: LLM-as-a-judge benchmarks are a crowded evaluation area

nodes.title: FIRE: Frobenius-Isometry Reinitialization for Balancing the Stability–Plasticity Tradeoff
nodes.tldr: FIRE reinitializes weights to balance stability and plasticity by minimizing Frobenius error to past weights subject to zero deviation from isometry, approximated with Newton-Schulz iteration.
nodes.problem: Reinitialization methods for nonstationary training are hard to tune between forgetting and lost plasticity.
nodes.approach: Constrained optimization of squared Frobenius error under isometry constraint, solved via Newton-Schulz iteration.
secondary_topics: Reinforcement Learning › Transfer, Meta & Continual RL
nodes.niche_reason: Plasticity loss and reinitialization are established but specialised.

nodes.title: Verifying Chain-of-Thought Reasoning via Its Computational Graph
nodes.tldr: CRV verifies chain-of-thought steps by classifying structural features of attribution graphs, finding domain-specific error signatures and correcting errors via transcoder feature interventions.
nodes.problem: Understanding why chain-of-thought steps fail, beyond black-box or activation-based correctness prediction.
nodes.approach: Train classifier on structural features of attribution graphs from transcoders; intervene on features to fix reasoning.
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › Language Model Interpretability
nodes.niche_reason: Circuit-level reasoning verification is specialised but growing.

nodes.title: On the Generalization Capacities of MLLMs for Spatial Intelligence
nodes.tldr: Argues RGB-only MLLMs overfit training cameras and proposes a camera-aware MLLM injecting intrinsics embeddings and camera-varying augmentation for generalizable 3D spatial reasoning.
nodes.problem: RGB-only multimodal LLMs entangle object properties with camera perspective, failing to generalize across cameras.
nodes.approach: Dense camera-intrinsics embedding conditioning visual tokens plus camera-aware data augmentation and geometry-grounded training.
nodes.confidence_reason: Straddles spatial MLLMs and 3D geometry/camera modeling; primary choice is a judgment call.
nodes.niche_reason: Spatial MLLM generalization with camera parameters is a specialised angle.

nodes.title: Generative Universal Verifier as Multimodal Meta-Reasoner
nodes.tldr: Generative verifier that checks and refines visual outputs during multimodal reasoning and generation, with a new benchmark and a 7B model plus test-time scaling.
nodes.problem: Vision-language models lack reliable visual verification of their own generated or reasoned outcomes.
nodes.approach: Generative verifier trained on automatically built verification data, used in sequential test-time scaling.
nodes.niche_reason: Generative visual verifiers for reasoning are an emerging niche.

nodes.title: Reasoning as Representation: Rethinking Visual Reinforcement Learning in Image Quality Assessment
nodes.tldr: Analyzes why RL-trained reasoning image quality assessment models generalize, finding MLLMs convert visual input into compact text representations, then distills this into an efficient model.
nodes.problem: Understanding and reducing the cost of RL-trained reasoning image quality assessment models.
nodes.approach: Analysis showing RL converts visual features to aligned text representations, motivating a cheaper non-reasoning variant.
secondary_topics: Reinforcement Learning › RL for LLMs & Reasoning
nodes.niche_reason: RL for image quality assessment is specialised.

nodes.title: SAFETY-GUIDED FLOW (SGF): A UNIFIED FRAMEWORK FOR NEGATIVE GUIDANCE IN SAFE GENERATION
nodes.tldr: Unifies safety guidance for diffusion and flow models with an MMD potential, showing negative guidance should be strong early and decay later.
nodes.problem: Safe diffusion generation uses heuristic negative guidance without clear criteria for when it is needed.
nodes.approach: MMD-based energy negative guidance, with a control-barrier-function analysis that sets a critical time window.
nodes.niche_reason: Specialised: safety-driven negative guidance for diffusion and flow models.

nodes.title: Pinet: Optimizing hard-constrained neural networks with orthogonal projection layers
nodes.tldr: Pinet is an output layer guaranteeing convex-constraint satisfaction via operator-splitting projections and implicit differentiation, enabling fast feasible-by-design optimization proxies.
nodes.problem: Neural network outputs that satisfy hard convex constraints for parametric optimization.
nodes.approach: Operator-splitting projection in the forward pass with implicit-function-theorem backpropagation, in JAX.
nodes.confidence_reason: No seed topic fits constrained-output layers; closest is a judgment call.
nodes.niche_reason: Hard-constraint output layers for optimization proxies are a rare niche.

nodes.title: Shoot First, Ask Questions Later? Building Rational Agents that Explore and Act Like People
nodes.tldr: Introduces Collaborative Battleship to test LM information-seeking and uses Bayesian experimental design Monte Carlo inference to let weaker LMs beat humans and GPT-5.
nodes.problem: LM agents are poor at rationally balancing question-asking and acting under limited information.
nodes.approach: Benchmark against humans plus Monte Carlo expected-information-gain inference strategies for questioner and answerer agents.
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › Agents & Tool Use
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Probabilistic & Bayesian Methods
nodes.niche_reason: Bayesian experimental design for LM agents is unusual.

nodes.title: The Art of Scaling Reinforcement Learning Compute for LLMs
nodes.tldr: Large-scale study of RL compute scaling for LLMs: fits sigmoidal compute-performance curves, ablates design choices, and proposes the ScaleRL recipe with predictable scaling.
nodes.problem: No predictive scaling methodology exists for RL compute in LLM training.
nodes.approach: 400k GPU-hour ablation study fitting sigmoidal scaling curves, distilled into the ScaleRL best-practice recipe.
nodes.primary_topic: Reinforcement Learning › RL for LLMs & Reasoning
secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › Pretraining, Scaling & Data
nodes.niche_reason: RL for LLMs is crowded, though scaling-law framing is somewhat distinct.

nodes.title: FALCON: Few-step Accurate Likelihoods for Continuous Flows
nodes.tldr: Enables few-step sampling with accurate likelihoods for flow-matched Boltzmann generators via a hybrid invertibility objective, about 100x faster than CNFs.
nodes.problem: Likelihood computation for continuous normalizing flows needs thousands of evaluations per sample.
nodes.approach: Hybrid flow-matching objective encouraging invertibility for few-step, accurate-enough likelihoods.
nodes.niche_reason: Boltzmann generators are specialised though flow matching is common

nodes.title: Softmax Transformers are Turing-Complete
nodes.tldr: Proves that length-generalizable softmax chain-of-thought transformers are Turing-complete via a CoT extension of C-RASP with relative positional encoding, with supporting experiments.
nodes.problem: Whether softmax-attention chain-of-thought transformers are Turing-complete under length generalization.
nodes.approach: Formal proof through CoT extension of Counting RASP, with relative positional encoding; empirical validation on formal languages.
nodes.primary_topic: Learning Theory & Optimization › Deep Learning Theory
nodes.niche_reason: Formal-language expressivity theory of transformers is a rare niche.

nodes.title: VibeVoice: Expressive Podcast Generation with Next-Token Diffusion
nodes.tldr: VibeVoice synthesizes up to 30-minute, 4-speaker podcast speech using an ultra-low frame rate continuous speech tokenizer and next-token diffusion.
nodes.problem: Traditional TTS struggles with long-form multi-speaker conversational audio, speaker consistency and natural turn-taking.
nodes.approach: 7.5 Hz continuous speech tokenizer, pseudo-transcript annotation pipeline, and next-token diffusion generation.
nodes.primary_topic: Generative Models › Audio, Speech & Music Generation
secondary_topics: Audio, Speech & Multimodal › Speech Recognition & Synthesis
nodes.niche_reason: Long-form multi-speaker TTS is established but specialised.

nodes.title: Non-Convex Federated Optimization under Cost-Aware Client Selection
nodes.tldr: Proposes a cost-aware federated optimization model distinguishing client-selection strategies, and RG-SAGA, a recursive-gradient SAGA estimator achieving best-known communication and local complexities for non-convex problems.
nodes.problem: Existing metrics ignore differing communication costs of client-selection strategies in federated non-convex optimization.
nodes.approach: Cost-aware complexity model plus inexact composite gradient method with a Recursive-Gradient improved SAGA estimator.
nodes.niche_reason: Cost-aware federated complexity theory is a rare specialised niche.

nodes.title: EditBench: Evaluating LLM Abilities to Perform Real-World Instructed Code Edits
nodes.tldr: EditBench is a 545-problem benchmark of real-world instructed code edits with context and cursor position; evaluates 40 LLMs, most scoring below 60%.
nodes.problem: Lack of realistic benchmarks for LLM instructed code editing
nodes.approach: Collect in-the-wild user instructions and code contexts, then evaluate 40 LLMs
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › Code Generation & Software
secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › LLM Evaluation & Benchmarks
nodes.niche_reason: Code benchmarks are common; editing-in-the-wild angle slightly narrower

nodes.title: Multi-Domain Transferable Graph Gluing for Building Graph Foundation Models
nodes.tldr: GraphGlue merges multiple graph datasets into a unified Riemannian manifold via neural manifold gluing, enabling batched multi-domain pre-training and a geometric transferability measure.
nodes.problem: Unclear how knowledge transfers across domains in multi-domain graph pre-training.
nodes.approach: Differential-geometric gluing of local orthogonal frames, with EMA prototyping for batched pre-training.
nodes.niche_reason: Manifold-gluing view of graph pre-training is unusual.

nodes.title: Is it Thinking or Cheating? Detecting Implicit Reward Hacking by Measuring Reasoning Effort
nodes.tldr: TRACE detects implicit reward hacking by truncating chain-of-thought at various lengths and measuring how early a verifier passes, outperforming CoT monitors.
nodes.problem: Implicit reward hacking evades chain-of-thought monitors because the reasoning appears benign.
nodes.approach: Compute area under accuracy-versus-truncated-CoT-length curve as a measure of reasoning effort.
nodes.primary_topic: Trustworthy ML › AI Safety & Alignment Research
secondary_topics: Reinforcement Learning › RL for LLMs & Reasoning
nodes.niche_reason: Reward hacking detection is an active but specialised topic.

nodes.title: FlashVID: Efficient Video Large Language Models via Training-free Tree-based Spatiotemporal Token Merging
nodes.tldr: Training-free token compression for video LLMs that merges spatiotemporal redundancy, keeping 10% of tokens while retaining 99.1% of performance.
nodes.problem: Video LLMs process huge visual token counts, and independent spatial and temporal compression is suboptimal.
nodes.approach: Attention and diversity-based token selection followed by tree-based spatiotemporal token merging.
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › Efficient LLM Inference & Architectures
nodes.niche_reason: Visual token compression for video LLMs is a crowded efficiency topic

nodes.title: Exchangeability of GNN Representations with Applications to Graph Retrieval
nodes.tldr: Shows GNN node embeddings are exchangeable, so graph similarities reduce to order-statistic distances, enabling a unified LSH framework for graph retrieval.
nodes.problem: Transport-based graph similarities are expensive to compute for retrieval, such as subgraph matching and edit distance.
nodes.approach: Exchangeability of trained GNN embeddings lets Euclidean LSH over order statistics approximate graph similarity.
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Optimal Transport & Divergences
nodes.niche_reason: Exchangeability of GNN embeddings for hashing is rare

nodes.title: WAFT: Warping-Alone Field Transforms for Optical Flow
nodes.tldr: Replaces RAFT's cost volume with high-resolution warping, ranking first on Spring, Sintel and KITTI with lower memory and up to 4.1x speedup.
nodes.problem: Optical flow methods rely on expensive cost volumes that consume memory and time.
nodes.approach: Minimal meta-architecture using high-resolution warping of features instead of correlation cost volumes.
nodes.niche_reason: Optical flow is established; cost-volume-free design is a variant.

nodes.title: WSM: Decay-Free Learning Rate Schedule via Checkpoint Merging for LLM Pre-training
nodes.tldr: WSM links learning rate decay to checkpoint merging, emulating decay schedules as model averaging in a decay-free schedule that beats WSD on MATH, HumanEval.
nodes.problem: Replacing learning rate decay phase in LLM pretraining

secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › Pretraining, Scaling & Data
nodes.niche_reason: LR schedules are common but merge-based view is specialised

nodes.title: Mamba-3: Improved Sequence Modeling using State Space Principles
nodes.tldr: Improves state-space sequence models with a more expressive recurrence, complex state updates and multi-input multi-output design for faster, stronger decoding.
nodes.problem: Transformers have quadratic costs, while prior linear models lag in quality and hardware efficiency.
nodes.approach: Expressive recurrence, complex state update rule, and MIMO state-space formulation with hardware-friendly decoding.
nodes.primary_topic: Architectures & Training › State-Space Models & Linear Attention
secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › Efficient LLM Inference & Architectures
nodes.niche_reason: Active mainstream sub-quadratic architecture research

nodes.title: Rodrigues Network for Learning Robot Actions
nodes.tldr: Introduces a neural architecture with a learnable forward-kinematics operator that injects kinematic bias, improving action prediction, diffusion-policy imitation learning, and 3D hand reconstruction.
nodes.problem: MLPs and Transformers lack inductive biases reflecting the kinematic structure of articulated systems.
nodes.approach: Neural Rodrigues Operator generalizing forward kinematics, composed into the Rodrigues Network for processing actions.
secondary_topics: Computer Vision › Human Pose, Avatars & Faces
nodes.niche_reason: Kinematic inductive-bias network architectures for actions are rare.

nodes.title: $p\textrm{-less}$ Sampling: A Robust Hyperparameter-Free Approach for LLM Decoding
nodes.tldr: Introduces p-less sampling, a hyperparameter-free information-theoretic truncation rule that keeps LLM output quality stable as temperature rises.
nodes.problem: Top-p and similar samplers need hyperparameter tuning and degrade at high temperature.
nodes.approach: Dynamically sets a per-step truncation threshold from the entire token probability distribution.
secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › Efficient LLM Inference & Architectures
nodes.niche_reason: LLM decoding strategies are a crowded area

nodes.title: MC-Search: Evaluating and Enhancing Multimodal Agentic Search with Structured Long Reasoning Chains
nodes.tldr: Benchmarks agentic multimodal RAG with 3,333 step-annotated reasoning chains, plus process-level metrics and a process-supervised fine-tuning method.
nodes.problem: Existing multimodal RAG benchmarks use simple QA with short retrieval chains, leaving adaptive planning underexplored.

nodes.title: InfoTok: Adaptive Discrete Video Tokenizer via Information-Theoretic Compression
nodes.tldr: InfoTok is an adaptive discrete video tokenizer that allocates tokens by information content using an ELBO-based algorithm, saving 20% tokens without losing performance.
nodes.problem: Fixed-rate video tokenizers waste tokens on redundancy or lose information in dense content.
nodes.approach: ELBO-based information-theoretic training of a transformer adaptive compressor allocating tokens by informational richness.
nodes.niche_reason: Adaptive video tokenization with theory is specialised.

nodes.title: LongWriter-Zero: Mastering Ultra-Long Text Generation via Reinforcement Learning
nodes.tldr: Trains LLMs for ultra-long text generation purely with reinforcement learning and specialized reward models, without synthetic SFT data, beating larger models.

secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › Pretraining, Scaling & Data
nodes.niche_reason: RL for LLMs is crowded; long-form writing is a narrower angle.

nodes.title: TileLang: Bridge Programmability and Performance in Modern Neural Kernels
nodes.tldr: Introduces TileLang, a tile-level programming system for fused neural kernels with inferred tile configurations, reaching up to 5x Triton speedup.
nodes.problem: Fused neural kernels are hard to write because Triton-style compilers lack fine-grained control.
nodes.approach: Explicit tile primitives plus tile inference from partial annotations and hardware-aware tile recommendation.

nodes.title: Structured Flow Autoencoders: Learning Structured Probabilistic Representations with Flow Matching
nodes.tldr: Augments continuous normalizing flows with graphical models and a flow-matching objective that jointly learns likelihood, posterior, and structured latent variables.
nodes.problem: Flow matching density estimators fail to capture the latent structure of complex data.
nodes.approach: Flow-matching objective within graphical-model-structured continuous normalizing flows, learning likelihood and posterior jointly.
secondary_topics: Generative Models › GANs, VAEs & Normalizing Flows
nodes.niche_reason: Structured latent flow autoencoders combine two specialised directions

nodes.title: SimuHome: A Temporal- and Environment-Aware Benchmark for Smart Home LLM Agents
nodes.tldr: Presents SimuHome, a time-accelerated Matter-based smart home simulator and a 600-episode benchmark showing reasoning and temporal scheduling remain hard for LLM agents.
nodes.problem: LLM smart-home agents lack realistic simulators and challenging benchmarks

nodes.title: DCFold: Efficient Protein Structure Generation with Single Forward Pass
nodes.tldr: DCFold is a single-step generative model matching AlphaFold3 accuracy using dual consistency training with a Temporal Geodesic Matching scheduler, giving 15x faster inference.
nodes.problem: AlphaFold3's iterative diffusion inference is too slow for virtual screening and protein design.

nodes.niche_reason: Consistency distillation for biomolecular structure is specialised.

nodes.title: Overcoming Joint Intractability with Lossless Hierarchical Speculative Decoding
nodes.tldr: Proposes hierarchical speculative decoding, a provably lossless sequence-level verification that accepts more drafted tokens and boosts LLM inference speed.

nodes.approach: Balances excess and deficient probability mass across accessible draft branches to verify jointly and losslessly.
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › Efficient LLM Inference & Architectures
nodes.niche_reason: Lossless hierarchical speculative decoding is a fairly active inference topic.

nodes.title: ThinKV: Thought-Adaptive KV Cache Compression for Efficient Reasoning Models
nodes.tldr: Thought-adaptive KV cache compression that quantizes and evicts tokens by reasoning-thought importance, keeping near-lossless accuracy at under 5% cache.
nodes.problem: Long chain-of-thought outputs make the KV cache of reasoning models overwhelm GPU memory.
nodes.approach: Hybrid quantization-eviction by thought type, plus a PagedAttention kernel reusing evicted slots.
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › Efficient LLM Inference & Architectures
nodes.niche_reason: KV cache compression for LLMs is a crowded area.

nodes.title: AstaBench: Rigorous Benchmarking of AI Agents with a Scientific Research Suite
nodes.tldr: AstaBench is a 2400-problem suite and reproducible environment for evaluating AI agents on scientific research; 57 agents show AI remains far from solving it.
nodes.problem: Existing agent benchmarks lack controlled tools, cost accounting, and holistic science-research coverage.

secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › Agents & Tool Use

nodes.title: Q-RAG: Long Context Multi‑Step Retrieval via Value‑Based Embedder Training
nodes.tldr: Q-RAG fine-tunes the embedder with value-based reinforcement learning for multi-step retrieval, achieving state-of-the-art on long-context benchmarks up to 10M tokens.
nodes.problem: Single-step RAG fails on multi-step questions, and fine-tuning LLMs for multi-step retrieval is costly.

nodes.title: In-The-Flow Agentic System Optimization for Effective Planning and Tool Use
nodes.tldr: AgentFlow trains a planner inside the live multi-turn tool-use loop of a modular agent system, using Flow-GRPO to assign credit across long-horizon sparse rewards.
nodes.problem: Monolithic tool-using LLM policies scale poorly over long horizons and generalise weakly to new scenarios.

nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › Agents & Tool Use

nodes.title: Actions Speak Louder than Prompts: A Large-Scale Study of LLMs for Graph Inference
nodes.tldr: Large controlled study of LLMs on text-rich graph node classification comparing prompting, tool-use and code generation, finding code generation strongest and robust on heterophilic graphs.
nodes.problem: How well LLMs process graph data for node classification across interaction modes.
nodes.approach: Controlled evaluation across interaction modes, datasets, homophily, text length, and input ablations.
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › LLM Evaluation & Benchmarks

nodes.title: WAVE: Learning Unified & Versatile Audio-Visual Embeddings with Multimodal LLM
nodes.tldr: WAVE builds prompt-aware LLM embeddings in one space for text, audio and video, enabling any-to-any cross-modal retrieval and multimodal question answering.
nodes.problem: Multimodal LLM embeddings are underexplored for dynamic audio and video modalities.

nodes.niche_reason: Unified audio-visual-text LLM embeddings are an emerging specialised niche

nodes.title: Exploratory Causal Inference in SAEnce
nodes.tldr: Discovers unknown treatment effects from trial data by running causal search over sparse-autoencoder features of foundation-model embeddings.
nodes.problem: Causal effect estimation relies on hand-crafted hypotheses and suffers from multiple-testing issues at scale.

secondary_topics: Science & Applications › Scientific Discovery & Symbolic Regression

nodes.title: Coupling Experts and Routers in Mixture-of-Experts via an Auxiliary Loss
nodes.tldr: Adds an auxiliary loss that aligns MoE router rows with expert capabilities using noisy proxy tokens, improving routing and specialization in 3B MoE LLMs.
nodes.problem: MoE routers are not explicitly constrained to match what each expert can do.
nodes.approach: Proxy tokens built from router rows drive a contrastive coupling loss between routers and experts.

nodes.title: One for Two: A Unified Framework for Imbalanced Graph Classification via Dynamic Balanced Prototype
nodes.tldr: UniImb handles class and topological imbalance in graph classification via learnable graph perturbations and dynamic balanced prototypes, plus the AirGraph dataset.

nodes.title: NextStep-1: Toward Autoregressive Image Generation with Continuous Tokens at Scale
nodes.tldr: A 14B autoregressive model with a flow-matching head generates images from continuous tokens via next-token prediction, reaching state-of-the-art AR text-to-image quality.
nodes.problem: AR image generation relies on slow diffusion heads or lossy vector-quantized tokens.
nodes.approach: Autoregressive transformer over text and continuous image tokens with a flow-matching output head.
nodes.niche_reason: AR continuous-token image generation is less common than diffusion, yet established.

nodes.title: On the Wasserstein Geodesic Principal Component Analysis of probability measures
nodes.tldr: Develops geodesic principal component analysis on probability measures under Otto-Wasserstein geometry, with exact Gaussian case and neural-network geodesic parameterization for general measures.
nodes.problem: Finding principal modes of variation in a collection of probability distributions.
nodes.approach: Geodesic PCA in Wasserstein space, lifted to linear maps for Gaussians and neural parameterized geodesics otherwise.
nodes.primary_topic: Learning Theory & Optimization › Optimal Transport & Divergences
nodes.niche_reason: Wasserstein geodesic PCA is a very rare mathematical niche.

nodes.title: Train-before-Test Harmonizes Language Model Rankings
nodes.tldr: Train-before-test gives every model identical benchmark-specific finetuning before evaluation, yielding consistent cross-benchmark model rankings and restoring perplexity-performance links across 61 models and 24 benchmarks.

nodes.title: DepthLM: Metric Depth from Vision Language Models

nodes.problem: VLMs struggle with 3D understanding from 2D input, lagging pure vision models on metric depth.

nodes.title: PetaGAIL++: Utility Optimized Private Trajectory Generation with Imitation Learning
nodes.tldr: Generates privacy-preserving synthetic human mobility trajectories with imitation learning, adding sample-sensitivity-aware noise to improve privacy-utility trade-off.

nodes.title: Speculative Actions: A Lossless Framework for Faster AI Agents

nodes.title: Hyperparameter Trajectory Inference with Conditional Lagrangian Optimal Transport
nodes.tldr: Learns via conditional Lagrangian optimal transport how a network's output shifts with its hyperparameters, giving surrogates for unseen settings.

nodes.title: Beyond Prompt-Induced Lies: Investigating LLM Deception on Benign Prompts
nodes.tldr: Measures LLMs' self-initiated deception on benign prompts using Contact Searching Questions, with a Deceptive Intention Score and a Deceptive Behavior Score across 16 models.

nodes.title: RAIN-Merging: A Gradient-Free Method to Enhance Instruction Following in Large Reasoning Models with Preserved Thinking Format
nodes.tldr: Merges an instruction-tuned model into a large reasoning model via gradient-free null-space projection, improving instruction following while keeping the thinking format.

nodes.title: Scaling Laws and Spectra of Shallow Neural Networks in the Feature Learning Regime

nodes.title: DTO-KD: Dynamic Trade-off Optimization for Effective Knowledge Distillation

nodes.title: It's All Just Vectorization: einx, a Universal Notation for Tensor Operations
nodes.tldr: Introduces einx, a declarative notation for tensor operations derived from vectorization, reducing large framework APIs to a few elementary operations with consistent shape rules.

nodes.title: GEPA: Reflective Prompt Evolution Can Outperform Reinforcement Learning
nodes.tldr: Optimizes LLM prompts via natural-language reflection and Pareto-based evolution, beating GRPO RL with up to 35x fewer rollouts.

nodes.title: Pareto-Conditioned Diffusion Models for Offline Multi-Objective Optimization
