nodes.niche_reason: RL post-training for diffusion is a crowded, fast-moving area.

nodes.title: LLMs Get Lost In Multi-Turn Conversation
nodes.tldr: Simulations across 200k+ conversations show LLMs drop about 39% in multi-turn settings, mostly from unreliability after early wrong assumptions.
nodes.problem: LLM benchmarks test single-turn fully specified tasks, missing degradation in multi-turn dialogue.
nodes.approach: Large-scale user simulation comparing single-turn and multi-turn performance across generation tasks.
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › LLM Evaluation & Benchmarks
secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › In-context Learning & Prompting
nodes.niche_reason: Multi-turn evaluation of LLMs is a common benchmarking direction

nodes.title: Mastering Sparse CUDA Generation through Pretrained Models and Deep Reinforcement Learning
nodes.tldr: SparseRL uses deep RL with a pretrained language model policy to generate efficient CUDA code for sparse matrix operations, using hierarchical correctness-and-speed rewards.
nodes.problem: Generating high-performance CUDA code for irregular sparse matrix operations.
nodes.approach: RL-finetune a pretrained LM taking nonzero indices as input, with sinusoidal sparse embeddings and hierarchical rewards.
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › Code Generation & Software
secondary_topics: Reinforcement Learning › RL for LLMs & Reasoning
nodes.niche_reason: Sparse-kernel CUDA generation with RL is a rare application niche.

nodes.title: Reasoning with Sampling: Your Base Model is Smarter Than You Think
nodes.tldr: Shows base LLMs match RL-posttrained reasoning via an MCMC-style iterative sampling algorithm using their own likelihoods, with no training or verifier and preserved diversity.
nodes.problem: Whether RL-level reasoning can be elicited from base models purely at inference time.
nodes.approach: MCMC sampling from sharpened base-model distributions using the model's own likelihoods.
secondary_topics: Reinforcement Learning › RL for LLMs & Reasoning
nodes.niche_reason: Training-free sampling alternative to RL for reasoning is relatively novel.

nodes.title: Reliable Weak-to-Strong Monitoring of LLM Agents
nodes.tldr: Monitor red teaming stress-tests LLM-agent misbehavior detectors; agent awareness matters most, a hybrid monitor lets weaker models oversee stronger agents, and targeted human review helps.
nodes.problem: Reliably detecting covert misbehavior by LLM agents with monitoring systems.
nodes.approach: Red-teaming workflow across tool-use and computer-use environments, plus hybrid hierarchical-sequential monitor scaffolding.
nodes.primary_topic: Trustworthy ML › AI Safety & Alignment Research
secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › Agents & Tool Use
nodes.confidence_reason: Mixes agent safety red teaming with evaluation methodology.
nodes.niche_reason: Agent oversight is an emerging but focused safety area.

nodes.title: Stable Video Infinity: Infinite-Length Video Generation with Error Recycling
nodes.tldr: Generates non-looping ultra-long videos by fine-tuning a diffusion transformer to recycle and correct its own autoregressive errors.
nodes.problem: Long autoregressive video generation accumulates errors because training sees clean data but testing conditions on errors.
nodes.approach: Error-Recycling Fine-Tuning injects, banks, and replays the model's own errors as supervisory signals during flow-matching training.
nodes.niche_reason: Long-video generation is an active, crowded area.

nodes.title: TROLL: Trust Regions Improve Reinforcement Learning for Large Language Models
nodes.tldr: Replaces PPO-style clipping in LLM reinforcement learning with a differentiable trust-region projection on sparse token logits, giving more stable updates.
nodes.problem: PPO-style clipping is a crude proxy for KL trust regions, causing unstable LLM RL updates.
nodes.approach: Discrete differentiable trust-region projection enforcing token-level KL constraints on the most important logits.
nodes.primary_topic: Reinforcement Learning › RL for LLMs & Reasoning
secondary_topics: Reinforcement Learning › Online & Deep RL Algorithms
nodes.niche_reason: Common LLM RL fine-tuning direction; PPO-variant refinement.

nodes.title: Optimal Sparsity of Mixture-of-Experts Language Models for Reasoning Tasks
nodes.tldr: Shows MoE sparsity affects memorization and reasoning differently: reasoning tracks active FLOPs and tokens per parameter, not just pretraining loss.
nodes.problem: Dense-model scaling laws do not capture how MoE sparsity changes reasoning versus memorization ability.
nodes.approach: Training MoE families that vary total parameters, active parameters and top-k routing under fixed compute budgets.
nodes.primary_topic: Architectures & Training › Mixture of Experts & Sparsity
secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › Pretraining, Scaling & Data
nodes.niche_reason: MoE scaling laws are an active mainstream topic with many variants

nodes.title: TabStruct: Measuring Structural Fidelity of Tabular Data
nodes.tldr: Proposes global utility, a metric that assesses structural fidelity of synthetic tabular data without ground-truth causal graphs, and a 13-generator benchmark.
nodes.problem: Structural fidelity of synthetic tabular data cannot be measured without ground-truth causal graphs.
nodes.approach: Joint evaluation of structural fidelity with conventional metrics via global utility, across 29 datasets.
secondary_topics: Generative Models › Generative Model Evaluation & Theory
nodes.confidence_reason: Metric and benchmark contributions straddle evaluation methodology and datasets.
nodes.niche_reason: Structural fidelity for tabular generators is specialised.

nodes.title: High-dimensional Analysis of Synthetic Data Selection
nodes.tldr: Shows covariance shift, not mean shift, drives generalisation error for synthetic data; covariance matching beats recent selection methods.
nodes.problem: Unclear which properties of generative synthetic data affect classifier generalisation error.
nodes.approach: High-dimensional regression analysis of covariance versus mean shift, with covariance-matching selection.
nodes.primary_topic: Data, Benchmarks & Evaluation › Synthetic Data & Data Curation
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › High-dimensional & Random Matrix Theory
nodes.niche_reason: Covariance-shift theory for synthetic data is specialised

nodes.title: AnyUp: Universal Feature Upsampling
nodes.tldr: AnyUp upsamples any vision feature to any resolution at inference time without per-encoder retraining, setting state of the art while preserving feature semantics.
nodes.problem: Learned feature upsamplers must be retrained for every encoder such as DINO or CLIP.
nodes.approach: Inference-time feature-agnostic upsampling architecture that generalizes across feature types.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › Vision Foundation Models & Self-Supervision
nodes.niche_reason: Feature upsampling is specialised; encoder-agnostic version is less common

nodes.title: Generative Human Geometry Distribution
nodes.tldr: Generates clothed human geometry by encoding flow-matching geometry distributions as 2D feature maps over an SMPL domain, with two-stage latent training.
nodes.problem: Extending single-geometry distributions to large human datasets is non-trivial and inefficient.
nodes.approach: Encode geometry distributions as 2D feature maps over SMPL domain; two-stage flow models in latent space.
secondary_topics: Computer Vision › Human Pose, Avatars & Faces
nodes.niche_reason: human avatar generation is established but specialised

nodes.title: SWINGARENA: Adversarial Programming Arena for Long-context GitHub Issue Solving
nodes.tldr: SwingArena evaluates LLMs adversarially on GitHub issue solving, pairing patch submitters with test-writing reviewers through CI pipelines, with retrieval for long-context code.
nodes.problem: Static benchmarks do not capture collaborative, CI-driven real-world software development.
nodes.approach: Submitter-reviewer adversarial framework with retrieval-augmented code generation across four languages.
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › Code Generation & Software
secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › LLM Evaluation & Benchmarks
nodes.niche_reason: Code agent benchmarks are common; adversarial CI framing is distinctive.

nodes.title: Energy-Based Transformers are Scalable Learners and Thinkers
nodes.tldr: Energy-Based Transformers assign energy to input-prediction pairs and predict via energy minimization, enabling unsupervised System 2 thinking that scales better than Transformer++ across modalities.
nodes.problem: Inference-time thinking approaches are modality-specific, domain-specific, or need extra supervision beyond pretraining.
nodes.approach: Train Transformers as energy-based verifiers and predict by iterative energy minimization.
nodes.primary_topic: Generative Models › GANs, VAEs & Normalizing Flows
nodes.confidence_reason: Energy-based modeling fits generative, architecture and reasoning topics; judgment call.
nodes.niche_reason: Energy-based models are a less mainstream paradigm for scaling transformers.

nodes.title: Hubble: a Model Suite to Advance the Study of LLM Memorization
nodes.tldr: Hubble is an open suite of standard and perturbed LLMs with inserted sensitive text, showing how data frequency, corpus size and timing govern memorization.
nodes.problem: Studying LLM memorization risks needs controlled models with known inserted data.
nodes.approach: Minimal-pair pretrained models with randomized text perturbations at varied scales and training phases.
nodes.primary_topic: Trustworthy ML › Machine Unlearning & Privacy Attacks
secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › Pretraining, Scaling & Data
nodes.niche_reason: Memorization testbeds are specialised but of rising interest.

nodes.title: AgentGym-RL: An Open-Source Framework to Train LLM Agents for Long-Horizon Decision Making via Multi-Turn RL
nodes.tldr: Open framework for training LLM agents with multi-turn RL, plus a staged horizon-expansion method that matches some commercial models.
nodes.problem: Training long-horizon LLM agents with multi-turn RL is unstable and lacks open frameworks
nodes.approach: Modular multi-turn RL framework plus ScalingInter-RL, a staged horizon-expansion training schedule
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › Agents & Tool Use
secondary_topics: Reinforcement Learning › RL for LLMs & Reasoning
nodes.niche_reason: LLM agent RL frameworks are increasingly common

nodes.title: Navigating the Latent Space Dynamics of Neural Models
nodes.tldr: Treats autoencoders as dynamical systems defining a latent vector field via iterated encode-decode, with attractors used to analyze memorization, extract priors and detect OOD.
nodes.problem: Analyzing what neural models encode and how they generalize or memorize
nodes.approach: Iterate encoding-decoding map to get a latent vector field; study its attractors
nodes.confidence_reason: Could also be interpretability; method vs analysis straddles.
nodes.niche_reason: Unusual dynamical-systems lens on latent spaces.

nodes.title: Through the Lens of Contrast: Self-Improving Visual Reasoning in VLMs
nodes.tldr: VC-STaR uses contrastive VQA image pairs to reduce hallucinations in self-generated rationales, yielding a visual reasoning dataset that improves VLM reasoning via fine-tuning.
nodes.problem: Self-improving reasoning for VLMs suffers from unverifiable visual hallucinations in rationales.
nodes.approach: Pair visually similar images with synonymous questions to generate better rationales, then fine-tune on VisCoR-55K.
nodes.niche_reason: VLM reasoning self-improvement is a popular direction.

nodes.title: Uncover Underlying Correspondence for Robust Multi-view Clustering
nodes.tldr: CorreGen frames noisy cross-view correspondence in multi-view clustering as maximum likelihood via EM, inferring soft correspondences and down-weighting unalignable samples with GMM marginals.
nodes.problem: Noisy correspondence (class-level and sample-level mismatches) breaks cross-view consistency in multi-view clustering.
nodes.approach: Generative EM framework inferring soft cross-view correspondences then updating embeddings to maximize expected likelihood.
nodes.niche_reason: Noisy-correspondence multi-view clustering is a narrow niche.

nodes.title: True Self-Supervised Novel View Synthesis is Transferable
nodes.tldr: Shows that self-supervised novel view synthesis needs transferable poses, and XFactor achieves this with latent poses and no 3D inductive biases.
nodes.problem: Prior self-supervised view synthesis poses do not transfer, so the same poses re-render different trajectories across scenes.
nodes.approach: Pairwise pose estimation with input-output augmentation that disentangles camera pose from scene content.
nodes.primary_topic: Computer Vision › 3D Reconstruction, NeRF & Gaussian Splatting
nodes.confidence_reason: Novel view synthesis with self-supervised pose learning; two topics
nodes.niche_reason: Pose-free transferable view synthesis is a specialised niche

nodes.title: Exploring Synthesizable Chemical Space with Iterative Pathway Refinements
nodes.tldr: Projects generated molecules onto synthesizable space by iteratively refining synthetic pathways with a unified autoregressive model and discrete flow edits.
nodes.problem: Molecular generators often produce molecules that cannot be synthesized.
nodes.approach: Bidirectional pathway decoding plus discrete flow editing of whole synthetic pathways.
nodes.niche_reason: Synthesizable molecule generation is specialised within chemistry ML

nodes.title: Distributional Equivalence in Linear Non-Gaussian Latent-Variable Cyclic Causal Models: Characterization and Learning
nodes.tldr: Characterizes when cyclic linear non-Gaussian latent-variable causal graphs are distributionally equivalent, and gives an algorithm recovering models up to that equivalence without structural assumptions.
nodes.problem: Latent-variable causal discovery usually needs strong structural assumptions, and equivalence classes are uncharacterized.
nodes.approach: Graphical equivalence criterion using edge rank constraints, plus a traversal procedure over the equivalence class.
nodes.primary_topic: Learning Theory & Optimization › Causality & Causal Inference
nodes.niche_reason: Structural-assumption-free latent causal discovery with cycles is a rare theory niche.

nodes.title: Compositional Diffusion with Guided search for Long-Horizon Planning
nodes.tldr: CDGS embeds search inside diffusion denoising so composed local generative models explore mode combinations, prune infeasible ones and reach global consistency for long-horizon plans.
nodes.problem: Composing local multimodal generative models averages incompatible modes, yielding incoherent long-horizon plans.
nodes.approach: Population-based sampling, likelihood-based filtering, and iterative resampling between overlapping segments.
nodes.confidence_reason: Planning versus generative sampling placement is a judgment call.
nodes.niche_reason: Compositional diffusion for long-horizon plans is specialised but growing.

nodes.title: Differentiable Model Predictive Control on the GPU
nodes.tldr: A GPU-parallel differentiable MPC solver using sequential quadratic programming and tridiagonal-preconditioned conjugate gradients, with large speedups and a real-car drifting demo.
nodes.problem: Differentiable MPC relies on sequential solvers that are hard to parallelize on GPUs.
nodes.approach: SQP with custom preconditioned conjugate gradient routine exploiting problem structure for GPU parallelism.
nodes.primary_topic: Architectures & Training › Differentiable Optimization & Structured Layers
nodes.confidence_reason: Spans differentiable optimization, control, and RL/IL applications.
nodes.niche_reason: GPU differentiable MPC solver is a rare intersection of control and learning.

nodes.title: EditVerse: Unifying Image and Video Editing and Generation with In-Context Learning
nodes.tldr: Unifies image and video generation and editing in one model, treating text, image and video as one token sequence.
nodes.problem: Video generation and editing remain fragmented from image tasks, with scarce video editing data.
nodes.approach: Joint in-context training on unified token sequences, plus a 232K-sample video editing pipeline.
nodes.niche_reason: Unified image-video generation and editing is a crowded, fast-moving area.

nodes.title: Temporal Sparse Autoencoders: Leveraging the Sequential Nature of Language for Interpretability
nodes.tldr: T-SAEs add a contrastive loss that keeps high-level sparse autoencoder features consistent across adjacent tokens, recovering smoother semantic concepts in language models.
nodes.problem: Sparse autoencoders recover token-specific, noisy concepts that ignore the sequential structure of language.
nodes.approach: Self-supervised contrastive loss encouraging consistent high-level feature activations over adjacent tokens.
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › Language Model Interpretability
nodes.niche_reason: Temporal regularisation of SAEs is a specialised variant.

nodes.title: Conformal Robustness Control: A New Strategy for Robust Decision
nodes.tldr: CRC directly optimises prediction sets under explicit robustness constraints rather than enforcing coverage, yielding less conservative decisions with robustness guarantees.
nodes.problem: Conformal coverage guarantees are sufficient but not necessary for robustness, making decisions overly conservative.
nodes.approach: Optimise prediction-set construction directly under robustness constraints, with efficient solvers and guarantees.
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Generalization & Statistical Learning
nodes.confidence_reason: conformal decision-making sits between uncertainty and robust optimization
nodes.niche_reason: conformal decision-making is a specialised but active area

nodes.title: Why DPO is a Misspecified Estimator and How to Fix It
nodes.tldr: Shows DPO is a misspecified estimator when true rewards are outside the policy class, and proposes AuxDPO with auxiliary variables to approximate RLHF.
nodes.problem: DPO fails under reward misspecification, causing preference reversal and sensitivity to preference data distribution.
nodes.approach: Statistical and geometric analysis of DPO versus RLHF, then AuxDPO adding auxiliary variables to the loss.
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › Alignment & Preference Optimization
secondary_topics: Reinforcement Learning › Reward Learning, Inverse RL & Preferences
nodes.niche_reason: DPO analysis is common, though the misspecification angle is more theoretical.

nodes.title: Modality-free Graph In-context Alignment
nodes.tldr: MF-GIA makes a pretrained graph encoder promptable for few-shot prediction across domains without modality assumptions, using gradient fingerprints to align features and labels in context.
nodes.problem: Graph foundation models struggle with cross-domain alignment when raw modality data is unavailable.
nodes.approach: Gradient-fingerprint-parameterized alignment transforms plus dual prompt-aware attention trained episodically for in-context adaptation.
nodes.niche_reason: Graph foundation models with in-context learning are rare and unusual.

nodes.title: Token-Importance Guided Direct Preference Optimization
nodes.tldr: Improves DPO by weighting tokens with gradient attribution plus a Gaussian prior and adding a triplet loss to guide preferred versus rejected responses.
nodes.problem: Direct preference optimization is noise-sensitive and treats all tokens equally
nodes.approach: Hybrid gradient-attribution token weights plus triplet preference loss
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › Alignment & Preference Optimization
nodes.niche_reason: Crowded DPO-variant space; many token-weighting DPO papers exist

nodes.title: How Reliable is Language Model Micro-Benchmarking?
nodes.tldr: Shows micro-benchmarks often rank model pairs inconsistently with full benchmarks, and introduces a meta-evaluation measure for their reliability.
nodes.problem: Micro-benchmarks cut LLM evaluation cost but may not rank models as consistently as the full benchmarks.
nodes.approach: Meta-evaluation measure of pairwise ranking reliability as a function of the full-benchmark performance gap.
secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › LLM Evaluation & Benchmarks
nodes.niche_reason: Benchmark subsampling for LLMs is a common evaluation topic

nodes.title: Generating metamers of human scene understanding
nodes.tldr: Introduces MetamerGen, a latent diffusion model that generates scenes matching what humans understand after viewing, conditioned on peripheral gist and foveated fixations.
nodes.problem: Generating images aligned with the scene representations humans form from foveated, peripherally degraded viewing.
nodes.approach: Dual-stream DINOv2 tokens fuse fixated detail with peripherally degraded context features, evaluated in a same-different experiment.
nodes.niche_reason: Generating human-perception metamers of scenes is very rare

nodes.title: Addressing divergent representations from causal interventions on neural networks
nodes.tldr: Shows causal interventions push activations off-distribution, separates harmless from pernicious divergences, and adapts a counterfactual latent loss to limit them.
nodes.problem: Interventions for mechanistic interpretability may create out-of-distribution activations that make explanations unfaithful.
nodes.approach: Theoretical analysis of harmless null-space versus pernicious divergences, plus a modified Counterfactual Latent loss.
secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › Language Model Interpretability
nodes.niche_reason: Mechanistic interpretability is established but specialised

nodes.title: OpenApps: Simulating Environment Variations to Measure UI Agent Reliability
nodes.tldr: Open-source ecosystem of configurable app clones that measures UI agent reliability across app design and content variations, with over 10,000 evaluations.
nodes.problem: Agent evaluations use fixed app environments, missing reliability shifts when apps vary in design or content.
nodes.approach: Six lightweight configurable apps generated at scale, running many independent evaluations of multimodal agents.
secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › Agents & Tool Use
nodes.niche_reason: Variation-based reliability testing for UI agents is a rare evaluation angle

nodes.title: Pre-training under infinite compute
nodes.tldr: Studies LM pre-training with fixed data and unlimited compute, finding heavy regularization and parameter plus ensemble scaling cut data needs 5x, with distillation retaining gains.
nodes.problem: How to pre-train language models efficiently when compute outgrows available text data.
nodes.approach: Tune regularization, estimate scaling-law asymptotes, ensemble independently trained models, and distill ensembles into smaller students.
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › Pretraining, Scaling & Data
nodes.niche_reason: Scaling and data efficiency are common, though infinite-compute framing is fresh.

nodes.title: Multimodal Aligned Semantic Knowledge for Unpaired Image-text Matching
nodes.tldr: MASK uses word embeddings as bridges to build prototypes aligning words and visual representations for unpaired image-text matching, with a prototype consistency contrastive loss.
nodes.problem: Unpaired image-text matching fails on out-of-distribution words and suffers variance across word visual representations.
nodes.approach: Word-embedding-bridged prototypes with prototype consistency contrastive loss to regularize the feature space.
secondary_topics: Audio, Speech & Multimodal › Audio-Visual & Cross-modal Learning
nodes.niche_reason: Unpaired image-text matching is a rarer setting than paired retrieval.

nodes.title: Monocular Normal Estimation via Shading Sequence Estimation
nodes.tldr: Reformulates single-image normal estimation as predicting shading sequences with an image-to-video diffusion model, then solves least squares for normals, trained on a new synthetic dataset.
nodes.problem: Direct normal map prediction yields surfaces misaligned with true geometry details under arbitrary lighting.
nodes.approach: Image-to-video generative model predicts shading sequences under varied lighting; ordinary least squares converts them to normals.
nodes.niche_reason: Repurposing video diffusion to predict shading for normals is an unusual formulation.

nodes.title: In-Place Test-Time Training
nodes.tldr: Turns the final MLP projection of LLMs into fast weights updated at inference, with a next-token objective, for adaptation.
nodes.problem: Static train-then-deploy LLMs cannot adapt their weights to continuous streams of new information.
nodes.approach: Chunk-wise test-time weight updates on final MLP projections, with a next-token-aligned fast-weight objective.
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › Long Context & Memory
nodes.confidence_reason: test-time training sits between long-context memory and continual learning
nodes.niche_reason: test-time training inside LLMs is less common

nodes.title: Revela: Dense Retriever Learning via Language Modeling
nodes.tldr: Self-supervised dense retriever training that conditions next-token prediction on cross-document context, weighting attention by retriever similarity.
nodes.problem: Dense retrievers need costly annotated query-document pairs, which are scarce in specialized or reasoning-heavy domains.
nodes.approach: In-batch attention weighted by retriever similarity, so the retriever is optimized through the language modeling loss.
nodes.niche_reason: Training retrievers via language modeling objective is less common than contrastive

nodes.title: EigenBench: A Comparative Behavioral Measure of Value Alignment
nodes.tldr: Benchmarks LLM values comparatively: models judge each other against a constitution, and EigenTrust aggregates judgments into alignment scores without ground truth.
nodes.problem: Value alignment lacks quantitative metrics for subjective traits without ground-truth labels.
nodes.approach: Ensemble of models mutually judge scenario outputs; EigenTrust aggregates these into weighted consensus scores.
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › LLM Evaluation & Benchmarks
secondary_topics: Trustworthy ML › AI Safety & Alignment Research
nodes.niche_reason: Ensemble peer-judgment value benchmarking is a specialised method

nodes.title: Diffusion Language Model Knows the Answer Before It Decodes
nodes.tldr: Shows diffusion language models internally identify correct answers about halfway through refinement, and introduces Prophet, a training-free early-commit decoding method for faster inference.
nodes.problem: Diffusion language models are slow due to bidirectional attention and many refinement steps.
nodes.approach: Detect early answer convergence and commit to the answer early to cut decoding steps without training.
secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › Efficient LLM Inference & Architectures
nodes.niche_reason: Diffusion LMs are an emerging, less crowded alternative to autoregression.

nodes.title: A Representer Theorem for Hawkes Processes via Penalized Least Squares Minimization
nodes.tldr: A representer theorem for linear Hawkes process triggering kernels whose dual coefficients are fixed to one, making kernel estimation far cheaper.
nodes.problem: Estimating triggering kernels of Hawkes processes nonparametrically in RKHS is computationally costly.
nodes.approach: Penalized least squares yields transformed kernels defined by integral equations, with analytically unit dual coefficients.
nodes.primary_topic: Learning Theory & Optimization › Kernels, GPs & Nonparametrics
secondary_topics: Architectures & Training › Time Series & Sequential Data
nodes.niche_reason: Representer theorems for Hawkes triggering kernels are unusual

nodes.title: Sequences of Logits Reveal the Low Rank Structure of Language Models
nodes.tldr: Shows logit matrices over prompts and responses of modern LLMs have low approximate rank, enabling generation via linear combinations of outputs on unrelated prompts, with theory.
nodes.problem: Understanding the inherent low-dimensional structure of language models at a model-agnostic level.
nodes.approach: Empirical low-rank analysis of logit matrices, linear-combination generation, and a sequential-model abstraction with learning guarantees.
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › Language Model Interpretability
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Deep Learning Theory
nodes.confidence_reason: Mixes empirical low-rank structure, generation method, and learning theory.
nodes.niche_reason: Model-agnostic low-rank view of LLM outputs is an unusual angle.

nodes.title: Semi-Supervised Preference Optimization with Limited Feedback
nodes.tldr: SSPO learns from few paired preference labels plus unpaired samples by pseudo-labeling with a theoretically justified reward threshold, cutting labeling costs.
nodes.problem: Preference optimization needs large paired feedback datasets, which are costly to acquire.
nodes.approach: Pseudo-labels unpaired responses using an optimal reward threshold that separates winning and losing responses with high probability.
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › Alignment & Preference Optimization
nodes.niche_reason: Semi-supervised preference learning is a less common twist on alignment.

nodes.title: Global Resolution: Optimal Multi-Draft Speculative Sampling via Convex Optimization
nodes.tldr: Shows two prior multi-draft speculative sampling formulations are equivalent and solves the optimal-transport verification via convex optimization for faster LLM decoding.
nodes.problem: Finding the optimal-transport acceptance criterion for multi-draft speculative sampling is an LP over V^n variables.
nodes.approach: Prove equivalence of importance-sampling and subset-selection formulations, then solve efficiently via convex optimization.
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › Efficient LLM Inference & Architectures
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Optimal Transport & Divergences
nodes.niche_reason: Speculative decoding is popular, but optimal-transport theory is specialised.

nodes.title: Locality-aware Parallel Decoding for Efficient Autoregressive Image Generation
nodes.tldr: LPD speeds autoregressive image generation with flexible parallel decoding using position query tokens and a locality-aware generation order, cutting steps from 256 to 20.
nodes.problem: Next-patch autoregressive image generation is slow and memory-bound.
nodes.approach: Flexible parallelized autoregressive model with learnable position queries and locality-aware generation ordering.
nodes.niche_reason: Accelerating autoregressive image generation is a common topic.

nodes.title: P-GenRM: Personalized Generative Reward Model with Test-time User-based Scaling
nodes.tldr: Personalized generative reward model that derives adaptive personas and rubrics, then clusters users into prototypes to score responses for unseen users.
nodes.problem: Personalized reward models oversimplify preferences and generalize poorly to new users.
nodes.approach: Dual-granularity test-time scaling over individual scoring schemes and similar-user prototypes.
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › Alignment & Preference Optimization
secondary_topics: Reinforcement Learning › Reward Learning, Inverse RL & Preferences
nodes.niche_reason: Personalized generative reward models are a growing but specialized subarea.

nodes.title: AutoEP: LLMs-Driven Automation of Hyperparameter Evolution for Metaheuristic Algorithms
nodes.tldr: AutoEP uses LLMs as zero-shot reasoners guided by online exploratory landscape analysis to adapt metaheuristic hyperparameters, outperforming neural evolution and LLM tuners on combinatorial benchmarks.
nodes.problem: Dynamic hyperparameter configuration of metaheuristics via learning has high sample complexity and poor generalization.
nodes.approach: Combine online landscape analysis feedback with a multi-LLM reasoning chain that generates adaptive hyperparameter strategies without training.
secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › Agents & Tool Use
nodes.niche_reason: LLM control of evolutionary metaheuristics is uncommon.

nodes.title: MedAgentGym: A Scalable Agentic Training Environment for Code-Centric Reasoning in Biomedical Data Science
nodes.tldr: MedAgentGym is a scalable sandboxed environment with 72k tasks for training and benchmarking coding-based biomedical reasoning LLM agents, with offline and online RL boosting Med-Copilot.
nodes.problem: Training and evaluating LLM agents on code-centric biomedical data science lacks scalable interactive environments.
nodes.approach: Executable sandbox tasks with verifiable ground truth and trajectory sampling, used for benchmarking and offline/online RL training.
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › Agents & Tool Use
nodes.niche_reason: Agent gyms are common but biomedical coding focus is specialised.

nodes.title: Benchmarking Empirical Privacy Protection for Adaptations of Large Language Models
nodes.tldr: Benchmarks membership inference and canary extraction on differentially private LLM adaptations; data closer to pretraining leaks more.
nodes.problem: Unclear whether differential privacy protects LLM adaptation data in practice, given pretraining overlap.
nodes.approach: Systematic benchmark varying data distribution from exact overlap to OOD, across adaptation methods and privacy budgets.
nodes.primary_topic: Trustworthy ML › Machine Unlearning & Privacy Attacks
nodes.confidence_reason: Benchmark spans privacy attacks and DP; could fit either topic
nodes.niche_reason: Privacy of LLM fine-tuning is a crowded, active area

nodes.title: Exploratory Diffusion Model for Unsupervised Reinforcement Learning
nodes.tldr: ExDM uses diffusion models to fit replay-buffer distributions, giving score-based intrinsic rewards for exploration in unsupervised RL and theory for fine-tuning diffusion policies.
nodes.problem: Unsupervised RL needs expressive models for density estimation and policy learning on heterogeneous exploration data.
nodes.approach: Diffusion model density estimates yield score-based intrinsic reward, plus algorithms for fine-tuning diffusion policies.
nodes.niche_reason: Diffusion for unsupervised RL exploration is specialised.

nodes.title: MemAgent: Reshaping Long-Context LLM with Multi-Conv RL-based Memory Agent
nodes.tldr: MemAgent reads long text in segments with overwritten memory, trained end-to-end by extended DAPO RL, extrapolating from 8K to 3.5M-token QA.
nodes.problem: Handling arbitrarily long documents without performance degradation during length extrapolation.
nodes.approach: Segment-wise memory-overwrite agent workflow trained with multi-conversation RL (extended DAPO).
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › Long Context & Memory
secondary_topics: Reinforcement Learning › RL for LLMs & Reasoning
Language Models & NLP › Agents & Tool Use

nodes.title: Text-to-3D by Stitching a Multi-view Reconstruction Network to a Video Generator
nodes.tldr: VIST3A stitches a feedforward multi-view 3D reconstruction network onto a latent video generator via model stitching, then aligns them for text-to-3D scene generation.

nodes.title: Enhancing Generative Auto-bidding with Offline Reward Evaluation and Policy Search

nodes.title: Overthinking Reduction with Decoupled Rewards and Curriculum Data Scheduling
nodes.tldr: Reduces overthinking in reasoning models by fixing length rewards with decoupled token-level penalties and curriculum batch scheduling, cutting tokens over 50%.

nodes.title: From Markov to Laplace: How Mamba In-Context Learns Markov Chains
nodes.tldr: Shows a single-layer Mamba learns the Bayes- and minimax-optimal Laplacian smoothing estimator for in-context Markov chains, with convolution enabling this representation.

nodes.title: Neon: Negative Extrapolation From Self-Training Improves Image Generation
nodes.tldr: Fine-tunes a generative model on its own synthetic samples, then reverses the gradient update to extrapolate away from degraded weights, improving image quality.
nodes.problem: Self-training on synthetic data causes model collapse and degrades sample quality and diversity.

nodes.title: Latent Speech-Text Transformer
nodes.tldr: Latent Speech-Text Transformer aggregates speech tokens into latent patches, improving speech-text pretraining data and compute efficiency and scaling.

nodes.title: Vid-LLM: A Compact Video-based 3D Multimodal LLM with Reconstruction–Reasoning Synergy
nodes.tldr: Vid-LLM is a compact video-only 3D multimodal LLM that injects geometric priors via a Cross-Task Adapter and metric depth calibration for 3D scene understanding.
nodes.problem: 3D multimodal LLMs depend on external 3D inputs, limiting scalability and generalization.

nodes.title: Planner Aware Path Learning in Diffusion Language Models Training
nodes.tldr: Derives a planned ELBO for discrete diffusion language models with non-uniform planners and introduces PAPL training, improving text, protein and code generation.

nodes.title: Radiometrically Consistent Gaussian Surfels for Inverse Rendering
nodes.tldr: Adds a radiometric consistency loss on unobserved views so Gaussian surfels learn indirect illumination, enabling inverse rendering and fast relighting.

nodes.title: Latent Particle World Models: Self-supervised Object-centric Stochastic Dynamics Modeling
nodes.tldr: LPWM is a self-supervised object-centric world model that discovers keypoints, boxes, and masks from video and models stochastic particle dynamics for decision-making.
nodes.problem: Object-centric world models have been hard to scale to real-world multi-object video without supervision.
nodes.approach: End-to-end video training with a latent action module for stochastic particle dynamics, conditioned on actions, language, or image goals.

nodes.niche_reason: Latent particle object-centric world models are a specialised, emerging niche.

nodes.title: Online Learning and Equilibrium Computation with Ranking Feedback
nodes.tldr: Studies online learning from ranking-only feedback, proving sublinear regret is impossible in general, giving algorithms under bounded variation, and deriving equilibrium computation.

nodes.niche_reason: Neural theorem proving tooling for Lean is a specialised niche.

nodes.title: Optimistic Task Inference for Behavior Foundation Models
nodes.tldr: Uses an optimistic, UCB-style decision criterion so behavior foundation models can infer unseen reward functions from environment interaction at test time.

nodes.title: Discount Model Search for Quality Diversity Optimization in High-Dimensional Measure Spaces
nodes.tldr: Quality-diversity search that uses a smooth learned model of discount values, so high-dimensional measures such as image datasets still discriminate solutions.
nodes.problem: Histogram-based QD stalls when high-dimensional measures map similar solutions to one cell.

nodes.title: Causal Structure Learning in Hawkes Processes with Complex Latent Confounder Networks
nodes.tldr: Identifies latent subprocesses and causal influences in Hawkes processes via a discrete-time causal view and a two-phase iterative algorithm with identifiability conditions.
nodes.problem: Causal discovery in partially observed multivariate Hawkes processes with latent confounding subprocesses.

nodes.title: Mean Flow Policy with Instantaneous Velocity Constraint for One-step Action Generation
nodes.tldr: Mean flow policy models mean velocity with an instantaneous velocity constraint, enabling one-step expressive action generation for RL and manipulation tasks.
nodes.problem: Flow-based policies trade off expressiveness against compute because action generation needs multiple flow steps.

nodes.title: Cross-Domain Lossy Compression via Rate- and Classification-Constrained Optimal Transport
nodes.tldr: Formulates cross-domain lossy compression as optimal transport with rate and classification constraints, deriving closed-form tradeoffs for Bernoulli and Gaussian sources and validating with deep models.
nodes.problem: Characterizing tradeoffs between rate, distortion, perception, and classification in cross-domain lossy compression.

nodes.title: FlashRNN: Unlocking Parallel Training of Nonlinear RNNs for Large Language Models
nodes.tldr: Parallelizes training of nonlinear RNNs by solving the full recurrence as one system with Newton iterations, scaling LSTM and GRU variants to 7B parameters.
nodes.problem: Nonlinear RNNs cannot be parallelized over sequence length, blocking scaling to large models

nodes.title: Learning with Dual-level Noisy Correspondence for Multi-modal Entity Alignment
nodes.tldr: Studies dual-level noisy correspondence in multi-modal entity alignment across knowledge graphs and proposes a robust learning framework for noisy entity-attribute and cross-graph pairs.
nodes.problem: Multi-modal KG entity alignment assumes clean intra-entity and inter-graph correspondences.

nodes.niche_reason: Multi-modal entity alignment with noisy correspondence is rare.

nodes.title: SANA-Video: Efficient Video Generation with Block Linear Diffusion Transformer
nodes.tldr: Small diffusion transformer generating minute-long 720p video quickly, using linear attention and a constant-memory block KV state.
nodes.problem: Long high-resolution video generation with full attention is too slow and memory-hungry for deployment.
nodes.approach: Linear-attention DiT with block-wise autoregressive generation and a constant-memory KV state.

nodes.title: Probabilistic Kernel Function for Fast Angle Testing
nodes.tldr: Replaces Gaussian random projections with deterministic reference-angle projections, yielding probabilistic kernels that speed up approximate nearest neighbor search.

nodes.title: BIRD-INTERACT: Re-imagining Text-to-SQL Evaluation via Lens of Dynamic Interactions
nodes.tldr: Benchmark for multi-turn text-to-SQL with a database interaction environment, user simulator, and executable tests, where frontier models solve few tasks.
nodes.problem: Existing text-to-SQL benchmarks are single-turn or read-only, missing ambiguity and interaction.

nodes.title: LoongRL: Reinforcement Learning for Advanced Reasoning over Long Contexts
nodes.tldr: LoongRL trains LLMs with RL on KeyChain-synthesized long-context multi-hop tasks, inducing a plan-retrieve-reason-recheck pattern that generalizes from 16K training to 128K contexts.

nodes.title: Mixture-of-Experts Can Surpass Dense LLMs Under Strictly Equal Resource
nodes.tldr: Under equal parameters, compute and data, MoEs with an optimal activation rate beat dense LLMs, and data reuse offsets the extra-data cost.

nodes.title: Decentralized Attention Fails Centralized Signals: Rethinking Transformers for Medical Time Series
nodes.tldr: Replaces attention with a centralized MLP that routes interactions through a global core token, capturing EEG/ECG channel dependencies at linear cost.

nodes.title: Latent Fourier Transform

nodes.title: Learning to Segment for Vehicle Routing Problems

nodes.title: Reducing Belief Deviation in Reinforcement Learning for Active Reasoning

nodes.title: Triple-BERT: Do We Really Need MARL for Order Dispatch on Ride-Sharing Platforms?

nodes.title: Partition Generative Modeling: Masked Modeling Without Masks

nodes.title: Non-Asymptotic Analysis of (Sticky) Track-and-Stop
nodes.tldr: Provides non-asymptotic sample complexity guarantees for Track-and-Stop and Sticky Track-and-Stop in fixed-confidence pure exploration, previously known only asymptotically.

nodes.title: Intrinsic Entropy of Context Length Scaling in LLMs

nodes.title: EmotionThinker: Prosody-Aware Reinforcement Learning for Explainable Speech Emotion Reasoning

nodes.primary_topic: Audio, Speech & Multimodal › Audio & Music Understanding
secondary_topics: Reinforcement Learning › RL for LLMs & Reasoning
nodes.niche_reason: Reasoning-based speech emotion recognition is specialised.

nodes.title: Visual Planning: Let's Think Only with Images
nodes.tldr: Proposes visual planning, where a vision model plans through image sequences trained with GRPO-based RL, beating text-only reasoning on visual navigation tasks.
nodes.problem: Text-only reasoning is a weak medium for spatial and geometric planning tasks.
nodes.approach: Plan via sequences of generated images, with VPRL reinforcement learning applied to a large vision model.
nodes.primary_topic: Reinforcement Learning › RL for LLMs & Reasoning
nodes.confidence_reason: Vision-first planning fits RL-for-reasoning and multimodal topics about equally.
nodes.niche_reason: Planning purely in image space is an unusual reasoning paradigm

nodes.title: Extending Sequence Length is Not All You Need: Effective Integration of Multimodal Signals for Gene Expression Prediction
nodes.tldr: Shows long DNA input hurts gene expression prediction and proposes Prism, which integrates proximal epigenomic signals with backdoor adjustment to remove background-chromatin confounding.
nodes.problem: Long DNA sequence models can hurt gene expression prediction, and simple concatenation of epigenomic signals adds spurious associations.
nodes.approach: Learns multiple combinations of epigenomic features as background chromatin states and applies backdoor adjustment.
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › Causality & Causal Inference
nodes.niche_reason: Causal epigenomic integration for expression prediction is unusual.

nodes.title: Multiplayer Nash Preference Optimization
nodes.tldr: Generalizes Nash learning from human feedback to n-player games with multiplayer Nash preference optimization, improving LLM alignment under heterogeneous and non-transitive preferences.
nodes.problem: Two-player Nash alignment methods have single-opponent bias and miss non-transitive heterogeneous preferences.
nodes.approach: Formulate alignment as an n-player game with population opponents and reference regularization; define multiplayer duality gap.
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › Alignment & Preference Optimization
nodes.niche_reason: Game-theoretic preference optimization is a specialised sub-branch of crowded alignment.

nodes.title: CauKer: Classification Time Series Foundation Models Can Be Pretrained on Synthetic Data
nodes.tldr: Generates causally coherent synthetic time series by combining GP kernel composition with structural causal models, enabling sample-efficient pretraining of time series classification foundation models.
nodes.problem: Time series foundation models need costly pretraining on large curated real-world sequence collections.
nodes.approach: Synthetic generator combining GP kernels and SCMs, with scaling-law experiments over dataset and model size.
nodes.primary_topic: Architectures & Training › Time Series & Sequential Data
secondary_topics: Data, Benchmarks & Evaluation › Synthetic Data & Data Curation
nodes.niche_reason: Synthetic pretraining for time series models is a specialized direction

nodes.title: Overparametrization bends the landscape: BBP transitions at initialization in simple Neural Networks
nodes.tldr: Analyzes the Hessian spectrum at initialization in a teacher-student phase-retrieval setting, showing overparametrization shifts the BBP transition and can bend the landscape.
nodes.problem: Whether gradient descent starts informative about a planted signal in overparametrized models.
nodes.approach: Field-theory spectral analysis of the Hessian at initialization, checked by simulations.
nodes.primary_topic: Learning Theory & Optimization › Deep Learning Theory
secondary_topics: Learning Theory & Optimization › High-dimensional & Random Matrix Theory
nodes.niche_reason: Random-matrix analysis of overparametrized landscapes is rare.

nodes.title: RealPDEBench: A Benchmark for Complex Physical Systems with Real-World Data
nodes.tldr: A benchmark pairing real-world measurements with simulated data across five physical systems, revealing sim-real gaps and benefits of simulation pretraining for scientific ML.
nodes.problem: Scientific ML models are trained and evaluated mostly on simulated data, lacking real-world benchmarks.
nodes.approach: Five paired real/simulated datasets, three tasks, nine metrics, and ten baselines including PDE foundation models.
nodes.niche_reason: Scientific ML benchmark with real measurements is specialised.

nodes.title: ScaleCUA: Scaling Open-Source Computer Use Agents with Cross-Platform Data
nodes.tldr: Builds a large cross-platform GUI dataset via a closed-loop pipeline of automated agents and human experts, and trains open-source computer-use agents across six operating systems.
nodes.problem: Open-source computer-use agents are limited by scarce large-scale GUI interaction data.
nodes.approach: Closed-loop agent-plus-human data pipeline and VLM training on cross-platform GUI data.
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › Agents & Tool Use
nodes.niche_reason: GUI agents are a fast-growing, common direction.

nodes.title: Differentially Private Domain Discovery
nodes.tldr: Shows a simple Weighted Gaussian Mechanism discovers domains near-optimally for private set union, then extends known-domain private top-k and hitting-set algorithms.
nodes.problem: Private algorithms need the item domain, which is unknown in practice.
nodes.approach: Weighted Gaussian Mechanism as a domain-discovery precursor, with missing-mass guarantees for set union.
nodes.niche_reason: Private domain discovery and missing-mass guarantees are a specialised niche.

nodes.title: WoW!: World Models in a Closed-Loop World
nodes.tldr: WoW! is an open closed-loop benchmark testing whether generative world models help embodied agents succeed, finding controllability and action-data post-training matter more than visual quality.
nodes.problem: Open-loop benchmarks judge world models by visual quality, not whether they help embodied agents act successfully.
nodes.approach: Unified online planning with a standard action API across four closed-loop environments, scored by task success.
nodes.primary_topic: Reinforcement Learning › Model-Based RL & World Models
nodes.confidence_reason: Straddles world-model RL, video generation, and robot evaluation benchmark.
nodes.niche_reason: Established area, but closed-loop evaluation of video world models is specialised.

nodes.title: MetaEmbed: Scaling Multimodal Retrieval at Test-Time with Flexible Late Interaction
nodes.tldr: Appends learnable Meta Tokens whose final states serve as flexible multi-vector embeddings, letting users trade retrieval quality for efficiency at test time.
nodes.problem: Single-vector multimodal embeddings lose fine detail, while many-vector retrieval is too costly.
nodes.approach: Matryoshka multi-vector training orders information by granularity for late-interaction retrieval.
nodes.niche_reason: Flexible multimodal embedding retrieval is an active, somewhat specialised area.

nodes.title: The Polar Express: Optimal Matrix Sign Methods and their Application to the Muon Algorithm
nodes.tldr: Polar Express computes polar decomposition with GPU-friendly polynomial iterations adapted per step via minimax optimization, proven optimal and improving Muon on GPT-2.
nodes.problem: Fast low-precision polar decomposition for the Muon optimizer
nodes.approach: Per-iteration minimax-optimal polynomial matrix sign updates, stable in bfloat16
nodes.niche_reason: Numerical linear algebra for optimizers is rare.

nodes.title: RedTeamCUA: Realistic Adversarial Testing of Computer-Use Agents in Hybrid Web-OS Environments
nodes.tldr: RedTeamCUA is a hybrid VM-OS and Docker web sandbox plus benchmark for testing computer-use agents against indirect prompt injection attacks.
nodes.problem: Evaluating prompt-injection risk to computer-use agents in realistic hybrid web-OS settings.
nodes.approach: Hybrid sandbox integrating OS VMs and web apps with adversarial benchmark scenarios.
nodes.primary_topic: Trustworthy ML › AI Safety & Alignment Research
secondary_topics: Language Models & NLP › Agents & Tool Use
Language Models & NLP › LLM Safety & Jailbreaks
nodes.niche_reason: Computer-use agent security is emerging and specialised.

nodes.title: Watch your steps: Dormant Adversarial Behaviors that Activate upon LLM Finetuning
nodes.tldr: Creates LLMs that look benign and perform well, but display adversarial behaviors once a downstream user finetunes them, via meta-learning that simulates finetuning.
nodes.problem: Open-weight models may hide behaviors that only activate after user finetuning
nodes.approach: Meta-learning through simulated downstream finetuning, with regularization keeping pre-finetune models benign
nodes.primary_topic: Language Models & NLP › LLM Safety & Jailbreaks
nodes.niche_reason: Dormant behaviors triggered by downstream finetuning is an unusual threat model

nodes.title: Depth Anything 3: Recovering the Visual Space from Any Views
nodes.tldr: Depth Anything 3 predicts consistent geometry from any number of views with or without poses, using a plain transformer and a single depth-ray target.
nodes.problem: Geometry estimation needs complex specialised architectures and multi-task learning across varying views.
nodes.approach: Plain DINOv2-style transformer with a single depth-ray prediction target, trained by teacher-student distillation.
secondary_topics: Computer Vision › Vision Foundation Models & Self-Supervision
nodes.niche_reason: Foundation depth and geometry models are a crowded mainstream area.

nodes.title: On The Surprising Effectiveness of a Single Global Merging in Decentralized Learning
nodes.tldr: One global model merge at the end of decentralized training greatly improves generalization under heterogeneous data; theory shows merged decentralized SGD matches parallel SGD rates.
nodes.problem: Decentralized learning generalizes poorly under limited communication and heterogeneous data.
nodes.approach: Concentrate communication late, perform one global merge, and prove convergence matching parallel SGD.
nodes.niche_reason: Decentralized learning theory is established but specialised.
